item.title: aswari joshi
item.dc:creator: admin
item.excerpt:encoded: LONDON, United Kingdom: Indian actress Asawari Joshi adjusts her hair between takes while filming the Bollywood production "Hat Trick" in south-west London , 10 November 2006. Love triangles, melodrama and sizzling song and dance numbers have always been vital ingredients of a classic Bollywood film but directors are increasingly adding something else to the mix -- scenes shot in London.The scenes appeal to young Asians raised in Britain who use film as a way of getting in touch with their roots, as well as introducing a note of glamour for audiences in India. A London element also provides a reference point for the growing number of British filmgoers with no family links to India who watch Bollywood films in multiplexes, where they are shown side-by-side with Hollywood hits. Some 35 Bollywood productions were shot in the Westminster area of central London last year alone. AFP PHOTO / ODD ANDERSEN (Photo credit should read ODD ANDERSEN/AFP via Getty Images)

item.title: Sample Page
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
This is an example page. It's different from a blog post because it will stay in one place and will show up in your site navigation (in most themes). Most people start with an About page that introduces them to potential site visitors. It might say something like this:

Hi there! I'm a bike messenger by day, aspiring actor by night, and this is my website. I live in Los Angeles, have a great dog named Jack, and I like piña coladas. (And gettin' caught in the rain.)

...or something like this:

The XYZ Doohickey Company was founded in 1971, and has been providing quality doohickeys to the public ever since. Located in Gotham City, XYZ employs over 2,000 people and does all kinds of awesome things for the Gotham community.

As a new WordPress user, you should go to your dashboard to delete this page and create new pages for your content. Have fun!

item.title: Privacy Policy
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Who we are

Suggested text: Our website address is: https://www.celebritybulaye.com.

Comments

Suggested text: When visitors leave comments on the site we collect the data shown in the comments form, and also the visitor’s IP address and browser user agent string to help spam detection.

An anonymized string created from your email address (also called a hash) may be provided to the Gravatar service to see if you are using it. The Gravatar service privacy policy is available here: https://automattic.com/privacy/. After approval of your comment, your profile picture is visible to the public in the context of your comment.

Media

Suggested text: If you upload images to the website, you should avoid uploading images with embedded location data (EXIF GPS) included. Visitors to the website can download and extract any location data from images on the website.

Cookies

Suggested text: If you leave a comment on our site you may opt-in to saving your name, email address and website in cookies. These are for your convenience so that you do not have to fill in your details again when you leave another comment. These cookies will last for one year.

If you visit our login page, we will set a temporary cookie to determine if your browser accepts cookies. This cookie contains no personal data and is discarded when you close your browser.

When you log in, we will also set up several cookies to save your login information and your screen display choices. Login cookies last for two days, and screen options cookies last for a year. If you select "Remember Me", your login will persist for two weeks. If you log out of your account, the login cookies will be removed.

If you edit or publish an article, an additional cookie will be saved in your browser. This cookie includes no personal data and simply indicates the post ID of the article you just edited. It expires after 1 day.

Embedded content from other websites

Suggested text: Articles on this site may include embedded content (e.g. videos, images, articles, etc.). Embedded content from other websites behaves in the exact same way as if the visitor has visited the other website.

These websites may collect data about you, use cookies, embed additional third-party tracking, and monitor your interaction with that embedded content, including tracking your interaction with the embedded content if you have an account and are logged in to that website.

Who we share your data with

Suggested text: If you request a password reset, your IP address will be included in the reset email.

How long we retain your data

Suggested text: If you leave a comment, the comment and its metadata are retained indefinitely. This is so we can recognize and approve any follow-up comments automatically instead of holding them in a moderation queue.

For users that register on our website (if any), we also store the personal information they provide in their user profile. All users can see, edit, or delete their personal information at any time (except they cannot change their username). Website administrators can also see and edit that information.

What rights you have over your data

Suggested text: If you have an account on this site, or have left comments, you can request to receive an exported file of the personal data we hold about you, including any data you have provided to us. You can also request that we erase any personal data we hold about you. This does not include any data we are obliged to keep for administrative, legal, or security purposes.

Where your data is sent

Suggested text: Visitor comments may be checked through an automated spam detection service.

item.title: About Us
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
About Celebrity Bulaye

Bringing Star Power
To Your Moments

We connect extraordinary events, brands and celebrations with the celebrities who make them truly unforgettable.

Explore Celebrities → Your Gateway To Celebrity Experiences
About Celebrity Bulaye

Where Star Power
Meets Your Vision

Welcome to Celebrity Bulaye, where the magic of celebrity presence awaits you.

Welcome to Celebrity Bulaye, the leading online platform that connects you with the most sought-after celebrities for events and corporate brand endorsements. Our mission is to make your events truly extraordinary by bringing in the star power and charisma of renowned personalities.

At Celebrity Bulaye, we understand the power of celebrity presence in making events memorable, impactful, and unforgettable. Whether you’re organizing a private party, corporate gathering, product launch, or charity event, our platform offers a seamless and efficient way to book celebrities who align with your vision and objectives.

Our user-friendly website serves as a one-stop destination where you can explore an extensive catalog of celebrities from various fields, including film, music, sports, fashion, and more. Each celebrity profile provides detailed information about their expertise, experience, availability, and pricing, enabling you to make an informed decision based on your specific requirements and budget.

Your Gateway To Extraordinary Celebrity Experiences
Celebrity Bulaye

Moments That Stay With You

From celebrity appearances to unforgettable events, explore some of the moments that bring star power to life.

Celebrity Appearance Star Moments Celebrity Bulaye Behind The Moments Celebrity Tushar Kapoor Events & Experiences Unforgettable Experiences Celebrity Bulaye Star Power Celebrity Appearance In The Spotlight Celebrity Suman Talwar Celebrity Special Moments Events Making Memories Celebrity Rimi Sen Celebrity Bulaye Deven Jha Celebrity Experiences The Celebrity Connection A Glimpse Into Our World
```
Celebrity Bulaye

Ready to Make Your Event Unforgettable?

From celebrity appearances to brand endorsements and special events, let us help you bring the right star to your occasion.

Make an Inquiry → Let's create something extraordinary together.

Celebrity Bulaye About Celebrity Bulaye

Bringing Star Power
to Your Special Moments

Welcome to Celebrity Bulaye, where the magic of celebrity presence awaits you.

Welcome to Celebrity Bulaye, the leading online platform that connects you with the most sought-after celebrities for events and corporate brand endorsements. Our mission is to make your events truly extraordinary by bringing in the star power and charisma of renowned personalities.

At Celebrity Bulaye, we understand the power of celebrity presence in making events memorable, impactful, and unforgettable. Whether you’re organizing a private party, corporate gathering, product launch, or charity event, our platform offers a seamless and efficient way to book celebrities who align with your vision and objectives.

Our user-friendly website serves as a one-stop destination where you can explore an extensive catalog of celebrities from various fields, including film, music, sports, fashion, and more. Each celebrity profile provides detailed information about their expertise, experience, availability, and pricing, enabling you to make an informed decision based on your specific requirements and budget.

for Every Occasion

item.title: Udit Narayan
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Udit Narayan

Playback Male Actor

Udit Narayan is a legendary playback singer who has been ruling the hearts of millions for decades. His soulful voice and versatile singing style have made him one of the most successful playback singers in Bollywood. Udit Narayan has lent his voice to numerous hit songs, including "Pehla Nasha," "Dil To Pagal Hai," and "Tum Hi Ho." His melodious voice and impeccable control over his vocals have made him a household name in the industry.

item.title: Sonu Nigan
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Sonu Nigam

Playback Male Actor

Sonu Nigam is a renowned playback singer in Bollywood known for his versatile voice and ability to emote through his songs. He has sung in multiple languages and has a wide range of songs to his credit. Sonu Nigam's soulful renditions and his ability to effortlessly hit high notes make him a favorite among music lovers. Some of his popular songs include "Kal Ho Naa Ho," "Sandese Aate Hai," and "Abhi Mujh Mein Kahin." His melodious voice and impeccable control over his vocal range have made him one of the most celebrated playback singers in the industry.

item.title: Mohit Chauhaan
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Mohit Chauhan

Playback Male Actor

Mohit Chauhan (born March 11, 1966) is an Indian playback singer known for his work in Hindi films. He was a part of the Silk Route band. Chauhan has received two Filmfare Awards for Best Male Playback Singer and three GIMA (Global Indian Music Academy) Awards for Best Male Playback Singer. He has recorded numerous songs for films and albums in various languages and is considered one of the prominent indie-pop singers.

 

Chauhan formed the band Silk Route along with Kem Trivedi, Atul Mittal, and Kenny Puri. Chauhan was the vocalist, Kem played the keyboards, Atul Mittal was the lead guitarist, and Kenny Puri played the drums. Their first album, "Boondein," was released in 1998 and included popular songs like "Dooba Dooba" and "Pahchan." Their second album was released in 2000. After Silk Route disbanded in 2008, Chauhan released another album titled "Fitoor" in 2009.

 

Chauhan's film singing career began in 2002 when he sang the song "Pehli Nazar Mein Dari Thi" for the film Road. His notable songs include "Khoon Chala" from Rang De Basanti and "Tum Se Hi" from Jab We Met. He won the Filmfare Award for Best Male Playback Singer for the song "Masakali" in 2010.

item.title: Jubin Nautiyall
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Jubin Nautiyal

Playback Male Actor

Jubin Nautiyal is an accomplished Indian playback singer and live performer. Born on 14 June 1989, he has garnered recognition and acclaim for his soulful vocals. In June 2022, he won the IIFA award for "Playback Singer (Male)" for the song "Raataan Lambiyan." He was also honored as the Upcoming Male Vocalist of the Year at the 8th Mirchi Music Awards for his rendition of "Zindagi Kuch Toh Bata (Reprise)" from the film Bajrangi Bhaijaan. Additionally, he received the Rising Musical Star Award at the Zee Business Awards.

 

Jubin Nautiyal has recorded songs for films in various Indian languages, primarily Hindi, and is signed to T-Series. His journey in the Indian music industry began in 2011 when he participated in the television music reality show X Factor, where he reached the top 25 participants.

 

He made his debut in the music industry with the song "Ek Mulakat" from the film Sonali Cable in 2014. The same year, he also lent his voice for the song "Meherbani" in The Shaukeens. In 2015, he delivered notable tracks including "Zindagi" for Bajrangi Bhaijaan, "Bandeyaa" for Jazbaa, "Tu Itni Khoobsurat Hain Reloaded" for Barkhaa, and "Samandar" with Shreya Ghoshal for Kis Kisko Pyaar Karoon.

 

Jubin Nautiyal made his Telugu debut with the film Sarrainodu, composed by S. Thaman, and his Bengali debut in the movie Aashiqui.

item.title: Honey Singh
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Honey Singh

Playback Male Actor

Honey Singh, also known as Yo Yo Honey Singh, is a popular Bollywood playback singer, rapper, and music producer. He gained immense popularity with his catchy tunes and rap style. Honey Singh's songs often have a blend of Punjabi and hip-hop elements, making them energetic and dance-worthy. Some of his popular tracks include "Blue Eyes," "Dheere Dheere," and "Lungi Dance." Known for his confident stage presence and catchy hooks, Honey Singh has carved a niche for himself in the music industry.

item.title: Himesh Reshammiya
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Himesh Reshammiya

Playback Male Actor

Himesh Reshammiya is a well-known and highly talented music composer in the Indian music industry. Born on July 23, 1973, in Mumbai, India, Reshammiya has made a significant contribution to the world of music with his unique style and compositions. Reshammiya started his career as a music composer in the late 1990s, but it was his work in the early 2000s that brought him widespread recognition. He is known for his ability to blend different genres of music, including pop, rock, and classical, to create catchy tunes that appeal to a wide audience. His compositions are often marked by a distinct mix of traditional Indian melodies and contemporary beats, which has made him a favorite among music lovers of all ages. Reshammiya's breakthrough came with the film "Aashiq Banaya Aapne" in 2005, where he not only composed the music but also lent his soulful voice to the popular title track. Since then, he has composed music for numerous successful films, including "Tere Naam," "Aksar," and "Bodyguard," to name just a few. His songs have topped the music charts and have become anthems for many. In addition to his work as a music composer, Reshammiya is also an accomplished singer and actor. He has released several albums and has given numerous live performances around the world. His unique nasal voice and charismatic stage presence have won him a dedicated fan following.

item.title: Guru Randhawa
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Guru Randhawa

Playback Male Actor

Gursharanjot Singh Randhawa, known as Guru Randhawa, was born on August 30, 1991. He is an Indian singer, songwriter, and music composer associated with Punjabi, Bhangra, Indi-pop, and Bollywood music. Some of his popular songs include "Lahore," "Ishare Tere," "Slowly Slowly," and "Tere Te."

Guru Randhawa made his debut with the single "Same Girl" in collaboration with Arjun. However, the song did not gain much success for both artists. In December 2012, he released his first single "Chhad Gayi" on YouTube under the label of Speed Records. His elder brother, Ramneek, provided financial assistance for the release of this song.

In 2013, Guru Randhawa released his first album titled "Page One" and unveiled three songs from the album: "Dardan Nu," "I Like You," and "Southall." Although he launched several songs, he did not achieve much popularity during this time. The remaining songs from the "Page One" album, including "Khali Bottlan," "My Jugni," "Maa," "Na Na Na Na Na," "Pyaar Wale Test," "Modern Thumka," and "Billo On Fire," were released in 2014 but did not attain significant success.

item.title: Gajendra Verma
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Gajendra Verma

Playback Male Actor

Gajendra Verma is an Indian singer, composer, lyricist, and sound recordist. He gained significant attention when his song titled "Emptiness," also known as "Tune Mere Jaana," was leaked on the internet with a fabricated story about a dying IIT student named Rohan Rathore. However, Verma claimed that he had composed the song seven and a half years prior to its release. The song garnered widespread popularity and received over 40 million views on YouTube.

 

In 2018, Gajendra Verma released the song "Tera Ghata," which has amassed over 450 million views on YouTube. He has established himself as a prominent artist in the Indian music industry.

item.title: Diljit Dosanjh
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Diljit Dosanjh

Playback Male Actor

Diljit Dosanjh, born on 6 January 1984 in Dosanjh Kalan, Jalandhar, is an Indian singer-songwriter, actor, film producer, and television personality. He is primarily known for his work in Punjabi music and has subsequently made a mark in Punjabi and Hindi cinema. Diljit Dosanjh gained recognition in the Punjabi music industry with albums like "Smile" (2005), "Chocolate" (2008), and "The Next Level" (2009) in collaboration with Yo Yo Honey Singh. In 2011, he made his acting debut in the Punjabi film "The Lion of Punjab." He then ventured into Bollywood with the crime thriller "Udta Punjab" in 2016, for which he received the Filmfare Award for Best Male Debut and a nomination for Best Supporting Actor. He further appeared in films like "Good Newwz" (2019), earning another nomination for Best Supporting Actor. Diljit Dosanjh has achieved significant success in Punjabi cinema, with movies like "Jatt & Juliet 2," "Punjab 1984," "Sajjan Singh Rangroot," and "Honsla Rakh" ranking among the highest-grossing Punjabi films in history. He has won multiple PTC Awards for Best Actor.

item.title: Asha Bhosle
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Asha Bhosle

Playback Female Singer

Asha Bhosle is an iconic Indian playback singer who has made an indelible mark on the music industry with her enchanting voice and versatile singing abilities. Born on September 8, 1933, in Sangli, Maharashtra, India, Asha Bhosle hails from a musical family and is the sister of legendary playback singer Lata Mangeshkar.

 

With a career spanning over seven decades, Asha Bhosle has recorded over 12,000 songs in various languages, including Hindi, Marathi, Bengali, Gujarati, and more. Her mesmerizing voice and impeccable rendition have earned her a prominent place in the hearts of music lovers worldwide. She is known for her ability to effortlessly adapt to different musical styles and genres, ranging from romantic ballads to peppy dance numbers.

 

Asha Bhosle has collaborated with numerous renowned music composers, including R.D. Burman, S.D. Burman, and O.P. Nayyar, to create memorable melodies that have stood the test of time. Some of her popular songs include "Piya Tu Ab To Aaja" from the film "Caravan" (1971), "Dum Maro Dum" from the movie "Hare Rama Hare Krishna" (1971), and "Chura Liya Hai Tumne Jo Dil Ko" from the film "Yaadon Ki Baaraat" (1973).

 

Her immense contribution to the music industry has been recognized with several awards and honors, including the prestigious Padma Vibhushan, the Dadasaheb Phalke Award, and multiple Filmfare Awards.

Asha Bhosle has collaborated with numerous renowned music composers, including R.D. Burman, S.D. Burman, and O.P. Nayyar, to create memorable melodies that have stood the test of time. Some of her popular songs include \"Piya Tu Ab To Aaja\" from the film \"Caravan\" (1971), \"Dum Maro Dum\" from the movie \"Hare Rama Hare Krishna\" (1971), and \"Chura Liya Hai Tumne Jo Dil Ko\" from the film \"Yaadon Ki Baaraat\" (1973).<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

item.title: Alka Yagnik
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Alka Yagnik

Playback Female Singer

Alka Yagnik is an acclaimed Indian playback singer known for her melodious and soulful voice. Born on March 20, 1966, in Kolkata, India, she has made a significant contribution to the Indian music industry. With a career spanning over three decades, Alka Yagnik has recorded songs in various languages, including Hindi, Bengali, Marathi, Punjabi, Gujarati, and others.

She gained prominence in the 1990s as one of the leading playback singers in Bollywood. Alka Yagnik has received numerous awards and accolades for her exceptional singing skills, including seven Filmfare Awards and two National Film Awards. Her collaboration with renowned composers like Nadeem-Shravan, Anu Malik, and A.R. Rahman has resulted in several chart-topping hits.

Alka Yagnik's voice is known for its versatility, allowing her to effortlessly express a wide range of emotions. She has successfully portrayed both the youthful exuberance of romantic tracks and the depth and intensity of emotional ballads. Her popular songs include "Dilbar Dilbar," "Pardesi Pardesi," "Tum Dil Ki Dhadkan Mein," and "Agar Tum Saath Ho," among many others.

item.title: Somlata Acharyya Chowdhury
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Somlata Acharyya Chowdhury

Playback Female Singer

Somlata Acharyya Chowdhury is an Indian Bengali singer known for her contributions to Bengali film music and her work with her band, Somlata & the Aces. She gained fame with the release of songs like "Tumi Asbe Bole" and "Jagarane Jay Bibhabaree" from the Bengali film "Ranjana Ami Ar Ashbona" in 2011. She has been active in the Bengali music industry since 2007.

 

In addition to her work in films, Somlata has released several solo albums with her band. She has garnered popularity for her soulful and melodious voice, earning her a dedicated fan following. Her music is known for its emotional depth and evocative lyrics.

Besides her career in music, Somlata also works as a guest lecturer of Psychology in Asutosh College, Kolkata. This reflects her diverse interests and her academic background in psychology.

item.title: Richa Sharma
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Richa Sharma

Playback Female Singer

Richa Sharma, born on August 29, 1974, is an Indian playback singer known for her work in Bollywood films as well as devotional music. She has received recognition for her versatile singing style and has sung in various genres including Indian classical, light music, ghazals, folk songs, and film songs.

 

Richa Sharma received formal training in Indian classical and light music under the guidance of Pandit Aaskaran Sharma. She expanded her repertoire by adding ghazals, Punjabi and Rajasthani folk songs, and film songs to her singing style, allowing her voice to reach a wider audience with diverse sounds.

 

In 1994, Richa Sharma moved to Mumbai, leaving her academic education behind, to pursue a career in the music industry. She initially sang cover versions and bhajans to sustain herself while struggling to establish herself in Bollywood. Her debut in Bollywood came in 1996 with the film "Salma Pe Dil Aa Gaya," directed by Sawan Kumar. She went on to sing for several films, and her breakthrough came with the song "Taal Se Taal Mila" in the film "Taal," composed by A.R. Rahman.

 

After the success of "Taal," Richa Sharma delivered a series of hit songs in various films, collaborating with renowned composers such as A.R. Rahman, Anu Malik, Ram Sampath, Jatin-Lalit, Shankar-Ehsaan-Loy, Sandesh Shandilya, Vishal-Shekhar, and more. Some of her notable film songs include "Zubeidaa," "Saathiya," "Hera Pheri," "Khakee," "Baghban," "Rudraksh," "Kal Ho Naa Ho," "Gangajal," "Popcorn Khao Mast Ho Jao," "Saawariya," and "Om Shanti Om." She also lent her voice to the popular song "Mahi Ve" in the film "Kaante."

 

Apart from playback singing, Richa Sharma has released several albums to showcase her talent. Albums like "Ni Main Yaar Nu Sajda Kardi," "Piya," and "Winds of Rajasthan" have highlighted the depth and versatility of her voice as a singer.

item.title: Neha Kakkar
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Neha Kakkar Singh

Playback Female Singer

Neha Kakkar Singh, born on June 6, 1988, is an Indian playback singer known for her work in Bollywood films. She is the younger sister of playback singers Tony Kakkar and Sonu Kakkar. Neha started performing at a young age at religious events and gained recognition when she participated in the second season of the singing reality show "Indian Idol" in 2005, although she was eliminated early in the show.

 

Neha Kakkar made her Bollywood debut as a chorus singer in the film "Meerabai Not Out." However, she rose to prominence with the release of the dance track "Second Hand Jawaani" from the film "Cocktail" in 2012. This song catapulted her career, and she subsequently recorded several popular party songs, including "Sunny Sunny" from "Yaariyan" and "London Thumakda" from the soundtrack album of the film "Queen."

 

In addition to playback singing, Neha Kakkar has appeared in several music videos and has been a judge on various television reality shows, including "Indian Idol." She has achieved significant success on YouTube, with billions of views on her videos. In January 2021, she became the first Indian singer to receive a YouTube Diamond Award. Neha Kakkar has also been recognized in the Forbes Celebrity 100 list in India in 2017 and 2019, and she was included in Forbes' list of Asia's 100 Digital Stars in 2020.

 

Neha Kakkar was born in Rishikesh, Uttar Pradesh (now Uttarakhand), and later moved to Delhi with her family in the early 1990s to pursue a career in singing. She auditioned for "Indian Idol" in Mumbai along with her brother Tony Kakkar. Although she got eliminated early in the show, it served as a platform for her to showcase her talent.

 

Throughout her career, Neha Kakkar has collaborated with various music composers and has delivered chart-topping songs. Her energetic and peppy singing style has made her popular among the audience. She has also acted in a film called "Isi Life Mein...!" and has lent her voice to songs in other regional languages like Kannada and Telugu.

Neha started performing at a young age at religious events and gained recognition when she participated in the second season of the singing reality show \"Indian Idol\" in 2005, although she was eliminated early in the show.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Neha Kakkar made her Bollywood debut as a chorus singer in the film \"Meerabai Not Out.\" However, she rose to prominence with the release of the dance track \"Second Hand Jawaani\" from the film \"Cocktail\" in 2012. This song catapulted her career, and she subsequently recorded several popular party songs, including \"Sunny Sunny\" from \"Yaariyan\" and \"London Thumakda\" from the soundtrack album of the film \"Queen.\"<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

In addition to playback singing, Neha Kakkar has appeared in several music videos and has been a judge on various television reality shows, including \"Indian Idol.\" She has achieved significant success on YouTube, with billions of views on her videos. In January 2021, she became the first Indian singer to receive a YouTube Diamond Award. Neha Kakkar has also been recognized in the Forbes Celebrity 100 list in India in 2017 and 2019, and she was included in Forbes' list of Asia's 100 Digital Stars in 2020.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Neha Kakkar was born in Rishikesh, Uttar Pradesh (now Uttarakhand), and later moved to Delhi with her family in the early 1990s to pursue a career in singing. \u00a0<\/p>

Throughout her career, Neha Kakkar has collaborated with various music composers and has delivered chart-topping songs. Her energetic and peppy singing style has made her popular among the audience. item.title: Manjari
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Manjari

Playback Female Singer

Manjari is a versatile Indian playback singer who has made a significant mark in the world of film music. She was introduced to the industry by renowned composer Ilaiyaraaja in the Sathyan Anthikad film "Achuvinte Amma." In her debut movie, she sang two songs, a duet titled "Swasathin Thalam" with Dr. K.J. Yesudas and a solo song called "Tamarakuruvikku." Since then, she has collaborated with esteemed composers such as Ramesh Narayan, Ilayaraaja, M. G. Radhakrishnan, Kaithapram Viswanathan, Vidyasagar, M. Jayachandran, Ouseppachan, Mohan Sithara, and the late Raveendran Master and Johnson Master. Manjari has also lent her voice to albums like Balabhaskar's "Mazhayil Aaro Oral." She has an extensive discography of over 300 songs in Malayalam, Tamil, and Telugu films, as well as several albums.

 

In addition to her work in film music, Manjari is a talented Hindustani classical singer and has performed numerous concerts in India and around the world under the banner of "Soorya." She has also gained popularity as a Ghazal singer and has performed in exclusive Ghazal shows, including the TV program "Khayal" on Media One TV, where she showcased popular Ghazals of yesteryears.

 

Manjari's exceptional vocal talent and contribution to the music industry have been recognized with prestigious awards. She has received the Kerala State Film Award for Best Female Singer twice, in 2004 for the song "Mukilin makale" from the film "Makalku" and in 2008 for the song "Mullulla Murikkinmel" from "Vilapangalkappuram." She has also been honored with the Sahir and Adeeb International Award in 2016 for her contribution to Urdu and the genre of Ghazals. Among the recipients, she was the only Indian and the youngest to receive the award in that year. The Sahir and Adeeb International Award has previously been bestowed upon eminent personalities and legends like Gulzar, Javed Akhtar, Kaifi Azmi, B R Chopra, Shabana Azmi, Sharmila Tagore, and Begum Bushra Rehman.

item.title: Kanika Kapoor
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Kanika Kapoor

Playback Female Singer

Kanika Kapoor, born on August 21, 1978, is an Indian singer known for her contributions to Bollywood playback singing. She was born and raised in Lucknow, India, and later moved to Mumbai in 2012 to pursue a career in singing.

 

Kapoor gained initial fame with her debut song "Jugni Ji" in 2012, which was a music video and became a commercial success. However, her breakthrough in Bollywood came in 2014 with the song "Baby Doll" from the film Ragini MMS 2. The song topped music charts and Kapoor received widespread acclaim for her singing style. She won the Filmfare Award for Best Female Playback Singer for her performance in the song.

 

Following her success, Kapoor went on to deliver a series of hit songs in Bollywood. Some of her notable songs include "Lovely" and "Kamlee" from Happy New Year (2014), "Chittiyaan Kalaiyaan" from Roy (2015), "Desi Look" from Ek Paheli Leela (2015), "Premika" from Dilwale (2015), and "Da Da Dasse" from Udta Punjab (2016). Her melodious voice and peppy singing style made her popular among audiences, and she received several awards and nominations for her playback singing.

 

In March 2020, Kapoor faced controversy when she tested positive for COVID-19 after attending parties in Lucknow despite the Ministry of Health's home quarantine advisory. A complaint was lodged against her for negligence.

item.title: Pritam Chakraborty
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Pritam Chakraborty

Music Composer

Pritam Chakraborty, widely known as Pritam, is a highly acclaimed Indian music composer and playback singer in the Bollywood film industry. Born on June 14, 1971, in Kolkata, West Bengal, Pritam has made a significant contribution to the Indian music scene with his versatile compositions and soulful melodies. Pritam's journey in the music industry began in the late 1990s when he started composing jingles for commercials. He then got his first break in Bollywood with the film "Tere Liye" in 2001, where his melodious compositions garnered attention and appreciation. Since then, there has been no looking back for this talented composer. Known for his ability to blend various musical genres seamlessly, Pritam has created a distinct style that resonates with the masses. Whether it's peppy dance numbers or soul-stirring romantic melodies, Pritam's compositions have an innate ability to strike a chord with listeners. He has worked with some of the biggest names in the industry, including Shah Rukh Khan, Aamir Khan, Ranbir Kapoor, and many others. Pritam's discography is vast and diverse, with numerous chart-topping hits to his credit. Some of his most popular soundtracks include "Dilwale," "Barfi!," "Jab We Met," "Ae Dil Hai Mushkil," and "Yeh Jawaani Hai Deewani." His music has won him several accolades, including multiple Filmfare Awards and IIFA Awards. Apart from his success in Bollywood, Pritam has also ventured into the international music scene. He has collaborated with renowned artists like DJ Snake, Marshmello, and Diplo, and has composed music for Hollywood films like "Inside Out" and "Life in a Metro."

item.title: Salim Merchant
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Salim Merchant

Music Composer

Salim Merchant is a well-known Indian music composer and playback singer who has left an indelible mark on the Indian music industry. Born on March 3, 1975, in Bhuj, Gujarat, Salim Merchant, along with his brother Sulaiman Merchant, forms the famous duo known as Salim-Sulaiman.

 

Salim's musical journey began at a very young age. He started learning the piano when he was just six years old and showed immense talent and passion for music. His dedication and love for music led him to pursue a career in the industry, and he moved to Mumbai to fulfill his dreams.

 

Salim's collaboration with his brother Sulaiman has been immensely successful. Together, they have composed music for numerous Bollywood films, including "Chak De! India," "Fashion," "Rab Ne Bana Di Jodi," and "Kurbaan," to name a few. Their compositions have been widely appreciated for their unique fusion of Indian classical and contemporary music.

 

Apart from Bollywood, Salim has also composed music for several advertising jingles and TV shows, such as the popular theme song for the Indian Premier League (IPL). His versatility as a composer is evident in the diverse range of projects he has worked on.

 

Salim's contribution to the Indian music industry has been recognized and honored with numerous awards, including Filmfare Awards, IIFA Awards, and Zee Cine Awards. His compositions have resonated with audiences, touching hearts and making an everlasting impact.

item.title: Santhosh Narayanan
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Santhosh Narayanan

Music Composer

Santhosh Narayanan is a highly talented and acclaimed music composer hailing from India. Born on May 15, 1983, in Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu, Narayanan has quickly risen to become one of the most sought-after composers in the South Indian film industry. 

 

His foray into the music industry began with his debut film, "Attakathi," in 2012, where his unique style and experimental compositions caught the attention of both critics and the audience. Since then, Narayanan has consistently delivered exceptional music, earning him widespread recognition and numerous accolades.

 

Narayanan's musical style is a blend of various genres, including folk, blues, and rock, with a touch of traditional Tamil music. His ability to seamlessly fuse these different elements creates a distinct sound that sets him apart from his contemporaries. Each of his compositions carries a raw and earthy feel, often capturing the essence of the narrative and characters of the films he works on.

 

Over the years, Narayanan has collaborated with several acclaimed filmmakers and actors, including Pa. Ranjith, Karthik Subbaraj, and Dhanush, among others. His work in movies like "Madras," "Kabali," and "Kaala" has garnered immense praise and contributed significantly to the success of these films.

 

In addition to his film compositions, Narayanan has also been actively involved in independent music projects. His collaborations with renowned artists like Anirudh Ravichander and Gautham Vasudev Menon have resulted in chart-topping hits and further showcased his versatility as a composer.

item.title: Sp Charan
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
S. P. Charan

Music Composer

S. P. Charan, born as Sripathi Panditharadhyula Charan, is a renowned Indian playback singer, actor, and film producer. He hails from a distinguished musical lineage, being the son of the legendary playback singer S. P. Balasubrahmanyam. Following in his father's footsteps, Charan has carved his own niche in the music industry.

 

Charan made his debut as a playback singer in the Tamil film industry and quickly gained recognition for his soulful and versatile voice. He has lent his vocals to numerous chart-topping songs and has collaborated with leading music directors in the industry. Charan's ability to emote through his singing and his exceptional range have garnered him a loyal fan base.

 

Apart from his singing career, Charan has also dabbled in acting and has appeared in a few Tamil films. He showcased his acting skills and versatility by taking on diverse roles. Additionally, he has produced films under his banner, Capital Film Works.

item.title: Vishal Dadlani
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Vishal Dadlani

Music Composer

Vishal Dadlani is a highly talented and acclaimed Indian music composer, singer, and lyricist. With his exceptional musical abilities and unique style, he has made a significant impact in the Indian music industry. Born on June 28, 1973, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, Vishal Dadlani started his career in the 1990s as the lead vocalist of the famous rock band Pentagram. He gained recognition for his powerful voice and dynamic stage presence, making Pentagram one of the most influential Indian rock bands of all time.

 

However, it was his collaboration with Shekhar Ravjiani that truly skyrocketed Vishal Dadlani's career. The duo formed the successful music composing partnership Vishal-Shekhar and went on to compose music for numerous Bollywood films. Together, they have created some of the most memorable and chart-topping songs that have won them accolades and praise from both the industry and the audience.

 

Vishal Dadlani's compositions are known for their versatility and ability to blend various genres seamlessly. From soulful melodies to foot-tapping dance numbers, he has showcased his exceptional talent in creating music that resonates with the masses. Some of his notable works include the soundtracks of films like "Dostana," "Bachna Ae Haseeno," "Chennai Express," "Bang Bang!," and "Student of the Year."

Apart from his composing prowess, Vishal Dadlani is also known for his outspoken nature and involvement in social and political issues. He has been a vocal advocate for various causes and has used his platform to raise awareness and inspire change.

item.title: Amit Trivedi
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Amit Trivedi

Music Composer

Amit Trivedi is a renowned Indian music composer who has made significant contributions to the film industry. With his unique and innovative approach to music, he has managed to carve a niche for himself in the highly competitive world of Bollywood.

Trivedi burst onto the scene with his debut album "Aamir" in 2008, which garnered critical acclaim and established him as a promising talent. However, it was his breakthrough soundtrack for the film "Dev.D" in the same year that truly showcased his brilliance as a composer. The album was a breath of fresh air, featuring a fusion of traditional Indian music with contemporary sounds, and it earned Trivedi widespread recognition.

What sets Trivedi apart from his peers is his ability to experiment with different genres and styles. He effortlessly blends folk, classical, rock, and electronic elements to create mesmerizing compositions that resonate with listeners. His music is known for its infectious melodies, soulful lyrics, and intricate arrangements that capture the essence of the narrative.

Trivedi's talent lies in his ability to understand the vision of the filmmakers and translate it into captivating music. Whether it's capturing the essence of a small-town romance in "Iktara" from the film "Wake Up Sid" or creating the hauntingly beautiful track "Namo Namo" for the biopic "PM Narendra Modi," Trivedi has consistently delivered memorable soundtracks that enhance the cinematic experience.

Over the years, Trivedi has collaborated with some of the biggest names in the industry and has won numerous accolades, including the prestigious National Film Award for Best Music Direction. His songs have become anthems for the youth, and his soundtracks have become synonymous with cinematic success.

Amit Trivedi's musical prowess and ability to push the boundaries of traditional film music have earned him a special place in the hearts of music lovers. He continues to inspire and captivate audiences with his extraordinary compositions, solidifying his position as one of the most talented music composers in India.

item.title: Anu Malik
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Anu Malik

Music Composer

Anu Malik, born on November 2, 1960, is a renowned Indian music director and composer who has made significant contributions to the Bollywood film industry. With a career spanning over four decades, Anu Malik has established himself as one of the most prolific and versatile music directors in India.

 

Known for his ability to create catchy tunes and memorable melodies, Anu Malik has composed music for numerous successful films, earning him accolades and widespread popularity. His compositions often blend traditional Indian classical music with contemporary elements, showcasing his creativity and mastery over various genres.

 

Anu Malik's repertoire includes a wide range of musical styles, from soulful ballads to foot-tapping dance numbers. His collaborations with renowned lyricists and singers have resulted in chart-topping hits that have stood the test of time.

 

Apart from his work in films, Anu Malik has also been a judge on popular reality shows like Indian Idol, where he has shared his expertise and mentored aspiring musicians. His vast experience and in-depth knowledge of music have made him a respected figure in the industry.

item.title: AR Rahman
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
A.R. Rahman

Music Composer

A.R. Rahman is an Indian music composer, record producer, singer, songwriter, musician, multi-instrumentalist and philanthropist, popular for his works in Indian cinema; predominantly in Tamil. He is known for his fusion of Indian classical music with electronic music and world music influences. He has won two Academy Awards, two Grammy Awards, a BAFTA Award, a Golden Globe Award, fifteen Filmfare Awards and seventeen Filmfare Awards South. In 2010, the Indian government conferred him with the Padma Bhushan, the nation's third-highest civilian award.

 

Rahman was born in Chennai, India, in 1967. He began his musical training at a young age, learning to play the piano and violin. He later studied Western classical music at the Trinity College of Music in London. After graduating, Rahman returned to India and began composing music for films.

item.title: Akshat Gupta
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Akshat Gupta

Lyricist

Akshat Gupta is a multi-talented individual known for his work as a writer, lyricist, and entrepreneur in India. Alongside his creative pursuits, he has also ventured into the restaurant industry, owning and managing a chain of restaurants. Akshat Gupta gained recognition as an author with the release of his book titled "The Hidden Hindu," which was published by Penguin Random House India.

 

"The Hidden Hindu" is a book that delves into the exploration of Hinduism from a unique perspective. Through his writing, Gupta aims to uncover the lesser-known aspects of Hinduism, shedding light on its hidden treasures and spiritual depth. The book provides insights into various facets of Hindu philosophy, rituals, traditions, and beliefs, offering readers a deeper understanding of the religion.

 

In addition to his writing career, Akshat Gupta is also recognized as a lyricist, contributing his creative talents to the field of music. He has worked on crafting meaningful and engaging lyrics for songs in the Indian music industry.

 

Furthermore, Akshat Gupta's entrepreneurial endeavors in the restaurant industry have allowed him to combine his passion for food and business. His chain of restaurants offers a unique dining experience, blending culinary excellence with a warm and inviting ambiance.

item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Amitabh Bhattacharya

Lyricist

Amitabh Bhattacharya is a renowned Indian lyricist and playback singer, known for his exceptional songwriting skills in the Bollywood film industry. Born on February 24, 1978, in Lucknow, India, Amitabh has made a significant impact with his lyrical contributions to numerous hit songs.

Amitabh's journey in the music industry began with his passion for poetry and writing. His talent was recognized when he won the National Film Award for Best Lyrics for the song "Emosanal Attyachaar" from the film "Dev.D" in 2010. Since then, he has collaborated with several acclaimed composers and filmmakers, consistently delivering impactful and memorable lyrics.

Known for his versatility and ability to capture the essence of emotions in his words, Amitabh has penned lyrics for a wide range of genres, from soulful ballads to peppy chart-toppers. His ability to resonate with listeners through his heartfelt and relatable words has made him one of the most sought-after lyricists in the industry.

item.title: Prasoon Joshi
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Prasoon Joshi

Lyricist

Prasoon Joshi is an accomplished Indian poet, writer, lyricist, screenwriter, communication specialist, and marketer. Born on September 16, 1971, he is known for his versatile contributions in various fields.

Currently, Prasoon Joshi serves as the CEO of McCann Worldgroup India and Chairman APAC (Asia Pacific), a subsidiary of the global marketing firm McCann Erickson. He is recognized for his expertise in the field of advertising and marketing, and his leadership role in the company.

 

Prasoon Joshi was appointed as the Chairperson of the Central Board of Film Certification on August 11, 2017. In this role, he has played a significant part in guiding and overseeing the certification process for films in India.

 

As a lyricist, Prasoon Joshi has been recognized and honored with several prestigious awards. He has won the Filmfare Best Lyricist Award three times, in 2007 and 2008 for his work in Hindi movies, and again in 2014 for the film "Bhaag Milkha Bhaag." He has also received the National Film Award for Best Lyrics twice, for his contributions to the films "Taare Zameen Par" (2007) and "Chittagong" (2013).

 

In recognition of his remarkable contributions to the fields of arts, literature, and advertising, Prasoon Joshi was awarded the Padma Shri by the Government of India in 2015. This prestigious honor reflects his significant impact and influence in his respective fields.

DJ Angel

DJ

DJ Angel is a popular Indian DJ who is known for her energetic sets and eclectic mix of music. She has been DJing for over a decade and has played at some of the biggest clubs in India, as well as at international festivals.

 

DJ Angel started her career as a drummer in school, but she quickly realized that her passion was for spinning tunes. She began DJing in small clubs and parties, and her popularity quickly grew. DJ Angel is known for her energetic sets and her ability to mix a variety of genres, from Bollywood to EDM. She is also known for her crowd-pleasing skills, and she always knows how to get the party started.

 

In addition to her DJing career, DJ Angel is also a music producer. She has released several singles and EPs, and her music has been featured in films and TV shows. She is also a brand ambassador for several companies, including Red Bull and Bacardi.

 

DJ Angel is a rising star in the Indian DJ scene, and she is sure to continue to be successful in the years to come. She is a talented DJ with a passion for music, and she is sure to continue to entertain audiences all over the world.

DJ Aqeel

DJ

DJ Aqeel is a well-known Indian DJ and composer. He has been in the industry for over two decades and has performed at some of the biggest clubs and festivals in the world. He is known for his energetic sets and his ability to mix Bollywood music with electronic dance music.

 

Aqeel was born in Mumbai, India, in 1977. He started DJing at the age of 16 and quickly became one of the most popular DJs in the city. In 1999, he moved to London to pursue his career as a DJ. He quickly became one of the most sought-after DJs in the UK, and he began to tour all over the world.

 

Aqeel has released several albums and singles, and he has collaborated with some of the biggest names in Bollywood music. He has also composed music for several Bollywood films. In 2017, he was awarded the Padma Shri, one of India's highest civilian awards, for his contribution to music.

 

Aqeel is a true pioneer in the Indian electronic dance music scene. He has helped to bring Bollywood music to a global audience, and he has inspired a new generation of DJs. He is a true icon of Indian music, and he continues to be one of the most popular DJs in the world.

DJ NYK

DJ

DJ NYK, also known as Nikhil Sahni, is an Indian DJ, music producer, radio host, VJ, music career coach, and label owner at Play Life records. He is widely known for his Bollywood remixes, mashups, and his live sets in locations like Lake Pichola and Kerala backwaters.

 

Nikhil Sahni was born on June 15, 1985, in New Delhi, India. He started his DJing career in 2003 at the age of 18. He quickly became one of the most popular DJs in India, and his career has since taken him all over the world.

 

DJ NYK is known for his eclectic mix of music, which includes Bollywood, electronic dance music, hip hop, and pop. He is also known for his energetic live sets, which always keep the crowd entertained.

 

In addition to his DJing career, DJ NYK is also a successful music producer. He has released several albums and singles, and his music has been featured in films and television shows. He is also the founder of Play Life records, a record label that focuses on promoting Indian electronic dance music.

DJ Rink

DJ

DJ Rink is an Indian DJ who has been making waves in the electronic music scene for over a decade. She is known for her energetic sets and her ability to mix a variety of genres, from Bollywood to hip hop to house. DJ Rink has performed at some of the biggest clubs and festivals in India, and she has also toured internationally. She is a role model for aspiring female DJs, and she is dedicated to promoting diversity in the electronic music industry.

 

DJ Rink was born in Mumbai, India, and she began her DJing career in 2006. She quickly gained a reputation for her skills, and she was soon playing at some of the most popular clubs in Mumbai. In 2010, she made her international debut, performing at the Sunburn Festival in Goa. DJ Rink has since toured extensively, performing in countries such as the United States, the United Kingdom, and Australia.

 

In addition to her live performances, DJ Rink is also a prolific producer. She has released several original tracks and remixes, and her music has been featured on some of the biggest electronic music labels in the world. DJ Rink is also a vocal advocate for diversity in the electronic music industry. She is a member of the Women in Electronic Music (WEM) organization, and she is committed to using her platform to promote female DJs and producers.

item.title: Sidharth Malhotra
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Sidharth Malhotra

Sidharth Malhotra is a popular Indian actor known for his work in Bollywood films. Born on January 16, 1985, in Delhi, India, Malhotra started his career in the entertainment industry as a model before making his debut as an actor.

 

Malhotra made his acting debut with the film "Student of the Year" in 2012, directed by Karan Johar. His performance as Abhimanyu Singh, a young college student, received positive reviews, earning him a Filmfare nomination for Best Male Debut. He showcased his versatility by taking on diverse roles in subsequent films, including "Hasee Toh Phasee," "Ek Villain," and "Kapoor & Sons."

 

Known for his good looks and charismatic screen presence, Malhotra has gained a substantial fan following. His performances have often been praised for their intensity and emotional depth. He has showcased his action skills in movies like "Brothers" and "Marjaavaan," where he portrayed intense and rugged characters.

 

Over the years, Sidharth Malhotra has established himself as a bankable star in the industry. With his dedication, charm, and commitment to his craft, he continues to impress audiences and filmmakers alike. His upcoming projects include films like "Thank God" and "Shershaah," where he is set to showcase his acting prowess in diverse roles.

item.content:encoded:
Varun Verma

Fashion Influencer

Varun Verma, the winner of the prestigious title of Mr. Supranational 2019, is an accomplished Indian model and pageant winner. Born on May 6, 1993, in Delhi, Varun has made a significant impact in the world of male pageantry with his remarkable achievements and charismatic presence.

 

Varun's journey to becoming Mr. Supranational began with his victory at the Rubaru Mr. India pageant in 2019, where he earned the opportunity to represent India on the global stage. His exceptional charm, confidence, and dedication propelled him to secure the coveted title of Mr. Supranational 2019, held in Poland.

 

During his reign, Varun exuded elegance, grace, and impeccable style, leaving a lasting impression on the pageant world. His exceptional physical fitness, along with his ability to connect with people from diverse backgrounds, played a pivotal role in his success. Varun's magnetic personality and warm smile made him an instant favorite among fans and judges alike.

 

As Mr. Supranational, Varun Verma took on various responsibilities and ambassadorial roles. He used his platform to raise awareness about important social issues, promote charitable causes, and inspire individuals to pursue their dreams fearlessly. His commitment to making a positive impact in society and his dedication to representing India with utmost pride and grace were evident throughout his reign.

Aditi Rajput's journey on Splitsvilla was filled with ups and downs, friendships, and heartbreaks. Her dynamic presence on the show made her a memorable contestant, and she left a lasting impact on both the audience and her co-contestants.

item.title: Baseer Ali
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Baseer Ali

Fashion Influencer

Baseer Ali is an Indian model and television personality. He is known for winning the tenth season of MTV Splitsvilla and participating in other reality shows such as Roadies Rising and Ace of Space 2.

 

Ali was born in Hyderabad, India. He studied at the National Institute of Fashion Technology in Delhi. After graduating, he worked as a model for a few years. In 2017, he participated in the tenth season of MTV Splitsvilla. He emerged as the winner of the show with his partner Naina Singh.

 

After winning Splitsvilla, Ali participated in other reality shows such as Roadies Rising and Ace of Space 2. He emerged as the runner-up in both the shows.

 

Ali is also an actor. He has appeared in several television shows and web series. He is currently playing the lead role in the Zee5 show Kundali Bhagya.

item.title: Kritika Khurana
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Kritika Khurana

Fashion Influencer

Kritika Khurana, popularly known as That Boho Girl, is a prominent fashion influencer and content creator hailing from India. With her unique bohemian style, Kritika has amassed a significant following and has become a prominent figure in the fashion industry.

 

Born on June 19, 1993, in New Delhi, Kritika began her journey as a fashion blogger, documenting her personal style and fashion choices on her blog and social media platforms. Her vibrant and eclectic fashion sense, characterized by bohemian prints, flowy silhouettes, and statement accessories, quickly caught the attention of fashion enthusiasts worldwide.

 

Kritika's influence extends beyond fashion, as she also shares lifestyle, travel, and beauty content with her audience. Her relatable and down-to-earth persona has garnered a loyal following who admire her authenticity and transparency.

 

Through her blog, YouTube channel, and social media presence, Kritika offers fashion tips, styling advice, and glimpses into her daily life. She inspires her followers to embrace their individuality, experiment with fashion, and express themselves confidently.

 

With collaborations with renowned brands, appearances at fashion events, and her own line of merchandise, Kritika has solidified her position as a respected fashion influencer. Her impact is not only limited to the online world but also extends to offline fashion circles.

item.title: Ankush Bahuguna
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Ankush Bahuguna

Beauty Influencer

Ankush Bahuguna is a well-known beauty influencer and content creator who has gained significant popularity and recognition in the beauty industry. With his expertise in makeup, skincare, and grooming, Ankush has successfully established himself as a trusted source of beauty advice and inspiration.

 

Born and raised in India, Ankush started his journey as a beauty influencer by sharing his passion for makeup and grooming on social media platforms. With his charismatic personality and knack for creating captivating content, he quickly attracted a large and dedicated following.

 

Ankush's content revolves around makeup tutorials, product reviews, skincare tips, and personal grooming advice. He possesses a deep knowledge of beauty products, techniques, and trends, and is adept at simplifying complex concepts for his audience. His ability to effortlessly blend humor and entertainment with informative beauty content has endeared him to his viewers.

 

Beyond his talent for makeup and skincare, Ankush has also used his platform to promote inclusivity and body positivity. He encourages his followers to embrace their unique features and celebrate their individuality, inspiring them to feel confident in their own skin.

 

Through collaborations with renowned beauty brands and participation in industry events, Ankush has established himself as a trusted influencer within the beauty community. His expertise, engaging content, and relatable approach have earned him the trust and admiration of his followers.

item.title: Anmol Bhatia
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Anmol Bhatia

Beauty Influencer

Anmol Bhatia, also known as The Style Bug, is an influential Indian blogger and social media personality. Born on August 16th, 1995, in New Delhi, India, she has made a name for herself in the fashion and beauty industry. With a degree in Commerce from Delhi College of Arts and Commerce, Anmol showcases her creativity and expertise through her engaging social media content.

 

At the age of 27, Anmol has established a significant presence on platforms like Instagram and YouTube, where she shares her fashion, lifestyle, and makeup tips with her dedicated followers. Her content resonates with her audience, and she has collaborated with various well-known brands.

 

Anmol is known for her friendships within the industry, including notable individuals like Awez Darbar, Ankita Chhetri, and Musskan Sethi. Her social media channels, particularly her YouTube channel under her own name, serve as platforms for her to express her passion for fashion, lifestyle, and makeup. She creates compelling content that is admired by her large and loyal fanbase.

 

Anmol Bhatia's influence extends beyond her content creation as she continues to inspire and guide her followers with her fashion-forward ideas and beauty expertise. With her creativity, style, and collaborations with renowned brands, Anmol has become a notable figure in the Indian influencer community.

item.title: Fiza Abdi
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Fizza Abdi

Beauty Influencer

Fizza Abdi is an Indian makeup artist and social media influencer who has gained significant popularity for her content on platforms like TikTok and YouTube. With a TikTok following of 4.2 million fans, she captivates her audience with a mix of comedy skits and beauty tips. On YouTube, she has amassed over 220,000 subscribers and shares makeup tutorials.

 

Fizza made her YouTube debut in May 2017 with a video titled "FLOWER GODDESS / NYX Face Awards INDIA." Since then, her content has gained traction, and her video titled "Bridal Makeup (Sangeet/Haldi) Makeup Tutorial" surpassed 100,000 views within a month of its release in 2019.

 

Although there is limited information available about Fizza's personal life, she did upload a tribute photo of her father on Instagram in March 2019, showcasing the importance of family to her.

 

Fizza Abdi has also had the opportunity to interact with notable individuals. In December 2019, she shared a picture with actor Kartik Aaryan on social media, indicating her association with popular figures in the industry. With her engaging content and growing fan base, Fizza continues to make a mark in the world of beauty and social media influence.

item.title: Amish Tripathi
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Amish Tripathi

Motivational Speaker

Amish Tripathi is an Indian author and diplomat known for his bestselling books, including the Shiva Trilogy and Ram Chandra Series. Born on October 18, 1974, in Mumbai, he grew up near Rourkela, Odisha. Tripathi attended Cathedral & John Connon School, St. Xavier's College in Mumbai, and the Indian Institute of Management Calcutta.

Tripathi's writing career took off with the publication of his first novel, "The Immortals of Meluha," in February 2010. This book marked the beginning of the Shiva Trilogy, with the subsequent novels "The Secret of the Nagas" (2011) and "The Oath of the Vayuputras" (2013) completing the series.

In June 2015, Tripathi released "The Scion of Ikshvaku," the first book in the Ram Chandra Series, which serves as a prequel to the Shiva Trilogy. The series continued with "Sita: Warrior of Mithila" (2017), "Raavan: The Enemy of Aryavarta" (2019), and "War of Lanka" (2022). He also ventured into historical fiction with "Legend of Suheldev: The King Who Saved India" in June 2020.

Aside from fiction, Tripathi has written non-fiction books such as "Immortal India" (2017) and "Dharma: Decoding the Epics for a Meaningful Life" (2020). His works have been widely translated into regional and international languages, making them accessible to a broader audience.

item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Sudhir Chaudhary

Media Person

Sudhir Chaudhary is an Indian journalist. He is a consulting editor for Hindi news channel Aaj Tak and hosts the show Black & White. He was previously the Editor-in-Chief and CEO of Zee News, WION, Zee Business, Zee 24 Taas and anchored the prime-time show Daily News & Analysis on Zee News.

item.title: Bharti Singh
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Bharti Singh

Bollybood

Bharti Singh is an Indian comedian and television personality. She is known for her work in stand-up comedy, television shows, and films. Singh began her career as a stand-up comedian in 2008, and she quickly became one of the most popular comedians in India. She has appeared in several stand-up comedy shows, including The Great Indian Laughter Challenge, Comedy Circus, and Comedy Nights Bachao. Singh has also hosted several award shows, including the Filmfare Awards and the IIFA Awards.

 

In addition to her work in stand-up comedy and hosting, Singh has also appeared in several television shows. She has had recurring roles in shows such as Pyaar Mein Twist, Comedy Nights with Kapil, and The Kapil Sharma Show. Singh has also starred in several films, including Nanhe Jaisalmer, Singh Saab the Great, and Housefull 4.

 

Singh is known for her quick wit and her ability to make people laugh. She is also known for her positive attitude and her willingness to talk about her personal life. Singh is a role model for many young people, and she is an inspiration to anyone who dreams of pursuing a career in comedy.

Ali Asgar

Bollybood

Ali Asgar is a talented Bollywood actor known for his versatile roles in the Indian film industry. Born on December 25, 1966, he started his career as a stand-up comedian and gained popularity with his impeccable comic timing. 

 

Ali has appeared in numerous films, showcasing his acting prowess in both comedic and dramatic roles. He has been a part of successful movies like "Partner," "Judwaa," and "Housefull 3," where his performances have garnered praise.

 

With his charming personality and ability to effortlessly bring humor to the screen, Ali Asgar has become a beloved figure in Bollywood, known for his entertaining performances.

item.title: Jhoney Lever
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Johnny Lever

Bollybood

Johnny Lever, often referred to as the "King of Comedy," is a veteran comedian and actor in the Indian film industry. With his impeccable comic timing and versatile range of expressions, Johnny has entertained audiences for decades. He made his acting debut in the film "Tum Par Hum Qurban" and quickly gained recognition for his talent.

 

 Johnny's ability to effortlessly switch between different accents and dialects, along with his spot-on mimicry skills, made him a crowd favorite. He has collaborated with leading actors and directors, delivering hilarious performances in films like "Baazigar," "Dulhe Raja," and "Hera Pheri." Johnny's performances in comedy shows, stage plays, and live events have further solidified his position as one of the finest comedians in the industry.

 

His contributions to Indian cinema have been acknowledged with several awards and accolades. Johnny Lever's infectious laughter and rib-tickling humor continue to make him an integral part of Bollywood's comedy landscape.

item.content:encoded:
Kapil Sharma

Bollybood

Kapil Sharma is a well-known Indian comedian, actor, and television host. Born on April 2, 1981, in Amritsar, Punjab, he rose to fame with his comedy show "Comedy Nights with Kapil" and later with "The Kapil Sharma Show." Known for his impeccable comic timing, Kapil Sharma has brought laughter to millions of viewers with his hilarious sketches and interactions with celebrity guests.

 

With his witty humor and ability to connect with the audience, Kapil Sharma has become one of the most popular comedians in India. His unique style of comedy, which includes spontaneous one-liners, funny characters, and humorous skits, has earned him a massive fan following. He has a natural talent for entertaining people and has received numerous accolades for his contributions to the comedy genre.

item.content:encoded:
Rajpal Yadav

Bollybood

Rajpal Yadav is an exceptionally talented comedian who has left an indelible mark on the world of Indian cinema. With his unique brand of humor and impeccable timing, he has earned a special place in the hearts of audiences. Rajpal's ability to effortlessly blend physical comedy with witty dialogue is a testament to his versatility as an actor. Known for his extraordinary comic timing, Rajpal has a knack for extracting laughter from the simplest of situations. His facial expressions, body language, and hilarious mannerisms have become iconic, making him instantly recognizable on screen. Whether it's playing the lovable bumbling sidekick or the eccentric character, Rajpal's performances are consistently uproarious. Beyond his comedic prowess, Rajpal Yadav possesses a remarkable range as an actor, seamlessly transitioning between comedy and drama. He has showcased his talent in a wide variety of films, proving his versatility and depth as an artist. Rajpal Yadav's contributions to comedy in Indian cinema have made him a beloved figure, adored by audiences of all ages. His infectious energy and ability to bring a smile to people's faces make him a true gem in the world of entertainment.

item.title: Manoj Pahwa
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Manoj Pahwa

Bollybood

Manoj Pahwa is a highly acclaimed Indian actor known for his remarkable performances in Bollywood. Born on September 1, 1963, in Delhi, India, Manoj has showcased his versatility and acting prowess through a wide range of roles in films, television, and theater.

 

Manoj's memorable roles include his portrayal of a strict father in the film "Sehar," a comic character in "Chup Chup Ke," and a lovable uncle in "Jolly LLB 2." He has worked with renowned directors like Anurag Kashyap, Shoojit Sircar, and Rajkumar Hirani, showcasing his ability to bring depth and authenticity to his characters.

 

Apart from films, Manoj has also made a mark in Indian television and theater. He has appeared in popular TV shows like "Office Office" and "Flop Show" and has been associated with notable theater productions.

 

With his impeccable comic timing, powerful performances, and the ability to effortlessly switch between intense and light-hearted roles, Manoj Pahwa has established himself as a respected and versatile actor in Bollywood.

item.title: Sanjay Mishra
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Sanjay Mishra

Bollybood

Sanjay Mishra is a comedian par excellence, known for his exceptional wit and impeccable timing. With his unique style, he has carved a niche for himself in the world of comedy. Mishra's performances are a delightful blend of observational humor, satire, and flawless mimicry, leaving audiences in splits.

 

What sets Mishra apart is his ability to effortlessly switch between various characters and accents, bringing them to life on stage. His mastery over body language and facial expressions adds an extra layer of hilarity to his acts. Whether he's mimicking politicians, celebrities, or common people, Mishra's spot-on impersonations never fail to elicit roaring laughter.

Beyond his remarkable comedic skills, Mishra possesses a natural charm and affability that endears him to his fans. He has the remarkable ability to find humor in everyday situations, turning mundane experiences into uproarious anecdotes. His jokes often carry a social commentary, cleverly highlighting societal quirks and absurdities.

item.title: Shakti Kapoor
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Shakti Kapoor

Bollybood

Shakti Kapoor is a renowned veteran Bollywood actor who has made a significant contribution to the Indian film industry with his versatile performances and iconic screen presence. Born as Sunil Sikanderlal Kapoor on July 3, 1952, in Delhi, India, Shakti Kapoor has become a household name in the realm of Hindi cinema.

 

Known for his impeccable comic timing and ability to portray eccentric and villainous characters, Shakti Kapoor has established himself as one of the most versatile actors in Bollywood. He has appeared in over 700 films, leaving a lasting impact with his memorable portrayals.

 

Shakti Kapoor's notable roles include comic characters in films like "Andaz Apna Apna" and "Raja Babu," as well as negative roles in movies such as "Qurbani" and "Judwaa." He has also showcased his acting range in dramatic films like "Aankhen" and "Dongri Ka Raja."

 

Apart from his acting career, Shakti Kapoor has appeared in various television shows and reality programs. His energetic and spirited performances, coupled with his unique voice, have made him a recognizable figure in Indian entertainment.

item.title: Sunil Garover
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Sunil Grover

Bollybood

Sunil Grover is an Indian actor and comedian who works in Hindi and Punjabi films and television. He came into limelight for his portrayal as Gutthi on television show Comedy Nights with Kapil but gained popularity for playing the role of Dr Mashhoor Gulati and Rinku Devi on The Kapil Sharma Show. He was also seen in Bollywood films Gabbar Is Back, The Legend of Bhagat Singh and Bharat.

 

Grover was born in Mandi Dabwali, Haryana, India. He studied at the National School of Drama in Delhi. After graduating, he started his career as a theater actor. He then moved to Mumbai and started working in television. He made his television debut with the show Comedy Circus. He then went on to star in shows like Comedy Nights with Kapil and The Kapil Sharma Show.

 

Grover is known for his comic timing and his ability to mimic celebrities. He has won several awards for his work, including the Indian Telly Award for Best Actor in a Comedy Series and the Filmfare Award for Best Actor in a Comic Role.

 

Grover is a versatile actor who can play a variety of roles. He is also a talented mimic and has been praised for his ability to imitate celebrities like Amitabh Bachchan and Shah Rukh Khan. Grover is a popular comedian and is loved by audiences all over India. He is known for his ability to make people laugh and his unique sense of humor.

item.title: Surendra Sharma
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Surendra Sharma

Bollybood

Surendra Sharma is an Indian poet, writer, and humorist. He is known for his comic sketches of himself and his wife, and for his use of the Haryanavi dialect. He has been performing comedy for over 50 years, and is considered one of the most popular comedians in India.

 

Sharma was born in Haryana in 1947. He studied commerce at Shri Ram College of Commerce in Delhi, and began performing poetry in college. He started performing comedy professionally in the 1970s, and his first cassette, "Chaar Laina Kavi," was released in 1980.

 

Sharma's comedy is observational and witty. He often talks about everyday life, relationships, and marriage. He is known for his dry humor and his ability to find the funny side of even the most mundane situations.

 

Sharma has performed all over India, and has also toured in the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom. He has won numerous awards for his comedy, including the Padma Shri, India's fourth-highest civilian award.

 

Sharma is a popular and respected figure in the Indian comedy scene. He is known for his sharp wit, his observational humor, and his ability to make people laugh. He is a true master of his craft, and his work continues to entertain and enlighten audiences around the world.

 

Sharma's jokes are often funny because they are relatable. He talks about the things that everyone experiences, like marriage, relationships, and everyday life. His humor is also universal, and people from all over the world can relate to his jokes.

item.content:encoded:
Sunil Pal

Bollybood

Sunil Pal is a popular Bollywood comedian known for his distinctive style and humorous performances. With his quick wit and impeccable comic timing, he has entertained audiences with his hilarious acts.

 

Sunil Pal's ability to effortlessly deliver punchlines and engage viewers with his energetic stage presence has made him a beloved figure in the Indian film industry. He has showcased his comedic talents in movies and television shows, leaving a lasting impression with his unique brand of humor.

 

Sunil Pal's infectious laughter and ability to bring joy to audiences through his comedic genius have firmly established him as a celebrated comedian in Bollywood.

item.title: Sugandha Mishra
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Sugandha Mishra

Bollybood

Sugandha Mishra is an Indian actress, playback singer, television presenter, comedian, and radio jockey. She is known for her character in The Kapil Sharma Show. She was also noticed for her appearance in the TV reality show The Great Indian Laughter Challenge.

 

Sugandha Mishra was born on 23 May 1988 in Jalandhar, Punjab, India. She started her career as a radio jockey and worked with BIG FM India. After that, she started her singing career and sang many jingles, bhajans, and songs in many documentaries, plays, and short films. She also made her appearance in the famous TV reality show Sa Re Ga Ma Pa Singing Superstar as a participant and became third-runner up in the show. After that, she appeared in the TV comedy show The Great Indian Laughter Challenge as a participant and became one of the finalists in the show. Apart from that she also gave her voice in Bollywood songs in the movies like Shree and Kamaal Dhamaal Malamaal.

 

Sugandha Mishra is a versatile artist and has a wide range of talents. She is a talented singer, comedian, and actor. She is also a good mimic and can imitate many famous personalities. She is a popular artist and has a large fan following. She is known for her witty humor and her ability to make people laugh. She is a rising star in the Indian entertainment industry and is sure to achieve great things in the future.

item.title: Salman khan
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Salman Khan

Bollywood Male Actor

Salman Khan, often referred to as the "Bhaijaan" of Bollywood, is one of the biggest superstars in the Indian film industry. With a career spanning over three decades, Salman Khan has established himself as a versatile actor, producer, and philanthropist. Known for his charisma, unique style, and larger-than-life persona, Salman Khan has delivered numerous blockbuster hits, including "Hum Aapke Hain Koun..!", "Bajrangi Bhaijaan," and the "Dabangg" franchise.

 

He is celebrated for his action-packed roles, impeccable comic timing, and his ability to connect with the masses. Salman Khan's performances often strike a perfect balance between entertainment and emotion, earning him a massive fan following. Apart from his acting prowess, Salman Khan is also involved in various charitable initiatives. He runs the "Being Human" foundation, which aims to provide healthcare and education to the underprivileged.

 

Salman Khan's philanthropic endeavors have earned him widespread admiration and respect.
