item.title: Aisha Sharma
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Aisha Sharma

Bollywood Female Actor

Aisha Sharma is an Indian actress and model who was born on January 25, 1989 in Bhagalpur, Bihar, India. She started her career as a model and went on to become a prominent face for many popular brands including Lakme, Pepsi and Campus shoes. In 2016, she was featured as one of the Kingfisher Calendar Girls.

 

Sharma made her acting debut in the 2018 Hindi action thriller Satyamev Jayate alongside John Abraham and Manoj Bajpayee. She played the role of Shikha, a police officer who is assigned to investigate a series of murders. Sharma's performance was well-received by critics and audiences alike.

 

In 2019, Sharma starred in the action thriller Commando 3 alongside Vidyut Jammwal. She played the role of Avantika, a woman who is kidnapped by a terrorist group. Sharma's performance was praised by critics for her action sequences and her chemistry with Jammwal.

 

Sharma is a rising star in the Hindi film industry and is known for her beauty, talent and action skills. She is sure to have a long and successful career in the years to come.

item.title: Alaya Furniturewala
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Alaya Furniturewala

Bollywood Female Actor

Alaya Furniturewala is an Indian actress who appears in Hindi films. She was born on 28 November 1997 in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India to actress Pooja Bedi and businessman Farhan Furniturewala. She is the granddaughter of actor Kabir Bedi and classical dancer Protima Bedi. She studied at Jamnabai Narsee School in Mumbai. Before making her film debut, she earned a diploma in acting at the New York Film Academy and later changed her name to Alaya F. She is presently training to be a contemporary and kathak dancer.

 

Alaya Furniturewala made her acting debut in 2020 with the comedy film Jawaani Jaaneman, opposite Saif Ali Khan. The film was a commercial success and she was praised for her performance. She won the Filmfare Award for Best Female Debut for her performance. She has since starred in the thriller Freddy (2022).

 

Alaya Furniturewala is a rising star in the Hindi film industry. She is known for her beauty, talent, and charisma. She is also a fashion icon and has been featured in several magazines and fashion shows. She is a role model for young women and is an inspiration to many.

 

Alaya Furniturewala is a versatile actress and is capable of playing a variety of roles. She is a rising star and is sure to have a successful career in the Hindi film industry.

item.title: Amy Jackson
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Amy Jackson

Bollywood Female Actor

my Louise Jackson is a British actress and model who is known for her work in Indian films, predominantly in Tamil films, along with a few Hindi, Kannada and Telugu films. A former Miss Teen World, Jackson has appeared in over fifteen films. She made her US debut in 2017 with Warner Brothers television production of DC Comics Supergirl as Imra Ardeen/ Saturn Girl.

 

Jackson was born in Douglas, Isle of Man, to a British father and an Indian mother. She began her modeling career at the age of 13 and was crowned Miss Teen World in 2009. In 2010, she made her acting debut in the Tamil film 'Madraspattinam'. She went on to star in several other Tamil films, including 'Ethir Neechal', 'I', 'Singh is Bling' and '2.0'. She has also appeared in a few Hindi films, including 'Freaky Ali' and 'Boogie Man'.

 

In 2017, Jackson made her US debut in the television series Supergirl. She played the role of Imra Ardeen/ Saturn Girl, a member of the Legion of Superheroes. The series ran for four seasons and ended in 2021.

 

Jackson is a patron for charities such as "The Sneha Sargar Orphanage for girls". In 2018, she was honoured with the United Nations' International Day of The Girl Child award in London. Jackson is a proclaimed vegan animal rights advocate and has been an ambassador for PETA since 2016 as well as supporting The Elephant Family with their mission to aid human-animal conflict primarily in Asia.

item.title: Ananya Panday
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Ananya Panday

Bollywood Female Actor

Ananya Panday is an Indian actress who works in Hindi films. She is the daughter of actor Chunky Panday and costume designer Bhavana Panday. She made her acting debut in 2019 with the teen film Student of the Year 2, for which she won the Filmfare Award for Best Female Debut. She has since starred in the films Pati Patni Aur Woh (2019), Khaali Peeli (2020), and Gehraiyaan (2022).

 

Panday was born in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India, on October 30, 1998. She attended Dhirubhai Ambani International School and then the University of Southern California, where she studied business administration. In 2017, she participated in Vanity Fair's Le Bal des débutantes event in Paris.

 

Panday's acting career began in 2019 with the release of Student of the Year 2, a sequel to the 2012 film Student of the Year. The film was a commercial success and Panday's performance was praised by critics. She won the Filmfare Award for Best Female Debut for her performance.

 

In 2019, Panday also starred in the comedy Pati Patni Aur Woh, opposite Kartik Aaryan and Bhumi Pednekar. The film was a commercial success and Panday's performance was praised by critics.

 

In 2020, Panday starred in the action thriller Khaali Peeli, opposite Ishaan Khattar. The film was a commercial failure but Panday's performance was praised by critics.

item.title: Aaditi Pohankar
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Aaditi Pohankar

Bollywood Female Actor

Aaditi Pohankar is an Indian actress who primarily works in Hindi cinema. She had her breakthrough role alongside Riteish Deshmukh in the Marathi action film Lai Bhaari (2014). To date, she has worked only in two films and two television series.

 

Pohankar was born on December 31, 1994, in Mumbai, Maharashtra. She is the daughter of Sudhir and Shobha Pohankar, both of whom are athletes. Pohankar herself was a talented athlete in her school days, representing Maharashtra in athletics and winning medals in the 100 meters and 200 meters races.

 

After completing her schooling, Pohankar moved to Mumbai to pursue a career in acting. She enrolled in the Kishore Namit Kapoor Acting Institute and graduated in 2012. After graduating, Pohankar started her career as a theatre actor, working with veteran theatre actor Makrand Deshpande. She was also mentored by Pandit Satyadev Dubey and participated in many stage plays in Mumbai.

 

Pohankar's first break in the Hindi film industry came with the movie LSD: Love, Sex Aur Dhokha (2010). She played a small role in the film, but her performance was noticed by many. Her next film was the Marathi action film Lai Bhaari (2014), in which she played a negative role opposite Riteish Deshmukh. Her performance in the film was critically acclaimed and she won the IMFAA Award for Best Debutant Female for her performance.

 

In 2017, Pohankar made her television debut with the web series Sacred Games. She played the role of constable Anjali Mathur in the series and her performance was praised by critics and audiences alike. She reprised her role in the second season of the series, which was released in 2019.

 

In 2020, Pohankar starred in the web series She. She played the role of a police officer who goes undercover to infiltrate a sex trafficking ring. Her performance in the series was critically acclaimed and she won the Filmfare OTT Award for Best Actress for her performance.

Aaditi Pohankar is an Indian actress who primarily works in Hindi cinema. She had her breakthrough role alongside Riteish Deshmukh in the Marathi action film Lai Bhaari (2014). To date, she has worked only in two films and two television<\/span>\u00a0series.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Pohankar was born on December 31, 1994, in Mumbai, Maharashtra. She is the daughter of Sudhir and Shobha Pohankar, both of whom are athletes. Pohankar herself was a talented athlete in her school days, representing Maharashtra in athletics and winning medals in the 100 meters and 200 meters races.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

After completing her schooling, Pohankar moved to Mumbai to pursue a career in acting. She enrolled in the Kishore Namit Kapoor Acting Institute and graduated in 2012. After graduating, Pohankar started her career as a theatre actor, working with veteran theatre actor Makrand Deshpande. She was also mentored by Pandit Satyadev Dubey and participated in many stage plays in Mumbai.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Pohankar's first break in the Hindi film industry came with the movie LSD: Love, Sex Aur Dhokha (2010). She played a small role in the film, but her performance was noticed by many. Her next film was the Marathi action film Lai Bhaari (2014), in which she played a negative role opposite Riteish Deshmukh. Her performance in the film was critically acclaimed and she won the IMFAA Award for Best Debutant Female for her performance.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

In 2017, Pohankar made her television debut with the web series Sacred Games. She played the role of constable Anjali Mathur in the series and her performance was praised by critics and audiences alike. She reprised her role in the second season of the series, which was released in 2019.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

In 2020, Pohankar starred in the web series She. She played the role of a police officer who goes undercover to infiltrate a sex trafficking ring. Her performance in the series was critically acclaimed and she won the Filmfare OTT Award for Best Actress for her performance.<\/p>","typography_typography":"custom","typography_font_weight":"bold"},"elements":[],"widgetType":"text-editor"}],"isInner":false}],"isInner":false},{"id":"5d9127b","elType":"section","settings":{"background_background":"classic","background_color":"#EAF0EE8F","hover_parallax":[{"layer_position_vr":{"unit":"%","size":30},"layer_position_hr":{"unit":"%","size":40},"_id":"ac4fb18"},{"layer_position_vr":{"unit":"%","size":60},"layer_position_hr":{"unit":"%","size":20},"_id":"a1b2b38"}]},"elements":[{"id":"6a309d7","elType":"column","settings":{"_column_size":100,"_inline_size":null},"elements":[{"id":"91b16d4","elType":"widget","settings":{"title":"Enquiry Form","header_size":"h3","align":"center","typography_typography":"custom","typography_font_size":{"unit":"px","size":40,"sizes":[]},"typography_font_weight":"bold","_margin":{"unit":"px","top":"40","right":"0","bottom":"20","left":"0","isLinked":false},"__globals__":{"title_color":"globals\/colors?id=6d3d44f9"}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"heading"},{"id":"0ad693e","elType":"widget","settings":{"shortcode":"[forminator_form id=\"5483\"]","_margin":{"unit":"px","top":"0","right":"0","bottom":"40","left":"0","isLinked":false}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"shortcode"}],"isInner":false}],"isInner":false}]

item.title: Kiara Advani
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Kiara Advani

Bollywood Female Actor

Kiara Advani is a talented Indian actress who has made a significant impact in a relatively short span of time. She gained widespread recognition and praise for her portrayal of the shy and innocent Preeti in the film "Kabir Singh." Kiara's performance was lauded for its sincerity and emotional depth.

 

She has since appeared in a variety of films, showcasing her versatility as an actress. Whether it's playing a strong-headed woman in "Good Newwz" or a confident and independent character in "Laxmii," Kiara brings a natural charm and authenticity to her roles. Her screen presence and ability to connect with audiences have made her a favorite among both critics and fans.

 

Kiara's dedication to her craft and her down-to-earth personality have won her a strong following in the industry.

item.content:encoded:
Alia Bhatt

Bollywood Female Actor

Alia Bhatt, one of the youngest and most talented actors in Bollywood, has quickly risen to stardom with her exceptional acting prowess and versatility. Known for her natural performances, Alia has showcased her talent in films like "Highway," "Udta Punjab," and "Raazi."

 

She has the ability to immerse herself completely in her characters, bringing authenticity and depth to each role she portrays. Alia's youthful charm and infectious energy have made her a favorite among the audience, and she continues to win hearts with her brilliant performances.

 

Apart from acting, Alia is also a successful entrepreneur with her own fashion line and actively supports social causes related to education and animal welfare.

item.title: Anushka Sharma
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Anushka Sharma

Bollywood Female Actor

Anushka Sharma is a prominent Indian actress, film producer, and entrepreneur. Born on May 1, 1988, in Ayodhya, Uttar Pradesh, she rose to fame in the Indian film industry with her versatile acting skills and captivating screen presence. Anushka made her debut in Bollywood with the film "Rab Ne Bana Di Jodi" in 2008, where she portrayed the character of a simple, ordinary girl, earning critical acclaim and establishing herself as a promising talent.

 

Throughout her career, Anushka has delivered remarkable performances in various genres, ranging from romantic dramas like "Jab Tak Hai Jaan" to intense thrillers like "NH10" and "Pari." Her ability to portray complex characters with depth and conviction has garnered widespread praise from audiences and critics alike.

 

Apart from acting, Anushka is also known for her entrepreneurial ventures. She co-founded the production company Clean Slate Films and has produced several successful films under its banner, including the critically acclaimed "NH10," "Phillauri," and "Pari."

item.content:encoded:
Deepika Padukone

Bollywood Female Actor

Deepika Padukone, one of the most accomplished actors in Bollywood, has won hearts with her mesmerizing beauty and exceptional acting skills. She made her debut with the film "Om Shanti Om" and has since starred in numerous successful films like "Padmaavat," "Bajirao Mastani," and "Piku."

 

Deepika's ability to portray diverse characters with depth and conviction has garnered her critical acclaim and several awards. Her charisma, elegance, and infectious energy have made her one of the most sought-after actors in the industry. Deepika is also known for her philanthropic work and her vocal support for mental health awareness.

 

She is an influential figure both on and off the screen, setting new benchmarks with her talent and determination.

item.title: Kareena Kapoor
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Kareena Kapoor

Bollywood Female Actor

Kareena Kapoor Khan, often referred to as the "Bebo" of Bollywood, is a renowned actress known for her charismatic screen presence and exceptional acting skills. She comes from the prestigious Kapoor family, which has a rich legacy in the Indian film industry.

 

Kareena made her debut with the film "Refugee" and has since delivered several memorable performances in movies like "Jab We Met," "Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham," and "3 Idiots." Her ability to effortlessly switch between intense emotional scenes and light-hearted comedy has made her one of the most versatile actresses in the industry. Kareena's beauty, style, and fashion sense have made her a trendsetter, and she is admired by fans for her confident and glamorous persona.

With her stunning looks and exceptional talent, Kareena Kapoor continues to be a prominent figure in Bollywood, leaving an indelible mark on the industry.

item.title: Shradha Kapoor
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Shraddha Kapoor

Bollywood Female Actor

Shraddha Kapoor is a talented Indian actress and singer who has made a mark in the Bollywood film industry. She comes from a film background, being the daughter of renowned actor Shakti Kapoor. Shraddha made her acting debut with the film "Teen Patti" but gained widespread recognition and popularity with her breakthrough role in the romantic drama "Aashiqui 2."

 

 Since then, she has delivered several successful films, including "Ek Villain," "Haider," and "Stree." Known for her charming screen presence and versatile acting skills, Shraddha has portrayed a variety of roles across different genres, ranging from romantic dramas to action thrillers. She has showcased her dancing skills in films like "ABCD 2" and "Street Dancer 3D," further establishing herself as a complete performer. Apart from acting, Shraddha is also a talented singer and has lent her voice to several songs in her films. 

 

With her consistent performances and dedication to her craft, Shraddha continues to shine in the industry and has a promising career ahead.

item.title: Sonakshi Sinha
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Sonakshi Sinha

Bollywood Female Actor

Sonakshi Sinha is an Indian actress known for her work in Hindi films. Born on June 2, 1987, in Mumbai, she made her Bollywood debut in 2010 with the blockbuster film "Dabangg" opposite Salman Khan. Her portrayal of Rajjo Pandey in the film garnered critical acclaim and earned her the Filmfare Award for Best Female Debut. Sonakshi went on to star in several successful movies including "Rowdy Rathore," "Lootera," "Akira," and "Mission Mangal." With her strong screen presence and versatility, she has established herself as a leading actress in the industry. Sonakshi is admired for her fashion sense and has served as a brand ambassador for various brands. She has also appeared as a judge on popular reality shows. In addition to her acting career, Sonakshi actively advocates for social causes and promotes body positivity and women's empowerment. With her talent, charisma, and philanthropic efforts, she continues to be a prominent figure in Indian cinema.

item.title: Tabu
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Tabu

Bollywood Female Actor

Tabu, whose real name is Tabassum Fatima Hashmi, is an acclaimed Indian film actress. She was born on November 4, 1971, in Hyderabad, India. Tabu has worked in various languages, including Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, Malayalam, and English, and is known for her versatile acting skills and intense performances.

 

Tabu made her acting debut in 1982 with the film "Bazaar" but gained recognition and critical acclaim in the early 1990s for her performances in movies like "Maachis" (1996) and "Virasat" (1997). Her portrayal of complex characters in films like "Astitva" (2000), "Chandni Bar" (2001), and "Maqbool" (2003) further established her as a talented actress.

 

Throughout her career, Tabu has collaborated with renowned directors and actors and has been a part of numerous successful films. Some of her notable movies include "Hum Saath-Saath Hain" (1999), "Haider" (2014), "Drishyam" (2015), and "Andhadhun" (2018). Her performances have earned her critical acclaim, several awards, including National Film Awards, and a dedicated fan base.

 

Tabu's acting prowess extends beyond Bollywood, as she has also appeared in international films. She acted in Mira Nair's "The Namesake" (2006) and had a memorable role in the Ang Lee-directed "Life of Pi" (2012), which garnered widespread acclaim and further showcased her talent on a global platform.

item.title: Zareen Khan
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Zarine Khan

Bollywood Female Actor

Zarine Khan is an Indian actress and model. She was born on May 14, 1987, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. Zarine gained recognition in Bollywood for her debut film and has since appeared in several movies.

 

Zarine Khan made her acting debut in the 2010 film "Veer," directed by Anil Sharma and starring alongside Salman Khan. Despite mixed reviews, her performance received attention, and she was nominated for the Zee Cine Award for Best Female Debut.

 

Following her debut, Zarine appeared in various films, including "Ready" (2011) alongside Salman Khan and "Housefull 2" (2012), where she had a supporting role. However, these movies did not fare well critically. Zarine also acted in regional films such as the Punjabi film "Jatt James Bond" (2014) and the Tamil film "Naan Rajavaga Pogiren" (2013).

item.title: Sunny Leone
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Sunny Leone

Bollywood Female Actor

Sunny Leone, born on May 13, 1981, as Karenjit Kaur Vohra, is a Canadian-born Indian-American actress, model, and former adult film star. She gained prominence in India after participating in the reality TV show "Bigg Boss" in 2011. Sunny Leone made her Bollywood debut in 2012 with the film "Jism 2" and has since appeared in several Hindi films.

 

Known for her attractive looks and bold on-screen persona, Sunny Leone has carved a niche for herself in the Indian film industry. She has starred in movies like "Ragini MMS 2," "Ek Paheli Leela," and "Tera Intezaar," among others. Apart from films, she has also made special appearances in item songs and has been a part of web series.

 

Sunny Leone is admired for her professionalism, business acumen, and philanthropic endeavors. She has launched her own line of perfumes, a makeup brand, and a lingerie brand. Additionally, she actively supports various charitable causes and has been involved in campaigns promoting animal rights and HIV/AIDS awareness.

item.title: Aahana Kumra
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Aahana Kumra

Bollywood Female Actor

Aahana Kumra is an Indian actress who works in Hindi films, television, and theatre. She is known for her roles in the television series Yudh (2013), Agent Raghav – Crime Branch (2015), and Inside Edge (2017), and the films Lipstick Under My Burkha (2017), Dolly Ki Doli (2017), and Serious Men (2019).

 

Kumra was born in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India, in 1985. She graduated from the National School of Drama in 2010. After graduating, she made her acting debut in the television series Yudh, where she played the role of Avni, the daughter of Amitabh Bachchan's character. She then went on to star in the television series Agent Raghav – Crime Branch, where she played the role of Trisha Dewan, a police officer.

 

In 2017, Kumra made her film debut in Lipstick Under My Burkha, where she played the role of Rehana, a young woman who dreams of becoming a writer. The film was a critical and commercial success, and it earned Kumra widespread praise for her performance. She then went on to star in the films Dolly Ki Doli and Serious Men.

item.title: Zoya Afroz
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Zoya Afroz

Bollywood Female Actor

Zoya Afroz is an Indian actress and model. She was born on January 10, 1994, in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India. Zoya began her career as a child artist and gained popularity for her work in films and television.

 

Zoya made her acting debut as a child artist in the Bollywood film "Hum Saath-Saath Hain" in 1999. She appeared in several other Hindi films as a child artist, including "Kuch Naa Kaho" (2003) and "Mann" (1999).

 

As an adult, Zoya Afroz participated in beauty pageants and won the title of Pond's Femina Miss India International in 2013. This opened doors for her in the modeling industry, and she appeared in various commercials and fashion shows.

In terms of her acting career, Zoya has predominantly worked in the South Indian film industry. She has appeared in Telugu films like "Sye" (2004) and "Anaganaga O Dheerudu" (2011). She also acted in the Malayalam film "Puthiya Mukham" (2009) and the Tamil film "Vaagai Sooda Vaa" (2011).

item.content:encoded:
Angira Dhar

Bollywood Female Actor

Angira Dhar is an Indian actress who appears in Hindi films and web series. She was born on May 25, 1988 in Srinagar, Jammu and Kashmir. She studied at the Shri Ram College of Commerce in Delhi and then moved to Mumbai to pursue a career in acting.

 

Dhar made her acting debut in the 2015 web series Bang Baaja Baaraat. The series was a critical and commercial success, and it helped to launch Dhar's career. She has since appeared in several other web series, including Inside Edge (2017) and Four More Shots Please! (2019).

 

Dhar has also appeared in several films, including Love per Square Foot (2018), Commando 3 (2019), and Runway 34 (2022). She has been praised for her versatility and her ability to portray a wide range of characters.

item.title: Anupriya Goenka
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Anupriya Goenka

Bollywood Female Actor

Anupriya Goenka is an Indian actress and model who appears in Hindi and Telugu films. She first shot to fame in 2013 as the face of UPA government's Bharat Nirman. Goenka made her on-screen debut with the 2013 Telugu film Potugadu, having previously starred in the 2013 short film Worth the Kiss. She made her Bollywood debut with Bobby Jasoos.

 

Goenka was born in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, India, to a Marwari family. She studied at the Shri Ram College of Commerce in Delhi, where she graduated with a degree in economics. After college, she worked as a management consultant for a few years before pursuing a career in acting.

 

Goenka made her acting debut in the 2013 Telugu film Potugadu. She then starred in the 2014 Hindi film Paathshala. In 2017, she appeared in the films Daddy and Tiger Zinda Hai. She also starred in the 2018 web series Sacred Games.

 

Goenka is known for her versatile acting skills and her ability to portray strong female characters. She has been praised by critics for her performances in films such as Daddy and Sacred Games.

In 2019, Goenka was nominated for the Filmfare Award for Best Actress in a Web Series for her performance in Sacred Games. She is also the recipient of the Zee Cine Award for Best Female Debut.

Goenka was born in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, India, to a Marwari family. She studied at the Shri Ram College of Commerce in Delhi, where she graduated with a degree in economics. After college, she worked as a management consultant for a few years before pursuing a career in acting.<\/p>

item.title: Mrunal Thakur
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Mrunal Thakur

Bollywood Female Actor

Mrunal Thakur is a talented Indian actress who has made a significant mark in the entertainment industry. With her mesmerizing beauty and acting prowess, she has captivated audiences both on the big screen and small screen. Born on August 1, 1992, in Mumbai, India, Mrunal began her career in acting with television shows like "Kumkum Bhagya" and "Har Yug Mein Ayega Ek Arjun," where she showcased her versatility and gained recognition.

 

However, it was her breakthrough role in the critically acclaimed film "Love Sonia" that brought her widespread acclaim. Mrunal's portrayal of the titular character showcased her immense talent and garnered her several accolades. She further solidified her position in the industry with notable films like "Super 30" and "Batla House," where she shared the screen with established actors.

 

Mrunal's ability to portray complex characters with depth and conviction has made her a sought-after actress in Bollywood. Along with her acting skills, she has also become a fashion icon, known for her impeccable sense of style. With her natural charm and dedication to her craft, Mrunal Thakur continues to shine as a rising star in the Indian film industry.

item.title: Yami Gautam
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Yami Gautam

Bollywood Female Actor

Yami Gautam is an Indian actress who primarily works in Hindi cinema. She was born on November 28, 1988, in Bilaspur, Himachal Pradesh, India. Yami has gained popularity for her performances in films and has established herself as a prominent actress in the industry.

Yami Gautam began her acting career with television shows. She made her television debut in 2008 with the serial "Chand Ke Paar Chalo." She gained recognition and rose to fame with her role as Leher Mathur in the show "Yeh Pyar Na Hoga Kam" (2009-2010).

In 2012, Yami made her Bollywood debut with the film "Vicky Donor," directed by Shoojit Sircar. The film was a critical and commercial success, and Yami received positive reviews for her performance as Ashima Roy. She won the IIFA Award for Star Debut of the Year for her role in the film.

Following her debut, Yami Gautam appeared in several successful Hindi films. Some of her notable movies include "Badlapur" (2015), "Kaabil" (2017), "Bala" (2019), and "Uri: The Surgical Strike" (2019). Her performances have been appreciated by both critics and audiences.

Yami has also worked in other regional film industries, including Telugu, Punjabi, and Tamil cinema. She has received acclaim for her roles in films like "Gouravam" (2013), "Total Siyapaa" (2014), and "Tamilselvanum Thaniyar Anjalum" (2016).

item.title: Prachi Desai
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Prachi Desai

Bollywood Female Actor

Prachi Desai is a talented Indian television actress who has made a mark in the entertainment industry with her impressive performances. Born on September 12, 1988, in Surat, Gujarat, Prachi began her acting career at a young age and rose to fame through her role as Bani Walia in the popular television show "Kasamh Se." Her portrayal of the innocent yet strong-willed Bani garnered critical acclaim and a massive fan following.

 

Prachi's on-screen presence, coupled with her natural acting skills, made her a household name in the Indian television industry. She continued to charm the audience with her performances in shows like "Kasautii Zindagii Kay" and "Naagin." Her ability to effortlessly connect with her characters and bring them to life has earned her accolades and several awards.

 

Apart from television, Prachi has also ventured into Bollywood and has worked in successful films like "Rock On!!" and "Once Upon a Time in Mumbaai." She has proven her versatility as an actress by taking up diverse roles and showcasing her range.

item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Radhika Madan

Bollywood Female Actor

Radhika Madan is a talented and versatile Indian actress who has made a significant mark in the entertainment industry. Born on May 1, 1995, in Delhi, Radhika started her career as a television actor before transitioning to the silver screen. Her passion for acting led her to pursue formal training at Barry John's acting school, which helped hone her skills and prepare her for the challenges ahead.

 

Radhika gained widespread recognition with her debut role as Ishani in the popular TV show "Meri Aashiqui Tum Se Hi." Her impressive performance earned her critical acclaim and a loyal fan base. In 2018, she made her Bollywood debut with the film "Pataakha," where she showcased her remarkable acting prowess and versatility. She followed it up with standout performances in movies like "Mard Ko Dard Nahi Hota" and "Angrezi Medium," solidifying her position as a promising young talent in the industry.

 

Known for her infectious energy and magnetic screen presence, Radhika has effortlessly portrayed a wide range of characters, from bold and feisty to vulnerable and sensitive. Her ability to bring depth and authenticity to her roles has earned her accolades and nominations at various award ceremonies.

item.title: Urvashi Rautela
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Urvashi Rautela

Bollywood Female Actor

Urvashi Rautela is an Indian actress and model. She was born on February 25, 1994, in Kotdwar, Uttarakhand, India. Urvashi began her career in the entertainment industry as a model and won several beauty pageants, including the Miss Diva Universe 2015 and Miss Tourism Queen of the Year International 2011.

 

She made her acting debut in Bollywood with the film "Singh Saab the Great" in 2013, where she played a supporting role. Urvashi gained more recognition with her appearance in the film "Sanam Re" in 2016, opposite Pulkit Samrat. She has since acted in movies like "Great Grand Masti," "Hate Story 4," and "Pagalpanti," among others.

 

Apart from her acting career, Urvashi Rautela is known for her stunning looks and has been featured in numerous fashion magazines. She has also been an ambassador for several brands and has worked in music videos

item.title: Vaani Kapoor
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Vaani Kapoor

Bollywood Female Actor

Vaani Kapoor is an Indian actress and model who primarily works in the Hindi film industry. She was born on August 23, 1988, in Delhi, India. Vaani made her acting debut with the Bollywood film "Shuddh Desi Romance" in 2013 and has since appeared in several notable films.

 

Vaani Kapoor gained recognition for her role as Tara in the film "Shuddh Desi Romance" (2013), for which she received critical acclaim and a Filmfare Award for Best Female Debut. She impressed the audience and critics with her performance and was praised for her fresh and natural portrayal of the character.

 

After her debut, Vaani starred in the film "Aaha Kalyanam" (2014), which was a Tamil remake of the Bollywood film "Band Baaja Baaraat." She then took a brief hiatus from the film industry before making a comeback with the film "Befikre" (2016), where she played the female lead opposite Ranveer Singh. The film received mixed reviews, but Vaani's performance was appreciated.

 

In 2019, Vaani Kapoor appeared in the film "War" alongside Hrithik Roshan and Tiger Shroff. The movie was a commercial success and became one of the highest-grossing Bollywood films of that year. Vaani received praise for her role in the film and showcased her dancing skills.

Vaani has also worked in the film "Bell Bottom" (2021), starring opposite Akshay Kumar. The film received positive reviews, and her performance was well-received by the audience.

item.title: Vidhya Balan
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Vidya Balan

Bollywood Female Actor

Vidya Balan is an Indian actress who is known for her outstanding performances in Bollywood films. She was born on January 1, 1979, in Poothamkurussy, Kerala, India. Vidya has received several accolades throughout her career, including National Film Awards and Filmfare Awards.

 

Vidya Balan made her acting debut in the Bengali film industry with "Bhalo Theko" in 2003. However, she gained widespread recognition and critical acclaim with her role as Lalita in the Hindi film "Parineeta" (2005). Her performance in the film earned her the Filmfare Award for Best Female Debut.

 

She went on to deliver exceptional performances in films such as "Lage Raho Munna Bhai" (2006), "Bhool Bhulaiyaa" (2007), and "Paa" (2009). However, it was her portrayal of Silk Smitha, a South Indian actress, in the film "The Dirty Picture" (2011) that established her as one of the finest actresses in the industry. For her role in "The Dirty Picture," Vidya received widespread acclaim and won the National Film Award for Best Actress.

 

Vidya Balan is known for her choice of unconventional and challenging roles. She has portrayed a variety of characters, from a pregnant woman searching for her missing husband in "Kahaani" (2012) to a radio jockey in "Tumhari Sulu" (2017). Her performances have been praised for their depth, authenticity, and versatility.

item.title: Vishakha Singh
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Vishakha Singh

Bollywood Female Actor

Vishakha Singh is an Indian film actress, producer, and entrepreneur. She was born on May 5, 1986, in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. Vishakha has worked predominantly in the Hindi and South Indian film industries.

 

Vishakha made her acting debut with the Tamil film "Kanna Kanmani" in 2005. She gained recognition with her role in the Telugu film "Gnaapakam" (2007) and subsequently appeared in several Telugu and Kannada films.

 

In 2011, Vishakha made her Bollywood debut with the film "Humsey Hai Jahaan." She went on to act in Hindi films such as "Khelein Hum Jee Jaan Sey" (2010) and "Fukrey" (2013), where she played a supporting role.

 

Apart from her acting career, Vishakha Singh is also known for her entrepreneurial ventures. In 2014, she co-founded a production company called "BBG (Bheja Fry, Bheja Genie) Films" and produced the critically acclaimed film "Peddlers" (2012).

item.title: Alok Nath
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Alok Nath

Bollywood Male Actor

Alok Nath is an Indian actor known for his work in Hindi cinema and television. He made his film debut with the 1982 English (and Hindi) film Gandhi, directed by Sir Richard Attenborough, which won an Oscar Academy Award for Best Picture that year.

 

He appeared in the soap opera, Buniyaad, which took the country by storm in 1986. He was also in Rishtey, which aired from 1999 to 2001. He appeared in Star Plus serials like Sapna Babul Ka... Bidaai, Yahaaan Main Ghar Ghar Kheli and Yeh Rishta Kya Kehlata Hai. Nath was born in Khagaria (Bihar) on 10 July 1956.

 

Nath is a versatile actor who has played a wide range of roles in his career. He is known for his portrayal of the ideal father, husband, and friend. He has also played negative roles, such as the antagonist in the film Mr. India.

item.title: Dilip Joshi
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Dilip Joshi

Television Male Actor

Dilip Joshi is a renowned Indian television and film actor who has left an indelible mark on the entertainment industry with his exceptional acting skills. Born on May 26, 1968, in Gujarat, India, Dilip Joshi has carved a niche for himself through his versatile performances.

 

Joshi gained immense popularity and widespread recognition for his portrayal of the character Jethalal Champaklal Gada in the long-running sitcom "Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah." His portrayal of the lovable, bumbling yet endearing Jethalal has won the hearts of millions of viewers. His comic timing, impeccable expressions, and unique dialogue delivery have made him one of the most beloved characters on Indian television.

 

Before "Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah," Dilip Joshi appeared in various television shows, including "Shubh Mangal Savadhan" and "Kya Baat Hai." He also showcased his talent in the film industry, with notable performances in movies like "Phir Bhi Dil Hai Hindustani" and "Hum Aapke Hain Koun..!"

 

Dilip Joshi's acting skills have earned him several accolades and awards, including the prestigious Indian Telly Award for Best Actor in a Comic Role multiple times. He is highly respected for his ability to bring characters to life and effortlessly entertain the audience.

item.title: Gautam Rode
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Gautam Rode

Bollywood Male Actor

Gautam Rode is an acclaimed Indian actor who has made a significant impact in both television and film industries. Known for his charming personality and versatile acting skills, Gautam has garnered a massive fan following and critical acclaim throughout his career.

Born on August 14, 1977, in Delhi, Gautam initially had a keen interest in modeling and began his career in the entertainment industry as a successful model. However, his true passion lay in acting, and he eventually transitioned into television.

Gautam rose to prominence with his portrayal of the character Saraswatichandra in the popular television drama series "Saraswatichandra" (2013-2014). His portrayal of the complex and multi-layered character won him widespread appreciation and established him as a talented actor in the industry. His chemistry with his co-star Jennifer Winget was highly praised by the audience.

Apart from his television work, Gautam has also ventured into the film industry. He made his Bollywood debut with the film "Annarth" in 2002 and has since appeared in several Hindi and regional films, showcasing his versatility as an actor.

item.title: Mohit Rana

item.content:encoded:
Mohit Raina

Bollywood Male Actor

Mohit Raina is a talented Indian actor who has made a name for himself in Bollywood. Born on August 14, 1982, in Jammu, India, Mohit gained widespread recognition and acclaim for his portrayal of Lord Shiva in the television series "Devon Ke Dev...Mahadev." His performance as Lord Shiva won him immense popularity and a dedicated fan following.

 

After his success on the small screen, Mohit transitioned to the silver screen with the film "Uri: The Surgical Strike" in 2019, where he played a pivotal role. He showcased his acting prowess and received positive reviews for his performance.

 

Known for his striking looks, intense performances, and screen presence, Mohit Raina continues to impress audiences with his talent and versatility. With his dedication to his craft, he has established himself as a promising actor in Bollywood, leaving a lasting impact on the industry.

item.content:encoded:
Mukesh Khanna

Bollywood Male Actor

Mukesh Khanna is a veteran Indian actor known for his notable contributions to Bollywood. Born on July 19, 1958, in Mumbai, India, Mukesh has had a prolific career in both film and television.

 

He rose to fame with his iconic portrayal of Bhishma Pitamah in the epic television series "Mahabharat," which became immensely popular across the country. Mukesh's powerful performance and authoritative presence made him a household name.

 

In Bollywood, he has appeared in films like "Karan Arjun," "Shaktimaan," and "Zanjeer." Mukesh is known for his ability to effortlessly transition between negative and positive roles, leaving a lasting impact on the audience.

item.title: Ram Kapoor
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Ram Kapoor

Bollywood Male Actor

Ram Kapoor, born on September 1, 1973, is an Indian actor known for his work in films and television serials. He gained fame for his portrayal of Jai Walia in the television series Kasamh Se and the character of Ram Kapoor in Bade Achhe Lagte Hain. Ram has also appeared in films such as Humshakals, where he played a triple role, and has hosted the reality show Rakhi Ka Swayamwar, based on The Bachelorette.

 

Throughout his career, Ram Kapoor has received several awards, including 3 ITA Awards and 3 Indian Telly Awards for Best Actor. He has showcased his talent and versatility in both the television and film industries.

 

Ram Kapoor spent his formative years at Sherwood College in Nainital, Uttarakhand, where he discovered his passion for acting. Under the guidance of Amir Raza Hussein, he honed his skills and decided to pursue a career in the entertainment industry. After completing his tenth board exams, he studied at the Kodaikanal International School before heading to Los Angeles, where he planned to join UCLA for filmmaking but ended up attending a Stanislavski-based acting academy.

 

Ram Kapoor made his onscreen debut with the television serial Nyaay in 1997, followed by appearances in shows like Heena, Sangharsh, and Kavita. In 2000, he acted in the popular family drama Ghar Ek Mandir and collaborated once again with Amir Raza Hussein in the play The Fifty Days of War - Kargil, where he played multiple characters.

 

His acting career expanded to films, with notable appearances in movies like Dhadkan, Hazaaron Khwaishein Aisi, and Udaan. In 2006, Ram Kapoor gained significant popularity through his role as Jai Udai Walia in the soap opera Kasamh Se. He went on to participate in reality shows like Jhalak Dikhhla Jaa as a contestant and Rakhi Ka Swayamwar as the host.

 

In 2011, Ram Kapoor starred in the television show Bade Achhe Lagte Hain, where he played the male protagonist, Ram Amarnath Kapoor. The show became a major success, and his performance received praise from the audience and critics alike.

 

Alongside his television career, Ram Kapoor has also made appearances in Bollywood films like Agent Vinod, Student of the Year, and Humshakals.

item.title: Ronit Roy
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Ronit Roy

Bollywood Male Actor

Ronit Roy is a renowned Bollywood actor who has made a significant impact on the Indian film industry with his powerful performances and commanding screen presence. Born on October 11, 1965, in Nagpur, India, Ronit initially pursued a career in the hotel industry but later found his true calling in acting.

 

Ronit made his acting debut in the 1992 film "Jaan Tere Naam" and quickly caught the attention of the audience with his intense portrayal of negative characters. He gained widespread recognition for his role as the ruthless Mihir Virani in the popular television series "Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi," which ran for several years and established him as one of the most sought-after actors on the small screen.

 

In Bollywood, Ronit has been praised for his versatile acting abilities, effortlessly transitioning between intense and nuanced roles. He has delivered stellar performances in films like "Udaan," where he played the abusive father, and "2 States," where he portrayed the strict, yet loving, father of the female lead.

 

Ronit's portrayal of Inspector Raja Tambat in the critically acclaimed film "Kaabil" earned him widespread acclaim and showcased his ability to bring depth and complexity to his characters. He has also made notable appearances in films such as "Student of the Year," "Boss," and "Thugs of Hindostan," leaving a lasting impact with his impeccable acting skills.

 

Apart from his film and television work, Ronit has also made his presence felt in the digital space with his performances in web series like "Hostages" and "Kehne Ko Humsafar Hain." His ability to effortlessly connect with the audience and bring authenticity to his roles has made him a respected figure in the entertainment industry.

item.title: Shabir Ahluwalia
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Shabir Ahluwalia

Bollywood Male Actor

Shabir Ahluwalia is an Indian actor and host known for his roles in various television shows and films. He gained popularity for his portrayal of Abhishek Prem Mehra in the television series Kumkum Bhagya. He has also appeared in shows like Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi, Kya Hadsaa Kya Haqeeqat, Kahi To Milenge, Kkavyanjali, Kasamh Se, Kasautii Zindagii Kay, Kayamath, and Laagi Tujhse Lagan, among others.

 

Shabir Ahluwalia won the third season of Fear Factor: Khatron Ke Khiladi and has hosted shows such as Nach Baliye, Guinness World Records – Ab India Todega, and Dancing Queen. He made his debut in Bollywood with the film Shootout at Lokhandwala, followed by Mission Istanbul. He is set to appear in the sixth installment of the YRF Spy Universe and the sequel to the movie War, titled War 2, alongside Hrithik Roshan and JR.NTR.

 

Born on August 10, 1979, in Mumbai, Shabir Ahluwalia comes from a mixed heritage, with a Sikh father and a Catholic mother. He has two siblings named Shefali Ahluwalia and Sameer Ahluwalia. He completed his schooling at St. Xavier's High School in Vile Parle and later graduated from the University of Maryland, College Park.

 

Shabir Ahluwalia married actress Kanchi Kaul on November 27, 2011. The couple has two sons, with the first born in 2014 and the second in 2016. Shabir Ahluwalia continues to entertain audiences with his versatile acting skills and captivating hosting presence.

item.title: Shivaji Satam
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Shivaji Satam

Bollywood Male Actor

Shivaji Satam is a renowned Indian actor primarily known for his work in Bollywood films and television. Born on April 21, 1950, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, Shivaji Satam has established himself as a versatile and talented actor over the years.

 

Satam gained widespread recognition for his portrayal of ACP Pradyuman in the long-running crime thriller television series, "CID." His portrayal of the no-nonsense, astute police officer made him a household name and earned him immense popularity among the audience. He played the role for an impressive 21 years, from 1998 to 2018, making him synonymous with the character.

 

Apart from his television success, Satam has also appeared in several Bollywood films, showcasing his acting prowess. Some of his notable film roles include appearances in movies like "Vaastav: The Reality," "Jis Desh Mein Ganga Rehta Hain," and "Yeshwant." He has displayed his versatility by successfully portraying a range of characters, from intense and serious to light-hearted and comedic.

 

Shivaji Satam's dedication and talent have earned him several accolades, including the Indian Telly Award for Best Actor in a Lead Role and the Lions Gold Award for Best Actor in a Negative Role. His contribution to the Indian entertainment industry and his memorable performances have made him a respected figure in both Bollywood and television.

item.title: Vivian Dsena
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Vivian Dsena

Television Male Actor

Vivian Dsena, born on June 28, 1988, is an Indian actor known for his work in Hindi television. He gained popularity with his debut role in the show Kasamh Se in 2008. However, he is best known for his performances as Vampire Abhay Raichand in the supernatural thriller Pyaar Kii Ye Ek Kahani and as Rishabh Kundra in the romantic drama Madhubala - Ek Ishq Ek Junoon. His portrayal in these shows received critical acclaim and earned him numerous awards, including Indian Telly Awards, ITA Awards, and Gold Awards.

 

Apart from these, Dsena has also appeared in other notable works such as the social drama Shakti - Astitva Ke Ehsaas Ki and the romantic drama Sirf Tum. In addition to his television roles, he has participated in reality shows like Fear Factor: Khatron Ke Khiladi 7 and Jhalak Dikhla Jaa 8.

item.title: Aakanksha Singh
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Aakanksha Singh

Television Female Actor

Aakanksha Singh is an Indian actress who primarily works in Telugu and Hindi films and television. She started her career with theatre and made her acting debut with the television series Na Bole Tum Na Maine Kuch Kaha (2012–2014). She made her film debut with Badrinath Ki Dulhania (2017).

 

Singh was born on 30 July 1990 in Jaipur, Rajasthan. She completed her schooling from Ryan International School, Jaipur. She then studied physiotherapy at the Jaipur National University. After completing her studies, she moved to Mumbai to pursue a career in acting.

 

Singh made her acting debut with the television series Na Bole Tum Na Maine Kuch Kaha in 2012. She played the role of Megha Vyas Bhatnagar, a widow with two children. The show was a huge success and Singh won the Indian Telly Award for Fresh New Face - Female for her performance.

 

After Na Bole Tum Na Maine Kuch Kaha, Singh went on to star in several other television shows, including Gulmohar Grand (2015), Girls Hostel (2016), and Aye Zindagi (2017). She also made guest appearances in several other shows, including Savdhaan India and Nach Baliye.

 

In 2017, Singh made her film debut with Badrinath Ki Dulhania. She played the role of Tara Singh, the sister of the protagonist. The film was a huge success and Singh was praised for her performance.

 

After Badrinath Ki Dulhania, Singh has starred in several other films, including Malli Raava (2017), Devadas (2018), Pailwaan (2019), and Runway 34 (2022). She has also starred in several web series, including Rangbaaz: Darr Ki Rajneeti (2022) and Meet Cute (2022).

item.title: Aamna Sharif
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Aamna Sharif

Television Female Actor

Aamna Sharif is an Indian television actress who is known for her roles in Kahiin To Hoga, Hongey Judaa Na Hum, and Kasautii Zindagii Kay 2. She has also appeared in a few Bollywood films, including Aloo Chaat, Aao Wish Karein, and Ek Villain.

 

Sharif was born in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India, in 1982. She studied at St. Anne's High School and then went on to pursue a degree in Mass Communication from Jai Hind College. During her second year of college, she started receiving offers for modeling assignments. She soon began appearing in music videos and advertisements.

 

In 2003, Sharif made her acting debut in the television series Kahiin To Hoga. She played the role of Kashish Garewal, a young woman who dreams of becoming a doctor. The show was a huge success and made Sharif a household name. She went on to star in several other popular television series, including Karam Apnaa Apnaa, Hongey Judaa Na Hum, and Ek Thhi Naayka.

 

In 2019, Sharif made a comeback to television with the second season of Kasautii Zindagii Kay. She played the role of Komolika Chaubey, a vamp who is determined to ruin the lives of Prerna and Anurag. The show was a huge success and Sharif's performance was critically acclaimed.

item.title: Aasiya Kazi
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Aasiya Kazi

Television Female Actor

Kazi started her acting career in 2009 with the role of Santu Dharamraj Mahiyavanshi in the television soap opera Bandini on Imagine TV. She also played the role of Saudamini in Colors TV and Hema Malini's Matti Ki Banno, Kastur Galla in Imagine TV's Dharampatni, Dr. Shweta Kapoor / Shweta Rishi Kumar in Zee TV's Hitler Didi, Ruku in Na Bole Tum Na Maine Kuch Kaha 2 on Colors TV, as Ganga in Balika Vadhu, and Sharda in Tenali Rama.

 

Kazi is a versatile actress who has played a variety of roles in her career. She has shown her ability to play both positive and negative characters. She is a talented actress who has entertained audiences with her work in television.

 

Aasiya Kazi is a rising star in the Indian television industry. She is sure to continue to entertain audiences with her work in the years to come.

item.title: Aalisha Panwar
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Aalisha Panwar

Television Female Actor

Aalisha Panwar is an Indian television actress who is best known for her roles in the shows Ishq Mein Marjawan, Teri Meri Ikk Jindri, and Kumkum Bhagya. She is a versatile actress who has played a variety of roles, from the innocent Aditi in Thapki Pyar Ki to the villainous Tara Raichand in Ishq Mein Marjawan.

Panwar made her acting debut in the 2012 film Akkad Bakkad Bambe Bo. She made her television debut in 2015 with the show Begusarai. She then went on to appear in shows like Thapki Pyar Ki, Jamai Raja, and Rishton Ki Saudagar – Baazigar.

In 2017, Panwar got her big break with the show Ishq Mein Marjawan. She played the dual role of Tara Raichand and Aarohi Kashyap. The show was a huge success and Panwar's performance was praised by critics.

In 2021, Panwar starred in the show Teri Meri Ikk Jindri. She played the role of Avneet, a strong and independent woman. The show was a hit with the audience and Panwar's performance was once again praised by critics.

In 2023, Panwar joined the cast of Kumkum Bhagya. She plays the role of Kaya Malhotra, a new love interest for Abhi. The show is one of the most popular shows on Indian television and Panwar's performance is being loved by the audience.

item.title: Adaa Khan
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Adaa Khan

Bollywood Female Actor

Adaa Khan is an Indian television actress and model. She is known for her roles in the television shows Behenein, Amrit Manthan, Naagin and Vish Ya Amrit: Sitara. In 2020, she participated in Fear Factor: Khatron Ke Khiladi 10.

 

Khan was born in Mumbai, India on May 12, 1989. She studied at the Jai Hind College in Mumbai and graduated with a degree in Mass Media. Khan started her career as a model and appeared in several commercials. She made her television debut in 2009 with the show Palampur Express.

 

In 2010, Khan bagged the role of Aakashi Shastri in the Star Plus show Behenein. The show was a huge success and Khan's performance was praised by critics. In 2012, Khan got her first leading role in the Director's Kut Productions drama Amrit Manthan as the heroic Princess Amrit Kaur Sodhi, co-starring Ankita Sharma, Dimple Jhangiani and Wasim Mushtaq. She did episodic roles in shows like Yeh Hai Aashiqui, Crime Patrol, Code Red and Savdhaan India @ 11. She was also a contestant on the reality show Welcome – Baazi Mehmaan Nawazi Ki.

 

In 2015, Khan got the role of Shesha, a shape-shifting serpent in Naagin. Her fierce looks and dialogue delivery made her character very popular among the audiences. The show was a huge success and ran for three seasons. In 2018, Khan played the role of Sitara in the Star Plus show Vish Ya Amrit: Sitara. The show was a moderate success.

 

Khan is a talented actress and has won several awards for her work in television. She has won the Indian Telly Award for Best Actress in a Negative Role (Jury) for her role of Amrit in Amrit Manthan, the Indian Telly Award for Best Actress in a Negative Role (Popular) for her role of Shesha in Naagin, and the Lions Gold Award for Best Actress in a Negative Role for her role of Shesha in Naagin.

Achint Kaur

Bollywood Female Actor

Achint Kaur is an Indian television and film actress. She is best known for her roles in the television shows Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi, Kahaani Ghar Ghar Kii, and Jamai Raja. She has also appeared in the films Om Jai Jagadish, Corporate, and The Tashkent Files.

 

Kaur was born in Meerut, Uttar Pradesh, India. She started her acting career in 1994 with the television show Banegi Apni Baat. She went on to appear in several other television shows, including Swabhimaan, Aahat, and Saaya.

 

In 2000, Kaur was cast as Mandira in Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi. The show was a huge success and Kaur's performance as the antagonist was widely praised. She won several awards for her role, including the Indian Telly Award for Best Actress in a Negative Role.

 

In 2007, Kaur was cast as Pallavi in Kahaani Ghar Ghar Kii. The show was another huge success and Kaur's performance was again praised by critics. She won several awards for her role, including the Indian Telly Award for Best Actress in a Negative Role.

 

In 2014, Kaur was cast as Durga Devi Patel in Jamai Raja. The show was a huge success and Kaur's performance was praised by critics. She won several awards for her role, including the Indian Telly Award for Best Actress in a Supporting Role.

 

Achint Kaur is a talented actress who has entertained audiences for many years. She is a versatile actress who has played a variety of roles, both positive and negative. She is a rising star in the Indian television industry and her future looks bright.

item.title: Additi Gupta
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Additi Gupta

Bollywood Female Actor

Additi Gupta is an Indian television actress who is known for her roles in "Kis Desh Mein Hai Meraa Dil", "Qubool Hai", and "Ishq Subhan Allah". She has also starred in the films "Love Breakups Zindagi" and "Azhar".

 

Gupta was born in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, India on April 21, 1988. She studied at the National School of Drama in Delhi and graduated with a degree in acting. She started her career as a theater actress and appeared in several plays. She made her television debut in 2008 with the show "Kis Desh Mein Hai Meraa Dil". She played the role of Heer, a young woman who falls in love with a Muslim man. The show was a huge success and Gupta's performance was praised by critics.

 

In 2012, Gupta bagged the role of Zoya in the Star Plus show "Qubool Hai". The show was a huge success and Gupta's performance was praised by critics. She won several awards for her role, including the Indian Telly Award for Best Actress.

 

In 2017, Gupta played the role of Zara in the Zee TV show "Ishq Subhan Allah". The show was a huge success and Gupta's performance was praised by critics. She won several awards for her role, including the Indian Telly Award for Best Actress.

item.title: Aditi Bhatia
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Aditi Bhatia

Bollywood Female Actor

Aditi Bhatia is an Indian actress and model who is known for her role as Ruhi Bhalla in the popular television show Yeh Hai Mohabbatein. She was born on October 29, 1999, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. She completed her schooling from Thakur Public School, Kandivali, Mumbai. She is currently pursuing her graduation from Thakur College of Science and Commerce, Kandivali, Mumbai.

 

Aditi Bhatia started her career as a child artist in 2015 with the television show Tashan-e-Ishq. She played the role of Bubbly Taneja in the show. In 2016, she joined the cast of Yeh Hai Mohabbatein and played the role of Ruhi Bhalla. She is currently playing the same role and is one of the most popular child artists in India.

 

Aditi Bhatia is a talented actress and has won several awards for her work in television. She has won the Indian Telly Award for Best Child Artist (2017) for Yeh Hai Mohabbatein and the Star Parivaar Award for Favorite Child Artist (2017) for Yeh Hai Mohabbatein.

item.title: Aditi Sharma

item.content:encoded:
Aditi Sharma

Bollywood Female Actor

Aditi Sharma was born on September 4, 1996, in New Delhi, India. She completed her schooling from Hansraj Model School, New Delhi. She started her career as a model, having walked for Amazon Fashion Week India. Later she appeared in number of TV commercials for various brands like Titan Raga, White Ponds Beauty BB+, Amazon, etc.

 

In 2018, Aditi Sharma made her acting debut with the Zee TV show Kaleerein. She played the role of Meera Dhingra, a young woman who is trying to find her place in the world. The show was a huge success and Aditi Sharma's performance was praised by critics.

 

In 2019, Aditi Sharma appeared in the television show Naagin 3. She played the role of Bela, a shape-shifting serpent who is trying to protect her family from evil forces. The show was a huge success and Aditi Sharma's performance was praised by critics.

Aditi Sharma Ahuja

Bollywood Female Actor

Aditi Sharma Ahuja is an Indian actress who is known for her roles in the television shows Gangaa, Silsila Badalte Rishton Ka, and Katha Ankahee. She was born on August 24, 1983, in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India. She completed her schooling from St. Joseph's Academy, Lucknow, and graduated in Mass Communication from the Amity University, Lucknow.

 

Aditi Sharma Ahuja started her career as a model and appeared in several commercials. She made her television debut in 2015 with the show Gangaa. She played the role of Gangaa, a young woman who fights for justice for her father. The show was a huge success and Aditi Sharma Ahuja's performance was praised by critics.

 

In 2018, Aditi Sharma Ahuja played the role of Mauli in the Colors TV show Silsila Badalte Rishton Ka. She played the role of a doctor who is trying to balance her career and personal life. The show was a moderate success.

 

Since December 2022, Aditi Sharma Ahuja is portraying the lead role of Katha in the Sony Entertainment Television show Katha Ankahee opposite Adnan Khan. The show is a romantic drama and is set in the backdrop of Lucknow. Aditi Sharma Ahuja is playing the role of Katha, a young woman who is trying to find her place in the world. The show has been well-received by the audience and Aditi Sharma Ahuja's performance has been praised by critics.

 

Aditi Sharma Ahuja is a talented actress who has been in the industry for over a decade. She has appeared in several popular television shows, including Gangaa, Silsila Badalte Rishton Ka, and Katha Ankahee. She has also starred in the films Angrej and Love Breakups Zindagi.

Aishwarya Khare

Bollywood Female Actor

Aishwarya Khare is an Indian television actress who is known for her roles in the television shows Yeh Hai Chahatein and Bhagya Lakshmi. She was born on 17 April 1995 in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh. She completed her schooling from St. Joseph's Convent, Bhopal. She is a trained classical dancer and has also won several awards for her dancing.

 

Aishwarya Khare started her career as a model and appeared in several commercials. She made her television debut in 2016 with the show Yeh Hai Chahatein. She played the role of Mahima Srinivasan Khurana, the younger sister of Ruhi Bhalla. She was a part of the show for three years and her performance was praised by critics and audiences alike.

 

In 2020, Aishwarya Khare bagged the lead role of Lakshmi Bajwa in the Zee TV show Bhagya Lakshmi. She is playing the role of a simple yet strong woman who is fighting for her rights. The show has been well-received by the audience and Aishwarya Khare's performance has been praised by critics.

item.title: Aneri Vajani

item.content:encoded:
Aneri Vajani

Bollywood Female Actor

Aneri Vajani is an Indian actress who primarily works in Hindi television. She made her acting debut with Kaali – Ek Punar Avatar as Paakhi in 2012. Vajani is best known for her portrayal of Nisha Gangwal in Nisha Aur Uske Cousins and Saanjh Mathur in Beyhadh.

 

Aneri Vajani was born on 26 March 1994 in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. She completed her schooling from St. Xavier's High School, Fort, Mumbai. She is a graduate in Mass Media from Jai Hind College, Mumbai.

 

Aneri Vajani started her career as a model and appeared in several commercials. She made her television debut in 2012 with the show Kaali – Ek Punar Avatar. She played the role of Paakhi, a young woman who is trying to find her place in the world. She was a part of the show for one year.

 

In 2013, Aneri Vajani joined the cast of Nisha Aur Uske Cousins and played the role of Nisha Gangwal. She was a part of the show for three years and her performance was praised by critics and audiences alike. She won the Indian Telly Award for Best Actress (Popular) for her role in Nisha Aur Uske Cousins.

 

In 2016, Aneri Vajani joined the cast of Beyhadh and played the role of Saanjh Mathur. She was a part of the show for one year and her performance was praised by critics and audiences alike. She won the Indian Telly Award for Best Actress in a Negative Role for her role in Beyhadh.

item.content:encoded:
Anchal Sahu

Bollywood Female Actor

Anchal Sahu is an Indian television actress who is known for her roles in the television shows Kyun Utthe Dil Chhod Aaye and Parineetii. She was born on 18 March 2005 in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. She completed her schooling from Thakur Public School, Kandivali, Mumbai. She is currently pursuing her graduation from Thakur College of Science and Commerce, Kandivali, Mumbai.

Anchal Sahu started her career as a child artist in 2015 with the television show Tashan-e-Ishq. She played the role of Bubbly Taneja in the show. In 2016, she joined the cast of Kyun Utthe Dil Chhod Aaye and played the role of Vashma Baig. She was a part of the show for two years and her performance was praised by critics and audiences alike.

In 2022, Anchal Sahu bagged the lead role of Parineet Kakkar in the Zee TV show Parineetii. She is playing the role of a young woman who is trying to find her place in the world. The show has been well-received by the audience and Anchal Sahu's performance has been praised by critics.

item.content:encoded:
Ankita Lokhande

Telivision Female Actor

Ankita Lokhande is an Indian actress who works in Hindi television and films. She is known for her roles in the television series Pavitra Rishta (2009–2014) and Manikarnika: The Queen of Jhansi (2019).

 

Lokhande was born on 19 December 1984 in Indore, Madhya Pradesh. She completed her schooling from St. Joseph's Convent, Indore. She started her career as a model and appeared in several commercials. She made her television debut in 2009 with the show Pavitra Rishta. She played the role of Archana Deshmukh, a young woman who is trying to find her place in the world. The show was a huge success and Ankita Lokhande became a household name. She won several awards for her performance, including the Indian Telly Award for Best Actress (Popular).

 

In 2019, Ankita Lokhande made her film debut with Kangana Ranaut's Manikarnika: The Queen of Jhansi. She played the role of Jhalkari Bai, a warrior who fought for the freedom of India. The film was a commercial success and Ankita Lokhande's performance was praised by critics.

item.title: Aparna Dixit
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Aparna Dixit

Telivision Female Actor

Aparna Dixit is an Indian television actress. She is known for her roles in the television shows Yeh Dil Sun Raha Hai, Porus, and Bepanah Pyaar.

 

Aparna Dixit was born on 20 October 1991 in Agra, Uttar Pradesh, India. She completed her schooling from St. Joseph's Convent, Agra. She is a trained classical dancer and has also won several awards for her dancing.

 

Aparna Dixit started her career as a model and appeared in several commercials. She made her television debut in 2013 with the show Mahabharat as Queen Ambika. She followed by acting in Zee TV's Pavitra Rishta. In 2014, Dixit portrayed Gauri in Colors TV's Meri Aashiqui Tum Se Hi. She got her first breakthrough as a lead in Sony Pal's Yeh Dil Sun Raha Hai opposite Navi Bhangu as Poorvi which went off the air in February 2015.

 

In 2017, Aparna Dixit played the role of Roxana in the historical drama Porus. She was praised for her performance and won several awards for her role.

 

In 2018, Aparna Dixit bagged the lead role of Bani in the Colors TV show Bepanah Pyaar. She is playing the role of a woman who is trying to find her way back to her life after being betrayed by her husband. The show has been well-received by the audience and Aparna Dixit's performance has been praised by critics.

item.content:encoded:
Arti Singh

Telivision Female Actor

Arti Singh is an Indian television actress who is known for her roles in the television shows "Yeh Hai Mohabbatein", "Pavitra Rishta", and "Bigg Boss 13". She was born on 5 April 1985 in Lucknow, India. She is the niece of actor Govinda and the sister of comedian Krushna Abhishek.

 

Arti Singh started her career as a child artist in the television show "Kahaani Ghar Ghar Kii". She then went on to play supporting roles in several television shows, including "Yeh Hai Mohabbatein", "Pavitra Rishta", and "Beintehaa".

 

In 2019, Arti Singh participated in the reality show "Bigg Boss 13". She emerged as the fourth runner-up of the show. Her stint on the show made her a household name and she gained a lot of popularity.

 

After "Bigg Boss 13", Arti Singh has appeared in several television shows, including "Dil Toh Happy Hai Ji" and "The Kapil Sharma Show". She is also a successful businesswoman and has her own clothing line.

 

Arti Singh is a talented actress and a popular television personality. She is known for her bubbly personality and her sense of humor. She is also a strong advocate for mental health and has spoken openly about her own struggles with depression.

item.title: Asha Negi
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Asha Negi

Telivision Female Actor

Asha Negi is an Indian television actress. She is known for her roles in the television shows Pavitra Rishta and Baarish. She was born on 23 August 1989 in Dehradun, Uttarakhand, India. She completed her schooling from St. Joseph's Convent, Dehradun. She is a trained classical dancer and has also won several awards for her dancing.

 

Asha Negi started her career as a model and appeared in several commercials. She made her television debut in 2010 with the show Sapnon Se Bhare Naina. She played the role of Madhura in the show. In 2011, she joined the cast of Pavitra Rishta and played the role of Purvi Deshmukh. She was a part of the show for four years and her performance was praised by critics and audiences alike. She won the Indian Telly Award for Best Actress (Popular) for her role in Pavitra Rishta.

 

In 2015, Asha Negi joined the cast of Baarish and played the role of Gauravi Karmarkar. She was a part of the show for two years and her performance was praised by critics and audiences alike. She won the Indian Telly Award for Best Actress (Popular) for her role in Baarish.

item.title: Ashi Singh
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Ashi Singh

Telivision Female Actor

Ashi Singh is an Indian television actress. She is known for her roles in the television shows Yeh Un Dinon Ki Baat Hai, Aladdin – Naam Toh Suna Hoga, and Meet. Ashi Singh was born on 12 August 1997 in Agra, Uttar Pradesh, India. She completed her schooling from St. Joseph's Convent, Agra. She is a trained classical dancer and has also won several awards for her dancing. Ashi Singh started her career as a model and appeared in several commercials. She made her television debut in 2015 with the show Secret Diaries: The Hidden Chapters. She was also seen in Gumrah, Crime Patrol and Savdhaan India. She made a cameo appearance in Qaidi Band as the jailer's daughter. In 2017, she was selected to play the lead role of Naina Agarwal in SET India's Yeh Un Dinon Ki Baat Hai opposite Randeep Rai. The show ran successfully until August 2019. In July 2020, after Avneet Kaur quit the show on health basis, Ashi then played Yasmine on Sony SAB's Aladdin – Naam Toh Suna Hoga opposite Siddharth Nigam. Since 2021, Ashi Singh is appearing as Meet Hooda in Zee TV's Meet. She is playing the role of a simple yet strong woman who is fighting for her rights. The show has been well-received by the audience and Ashi Singh's performance has been praised by critics.

item.title: Ashnoor Kaur
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Ashnoor Kaur

Telivision Female Actor

Ashnoor Kaur is an Indian actress who is known for her roles in the television shows Jhansi Ki Rani, Yeh Rishta Kya Kehlata Hai and Patiala Babes. She was born on 3 May 2004 in New Delhi, India. She completed her schooling from Amity International School, Vasant Kunj, New Delhi. She is currently pursuing her graduation from Amity University, Noida, Uttar Pradesh.

 

Ashnoor Kaur started her career as a child artist in 2009 with the television show Jhansi Ki Rani. She played the role of young Jhansi Rani in the show. In 2010, she joined the cast of Yeh Rishta Kya Kehlata Hai and played the role of Naksh Singhania. She was a part of the show for six years and her performance was praised by critics and audiences alike.

 

In 2016, Ashnoor Kaur bagged the lead role of Mini Thakur in the Colors TV show Patiala Babes. She played the role of a young girl who is trying to find her place in the world. The show was well-received by the audience and Ashnoor Kaur's performance was praised by critics.

item.title: Avika Gor
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Avika Gor

Telivision Female Actor

Avika Gor is an Indian actress who works primarily in Hindi and Telugu, films and television. She is famously known for playing the role of Anandi in Balika Vadhu and Roli in Sasural Simar Ka. She made her Telugu film debut with Uyyala Jampala (2013), for which she won SIIMA Award for Best Female Debut – Telugu.

 

Avika Gor was born on June 30, 1997 in Mumbai, Maharashtra. She attended Sharon English High School in the Mulund suburb of Mumbai. She made her Hindi television debut with Ssshhhh... Koi Hai in 2007. She made her film debut in Tollywood with Uyyala Jampala in 2013 and won SIIMA Award for Best Female Debut – Telugu.

 

Avika Gor is a talented actress who has been in the industry for over a decade. She has appeared in several popular television shows, including Balika Vadhu, Sasural Simar Ka, and Laado 2. She has also starred in the films Uyyala Jampala, Ekkadiki Pothavu Chinnavada, and Raju Gari Gadhi

item.title: Barkha Bisht Sengupta
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Barkha Bisht Sengupta

Bollywood Female Actor

Barkha Bisht Sengupta is a talented Indian actress known for her work in both Hindi TV serials and Bengali and Hindi films. Her journey in the entertainment industry began with her first TV appearance in the show "Kitni Mast Hai Zindagi" as Udita. She made her debut on the big screen with the Hindi film "Raajneeti" in 2010 and ventured into Bengali cinema with "Dui Prithibi" in the same year.

 

Born and raised in military towns, Barkha's father being a colonel, she spent her childhood in places like Kolkata. She hails from Dehradun, Uttarakhand, and is of Garhwali descent. She has two elder sisters, one a hotel management professional and the other a fashion designer.

 

In her television career, Barkha played lead roles in various shows like "Pyaar Ke Do Naam: Ek Raadha, Ek Shyaam" and "Doli Saja Ke." She also hosted the film-news based program "Popkorn" on Zoom TV. Her versatility as an actress was showcased in shows like "Sajan Ghar Jaana Hai," where she portrayed the central character of Dhani, and "Sankat Mochan Mahabali Hanumaan," where she played the role of Hanuman's mother, Añjanā.

 

Barkha's personal life includes her marriage to actor Indraneil Sengupta, with whom she tied the knot in 2008 after a two-year courtship. They have a daughter named Meira. However, they separated in 2021, and Barkha is currently in a relationship with actor and producer Ashish Sharma.

item.title: Jackie Shroff
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Jackie Shroff

Bollywood Male Actor

Jackie Shroff, also known as the "Bhidu" of Bollywood, is an iconic actor who has left a lasting impact on Indian cinema. With his charming personality, deep voice, and rugged looks, Jackie made a powerful presence on the silver screen. He rose to fame with the film "Hero," where his portrayal of a fearless and rebellious lover earned him immense popularity.

 

 Jackie's natural acting skills and ability to connect with the audience made him a versatile actor who excelled in both intense and light-hearted roles. Films like "Parinda," "Rangeela," and "Khalnayak" showcased his versatility and garnered critical acclaim. Jackie's performances have won him several awards, including a Filmfare Award for Best Actor.

item.title: Govinda
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Govinda

Bollywood Male Actor

Govinda, often referred to as the "Hero No. 1" of Bollywood, is a versatile actor known for his impeccable comic timing and energetic dance performances. With his unique style and ability to make audiences laugh, Govinda has entertained millions of fans throughout his career. Starting his journey as an actor with the film "Ilzaam," Govinda quickly gained popularity for his effortless portrayal of comic characters.

 

His collaborations with filmmaker David Dhawan resulted in several successful and iconic comedy films, such as "Coolie No. 1," "Hero No. 1," and "Haseena Maan Jaayegi." Govinda's infectious energy and ability to deliver hilarious dialogues made him a favorite among the masses. Besides comedy, Govinda has also showcased his talent in dramatic roles, proving his versatility as an actor.

item.title: Pankaj Tripathi
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Pankaj Tripathi

Bollywood Male Actor

Pankaj Tripathi is a highly regarded Indian actor known for his exceptional performances in both films and web series. He rose to prominence with his portrayal of the endearing and unconventional character, Sultan Qureshi, in the film "Gangs of Wasseypur." Pankaj Tripathi's acting style is characterized by his understated yet impactful performances, his ability to breathe life into any character he plays, and his impeccable comic timing.

 

He has displayed his versatility by taking on a wide range of roles, from intense and serious characters to comical and eccentric ones. Pankaj Tripathi's performances in films like "Stree," "Newton," and "Ludo" have garnered critical acclaim and numerous accolades, including a National Film Award. Additionally, his roles in popular web series like "Mirzapur" and "Sacred Games" have further solidified his position as a talented actor. Pankaj Tripathi's ability to captivate audiences with his subtle expressions, his ability to seamlessly blend into his characters, and his distinctive screen presence make him a highly respected and sought-after actor in the industry.
