item.title: Sanjay Dutt
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Sanjay Dutt

Bollywood Male Actor

Sanjay Dutt, popularly known as "Sanju Baba," is a renowned Bollywood actor with a career spanning several decades. He comes from a family deeply rooted in the film industry and has carved a niche for himself with his distinct on-screen presence. Sanjay Dutt's acting journey has been marked by a wide range of roles, including action-packed performances, intense portrayals, and memorable characters.

 

He has delivered notable performances in films like "Khalnayak," "Munna Bhai M.B.B.S.," and "Agneepath." Sanjay Dutt's personal life has seen its share of ups and downs, with his battles with addiction and legal troubles making headlines. However, he has shown tremendous resilience and has emerged as a symbol of strength and redemption. Sanjay Dutt's ability to bounce back and rebuild his career is a testament to his determination and love for his craft. Beyond his acting career, Sanjay Dutt is also actively involved in various social causes.

item.title: Aasif Sheikh
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Aasif Sheikh

Bollywood Male Actor

Aasif Sheikh is a talented Bollywood actor known for his versatile performances in the Indian film industry. Born on November 11, 1964, in Varanasi, India, Aasif Sheikh has made a significant contribution to Hindi cinema.

 

He began his acting career in the 1980s and gained recognition for his roles in films like "Hum Kisise Kum Nahin" and "Kurbaan." However, he achieved immense popularity and critical acclaim for his portrayal of the lovable character "Vibhuti Narayan Mishra" in the hit television series "Bhabiji Ghar Par Hain!"

 

Aasif Sheikh's impeccable comic timing and natural acting skills have endeared him to audiences, making him one of the most respected actors in Bollywood. With his charming personality and impressive body of work, Aasif Sheikh continues to entertain and captivate audiences with his performances.

Abhinav Shukla

Bollywood Male Actor

Abhinav Shukla is a talented Bollywood actor who has made a mark in the Indian film industry. Born on September 27, 1982, in Ludhiana, Punjab, Abhinav started his career in the entertainment industry as a model and later transitioned into acting.

 

He made his acting debut with the film "Jaane Tu... Ya Jaane Na" and went on to work in movies like "Aksar 2" and "Roar: Tigers of the Sundarbans." A

bhinav is known for his striking looks, charming screen presence, and dedication to his craft. In addition to his film career, he has also appeared in popular television shows like "Geet - Hui Sabse Parayi" and "Diya Aur Baati Hum."

item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Abhay Deol

Bollywood Male Actor

Abhay Deol is a talented Bollywood actor known for his unconventional film choices and powerful performances. Born on March 15, 1976, in Mumbai, India, Abhay comes from a family with a rich cinematic background. He made his acting debut with the film "Socha Na Tha" and gained critical acclaim for his performances in movies like "Dev.D," "Oye Lucky! Lucky Oye!," and "Zindagi Na Milegi Dobara."

 

Abhay is known for his ability to portray complex and nuanced characters with depth and authenticity. With his refreshing approach to cinema and commitment to meaningful storytelling, he has carved a niche for himself in the industry, earning him a loyal fan base.

Adil Hussain

Bollywood Male Actor

Adil Hussain is a highly acclaimed and versatile Bollywood actor known for his exceptional acting skills and diverse roles. Born on October 5, 1963, in Assam, India, Adil has made a significant impact on both Indian cinema and international films.

 

He has showcased his talent in movies like "English Vinglish," "Life of Pi," and "Parched," among others. Adil's performances are marked by his intense portrayal of characters, capturing their emotions and complexities with great depth. His ability to effortlessly switch between mainstream Bollywood and independent cinema has earned him critical acclaim and numerous awards.

item.title: Aditya Srivastava
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Aditya Srivastava

Bollywood Male Actor

Aditya Srivastava is indeed an Indian actor known for his work in Hindi films, television, and theatre. He gained significant popularity for his portrayal of Senior Inspector Abhijeet in the long-running television series C.I.D. Some of his notable Bollywood films include "Satya," "Gulaal," "Lakshya," "Paanch," "Black Friday," "Kaalo," "Super 30," and "Dil Se Pooch Kidhar Jana Hai."

 

During his graduation years at Allahabad University, Aditya Srivastava actively participated in theatre plays at Sangeet Samiti in Civil Lines, Allahabad. In 1989, he moved to Delhi to further refine his acting skills and pursue a career in the field. In Delhi, he primarily focused on theatre work at the Sri Ram Center of Performing Arts. It was during this time that he caught the attention of filmmaker Shekhar Kapoor, which led to his first break in the movie "Bandit Queen," where he played the character Puttilal.

 

In 1995, Aditya Srivastava relocated to Mumbai (then Bombay) and began working in the entertainment industry. Initially, he lent his voice for promos and advertisements and also appeared in significant episodic roles in TV shows like "Byomkesh Bakshi," "Rishtey," and "Aahat." He gained prominence through his roles in TV shows such as "Naya Daur," "9 Malabar Hill," and "Yeh Shaadi Nahi Ho Sakti," where he had substantial and memorable roles.

Aditya Srivastava is indeed an Indian actor known for his work in Hindi films, television, and theatre. He gained significant popularity for his portrayal of Senior Inspector Abhijeet in the long-running television series C.I.D. Some of his notable Bollywood films include \"Satya,\" \"Gulaal,\" \"Lakshya,\" \"Paanch,\" \"Black Friday,\" \"Kaalo,\" \"Super 30,\" and \"Dil Se Pooch Kidhar Jana Hai.\"<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

During his graduation years at Allahabad University, Aditya Srivastava actively participated in theatre plays at Sangeet Samiti in Civil Lines, Allahabad. In 1989, he moved to Delhi to further refine his acting skills and pursue a career in the field. In Delhi, he primarily focused on theatre work at the Sri Ram Center of Performing Arts. It was during this time that he caught the attention of filmmaker Shekhar Kapoor, which led to his first break in the movie \"Bandit Queen,\" where he played the character Puttilal.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

In 1995, Aditya Srivastava relocated to Mumbai (then Bombay) and began working in the entertainment industry. Initially, he lent his voice for promos and advertisements and also appeared in significant episodic roles in TV shows like \"Byomkesh Bakshi,\" \"Rishtey,\" and \"Aahat.\" He gained prominence through his roles in TV shows such as \"Naya Daur,\" \"9 Malabar Hill,\" and \"Yeh Shaadi Nahi Ho Sakti,\" where he had substantial and memorable roles.<\/p>","typography_typography":"custom","typography_font_weight":"bold"},"elements":[],"widgetType":"text-editor"}],"isInner":false}],"isInner":false},{"id":"6d8c4ef","elType":"section","settings":{"background_background":"classic","background_color":"#EAF0EE8F","hover_parallax":[{"layer_position_vr":{"unit":"%","size":30},"layer_position_hr":{"unit":"%","size":40},"_id":"ac4fb18"},{"layer_position_vr":{"unit":"%","size":60},"layer_position_hr":{"unit":"%","size":20},"_id":"a1b2b38"}]},"elements":[{"id":"e3bbfd9","elType":"column","settings":{"_column_size":100,"_inline_size":null},"elements":[{"id":"e0893ad","elType":"widget","settings":{"title":"Enquiry Form","header_size":"h3","align":"center","typography_typography":"custom","typography_font_size":{"unit":"px","size":40,"sizes":[]},"typography_font_weight":"bold","_margin":{"unit":"px","top":"40","right":"0","bottom":"20","left":"0","isLinked":false},"__globals__":{"title_color":"globals\/colors?id=6d3d44f9"}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"heading"},{"id":"7b45c4f","elType":"widget","settings":{"shortcode":"[forminator_form id=\"5483\"]","_margin":{"unit":"px","top":"0","right":"0","bottom":"40","left":"0","isLinked":false}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"shortcode"}],"isInner":false}],"isInner":false}]

item.title: Aftab Shivdasani
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Aftab Shivdasani

Bollywood Male Actor

Aftab Shivdasani is a popular Bollywood actor known for his versatile performances in the Indian film industry. Born on June 25, 1978, in Mumbai, India, he started his acting career as a child artist in the 1987 film "Mr. India."

 

Aftab gained recognition and critical acclaim for his role in the 1999 romantic comedy "Mast," which established him as a promising young talent. He went on to deliver notable performances in movies like "Kasoor," "Awara Paagal Deewana," and "Hungama."

 

Aftab's charming persona, natural acting skills, and ability to excel in both comedy and drama genres have made him a respected figure in Bollywood. With his talent and dedication, Aftab Shivdasani continues to entertain audiences and make his mark in the Indian film industry.

item.content:encoded:
Farhan Akhtar

Bollywood Male Actor

Danny Denzongpa is an iconic Bollywood actor known for his versatile performances in the Indian film industry. Born on February 25, 1948, in Sikkim, he has carved a niche for himself with his commanding screen presence and intense acting skills.

 

Danny made his acting debut with the film "Zaroorat" in 1972 and has since then delivered memorable performances in movies like "Kabhie Kabhie," "Agneepath," and "Baby." Bollywood Male Actor

Jugal Hansraj is a talented Bollywood actor who has been a part of the industry since his childhood. Born on July 26, 1972, he began his career as a child artist and gained recognition with his memorable role in the film "Masoom."

 

Jugal continued to showcase his acting prowess in movies like "Papa Kehte Hai" and "Mohabbatein." Besides acting, he has also ventured into direction and writing. Jugal's dedication to his craft and his ability to portray a wide range of characters have earned him admiration from audiences.

item.title: Kabir Bedi
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Kabir Bedi

Bollywood Male Actor

Kabir Bedi is a veteran Bollywood actor who has made significant contributions to the Indian film industry. Born on January 16, 1946, he has had a prolific career spanning several decades. Kabir's notable films include "Khoon Bhari Maang," "Kurbaan," and "Main Hoon Na."

 

With his captivating screen presence and commanding acting skills, he has left a lasting impression on audiences. Kabir Bedi has also worked in international projects, notably featuring as a Bond villain in the film "Octopussy." Beyond acting, he has been involved in theater, television, and writing.

item.content:encoded:
Kamaal R Khan

Bollywood Male Actor

Kamaal R Khan, often referred to as KRK, is a controversial figure in the Bollywood industry. Born on June 1, 1975, he started his career as a supporting actor in films like "Deshdrohi" and "Mumbai Mirror." However, KRK gained more prominence for his controversial statements and social media presence rather than his acting abilities. He has been known to make provocative and often offensive remarks about celebrities and films.

 

While his acting career has not achieved significant success, KRK has managed to stay in the limelight through his controversial persona.

Bollywood Male Actor

Kunal Khemu is a talented Bollywood actor known for his versatile performances and youthful charm. Born on May 25, 1983, he started his acting career as a child artist and transitioned into adult roles with films like "Kalyug" and "Traffic Signal."

 

Kunal has displayed his acting prowess in a variety of genres, including comedy, drama, and thrillers. His notable films include "Golmaal" series, "Blood Money," and "Lootcase."

Apart from acting, Mahesh Manjrekar has also directed and written several successful films, showcasing his multifaceted talent.

item.title: Ameesha Patel
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Ameesha Patel

Bollywood Female Actor

Ameesha Patel is an Indian actress and model who predominantly appears in Hindi films. She made her acting debut in 2000 with the romantic thriller film Kaho Naa... Pyaar Hai which became critically and commercially successful and won her several awards including Zee Cine Award for Best Female Debut.

 

Patel was born in a Gujarati family to Amit and Asha Patel on 9 June 1975. She is the sister of Ashmit Patel and the granddaughter of lawyer-politician Barrister Rajni Patel, who was the Congress Pradesh Committee President of Mumbai. She was born in the Breach Candy Hospital in Mumbai and has been a trained Bharatnatyam dancer since the age of five. Her birth-name is a blend of the first three letters of her father's name Amit and the last three letters of her mother's name Asha.

 

After completing her schooling from Cathedral and John Connon School, Mumbai, Patel moved to the United States to study economics at Tufts University. However, she dropped out after a year to pursue a career in modelling. She returned to India in 1999 and signed a three-film deal with Suneel Darshan. Her debut film, Kaho Naa... Pyaar Hai, opposite Hrithik Roshan, was released in 2000 and became a blockbuster. Patel won several awards for her performance, including the Filmfare Award for Best Female Debut.

 

Patel went on to star in a number of successful films, including Gadar: Ek Prem Katha (2001), Humraaz (2002), Yeh Hai Jalwa (2002), Main Hoon Na (2004), Bhool Bhulaiyaa (2007) and Race 2 (2013). She has also appeared in a few Telugu films, including Athadu (2005) and Pokiri (2006).

 

In recent years, Patel has taken a break from acting to focus on her personal life. She married businessman Vikram Bhatt in 2011, but the couple divorced in 2013. She has also been involved in a number of charitable causes, including the Make-A-Wish Foundation and the World Wildlife Fund.

item.title: Amrita Arora
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Amrita Arora

Bollywood Female Actor

Amrita Arora is an Indian actress, model, television presenter and video jockey, who primarily appears in Hindi-language films. She was born on January 31, 1981 in Mumbai, Maharashtra to a Punjabi Hindu father and a Malayali mother. She is the younger sister of actress Malaika Arora.

Amrita Arora began her career as a model and appeared in several advertisements, including those for Ponds, Elle 18, After Smoke, and Sunsilk Fruitiness. She then made her acting debut in the 2002 film Kitne Door Kitne Paas, which was a commercial failure. However, she went on to star in several successful films, including Kal Ho Naa Ho (2003), Salaam Namaste (2005), and Partner (2007).

 

In addition to her acting career, Amrita Arora has also hosted several television shows, including MTV Housefull and MTV Chillout. She is also a popular fashion icon and has been featured in several fashion magazines.

Bollywood Male Actor

Javed Jaffrey is a versatile Bollywood actor known for his incredible comedic timing and captivating performances. Born on December 4, 1963, he comes from a renowned entertainment family with his father, Jagdeep, being a legendary actor. Javed has showcased his talent in a wide range of roles, from comedy to drama.

 

His notable films include "Salaam Namaste," "Dhamaal," and "Jagga Jasoos." 

 

Besides acting, Javed is also an accomplished dancer and a popular television host. With his unique charm, wit, and ability to effortlessly entertain audiences, Javed Jaffrey has established himself as a beloved figure in the Bollywood industry, leaving a lasting impression with his memorable performances.

Bollywood Male Actor

Jeetendra, popularly known as "Jumping Jack," is a legendary Bollywood actor who has left an indelible mark on Indian cinema. Born on April 7, 1942, he ruled the silver screen during the 1970s and 1980s with his charismatic presence and remarkable dance skills.

 

Jeetendra's notable films include "Caravan," "Parichay," and "Himmatwala," among many others. He was known for his signature dance moves and unique style, which made him a heartthrob of his time. Jeetendra's contribution to the industry extends beyond acting, as he later became a successful film producer.

item.title: Amrita Rao
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Amrita Rao

Bollywood Female Actor

Amrita Rao is an Indian actress who works in Hindi films. She made her acting debut with the 2002 film Ab Ke Baras, which earned her a nomination for the Filmfare Award for Best Female Debut. She won the IIFA Award for Star Debut of the Year – Female for her portrayal of a college student in the 2003 romantic drama Ishq Vishk, her first commercial success. Rao was born in Mumbai, India, on June 7, 1981. She is the younger sister of actress Preetika Rao. Rao studied at the St. Joseph's Convent School in Bandra, Mumbai. She then attended the Mithibai College of Arts, Commerce and Economics, where she studied economics. Rao began her career as a model in 2000. She appeared in several commercials and print ads. In 2002, she made her acting debut with the film Ab Ke Baras. The film was a critical and commercial failure. However, Rao's performance was praised by critics. She was nominated for the Filmfare Award for Best Female Debut for her performance. In 2003, Rao starred in the romantic drama Ishq Vishk. The film was a commercial success and Rao's performance was praised by critics. She won the IIFA Award for Star Debut of the Year – Female for her performance. Rao went on to star in several successful films, including Vivah (2006), Main Hoon Na (2004), and Lakshya (2004). She also starred in the television series Meri Awaaz Hi Pehchaan Hai (2016). Rao is married to RJ Anmol. The couple have a son, Agastya, who was born in 2016. Rao is a popular actress in India. She is known for her sweet and innocent image. She is also known for her charity work. She is a brand ambassador for several charities, including the Smile Train and the World Wildlife Fund.

item.title: Amrita Singh
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Amrita Singh

Bollywood Female Actor

Amrita Singh is an Indian actress who has appeared in over 100 films since her debut in 1983. She is known for her roles in films such as Betaab (1983), Mard (1985), and Rangeela (1995). Singh has won several awards for her work, including the Filmfare Award for Best Actress for her performance in Betaab. She is also the recipient of the Padma Shri, the fourth-highest civilian award in India.

 

Singh was born in Hadali, Pakistan, in 1958. Her father was an army officer and her mother was a political activist. Singh moved to India with her family when she was a child. She studied at the Convent of Jesus and Mary in New Delhi and the National School of Drama in Delhi.

 

Singh made her film debut in 1983 with the film Betaab. She was paired opposite Rishi Kapoor in the film and their chemistry was well-received by the audience. Singh went on to star in several successful films in the 1980s, including Mard (1985), Qayamat Se Qayamat Tak (1988), and Vijay (1988).

 

In the 1990s, Singh continued to act in successful films, such as Rangeela (1995), Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge (1995), and Pardes (1997). She also made her debut on television in 1997 with the show Amrita.

 

Singh has taken a break from acting in recent years, but she has not retired from the industry. She continues to be active in public life and is a vocal advocate for women's rights. She is also a successful businesswoman and owns a production company, Amrita Singh Films.

item.title: Amyra Dastur
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Amyra Dastur

Bollywood Female Actor

Amyra Dastur is an Indian actress who works in Hindi, Telugu, and Tamil films. She was born on May 7, 1993, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. Dastur is a Parsi and she speaks English, Gujarati, Tamil, and French. She holds a bachelor's degree in commerce from Mumbai's HR College.

 

Dastur began her career as a model in commercials. She appeared in advertisements for brands such as Clean & Clear, Dove, Airtel, and Micromax. In 2013, Dastur made her Hindi cinema debut with the romantic drama Issaq, opposite Prateik Babbar. The film was directed by Manish Tiwary.

 

In 2017, Dastur made her international debut with the action comedy film Kung Fu Yoga, alongside Jackie Chan. The film was a commercial success and was well-received by critics. Dastur has also starred in the films Kaalakaandi (2018), Mard Ko Dard Nahi Hota (2018), and Parmanu: The Story of Pokhran (2018).

Katrina Kaif is a British-Indian actress and one of the most popular and influential personalities in the Indian film industry. Known for her stunning beauty, graceful dance moves, and versatile performances, she has won the hearts of millions of fans across the globe.

 

Katrina made her Bollywood debut with the film "Boom" and rose to prominence with movies like "Namastey London," "Ek Tha Tiger," and "Dhoom 3." She is often praised for her dedication to her craft and her ability to portray a range of characters with depth and authenticity. Katrina's dance skills are exceptional, and she has given mesmerizing performances in numerous songs that have become chart-toppers.

item.content:encoded:
Rakul Preet Singh

Bollywood Female Actor

Rakul Preet Singh is an Indian actress and model who predominantly works in the Telugu and Hindi film industries. With her charming persona and impressive acting skills, she has gained a considerable fan following. Rakul made her acting debut in the Kannada film "Gilli" and then went on to work in Telugu and Tamil films.

 

She eventually made her mark in Bollywood with films like "Yaariyan," "De De Pyaar De," and "Marjaavaan." Rakul is known for her versatility, as she effortlessly transitions between different genres and roles. Along with her acting career, she has also been associated with several brands as a brand ambassador, showcasing her popularity and influence.

item.title: Aamir Ali
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Aamir Ali

Bollywood Male Actor

Aamir Ali is an Indian actor and model. He was born on September 1, 1977 in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. He made his acting debut in the 2006 television series F.I.R., and has since appeared in several other television shows, including Kya Dill Mein Hai, Punar Vivah, and Qubool Hai. He has also appeared in a few films, including I Hate Luv Storys and Raakh.

 

Ali is known for his good looks and his acting skills. He is also a talented dancer, and has participated in several dance reality shows, including Nach Baliye 3. He is a popular figure on social media, and has over 7 million followers on Instagram.

 

In 2012, Ali married actress Sanjeeda Sheikh. The couple have a daughter, Ayra, who was born in 2014.

item.title: Aamir Dalvi
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Aamir Dalvi

Television Male Actor

Aamir Dalvi is an Indian actor who has worked in both television and films. He is best known for his role as Zafar in the television series Aladdin - Naam Toh Suna Hoga.

 

Dalvi was born in Mumbai, India in 1975. He studied acting at the National School of Drama in Delhi. After graduating, he began his acting career with small roles in television shows. He made his film debut in the 1999 film Nyay.

 

In 2018, Dalvi was cast as Zafar in the television series Aladdin - Naam Toh Suna Hoga. The series was a huge success and Dalvi's performance was critically acclaimed. He won several awards for his performance, including the ITA Award for Best Actor in a Negative Role.

 

Dalvi has also appeared in several films, including Dilli Gang (2013), Saansein: The Last Breath (2016), and The Tashkent Files (2019). He is currently working on the upcoming film, Mumbai Saga.

item.title: Abrar Qazi
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Abrar Qazi

Television Male Actor

Abrar Qazi is an Indian television actor. He was born on 3 August 1992 in Srinagar, Jammu and Kashmir. He made his television debut in 2019 with the show Gathbandhan. He played the role of Raghu Jadhav, a Dombivli gangster who falls in love with a police officer. Qazi's performance in the show was praised by critics and audiences alike. He won the Indian Telly Award for Best Actor in a Lead Role Male for his performance in Gathbandhan.

 

In 2020, Qazi was cast in the show Yeh Hai Chahatein. He plays the role of Rudraksh Khurana, a rockstar who falls in love with a single mother. Qazi's performance in the show has been well-received by critics and audiences alike. He has been nominated for the Indian Telly Award for Best Actor in a Lead Role Male for his performance in Yeh Hai Chahatein.

item.title: Adnan Khan
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Adnan Khan

Television Male Actor

Adnan Khan is an Indian actor who appears in Hindi Films, Hindi Television and Web series. He is best known for his role as Mawlawi Kabeer Ahmed in Zee TV's drama series Ishq Subhan Allah.

 

Khan was born in Dubai, United Arab Emirates on December 24, 1988. He has an older brother named Imran Ali. Khan went to Our Own English High School in Dubai and graduated from the esteemed Manipal University Dubai in the year 2009. He holds a degree in Business Administration (BBA With Specialization In International Business Management). Khan briefly worked as a Human Resources Manager in a Dubai-based firm and left his job as he always looked forward to a career in acting.

 

Khan made his acting debut in 2018 with the Zee TV drama series Ishq Subhan Allah. He played the role of Mawlawi Kabeer Ahmed, a devout Muslim who falls in love with a Hindu girl named Zara Siddiqui (played by Eisha Singh). The show was a huge success and Khan's performance was critically acclaimed. He won several awards for his performance, including the Indian Telly Award for Best Actor in a Lead Role (Male) and the Gold Awards for Best Actor in a Negative Role.

 

After Ishq Subhan Allah, Khan appeared in the web series The Rage: Over Injustice. He played the role of Arjun, a young man who is falsely accused of a crime he did not commit. The show was a critical and commercial success.

 

Khan is currently working on the web series Katha Ankahee. He plays the role of Viaan Raghuwanshi, a young man who is trying to find his way in the world. The show is scheduled to release in 2023.

item.title: Aham Sharma
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Aham Sharma

Television Male Actor

Aham Sharma is an Indian actor who is best known for his work in Indian television. He has also featured in several Bollywood films including 1962 My Country Land which premiered at Marche du Film of the 69th Cannes Film Festival.

 

Sharma was born in Salimpur, Bihar, India on July 22, 1989. He studied at the National School of Drama in Delhi. After graduating, he began his acting career in Hindi television. He made his television debut in the 2008 show Chand Ke Paar Chalo. He then went on to star in shows such as Aasman Se Aage, Saathi Neyi Soch Ka, and Mahabharat.

 

In 2013, Sharma made his Bollywood debut with the film Blue Oranges. He then went on to star in films such as 1962 My Country Land, Dosti... Yaariyan... Manmarziyan, and Brahmarakshas.

 

Sharma is a versatile actor who has been praised for his performances in both television and films. He is known for his intense acting and his ability to bring characters to life. He is also a talented dancer and has performed in several music videos.

item.title: Akshay Kharodia
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Akshay Kharodia

Television Male Actor

Akshay Kharodia is an Indian actor who is best known for his role as Dev Pandya in the television series Pandya Store. He was born in Kota, Rajasthan, India on May 2, 1996. He studied at Maheshwari Public School in Kota and later attended the Film and Television Institute of India (FTII) in Pune.

 

Kharodia began his acting career in 2016 with a role in the television series Yeh Hai Aashiqui. He then went on to appear in several other television series, including Ishq Subhan Allah, Dil Bole Oberoi, and Naagin 3. In 2020, he was cast in the lead role of Dev Pandya in Pandya Store. The series has been a huge success and has made Kharodia a household name.

 

In addition to his work in television, Kharodia has also appeared in a few films. He made his film debut in 2019 with a role in the film Kandy Twist. He then went on to appear in the films Loveyatri and Malang.

item.title: Aly Goni
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Aly Goni

Television Male Actor

Aly Goni is an Indian actor and model who appears in Hindi television. He made his debut through participating in MTV's dating reality show Splitsvilla 5. Goni rose to fame after portraying Romesh Bhalla in StarPlus's romantic Yeh Hai Mohabbatein till 2019. He has also participated in stunt-based reality show Khatron Ke Khiladi 9, and Nach Baliye 9 both in 2019. In 2020, Goni participated in Colors TV's reality show Bigg Boss 14 where he finished at 4th place.

 

Goni was born on 25 February 1991 to a Muslim family in Bhaderwah, Jammu & Kashmir. He is the son of Amjad Goni and Ruby Goni and has a sister named Ilham Goni. Goni started his career as a model and appeared in several commercials. He made his acting debut in 2014 with the TV show Yeh Hai Mohabbatein. Goni played the role of Romesh Bhalla, a young man who is struggling to find his place in the world. His performance was well-received by the audience and critics alike.

 

In 2019, Goni participated in the stunt-based reality show Khatron Ke Khiladi 9. He emerged as the runner-up of the show. The same year, he also participated in the dance reality show Nach Baliye 9 with his girlfriend Jasmin Bhasin. The couple finished as the first runner-up of the show.

item.title: Anas Rashid
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Anas Rashid

Television Male Actor

Anas Rashid is an Indian actor known for his work in Hindi television. He gained popularity for his roles in the historical drama "Dharti Ka Veer Yodha Prithviraj Chauhan" as Prithviraj Chauhan (2006-09) and in the soap opera "Diya Aur Baati Hum" as Sooraj Rathi, which was one of the highest-rated Indian television series.

 

Anas Rashid was born in Malerkotla into a Muslim family. He has two brothers and two sisters. He completed his schooling from an Urdu Medium School and holds a post-graduation degree in Psychology. He is proficient in Urdu, Punjabi, Arabic, and Persian languages. He is also a trained singer and won the title of Mr. Punjab in 2004.

 

His acting career began with the Star Plus drama "Kahiin To Hoga" where he played the character of Kartik Ahluwalia. He later appeared in a supporting role in the drama "Aise Karo Naa Vidaa." However, his breakthrough role came with the portrayal of Prithviraj Chauhan in "Dharti Ka Veer Yodha Prithviraj Chauhan" on Star Plus, which made him a household name in India. He then went on to play the male lead in "Diya Aur Baati Hum" as Sooraj Rathi. Anas Rashid also made his singing debut with one of the songs from the series. "Diya Aur Baati Hum" was highly acclaimed and garnered high viewership ratings. His performance in the series earned him widespread recognition and several awards.

item.title: Aniruddh Dave
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Aniruddh Dave

Television Male Actor

Aniruddh Dave is an Indian film and television actor. He was born on 21 July 1986 in Dehradun, Uttarakhand. He made his acting debut in the 2009 television series Raajkumar Aaryyan.

Dave is known for his versatile acting skills and his ability to portray a wide range of characters. He is also a popular figure on social media, with over 269,000 followers on Instagram.

In 2015, Dave married Shubhi Ahuja, an actress. 

He has since appeared in several other television series, including Woh Rehne Waali Mehlon Ki (2009), Mera Naam Karegi Roshan (2011), Phulwa (2012), and Patiala Babes (2018). He has also appeared in the films Tere Sang (2012), Shorgul (2016), and Bellbottom (2021).

item.title: Ankit Gera
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Ankit Gera

Television Male Actor

Ankit Gera is an Indian actor known for his roles in various television soaps. He gained recognition for his performances and also appeared as a contestant on the reality show Bigg Boss 9.

 

Ankit completed his studies in Delhi before entering the entertainment industry. He made his television debut with the romantic comedy series Mahi Way on Sony Entertainment Television. His breakthrough role came in the television show Mann Kee Awaaz Pratigya in 2009, where he portrayed the character of Adarsh Saxena until 2011.

 

In 2012, Ankit landed his first lead role in Zee TV's soap opera Sapne Suhane Ladakpan Ke, where he played the character of Mayank Garg opposite Roopal Tyagi. The show garnered him critical acclaim and multiple nominations. The series concluded in 2015.

 

Ankit Gera participated in the reality game show Killer Karaoke Atka Toh Latkah in 2015. He also appeared in the fantasy action series Maharakshak: Devi as Bhasmasur on Zee TV.

 

In 2015, Ankit entered the Bigg Boss house as a celebrity contestant in the show's ninth season. However, he was evicted on Day 7 of the competition.

item.title: Ankit Gupta
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Ankit Gupta

Television Male Actor

Ankit Gupta is an Indian actor who is known for his work in Hindi television. He is best known for his roles as Parth Kashyap in Sadda Haq, Garv Priyom Thakur in Begusarai and Fateh Singh Virk in Colors TV's Udaariyaan.

 

Gupta was born on 6 November 1988 in Meerut, Uttar Pradesh, India. He made his television debut in 2012 with the show Balika Vadhu. He then went on to appear in shows such as Oye Jassie, Sadda Haq, Begusarai and Kuch Rang Pyar Ke Aise Bhi. In 2021, he was cast as the male lead in Udaariyaan. The show became a huge success and Gupta won critical acclaim for his performance.

 

Gupta is also a popular model and has appeared in several ad campaigns.

 

In 2022, Gupta participated in the reality show Bigg Boss 16. He was one of the most popular contestants on the show and finished in the top 5.

item.title: Ankit Mohan
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Ankit Mohan

Television Male Actor

Ankit Mohan is an Indian actor who mainly works in Hindi television and Marathi films. He is best known for his role in the television series Mahabharat, Kumkum Bhagya, and Naagin 3.

 

Mohan was born on January 20, 1988 in Delhi, India. He made his acting debut in the 2009 reality show MTV Roadies. He then went on to appear in several television series, including Ghar Aaja Pardesi, Basera, and Shobha Somnath Ki. In 2013, he was cast as Ashwathama in the television series Mahabharat. The role earned him critical acclaim and made him a household name.

 

In 2015, Mohan was cast as Aakash in the television series Kumkum Bhagya. He played the role for two years and became one of the most popular actors on the show. In 2017, he was cast as Rocky in the television series Naagin 3. The role was a major departure from his previous roles and earned him praise from critics and audiences alike.

 

Mohan has also appeared in several Marathi films, including Timepass, Timepass 2, and Lagna Kallol. He is currently working on the upcoming Marathi film Timepass 3.

 

Mohan is married to Ruchi Savarn. The couple has a son, Agastya, who was born in 2018.

item.title: Anup Soni
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Anup Soni

Television Male Actor

Anup Soni is an Indian actor and anchor. He is an alumnus of the National School of Drama. Soni began his career with roles in television serials such as Sea Hawks and Saaya. He then took a break from television to work in films. He appeared in the 2003 films Kharaashein: Scars From Riots, Hum Pyar Tumhi Se Kar Baithe as well as Hathyar. In 2004, he appeared in Ashoke Pandit's film Sheen. But he returned to television to work in CID: Special Bureau. He continues working both in films and television, and he previously worked in the serial Crime Patrol on Sony.

 

Soni is known for his versatile acting skills and has won several awards for his work, including the Indian Telly Award for Best Actor in a Supporting Role, ITA Award for Best Actor in a Supporting Role, and Indian Telly Jury Award for Best Actor in a Supporting Role. He is also a popular anchor and has hosted several television shows, including Crime Patrol.

 

Soni is married to Juhi Babbar, the daughter of veteran actor-politician Pawan Kumar Babbar. The couple has two daughters, Myra and Zoya.

item.title: Apurva Agnihotri
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Apurva Agnihotri

Television Male Actor

Apurva Agnihotri is an Indian actor who works in Hindi films and television. He was born in Kolkata, India on December 2, 1972. He made his acting debut in the 1997 film Pardes, which starred Shah Rukh Khan and Kajol.

He has since appeared in over 50 films, including Pyaar Koi Khel Nahin (1999), Soldier (1998), and Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge (1995).

Agnihotri made his television debut in the 2003 show Jassi Jaissi Koi Nahin, in which he played the lead role of Armaan Suri. The show was a huge success and made Agnihotri a household name. He has since appeared in several other television shows, including Nach Baliye (2005), Bigg Boss 7 (2013), and Kasautii Zindagii Kay (2018).

item.title: Arhaan Behll
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Arhaan Behll

Television Male Actor

Arhaan Behll is an Indian television actor. He is best known for his role as Krishna Singh Thakur in the Star Plus television series Mann Kee Awaaz Pratigya (2009–2012). He has also appeared in the television series Do Dil Bandhe Ek Dori Se (2013–2014), Vish Ya Amrit: Sitara (2015–2016), and Yehh Jadu Hai Jinn Ka! (2019–2020).

 

Behll was born in Ajmer, Rajasthan, India. He studied at the National School of Drama in Delhi. He made his television debut in the 2009 television series Mann Kee Awaaz Pratigya. He played the role of Krishna Singh Thakur, a young man who is married to a strong-willed woman named Pratigya (played by Pooja Gor). The series was a critical and commercial success, and Behll's performance was praised by critics. He won several awards for his performance, including the ITA Award for Best Actor in a Lead Role and the STAR Parivaar Award for Favourite Actor.

 

In 2013, Behll starred in the television series Do Dil Bandhe Ek Dori Se. He played the role of Raghu Seharia, a young man who is torn between two women. The series was a moderate success. In 2015, Behll starred in the television series Vish Ya Amrit: Sitara. He played the role of Viraj Singh, a young man who is cursed with the power to turn into a vampire. The series was a commercial success. In 2019, Behll starred in the television series Yehh Jadu Hai Jinn Ka!. He played the role of Aman, a young man who is possessed by a jinn. The series was a commercial success.

Arjit Taneja

Television Male Actor

Arjit Taneja is an Indian television actor and model. He made his television debut in the reality shows MTV Splitsvilla 6 and Box Cricket League and TV fiction dramas Kumkum Bhagya, Kaleerein, Bahu Begum, Naagin 5 & Naagin 6, Nath – Zewar Ya Zanjeer and Banni Chow Home Delivery.

 

Taneja was born on 10 November 1992 in Delhi, India. He attended Modern School, Delhi and graduated with a BA degree in Computer Programming from the University of Delhi. In November 2010, he joined the modelling agency Elite Model Management India Pvt. Ltd. Two years later in mid-2012, Taneja moved from Delhi to Mumbai and began his acting career on television that year as the friend of Karan Kundra's character in Channel V India's V The Serial, produced by Ekta Kapoor.

 

Taneja's breakthrough role came in 2014 when he was cast as Purab Kohli in the Star Plus soap opera Kumkum Bhagya. He played the role for three years and became one of the most popular actors on Indian television. In 2017, he starred in the Colors TV show Kaleerein as Arjun Mittal. He then went on to play the lead role in the Zee TV show Bahu Begum as Azaan Ahmed Khan. In 2019, he starred in the Colors TV show Naagin 5 as Rocky Pratap Singh. In 2020, he starred in the Colors TV show Naagin 6 as Veer Pratap Singh. In 2022, he starred in the StarPlus show Banni Chow Home Delivery as Yuvraj Singh Bedi.

item.title: Arjun (Firoz Khan)
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Arjun Firoz Khan

Television Male Actor

Arjun Firoz Khan is an Indian actor, best known for playing the character of warrior prince Arjuna in B. R. Chopra's epic television series Mahabharat. He has also acted in negative roles in several Hindi language movies and television series.

 

Khan was born in Mumbai, India, into a Muslim family. He studied at the Shrimati Mithibai Motiram Kundnani College of Commerce & Economics in Mumbai, and then went on to study at Oxford University in England. After completing his studies, he returned to India and began his acting career.

 

Khan's first major role was in the television series Mahabharat, in which he played the character of Arjuna. The series was a huge success, and Khan's performance was critically acclaimed. He went on to act in several other television series, including Vishnu Puran and Kabhie Khushi Kabhie Gham.

 

Khan has also appeared in several Hindi language movies, including Qayamat Se Qayamat Tak, Jigar, Tiranga, Aa Gale Lag Jaa, Karan Arjun, and Jodi No. 1. He has also played negative roles in movies such as Khatron Ke Khiladi, Mehndi, and Yamla Pagla Deewana 2.

 

Khan is a versatile actor who is known for his ability to portray a wide range of characters. He is also a popular figure in the Indian entertainment industry. He has won several awards for his work, including the Indian Telly Award for Best Actor in a Leading Role, ITA Award for Best Actor in a Leading Role, and Indian Telly Jury Award for Best Actor in a Leading Role.

item.title: Arjun Bijlani
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Arjun Bijlani

Television Male Actor

Arjun Bijlani is an Indian actor known for his work in the Hindi television industry. He has established himself as a prominent figure in the industry with his versatile acting skills and charming persona. Born on October 31, 1982, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, Arjun started his career as a model before transitioning into acting.

Arjun Bijlani gained recognition and popularity for his role as Mayank Sharma in the youth-oriented drama series "Miley Jab Hum Tum" (2008-2010). His portrayal of the intelligent and witty college student won him a loyal fan following. He further solidified his position in the television industry with his role as Aalekh Sharma in the popular show "Left Right Left" (2006-2008).

Over the years, Arjun has showcased his versatility by taking on diverse roles in various television shows. He has been part of successful projects such as "Naagin" (2015-2016), "Pardes Mein Hai Mera Dil" (2016-2017), and "Ishq Mein Marjawan" (2017-2019). His performances have been widely appreciated by the audience and critics alike.

Apart from television, Arjun Bijlani has also participated in reality shows such as "Jhalak Dikhhla Jaa" and "Khatron Ke Khiladi," showcasing his dancing and adventurous skills. He has been a host for several television events and award shows, adding to his versatility in the industry.

item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Arpit Ranka

Television Male Actor

Arpit Ranka is an Indian actor known for his work in the Hindi film and television industry. He gained recognition for his notable performances in both movies and TV shows, showcasing his talent and versatility as an actor.

 

Arpit Ranka was born and raised in Bhilwara, Rajasthan, India. He developed a passion for acting from a young age and decided to pursue it as a career. He made his debut in the entertainment industry with the popular mythological television series "Mahabharat," where he portrayed the iconic character of Duryodhana. His portrayal of the complex and powerful character received critical acclaim and established him as a promising actor in the industry.

 

Following the success of "Mahabharat," Arpit Ranka ventured into the world of movies. He appeared in several films across different languages, including Hindi, Tamil, and Telugu. His notable film credits include "Gabbar Is Back," "Sardaar Gabbar Singh," and "Rudhramadevi." Arpit's performances in these films were appreciated by the audience and critics alike, further cementing his position in the industry.

 

Apart from his acting skills, Arpit Ranka is also known for his towering height and impressive physique, which has made him a sought-after choice for roles that require a commanding presence. He continues to explore different genres and mediums, showcasing his versatility as an actor.

Ashish Sharma

Television Male Actor

Ashish Sharma is an Indian actor known for his versatile performances in both television and film. He was born on August 30, 1984, in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India. With his charismatic personality and acting skills, Ashish has gained a significant fan following over the years.

 

Ashish Sharma started his acting career in 2010 with the television show "Gunahon Ka Devta," where he played the lead role of Avdesh Singh Thakur. His portrayal of the complex character garnered critical acclaim and established him as a talented actor in the industry. He further showcased his acting prowess in shows like "Chandragupta Maurya" and "Rangrasiya," where he portrayed historical characters with conviction and depth.

 

Apart from television, Ashish Sharma has also made notable appearances in films. He made his Bollywood debut in 2013 with the film "Zila Ghaziabad," where he shared the screen with renowned actors like Sanjay Dutt and Vivek Oberoi. He has also worked in regional cinema, including the Rajasthani film "Khejdi."

 

What sets Ashish Sharma apart is his ability to immerse himself completely into his characters, bringing them to life with his intense performances. His dedication and commitment to his craft have earned him numerous accolades and awards throughout his career.

item.title: Avinash Sachdev
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Avinash Sachdev

Television Male Actor

Avinash Sachdev is an Indian television actor known for his notable performances in Hindi serials. Born on August 22, 1986, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, Avinash Sachdev has made a name for himself in the industry with his versatile acting skills and charming screen presence.

 

Sachdev started his acting career in 2004 with the show "Karam Apnaa Apnaa" where he played a supporting role. However, it was his portrayal of Dev in the popular serial "Choti Bahu - Sindoor Bin Suhagan" that brought him widespread recognition and fame. His chemistry with co-star Rubina Dilaik was highly appreciated by the audience, and they became one of the most loved on-screen couples.

 

Following the success of "Choti Bahu," Avinash Sachdev appeared in several other television shows, including "Main Teri Parchhain Hoon," "Pavitra Rishta," and "Iss Pyaar Ko Kya Naam Doon?...Ek Baar Phir." He showcased his versatility by portraying different characters with conviction and received accolades for his performances.

 

Avinash Sachdev's talent and dedication to his craft have earned him numerous awards and nominations. His ability to connect with the audience through his characters and deliver impactful performances has made him a favorite among viewers.

 

Apart from his acting skills, Avinash Sachdev is also known for his good looks and charming personality. His fans appreciate his down-to-earth nature and engaging social media presence.

item.title: Barun Sobti
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Barun Sobti

Television Male Actor

Barun Sobti is an Indian actor who has made a name for himself in both television and film industries. He is best known for his portrayal of Arnav Singh Raizada in the popular television series "Iss Pyaar Ko Kya Naam Doon?" which catapulted him to immense fame and garnered him a massive fan following.

 

Born on August 21, 1984, in Delhi, India, Barun Sobti initially pursued a career in the corporate sector after completing his education in Delhi. However, his passion for acting led him to participate in several modeling and acting assignments, eventually landing him his breakthrough role in "Iss Pyaar Ko Kya Naam Doon?" in 2011.

 

Barun's portrayal of the complex character Arnav Singh Raizada, a suave and brooding business tycoon, struck a chord with the audience and established him as a talented actor. His chemistry with co-star Sanaya Irani, who played the female lead, was highly praised and became the talk of the town. The show became immensely popular and earned him numerous awards and accolades.

 

Following his success on television, Barun Sobti ventured into the world of films. He made his Bollywood debut with the romantic comedy film "Main Aur Mr. Riight" in 2014, where he showcased his versatility as an actor. He went on to star in other notable films such as "Tu Hai Mera Sunday" and "22 Yards," where he received critical acclaim for his performances.

item.title: Bhavya Gandhi
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Bhavya Gandhi

Television Male Actor

Bhavya Gandhi is an Indian actor known for his portrayal of Tapu in the popular Hindi television sitcom "Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah." Born on June 20, 1997, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, Bhavya began his acting career at a very young age and gained immense popularity for his role in the long-running TV series.

 

Bhavya Gandhi started his acting journey as a child artist and made his debut with the Gujarati film "Saptapadii" in 2013. However, it was his role as Tapu in "Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah" that brought him widespread recognition and made him a household name. His portrayal of the mischievous yet lovable Tapu won the hearts of audiences across all age groups. He played the character for almost nine years before bidding farewell to the show in 2017.

 

Apart from his television career, Bhavya has also appeared in a few other projects. He starred in the Gujarati film "Pappa Tamne Nahi Samjaay" in 2017 and made his Bollywood debut with the film "Tujhse Hai Raabta" in 2018. While he continues to explore opportunities in the entertainment industry, he remains most closely associated with his iconic role in "Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah."

item.title: Dayanand Shetty
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Dilip Joshi

Television Male Actor

Dilip Joshi is a renowned Indian television and film actor who has left an indelible mark on the entertainment industry with his exceptional acting skills. Born on May 26, 1968, in Gujarat, India, Dilip Joshi has carved a niche for himself through his versatile performances.

Joshi gained immense popularity and widespread recognition for his portrayal of the character Jethalal Champaklal Gada in the long-running sitcom "Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah." His portrayal of the lovable, bumbling yet endearing Jethalal has won the hearts of millions of viewers. His comic timing, impeccable expressions, and unique dialogue delivery have made him one of the most beloved characters on Indian television.

Before "Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah," Dilip Joshi appeared in various television shows, including "Shubh Mangal Savadhan" and "Kya Baat Hai." He also showcased his talent in the film industry, with notable performances in movies like "Phir Bhi Dil Hai Hindustani" and "Hum Aapke Hain Koun..!"

Dilip Joshi's acting skills have earned him several accolades and awards, including the prestigious Indian Telly Award for Best Actor in a Comic Role multiple times. He is highly respected for his ability to bring characters to life and effortlessly entertain the audience.

item.title: Deepak Wadhwa
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Deepak Wadhwa

Television Male Actor

Deepak Wadhwa is an Indian actor known for his versatile performances in Hindi television shows. He has portrayed numerous roles in various series, showcasing his acting prowess. Here is a summary of his notable appearances:

 

In "Dhoondh Legi Manzil Humein," Deepak Wadhwa displayed his acting skills, captivating the audience with his performance. He also made a notable impression in "Kaali- Ek Punar Avtaar" and "Ishq Kills," exhibiting his versatility as an actor.

Wadhwa gained recognition for his role as Rahaat in the popular Zee TV show "Qubool Hai." His portrayal was appreciated by the viewers. He also portrayed the lead character of Sanjay in the Star Plus sports-drama series "Meri Tamanna," leaving a lasting impact with his performance.

 

Deepak Wadhwa appeared in the television series "Tamanna," showcasing his acting range in diverse roles. He also made a cameo appearance in the film "Calendar Girls," adding to his repertoire of work.

 

Additionally, Wadhwa was seen in the TV show "Code Red" and "Haasil," further expanding his acting portfolio. As of July 2017, his most recent role was in the popular Hindi series "Yeh Hai Mohabbatein," highlighting his consistent presence in the industry.

item.title: Dev Joshi
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Dev Joshi

Television Male Actor

Dev Joshi is an Indian actor who has gained recognition for his work in the Hindi television industry. He rose to prominence for his portrayal of the superhero character Balveer in the popular fantasy series "Baal Veer" that aired on SAB TV. Born on November 28, 2000, Dev Joshi hails from a Gujarati family and has showcased immense talent and dedication from a young age.

 

Dev Joshi started his acting career at the tender age of 11 when he was cast as the lead protagonist in "Baal Veer." His portrayal of a young boy with extraordinary powers who fights against evil forces captivated the audience and made him a household name. Dev's portrayal of Balveer was loved by viewers of all age groups, especially children, who were inspired by his bravery and heroic acts.

 

Apart from his acting skills, Dev Joshi is also known for his hard work and discipline. He dedicated long hours to shooting and performed most of his stunts himself, displaying his commitment to his craft. His charming personality and friendly demeanor have made him a favorite among his co-stars and fans alike.

 

Dev Joshi's portrayal of Balveer earned him numerous awards and accolades, including the Indian Telly Awards for Best Child Actor. He became a role model for many young aspiring actors and garnered a huge fan following across the country.

item.title: Deven Bhojani
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Deven Bhojani

Television Male Actor

Deven Bhojani is an accomplished Indian actor and director who has made a significant impact in the entertainment industry. Born on November 25, 1969, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, Bhojani has showcased his versatile talent across various mediums, including television, theatre, and films. Bhojani initially gained recognition through his role as Gattu in the immensely popular Indian sitcom "Malgudi Days" (1986). However, he rose to widespread fame with his portrayal of the lovable and goofy character Gattu in the television series "Dekh Bhai Dekh" (1993-1994), which became a cult classic. Not limited to acting, Bhojani has also made a name for himself as a skilled director. He has directed several successful television shows, including "Sarabhai vs Sarabhai" (2004-2006), "Khichdi" (2002-2005), and "Baa Bahoo Aur Baby" (2005-2010). His directorial work is known for its sharp wit, relatable characters, and comedic timing. Apart from his television ventures, Deven Bhojani has also made notable appearances in Bollywood films such as "Sarfarosh" (1999) and "Bhool Bhulaiyaa" (2007). His performances have always been marked by his impeccable comic timing and ability to effortlessly switch between various genres.

item.title: Dheeraj Dhoopar
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Dheeraj Dhoopar

Television Male Actor

Dheeraj Dhoopar is an Indian television actor who has made a significant mark in the Hindi television industry. He gained widespread recognition and popularity for his roles in various TV shows, showcasing his versatility as an actor. Born on December 20, 1984, in Delhi, Dheeraj initially had aspirations of becoming a fashion designer. However, fate had different plans for him, and he found himself drawn towards acting. He made his television debut with the show "Maat Pitaah Ke Charnon Mein Swarg" in 2009. However, it was his role as Prem Bhardwaj in the long-running soap opera "Sasural Simar Ka" that shot him to fame. Dheeraj's portrayal of Prem garnered immense appreciation from the audience, and he became a household name. His charming looks, impeccable acting skills, and on-screen chemistry with his co-stars contributed to his popularity. Dheeraj has also participated in reality shows like "Nach Baliye 5" and "India's Best Dramebaaz," further showcasing his talent and versatility. In 2019, Dheeraj took on the lead role of Karan Luthra in the popular TV show "Kundali Bhagya," a spin-off of "Kumkum Bhagya." His portrayal of Karan Luthra, a suave and dynamic character, earned him critical acclaim and a massive fan following. Dheeraj's chemistry with his co-star Shraddha Arya was highly appreciated by the audience. Apart from his acting prowess, Dheeraj Dhoopar is also known for his style and fashion sense. He has been recognized with several awards for his outstanding performances, including the prestigious Gold Awards and Indian Telly Awards.

item.title: Eijaz Khan
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Eijaz Khan

Television Male Actor

Eijaz Khan is an Indian actor who has primarily worked in the Hindi television and film industry. He was born on August 28, 1975, in Hyderabad, Telangana, India. Eijaz Khan gained popularity through his roles in various television shows. He made his acting debut in the late 1990s with the TV show "Thoda Hai Bas Thode Ki Zaroorat Hai." However, he gained widespread recognition for his portrayal of the character Ravi in the popular daily soap opera "Kkavyanjali," which aired from 2005 to 2006. Over the years, Eijaz Khan appeared in several other successful television shows, including "Kkusum," "Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi," and "Kahaani Ghar Ghar Kii." He has also participated in reality shows like "Bigg Boss" and "Jhalak Dikhhla Jaa." In addition to television, Eijaz Khan has acted in a few Bollywood films. He made his film debut in 2003 with the movie "Thakshak" and has appeared in films like "Tanu Weds Manu," "Zilla Ghaziabad," and "Lucky Kabootar."

item.title: Fahmaan Khan
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Fahmaan Khan

Television Male Actor

Fahmaan Khan is an Indian actor and model known for his work in Hindi television. He gained recognition for his roles in popular TV shows like "Apna Time Bhi Aayega," "Imlie," and "Pyar Ke Saat Vachan Dharampatnii." Fahmaan began his career as a model, working with various brands before transitioning to acting. Prior to his television debut, he spent over nine years acting in theatre plays. He made his screen debut in the short film "Ver Joints" in 2014. In 2015, he had a cameo role in the TV serial "Yeh Vaada Raha," followed by another cameo in "Kundali Bhagya" in 2017. From 2017 to 2020, Fahmaan appeared in recurring roles in shows like "Kya Qusoor Hai Amala Ka," "Ishq Mein Marjawan," and "Mere Dad Ki Dulhan." However, his breakthrough came with lead roles in TV series such as "Apna Time Bhi Aayega," "Imlie," and "Pyar Ke Saat Vachan Dharampatnii," where he garnered attention and appreciation for his performances. In 2022, Fahmaan made his directorial debut with the music video "Ishq Ho Gaya," sung by Tabish Pasha. He starred in the music video alongside Sumbul Touqeer Khan.

item.title: Gaurav Chopra
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Gaurav Chopra

Television Male Actor

Gaurav Chopra is an Indian television actor known for his impactful performances in various TV shows. Born on April 4, 1979, in New Delhi, Gaurav started his career in the entertainment industry with modeling and commercial advertisements. He then made his television debut with the show "Ruby Duby Hub Dub" in 2004. Gaurav gained significant recognition and popularity for his role as Raghuvendra Pratap Rathore in the hit TV series "Uttaran." His portrayal of a complex and layered character earned him critical acclaim and a loyal fan base. Gaurav's ability to bring depth and nuance to his roles has made him a sought-after actor in the industry. Known for his versatility, Gaurav has showcased his acting skills in various genres, ranging from drama to comedy. He has appeared in shows like "Left Right Left," "C.I.D," and "Doli Armaano Ki," among others. Gaurav's performances have been lauded for their intensity, emotional depth, and convincing portrayals. In addition to his television work, Gaurav has also participated in reality shows such as "Bigg Boss 10" and "Nach Baliye 2," where he showcased his personality and versatility outside of scripted roles.

item.title: Gaurav Khanna
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Gaurav Khanna

Television Male Actor

Gaurav Khanna is an accomplished Indian television actor known for his versatile performances and charming on-screen presence. Born on December 11, 1981, in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, Gaurav began his acting career in 2004 and has since established himself as a prominent figure in the Hindi television industry. Gaurav made his debut with the popular television series "Kumkum - Ek Pyara Sa Bandhan" where he portrayed the character of Sharman Wadhwa. His portrayal of the lovable and caring Sharman garnered him recognition and appreciation from the audience. He then went on to showcase his acting prowess in various television shows, displaying his ability to portray a range of characters. One of Gaurav's notable roles came in the show "Yeh Pyar Na Hoga Kam" where he played the lead character of Abeer Bajpai. His portrayal of Abeer, a young man fighting against societal norms and prejudices, earned him critical acclaim and a loyal fan following. Gaurav has also been a part of other successful shows such as "Kis Desh Mein Hai Meraa Dil," "Byaah Hamari Bahoo Ka," and "Tere Bin," among others. His ability to bring depth and emotion to his characters has made him a favorite among viewers. Apart from his television work, Gaurav Khanna has also made appearances in web series and has dabbled in the theater. His dedication to his craft and his ability to connect with the audience through his performances have earned him numerous awards and nominations throughout his career.

item.title: Gautam Gulati
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Gautam Gulati

Television Male Actor

Gautam Gulati is an Indian actor and model who has made a name for himself in the entertainment industry. Born on November 27, 1987, in Delhi, Gautam started his career as a model and gained recognition for his charming looks and confident personality. He initially gained popularity by winning the reality TV show "MTV Roadies 8" in 2011, where he showcased his determination and competitive spirit.

However, it was his stint in the reality show "Bigg Boss 8" in 2014 that skyrocketed his fame. Gautam Gulati emerged as the winner of the season, captivating the audience with his wit, charisma, and entertaining personality. His journey in the Bigg Boss house earned him a massive fan following and established him as a household name.

Following his success in reality TV, Gautam ventured into acting and made his Bollywood debut with the film "Azhar" in 2016, where he portrayed the role of Ravi Shastri. He also appeared in other films like "Behen Hogi Teri" and "Udanchhoo." Gautam has also made notable appearances in web series such as "Operation Cobra" and "Virgin Bhasskar."

Besides acting, Gautam Gulati has been a part of various TV shows and has showcased his hosting skills in events and award functions. He has a strong social media presence and keeps his fans engaged with his updates and interactions.

item.title: Gurmeet Chaudhary
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Gurmeet Chaudhary

Bollywood Male Actor

Gurmeet Chaudhary is an Indian actor, model, and dancer who has made a significant impact in the entertainment industry. Born on February 22, 1984, in Chandigarh, India, Gurmeet initially rose to fame as a contestant on the reality television show "Mr. and Miss Bollywood," where he showcased his acting skills and charming personality. Gurmeet gained widespread recognition for his portrayal of Lord Rama in the mythological television series "Ramayan" (2008-2009). His convincing performance and dedication to the role garnered him immense praise from the audience and established him as a talented actor. The show's success further catapulted his career, opening doors to more opportunities. In 2010, Gurmeet starred in the romantic drama series "Geet - Hui Sabse Parayi," where he played the lead role of Maan Singh Khurana. His portrayal of the intense and passionate character won him a massive fan following and critical acclaim. Gurmeet's on-screen chemistry with his co-star Drashti Dhami was highly appreciated by the viewers. Furthermore, Gurmeet's exceptional dancing skills were showcased in various dance reality shows such as "Jhalak Dikhhla Jaa" and "Nach Baliye," where he mesmerized the audience with his flawless performances. He also ventured into Bollywood with films like "Khamoshiyan" and "Paltan," further expanding his acting repertoire. Gurmeet Chaudhary is known for his dedication, versatility, and commitment to his craft. He has received several accolades for his performances, including multiple awards at prestigious ceremonies like the Gold Awards and Indian Television Academy Awards.

item.title: Harsh Rajput
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Harsh Rajput

Bollywood Male Actor

Harsh Rajput is an Indian actor known for his work in the Hindi television and film industry. He has carved a niche for himself with his notable performances and versatility as an actor. Born on 5th January 1988 in Navsari, Gujarat, Harsh Rajput began his acting career in 2012 with the popular television show "Dharti Ka Veer Yodha Prithviraj Chauhan" where he played the role of Bharat. This role marked his entry into the television industry and showcased his acting potential. He gained recognition for his portrayal of Bharat and left a lasting impression on the audience. Harsh Rajput further gained prominence with his lead role as Ansh Rathod in the supernatural drama series "Nazar." His portrayal of a half-human, half-demon character received appreciation for its intensity and depth. Harsh's performance in "Nazar" showcased his ability to effectively portray complex and challenging roles. In addition to television, Harsh Rajput has also ventured into the film industry. He made his Bollywood debut with the horror film "Krishna Cottage" in 2004, where he played a pivotal role. He has also appeared in other films like "Ranjish" and "The Forest."

item.title: Harshad Arora
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Harshad Arora

Bollywood Male Actor

Harshad Arora is an Indian actor who has made a notable impact in the Hindi television industry with his impressive performances. Known for his charming personality and versatile acting skills, Harshad has gained a dedicated fan following. Born on September 3, 1987, in Delhi, Harshad initially pursued a career in engineering but later found his true passion in acting. He made his television debut with the show "Beintehaa" in 2013, where he portrayed the role of Zain Abdullah. His portrayal of the complex and intense character garnered him immense praise and established him as a promising actor. Harshad's next significant role came in the fantasy drama series "Dehleez," where he played the role of Adarsh Sinha. His portrayal of a righteous and honest officer in the show earned him critical acclaim and further showcased his acting prowess. He was lauded for his ability to bring depth and conviction to his characters. In addition to his television work, Harshad has also participated in reality shows like "Khatron Ke Khiladi" and "Fear Factor: Khatron Ke Khiladi Torchaar." His adventurous spirit and determination on these shows won him admiration from the audience. Harshad's good looks and on-screen charm have also made him a popular choice for brand endorsements and magazine covers. He has been recognized with several awards for his outstanding performances, including the Indian Television Academy Award for Best Actor.

item.title: Harshad Chopda
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Harshad Chopda

Bollywood Male Actor

Harshad Chopda is a renowned Indian television actor who has made a significant impact with his talent and versatility. Born on May 17, 1983, in Gondia, Maharashtra, Harshad began his acting journey with modeling and commercials before making his way into the world of television. Harshad gained popularity and critical acclaim for his portrayal of Cadet Ali Baig in the television series "Left Right Left" in 2006. His performance as the disciplined and righteous cadet won the hearts of the audience and established him as a promising actor in the industry. He further showcased his acting prowess with his role as Prem Juneja in the serial "Kis Desh Mein Hai Meraa Dil," solidifying his position as a talented actor. In 2010, Harshad garnered immense appreciation and a massive fan following with his portrayal of Anurag Ganguly in the romantic drama "Tere Liye." His chemistry with co-star Anupriya Kapoor was widely loved by the audience. Harshad's ability to bring depth and emotion to his characters made him stand out among his peers. After a brief hiatus, Harshad returned to television screens with the immensely popular show "Bepannaah" in 2018, where he played the role of Aditya Hooda. Once again, his performance was lauded for its intensity and emotional depth. Harshad's portrayal of a complex and layered character showcased his growth as an actor and earned him a dedicated fan base.

item.title: Hiten Tejwani
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Hiten Tejwani

Television Male Actor

Hiten Tejwani is an Indian television and film actor known for his notable contributions to the Hindi entertainment industry. Born on March 5, 1974, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, Hiten started his acting career in the late 1990s and has since garnered immense popularity and acclaim. Hiten rose to prominence with his portrayal of the character Karan Virani in the iconic TV show "Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi." His role as the eldest son of the Virani family earned him widespread recognition and established him as a talented actor in the industry. Hiten's impeccable acting skills and charming personality made him a favorite among viewers. Throughout his career, Hiten has been a part of several successful television shows, including "Kabhii Sautan Kabhii Sahelii," "Kasautii Zindagii Kay," and "Pavitra Rishta." He has also participated in reality shows such as "Bigg Boss" and "Nach Baliye," where he showcased his versatility and entertained the audience with his performances. In addition to television, Hiten has also appeared in a few films, including "Krishna Cottage" and "Love Games." While his focus primarily remains on television, Hiten's film appearances have been appreciated by audiences. Known for his down-to-earth nature and professionalism, Hiten Tejwani is highly regarded by his co-stars and colleagues in the industry. He has received several awards for his outstanding performances, including the Indian Telly Awards and the Zee Gold Awards.

item.title: Hussain Kuwajerwala
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Hussain Kuwajerwala

Bollywood Male Actor

Hussain Kuwajerwala is a well-known Indian actor, television host, and dancer. Born on October 12, 1977, in Mumbai, he has made a significant contribution to the Indian entertainment industry with his versatile talent and charismatic presence. Hussain started his career in the early 2000s as a model and gained recognition with his appearance in various commercials. He made his television debut with the popular sitcom "Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi" in 2001, where he portrayed the character of Sumit Wadhwa. His impeccable comic timing and natural acting skills made him a favorite among viewers. He went on to appear in several other successful TV shows such as "Kumkum," "Kvyaanjali," and "Rishtey." Apart from acting, Hussain is also known for his exceptional dancing skills. He showcased his talent and won the hearts of the audience when he participated in the dance reality show "Nach Baliye 2" alongside his wife, Tina Kuwajerwala. Their chemistry and performances on the show were highly appreciated, and they emerged as the winners. Hussain's charming personality and effortless hosting skills have made him a sought-after television host. He has hosted various reality shows and events, including "Indian Idol," "Indian Idol Junior," and "Dance Premier League." His ability to connect with the audience and his friendly demeanor have made him a popular choice for hosting gigs.

item.title: Indraneil Sengupta
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Indraneil Sengupta

Bollywood Male Actor

Indraneil Sengupta is a talented Indian actor known for his work in Hindi and Bengali cinema, as well as television. Born on September 8, 1974, in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, he has made a significant impact in the entertainment industry with his remarkable performances. Indraneil began his acting journey in the Bengali film industry, where he garnered critical acclaim for his roles in movies like "Shakti," "Autograph," and "Angshumaner Chhobi." His ability to portray diverse characters with depth and conviction showcased his versatility as an actor. In addition to his success in Bengali cinema, Indraneil has also made a mark in Hindi television. He gained popularity through his roles in TV shows such as "Banoo Main Teri Dulhann," "Maayka," and "Tumhari Paakhi." His portrayal of complex characters with nuanced performances earned him recognition and a loyal fan base. Indraneil's tall and charismatic persona, along with his acting skills, has also led him to venture into the world of modeling. He has been part of several ad campaigns and has walked the ramp for renowned fashion designers. Beyond his on-screen achievements, Indraneil Sengupta is also known for his philanthropic work. He actively supports various charitable causes and has been involved in initiatives focused on education and child welfare.

item.title: Jay Bhanushali
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Jay Bhanushali

Bollywood Male Actor

Jay Bhanushali is a popular Indian television actor and host known for his charismatic personality and versatile performances. Born on December 25, 1984, in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, Jay started his career as a model and later ventured into the world of television. Jay rose to prominence with his portrayal of Neev Shergill in the hit soap opera "Kayamath." His portrayal of a passionate lover and his on-screen chemistry with co-star Panchi Bora garnered him immense popularity and a dedicated fan base. He then went on to showcase his acting skills in various shows like "Kis Desh Mein Hai Meraa Dil," "Dhoom Machaao Dhoom," and "Kairee: Rishta Khatta Meetha." In addition to his acting career, Jay Bhanushali has also made a mark as a television host. He has hosted popular reality shows like "Dance India Dance," "Jhalak Dikhhla Jaa," and "Indian Idol Junior." Jay's dynamic hosting style and his ability to connect with the audience have made him a sought-after host in the industry. Jay has also dabbled in Bollywood, appearing in films like "Hate Story 2" and "Desi Kattey." His performances in these films showcased his versatility as an actor and further expanded his fan base.

item.title: Jay Soni
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Jay Soni

Bollywood Male Actor

Jay Soni is an Indian television actor who has made a notable mark in the Hindi television industry with his versatile performances. Born on 25 December 1986 in Gujarat, India, Jay Soni began his acting career at a young age and quickly gained recognition for his talent and charming on-screen presence. Jay Soni rose to fame with his role as Ishaan in the popular TV series "Sasural Genda Phool." His portrayal of the lovable and innocent Ishaan won the hearts of the audience and established him as a talented actor. The show's success earned him immense popularity and critical acclaim. Known for his ability to effortlessly portray both comic and dramatic roles, Jay Soni showcased his versatility in various other television shows. He played the lead role of Bhaskar in "Sanskaar - Dharohar Apno Ki" and the character of Anuj in "Bhaag Bakool Bhaag." His performances in these shows further solidified his position in the industry. Jay Soni's impeccable comic timing and natural acting skills have also been appreciated in reality shows like "Nach Baliye" and "Comedy Nights with Kapil," where he showcased his humorous side. Apart from television, Jay Soni has also ventured into films, making his Bollywood debut with the movie "Budhia Singh – Born to Run." He displayed his acting prowess in the film, receiving positive reviews for his performance.

item.title: Kanwar Dhillon
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Kanwar Dhillon

Bollywood Male Actor

Kanwar Dhillon is a talented Indian actor known for his work in Hindi television. Born on 15 March 1993, he hails from a family with a strong background in the entertainment industry. His father, Deep Dhillon, is a renowned Punjabi actor, and his mother, Rani Dhillon, is a television producer. Kanwar Dhillon made his acting debut with the popular TV show "Na Bole Tum Na Maine Kuch Kaha" in 2012. His portrayal of the character Aditya "Addu" Singh won him praise for his acting skills and screen presence. Over the years, Kanwar Dhillon has appeared in several television series, each time proving his acting prowess. item.title: Karan Jotwani
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Karan Jotwani

Bollywood Male Actor

Karan Jotwani is an Indian actor who has made a name for himself in the Hindi television industry. With his charming persona and acting skills, he has won the hearts of the audience and established himself as a talented performer. Born and raised in Mumbai, Karan Jotwani pursued his passion for acting from a young age. He made his television debut with the show "Bade Achhe Lagte Hain" in 2014, where he played the role of Arav Kapoor. Although it was a supporting role, his performance was well-received and caught the attention of viewers. Karan gained significant recognition and popularity for his portrayal of Sahil Agarwal in the TV series "Aap Ke Aa Jane Se." His character showcased a range of emotions and complexities, and Karan's ability to portray them with conviction impressed both critics and the audience. He displayed his versatility as an actor by successfully capturing the nuances of the character. Apart from television, Karan Jotwani has also ventured into web series. He appeared in the popular web series "It Happened in Calcutta," which received positive reviews for its engaging storyline and performances.
