item.title: Anurag Basu
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Anurag Basu

Director

Anurag Basu is a renowned Indian filmmaker, writer, and director known for his distinct storytelling style and unconventional approach to filmmaking. Born on May 8, 1974, in Bhilai, Chhattisgarh, Basu has made a significant impact on the Indian film industry with his imaginative narratives and visually stunning films. Basu began his career in the entertainment industry as a television serial director, working on popular shows such as "Tara" and "Koshish...Ek Aashaa." He gained recognition for his ability to create engaging narratives and compelling characters, setting the stage for his transition to feature films. In 2003, Basu made his directorial debut with the critically acclaimed film "Murder."

 

The erotic thriller, starring Emraan Hashmi and Mallika Sherawat, was a commercial success and established Basu as a filmmaker unafraid to experiment with bold themes and unconventional storytelling techniques. The film's success paved the way for a series of successful collaborations between Basu and actor Emraan Hashmi. One of Basu's most notable works is the film "Life in a... Metro" (2007), an anthology drama that weaves together multiple narratives set in the bustling city of Mumbai. The film received widespread acclaim for its realistic portrayal of urban life, complex characters, and soulful music. "Life in a... Metro" showcased Basu's ability to capture the essence of human relationships and emotions with a nuanced touch. In 2012, Basu directed the critically acclaimed film "Barfi!" which garnered both critical acclaim and commercial success.

 

 Starring Ranbir Kapoor, Priyanka Chopra, and Ileana D'Cruz, the film explored the unconventional love story between a deaf-mute man and an autistic woman. "Barfi!" showcased Basu's mastery in blending humor, emotion, and visual storytelling, earning him several awards and nominations, including the Best Director award at the Filmfare Awards. Basu's filmography also includes the musical drama "Jagga Jasoos" (2017), featuring Ranbir Kapoor as a young detective, and the anthology film "Ludo" (2020), which intertwines multiple stories of love, chance, and destiny. These films further solidified Basu's reputation as a filmmaker who pushes boundaries, experiments with narrative structures, and creates visually captivating experiences. Known for his attention to detail and innovative storytelling techniques, Basu often combines different genres and visual styles in his films.

 

He seamlessly blends elements of romance, drama, comedy, and crime, resulting in narratives that are both engaging and thought-provoking. His films are often accompanied by memorable soundtracks, highlighting his keen ear for music.

item.title: A. R. Murugadoss
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
A.R. Murugadoss

Director

A.R. Murugadoss is an Indian film director, producer, and screenwriter who predominantly works in the Tamil film industry. He is known for his action films mainly on social issues. In addition, he has worked in Telugu films and Hindi films. Murugadoss won the Filmfare Award for Best Director for his 2014 Tamil action drama Kaththi.

 

Murugadoss was born in Kallakurichi, Tamil Nadu, on September 25, 1974. He studied at the Government Higher Secondary School and Bishop Heber College in Tiruchirapalli. His first break in the film industry was as an assistant director of Ratchagan (1997).

Murugadoss made his directorial debut with the Tamil film Dheena (2001). The film was a critical and commercial success, and it established Murugadoss as a promising director. He followed up Dheena with a string of successful films, including Ghajini (2005), Aathi (2006), and Enthiran (2010).

 

Murugadoss' films are known for their strong social commentary. He often tackles issues such as corruption, terrorism, and social injustice in his films. His films have been praised for their realistic portrayal of social problems and for their ability to entertain and educate audiences at the same time.

item.title: Anurag Kashyap
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Anurag Kashyap

Director

Anurag Kashyap is a renowned Indian filmmaker, screenwriter, and producer who has made a significant impact on the Indian film industry. Born on September 10, 1972, in Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh, Kashyap is known for his bold and gritty storytelling, tackling unconventional subjects and pushing the boundaries of Indian cinema. Kashyap began his career as a screenwriter, working on films like "Satya" (1998) and "Kaun" (1999). His unique writing style, which delved into the dark and gritty aspects of society, garnered attention and set the stage for his transition to directing.

 

In 2003, Kashyap made his directorial debut with the film "Paanch," a crime thriller that faced censorship challenges due to its explicit content. Although the film was not released theatrically, it gained a cult following and established Kashyap as a director unafraid to explore taboo subjects and challenge societal norms. One of Kashyap's breakthrough films came in 2009 with "Dev.D," a modern-day adaptation of the classic novel "Devdas." The film reimagined the story with contemporary sensibilities, exploring themes of love, addiction, and self-destruction. "Dev.D" received critical acclaim for its unconventional narrative structure, edgy storytelling, and standout performances.

 

It solidified Kashyap's reputation as a filmmaker with a unique voice. Kashyap's filmography includes several notable works, including "Gangs of Wasseypur" (2012), an epic crime saga spanning multiple generations; "Ugly" (2013), a dark thriller exploring the ugliness within society and relationships; and "Raman Raghav 2.0" (2016), a psychological thriller inspired by a real-life serial killer. He has also been associated with anthology films like "Bombay Talkies" (2013) and "Lust Stories" (2018), collaborating with other acclaimed filmmakers to present multiple stories within a single film. Known for his realistic portrayal of characters and their struggles, Kashyap often explores the underbelly of society, highlighting social issues, and giving voice to marginalized narratives. His films often feature flawed and complex characters, grappling with personal demons and societal pressures. Kashyap's filmmaking style is marked by his distinctive visual aesthetics, gritty realism, and innovative storytelling techniques. He has been praised for his ability to capture the essence of the locations he depicts and to create an immersive cinematic experience for the audience. In addition to his directorial ventures, Kashyap has also produced films under his production company, Phantom Films.

item.title: Karan Johar
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Karan Johar

Producer

Karan Johar, born Rahul Kumar Johar on May 25, 1972, is a prominent Indian filmmaker and television personality in the Hindi film industry. He is widely known as KJo and is the son of renowned film producer Yash Johar. Karan Johar is the owner of Dharma Productions, a production company through which he has launched the careers of numerous successful actors.

 

Johar made his directorial debut with the romantic comedy-drama "Kuch Kuch Hota Hai" in 1998, which garnered him critical acclaim and several awards, including the National Film Award for Best Popular Film Providing Wholesome Entertainment, the Filmfare Award for Best Director, and the Filmfare Award for Best Screenplay. He followed it up with other successful films like "Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham..." (2001) and "Kabhi Alvida Naa Kehna" (2006), which were major hits both domestically and internationally.

 

In addition to directing, Johar has also produced several notable films under Dharma Productions. He produced the critically acclaimed spy thriller "Raazi" (2018) and the biographical war film "Shershaah" (2021), both of which won him the Filmfare Award for Best Film.

 

Apart from filmmaking, Karan Johar has explored various avenues in the entertainment industry. He is a popular host and has anchored the television talk show "Koffee with Karan," which has gained immense popularity over the years. He has also hosted a dating show called "What the Love!" and a radio show titled "Calling Karan." Johar has appeared as a judge on competition reality shows like "Jhalak Dikhhla Jaa" and "India's Got Talent."

Karan Johar, born Rahul Kumar Johar on May 25, 1972, is a prominent Indian filmmaker and television personality in the Hindi film industry. He is widely known as KJo and is the son of renowned film producer Yash Johar. Karan Johar is the owner of Dharma Productions, a production company through which he has launched the careers of numerous successful actors.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Johar made his directorial debut with the romantic comedy-drama \"Kuch Kuch Hota Hai\" in 1998, which garnered him critical acclaim and several awards, including the National Film Award for Best Popular Film Providing Wholesome Entertainment, the Filmfare Award for Best Director, and the Filmfare Award for Best Screenplay. He followed it up with other successful films like \"Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham...\" (2001) and \"Kabhi Alvida Naa Kehna\" (2006), which were major hits both domestically and internationally.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

In addition to directing, Johar has also produced several notable films under Dharma Productions. He produced the critically acclaimed spy thriller \"Raazi\" (2018) and the biographical war film \"Shershaah\" (2021), both of which won him the Filmfare Award for Best Film.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Apart from filmmaking, Karan Johar has explored various avenues in the entertainment industry. He is a popular host and has anchored the television talk show \"Koffee with Karan,\" which has gained immense popularity over the years. He has also hosted a dating show called \"What the Love!\" and a radio show titled \"Calling Karan.\" Johar has appeared as a judge on competition reality shows like \"Jhalak Dikhhla Jaa\" and \"India's Got Talent.\"<\/p>","typography_typography":"custom","typography_font_weight":"bold"},"elements":[],"widgetType":"text-editor"}],"isInner":false}],"isInner":false},{"id":"9dda3c6","elType":"section","settings":{"background_background":"classic","background_color":"#EAF0EE8F","hover_parallax":[{"layer_position_vr":{"unit":"%","size":30},"layer_position_hr":{"unit":"%","size":40},"_id":"ac4fb18"},{"layer_position_vr":{"unit":"%","size":60},"layer_position_hr":{"unit":"%","size":20},"_id":"a1b2b38"}]},"elements":[{"id":"57215b7","elType":"column","settings":{"_column_size":100,"_inline_size":null},"elements":[{"id":"a45feed","elType":"widget","settings":{"title":"Enquiry Form","header_size":"h3","align":"center","typography_typography":"custom","typography_font_size":{"unit":"px","size":40,"sizes":[]},"typography_font_weight":"bold","_margin":{"unit":"px","top":"40","right":"0","bottom":"20","left":"0","isLinked":false},"__globals__":{"title_color":"globals\/colors?id=6d3d44f9"}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"heading"},{"id":"27d45ba","elType":"widget","settings":{"shortcode":"[forminator_form id=\"5483\"]","_margin":{"unit":"px","top":"0","right":"0","bottom":"40","left":"0","isLinked":false}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"shortcode"}],"isInner":false}],"isInner":false}]

item.title: Ekta Kapoor
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Ekta Kapoor

Producer

Ekta Kapoor, born on June 7, 1975, is a prominent figure in the Indian entertainment industry. She is a television producer, film producer, and director, known for her work in Hindi cinema and soap operas. Kapoor holds the positions of joint managing director and creative head at Balaji Telefilms Limited, a production company she co-founded in 1994.

Under her leadership, Balaji Telefilms has produced numerous successful television shows, making Kapoor a prominent figure in the Indian television industry. In 2001, she expanded her ventures by launching Balaji Motion Pictures, a film production and distribution company. Additionally, in April 2017, Kapoor introduced ALT Balaji, a digital platform for original web series and shows.

Kapoor's contributions to the entertainment industry extend beyond production and direction. In 2017, she released her biography titled "Kingdom of the Soap Queen: The Story of Balaji Telefilms," offering insights into her journey and the growth of her production company.

Recognizing her significant contributions to the arts, Ekta Kapoor was honored with the Padma Shri, one of India's highest civilian awards, in 2020. This prestigious recognition further highlights her impact and influence in the field of entertainment.

item.title: Sajid Nadiadwala
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Sajid Nadiadwala

Producer

Sajid Nadiadwala, born on February 18, 1966, is an Indian film producer, writer, and director known for his work in Hindi cinema. He is the owner of Nadiadwala Grandson Entertainment, a production company that has been associated with several successful films.

 

Sajid Nadiadwala comes from a family with a rich film background. His grandfather, Abdul Karim Nadiadwala, was a well-known filmmaker who produced numerous films in Bombay, including the iconic film "Taj Mahal." Sajid's father was also involved in film production. Growing up in Malad, where the family owned theaters and had significant property, Sajid developed a deep passion for films from a young age.

 

After completing his Chartered Accountancy (CA) and law studies, Sajid joined filmmaker J.P. Dutta as an assistant director at the age of 21. He worked on the film "Ghulami" and gained valuable experience in the industry. Inspired by his family's legacy and his own creative aspirations, Sajid ventured into film production, writing, and directing.

 

As a producer, Sajid Nadiadwala has been associated with successful films like "Housefull" (2010) and "Baaghi" (2016). He has also ventured into directing and made his directorial debut with the film "Kick" (2014), which received accolades and awards for his debut as a director. Additionally, he has written films, including the Marathi film "Lai Bhaari," which was produced by Riteish Deshmukh.

item.title: Binod Pradhan
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Binod Pradhan

Cinematography

Binod Pradhan is an Indian cinematographer, director, and actor known for his notable work in the Indian film industry. He has worked on several popular and critically acclaimed films as a cinematographer. Some of his award-winning films include "1942 A Love Story," "Devdas," "Rang De Basanti," "Mission Kashmir," and "Munna Bhai M.B.B.S."

Binod Pradhan grew up in the picturesque hill town of Kalimpong, West Bengal. He developed a passion for photography from a young age, receiving his first box camera from his father, who ran a photo studio. He would experiment with capturing black-and-white pictures and coloring them using water-paints. His father recognized his talent, and Binod's photographs were displayed in the studio. By the age of 14, he was already handling operations at the studio.

However, he realized that the isolated life in Kalimpong was limiting his opportunities to pursue photography as a career. Binod learned about the Film and Television Institute of India (FTII) in Pune, and he applied with his portfolio, eventually being admitted into a three-year course in cinematography.

Binod's entry into the film industry came when film director Prem Sagar visited FTII to judge the students' work. Impressed by Binod's talent, Prem Sagar offered him a job as an assistant at Sagar Arts. Binod then worked as an assistant to Prem Sagar on films like "Charas" and "Ram Bharose." However, he felt the need to establish his own identity in the industry, leading him to explore other options.

Renowned cinematographer A. K. Bir, who was working on the film "Gharonda," offered Binod the position of assistant cameraman in charge of the zoom and focus department. This experience proved to be invaluable for his growth as a cinematographer.

Binod faced a period of limited work opportunities and frequently changing addresses. He took up sporadic assignments, including documentaries, ads, and corporate films, to further enhance his technical skills. During this time, he lived with a Kutchi family and met Dolly, with whom he fell in love.

Despite facing resistance from Dolly's parents, Binod eloped with her back to Kalimpong. They later had two sons named Binay and Deep Pradhan.

Binod's career took a positive turn when director Kundan Shah gathered his FTII friends to work on the film "Jaane Bhi Do Yaaro," which went on to become a cult classic.

item.title: Anil Mehta
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Anil Mehta

Cinematography

Anil Mehta is an Indian cinematographer, film director, and writer known for his work in Hindi cinema. He is recognized as one of the founding members of the Indian Society of Cinematographers (ISC). Mehta studied cinematography at the Film and Television Institute of India in Pune in 1986.

 

His career began with his collaboration with filmmaker Ketan Mehta on movies like "Holi" (1984) and "Mirch Masala" (1987) while he was still a student. He later worked as an assistant to Barun Mukherjee on television commercials.

 

Mehta made his debut as a cinematographer with the short Indo-German drama film called "The Cloud Door" (1984). His first full-length film was "Khamoshi: The Musical" (1996), which marked the directorial debut of Sanjay Leela Bhansali.

 

In 1999, Mehta received the National Film Award for Best Cinematography for his work in "Hum Dil De Chuke Sanam" (1999). He also worked on the critically acclaimed and commercially successful film "Lagaan" (2001), which was one of the most expensive Indian films at that time.

 

During the early 2000s and onwards, Mehta worked on several notable films such as "Kal Ho Naa Ho" (2003), "Veer-Zaara" (2004), "Kabhi Alvida Naa Kehna" (2006), and "Ae Dil Hai Mushkil" (2016).

 

In addition to his cinematography work, Mehta ventured into film direction with his first feature film, "Aaja Nachle" (2007), produced by Yash Raj Films. The film marked the comeback of actress Madhuri Dixit and also starred Konkona Sen Sharma, Akshaye Khanna, and Kunal Kapoor.

item.title: C.K. Muraleedharan
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
C.K. Muraleedharan

Cinematography

C.K. Muraleedharan is indeed an Indian cinematographer who is well-regarded in the film industry. He was born and raised in rural Kerala and has achieved significant success in his career. Muraleedharan completed his specialization in Cinematography from the Film and Television Institute of India, Pune in 1987.

 

While he has worked on various projects, including short films, commercials, and television, Muraleedharan gained prominence through his work in Hindi cinema, Telugu cinema, and Malayalam cinema. His debut in mainstream cinema was with the Bollywood film "Ek Chhotisi Love Story" in 2002.

 

Interestingly, Muraleedharan's daughter, Karthika Muralidharan, is also associated with the Malayalam film industry as an actress. It seems that the artistic talent runs in the family.

item.title: Namrata Soni
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Namrata Soni

Makeup Artist

Namrata Soni is a renowned makeup artist who has made a significant mark in the Indian beauty and fashion industry. With her exceptional talent and creativity, Namrata has become one of the most sought-after makeup artists in the country. She has worked with numerous celebrities, fashion designers, and magazines, showcasing her versatile skills and ability to create stunning makeup looks.

 

Known for her expertise in both bridal and editorial makeup, Namrata Soni has the ability to transform her clients with her artistry. She has a keen eye for detail and a deep understanding of different skin tones and textures, allowing her to create customized looks that enhance the natural beauty of each individual.

 

Namrata's signature style often involves flawless skin, defined eyes, and accentuated features. She is skilled at creating a wide range of looks, from glamorous and bold to soft and romantic. Her ability to adapt to different styles and preferences has made her a favorite among clients.

 

Apart from her work in the beauty industry, Namrata Soni has also been a part of major fashion weeks and events, where she has collaborated with renowned designers to create stunning makeup looks for their runway shows. She has also conducted makeup masterclasses and workshops, sharing her knowledge and expertise with aspiring makeup artists.

item.title: Parul Garg
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Parul Garg

Makeup Artist

Parul Garg is a well-renowned makeup artist from India who has achieved great success in her career. Despite having a formal education as a lawyer, she decided to pursue her childhood passion for makeup. Parul's love for cosmetics and her enthusiasm for applying makeup to herself, friends, and family eventually led her to become one of India's most loved and respected makeup artists.

 

Throughout her career, Parul Garg has dedicated herself to ensuring that every bride she works with looks exceptionally beautiful on their special day. Her attention to detail and commitment to her clients have earned her a strong reputation in the bridal makeup industry.

 

In addition to her work with brides, Parul also runs a makeup academy where she imparts her knowledge and skills to aspiring makeup artists. By teaching hundreds of students the art of makeup application, she not only shares her expertise but also empowers them to become successful entrepreneurs. Parul's vision is to spread knowledge and help her students establish themselves in the field.

 

With a significant social media following of over 6 million, Parul Garg has become a celebrated makeup artist in India. Her hard work and dedication have played a crucial role in reaching the pinnacle of her career. item.title: Chetan Bhagat
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Chetan Bhagat

Writer

Chetan Bhagat is a prominent Indian author, columnist, and YouTuber. He gained widespread recognition for his works and has been acknowledged as one of the world's most influential people by Time magazine in 2010. Several of his novels have also been adapted into films.

Bhagat was raised in a traditional Punjabi Hindu family. His father served as a lieutenant colonel in the Indian Army, while his mother worked as a scientist at the Indian Agricultural Research Institute in New Delhi. He attended the Army Public School, Dhaula Kuan, during his schooling years. Despite considering himself an average student at the age of 15, Bhagat discovered his passion for writing during this time. He started writing articles for his school's literary magazine, and seeing his name published as a writer brought him immense joy and motivated him to continue writing.

 

He pursued a Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech.) degree in Mechanical Engineering from the Indian Institute of Technology, Delhi, graduating in 1995 with a remarkable academic record. Subsequently, Bhagat enrolled in the Indian Institute of Management, Ahmedabad (IIMA), where he completed a Master of Business Administration (MBA) degree in marketing in 1997. His achievements in the field of art and entertainment were recognized by IIMA in June 2018 when he was honored with the "Young Alumni Achiever's Award 2018."

 

Chetan Bhagat's career as an author has been highly successful, with his novels resonating with a wide readership. Some of his notable works include "Five Point Someone," "One Night @ the Call Center," "The 3 Mistakes of My Life," "2 States," and "Half Girlfriend." These novels explore various themes, including relationships, youth culture, and societal issues, and have garnered both commercial success and critical acclaim. Bhagat's writing style, which often incorporates a mix of humor and relatable storytelling, has made him a popular figure among readers in India and beyond.

 

In addition to his writing career, Chetan Bhagat is known for his columns, where he offers opinions on diverse subjects, including politics, youth, and social issues. He has also ventured into the digital space and has a significant presence on YouTube, where he shares videos on various topics, including motivational content and his thoughts on current events.

item.title: Zoya Akhtar
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Zoya Akhtar

Writer

Zoya Akhtar is a renowned Indian film director and screenwriter known for her unique storytelling style, visual flair, and compelling narratives. With her ability to create thought-provoking cinema and her exploration of complex human emotions, Akhtar has made a significant impact on the Indian film industry. Born on October 14, 1972, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, Zoya Akhtar comes from a family with deep roots in the Indian film industry. Her father is the renowned lyricist Javed Akhtar, and her brother is the acclaimed film director and actor Farhan Akhtar.

 

Growing up in this creative environment, Akhtar developed a passion for storytelling from an early age. Akhtar made her directorial debut with the critically acclaimed film "Luck By Chance" in 2009. The film, which explores the highs and lows of the Hindi film industry, showcased Akhtar's ability to create engaging narratives and draw realistic performances from her actors. It received widespread praise for its authentic portrayal of the industry and its satirical take on fame and success. She further cemented her reputation as a director with the films "Zindagi Na Milegi Dobara" (2011) and "Dil Dhadakne Do" (2015). These films delved into complex themes such as friendship, love, and family dynamics, while also showcasing Akhtar's visual storytelling skills. Her films are known for their stunning cinematography, vibrant locations, and the ability to capture the essence of contemporary Indian society.

item.title: Jaideep Sahni
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Jaideep Sahni

Writer

Jaideep Sahni is an Indian screenwriter, songwriter, and creative producer known for his work in Hindi cinema. He has written the screenplays for several notable films, including "Chak De! India," "Khosla Ka Ghosla," "Company," "Bunty Aur Babli," "Rocket Singh: Salesman of the Year," and "Shuddh Desi Romance."

 

Sahni has received recognition and awards for his writing. He won the Filmfare Award for Best Dialogue and Best Story for the film "Company" (2002) and the Filmfare Award for Best Screenplay for "Khosla Ka Ghosla" (2006). He also won the IIFA Award for Best Story for "Chak De! India" (2007).

 

Born and raised in New Delhi, Sahni studied at the Guru Nanak Dev Engineering College in Bidar. He initially worked as a computer engineer and was employed at NIIT. However, his passion for writing led him to pursue a career in screenwriting and songwriting.

 

Sahni's journey as a writer began with his work as a lyricist after jam sessions with Palash Sen. He then discovered the screenplay for the film "Gandhi" in a bookstore in Delhi, which inspired him to start writing screenplays at the age of 27. He wrote both the screenplay and lyrics for the film "Jungle" (2000), directed by Ram Gopal Verma. His collaboration with Verma continued with the critically acclaimed film "Company" (2002), which received multiple nominations and awards.

 

Sahni has also worked with director Dibakar Banerjee on the film "Khosla Ka Ghosla." He has had a long association with Yash Raj Films, starting with the successful film "Bunty Aur Babli" (2005), directed by Shaad Ali. He went on to write the screenplay for "Chak De! India" (2007), directed by Shimit Amin, which starred Shah Rukh Khan and was inspired by the real-life story of Maharaj Krishan Kaushik. Sahni also contributed to the screenplay of "Aaja Nachle" (2007) and "Rocket Singh: Salesman of the Year" (2009), both directed by Shimit Amin.

item.title: Sharmistha Roy
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Sharmishta Roy

Production Designer

Sharmishta Roy is a prominent Indian film art director and production designer, primarily known for her work in Hindi cinema. She has made significant contributions to the visual aesthetics and design of numerous films.

 

Sharmishta Roy comes from a family with a strong background in film production design. Her father, Sudhendu Roy, was a renowned production designer who worked on notable films like Bimal Roy's "Sujata" (1959), "Madhumati" (1959), and "Bandini" (1963), as well as Yash Chopra's "Silsila" (1981) and "Chandni" (1989). Being exposed to her father's work, Sharmishta gained valuable insights and experience while assisting him before embarking on her own journey as an independent art director.

 

As an art director and production designer, Sharmishta Roy has displayed a remarkable ability to create visually stunning and immersive environments that enhance the storytelling in films. Her meticulous attention to detail, creative vision, and understanding of the director's vision have made her a sought-after professional in the industry.

 

Sharmishta has worked on a wide range of Hindi films, collaborating with renowned directors and contributing to the success of several notable movies. Her work encompasses various genres, from romantic dramas to period films and contemporary narratives. With her expertise and talent, she has played a vital role in shaping the visual narrative of Hindi cinema.

item.title: Nitin Chandrakant Desai
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Nitin Chandrakant Desai

production Designer

Nitin Chandrakant Desai is a renowned Indian art director, production designer, film producer, and television producer. He is best known for his exceptional work in Marathi and Hindi films, as well as his contributions to large-scale events such as the World Cultural Festival 2016 in Delhi.

 

Throughout his career spanning two decades, Nitin Desai has collaborated with some of the most acclaimed directors in the Indian film industry, including Ashutosh Gowariker, Vidhu Vinod Chopra, Rajkumar Hirani, and Sanjay Leela Bhansali. He has played a pivotal role in the visual design and aesthetics of notable films such as "Hum Dil De Chuke Sanam" (1999), "Lagaan" (2001), "Devdas" (2002), "Jodhaa Akbar" (2008), and "Prem Ratan Dhan Payo" (2015). His exceptional art direction and production design have garnered him several accolades, including four National Film Awards for Best Art Direction and three Filmfare Best Art Direction Awards.

 

In 2002, Nitin Desai ventured into film production with his company Chandrakant Productions, and produced "Desh Devi," a devotional film about Devi Mata of Kutch. Additionally, he established ND Studios, a sprawling 52-acre (21-hectare) facility in Karjat, Navi Mumbai, which has become a hub for film and television productions. Notable projects filmed at ND Studios include "Jodhaa Akbar" and the reality show "Bigg Boss."

 

Nitin Desai's passion for the arts began early in his life. He studied photography at the prestigious J.J. School of Art and L.S. Raheja School of Arts in Mumbai before venturing into the world of cinema. His artistic sensibilities and technical expertise have made him a sought-after professional in the industry, known for his ability to create visually stunning and immersive experiences for audiences.

item.title: Sabu Cyril
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Sabu Cyril

production Designer

Sabu Cyril, born as Sebastian Vincent Cyril, is a highly acclaimed Indian film production designer. With a remarkable career spanning over 116 feature films and 2500 ad films, he has established himself as one of the most celebrated art directors in the country.

 

Sabu Cyril has received numerous accolades and awards for his exceptional work. He has won four National Film Awards for Best Production Design, four state awards, six Filmfare Awards for Best Art Direction (including the southern region), five International Indian Film Academy Awards, and many more. His outstanding contribution to the film industry has garnered international recognition, particularly for his work in the film "Enthiran."

 

Born in Valparai, a hill station in Coimbatore District, Tamil Nadu, Sabu Cyril completed his schooling at Asan Memorial in Chennai. He pursued his higher education at the Government College of Fine Arts in Chennai, formerly known as the Government School of Arts and Crafts.

 

Sabu Cyril's artistic inclination can be attributed to his family background. His grandfather, George Vincent, was a pioneer in photography, having opened the first photography studio in Malabar, Kozhikode, called Chitra Studio. Additionally, his uncle, Mr. A. Vincent, was a renowned cinematographer and director in the South Indian Film Industry. Growing up surrounded by nature, wildlife, and cinema, Sabu developed a deep appreciation for aesthetics and design.

item.title: Rohit Shetty
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Rohit Shetty

Action Director

Rohit Shetty is a highly successful and renowned Indian film director, producer, and screenwriter known for his high-octane action films and larger-than-life cinematic style. With a career spanning over two decades, Shetty has emerged as one of the most commercially successful and influential directors in the Hindi film industry. Born on March 14, 1973, in Mumbai, Rohit Shetty hails from a family with a strong background in the Indian film industry. His father, M.B. Shetty, was a renowned stuntman and action choreographer.

 

 Shetty's early exposure to the world of films influenced his passion for action-packed storytelling. Shetty made his directorial debut with the film "Zameen" in 2003, which showcased his inclination towards action and thrill. However, it was his collaboration with actor Ajay Devgn that proved to be a turning point in his career. The duo teamed up for the film "Golmaal: Fun Unlimited" (2006), a comedy franchise that went on to become a massive hit and established Shetty's reputation as a director with a flair for entertaining and light-hearted cinema. Shetty's signature style is characterized by larger-than-life action sequences, extravagant sets, and a perfect blend of comedy and drama.

 

His films often feature cars, stunts, and thrilling chase sequences, earning him the title of the "masala entertainer" filmmaker. Franchises like "Golmaal," "Singham," and "Dilwale" exemplify Shetty's ability to deliver crowd-pleasing, commercially successful films. While known primarily for his action-comedy films, Shetty has also explored other genres. He directed the romantic comedy "Chennai Express" (2013), which became one of the highest-grossing films in Indian cinema. Shetty's collaboration with actor Ranveer Singh in "Simmba" (2018) further showcased his versatility as a director, blending action, comedy, and social commentary. In addition to his directorial ventures, Shetty has also ventured into production under his banner, Rohit Shetty Picturez. He has produced films like "Bol Bachchan" (2012) and "Golmaal Again" (2017), ensuring a successful continuation of his film franchises. Rohit Shetty's films have received both commercial success and mixed critical reviews.

Rohit Shetty is a highly successful and renowned Indian film director, producer, and screenwriter known for his high-octane action films and larger-than-life cinematic style. With a career spanning over two decades, Shetty has emerged as one of the most commercially successful and influential directors in the Hindi film industry. Born on March 14, 1973, in Mumbai, Rohit Shetty hails from a family with a strong background in the Indian film industry. His father, M.B. Shetty, was a renowned stuntman and action choreographer.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

\u00a0Shetty's early exposure to the world of films influenced his passion for action-packed storytelling. Shetty made his directorial debut with the film \"Zameen\" in 2003, which showcased his inclination towards action and thrill. However, it was his collaboration with actor Ajay Devgn that proved to be a turning point in his career. The duo teamed up for the film \"Golmaal: Fun Unlimited\" (2006), a comedy franchise that went on to become a massive hit and established Shetty's reputation as a director with a flair for entertaining and light-hearted cinema. Shetty's signature style is characterized by larger-than-life action sequences, extravagant sets, and a perfect blend of comedy and drama.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

His films often feature cars, stunts, and thrilling chase sequences, earning him the title of the \"masala entertainer\" filmmaker. Franchises like \"Golmaal,\" \"Singham,\" and \"Dilwale\" exemplify Shetty's ability to deliver crowd-pleasing, commercially successful films. While known primarily for his action-comedy films, Shetty has also explored other genres. He directed the romantic comedy \"Chennai Express\" (2013), which became one of the highest-grossing films in Indian cinema. Shetty's collaboration with actor Ranveer Singh in \"Simmba\" (2018) further showcased his versatility as a director, blending action, comedy, and social commentary. In addition to his directorial ventures, Shetty has also ventured into production under his banner, Rohit Shetty Picturez. He has produced films like \"Bol Bachchan\" (2012) and \"Golmaal Again\" (2017), ensuring a successful continuation of his film franchises. Rohit Shetty's films have received both commercial success and mixed critical reviews.<\/p>","typography_typography":"custom","typography_font_weight":"bold"},"elements":[],"widgetType":"text-editor"}],"isInner":false}],"isInner":false},{"id":"d81cb7c","elType":"section","settings":{"background_background":"classic","background_color":"#EAF0EE8F","hover_parallax":[{"layer_position_vr":{"unit":"%","size":30},"layer_position_hr":{"unit":"%","size":40},"_id":"ac4fb18"},{"layer_position_vr":{"unit":"%","size":60},"layer_position_hr":{"unit":"%","size":20},"_id":"a1b2b38"}]},"elements":[{"id":"5fc1ba1","elType":"column","settings":{"_column_size":100,"_inline_size":null},"elements":[{"id":"1657732","elType":"widget","settings":{"title":"Enquiry Form","header_size":"h3","align":"center","typography_typography":"custom","typography_font_size":{"unit":"px","size":40,"sizes":[]},"typography_font_weight":"bold","_margin":{"unit":"px","top":"40","right":"0","bottom":"20","left":"0","isLinked":false},"__globals__":{"title_color":"globals\/colors?id=6d3d44f9"}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"heading"},{"id":"d79a693","elType":"widget","settings":{"shortcode":"[forminator_form id=\"5483\"]","_margin":{"unit":"px","top":"0","right":"0","bottom":"40","left":"0","isLinked":false}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"shortcode"}],"isInner":false}],"isInner":false}]

item.title: Sham Kaushal
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Sham Kaushal

Action Director

From a humble origin to become one of the most popular and sought after action directors in Hindi film industry, Mr Sham Kaushal has come a long way in his 31 years long career as Action Director. He has the prestigious Oscar winning movie Slumdog Millionare along with Hindi superhits like Padmavat, Kaabil, Sanju, Dangal, Bajirao Mastani, Krrish 2 & 3, Bajrangi Bhaijan, Gangs of Wasseypur, Dhoom 3, Ram Leela, Raajneeti, Phantom, Kaminey, Om Shanti Om, Gundey, Ishaqzaade & realistic Films like Blackfriday, Parzania, 1971, A Wednesday and The Reluctant Fundamentalist to his credit. Apart from many other prestigious awards he has got four Filmfare Awards, maximum any Action Director has got. He is thankful to God for being so kind to him.

 

He was born in a small village called Mirzapur near Tanda in Punjab, India. He did his Post graduation in English literature from Govt college, Hoshiarpur in Punjab. The journey from his native Punjab village to Mumbai was solely for survival with no intention or ambition in films. His first job as a sales representative lasted only for an year as he realised his interests were somewhere else. A chance meeting with some stunt men in the neighbourhood, who worked with big names in the industry then, changed Sham's destiny! He worked as a stuntman for 7 years before getting the big break as an independent action director in 1990.

item.title: Ajay Nagar (Carry Minati)
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Ajay Nagar (Carry Minati)

Youtuber Comedian

Carryminati, whose real name is Ajey Nagar, is a popular Indian YouTuber, gamer, and social media personality. He gained immense fame and a massive fan following through his entertaining and often controversial content. Known for his witty and humorous style, Carryminati has become one of the most influential creators in the Indian online community.

Born on June 12, 1999, in Faridabad, India, Carryminati began his YouTube journey in 2014 at the age of 15. Initially focusing on gaming content, he gradually shifted to creating roasting and reaction videos. His distinctive style of satirical commentary, coupled with his energetic persona, struck a chord with the audience, especially the younger generation.

Carryminati's most notable video, titled "YouTube vs TikTok - The End," catapulted him into the spotlight in 2020. The video, which was a response to a controversial TikTok video, went viral and broke several records on YouTube, accumulating millions of views within a short period. Despite the video being taken down due to policy violations, it cemented Carryminati's position as a prominent figure in the Indian YouTube community.

item.title: Jordindian
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Jordindian

Youtuber Comedian

Jordindian is an Indian-Jordanian sketch comedy and music YouTube channel created by Nazer Al Azzeh and Vineeth Kumar. The name "Jordindian" is based on the origins of the two creators: Naser is Jordanian, while Vineeth is from India. The channel was created in 2016 and has since amassed over 2.7 million subscribers and over 50 million views. Jordindian's videos typically feature the two friends in comedic sketches that are based on their own experiences and observations of life in India and Jordan. The channel's humor is often self-deprecating and relatable, and it has been praised for its ability to capture the nuances of cross-cultural relationships. Some of Jordindian's most popular videos include "Smoke Shisha Play FIFA," "How Students Study for Exams," and "Types of Drivers." The channel has also been featured in YouTube Rewind 2018. Jordindian is a popular and successful YouTube channel that has gained a large following for its relatable and humorous content. The channel's success is a testament to the talent and creativity of its creators, and it is sure to continue to entertain viewers for years to come.

item.title: Mallika Dua
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Mallika Dua

Youtuber Comedian

Mallika Dua is a popular Indian comedian who rose to fame through her YouTube videos. She is known for her observational humor and her ability to skewer Indian culture and society. Her videos have been praised for their wit and their insights into the human condition.

Dua began her career as a stand-up comedian in 2014. She quickly gained a following for her unique brand of humor. In 2015, she launched her own YouTube channel, where she began posting videos of her stand-up sets. Her videos quickly went viral, and she soon became one of the most popular comedians in India.

Dua's YouTube videos are known for their sharp wit and their insightful commentary on Indian culture and society. In one video, she skewers the Indian obsession with fair skin. In another, she mocks the Indian tendency to over-dramatize everything. Her videos have been praised for their humor, their intelligence, and their ability to spark conversations about important issues.

In addition to her YouTube channel, Dua has also appeared on several television shows, including "Comedy Nights with Kapil" and "The Kapil Sharma Show." She has also starred in several films, including "Baar Baar Dekho" and "Finding Fanny."

item.title: Manjull Khattar
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Manjul Khattar

Fashion Influencer

Manjul Khattar was born on Monday, 20 July 1998 in the Gurugram City of Haryana. His zodiac sign is Cancer. He did his schooling from Xion International Convent School, Gurugram. He pursued his B.Com (correspondence) from Amity University, Noida.

 

In 2016, Manjul opened his Instagram account and started posting his videos and photos. On 8 June 2017, Manjul started a youtube channel by the name ‘MANJUL KHATTAR,’ where he started posting his videos. On 10 June 2017, he posted his first video by the title ‘HEIGHTS OF BARGAINING.’

 

In 2018, he was featured in the music video of the song by Monali Thakur, ‘Shy Mora Saiyaan.’ Since then, he has appeared in many music videos.

item.title: Mridul Madhok
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Mridul Madhok

Fashion Influencer

Mridul Madhok is an Indian social media influencer and a popular TikToker. He is famous for being the doppelganger of the Indian actor Arjun Kapoor.

 

Mridul was born on Saturday, 19 January 1991 in Delhi. His zodiac sign is Aquarius. He did his schooling from Bal Bharati Public School, Delhi and Ryan International School, Delhi. In 2017, he did Bachelor of Technology in Electrical and Electronics Engineering from Bhagwan Parshuram Institute Of Technology, Delhi.

 

His father, Ajay Madhok, is an actor too. His mother’s name is Deepa Madhok, and his younger brother, Karan Madhok, is President at Anhad – The Music Society of KMV.

 

In 2015, he did his summer internship at Larsen and Turbo in Delhi. In 2016, he joined Unica Solutions S.R.L. as manager of international sales. After working there for more than a year, he joined LegalRaasta as a business development manager in Delhi. He started his career as a model and has worked for various print advertisements and TV commercials. He has appeared in various TV shows like ‘Dating in the Dark’ (2018) and ‘Fashion Superstar’ (2020).

item.title: Santoshi Shetty
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Santoshi Shetty

Fashion Influencer

Santoshi Shetty, born on December 17, 1993, in Mumbai, is a 27-year-old fashion influencer and content creator. She belongs to the zodiac sign of Sagittarius. Santoshi completed her schooling at St Xavier's High School in 2009 before continuing her education at S. M. Shetty High School in Powai, Mumbai. For her graduation, she attended IES College of Architecture in Bandra, Mumbai, where she studied architecture. Her thesis topic during her graduation was focused on "A Fashion Technology Park."

 

Santoshi comes from a family with a background in the hospitality industry. Her father is a hotelier who owns a chain of restaurants called Gopalas. Her mother's name is Sharanya Shetty, and she has a sister named Sanskruti Shetty. Additionally, Santoshi's brother, Siddharth Shetty, works at The NoMad Hotel in New York.

 

During her time as a student, Santoshi began attracting attention from renowned brands for social media collaborations in 2013 and 2014. She also started a YouTube channel with the assistance of a production company while pursuing her graduation. Santoshi's online presence and fashion-focused content have made her a prominent figure in the influencer community.

For her graduation, she attended IES College of Architecture in Bandra, Mumbai, where she studied architecture. Her thesis topic during her graduation was focused on \"A Fashion Technology Park.\"<\/p>

item.content:encoded:
Navina Bole

Telivision Female Actor

Navina Bole is an accomplished Indian actress known for her prominent roles in the Indian television industry. Born on October 30, 1983, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, Navina has made a significant impact with her talent and versatility.

 

Navina gained popularity with her portrayal of the charming and vivacious Diya Bhushan in the long-running TV show "Miley Jab Hum Tum." Her stellar performance in the series won her critical acclaim and a dedicated fan following. Since then, she has been a part of several successful television shows, including "Ishqbaaaz," "Kasautii Zindagii Kay," and "Bahu Hamari Rajni Kant."

 

With her natural acting skills, Navina has proved her ability to portray diverse characters with ease. Her screen presence and ability to connect with the audience have made her a sought-after actress in the industry. Navina's dedication and hard work have been recognized with various awards and nominations.

 

Apart from her acting prowess, Navina is also known for her elegant style and graceful personality. She has a significant presence on social media, where she shares glimpses of her personal and professional life with her fans.

item.title: Rakesh Bedi
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Rakesh Bedi

Telivision Male Actor

Rakesh Bedi is a renowned Indian actor who has left an indelible mark on the entertainment industry with his versatile performances. Born on December 1, 1954, Bedi has been a prominent figure in both films and television for over four decades. He is best known for his impeccable comic timing and ability to effortlessly switch between different characters. Bedi made his acting debut in the late 1970s and gained recognition for his roles in popular television shows like "Yeh Jo Hai Zindagi" and "Shrimaan Shrimati." His impeccable comic timing and ability to portray diverse characters endeared him to the audience, making him a household name. In addition to television, Bedi has also showcased his talent on the silver screen, delivering memorable performances in films like "Chashme Buddoor," "Khoobsurat," and "Dil Vil Pyar Vyar." His ability to bring humor and warmth to his characters has earned him critical acclaim and a loyal fan base.

item.title: Tusshar Kapoor
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Tusshar Kapoor

Telivision Male Actor

Tusshar Kapoor, born on 20 November 1976, is an Indian actor and film producer who primarily works in Hindi cinema. He comes from a prominent film family, being the son of Indian actors Jeetendra and Shobha Kapoor. His elder sister, Ekta Kapoor, is a renowned television and film producer.

Tusshar Kapoor attended the Bombay Scottish School, where he was in the same class as Abhishek Bachchan. He later pursued a BBA degree at the Stephen M. Ross School of Business at the University of Michigan in Ann Arbor. Similar to his father, Tusshar Kapoor is a follower of Nichiren Buddhism.

 

In June 2016, Tusshar Kapoor made headlines when he opted for in vitro fertilization (IVF) and became a single parent to his son, Laksshya Kapoor, through surrogacy. This decision inspired many and shed light on alternative paths to parenthood.

 

Before making his acting debut, Tusshar Kapoor worked as an assistant to film director David Dhawan. He then received training in acting from Roshan Taneja and Mahendra Verma at their acting school, and in dance from Nimesh Bhatt.

Tusshar Kapoor made his acting debut in 2001 with the film "Mujhe Kucch Kehna Hai," a remake of the Telugu hit "Tholi Prema," in which he starred alongside Kareena Kapoor. His performance in the film earned him the Filmfare Award for Best Male Debut. He subsequently appeared in films like "Kyaa Dil Ne Kahaa" (2002), "Jeena Sirf Merre Liye" (2002), and "Yeh Dil" (2003), which were remakes of Telugu films but didn't perform well at the box office.

 

He gained recognition for his role in Ram Gopal Varma's production "Gayab" (2004), despite the film's average performance. From 2004 onwards, Tusshar Kapoor starred in several commercially successful films, including "Khakee" (2004), "Kyaa Kool Hai Hum" (2005), "Golmaal" (2006), "Shootout at Lokhandwala" (2007), "Golmaal Returns" (2008), "Golmaal 3" (2010), "The Dirty Picture" (2011), "Kyaa Super Kool Hain Hum" (2012), "Shor in the City" (2012), and "Shootout at Wadala" (2013).

 

Apart from acting, Tusshar Kapoor has been involved in philanthropic activities. In 2012, he participated in the "Fashion for a Cause" event, which aimed to raise funds for homeless children. He has also co-produced and acted in films like "Chaar Din Ki Chandni" (2012), "Kyaa Kool Hain Hum 3" (2016), and "Mastizaade" (2016).

 

In 2017, Tusshar Kapoor starred as Lucky in the comedy film "Golmaal Again," which became a blockbuster success. He made a special appearance as himself in the song "Aankh Marey" in the film "Simmba" (2018). In 2019, he appeared in the web horror series "Boo Sabki Phategi," produced by ALT Balaji, alongside Mallika Sherawat.

item.title: Kishwer Merchant
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Kishwer Merchant

Telivision Female Actor

Kishwer Merchant is an Indian television actress and model. She was born on February 3, 1981, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. Kishwer began her career as a model and later transitioned into acting.

Kishwer Merchant gained popularity through her roles in various television shows. She made her acting debut with the popular show "Hip Hip Hurray" in the late 1990s, where she played the role of Nonie. However, she rose to fame with her portrayal of Haseena Raichand in the serial "Pyaar Kii Ye Ek Kahaani."

 

Over the years, Kishwer has appeared in numerous television shows, including "Kasautii Zindagii Kay," "Kasamh Se," "Kkavyanjali," and "Parvarrish - Kuchh Khattee Kuchh Meethi." She has also participated in reality shows like "Bigg Boss 9," where she emerged as one of the finalists, and "Box Cricket League."

 

Kishwer Merchant is known for her bold and outspoken nature, and she has often portrayed strong and independent characters in her TV shows. She is admired for her acting skills and has garnered a significant fan following. Kishwer is also active on social media platforms, where she engages with her fans and shares updates about her personal and professional life.

Anil Rastogi

Bollywood Male Actor

Anil Rastogi is an Indian theatre, television and film actor. He is known for his roles in Ishaqzaade, Udaan and Na Bole Tum Na Maine Kuch Kaha.

He has more than 600 theatrical performances and is a former scientist at the Central Drug Research Institute (CDRI), Lucknow.

item.title: Sudha Chandran
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Sudha Chandran

Television Female Actress

Sudha Chandran is an acclaimed Indian actress, classical dancer, and television personality. She was born on September 27, 1965, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. Sudha is best known for her remarkable journey as a Bharatanatyam dancer who overcame adversity.

 

At the age of 16, Sudha Chandran met with a tragic accident that resulted in the amputation of her right leg due to medical negligence. However, she did not let this setback deter her passion for dance. With the help of a prosthetic leg, she resumed her dance training and became an inspiration to many.

 

Sudha's dedication and determination led her to become one of the most prominent dancers in the Indian classical dance form of Bharatanatyam. She performed extensively on national and international stages, captivating audiences with her grace, expressions, and flawless footwork.

 

In addition to her dance career, Sudha Chandran ventured into acting and became a popular face on Indian television. She made her debut in the Hindi TV serial "Kasamh Se" and gained widespread recognition for her portrayal of Ramola Sikand. Sudha has since appeared in various TV shows, including "Naagin," "Shakti - Astitva Ke Ehsaas Ki," and "Ye Hai Mohabbatein," showcasing her versatility as an actress.

item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Brijendra Kala

Bollywood Male Actor

Brijendra Kala is an Indian actor who works in Bollywood films. He is known for his subtle portrayals of characters rooted in reality. He gained attention for his small roles in mainstream cinema.

 

He wrote dialogues for several TV shows produced by Ekta Kapoor, including Kahani Khar Khar Ki. He made his acting debut in 2003 when he played a small role as a newspaper vendor in Dikmanshu Dhulia Hasil.

 

He has appeared in small or supporting roles in films such as Jab Vi Met, Midhya, Agnipath, Paan Singh Tomar, Ankon Theki, PK, Tubelight and Patti Gul Meter Salu, and has played various roles specializing in comedy. depictions

item.title: Amrita Prakash
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Amrita Prakash

Bollywood Female Actor

She rose to fame in 2001 with her debut film Anubhav Sinha's Tum Bin, where she played the lead role of Milli. After that, Amrita continued on television. When she was 14, she was selected to be a part of India's first reality show, Kya Masti Kya Dhoom, which she co-hosted with Bollywood actress Sonali Bhindre for over two years.

 

Her last television drama was Har Kuch Gehta Hai for Zee TV, where she played one of the lead heroines.

She did one of her most convincing roles with Rajshri Films in Sooraj Parjatya's Viva as Choti. Her performance in Viva was greatly appreciated by the critics. Amrita has repeatedly quoted- “Vivah is one of the biggest milestones and turning points of my career.

Amrita played the character Sandhya in Ek Viva Aisa B. She played a small role in Dharma Productions We Are Family.

He took up the show Ek Rishta Aisa B for Sony Paul. She played the lead role of Deepika in the show.

item.title: Suman Talwar
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Suman Talwar

Bollywood Female Actor

He acted in several Telugu action and romantic films including Tarangini (1982), Netty Bharatham (1983) and Sithara (1984). Suman played mythological characters like Venkateswara, Shiva and Ram in Telugu. In 1993 he won the Nandi Award for Best Actor for Bhava Bhavamarithi.

 

He returned to acting by playing the villain in the Tamil films Sivaji (2007) and Kuruvi (2008). He played the main antagonist in the Malayalam film Sagar named Jackie (2009). He also won the Asianet Film Honor Special Jury Award in 2009.

item.title: Rimi Sen
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Rimi Sen

Bollywood Female Actor

Rimi Sen is an Indian film actress who primarily worked in Hindi cinema. She was born on September 21, 1981, in Kolkata, West Bengal, India. Rimi began her career as a model before transitioning to acting.

 

Rimi Sen made her acting debut with the Telugu film "Nee Thodu Kavali" in 2002. She then ventured into Bollywood with the comedy film "Hungama" in 2003, directed by Priyadarshan. The film was a commercial success, and Rimi received positive reviews for her performance, which earned her a nomination for the Filmfare Award for Best Female Debut.

 

She went on to appear in several successful films, including "Dhoom" (2004), in which she played a pivotal role alongside stars like Abhishek Bachchan and Uday Chopra. Rimi also appeared in movies like "Golmaal: Fun Unlimited" (2006) and its sequels, "Dhoom 2" (2006), and "Phir Hera Pheri" (2006). Her performances were appreciated by the audience, and she became known for her comic timing and charming screen presence.

 

Rimi Sen took a break from acting after a while and participated in the reality show "Bigg Boss" in 2015, gaining further popularity. However, she returned to films with the Bengali film "Budhia Singh - Born to Run" in 2016.

item.title: Rekha
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Rekha

Bollywood Female Actor

Rekha, whose full name is Bhanurekha Ganesan, is an Indian film actress who has primarily worked in Hindi cinema. She was born on October 10, 1954, in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. Rekha is known for her mesmerizing beauty, versatile acting skills, and enigmatic screen presence.

 

Rekha made her acting debut as a child artist in the Telugu film "Rangula Ratnam" in 1966. She then transitioned into Hindi cinema and gained recognition for her performances in films like "Sawan Bhadon" (1970) and "Namak Haraam" (1973). However, it was her role in "Ghar" (1978) that brought her critical acclaim and established her as a leading actress in Bollywood.

 

Throughout her career, Rekha has portrayed a wide range of characters, including strong female leads, complex protagonists, and women with shades of gray. Some of her notable films include "Muqaddar Ka Sikandar" (1978), "Silsila" (1981), "Khoon Bhari Maang" (1988), and "Umrao Jaan" (1981), for which she won the National Film Award for Best Actress.

item.title: Ragini Khanna
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Ragini Khanna

Bollywood Female Actor

Ragini Khanna is a talented Indian actress who has made a significant mark in the entertainment industry. Born on December 9, 1987, in Mumbai, India, Ragini comes from a family with a rich legacy in Bollywood. She is the daughter of actor and film director Praveen Khanna and niece of renowned actress Juhi Chawla.

 

Ragini made her acting debut in the television industry with the popular show "Radhaa Ki Betiyaan Kuch Kar Dikhayengi" in 2008, where she portrayed the character of Ragini Sharma. Her natural acting prowess and charming persona quickly won the hearts of audiences, and she went on to appear in several successful TV shows, including "Sasural Genda Phool" and "Bhaskar Bharti."

 

Apart from television, Ragini has also ventured into the world of films and has acted in movies like "Teen Thay Bhai" and "Gurgaon." Her performances have been critically acclaimed, showcasing her versatility as an actress.

 

Ragini Khanna is known for her infectious smile, effortless acting skills, and ability to connect with viewers on an emotional level. Her dedication and hard work have earned her numerous awards and nominations. With her talent, grace, and determination, Ragini continues to enthrall audiences and remains one of the most promising stars in the Indian entertainment industry.

item.title: Shoma Chaudhury
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Shoma Chaudhury

Bollywood Female Actor

Shoma Chaudhary is an award-winning journalist, editor and curator. and founder of Lucid Lines, an independent ideas, events and intellectual property agency. Currently hosts a podcast called INQUIRY and a live chat series called IGNITION.

 

In 2011, Newsweek (US) selected Shoma Chaudhary as one of the "150 Power Women Who Shook the World". Other Indian women on the list that year were Sonia Gandhi and Arundhati Roy. Sabiatoro is also the recipient of the Ernest Hemingway Award for Political Journalism (2013).

 

Mumbai Press Club Award for Political Journalism (2012), Ramnath Goenka Award and Sameli Devi Jain Award for Best Women Journalist (2009) for "Going Where Angels Fear to Tread".

Bollywood Female Actor

Neha Dixit is an Indian freelance journalist covering politics, gender and social justice. He is a visiting professor at Ashoka University and a recipient of the Sameli Devi Jain Award (2016) and the CPJ International Press Freedom Award (2019).

item.title: Anil Kapoor
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Anil Kapoor

Bollywood Male Actor

Anil Kapoor is a highly acclaimed actor known for his dynamic performances and youthful energy. With a career spanning over four decades, Anil has been a part of several iconic films and has achieved both critical acclaim and commercial success. Anil Kapoor's versatility as an actor is evident in his diverse filmography.

From intense roles in films like "Tezaab" and "Ram Lakhan" to nuanced performances in movies like "Lamhe" and "Pukar," he has demonstrated his range and ability to adapt to various genres. Anil Kapoor's infectious charisma and charm have made him a favorite among audiences of all ages. He has also garnered international recognition through his work in films like "Slumdog Millionaire" and the TV series "24."

Anil's dedication to his craft and his ability to reinvent himself over the years have ensured his longevity in the industry. Beyond his acting career, Anil Kapoor is known for his youthful appearance and commitment to fitness. He continues to impress audiences with his remarkable energy and passion for his craft, making him a true icon of Indian cinema.

item.title: Akshay Kumar
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Akshay Kumar

Bollywood Male Actor

Akshay Kumar, often referred to as the "Khiladi" of Bollywood, is a versatile actor known for his remarkable energy, impeccable comic timing, and dedication to action-packed roles. With a career spanning over three decades, Akshay has established himself as one of the most successful and bankable actors in the industry.

 

He has a unique ability to seamlessly transition between comedy, action, and drama, leaving a lasting impact on audiences. Akshay's filmography boasts a diverse range of roles, including memorable performances in films like "Hera Pheri," "Khiladi," "Namastey London," and "Special 26." He has also delved into socially relevant subjects and delivered impactful performances in films such as "Toilet: Ek Prem Katha" and "Pad Man," which shed light on important societal issues. Beyond his acting prowess, Akshay is admired for his disciplined work ethic and commitment to fitness.

 

Known for performing his own stunts, he has gained a reputation as an action hero. Additionally, he has actively supported various social causes, including education for the underprivileged and women's empowerment.

item.title: Aditya Roy Kapur
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Aditya Roy Kapur

Bollywood Male Actor

Aditya Roy Kapur is a talented Indian actor known for his charming persona and his ability to portray intense and emotionally complex characters. He made his acting debut with the film "London Dreams" in 2009 but gained widespread recognition and acclaim for his role in the romantic drama "Aashiqui 2" in 2013.

 

Aditya's portrayal of a troubled musician in the film struck a chord with audiences and established him as a promising talent in Bollywood. He further showcased his versatility through films like "Yeh Jawaani Hai Deewani" and "Kalank," where he portrayed diverse characters with depth and sincerity. Aditya's on-screen presence, combined with his good looks and natural acting style, has earned him a dedicated fan following.

 

His ability to emote and connect with audiences on an emotional level has made him a sought-after actor in the industry. Aditya Roy Kapur continues to explore different genres and push his boundaries as an actor, constantly evolving and showcasing his versatility through his performances.

item.title: Bobby Deol
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Bobby Deol

Bollywood Male Actor

Bobby Deol, born as Vijay Singh Deol, is an Indian actor who has had a successful career in Bollywood. He comes from a prominent film family, being the son of veteran actor Dharmendra and the younger brother of Sunny Deol. Bobby made his acting debut with the film "Barsaat" and soon became a heartthrob with his charming looks and charismatic on-screen presence.

 

He gained widespread popularity through films like "Gupt: The Hidden Truth," "Soldier," and "Humraaz," where he showcased his versatility as an actor. After a brief hiatus from films, Bobby made a powerful comeback with the film "Race 3," receiving acclaim for his performance. He continued to impress with projects like "Housefull 4" and the web series "Aashram."

 

Chandrachur Singh: Chandrachur Singh is an Indian actor who made his mark in the Hindi film industry in the late 1990s. Known for his boyish charm and intense performances, Chandrachur left a lasting impact with his early films.

With his nuanced performances and dedication to his craft, Arif Zakaria continues to be a respected figure in Bollywood.

item.title: Nia Sharma
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Nia Sharma

Television Female Actor

ia Sharma, a prominent name in the Indian television industry, has captivated audiences with her stunning performances and charming persona. Known for her versatility and dynamic acting skills, Nia has carved a niche for herself in the hearts of millions.

 

With her striking looks and impeccable fashion sense, Nia Sharma exudes confidence both on and off-screen. Her journey began with the popular TV show "Ek Hazaaron Mein Meri Behna Hai," where she portrayed the character of Maanvi, earning critical acclaim and a loyal fan base. She further showcased her acting prowess in shows like "Jamai Raja" and "Ishq Mein Marjawan," where she portrayed complex characters with finesse.

 

Nia Sharma is not just a talented actress but also a style icon. Her bold and experimental fashion choices have garnered widespread attention and accolades. She has been ranked among the topmost stylish women in the Indian television industry.

 

Beyond her acting career, Nia Sharma has also made her mark in reality shows like "Fear Factor: Khatron Ke Khiladi" and "Bigg Boss," displaying her adventurous spirit and competitive streak.

 

With her sheer talent, magnetic presence, and strong fan following, Nia Sharma continues to leave an indelible mark in the world of television, setting new benchmarks for aspiring actors and inspiring many with her journey.

item.title: Aamir Bashir
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Aamir Bashir

Bollywood Male Actor

Aamir is an Indian actor, director and producer best known for his powerful roles in A Wednesday and Haider.

After working in Indian television shows & commercials, he made his feature acting debut in Dev Benegal's Split Wide Open. 

He made his directorial and co-producer debut with Harud, an Urdu film which won the National Award for the Best Urdu Feature Film at the 60th National Film Awards. 

He was most recently seen in Netflix's first Indian Original series - Sacred Games. He recently appeared in the second season of Sacred Games and Navdeep Singh's Laal Kaptaan. He will soon be seen in Inside Edge S2 and is shooting for an international TV series.

item.content:encoded:
Bhumi Pednekar

Bollywood Female Actor

Bhumi Pednekar has made a significant impact in the Indian film industry with her unconventional choice of roles and remarkable performances. Known for her powerful performances in films like "Dum Laga Ke Haisha," "Toilet: Ek Prem Katha," and "Saand Ki Aankh,"

 

Bhumi has proved her versatility as an actor. She fearlessly takes on challenging characters, often portraying strong and independent women who challenge societal norms. Bhumi's dedication to her craft and her ability to bring depth and authenticity to her roles have garnered her critical acclaim and awards. She has become an inspiration for many with her impactful performances and her vocal support for social causes like climate change and women's empowerment.

 

 Bhumi's journey in the film industry exemplifies her passion for acting and her commitment to creating meaningful cinema.

item.title: Barkha Singh
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Barkha Singh

Bollywood Female Actor

Barkha Singh is a talented Indian actress and model who has made a significant mark in the entertainment industry. With her exceptional acting skills and charming personality, she has garnered a substantial fan following. Born on August 3, 1992, in Bikaner, Rajasthan, Barkha started her career as a child artist and later transitioned into adult roles with great finesse.

 

Barkha made her debut in the television industry with the popular show "Yeh Hai Aashiqui" and gained recognition for her remarkable performance. She has also appeared in several other TV shows, including "MTV Girls on Top" and "Engineering Girls," where she showcased her versatility as an actress.

 

In addition to television, Barkha has also ventured into films. She has acted in movies like "Samrat & Co." and "Mujhse Fraaandship Karoge," receiving praise for her acting prowess. Her on-screen presence is captivating, and she effortlessly brings her characters to life, making her performances memorable.

 

Apart from her acting career, Barkha is also an active social media influencer, where she engages with her fans and shares insights into her personal and professional life. With her stunning looks and infectious energy, Barkha Singh continues to charm audiences and carve her path in the entertainment industry, leaving a lasting impression on all who watch her on screen.

item.title: aditya shrivastava
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Aditya Srivastava

Bollywood Male Actor

Aditya Srivastava is indeed an Indian actor known for his work in Hindi films, television, and theatre. He gained significant popularity for his portrayal of Senior Inspector Abhijeet in the long-running television series C.I.D. Some of his notable Bollywood films include "Satya," "Gulaal," "Lakshya," "Paanch," "Black Friday," "Kaalo," "Super 30," and "Dil Se Pooch Kidhar Jana Hai."

 

During his graduation years at Allahabad University, Aditya Srivastava actively participated in theatre plays at Sangeet Samiti in Civil Lines, Allahabad. In 1989, he moved to Delhi to further refine his acting skills and pursue a career in the field. In Delhi, he primarily focused on theatre work at the Sri Ram Center of Performing Arts. It was during this time that he caught the attention of filmmaker Shekhar Kapoor, which led to his first break in the movie "Bandit Queen," where he played the character Puttilal.

 

In 1995, Aditya Srivastava relocated to Mumbai (then Bombay) and began working in the entertainment industry. Initially, he lent his voice for promos and advertisements and also appeared in significant episodic roles in TV shows like "Byomkesh Bakshi," "Rishtey," and "Aahat." He gained prominence through his roles in TV shows such as "Naya Daur," "9 Malabar Hill," and "Yeh Shaadi Nahi Ho Sakti," where he had substantial and memorable roles.

Aditya Srivastava is indeed an Indian actor known for his work in Hindi films, television, and theatre. He gained significant popularity for his portrayal of Senior Inspector Abhijeet in the long-running television series C.I.D. Some of his notable Bollywood films include \"Satya,\" \"Gulaal,\" \"Lakshya,\" \"Paanch,\" \"Black Friday,\" \"Kaalo,\" \"Super 30,\" and \"Dil Se Pooch Kidhar Jana Hai.\"<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

During his graduation years at Allahabad University, Aditya Srivastava actively participated in theatre plays at Sangeet Samiti in Civil Lines, Allahabad. In 1989, he moved to Delhi to further refine his acting skills and pursue a career in the field. In Delhi, he primarily focused on theatre work at the Sri Ram Center of Performing Arts. It was during this time that he caught the attention of filmmaker Shekhar Kapoor, which led to his first break in the movie \"Bandit Queen,\" where he played the character Puttilal.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

In 1995, Aditya Srivastava relocated to Mumbai (then Bombay) and began working in the entertainment industry. Initially, he lent his voice for promos and advertisements and also appeared in significant episodic roles in TV shows like \"Byomkesh Bakshi,\" \"Rishtey,\" and \"Aahat.\" He gained prominence through his roles in TV shows such as \"Naya Daur,\" \"9 Malabar Hill,\" and \"Yeh Shaadi Nahi Ho Sakti,\" where he had substantial and memorable roles.<\/p>","typography_typography":"custom","typography_font_weight":"bold"},"elements":[],"widgetType":"text-editor"}],"isInner":false}],"isInner":false},{"id":"c1c619e","elType":"section","settings":{"background_background":"classic","background_color":"#EAF0EE8F","hover_parallax":[{"layer_position_vr":{"unit":"%","size":30},"layer_position_hr":{"unit":"%","size":40},"_id":"ac4fb18"},{"layer_position_vr":{"unit":"%","size":60},"layer_position_hr":{"unit":"%","size":20},"_id":"a1b2b38"}]},"elements":[{"id":"7ec131e","elType":"column","settings":{"_column_size":100,"_inline_size":null},"elements":[{"id":"d9ce36c","elType":"widget","settings":{"title":"Enquiry Form","header_size":"h3","align":"center","typography_typography":"custom","typography_font_size":{"unit":"px","size":40,"sizes":[]},"typography_font_weight":"bold","_margin":{"unit":"px","top":"40","right":"0","bottom":"20","left":"0","isLinked":false},"__globals__":{"title_color":"globals\/colors?id=6d3d44f9"}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"heading"},{"id":"527387e","elType":"widget","settings":{"shortcode":"[forminator_form id=\"5483\"]","_margin":{"unit":"px","top":"0","right":"0","bottom":"40","left":"0","isLinked":false}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"shortcode"}],"isInner":false}],"isInner":false}]

item.title: chetan hansraj
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Chetan Hansraj

Bollywood Male Actor

Chetan Hansraj is an Indian actor who predominantly works in the Indian television and film industry. He was born on June 15, 1972, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India.

 

Chetan Hansraj began his acting career in the late 1990s and has since appeared in numerous TV shows and films. He gained recognition for his role as Sasha in the popular television series "Kahaani Ghar Ghar Kii" (2000-2008). His portrayal of the character earned him widespread acclaim and popularity among the audience.

 

In addition to his television work, Chetan Hansraj has also made appearances in Bollywood films. Some of his notable film credits include "Krrish" (2006), "Don" (2006), and "Jodhaa Akbar" (2008). He has played supporting roles in these movies and showcased his versatility as an actor.

 

Chetan Hansraj is known for his intense and impactful performances, often portraying negative or antagonistic characters. His strong screen presence and ability to immerse himself in diverse roles have made him a respected figure in the Indian entertainment industry.

item.title: Dharmendra
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Dharmendra

Bollywood Male Actor

Dharmendra, also known as the "He-Man" of Indian cinema, is a legendary actor who has left an indelible mark on the Hindi film industry. With his charming persona, rugged looks, and exceptional acting skills, Dharmendra has won the hearts of millions of fans across generations. Dharmendra made his acting debut with the film "Dil Bhi Tera Hum Bhi Tere" and went on to deliver several memorable performances.

 

 Known for his versatility, he effortlessly portrayed a wide range of characters, be it romantic heroes, action-oriented roles, or intense and dramatic characters. Films like "Sholay," "Phool Aur Patthar," and "Seeta Aur Geeta" have become timeless classics, earning him a special place in Bollywood history.

 

His on-screen chemistry with leading actresses like Hema Malini and Saira Banu was highly appreciated and contributed to the success of many films. Dharmendra's contribution to Hindi cinema has been recognized with several awards and honors.
