item.title: Rahul Roy
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Rahul Roy

Bollywood Male Actor

Rahul Roy is a Bollywood actor who rose to fame with his debut film "Aashiqui" in 1990, where he played the lead role and became an instant heartthrob. Born on February 9, 1968, in Kolkata, India, Roy captured the hearts of millions with his boyish charm and romantic persona. He continued to star in successful films like "Junoon" and "Phir Teri Kahani Yaad Aayee," solidifying his position as a promising actor. However, despite his initial success, Roy's career faced a slump in the later years, and he took a hiatus from the film industry.

 

In recent years, Rahul Roy has made appearances in reality shows and also ventured into regional cinema. His journey has been marked by both highs and lows, but he remains a beloved figure in the hearts of his fans. In 2020, he made headlines after suffering a stroke while shooting for a film. His recovery journey has been inspiring, and he continues to make occasional appearances in the media.

item.title: Rahul Singh
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Rahul Singh

Bollywood Male Actor

Rahul Singh is an Indian actor, playwright, and screenwriter. He is the son of Prabha Thakur, a poet and member of Rajya Sabha. Singh attended Mayo College in Ajmer and graduated from St. Xavier's College. During his college years, he wrote over 50 street plays and was part of an acting group that performed for various social organizations.

 

In 2001, Singh made his film debut with a role in "Zubeidaa." He also contributed as a dialogue writer for the Bollywood film "Kaante" in 2002. In 2009, he appeared in the film "Jail."

 

Currently, Singh plays the lead role of Brij Bhushan in the TV serial "Sapno Ke Bhanwar Mein." He has also portrayed the negative role of Vikrant Maharia in the series "24."

Singh is also known for his work in theater. He has written, directed, and acted in stage plays for the Jagrut theatre group, which he founded. His plays address various social issues and have raised awareness on important topics. He has performed in cultural festivals like Mood Indigo and Malhar, as well as in renowned plays such as "The Shawl" by David Mamet, "Hamlet" and "The Merchant of Venice" by Shakespeare, and "The Black Cat" by Edgar Allan Poe. Singh's performances span both English and Hindi theater, with notable appearances at the Oval House Theatre.

item.title: Manushi Chhillar
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Manushi Chhillar

Bollywood Female Actor

Manushi Chhillar is an Indian beauty queen and a symbol of grace, intelligence, and determination. Born on May 14, 1997, in Haryana, India, she rose to prominence by winning the coveted title of Miss World in 2017. Manushi's journey to success began when she competed in Femina Miss India, where she emerged victorious as Miss India World.

 

Manushi's reign as Miss World brought her international acclaim and opened doors for her to advocate for causes close to her heart. With her beauty and intellect, she used her platform to raise awareness about menstrual hygiene and launched the "Beauty with a Purpose" project, focusing on providing sanitary pads and promoting women's health in rural areas of India.

 

Beyond her beauty pageant success, Manushi is a medical student with dreams of becoming a cardiac surgeon. Her commitment to education and healthcare is evident in her efforts to improve access to medical facilities for those in need.

item.title: Meera Chopra
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Meera Chopra

Bollywood Female Actor

Meera Chopra is a talented Indian actress known for her work in the Hindi and Telugu film industries. With her striking looks, versatile acting skills, and magnetic screen presence, Meera has captivated audiences and garnered a dedicated fan following.

 

Born and raised in Delhi, Meera Chopra hails from a family with a strong background in the entertainment industry. She made her acting debut in 2005 with the Tamil film "Anbe Aaruyire," and later ventured into Telugu cinema with "Bangaram" in 2006. Her breakthrough performance came with the Telugu film "Vaana" in 2008, where she received critical acclaim for her portrayal of a bubbly and vivacious character.

 

Meera's journey in the film industry has been marked by a range of diverse roles, showcasing her acting prowess. Whether it's portraying a strong-willed woman, a vulnerable character, or a romantic lead, Meera has proven her versatility time and again.

 

Beyond her acting career, Meera Chopra is also known for her philanthropic endeavors. She has actively supported various charitable causes and has been associated with organizations working towards child welfare and animal rights.

item.title: Rajneesh Duggal
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Rajneesh Duggal

Bollywood Male Actor

Rajneesh Duggal is a Bollywood actor who has made a mark in the industry with his charm and acting skills. Born on November 19, 1981, in Delhi, India, Duggal started his career as a model and went on to win the title of Mr. India in 2003. He made his acting debut with the film "1920" in 2008, which garnered him critical acclaim and recognition.

 

Duggal has appeared in a range of films, including "Phhir," "Ek Paheli Leela," and "Beiimaan Love." He is known for his versatile performances and has showcased his talent in both romantic and thriller genres. With his good looks and screen presence, Duggal has garnered a loyal fan following.

 

Apart from his film career, he has also participated in reality shows like "Fear Factor: Khatron Ke Khiladi" and "Bigg Boss." Duggal continues to work in the industry and explore new opportunities, captivating audiences with his performances.

 

Rajneesh Duggal's journey in Bollywood is a testament to his determination and passion for acting. He has carved a niche for himself and continues to entertain audiences with his acting prowess and charismatic presence on screen.

item.content:encoded:
Rajit Kapur

Bollywood Male Actor

Rajit Kapur is a renowned Bollywood actor known for his remarkable performances in Hindi cinema. With his versatility and captivating screen presence, he has established himself as a prominent figure in the industry.

Kapur gained widespread recognition for his portrayal of the iconic character Byomkesh Bakshi in the popular television series of the same name.

 

He has also appeared in notable films like "The Making of the Mahatma," "The Last Lear," and "Udaan." Known for his subtle and nuanced acting style, Rajit Kapur continues to be admired for his impeccable performances, making him a highly respected actor in Bollywood.

item.title: Rajeev Khandelwal
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Rajeev Khandelwal

Bollywood Male Actor

Rajeev Khandelwal is a popular Bollywood actor known for his compelling performances and unconventional choices in films. Born on October 16, 1975, in Jaipur, India, Khandelwal began his career in the entertainment industry as a model and made his acting debut with the critically acclaimed television show "Kahiin To Hoga."

 

He made his transition to the silver screen with the film "Aamir" in 2008, which earned him widespread recognition and critical acclaim. Khandelwal continued to impress audiences with his roles in movies like "Shaitan," "Table No. 21," and "Samrat & Co." He is known for portraying intense and complex characters with finesse.

 

Apart from his film career, Khandelwal has also explored the digital space and has appeared in popular web series like "Haq Se" and "Coldd Lassi Aur Chicken Masala." He has also hosted several television shows and is admired for his charming on-screen presence.

item.title: Rajat Kapoor
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Rajat Kapoor

Bollywood Male Actor

Rajat Kapoor is a versatile actor, filmmaker, and theatre personality who has made significant contributions to the Indian film industry. Born on February 11, 1961, in Delhi, India, Kapoor has established himself as a prominent figure in both mainstream and independent cinema. He made his acting debut in the 1990s and gained recognition for his nuanced and natural performances.

 

Kapoor is known for his ability to effortlessly portray complex characters and has been praised for his exceptional acting skills. Some of his notable films include "Bheja Fry," "Mithya," "Ankhon Dekhi," and "Kapoor & Sons," where he showcased his versatility and received critical acclaim.

 

Apart from acting, Kapoor has also ventured into filmmaking and has directed films like "Ragini MMS," "Aankhon Dekhi," and "Kadakh." His directorial ventures have been appreciated for their unique storytelling and unconventional narratives.

item.title: Rajat Bedi
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Rajat Bedi

Bollywood Male Actor

Rajat Bedi is an Indian actor who has primarily worked in Bollywood films. Born on January 1, 1970, in India, Bedi made his acting debut in the late 1990s and gained recognition for his strong screen presence and intense performances. He has predominantly played supporting roles and has appeared in films such as "Koi... Mil Gaya," "Bichhoo," and "The Hero: Love Story of a Spy."

 

Known for his portrayal of negative characters, Bedi has showcased his versatility as an actor. His performances often exude a sense of intensity and command attention on screen. Alongside his film career, Bedi has also ventured into the Punjabi film industry, further expanding his reach as an actor.

 

While Bedi may not have achieved the same level of fame as some of his contemporaries, he has left a mark with his impactful performances. He continues to contribute to the Indian film industry and is appreciated for his dedication and talent as an actor.

item.title: Raj Babbar
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Raj Babbar

Bollywood Male Actor

Raj Babbar is a prominent Bollywood actor who has made significant contributions to Indian cinema. Born on June 23, 1952, in Tundla, Uttar Pradesh, India, Babbar began his acting career in the 1970s and quickly gained recognition for his versatile performances. He has showcased his talent in both mainstream and parallel cinema, earning critical acclaim and a dedicated fan following. Some of his notable films include "Insaaf Ka Tarazu," "Aap To Aise Na The," and "Baabul."

 

Apart from his acting prowess, Babbar has also ventured into politics and is associated with the Indian National Congress party. He has served as a Member of Parliament and has been actively involved in social and political initiatives.

item.title: Rohit Saraf
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Rohit Saraf

Bollywood Male Actor

Rohit Saraf is a talented and promising Bollywood actor who has garnered attention and acclaim for his impressive performances on the big screen. Born on December 8, 1996, in Nagpur, India, Rohit ventured into the world of acting at a young age and has since made a mark with his incredible talent and versatility.

 

Rohit made his acting debut in the 2016 film "Dear Zindagi," where he played the role of Alia Bhatt's younger brother. Although he had a limited screen time, his portrayal caught the audience's attention and set the stage for his future endeavors. He further gained recognition for his role in the 2018 blockbuster film "The Sky Is Pink," where he portrayed the character of Ishaan, Priyanka Chopra's on-screen brother.

 

Since then, Rohit Saraf has been consistently delivering exceptional performances in various films and web series. He has showcased his acting prowess in projects like "Mere Dad Ki Maruti," "Hichki," and the critically acclaimed Netflix series "Mismatched." Rohit's ability to portray emotions with authenticity and bring depth to his characters has earned him praise from both critics and viewers.

item.title: Ravi Kishan
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Ravi Kishan

Bollywood Male Actor

Ravi Kishan is a popular Bollywood actor known for his versatile performances in Hindi cinema. Born on July 17, 1969, in Jaunpur, Uttar Pradesh, India, Kishan started his acting career in Bhojpuri cinema and later made a successful transition to Bollywood.

 

He has appeared in numerous films, showcasing his talent in both supporting and lead roles. Kishan's notable Bollywood films include "Tere Naam," "Luck," "Mukkabaaz," and "Batla House." He is known for his energetic screen presence and ability to captivate audiences with his performances.

 

Apart from his acting career, Kishan has also ventured into politics and is associated with the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP). He has been an active member of Parliament, representing the Gorakhpur constituency in Uttar Pradesh.

 

Ravi Kishan's charm, versatility, and dedication to his craft have made him a popular and respected figure in Bollywood. He continues to entertain audiences with his powerful performances and remains a prominent presence in the film industry.

item.title: Ranvir Shorey
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Ranvir Shorey

Bollywood Male Actor

Ranvir Shorey is a talented Bollywood actor known for his versatility and strong performances in Hindi cinema. Born on August 18, 1972, in Jalandhar, Punjab, India, Shorey began his career in the entertainment industry with supporting roles in films like "Ek Chhotisi Love Story" and "Jism." However, he gained widespread recognition and critical acclaim for his performances in films like "Bheja Fry," "Khosla Ka Ghosla," and "Pyaar Ke Side Effects."

 

Shorey is known for his impeccable comic timing, natural acting style, and ability to bring depth to his characters. He has the ability to effortlessly switch between intense drama and light-hearted comedy, showcasing his versatility as an actor.

 

Apart from films, Shorey has also appeared in several notable television series and web shows, further expanding his presence in the entertainment industry. He has received several awards and nominations for his outstanding performances, including a Filmfare Award.

item.title: Randeep Hooda
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Randeep Hooda

Bollywood Male Actor

Randeep Hooda is a highly acclaimed Bollywood actor known for his exceptional acting skills and intense portrayals of characters. Born on August 20, 1976, in Rohtak, Haryana, India, Hooda initially began his career in the theater before making his film debut in "Monsoon Wedding" in 2001.

 

Hooda garnered widespread recognition and critical acclaim for his performances in films like "Once Upon a Time in Mumbaai," "Highway," "Sarbjit," and "Laal Rang." He is known for his dedication to his craft and his ability to completely immerse himself in his characters, often undergoing physical transformations to bring authenticity to his roles.

 

With his intense screen presence and versatility, Hooda has captivated audiences with his performances in a range of genres, from gritty dramas to action-packed thrillers. He has earned numerous awards and nominations for his exceptional portrayals.

Beyond his acting career, Hooda is also actively involved in various social and environmental causes. He is known for his love for horses and equestrian sports, and he actively participates in horse riding events.

item.title: Shreyas Talpade
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Shreyas Talpade

Bollywood Male Actor

Shreyas Talpade is a prominent Indian actor who has made a mark in Bollywood with his versatile performances. Born on January 27, 1976, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, Talpade began his acting career in Marathi theater before making his foray into Hindi cinema.

Talpade gained recognition and critical acclaim for his role in the 2005 comedy film, "Iqbal," where he portrayed the role of a deaf and mute aspiring cricketer. His sensitive portrayal of the character earned him widespread praise and established him as a talented actor in the industry. He received the Screen Award for Best Supporting Actor for his performance in the film.

Following his breakthrough, Talpade appeared in several successful films, showcasing his versatility and comedic timing. Some of his notable movies include "Dor," "Welcome to Sajjanpur," and "Golmaal Returns." He has often excelled in comedy roles, delivering memorable performances that have entertained audiences.

Apart from acting, Talpade has also ventured into producing films. He co-produced the Marathi film, "Sanai Choughade," and the Hindi comedy film, "Poshter Boyz," which received positive reviews from critics and audiences alike.

Talpade's talent and dedication to his craft have earned him accolades, including the Zee Cine Award for Best Actor in a Comic Role and the IIFA Award for Best Supporting Actor. His charismatic presence and ability to effortlessly switch between different genres have made him a popular and respected figure in Bollywood.

item.title: Sharman Joshi
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Sharman Joshi

Bollywood Male Actor

Sharman Joshi is a talented Bollywood actor who has garnered immense praise and popularity for his impressive performances in Hindi cinema. Born on March 28, 1979, in Mumbai, India, Sharman comes from a family with a strong theatrical background. He is the son of renowned actor Arvind Joshi and brother of actress Mansi Joshi Roy.

 

Sharman made his acting debut in 1999 with the film "Godmother," but it was his breakthrough role as Raju Rastogi in the iconic film "3 Idiots" (2009) that catapulted him to stardom. His portrayal of the lovable and endearing character won him critical acclaim and a wide fan base.

 

Known for his versatility, Sharman has showcased his acting prowess in a variety of roles. From intense dramas like "Rang De Basanti" and "Ferrari Ki Sawaari" to comedy films like "Golmaal: Fun Unlimited" and "The Legend of Michael Mishra," he has proved his mettle as an actor.

 

Sharman's ability to evoke genuine emotions and connect with the audience has been a hallmark of his performances. His nuanced portrayals and impeccable comic timing have made him a sought-after actor in the industry.

 

Apart from his film career, Sharman has also ventured into theater and made appearances in web series. His dedication to his craft and his ability to bring depth and relatability to his characters have solidified his position as one of the most talented actors in Bollywood.

item.title: Shiney Ahuja
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Shiney Ahuja

Bollywood Male Actor

Shiney Ahuja is a Bollywood actor who rose to fame with his debut film "Hazaaron Khwaishein Aisi" in 2003. Born on May 15, 1973, in Delhi, India, Shiney Ahuja quickly gained recognition for his intense and realistic portrayals.

 

Known for his exceptional acting skills and brooding charm, Shiney Ahuja showcased his talent in films such as "Gangster," "Woh Lamhe," and "Life in a... Metro." He received critical acclaim for his performances and won the Filmfare Award for Best Male Debut for his role in "Hazaaron Khwaishein Aisi."

 

However, Shiney Ahuja's career faced a setback when he was embroiled in a legal controversy in 2009. He was accused of rape, which led to a trial and subsequent conviction. This incident had a significant impact on his career, and he has had limited appearances in films since then.

 

Despite the personal and professional challenges he faced, Shiney Ahuja's talent and performances in his earlier films still hold a place in Bollywood history. His career serves as a reminder of the complexities and challenges faced by individuals in the entertainment industry.

item.title: Shatrughan Sinha
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Shatrughan Sinha

Bollywood Male Actor

Shatrughan Sinha, popularly known as "Shotgun," is a legendary Bollywood actor who has made an indelible mark in the Indian film industry. Born on December 9, 1945, in Patna, Bihar, India, Shatrughan Sinha has had a successful career spanning several decades.

 

Known for his charismatic screen presence and powerful dialogue delivery, Shatrughan Sinha has portrayed a wide range of characters. He has excelled in both positive and negative roles, often playing strong and rebellious characters. Some of his notable films include "Kalicharan," "Dostana," "Vishwanath," and "Shaan."

 

In addition to his acting prowess, Shatrughan Sinha has been actively involved in politics. He has served as a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and held various political positions, including serving as a Member of Parliament.

Shatrughan Sinha's distinct voice and his ability to effortlessly captivate the audience have made him a beloved and respected actor in Bollywood. He has received numerous accolades for his contributions to the industry, including several Filmfare Awards.

item.content:encoded:
Sharad Saxena

Bollywood Male Actor

Sharad Saxena is a celebrated Bollywood actor known for his remarkable performances in Hindi cinema. Born on August 17, 1951, in Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh, India, Sharad Saxena has established himself as a versatile actor with his exceptional acting skills and commanding screen presence.

 

Sharad Saxena made his acting debut in the late 1970s and has since appeared in numerous films. He has portrayed a wide range of characters, from supporting roles to negative and comedic roles, displaying his versatility as an actor. Some of his notable films include "Mr. India," "Ghulam," "Lagaan," and "Baghban."

 

With his powerful screen presence and impactful performances, Sharad Saxena has left a lasting impression on audiences. He is known for his ability to bring depth and authenticity to his characters, whether it's a strict father, a menacing villain, or a comedic sidekick.

 

Apart from his work in Bollywood, Sharad Saxena has also acted in regional cinema and made appearances in television shows and web series. His talent and dedication to his craft have earned him respect and admiration from both critics and fans.

item.title: Sharad Kapoor

item.content:encoded:
Sharad Kapoor

Bollywood Male Actor

Sharad Kapoor is an Indian Bollywood actor who has appeared in several Hindi films. Born on February 13, 1976, in Calcutta (now Kolkata), India, Sharad Kapoor made his acting debut in 1996 with the film "Dastak." He gained recognition for his performances in movies like "Josh," "Tirchhi Topiwale," and "Fareb."

 

Sharad Kapoor is known for his intense and villainous portrayals, often bringing a menacing presence to the screen. However, his acting career faced setbacks, and he took a hiatus from the industry. He made a comeback in the early 2000s but has since appeared in limited projects.

 

While details of his recent activities may be less prominent, Sharad Kapoor's contributions to Bollywood have left an impact on audiences and showcased his talent as an actor.

Bollywood Male Actor

Shiva Rindani, originally known as Mukesh Rindani, is an Indian actor who has primarily worked in Hindi films. With a career spanning several years, he has appeared in over 100 films, predominantly portraying either villainous or comic characters.

 

Some of Shiva Rindani's notable films include "Deshdrohi" (2008), "Hum" (as Captain Attack), and "Ghatak: Lethal." While his filmography may not be as recent, his contributions to the Bollywood industry have left an impact. His ability to portray diverse roles, whether as a menacing antagonist or a comic relief, showcases his versatility as an actor.

Siddhant Chaturvedi

Bollywood Male Actor

Siddhant Chaturvedi is a talented Indian actor who rose to fame with his breakthrough role in the Bollywood movie "Gully Boy." Born on April 29, 1993, in Ballia, Uttar Pradesh, Siddhant Chaturvedi initially pursued a career in modeling before venturing into acting.

 

In 2019, Chaturvedi made his mark in the industry with his portrayal of MC Sher, a charismatic rapper and mentor, in the critically acclaimed film "Gully Boy." Starring alongside Ranveer Singh and Alia Bhatt, Chaturvedi delivered a standout performance that garnered him widespread praise. His natural acting skills and on-screen presence were widely appreciated, earning him accolades and establishing him as a promising talent.

 

"Gully Boy," directed by Zoya Akhtar, revolves around the underground rap scene in Mumbai and tells the story of a young aspiring rapper from the slums. The movie received widespread acclaim for its powerful storytelling, memorable characters, and impactful performances. It became a massive success both critically and commercially, winning numerous awards and representing India as its official entry for the Best International Feature Film category at the 92nd Academy Awards.

 

Following the success of "Gully Boy," Siddhant Chaturvedi has garnered a dedicated fan base and has been flooded with exciting opportunities in the industry. He has since appeared in films like "Bunty Aur Babli 2" and "Phone Bhoot," showcasing his versatility and range as an actor.

item.title: Sikander Kher
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Sikander Kher

Bollywood Male Actor

Sikander Kher is an Indian actor who has made notable contributions to the Bollywood film industry. Born on October 31, 1980, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, Sikander is the son of veteran actors Anupam Kher and Kirron Kher.

 

Kher made his acting debut with the film "Woodstock Villa" in 2008, where he portrayed the lead role. Though the film did not achieve commercial success, Sikander's performance received appreciation from critics for his portrayal of a complex character. He later appeared in films like "Khelein Hum Jee Jaan Sey" and "Players," showcasing his acting skills.

 

Known for his versatility, Sikander Kher has worked in both films and web series. He has been part of acclaimed web series like "Aarya," where he played a pivotal role alongside Sushmita Sen. His portrayal of a cunning and unpredictable character in the series received praise from audiences and critics alike.

 

While Sikander Kher's filmography may not be extensive, he has managed to leave an impression with his performances. With his lineage and dedication to his craft, he continues to explore diverse roles, proving his mettle as an actor in the industry.

item.title: Sohail Khan
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Sohail Khan

Bollywood Male Actor

Sohail Khan, born on December 20, 1970, is an Indian actor, writer, film director, and producer who primarily works in Hindi cinema. He is the younger brother of actors Salman Khan and Arbaaz Khan and the son of screenwriter Salim Khan and Salma Khan. Sohail Khan produces films under his banner Sohail Khan Productions.

 

Born in Mumbai to a Muslim father and a Maharashtrian mother, Sohail Khan comes from a film-oriented family. His stepmother is actress Helen, and his sister Alvira Khan is married to Bollywood director Atul Agnihotri. Sohail has two elder brothers, Salman Khan and Arbaaz Khan, who are also prominent actors in the industry. His younger sister, Arpita Khan, has worked with Sneha Ullal in a film produced by Sohail Khan Productions. Arpita is married to actor Aayush Sharma.

 

Sohail Khan began his career in the film industry as a producer and director. He made his directorial debut with the action thriller "Auzaar" in 1997, which starred his brother Salman Khan and Sanjay Kapoor. He went on to direct his brothers in films like "Pyaar Kiya To Darna Kya" (1998) and "Hello Brother" (1999). In 2002, Sohail wrote, produced, directed, and made his acting debut in "Maine Dil Tujhko Diya," which had an average performance at the box office.

 

Although he appeared in several more films, Sohail Khan faced limited success as an actor. His breakthrough came with the film "Maine Pyaar Kyun Kiya?" (2005), where he co-starred with his brother Salman Khan. Sohail also produced the multi-starrer "Fight Club - Members Only," but it did not perform well commercially. In 2007, he produced the successful film "Partner," starring Salman Khan and Govinda. Sohail has also produced live stage shows featuring Indian film stars and ventured into television with "Chehre Pe Chehra."

 

Sohail Khan returned to directing with the films "Jai Ho" (2014), starring Salman Khan, and "Freaky Ali" (2016), starring Nawazuddin Siddiqui. He made his acting comeback after seven years in the film "Tubelight" (2017), alongside his brother Salman Khan.

item.title: Sonu Sood
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Sonu Sood

Bollywood Male Actor

Sonu Sood, born on July 30, 1973, is an Indian actor, film producer, model, humanitarian, and philanthropist. He primarily works in Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, and Kannada films. Sood has received numerous awards and accolades for his performances, including the Andhra Pradesh State Nandi Award for Best Villain and the Filmfare Award for Best Supporting Actor - Telugu for his role in the Telugu film "Arundhati" (2009).

 

He gained further recognition with his negative roles in films like "Dabangg" (2010), for which he won the Apsara Award for Best Actor in a Negative Role and the IIFA Award for Best Performance in a Negative Role. Some of his notable works include "Yuva" (2004), "Athadu" (2005), "Jodhaa Akbar" (2008), "Shootout at Wadala" (2013), "Simmba" (2018), and "Kurukshetra" (2019).

 

Apart from his acting career, Sonu Sood has ventured into film production with his production house called Shakti Sagar Productions, which he established in 2016. He has also appeared in commercials for brands like Apollo Tyres and Airtel.

 

During the COVID-19 pandemic, Sood gained widespread recognition for his humanitarian efforts. He helped thousands of migrant workers and other people in need by arranging transportation, providing meals, and supporting healthcare services. In recognition of his philanthropic work, he was honored with the ‛SDG Special Humanitarian Action Award’ by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) in 2020.

 

In June 2022, Sonu Sood launched his own social media app called Explurger.

Sood completed his education at Sacred Heart School in Moga and Yeshwantrao Chavan College of Engineering (YCCE) in Nagpur.

item.title: Sooraj Pancholi
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Sooraj Pancholi

Bollywood Male Actor

Sooraj Pancholi, born on November 9, 1990, is an Indian actor known for his work in Hindi-language films. He is the son of Bollywood actors Aditya Pancholi and Zarina Wahab. Pancholi made his acting debut in 2015 with the romantic action film "Hero," for which he received the Filmfare Award for Best Newcomer in 2016.

 

Before stepping into acting, Sooraj worked as an assistant director on films like "Guzaarish" and "Ek Tha Tiger." After his successful debut in "Hero," he appeared in the film "Satellite Shankar" in 2019, portraying the role of a soldier. He has also been cast in the upcoming Indian dance film "Time to Dance." In addition to his film roles, Sooraj has appeared in music videos such as "GF BF" (2016) and "Dim Dim Lights" (2019).

 

Sooraj Pancholi's personal life has been marred by controversy. He was arrested in 2013 after actress Jiah Khan, with whom he was in a relationship, died by suicide. Jiah's suicide note mentioned their strained relationship as a contributing factor to her decision. In 2018, Pancholi was formally charged with abetting the suicide. However, he denied any involvement in her death, stating that he was being made a scapegoat. Jiah's family believed that Sooraj was responsible for their daughter's death.

item.title: Tahir Raj Bhasin
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Tahir Raj Bhasin

Bollywood Male Actor

Tahir Raj Bhasin, born on April 21, 1987, is an Indian actor who primarily works in Hindi films. He was born in New Delhi and holds a master's degree in media from the University of Melbourne.

 

Tahir Raj Bhasin made his screen debut with a small role in the film "Kismat Love Paisa Dilli" in 2012. He also made brief appearances in films like "Kai Po Che!" (2013) and "One by Two" (2014). However, his official film debut came with "Mardaani" in 2014, where he played the role of a human trafficking kingpin. His performance in the film earned him a Filmfare Award nomination for Best Supporting Actor and a Screen Award for Best Actor in a Negative Role. He also portrayed the antagonist in "Force 2" and gained further popularity with the film "Chhichhore" (2019), which was a blockbuster hit. In "83" (2021), he portrayed the legendary cricketer Sunil Gavaskar.

 

During his school days, Tahir Raj Bhasin participated in various extracurricular activities and played basketball. He developed an interest in acting at a young age and underwent training at the Barry John Acting School. He studied political science at Hindu College, University of Delhi, and further honed his acting skills through workshops and training programs with notable personalities such as Aamir Raza Hussain and Naseeruddin Shah. He also holds a master's degree in media from the University of Melbourne.

 

Tahir Raj Bhasin committed to acting professionally in 2012 and appeared in short films and television advertisements before making his mark in Bollywood. His breakthrough role in "Mardaani" brought him critical acclaim and established him as a talented actor. He has since appeared in notable films like "Force 2," "Chhichhore," and "83."

 

In addition to his acting career, Tahir Raj Bhasin has been actively involved in charitable work. He has supported organizations like Smile Foundation and has participated in events like "Ramp For Champs" to raise funds for girls' education.

item.title: Tej Sapru
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Tej Sapru

Bollywood Male Actor

Tej Sapru, born on January 5, 1955, is an Indian actor known for his work in Bollywood films and television series. He comes from a family with a strong presence in the Hindi film industry. His parents, D. K. Sapru and Hemvati, were both actors.

 

Tej Sapru has appeared in numerous Bollywood films from the 1980s to the 2010s. Some of his notable film credits include "Gupt," "Mohra," "Sirf Tum," and "Saajan." He has portrayed diverse characters in these movies, showcasing his acting skills.

 

In addition to his film work, Tej Sapru has also made a mark in the television industry. He has been part of popular television series such as "Qubool Hai," "Saat Phere," "Yahan Main Ghar Ghar Kheli," and "The Zee Horror Show." His performances in these shows have garnered him recognition and a loyal fan base.

 

Tej Sapru's sisters, Priti Sapru and Reema Rakesh Nath, are also well-known personalities in the entertainment industry. Priti Sapru is an actress who has worked in Punjabi and Hindi cinema, while Reema Rakesh Nath is a screenwriter.

 

Tej Sapru is married to Dhanlaxmi, who happens to be the maternal half-sister of renowned actress Rekha. This connection further ties him to the film industry and adds to his family's legacy in Indian cinema.

item.title: Tinnu Anand
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Tinu Anand

Bollywood Male Actor

Tinu Anand, born as Virender Raj Anand on 12 October 1945, is an Indian actor, director, writer, and producer in Hindi cinema, as well as a few Telugu and Tamil films. He comes from a film-oriented family, being the son of veteran writer Inder Raj Anand, the brother of producer Bittu Anand, and the uncle of director Siddharth Anand. Tinu Anand attended Mayo College in India for his schooling. He is married to Shahnaz, the daughter of veteran actor Agha.

 

Despite his father's initial reluctance for him to enter the film industry, Tinu Anand pursued his passion for filmmaking. His father wanted him to choose a different path, believing that the film industry was not suitable for his sons. However, after realizing Tinu's determination, his father sent him to the Satyajit Ray School, where he learned the art of filmmaking under the guidance of renowned filmmaker Satyajit Ray. Tinu Anand had initially been offered a role in K. Abbas' film "Saat Hindustani," but he had to give it up when he received an opportunity to work with Satyajit Ray. As a result, the role went to Amitabh Bachchan, who was just starting his acting career at the time.

 

Tinu Anand also worked as an assistant director to Satyajit Ray for five years, assisting him in several Bengali films, including "Goopy Gyne Bagha Byne" (1969), "Aranyer Din Ratri" (1970), "Pratidwandi" (1970), "Seemabaddha" (1971), and "Ashani Sanket" (1973).

 

In his acting career, Tinu Anand played a significant role in the film "Ghajini" in 2008. In interviews, he has shared anecdotes from his early days in the industry and has praised Amitabh Bachchan for his generosity and support.

Tinu Anand attended Mayo College in India for his schooling. He is married to Shahnaz, the daughter of veteran actor Agha.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Despite his father's initial reluctance for him to enter the film industry, Tinu Anand pursued his passion for filmmaking. His father wanted him to choose a different path, believing that the film industry was not suitable for his sons. However, after realizing Tinu's determination, his father sent him to the Satyajit Ray School, where he learned the art of filmmaking under the guidance of renowned filmmaker Satyajit Ray. Tinu Anand had initially been offered a role in K. Abbas' film \"Saat Hindustani,\" but he had to give it up when he received an opportunity to work with Satyajit Ray. As a result, the role went to Amitabh Bachchan, who was just starting his acting career at the time.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Tinu Anand also worked as an assistant director to Satyajit Ray for five years, assisting him in several Bengali films, including \"Goopy Gyne Bagha Byne\" (1969), \"Aranyer Din Ratri\" (1970), \"Pratidwandi\" (1970), \"Seemabaddha\" (1971), and \"Ashani Sanket\" (1973).<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

In his acting career, Tinu Anand played a significant role in the film \"Ghajini\" in 2008. In interviews, he has shared anecdotes from his early days in the industry and has praised Amitabh Bachchan for his generosity and support.<\/p>","typography_typography":"custom","typography_font_weight":"bold"},"elements":[],"widgetType":"text-editor"}],"isInner":false}],"isInner":false},{"id":"da07233","elType":"section","settings":{"background_background":"classic","background_color":"#EAF0EE8F","hover_parallax":[{"layer_position_vr":{"unit":"%","size":30},"layer_position_hr":{"unit":"%","size":40},"_id":"ac4fb18"},{"layer_position_vr":{"unit":"%","size":60},"layer_position_hr":{"unit":"%","size":20},"_id":"a1b2b38"}]},"elements":[{"id":"a58bce5","elType":"column","settings":{"_column_size":100,"_inline_size":null},"elements":[{"id":"bebe1d8","elType":"widget","settings":{"title":"Enquiry Form","header_size":"h3","align":"center","typography_typography":"custom","typography_font_size":{"unit":"px","size":40,"sizes":[]},"typography_font_weight":"bold","_margin":{"unit":"px","top":"40","right":"0","bottom":"20","left":"0","isLinked":false},"__globals__":{"title_color":"globals\/colors?id=6d3d44f9"}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"heading"},{"id":"f2b8d3d","elType":"widget","settings":{"shortcode":"[forminator_form id=\"5483\"]","_margin":{"unit":"px","top":"0","right":"0","bottom":"40","left":"0","isLinked":false}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"shortcode"}],"isInner":false}],"isInner":false}]

item.title: Tanmay Dhanania
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Tanmay Dhanania

Bollywood Male Actor

Tanmay Dhanania is an Indian actor who was born in Calcutta. He pursued his education in Nuclear Engineering at the University of California, Berkeley, before undergoing formal training as an actor at the Royal Academy of Dramatic Art (RADA).

 

He has appeared in various notable projects across film and web series. In the TV series "Indian Summers" (2015), he portrayed the character Naseem Ali Khan. He also played the role of Ajay in the film "Brahman Naman" (2016), which premiered in competition at the Sundance Film Festival. This film holds the distinction of being India's first Netflix Original.

 

Tanmay Dhanania portrayed Prince Jeejeebuoy in the TV series "The Durrells of Corfu" and Phanishwar in the film "Garbage," which premiered at the 68th Berlinale and is available on Netflix.

 

He appeared in the film "Cat Sticks," which won the Jury Award at the Slamdance Film Festival in 2019 and is available on Mubi. Tanmay Dhanania played the lead role in the film "Nazarband" (Captive), which premiered at the Busan International Film Festival in 2020. His performance in this film earned him a nomination for the Best Actor award at the New York Indian Film Festival in 2021.

 

He also appeared in the film "The Rapist" by Aparna Sen, which premiered at the Busan International Film Festival in 2021 and won the Kim Jiseok Award. Additionally, Tanmay Dhanania made his Malayalam feature film debut with "Nishiddho" (Forbidden), which won the KR Mohanan Award at the International Film Festival of Kerala. His performance in the film garnered him his second Best Actor nomination.

item.title: Taaruk Raina
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Taaruk Raina

Bollywood Male Actor

Taaruk Raina is an Indian actor, singer, songwriter, and composer. He started his career as Aditya Chopra's assistant at Yash Raj Films, working on the film "Befikre" in 2015. He then ventured into theater and played the lead character in an Indian adaptation of Disney's "Aladdin" in 2018, showcasing his acting and singing skills in front of a live audience.

 

In 2018, Raina made his film debut with "High Jack" and subsequently appeared in ZEE5's "Dhumrapaan" and "Kaand" in 2019. In February 2020, he starred in MX Player's relationship drama "Pawan & Pooja" as the character Pawan. He also featured in the short film "Purple" in June 2020.

 

From November 2020, Taaruk Raina portrayed the character Anmol Malhotra in the Netflix teenage romantic drama "Mismatched." He not only acted in the series but also contributed two songs to its soundtrack. He further appeared in the music video "Sukoon" by Sony Music India, featuring himself opposite Aisha Ahmed.

 

In 2021, Raina appeared in the Netflix mini-series "Aryan & Meera" as the character Aryan, starring alongside Zayn Marie Khan. In 2022, he was seen in ZEE5's "The Broken News" and Amazon Prime Video's "Jugaadistan." He also played Rishi Kapoor's son, Vinayak Sharma, in the film "Sharmaji Namkeen."

item.title: Tanuj Virwani
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Tanuj Virwani

Bollywood Male Actor

Tanuj Virwani is a talented Indian actor and model who has made a mark in the Bollywood industry. He is best known for his portrayal of Vayu Raghavan in the Amazon Original television series "Inside Edge," which garnered him significant recognition. Throughout his career, Tanuj has appeared in several successful web series and films, showcasing his versatility and acting prowess.

 

As the son of veteran actress Rati Agnihotri, Tanuj comes from a family with a strong connection to the entertainment industry. He made his Bollywood debut with the film "Luv U Soniyo" in 2013, directed by Joe Rajan. He went on to appear in the film "Purani Jeans" in 2014, opposite Izabelle Leite and Aditya Seal, further establishing his presence in the industry.

 

Tanuj's digital journey began with the critically acclaimed and Emmy-nominated series "Inside Edge" in 2017. He then continued his success on the digital platform with shows like "Poison" on ZEE5 and "Code M" on Alt Balaji, opposite Jennifer Winget. He has also delved into direction and writing, creating several socially relevant short films.

 

In addition to his web series success, Tanuj Virwani has appeared in Bollywood films like "One Night Stand" alongside Sunny Leone, which released in 2016.

His career further expanded to various streaming platforms, including Disney+ Hotstar, where he played notable roles in series like "The Tattoo Murders" and "Murder Meri Jaan." Tanuj also displayed his versatility by taking on negative roles, as seen in the crime thriller "Tandoor," opposite Rashami Desai.

item.title: Tushar Pandey
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Tushar Pandey

Bollywood Male Actor

Tushar Pandey, born on November 22, 1991, is a prominent Indian actor primarily recognized for his contributions to Bollywood. With a strong foundation in acting education, he is notable for his role as Mummy in the 2019 film "Chhichhore." His acting journey began in 2015 with the psychological thriller "Beyond Blue: An Unnerving Tale of a Demented Mind," which made its debut at the Cannes Film Festival's Marché du Film.

 

Growing up in Delhi, Tushar's passion for the performing arts was ignited during his school days at Montfort Senior Secondary School. He actively participated in stage plays, music, and sports competitions. After completing school, he secured admission to Kirori Mal College, majoring in English (H), through the special theater admission process. He became a member of the college's theater society, 'The Players.'

 

His formal training in acting commenced at the esteemed National School of Drama, an institution renowned throughout Asia for its theater education. Additionally, he received advanced training in physical theater from the London International School of Performing Arts, earning an Inlaks Shivadasani Foundation International Scholarship.

 

Tushar's acting career debuted with a minor role in the film "Rang De Basanti," where he portrayed a student auditioning for a documentary role. He gained recognition for his supporting role in the acclaimed 2016 film "Pink," sharing the screen with Amitabh Bachchan and Taapsee Pannu. In 2019, he was introduced as the lead in Rajshri Productions' youth-oriented film "Hum Chaar."

 

However, Tushar's breakthrough came in the same year with the film "Chhichhore," directed by Nitesh Tiwari. Starring alongside actors like Sushant Singh Rajput and Shraddha Kapoor, the film received widespread acclaim and emerged as one of the year's biggest hits.

Tushar Pandey, born on November 22, 1991, is a prominent Indian actor primarily recognized for his contributions to Bollywood. With a strong foundation in acting education, he is notable for his role as Mummy in the 2019 film \"Chhichhore.\" His acting journey began in 2015 with the psychological thriller \"Beyond Blue: An Unnerving Tale of a Demented Mind,\" which made its debut at the Cannes Film Festival's March\u00e9 du Film.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Growing up in Delhi, Tushar's passion for the performing arts was ignited during his school days at Montfort Senior Secondary School. He actively participated in stage plays, music, and sports competitions. After completing school, he secured admission to Kirori Mal College, majoring in English (H), through the special theater admission process. He became a member of the college's theater society, 'The Players.'<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

His formal training in acting commenced at the esteemed National School of Drama, an institution renowned throughout Asia for its theater education. Additionally, he received advanced training in physical theater from the London International School of Performing Arts, earning an Inlaks Shivadasani Foundation International Scholarship.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Tushar's acting career debuted with a minor role in the film \"Rang De Basanti,\" where he portrayed a student auditioning for a documentary role. He gained recognition for his supporting role in the acclaimed 2016 film \"Pink,\" sharing the screen with Amitabh Bachchan and Taapsee Pannu. In 2019, he was introduced as the lead in Rajshri Productions' youth-oriented film \"Hum Chaar.\"<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

However, Tushar's breakthrough came in the same year with the film \"Chhichhore,\" directed by Nitesh Tiwari. Starring alongside actors like Sushant Singh Rajput and Shraddha Kapoor, the film received widespread acclaim and emerged as one of the year's biggest hits.<\/p>","typography_typography":"custom","typography_font_weight":"bold"},"elements":[],"widgetType":"text-editor"}],"isInner":false}],"isInner":false},{"id":"ae1d051","elType":"section","settings":{"background_background":"classic","background_color":"#EAF0EE8F","hover_parallax":[{"layer_position_vr":{"unit":"%","size":30},"layer_position_hr":{"unit":"%","size":40},"_id":"ac4fb18"},{"layer_position_vr":{"unit":"%","size":60},"layer_position_hr":{"unit":"%","size":20},"_id":"a1b2b38"}]},"elements":[{"id":"d090eba","elType":"column","settings":{"_column_size":100,"_inline_size":null},"elements":[{"id":"4ea4ee6","elType":"widget","settings":{"title":"Enquiry Form","header_size":"h3","align":"center","typography_typography":"custom","typography_font_size":{"unit":"px","size":40,"sizes":[]},"typography_font_weight":"bold","_margin":{"unit":"px","top":"40","right":"0","bottom":"20","left":"0","isLinked":false},"__globals__":{"title_color":"globals\/colors?id=6d3d44f9"}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"heading"},{"id":"093ef92","elType":"widget","settings":{"shortcode":"[forminator_form id=\"5483\"]","_margin":{"unit":"px","top":"0","right":"0","bottom":"40","left":"0","isLinked":false}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"shortcode"}],"isInner":false}],"isInner":false}]

item.title: Upen Patel
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Upen Patel

Bollywood Male Actor

Upen Patel, born on 16 August 1982, is an Indian actor and model primarily known for his work in Bollywood. He has also participated in various television reality shows, including Bigg Boss 8 and Nach Baliye 7, and co-hosted MTV Love School with Karishma Tanna.

Upen Patel was born in India and belongs to a Gujarati family. However, he grew up in London, England. In terms of his personal life, he dated actress Karishma Tanna from 2014 to 2016.

 

Upen Patel made his Bollywood debut in May 2006 with the film "36 China Town," directed by Abbas-Mustan. He gained further recognition with his role in "Namastey London" (2007), where he portrayed a Pakistani Muslim living in London. In April 2007, he appeared in the film "Shakalaka Boom Boom," which was produced and directed by Suneel Darshan. He also had roles in movies like "Money Hai Toh Honey Hai" and "One Two Three" in 2008. In November 2009, he appeared in "Ajab Prem Ki Ghazab Kahani." Patel expanded his acting career to the Tamil film industry with his debut in the movie "I" in January 2015, directed by S. Shankar.

 

Apart from acting, Upen Patel worked as a host for the weekly cooking show "Cook Na Kaho" until March 2005 when he was replaced by Shayan Munshi. He also participated in the reality TV show "Bigg Boss" with the intention of boosting his career. Upen Patel was a contestant on Nach Baliye 7, a dance reality show produced by Ekta Kapoor under the banner of Balaji Telefilms, along with Karishma Tanna. They reached the finals of the show.

item.title: Varun Sharma
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Varun Sharma

Bollywood Male Actor

Varun Sharma is a popular Bollywood actor known for his impeccable comic timing and vibrant performances. He was born on February 4, 1990, in Jalandhar, Punjab, India. Varun made his acting debut with the blockbuster film "Fukrey" in 2013, where he played the role of Choocha, a lovable and quirky character. His portrayal of Choocha received widespread acclaim and established him as a promising talent in the industry.

 

Varun's unique ability to bring life to comic characters with his impeccable dialogue delivery and natural flair for comedy has earned him a special place in the hearts of the audience. He has since appeared in several successful films, including "Dilwale" (2015), "Fukrey Returns" (2017), and "Chhichhore" (2019), showcasing his versatility as an actor.

 

With his infectious energy and exceptional comic timing, Varun has carved a niche for himself in the comedy genre. His on-screen presence and ability to evoke laughter have made him a sought-after actor for comedy films in Bollywood.

item.title: Vijay Varma
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Vijay Varma

Bollywood Male Actor

Vijay Varma is an Indian actor known for his work in Hindi cinema. He gained recognition for his role in the film "Pink" in 2016 and has since appeared in several critically acclaimed projects.

 

Born on March 29, 1986, Vijay Varma comes from a Marwari family settled in Hyderabad, Telangana. He studied at the Film and Television Institute of India (FTII).

 

Varma began his acting career in theater in Hyderabad before pursuing formal training in acting at FTII in Pune for two years. After completing his postgraduate course, he moved to Mumbai to seek opportunities in the acting industry.

 

His first acting job was in the short film "Shor," directed by Raj Nidimoru and Krishna DK. The film received critical acclaim and won the Best Short Film award at the MIAAC festival in New York. Varma's performance in the critically acclaimed film "Pink" further established his talent and earned him recognition.

 

Following his success in "Pink," Vijay Varma went on to appear in notable projects such as "MCA," "Gully Boy," "Baaghi 3," "Darlings," and the web series "Mirzapur" and "She." He has been praised for his performances in these roles, showcasing his versatility and acting prowess.

item.title: Vikrant Massey
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Vikrant Massey

Bollywood Male Actor

Vikrant Massey is an Indian actor known for his work in Hindi television, films, and web series. He made his debut in the acting industry with the role of Aamir Hassan in the television show "Dhoom Machaao Dhoom." He gained popularity through his roles in TV shows like "Dharam Veer," "Baba Aiso Varr Dhoondo," and "Qubool Hai."

 

Massey ventured into films with his debut in the movie "Lootera" in 2013, directed by Vikramaditya Motwane. He then appeared in supporting roles in films like "Dil Dhadakne Do" and "Half Girlfriend." However, he garnered critical acclaim for his lead performances in "A Death in the Gunj" and "Chhapaak."

 

Apart from his work in films, Vikrant Massey has also made a mark in the web series space. He gained recognition for his roles in popular web series such as "Mirzapur" and "Broken But Beautiful." He has also appeared in web series like "Criminal Justice" and "Made In Heaven."

 

Massey has been part of various television commercials and has worked as a choreographer on the show "Dhoom Machaao Dhoom." He is also a trained modern contemporary dancer and has worked with renowned choreographer Shiamak Davar.

 

In his personal life, Vikrant Massey is married to actress Sheetal Thakur. They got engaged in 2019 and tied the knot in 2022.

item.title: Vinay Pathak
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Vinay Pathak

Bollywood Male Actor

Vinay Pathak is an Indian theater and film actor known for his work in Hindi cinema. He has appeared in numerous films, including notable ones like "Khosla Ka Ghosla," "Bheja Fry," "Island City," and "Johnny Gaddaar." He has also had supporting roles in movies such as "Jism," "Rab Ne Bana Di Jodi," and "My Name is Khan."

 

Born on July 27, 1968, in the Bhojpur district of Bihar, India, Vinay Pathak spent his early years in Dhanbad as his father was posted in the police department. He attended Vikas Vidyalaya, a boarding school in Ranchi, until 1982. After completing his graduation from Allahabad University, he moved to the United States for higher studies. During his time at the State University of New York at Stony Brook, he had various acting roles and gained experience in comedies like "Khosla Ka Ghosla" and "Bheja Fry."

In 1999, Pathak played the role of Vinny in the television series "Hip Hip Hurray." He also ventured into film production and produced the movie "Dasvidaniya," which depicted the story of a common man bidding farewell before dying.

Pathak has been associated with several television shows as a host and anchor. He co-hosted the talk show "Ranvir Vinay Aur Kaun?" with his close friend Ranvir Shorey. Together, they also anchored shows like "House Arrest," "Duniya Goal Hain," and "Cricket Crazy." Pathak was part of the gag-based show "The Great Indian Comedy Show," alongside Ranvir Shorey, Suresh Menon, and Gaurav Gera.

In addition to his television work, Pathak has acted in various films, including "Johnny Gaddaar," "Aaja Nachle," "Khoya Khoya Chand," "Rab Ne Bana Di Jodi," and "Antardwand."

item.title: Vishwajeet Pradhan
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Vishwajeet Pradhan

Bollywood Male Actor

Vishwajeet Pradhan is an Indian actor known for his work in Bollywood films, theater, and television. He was born on September 11, 1965, in Meerut, Uttar Pradesh.

 

One incident that occurred on the sets of the film "No Problem" involved a major fire breaking out during the shooting of a crucial action sequence in the middle of the sea. Pradhan was in a scene where he was supposed to portray panic over the fire and save himself. However, he actually caught fire and suffered a leg injury. Initially, everyone thought it was part of his act and praised his acting skills, but once they realized the seriousness of the situation, prompt action was taken to save him. Sunil Shetty also suffered burns on his hands during the incident.

 

Another incident took place on the sets of "Rakht Charitra." Pradhan was shooting the film's climax sequence where his character was supposed to be shot dead. However, the blast in the shot was so intense that he received a large cut along his jawline, requiring surgery. He was admitted to the emergency ward and later underwent reconstructive plastic surgery to conceal the scar. The blast scene went wrong, causing a powerful impact that hit the actor's face and left him bleeding.

item.title: Vivan Bhatena
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Vivan Bhatena

Bollywood Male Actor

Vivan Bhatena is an Indian model and actor known for his work in Hindi films. He was born on October 28, 1978.

Bhatena started his career as a model and gained recognition by winning the Mister India World title in 2001. He then transitioned to acting, making his television debut with the role of Abhishek, Tulsi Virani's son-in-law, in the popular show "Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi." He subsequently appeared in television series such as "Maayka," "Kumkum - Ek Pyara Sa Bandhan," and "Pyaar Ka Bandhan."

 

In addition to his television work, Bhatena has also ventured into the film industry. He has appeared in notable Hindi films including "Dangal" (2016), "Judwaa 2" (2017), and "Raja the Great" (2017).

 

In 2016, he participated as a contestant on the reality show "Fear Factor: Khatron Ke Khiladi 7."

Bhatena has also made appearances in music videos, including Falguni Pathak's popular video "Maine Payal Hain Chhankai."

item.title: Vivek Mushran
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Vivek Mushran

Bollywood Male Actor

Vivek Mushran is an Indian actor, born on August 9, 1969.

He began his acting career in 1991 with the Hindi movie "Saudagar," which became a blockbuster. Since then, he has appeared in various films, including "Ram Jaane," "Aisi Bhi Kya Jaldi Hai" directed by Sachin, "First Love Letter," and "Anjaane."

 

Mushran has also worked in television. He starred in the popular STAR Plus sitcom "Son Pari" and the Zee TV serial "Kittie Party." He was also seen in the Sony TV serials "Bhaskar Bharti" and "Baat Hamari Pakki Hai," as well as the Doordarshan TV serial "Ae Dil-E-Naadaan." In recent years, he appeared in the Sony TV serial "Parvarrish – Kuchh Khattee Kuchh Meethi" and played the role of Saachi's uncle in "Baat Hamari Pakki Hai."

 

Mushran has also showcased his singing talent and released an album titled "Kahin Kho Gaya," where he sang songs.

 

His latest television role was in the serial "Nisha Aur Uske Cousins," where he portrayed the father of the main character. He has also played the role of Vikramjeet Singh in the Sony TV series "Main Maike Chali Jaungi Tum Dekhte Rahiyo."

Vivek Mushran is an Indian actor, born on August 9, 1969.<\/p>

He began his acting career in 1991 with the Hindi movie \"Saudagar,\" which became a blockbuster. Since then, he has appeared in various films, including \"Ram Jaane,\" \"Aisi Bhi Kya Jaldi Hai\" directed by Sachin, \"First Love Letter,\" and \"Anjaane.\"<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Mushran has also worked in television. He starred in the popular STAR Plus sitcom \"Son Pari\" and the Zee TV serial \"Kittie Party.\" He was also seen in the Sony TV serials \"Bhaskar Bharti\" and \"Baat Hamari Pakki Hai,\" as well as the Doordarshan TV serial \"Ae Dil-E-Naadaan.\" In recent years, he appeared in the Sony TV serial \"Parvarrish \u2013 Kuchh Khattee Kuchh Meethi\" and played the role of Saachi's uncle in \"Baat Hamari Pakki Hai.\"<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Mushran has also showcased his singing talent and released an album titled \"Kahin Kho Gaya,\" where he sang songs.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

His latest television role was in the serial \"Nisha Aur Uske Cousins,\" where he portrayed the father of the main character. He has also played the role of Vikramjeet Singh in the Sony TV series \"Main Maike Chali Jaungi Tum Dekhte Rahiyo.\"<\/p>","typography_typography":"custom","typography_font_weight":"bold"},"elements":[],"widgetType":"text-editor"}],"isInner":false}],"isInner":false},{"id":"bd90fa6","elType":"section","settings":{"background_background":"classic","background_color":"#EAF0EE8F","hover_parallax":[{"layer_position_vr":{"unit":"%","size":30},"layer_position_hr":{"unit":"%","size":40},"_id":"ac4fb18"},{"layer_position_vr":{"unit":"%","size":60},"layer_position_hr":{"unit":"%","size":20},"_id":"a1b2b38"}]},"elements":[{"id":"9d14a93","elType":"column","settings":{"_column_size":100,"_inline_size":null},"elements":[{"id":"f6d99fa","elType":"widget","settings":{"title":"Enquiry Form","header_size":"h3","align":"center","typography_typography":"custom","typography_font_size":{"unit":"px","size":40,"sizes":[]},"typography_font_weight":"bold","_margin":{"unit":"px","top":"40","right":"0","bottom":"20","left":"0","isLinked":false},"__globals__":{"title_color":"globals\/colors?id=6d3d44f9"}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"heading"},{"id":"541a147","elType":"widget","settings":{"shortcode":"[forminator_form id=\"5483\"]","_margin":{"unit":"px","top":"0","right":"0","bottom":"40","left":"0","isLinked":false}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"shortcode"}],"isInner":false}],"isInner":false}]

item.title: Vineet kumar singh
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Vineet Kumar Singh

Bollywood Male Actor

Vineet Kumar Singh is an Indian actor and writer born on August 28, 1978, in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh. He comes from a Rajput family and had a keen interest in sports, particularly basketball, in which he played at the national level. Vineet initially wanted to join the National School of Drama, but due to parental pressure and societal norms, he pursued a career in medicine.

 

He obtained his Bachelor of Ayurveda, Medicine, and Surgery degree from R. A. Podar Ayurved Medical College and went on to earn an MD (Doctor of Medicine) in Ayurveda from Government Medical College and Hospital, Nagpur. Vineet is a licensed medical practitioner and had a successful career in the field.

 

However, his passion for acting led him to Mumbai, where he participated in the Superstars Talent Hunt. He won the competition, which caught the attention of actor-director Mahesh Manjrekar, who offered him a role in the film "Pitaah" starring Sanjay Dutt. Despite the film's poor reception, Vineet faced difficulties in securing further roles.

 

He then worked as an associate/assistant director for Mahesh Manjrekar in films like "Viruddh" (2005) and "Deh." In 2007, Vineet decided to focus solely on acting. He appeared in Bhojpuri serials and had minor roles in films like "Gori Tere Pyaar Mein" and "Isaaq." However, his breakthrough came with the Hindi-Marathi bilingual film "City of Gold" (2010).

 

Director Anurag Kashyap cast Vineet in the role of Danish Khan in "Gangs of Wasseypur," which further established his presence in the industry. He went on to act in films like "Ugly" and "Bombay Talkies" (2013). Vineet's performance in "Ugly" earned him a Screen nomination for Best Supporting Actor. He also appeared in commercials for Birla Sunlife and 7up Nimbooz.

 

In 2016, Vineet acted opposite Raima Sen in the film "Bollywood Diaries," directed by K.D. Satyam. However, his breakthrough as a lead actor came with Anurag Kashyap's film "Mukkabaaz" (2018), in which he portrayed the role of an aspiring boxer named Shravan Kumar Singh. Vineet underwent intense training for two years to prepare for the role. His performance in "Mukkabaaz" earned him critical acclaim and he won two awards for his portrayal.

item.title: Vindu Dara Singh
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Vindu Dara Singh

Bollywood Male Actor

Vindu Dara Singh, born Virender Singh Randhawa on May 6, 1964, is an Indian actor known for his work in Hindi and Punjabi television and films. He gained widespread recognition after winning the third season of the reality TV show Bigg Boss. Prior to this, he portrayed the role of Lord Hanuman in the television series Jai Veer Hanuman on Sony TV in 1996.

 

Vindu made his acting debut in the 1994 Hindi film "Karan" and later appeared in the Punjabi film "Rab Dian Rakhan" in 1996, directed by his father. Throughout his career, he has predominantly played supporting roles in numerous films.

In addition to his film work, Vindu has also acted in various television serials. He portrayed the character of Hanuman in the TV series "Jai Veer Hanuman," a role similar to the one his father played in Ramayan. He also played supervillain roles in TV serials like "Ssshhhh...Koi Hai" (2003) and "Karma" (2004) on Star Plus. He gained recognition for his portrayal of Rajiv, a medium with the ability to connect with spirits, in the serial "Black" on 9X.

 

Vindu Dara Singh has made appearances in several television shows, including "Master Chef 2," "Zor ka Jhatka," "Nach Baliye," "Comedy Circus," "All Most Famous," and "Maa Exchange." He even appeared in a Pepsi commercial alongside Ranbir Kapoor.

His notable film credits include "Garv," "Maine Pyaar Kyun Kiya," "Partner," "Khushboo," "Team - The Force," "Kisse Pyaar Karoon," "Kambakkht Ishq," "Maruti," "Mujhse Shaadi Karogi," "Son of Sardaar," "Jatt James Bond," "The Lion of Punjab," "Housefull," and "Housefull 2."

 

Vindu Dara Singh's victory on Bigg Boss 3 in 2009 was a significant milestone in his career. He was praised as the most stylish and bold contestant, winning both the cash prize and a Chevrolet Cruze car, a first in the show's history. His housemates affectionately gave him the title "Bade dil wala" (man with a golden heart).

Yatin Karyekar

Bollywood Male Actor

Yatin Karyekar is a well-known Indian actor who has primarily worked in the Bollywood film industry. He has also made notable contributions to the television industry, including his role in the long-running serial "Shanti." Additionally, he gained recognition for his portrayal of Aurangzeb in the popular Marathi serial "Raja Shivchhatrapati."

 

Not much information is available about Yatin Karyekar's early life and personal background. However, it is known that he was previously married to Iravati Harshe.

 

Yatin Karyekar has established himself as a veteran actor in Bollywood. He has appeared in numerous films, showcasing his versatility and acting skills. While specific details about his filmography are not provided in the provided text, it is safe to assume that he has worked on a range of projects throughout his career.

 

In addition to his film work, Yatin Karyekar has made a significant impact on the television industry. He gained widespread fame for his role in the serial "Shanti," which was known for its pioneering approach to social issues and women empowerment. His portrayal in the show helped him gain recognition and further opportunities in the television space.

 

Furthermore, Yatin Karyekar impressed the audience with his performance as Aurangzeb in the Marathi serial "Raja Shivchhatrapati." The historical drama depicted the life and reign of the Maratha warrior king Shivaji Maharaj, and Yatin's portrayal of Aurangzeb, one of Shivaji's adversaries, added depth and intensity to the character.

item.title: Zayed Khan
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Zayed Abbas

Bollywood Male Actor

Zayed Abbas Khan is a former Indian actor and producer known for his work in Hindi films. He was born on July 5, 1980, and is the son of Bollywood actor Sanjay Khan. Zayed Khan has been nominated for a Filmfare Award for his performances.

 

After completing his education in Business Management at Montgomery College and Film Making at the London Film Academy, Zayed Khan made his acting debut in 2003 with the film "Chura Liyaa Hai Tumne." He has appeared in several films including "Main Hoon Na" (2004), "Shabd" (2005), "Dus" (2005), "Yuvvraaj" (2008), "Blue" (2009), and "Anjaana Anjaani" (2010).

 

In 2011, Zayed Khan ventured into production by co-owning the production house Born Free Entertainment with his friend and actress Dia Mirza, and her spouse Sahil Sanga. Their first film together, "Love Breakups Zindagi," was released in 2011. In 2017, he made his television debut in the show "Haasil."

 

Zayed Khan has been married to Malaika Parekh since 2005, and they have two children together. He gave up smoking in 2008 upon the birth of his first son, aiming to set a good example for his children.

item.title: Zain Khan Durrani
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Zain Khan Durrani

Bollywood Male Actor

Zain Khan Durrani is a versatile Indian actor and poet who has garnered recognition for his performances in both films and television. Born and raised in the picturesque Bagh e Mehtab suburb of Srinagar, Jammu and Kashmir, he hails from a Kashmiri family. Zain received his early education at Burn Hall School and later attended Delhi Public School. He pursued higher studies and graduated from Zakir Hussain College, Delhi University.

 

Zain's interest in acting blossomed during his school days, where he participated in stage plays, showcasing his talent and passion for the performing arts. Additionally, he is a skilled poet and has crafted verses that reflect his artistic sensibilities.

 

In his acting career, Zain Khan Durrani has been part of several notable projects that have earned him acclaim from critics and audiences alike. He gained recognition for his portrayal of Alfaaz in the movie "Kuchh Bheege Alfaaz," which contributed to him building a dedicated fan base.

 

Continuing to showcase his talent, Zain appeared as a radio jockey on the program "Lamhey with Zain" on Big 92.7 FM, further displaying his versatility in the entertainment industry. His performances in the film "Shikara" and the series "Mukhbir - The Story of a Spy" were highly appreciated, cementing his position as a talented actor.

 

In 2021, Zain played the role of hijacker Daljeet Singh Dodi in the movie "Bell Bottom," further establishing himself as a competent actor capable of taking on diverse roles.

item.title: Vikas Verma
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Vikas Verma

Bollywood Male Actor

Vikas Verma is an Indian actor and model known for his work in Bollywood. He has appeared in notable films such as "Raabta" (2017), "Mom" (2017), "Judwaa 2" (2017), and "Coolie No. 1" (2020). Prior to his acting career, Vikas began as a model and won the title of India's Fashion Star 2009 on Zoom TV. He has walked the ramp for leading fashion designers at various fashion weeks, showcasing his talent and style.

 

Vikas made his acting debut in 2009 with the TV serial "Jhansi Ki Rani," where he portrayed the negative roles of Marshall and Captain Robert Hamilton. His performance earned him a nomination for "Best Male Negative Lead" at the Indian Telly Awards. In 2013, he appeared in the promotional video song "Pyaar ki Pungi" of the film "Agent Vinod" alongside Saif Ali Khan.

 

In 2014, Vikas ventured into the big screen with the romance adventure film "Yaariyan," directed by Divya Khosla Kumar, where he portrayed the character of Mike. He also appeared in the Punjabi film "Kirpaan: The Sword of Honour" as a negative lead, playing the role of a British cop.

 

In 2015, he had a significant role in the romantic comedy film "Shaandaar," directed by Vikas Bahl and produced by Anurag Kashyap and Vikramaditya Motwane. He played the character of Robin Fundwani. Vikas has also made special appearances in films like "Raabta," where he portrayed Kriti Sanon's ex-boyfriend Maanav, and "Mom," where he shared the screen with legendary actors Sridevi and Nawazuddin Siddiqui. He was also seen in the film "Judwaa 2" alongside Varun Dhawan, Jacqueline Fernandez, and Taapsee Pannu.

 

Apart from his film career, Vikas has appeared in various TV advertisements for brands such as Rupa Hunk, Quickr, Set Wet Deo, Kit Kat, and more. He has also been associated with renowned brands like Bare Denim, Adams, Mc Dowel Diet Whiskey, JW Marriott Arola, and others.

item.title: Vipul Gupta
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Vipul Gupta

Bollywood Male Actor

Vipul Gupta is an Indian actor known for his work in both television and film industries. He was born on September 17, 1980, in New Delhi, India. Vipul has appeared in various television shows and films, showcasing his versatility as an actor.

 

Vipul Gupta made his acting debut with the popular television show "K Street Pali Hill" (2004-2005), where he played the role of Aryan. He gained recognition for his portrayal of the character Anand in the television series "Maryada: Lekin Kab Tak?" (2010-2012). The show explored the complexities of relationships and received critical acclaim.

 

In addition to television, Vipul Gupta has also worked in Hindi films. He has appeared in movies such as "Paathshaala" (2010) and "Force" (2011). In "Force," he played the character of Lakshman, a pivotal role in the action-thriller film starring John Abraham.

item.title: Vaibhav Raj Gupta
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Vaibhav Raj Gupta

Bollywood Male Actor

Vaibhav Raj Gupta is an actor and model who was born on January 19, 1991, in Sitapur, Uttar Pradesh. He completed his schooling at Sacred Heart Inter College and Sumitra Inter College in Sitapur.

 

After participating in the Mr. Sitapur competition, Vaibhav began his modeling career in 2007 in his hometown. Despite his father's wish for him to pursue a career in chartered accountancy (CA) in Lucknow, Vaibhav decided to follow his passion for modeling. He moved to Mumbai and joined a theater group.

 

In Mumbai, Vaibhav Raj Gupta made his debut in theater with the play "Agni Aur Barkha." It seems he initially focused on theater to refine his acting skills and gain experience in the industry.

item.title: Vihaan Samat
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Vihaan Samat

Bollywood Male Actor

Vihaan Samat is a talented Indian actor known for his work in Hindi web series and films. He gained popularity through his roles in Netflix series such as "Eternally Confused and Eager for Love" and "Mismatched."

 

In "Mismatched," produced by RSVP and aired on Netflix, Vihaan portrayed the character of Harsh Agarwal. His performance received praise for his impressive American accent and the sensitivity with which he navigated the love triangle storyline. The show's charming cast and Vihaan's portrayal contributed to its appeal.

 

Vihaan then took on the lead role in the Netflix series "Eternally Confused and Eager for Love." Playing the character of Ray, an anxiety-stricken young man, Vihaan delivered a noteworthy performance. He received accolades for his portrayal, with viewers appreciating his ability to make them empathize with his character's struggles.

 

In addition to his web series work, Vihaan Samat has also been involved in brand endorsements. He has appeared in advertisements for Mamaearth alongside Sara Ali Khan, further showcasing his versatility and presence in the entertainment industry.

item.title: Vikram Kochhar
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Vikram Kochhar

Bollywood Male Actor

Vikram Kochhar, born on September 27, 1983, is a versatile Indian actor known for his work in film, television, and theatre. Hailing from the Kochhar family in Gurgaon, Haryana, he was raised in a supportive environment that nurtured his passion for acting from a young age. His early education took place at Army School in Noida.

 

After completing his schooling, Vikram moved to Delhi to pursue his graduation. It was during this time that he further honed his acting skills and delved into the world of theatre. His dedication and talent in the dramatic arts led him to be noticed by industry professionals, opening doors to various acting opportunities.

 

Vikram Kochhar's breakthrough in the entertainment industry came through theatre, where he showcased his ability to portray diverse characters with finesse. His performances on stage were lauded by audiences and critics alike, earning him recognition as a promising actor.

 

With his established reputation in theatre, Vikram transitioned to the realm of television and films. He took on roles that allowed him to display his acting prowess and versatility, winning the hearts of viewers across the country. His on-screen presence and ability to embody characters with authenticity have contributed to his success in the Indian entertainment industry.

item.title: Vineet Sharma
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Vineet Sharma

Bollywood Male Actor

Vineet Sharma is a talented Indian actor who has left a mark in the Bollywood film industry with his notable performances. Throughout his career, he has been a part of several successful movies, showcasing his versatility and acting prowess.

Starting in 2000 with the movie "Mission Kashmir," Vineet began his journey in Bollywood. Over the years, he appeared in various films, including "Kaal," "Singham," "Shootout at Wadala," and "Singham Returns," where he portrayed diverse roles that demonstrated his ability to adapt to different characters with ease.

In 2016, Vineet Sharma acted in the film "31st October," a gripping drama based on real events. He continued to impress audiences with his acting skills in movies like "Bhay" and "Ek Sangaychay... Unsaid Harmony" in 2018, earning praise from critics and viewers alike.

One of his prominent films in 2019 was "Main Zaroor Aaunga," which further solidified his position as a talented actor in the industry. Vineet Sharma's dedication to his craft and the ability to bring depth to his characters have earned him the respect and admiration of his peers and audiences.

Throughout his career, Vineet has worked alongside some of the industry's biggest names and has proven himself as a reliable and skilled actor. His contributions to the Indian film industry have been appreciated, and he continues to be a sought-after talent in various projects.
