item.content:encoded:
Vivaan Shah

Bollywood Male Actor

Vivaan Shah, an accomplished Indian actor, has left a mark in the Hindi film industry with his notable performances. Born on 11 January 1990, he made his debut in the movie "Saat Khoon Maaf" (2011) as the character Arun Kumar. Following his debut, he signed a promising three-film deal with acclaimed director Vishal Bhardwaj. In 2014, he gained further recognition when he landed a role in Farah Khan's film "Happy New Year."

 

Vivaan comes from a talented family of actors, being the younger son of the renowned actors Naseeruddin Shah and Ratna Pathak. He is also the nephew of Lt. Gen. Zameer Uddin Shah, the former vice-chancellor of Aligarh Muslim University. Additionally, his brother is the talented actor Imaad Shah, and he has a paternal half-sister, Heeba Shah.

item.title: Meher Vij
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Meher Vij

Bollywood Female Actor

Meher Vij, an accomplished Indian actress, is a name that shines brightly in the world of entertainment. Born on 22nd September 1986, she has captivated audiences with her exceptional talent and versatility. With her charming persona and impeccable acting skills, Meher has left an indelible mark on both the big and small screens.

 

Meher made her debut in the film industry with the critically acclaimed movie "Lucky: No Time for Love" in 2005. However, it was her portrayal of the supportive and loving mother in the film "Secret Superstar" (2017) that catapulted her into the limelight. Her performance garnered immense praise and earned her several awards and nominations, including a Filmfare nomination for Best Supporting Actress.

 

Known for her ability to portray a wide range of characters, Meher Vij effortlessly brings depth and authenticity to her roles. Whether it's a strong-willed woman fighting against societal norms or a vulnerable soul searching for her identity, she immerses herself completely into every character she portrays.

 

Beyond her talent as an actress, Meher Vij is admired for her humility, grace, and dedication to her craft. Her journey in the film industry is an inspiration to aspiring actors, and her success serves as a testament to her hard work and perseverance.

item.title: Mita Vashisht
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Mita Vashisht

Bollywood Female Actor

Mita Vashisht is a renowned Indian actress who has made a significant impact on both the small and big screens. With her mesmerizing performances and versatile acting skills, she has carved a niche for herself in the entertainment industry. Born on November 2, 1967, in Pune, Maharashtra, Mita Vashisht began her acting journey in the late 1980s and has since appeared in numerous films, television shows, and theater productions.

 

Known for her ability to portray diverse characters with depth and authenticity, Mita Vashisht has garnered critical acclaim and a loyal fan base. Her performances in films like "Drohkaal" and "Ghaath" showcased her exceptional acting prowess. On television, she has been part of successful shows like "Raat Hone Ko Hai" and "Kundali Bhagya," leaving an indelible mark with her memorable roles.

 

Apart from acting, Mita Vashisht is also an accomplished theater artist and has worked with renowned directors and playwrights. Her dedication to her craft and passion for storytelling is evident in every role she undertakes.

With her striking screen presence, versatility, and ability to bring characters to life, Mita Vashisht continues to be a prominent figure in the Indian entertainment industry, leaving an enduring legacy for aspiring actors to follow.

Mithila Palkar

Bollywood Female Actor

Mithila Palkar is a talented Indian actress and singer who has captivated audiences with her charm, versatility, and infectious energy. Born on January 12, 1993, in Mumbai, India, Mithila rose to fame through her notable performances in web series and films.

 

With her girl-next-door persona, Mithila has won hearts through her relatable portrayals of characters in popular web series like "Little Things" and "Girl in the City." Her natural acting prowess, combined with her expressive eyes and radiant smile, has made her a favorite among viewers of all ages. Mithila effortlessly brings life to her characters, making them feel genuine and endearing.

 

In addition to her acting skills, Mithila is also an accomplished singer. She gained recognition for her soulful renditions of popular songs on her YouTube channel. Her melodious voice and ability to connect with the audience through music have further solidified her position as a multi-talented artist.

 

Beyond her on-screen and musical talents, Mithila is known for her down-to-earth nature and positive outlook on life. She uses her platform to promote important social issues and inspire her fans to embrace their true selves.

item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Meenakshi Chaudhary

Bollywood Female Actor

Meenakshi Chaudhary is a remarkable individual who has made significant strides in various fields. Born on June 17, 1997, in Chandigarh, India, she has emerged as a notable personality in the world of beauty pageants, modeling, and social activism.

 

Meenakshi's journey in the pageant world began when she won the title of Miss Grand India 2018, which earned her a spot in the prestigious Miss Grand International pageant. Her grace, poise, and intelligence shone through as she represented India on the global stage, captivating audiences with her charm.

 

Beyond her success in pageantry, Meenakshi is also recognized for her philanthropic endeavors. She actively supports causes related to women's empowerment, education, and health. Her advocacy work reflects her compassionate nature and dedication to making a positive impact on society.

 

Furthermore, Meenakshi's modeling career has flourished, with her being associated with numerous renowned brands and fashion houses. Her versatility and ability to effortlessly adapt to different styles have made her a sought-after model in the industry.

item.title: Mahhi Vij
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Mahhi Vij

Bollywood Female Actor

Mahhi Vij is an Indian television actress known for her versatile performances and captivating screen presence. Born on April 1, 1982, in Delhi, India, she has established herself as a prominent figure in the Indian entertainment industry. With her exceptional acting skills and striking beauty, Mahhi has won the hearts of millions of viewers.

 

She gained immense popularity for her portrayal of Nakusha in the acclaimed television series "Laagi Tujhse Lagan." Her nuanced performance in the show showcased her talent and earned her critical acclaim. Mahhi has also appeared in various reality shows, including "Nach Baliye" and "Khatron Ke Khiladi," where she showcased her versatility and competitive spirit.

 

Beyond her acting prowess, Mahhi Vij is known for her philanthropic endeavors. She actively supports various charitable causes, particularly those related to child welfare. Her compassionate nature and dedication to making a positive impact on society have earned her admiration and respect.

item.title: Mugdha Godse
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Mugdha Godse

Bollywood Female Actor

Mugdha Veira Godse is an Indian actress and model known for her work in Hindi films. She was born in 1986 in Pune, India, and comes from a middle-class family. She completed her schooling from Nutan Marathi Vidyalaya and earned a Bachelor of Commerce degree from Marathwada Mitra Mandal College of Commerce in Pune.

Godse started her career in modeling and gained recognition after winning the Gladrags Mega Model Hunt in 2002. In 2004, she participated in the Femina Miss India contest and reached the semi-finals, winning the Miss Perfect Ten title. She then moved to Mumbai to pursue a career in modeling.

As a model, Godse appeared in various commercials and advertisements, including notable ones for Airtel and Close-Up toothpaste. She also worked on music videos and walked the runway at national and international fashion shows.

Godse made her Bollywood acting debut in the film "Fashion" (2008), directed by Madhur Bhandarkar. She received critical acclaim for her performance and was nominated for the Filmfare Award for Best Female Debut. She won the Apsara Award for Best Female Debutante for her role in the film.

In addition to "Fashion," Godse has appeared in films such as "All The Best" (2009), "Jail" (2009), "Help" (2010), "Gali Gali Chor Hai" (2012), and "Will You Marry Me?" (2012). She has also acted in the Tamil film "Thani Oruvan" and served as a judge on the Marathi reality show "Marathi Paul Padte Pudhe."

item.content:encoded:
Meenal Sahu

Bollywood Female Actor

Meenal Sahu is a talented and versatile actress who has captivated audiences with her incredible performances on the silver screen. With her enchanting beauty and exceptional acting prowess, she has established herself as one of the most promising stars in the entertainment industry.

 

Born with a natural flair for acting, Meenal embarked on her acting journey at a young age and quickly garnered attention for her remarkable talent. Her ability to seamlessly embody diverse characters has allowed her to portray a wide range of roles, from intense dramas to lighthearted comedies, leaving a lasting impression on viewers.

 

Meenal's dedication to her craft is evident in every role she takes on. She meticulously prepares for each character, immersing herself in their world and bringing them to life with authenticity and depth. Her ability to evoke genuine emotions has garnered critical acclaim and a dedicated fan base.

 

Beyond her acting abilities, Meenal Sahu is known for her warm and down-to-earth personality, making her approachable and beloved by both her colleagues and fans. Her commitment to her artistry, coupled with her humility, sets her apart as a truly remarkable actress.

item.title: Mahabanoo Mody-Kotwal
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Mahabanoo Mody-Kotwal

Bollywood Female Actor

Mahabanoo Mody-Kotwal is an accomplished actress who has made a significant impact on the Indian theater scene. With her exceptional talent and passion for the arts, she has become a prominent figure in the industry. Known for her versatility and ability to portray a wide range of characters, Mahabanoo has captivated audiences with her powerful performances.

 

Her career spans several decades, during which she has collaborated with some of the most renowned theater directors and actors in India. Mahabanoo has showcased her skills in various plays, including classics, contemporary works, and experimental productions. Her ability to effortlessly immerse herself in the roles she plays has earned her critical acclaim and admiration from theater enthusiasts.

 

Mahabanoo's dedication to the craft extends beyond her acting prowess. She is also a co-founder of the popular theater company "Poor-Box Productions" and has worked tirelessly to promote theater as a medium for social change and cultural expression. Her commitment to fostering a vibrant theater community has made her a respected figure among her peers.

item.title: Mandakini
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Mandakini

Bollywood Female Actor

Mandakini, born as Yasmeen Joseph, is an Indian actor who rose to fame in the 1980s for her captivating performances in Bollywood films. Born on July 30, 1963, in Meerut, Uttar Pradesh, Mandakini started her career in the film industry at a young age.

 

She gained immense popularity with her debut film "Ram Teri Ganga Maili" in 1985, directed by Raj Kapoor. Mandakini's portrayal of a young woman caught in the moral complexities of society garnered critical acclaim and won her the Filmfare Award for Best Female Debut.

 

Her ethereal beauty and natural acting talent captured the hearts of audiences across the nation. Mandakini became an overnight sensation and established herself as one of the leading actresses of her time. Her subsequent films like "Dance Dance" and "Loha" further showcased her versatility as an actor.

However, Mandakini's career faced controversies and setbacks, particularly due to her alleged involvement in the 1993 Mumbai underworld connections. Despi

item.title: Mahek chahal
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Mahek Chahal

Bollywood Female Actor

Mahek Chahal is a talented Indian actor known for her notable work in the film and television industry. With her captivating screen presence and versatile acting skills, she has carved a niche for herself in the entertainment world.

 

Born on February 1, 1979, in Norway, Mahek Chahal made her debut in Bollywood with the film "Nayee Padosan" in 2003. She gained recognition for her role in the movie "Wanted" (2009), where she portrayed the character of a seductive antagonist with finesse. Her performance was widely appreciated, earning her critical acclaim and establishing her as a promising talent.

 

Apart from her film career, Mahek Chahal has also made her mark on the small screen. She participated in the reality show "Bigg Boss 5" (2011), which further boosted her popularity. Her strong personality and confident demeanor won her a significant fan base.

 

With her striking looks and impeccable acting prowess, Mahek Chahal continues to enthrall audiences with her performances. She is known for her ability to portray diverse roles, seamlessly transitioning from intense characters to light-hearted ones. Her dedication and passion for her craft have earned her accolades in the industry, making her a respected figure in Indian cinema.

item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Maanvi Gagroo

Bollywood Female Actor

Maanvi Gagroo is an Indian actress known for her appearances in Hindi films and television, particularly in web series. She has gained recognition for her roles in popular web series such as TVF Pitchers, TVF Tripling, Made in Heaven, and Four More Shots Please!.

 

Born into a Kashmiri Pandit family in New Delhi, Maanvi completed her education at The Mother's International School and obtained a bachelor's degree in psychology from Gargi College, University of Delhi. Her parents are Surender and Urmil Gagroo.

 

Maanvi's acting career took off with her debut in the Disney Channel's television show called Dhoom Machaao Dhoom in 2007. However, she gained widespread acclaim for her roles in various web series. She has been a part of popular shows like TVF Pitchers, TVF Tripling, and Made in Heaven. Her portrayal of the character 'Apsara,' a plus-size woman in the comedy film Ujda Chaman (2019), opposite Sunny Singh, garnered attention. For the role, she wore a fat suit.

 

In addition to her web series work, Maanvi has also appeared in the film Shubh Mangal Zyada Saavdhan, alongside Ayushmann Khurrana. The film addresses the topic of same-sex love, and Maanvi portrayed the role of a quirky bride.

item.title: Nandita Das
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Nandita Das

Bollywood Female Actor

Nandita Das, an eminent Indian actress, director, and social activist, is a true epitome of talent and courage. With her compelling performances and unwavering commitment to social issues, she has carved a niche for herself in the entertainment industry.

 

Known for her natural and nuanced acting, Nandita Das has portrayed a wide range of characters that resonate with audiences across the globe. Her notable films include "Fire," "Earth," and "Bawandar," where she fearlessly tackled complex themes and showcased her versatility as an actress. Nandita's magnetic presence on screen and her ability to bring depth and authenticity to her roles have earned her critical acclaim and numerous awards.

 

Beyond her acting prowess, Nandita is a passionate advocate for social change. She fearlessly speaks out on issues such as gender equality, women's rights, and communal harmony. Her directorial debut, "Firaaq," a hard-hitting film about the aftermath of the Gujarat riots, demonstrated her dedication to addressing social injustices through her work.

 

Nandita Das is not just an artist; she is a catalyst for change. Her unwavering commitment to both her craft and social causes makes her a role model for aspiring artists and activists alike. With her talent, conviction, and indomitable spirit, she continues to inspire and leave an indelible mark on Indian cinema and society as a whole.

item.title: Nargis Fakhri
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Nargis Fakhri

Bollywood Female Actor

Nargis Fakhri is an American-born Indian actress and model who has made her mark in the Bollywood film industry. Born on October 20, 1979, in Queens, New York, she began her career as a model and gained recognition for her appearances in popular magazines like Maxim and Vogue. Her striking looks and confident demeanor soon caught the attention of filmmakers, leading to her debut in the Hindi film industry with the movie "Rockstar" in 2011.

 

Nargis Fakhri's on-screen presence and natural acting talent quickly made her a sought-after actress. She went on to star in films like "Madras Cafe," "Main Tera Hero," and "Azhar," showcasing her versatility as an actor. With her distinctive charm and ability to effortlessly portray diverse characters, she has carved a niche for herself in the industry.

 

Beyond her acting career, Nargis Fakhri is known for her philanthropic endeavors. She has actively supported various social causes and charity organizations, using her platform to raise awareness and make a positive impact.

 

Nargis Fakhri continues to captivate audiences with her beauty, talent, and down-to-earth personality. Her journey from the world of modeling to becoming a successful actress serves as an inspiration to many aspiring artists. With her talent and determination, she has undoubtedly secured a place among the leading ladies of Bollywood.

item.title: Navneet Kaur Dhillon
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Navneet Kaur Dhillon

Bollywood Female Actor

Navneet Kaur Dhillon is an Indian actress, model, and beauty queen who gained prominence after winning the coveted title of Femina Miss India World 2013. Born on September 23, 1992, in Ambala, Haryana, Navneet displayed a passion for performing arts from a young age. Her journey in the world of glamour began with her participation in several beauty pageants, ultimately leading to her remarkable victory at the national level.

 

After her Miss India win, Navneet represented India at the Miss World 2013 pageant held in Bali, Indonesia, where she showcased her intelligence, grace, and charisma. Although she didn't clinch the Miss World crown, Navneet left a lasting impression with her stunning presence and remarkable poise.

 

Following her pageant success, Navneet ventured into the entertainment industry. She made her acting debut in 2015 with the Punjabi film "Ambarsariya" and later appeared in movies like "Loveshhuda" and "Mukkabaaz." Her performances received critical acclaim, and she proved her versatility as an actress.

item.title: Neena Gupta
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Neena Gupta

Bollywood Female Actor

Neena Gupta, an exceptional Indian actress and television director, has left an indelible mark on the entertainment industry with her talent and versatility. Born on July 4, 1959, she has graced the silver screen for decades and continues to captivate audiences with her brilliant performances.

 

Neena Gupta's career spans across various mediums, including films, television, and theater. She made her mark with memorable roles in movies like "Gandhi" and "Mandi," establishing herself as a powerhouse performer. Her ability to bring depth and authenticity to her characters has garnered critical acclaim and numerous awards.

 

In recent years, Neena Gupta has made a strong comeback, defying age stereotypes and redefining the roles available to women in the Indian film industry. With films like "Badhaai Ho" and "Shubh Mangal Zyada Saavdhan," she has showcased her impeccable comic timing and brought unconventional stories to the forefront.

 

Apart from her acting prowess, Neena Gupta is admired for her candid and fearless approach to life. She has fearlessly voiced her opinions on social issues and has been an inspiration for many women aspiring to make a mark in the industry.

item.title: Neena Kulkarni
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Neena Kulkarni

Bollywood Female Actor

Neena Kulkarni is a highly acclaimed Indian actress who has made her mark in the realms of theater, television, and film. Born on June 15, 1955, in Pune, Maharashtra, Neena Kulkarni has garnered immense respect and admiration for her versatile acting prowess and impeccable performances.

 

Kulkarni's journey in the entertainment industry spans over four decades, during which she has portrayed a wide range of characters with finesse and depth. She started her career in Marathi theater, where her exceptional talent and dedication earned her accolades and a loyal fan following. Her notable theatrical performances include roles in iconic plays like "Sakharam Binder" and "Wada Chirebandi."

 

Neena Kulkarni's excellence transcended to the silver screen, where she showcased her acting skills in both Marathi and Hindi cinema. Her memorable performances in films like "Sarfarosh," "Pyaar Vali Love Story," and "Little Things" have established her as a highly respected actress.

item.title: Neha Dhupia
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Neha Dhupia

Bollywood Female Actor

Neha Dhupia is a versatile Indian actress, model, and television presenter who has left an indelible mark on the entertainment industry. Born on August 27, 1980, in Kochi, Kerala, Neha embarked on her journey in the world of glamour after winning the Femina Miss India title in 2002. She gained prominence with her debut film "Qayamat: City Under Threat" in 2003, and since then, she has been a part of numerous successful Bollywood movies.

 

Known for her striking looks, charming personality, and impeccable acting skills, Neha has showcased her versatility in various genres of films, including romantic comedies, thrillers, and drama. Her notable performances can be seen in movies like "Julie," "Singh is Kinng," and "Tumhari Sulu."

 

Apart from her acting career, Neha Dhupia has also been a prominent figure in the world of television. She has hosted popular reality shows like "Roadies" and "No Filter Neha," where she displays her candid and outspoken persona.

 

Off-screen, Neha is an advocate for social causes and uses her platform to raise awareness about women empowerment, body positivity, and mental health. Her charismatic presence and strong voice have earned her a loyal fan following.

item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Neha Sharma

Bollywood Female Actor

Neha Sharma is a talented Indian actress who has made a significant mark in the world of cinema. Born on November 21, 1987, in Bhagalpur, Bihar, Neha began her career in the entertainment industry with modeling assignments and television commercials. Her striking looks and captivating screen presence soon caught the attention of filmmakers, leading her to make her acting debut in the Bollywood film "Crook" in 2010.

 

Since then, Neha has appeared in several notable films, showcasing her versatility and acting prowess. Some of her noteworthy performances include "Kyaa Super Kool Hain Hum," "Youngistaan," and "Tum Bin II." Neha's ability to portray a wide range of characters, from bubbly and vivacious to intense and emotional, has garnered her a loyal fan base.

 

Aside from her acting skills, Neha is also admired for her fashion sense and style. She has graced the covers of numerous fashion magazines and is considered a fashion icon by many.

 

With her talent, charm, and dedication, Neha Sharma continues to carve a niche for herself in the film industry. Her fans eagerly await her upcoming projects, as they anticipate witnessing more of her captivating performances on the silver screen.

item.title: Neeru Bajwa
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Neeru Bajwa

Bollywood Female Actor

Neeru Bajwa is a renowned actress and producer in the Indian film industry. Born on August 26, 1980, in Canada, she has carved a niche for herself in Punjabi and Hindi cinema. With her remarkable talent and captivating screen presence, Neeru has won the hearts of audiences worldwide.

 

Neeru Bajwa made her acting debut in the year 1998 with the Bollywood film "Main Solah Baras Ki." However, it was her foray into Punjabi cinema that established her as a leading lady. She has appeared in numerous successful Punjabi films, including "Mel Karade Rabba," "Jatt & Juliet," and "Sardaar Ji." Her performances have been lauded by critics and fans alike, earning her several awards and accolades.

 

Apart from acting, Neeru Bajwa has also ventured into production. She co-owns a production company called Neeru Bajwa Entertainment, which has produced films like "Sargi" and "Shadaa."

Neeru is known for her versatility as an actress, effortlessly transitioning between different genres and delivering memorable performances. Her charm, elegance, and dedication to her craft have made her one of the most sought-after actresses in the Punjabi film industry.

item.title: Nithya Menen
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Nithya Menen

Bollywood Female Actor

Nithya Menen is a versatile Indian actress known for her exceptional talent and captivating performances in the film industry. Born on April 8, 1988, in Bangalore, Karnataka, Nithya made her acting debut in the Malayalam film industry with "Akhila" in 2009. Since then, she has made a significant impact in the South Indian film industry, gaining immense popularity and critical acclaim.

 

Nithya's acting prowess is evident in her ability to effortlessly portray a wide range of characters across different genres. Her natural charm, expressive eyes, and command over emotions make her performances truly mesmerizing. Whether it is playing a strong-willed protagonist, a vulnerable character, or a girl-next-door, Nithya brings authenticity and depth to every role she undertakes.

 

Her notable films include "Ala Modalaindi," "Urumi," "Mersal," and "OK Kanmani," among others. Nithya's remarkable acting skills have earned her several awards and nominations, including the prestigious Nandi Award and Filmfare Award.

 

Besides her acting career, Nithya has also ventured into singing and has lent her soulful voice to some of her films. Her passion for storytelling extends beyond acting, as she has expressed interest in directing and writing in the future.

item.title: Neha Pendse
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Neha Pendse

Bollywood Female Actor

Neha Pendse, born on November 29, 1984, is an Indian actress and television personality who has made a mark in the entertainment industry. With her charming persona and acting prowess, she has captivated the hearts of audiences across the country.

 

Pendse began her acting career at a young age and rose to fame with her role as Sanjana Hiteshi in the popular Indian sitcom "May I Come In Madam?" Her impeccable comic timing and expressive acting made her a household name. She has also showcased her talent in various Marathi and Hindi films, leaving a lasting impression with her versatile performances.

 

Apart from her acting skills, Neha Pendse has also dabbled in television hosting, adding another dimension to her career. Her graceful presence as a host on reality shows and award ceremonies has earned her widespread recognition.

 

With her vibrant personality and infectious energy, Pendse has become a favorite among fans and critics alike. She continues to evolve as an artist, taking on challenging roles and pushing her boundaries. Neha Pendse's talent, dedication, and determination make her a prominent figure in the Indian entertainment industry, and she remains an inspiration to aspiring actors across the nation.

item.title: Nidhhi Agerwal

item.content:encoded:
Nidhhi Agerwal

Bollywood Female Actor

Nidhhi Agerwal is a talented and versatile Indian actress who has made a mark in the film industry with her remarkable performances. Born on August 17, 1993, she began her career as a model before venturing into acting. Nidhhi made her acting debut in 2017 with the Bollywood film "Munna Michael," where she portrayed the lead female role opposite Tiger Shroff. Her performance garnered attention and showcased her dancing skills, which she honed from a young age.

 

Nidhhi's beauty, charm, and acting prowess have allowed her to venture into different film industries, including Telugu and Tamil cinema. She has worked with renowned directors and shared screen space with popular actors, earning critical acclaim for her roles. With her dedication and commitment to her craft, Nidhhi continues to impress audiences with her on-screen presence and versatility.

 

Beyond her acting career, Nidhhi is also known for her fashion sense and has been a part of various endorsements and brand campaigns. Her social media presence is strong, making her popular among her fans. As she continues to explore new opportunities and challenges in the entertainment world, Nidhhi Agerwal is undoubtedly an actress to watch out for.

item.title: Nidhi Subbaiah
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Nidhi Subbaiah

Bollywood Female Actor

Nidhi Subbaiah is an Indian actress who has made her mark in the Kannada and Hindi film industries. Born on February 16, 1987, in Kodagu, Karnataka, Nidhi's journey in the entertainment world began when she won the Femina Miss India pageant in 2009. She made her acting debut in Kannada cinema with the film "Pancharangi" in 2010, which garnered critical acclaim and earned her a Filmfare Award nomination for Best Actress.

 

Known for her charming presence and versatile acting skills, Nidhi went on to star in several successful Kannada films such as "Krishnan Marriage Story," "Anna Bond," and "Direct Ishq." She also ventured into Hindi cinema with the film "Ajab Gazabb Love" alongside Jackky Bhagnani.

 

Apart from her acting prowess, Nidhi is also recognized for her elegant and stylish appearance. With her radiant smile and graceful persona, she has captivated audiences and gained a significant fan following. Nidhi Subbaiah continues to impress with her talent, beauty, and dedication to her craft, making her a prominent figure in the Indian film industry.

item.content:encoded:
Niharika Singh

Bollywood Female Actor

Niharika Singh is a talented and versatile actress who has made her mark in the Indian film industry. With her exceptional acting skills and captivating presence, she has garnered a significant fan following. Born on 31 August 1982 in India, Niharika started her career in the entertainment industry as a model, before transitioning into acting.

 

Niharika's breakthrough role came in the critically acclaimed film "Miss Lovely" (2012), where she portrayed the complex character of Pinky, earning her widespread recognition and accolades. Her performance in the film showcased her ability to delve into challenging roles and bring them to life with depth and authenticity.

 

Throughout her career, Niharika has displayed her versatility by taking on diverse roles in both mainstream and independent cinema. With each project, she has demonstrated her commitment to her craft and an innate understanding of her characters. Her performances have been lauded for their nuanced portrayals and emotional depth.

 

Beyond her acting prowess, Niharika is also known for her grace and elegance, both on and off the screen. With her natural charm and radiant personality, she continues to captivate audiences and leave a lasting impression. Niharika Singh is undoubtedly a talent to watch out for in the Indian film industry.

item.content:encoded:
Niharica Raizada

Bollywood Female Actor

Niharica Raizada is a talented and accomplished actress who has made a significant impact in the Indian film industry. Born on January 18, 1990, in Luxembourg, Niharica possesses a unique blend of beauty, charm, and immense acting prowess. She started her acting career in Bollywood and has since garnered critical acclaim for her performances.

 

With her captivating screen presence and versatility, Niharica has successfully portrayed a wide range of characters, effortlessly transitioning between intense drama, romantic roles, and even action sequences. Her dedication to her craft and ability to bring depth to her characters has made her a sought-after talent in the industry.

 

Niharica's notable films include "Total Dhamaal," "Masaan," and "Warrior Savitri," where she showcased her acting skills alongside some of the industry's biggest stars. She has also made her mark internationally by representing India at prestigious events like the Cannes Film Festival.

 

Beyond her acting career, Niharica is admired for her philanthropic efforts and dedication to social causes. She actively supports initiatives related to education, healthcare, and women empowerment.

item.title: Niki Aneja
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Niki Aneja

Bollywood Female Actor

Niki Aneja is a talented and accomplished actress who has made a significant mark in the world of entertainment. Born on 17th September 1972, she hails from Mumbai, India. Niki is best known for her notable roles in both Indian television and film industry. With her charismatic presence and remarkable acting skills, she has captivated audiences across the globe.

 

Niki Aneja rose to prominence with her portrayal of Dr. Simran Chopra in the popular Indian medical drama series, "Dill Mill Gayye." Her portrayal of a strong and compassionate doctor won hearts and earned her critical acclaim. Niki's ability to bring depth and authenticity to her characters has made her a highly respected actress in the industry.

 

Apart from her television work, Niki has also ventured into films and has showcased her versatility in various genres. Her ability to effortlessly switch between intense emotional scenes and lighthearted moments has solidified her reputation as a versatile performer.

 

With her dedication, talent, and striking screen presence, Niki Aneja continues to be a cherished actress in the entertainment industry, leaving an indelible impression on the hearts of her fans.

Nikita Anand

Bollywood Female Actor

Nikita Anand is a talented Indian actress who has made her mark in the entertainment industry. With her stunning looks, versatility, and acting prowess, she has garnered a significant following and critical acclaim. item.title: Nimrat Kaur
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Nimrat Kaur

Bollywood Female Actor

Nimrat Kaur is a talented Indian actress known for her work in both Indian and international film and television productions. She was born on March 13, 1982, in Pilani, Rajasthan, India. Nimrat started her acting career in the theater before making her breakthrough in the critically acclaimed film "The Lunchbox" in 2013.

 

Her performance in "The Lunchbox" garnered widespread praise, establishing her as a promising actress. She went on to star in films like "Airlift" and "Lust Stories," further solidifying her reputation as a versatile and talented performer. Nimrat also ventured into international projects, notably playing a pivotal role in the Emmy-nominated TV series "Homeland."

 

Nimrat Kaur's acting prowess and natural charm have earned her recognition and appreciation from both audiences and critics. She brings depth and authenticity to her characters, captivating viewers with her nuanced performances. Nimrat continues to work in a variety of projects, showcasing her talent in diverse genres and mediums.

item.content:encoded:
Nushrat Bharucha

Bollywood Female Actor

Nushrat Bharucha is an Indian actress known for her work primarily in Hindi cinema. She was born on May 17, 1985, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. Nushrat made her acting debut in 2006 with the film "Jai Santoshi Maa," but gained recognition and popularity with her role in the romantic comedy "Pyaar Ka Punchnama" in 2011.

Her portrayal of the character Neha in "Pyaar Ka Punchnama" garnered her widespread acclaim, and she became known for her ability to portray lively and relatable characters. Nushrat further solidified her position in the industry with successful films like "Pyaar Ka Punchnama 2," "Sonu Ke Titu Ki Sweety," and "Dream Girl."

With her girl-next-door charm and impeccable comic timing, Nushrat has won the hearts of audiences. She is admired for her versatility and has showcased her acting skills in a range of genres, including comedy, romance, and drama.

Nushrat Bharucha continues to explore diverse roles and is known for her dedication to her craft. Her on-screen presence and charismatic performances have made her a popular choice among filmmakers and audiences alike, and she remains a prominent figure in Hindi cinema.

item.title: Neetu Kapoor
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Neetu Kapoor

Bollywood Female Actor

Neetu Kapoor, formerly known as Neetu Singh, is an Indian actress who primarily worked in Hindi films during the late 1960s, 1970s, and early 1980s. She was born on July 8, 1958, in New Delhi, India, as Harneet Kaur, to Punjabi Sikh parents Darshan Singh and Rajee Kaur Singh. Neetu Kapoor began her acting career as a child artist and made her debut in the film industry with the movie "Suraj" in 1966. She gained recognition for her dual role in the romantic comedy "Do Kaliyaan" (1968).

 

During her career, Neetu Kapoor transitioned to more mature roles and appeared in notable films such as "Yaadon Ki Baaraat" (1973), "Deewaar" (1975), "Kabhi Kabhie" (1976), "Amar Akbar Anthony" (1977), and "Dharam Veer" (1977). Her performances in films like "Parvarish" (1977), "Jaani Dushman" (1979), "Kaala Patthar" (1979), and "Yaarana" (1981) were praised by critics.

 

In 1980, Neetu Kapoor married actor Rishi Kapoor, with whom she had two children, Riddhima Kapoor Sahni and Ranbir Kapoor. After her marriage, she took a hiatus from acting and made a comeback almost three decades later with a minor role in the film "Love Aaj Kal" (2009). She then starred in films like "Do Dooni Chaar" (2010), which won her a Zee Cine Award, "Besharam" (2013), and made guest appearances in "Jab Tak Hai Jaan" (2012). She also starred in the film "Jug Jugg Jeeyo" (2022).

item.title: Pooja Hegde
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Pooja Hegde

Bollywood Female Actor

Pooja Hegde is a prominent Indian actress and model known for her work in the Telugu and Hindi film industries. Born on October 13, 1990, in Mumbai, Pooja began her career as a model and rose to fame after winning the second runner-up title at the Miss Universe India 2010 pageant. Her mesmerizing beauty and graceful demeanor quickly caught the attention of filmmakers, leading to her acting debut in the 2012 Tamil film "Mugamoodi."

 

Pooja's breakthrough came with the Telugu film "Oka Laila Kosam" in 2014, where she showcased her acting skills alongside her captivating screen presence. She further solidified her position in the industry with successful films like "Mukunda," "Duvvada Jagannadham," and "Aravinda Sametha Veera Raghava."

 

With her versatility and talent, Pooja also made a mark in Bollywood, starring in films like "Mohenjo Daro" and "Housefull 4." Her ability to effortlessly portray diverse characters has won her accolades and a significant fan following.

item.title: Puja Gupta
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Puja Gupta

Bollywood Female Actor

Puja Gupta is an Indian film actress and model. She was born on January 30, 1988, in New Delhi, India.

Puja Gupta made her acting debut in Bollywood with the film "F.A.L.T.U" in 2011. The comedy-drama film was directed by Remo D'Souza, and Puja's performance as the female lead was well-received. She was appreciated for her screen presence and acting skills.

 

Following her debut, Puja appeared in films like "Shortcut Romeo" (2013) and "Go Goa Gone" (2013), where she played supporting roles. While these films did not gain much commercial success, Puja's performances were noted by the audience and critics.

 

In addition to her film career, Puja Gupta has also worked as a model and has participated in beauty pageants. She won the title of Miss India Universe in 2007 and represented India at the Miss Universe pageant.

 

While Puja Gupta's appearances in films have been relatively limited, she has left an impression with her performances and continues to be associated with the entertainment industry.

item.title: Priyanka Chopra Jonas
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Priyanka Chopra Jonas

Bollywood Female Actor

Priyanka Chopra Jonas is an internationally acclaimed Indian actress, singer, and film producer. Born on July 18, 1982, in Jamshedpur, Jharkhand, she began her career in the entertainment industry as a model before transitioning into acting. Priyanka made her acting debut in Bollywood with the film "The Hero: Love Story of a Spy" in 2003. Priyanka Chopra's talent and versatility have allowed her to portray a wide range of characters in both Hindi and English-language films. She gained widespread recognition and critical acclaim for her performances in films like "Fashion" (2008), for which she won the National Film Award for Best Actress, and "Barfi!" (2012), which showcased her exceptional acting skills. In addition to her successful Bollywood career, Priyanka has made a significant impact on the international stage. She starred in the American television series "Quantico" (2015-2018) and has acted in Hollywood films such as "Baywatch" (2017) and "Isn't It Romantic" (2019).

item.title: Priyamani
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Priyamani

Bollywood Female Actor

Priyamani, born as Priya Vasudev Mani Iyer, is a talented Indian actress known for her exceptional performances in the South Indian film industry. With her remarkable acting skills and striking beauty, she has carved a niche for herself in the hearts of millions of fans. Priyamani made her acting debut in 2003 with the Telugu film "Evare Atagaadu," and since then, she has captivated audiences with her versatile portrayals across various languages, including Tamil, Malayalam, Kannada, and Hindi. She has consistently delivered memorable performances in films like "Paruthiveeran," for which she received the prestigious National Film Award for Best Actress, and "Rakta Charitra," showcasing her ability to effortlessly adapt to different roles and genres. Besides her remarkable acting prowess, Priyamani is also known for her strong on-screen presence and dynamic personality. She effortlessly embodies the characters she portrays, whether it's a village belle, a strong-willed woman, or a modern-day protagonist. Beyond her success in films, Priyamani has also made a mark on the digital platform. She gained widespread acclaim for her portrayal of Suchitra in the popular web series "The Family Man," further establishing her versatility as an actress.

item.content:encoded:
Payal Rohatgi

Bollywood Female Actor

Payal Rohatgi is an Indian actress and model known for her work in the Indian film industry. With her stunning looks and vibrant personality, she has made a mark in both Bollywood and regional cinema. Payal gained popularity through her appearances in movies like "36 China Town" and "Corporate," where she showcased her acting skills and garnered attention for her bold and confident portrayal of characters.

 

Apart from her film career, Payal has also made notable appearances on reality TV shows like "Bigg Boss" and "Nach Baliye," where she showcased her versatility and charm. With her strong presence and outspoken nature, she has become a familiar face in the entertainment industry.

 

Payal Rohatgi is also known for her active presence on social media, where she shares her thoughts and opinions on various issues. She has often expressed her views fearlessly, making her a controversial figure at times.

item.title: Preeti Jhangiani
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Preeti Jhangiani

Bollywood Female Actor

Preeti Jhangiani is an Indian actress known for her captivating presence and versatile performances in the Bollywood film industry. Born on August 18, 1980, in Mangalore, India, she made her acting debut in the 1999 film "Mohabbatein," directed by Aditya Chopra. Preeti's charm and natural acting skills quickly caught the audience's attention, earning her critical acclaim and a dedicated fan following.

 

She went on to star in several successful films, including "Awara Paagal Deewana," "Yeh Hai Jalwa," and "Love Ke Liye Kuch Bhi Karega." Preeti's radiant beauty and talent made her a sought-after actress in the early 2000s, and she garnered a reputation for her ability to portray both intense and light-hearted characters with ease.

 

Beyond her acting career, Preeti Jhangiani is also recognized for her philanthropic work and advocacy for social causes. She actively supports organizations that focus on child welfare and education. Preeti continues to be remembered as a talented actress who left an indelible mark on the Bollywood industry through her memorable performances and philanthropic endeavors.

item.content:encoded:
Padmini Kolhapure

Bollywood Female Actor

Padmini Kolhapure is a renowned Indian actress who has made significant contributions to the Hindi film industry. She was born on November 1, 1965, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. Padmini began her acting career as a child artist and gained recognition for her exceptional talent and screen presence.

 

She made her debut as a leading actress in the film "Zindagi" in 1976 and subsequently appeared in numerous successful films during the 1970s and 1980s. Padmini is best known for her memorable performances in movies like "Satyam Shivam Sundaram," "Prem Rog," and "Insaaf Ka Tarazu." Her roles often showcased her versatility and ability to portray a wide range of emotions.

 

Padmini Kolhapure's performances have earned her critical acclaim, and she has received several awards for her acting prowess. She is admired for her natural beauty, expressive eyes, and graceful presence on-screen.

item.content:encoded:
Pallavi Kulkarni

Bollywood Female Actor

Pallavi Kulkarni is an Indian actress known for her work in Hindi and Marathi television. She was born on June 15, 1976, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. Pallavi made her acting debut in the 1990s and quickly gained popularity with her notable performances.

 

She rose to prominence with her portrayal of the character Padmini in the Hindi TV serial "Pallavi Joshi." Pallavi Kulkarni became a household name and captured the hearts of audiences with her convincing acting skills and charming screen presence. She went on to act in several successful TV shows, including "Kehta Hai Dil" and "Vaidehi."

 

Pallavi's performances have been praised for their depth and authenticity, and she has showcased her versatility by portraying a range of characters. She has also made appearances in Marathi television series, further expanding her acting repertoire.

item.title: Pallavi Joshi
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Pallavi Joshi

Bollywood Female Actor

Pallavi Joshi is a versatile Indian actress, presenter, and producer known for her work in Hindi and Marathi cinema, as well as in television. She was born on April 4, 1969, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. Pallavi began her acting career in the late 1970s as a child artist and went on to establish herself as a talented performer in both films and television.

 

She has acted in a wide range of films, including notable works such as "Badla," "Rihaee," and "The Tashkent Files." Pallavi's performances have been applauded for their depth and realism, and she has received critical acclaim for her portrayal of complex characters.

 

In addition to her film career, Pallavi Joshi has made significant contributions to Indian television. She has appeared in popular TV shows like "Bharat Ek Khoj," "Wagle Ki Duniya," and "Aarohan," winning accolades for her performances.

item.title: Pallavi Sharda
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Pallavi Sharda

Bollywood Female Actor

Pallavi Sharda is an Australian-Indian actress, dancer, and model who has worked in both Bollywood and Hollywood productions. She was born on March 5, 1988, in Perth, Australia, to Indian parents. Pallavi began her career as a classical Indian dancer and went on to explore acting and modeling.

 

She made her Bollywood debut in 2010 with the film "My Name Is Khan," where she had a small role. However, it was her performance in the critically acclaimed film "Besharam" in 2013, alongside Ranbir Kapoor, that gained her recognition and praise.

 

Pallavi's talent and versatility allowed her to transition to international projects. She has appeared in Hollywood films like "Lion" and "Beecham House," showcasing her acting skills on a global platform. Her performances have been appreciated for their authenticity and depth.

item.title: Paoli Dam
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Paoli Dam

Bollywood Female Actor

Paoli Dam is an Indian actress known for her work in Bengali and Hindi cinema. She was born on October 4, 1980, in Kolkata, West Bengal, India. Paoli began her acting career in Bengali cinema and gained recognition for her bold and powerful performances.

 

She rose to prominence with her role in the critically acclaimed Bengali film "Kaalbela" in 2009. Paoli's portrayal of the character Supriya garnered her praise and marked her as an actress to watch. She further solidified her position in the industry with films like "Chatrak" and "Elar Char Adhyay."

 

Paoli Dam made her foray into Hindi cinema with the film "Hate Story" in 2012, where she portrayed the lead role of Kavya. Her performance in the film garnered attention and showcased her ability to handle intense and complex characters.

item.title: Pairneeti Chopra
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Parineeti Chopra

Bollywood Female Actor

Parineeti Chopra is a popular Indian actress known for her work in Hindi films. She was born on October 22, 1988, in Ambala, Haryana, India. Parineeti comes from a family with connections to the Indian film industry, as she is the cousin of actress Priyanka Chopra.

 

She made her acting debut in 2011 with the film "Ladies vs Ricky Bahl," in which she played a supporting role. However, it was her breakthrough performance in the film "Ishaqzaade" in 2012 that brought her widespread recognition and critical acclaim. Her portrayal of the feisty and rebellious Zoya Qureshi earned her several awards and nominations.

 

Parineeti has since appeared in a range of successful films, including "Shuddh Desi Romance," "Hasee Toh Phasee," and "Golmaal Again." She is known for her versatility and ability to portray both dramatic and comedic roles with equal finesse.

item.title: Preity Zinta
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Preity Zinta

Bollywood Female Actor

Preity Zinta is a prominent Indian actress and entrepreneur known for her work in Hindi films. Born on January 31, 1975, in Shimla, Himachal Pradesh, India, Preity began her acting career in the late 1990s and quickly gained recognition for her vivacious and charming on-screen presence.

 

She made her debut with the film "Dil Se" in 1998, but it was her performance in "Soldier" in the same year that earned her critical acclaim and a Filmfare Award for Best Female Debut. Preity went on to deliver several memorable performances in films like "Kya Kehna," "Kal Ho Naa Ho," and "Veer-Zaara."

 

Preity Zinta is admired for her versatility, effortlessly transitioning between roles that showcase her range as an actress. She has excelled in both romantic comedies and intense dramas, captivating audiences with her talent and charisma.

item.title: Pooja Bhatt
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Pooja Bhatt

Bollywood Female Actor

Pooja Bhatt is an Indian actress, filmmaker, and producer known for her contributions to Hindi cinema. She was born on February 24, 1972, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. Pooja is the daughter of renowned filmmaker Mahesh Bhatt and belongs to a family deeply rooted in the Indian film industry.

 

She made her acting debut at the age of 17 with the film "Daddy" in 1989, which was directed by her father. Pooja's performance was widely appreciated, and she went on to star in several successful films like "Dil Hai Ke Manta Nahin," "Sadak," and "Junoon."

 

Pooja Bhatt also ventured into filmmaking and production, starting her own production company called Fish Eye Network. She directed and produced notable films like "Paap," "Jism," and "Zakhm." Her work as a filmmaker has been known for tackling bold and unconventional subjects.

item.title: Pooja Chopra
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Pooja Chopra

Bollywood Female Actor

Pooja Chopra is an Indian actress and model who primarily works in Hindi films. She was born on May 3, 1985, in Kolkata, West Bengal, India. Pooja rose to fame after winning the Miss India World title in 2009, representing her home state of Jammu and Kashmir.

 

She made her acting debut in the film "Commando: A One Man Army" in 2013, where she played the female lead opposite Vidyut Jammwal. Pooja's performance in the action-packed film was well-received, and she garnered praise for her on-screen presence and action sequences.

 

Pooja Chopra has since appeared in films like "Yea Toh Two Much Ho Gayaa" and "Aiyaary." She has showcased her versatility by portraying a variety of characters, ranging from romantic dramas to action-oriented roles.

item.title: Patralekha
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Patralekha

Bollywood Female Actor

Patralekha, whose real name is Anwita Paul, is an Indian actress known for her work in Hindi cinema. She was born on February 20, 1990, in Shillong, Meghalaya, India. Patralekha made her acting debut in Bollywood with the critically acclaimed film "CityLights" in 2014, directed by Hansal Mehta and produced by Mahesh Bhatt.

 

Her performance as Rakhi, a woman struggling with poverty and adversity, garnered praise from critics and established her as a promising actress. Patralekha's realistic portrayal of the character earned her the Best Female Debut award at several prestigious award ceremonies.

 

Following her successful debut, she appeared in films like "Love Games" and "Nanu Ki Jaanu." Patralekha has showcased her versatility by exploring different genres and characters, displaying her acting skills.

item.title: Pooja Bedi
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Pooja Bedi

Bollywood Female Actor

Pooja Bedi is an Indian actress, television presenter, and social activist. She was born on May 11, 1970, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. Pooja comes from a prominent film family, as her father is veteran actor Kabir Bedi and her mother is late dancer Protima Bedi.

 

She made her acting debut in Bollywood with the film "Vishkanya" in 1991. Pooja gained recognition for her bold and unconventional roles in films like "Jo Jeeta Wohi Sikandar" and "Phir Teri Kahani Yaad Aayee." She was known for her glamorous and rebellious image, breaking stereotypes with her on-screen presence.

 

Pooja Bedi has also appeared in various television shows as a host and participant. She was a contestant on the reality show "Bigg Boss" in 2011 and has been associated with other reality programs like "Nach Baliye" and "Maa Exchange." Her frank and outspoken personality has made her a popular figure in the Indian television industry.

item.title: Payal Ghosh
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Nushrat Bharucha

Bollywood Female Actor

Payal Ghosh is an Indian actress known for her work in Hindi and Telugu films. She was born on November 13, 1989, in Kolkata, West Bengal, India. Payal started her acting career in the Telugu film industry with the movie "Prayanam" in 2009.

 

She made her Bollywood debut with the film "Patel Ki Punjabi Shaadi" in 2017, where she shared the screen with veteran actors Paresh Rawal and Rishi Kapoor. Payal has also appeared in other Hindi films like "Red" and "Jai Mata Di."

 

In 2020, Payal Ghosh made headlines when she accused filmmaker Anurag Kashyap of sexual misconduct. Her accusation sparked a controversy and led to a series of legal actions and investigations.

item.title: Pia Bajpiee
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Pia Bajpiee

Bollywood Female Actor

Pia Bajpiee, also known as Piaa Bajpai, is an Indian actress who primarily works in the South Indian film industry. She was born on December 27, 1989, in Etawah, Uttar Pradesh, India.

 

Pia Bajpiee made her acting debut in the Tamil film industry with the movie "Poi Solla Porom" in 2008. She gained recognition for her role in the critically acclaimed Tamil film "Aegan" (2008), in which she starred alongside Ajith Kumar. Pia subsequently appeared in several Tamil, Telugu, and Malayalam films, showcasing her acting skills and versatility.

 

Some of Pia Bajpiee's notable movies include "Ko" (2011), "Goa" (2010), "Ninnu Kalisaka" (2009), and "Laal Rang" (2016). She has worked with renowned directors and actors in the South Indian film industry.

 

In addition to her work in regional cinema, Pia has also ventured into Hindi films. She appeared in the Bollywood movie "Mirza Juuliet" in 2017, playing the lead role. She has also been part of web series such as "Jamai 2.0" and "Virgin Bhasskar."

item.title: Plabita Borthakur
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Plabita Borthakur

Bollywood Female Actor

Plabita Borthakur is an Indian actress and singer who primarily works in the Hindi film industry. She was born on April 13, 1990, in Duliajan, Assam, India.

 

Plabita made her acting debut with the critically acclaimed film "PK" in 2014, directed by Rajkumar Hirani. However, it was her role as Rehana in the coming-of-age film "Lipstick Under My Burkha" (2016) that brought her widespread recognition and critical acclaim. Her performance in the film, which dealt with themes of female sexuality and liberation, garnered praise for its authenticity and portrayal of a rebellious young woman.

 

Following the success of "Lipstick Under My Burkha," Plabita appeared in other Hindi films such as "Judgementall Hai Kya" (2019) and "Ghost Stories" (2020). She also made her debut in the Telugu film industry with the movie "Falaknuma Das" (2019).

Pooja Batra

Pooja Batra is an Indian actress and model. She was born on October 27, 1976, in Faizabad, Uttar Pradesh, India. Pooja Batra began her career as a model and gained recognition after winning the Femina Miss India International title in 1993. She then represented India at the Miss International pageant, where she was crowned as the Miss International 1993.

 

After her successful stint in the beauty pageant, Pooja Batra made her Bollywood debut with the film "Vishwavidhaata" in 1997. She went on to appear in several Hindi films, including "Virasat" (1997), "Haseena Maan Jaayegi" (1999), and "Nayak: The Real Hero" (2001), among others. Pooja Batra also acted in Tamil, Telugu, and Malayalam films.

Prachi Shah is an Indian actress known for her work in Hindi and Marathi films and television shows. She was born on 7th April 1975 in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. Shah started her acting career at a young age and has been active in the industry for over two decades.

 

Prachi Shah has appeared in several popular television serials. She gained recognition for her role as Meera in the Hindi serial "Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi," which aired from 2000 to 2008. Her portrayal of Meera, a strong-willed and independent character, won her a lot of appreciation from the audience. She has also appeared in other notable TV shows like "Sarabhai vs Sarabhai," "Kahani Ghar Ghar Ki," and "Ek Shringaar-Swabhiman," among others.

 

In addition to television, Prachi Shah has worked in films, predominantly in Marathi cinema. She has acted in movies like "Natha Pure Ata" (2012), "Bhola Shankar" (2014), and "Family Katta" (2016). Her performances in these films have been well-received by the audience and critics

item.title: Poonam Dhillon
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Nushrat Bharucha

Bollywood Female Actor

Nushrat Bharucha is an Indian actress known for her work primarily in Hindi cinema. She was born on May 17, 1985, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. Nushrat made her acting debut in 2006 with the film "Jai Santoshi Maa," but gained recognition and popularity with her role in the romantic comedy "Pyaar Ka Punchnama" in 2011.

 

Her portrayal of the character Neha in "Pyaar Ka Punchnama" garnered her widespread acclaim, and she became known for her ability to portray lively and relatable characters. Nushrat further solidified her position in the industry with successful films like "Pyaar Ka Punchnama 2," "Sonu Ke Titu Ki Sweety," and "Dream Girl."

 

With her girl-next-door charm and impeccable comic timing, Nushrat has won the hearts of audiences. She is admired for her versatility and has showcased her acting skills in a range of genres, including comedy, romance, and drama.

Pranoti Pradhan

Bollywood Female Actor

Pranoti Pradhan is a talented actress who has made a significant mark in the entertainment industry with her exceptional acting prowess. Born with a natural flair for performing arts, Pranoti embarked on her acting journey at a young age, captivating audiences with her charm and versatility.

 

With her radiant smile and expressive eyes, Pranoti has the ability to bring characters to life, effortlessly immersing herself in their emotions and experiences. Whether it's portraying a strong-willed protagonist or a vulnerable supporting role, she delivers performances that resonate with audiences on a profound level.

 

Pranoti's dedication to her craft is evident in the meticulous preparation she undertakes for each role. She has a remarkable ability to delve deep into the psyche of her characters, exploring their complexities and bringing out their nuances with finesse. Her commitment to authenticity and attention to detail make her performances captivating and relatable.

Rashi Mal

Bollywood Female Actor

Rashi Mal is a remarkable individual who has made significant contributions in her chosen field. With a passion for entrepreneurship and a drive for success, she has become a prominent figure in the business world. Rashi's entrepreneurial journey began at a young age, and she has since established herself as a visionary leader.

 

Rashi's innovative thinking and determination have led her to create several successful startups. Her ability to identify market gaps and develop creative solutions has earned her recognition and respect within the industry. Through her ventures, she has not only generated substantial revenue but also provided employment opportunities for many.

 

Despite her achievements, Rashi remains humble and grounded. She values teamwork and fosters a collaborative work environment, empowering her employees to thrive. Her leadership style is characterized by integrity, resilience, and a forward-thinking mindset.

 

Rashi Mal's journey serves as a testament to the power of determination, innovation, and philanthropy. Her contributions to the business world and society at large make her a role model for aspiring entrepreneurs and changemakers.

item.title: Ritika Singh
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Ritika Singh

Bollywood Female Actor

Ritika Singh is a talented and versatile Indian actress who has made a significant impact in the film industry. Born on December 16, 1994, in Mumbai, India, she entered the spotlight through her exceptional skills as a professional mixed martial artist. However, her passion for acting eventually led her to pursue a career in the entertainment world.

 

Ritika's breakthrough came with her debut film, "Irudhi Suttru" (Saala Khadoos in Hindi), in 2016, where she portrayed the role of a determined boxer. Her performance garnered critical acclaim and earned her several accolades, including the Filmfare Award for Best Female Debut - South.

 

Known for her dedication and commitment to her craft, Ritika continued to impress audiences with her subsequent performances in films like "Guru" and "Shivalinga." She effortlessly transitions between intense and emotional scenes, showcasing her versatility as an actress.

 

Beyond her acting abilities, Ritika's down-to-earth nature and charismatic personality have made her a favorite among fans. She has successfully carved a niche for herself in the industry, breaking stereotypes and challenging societal norms.

item.title: Naira Shah
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Naira Shah

Bollywood Female Actor

Naira Shah is an exceptional actor whose talent and versatility have made her a rising star in the entertainment industry. With her captivating performances and natural charisma, Naira has captivated audiences worldwide.

 

Born and raised in Mumbai, India, Naira Shah discovered her passion for acting at a young age. Her dedication and hard work led her to train in various acting techniques, honing her skills and preparing her for the demanding world of acting.

 

Naira's breakthrough came with her debut in a critically acclaimed indie film, where she showcased her ability to embody complex characters and deliver powerful performances. Her raw talent and ability to bring depth and authenticity to her roles quickly garnered attention from both critics and audiences alike.

 

Since then, Naira Shah has gone on to star in a diverse range of projects, including mainstream films, television dramas, and theater productions. Her ability to seamlessly transition between different genres and roles has solidified her reputation as a versatile actor.

 

Beyond her acting prowess, Naira is known for her philanthropic efforts, using her platform to raise awareness and support various social causes. Her dedication to her craft, coupled with her compassionate nature, has made her a role model for aspiring actors and individuals alike.

Rani Mukerji

Bollywood Female Actor

Rani Mukerji is an Indian actress who has made a significant impact on the Bollywood film industry. Born on March 21, 1978, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, she comes from a film-oriented family. Rani made her acting debut in 1997 with the film "Raja Ki Aayegi Baraat" but achieved widespread recognition and critical acclaim for her performance in the crime thriller "Ghulam" (1998).

 

Rani Mukerji went on to star in numerous successful films, displaying her versatility and talent as an actress. Some of her notable movies include "Kuch Kuch Hota Hai" (1998), "Black" (2005), "Hum Tum" (2004), and "Mardaani" (2014). She has received several awards, including multiple Filmfare Awards, for her performances in these films.

 

Known for her strong screen presence and ability to portray complex characters, Rani has been praised for her intense performances, particularly in roles that explore social issues and women empowerment. She continues to be a respected and influential figure in the Indian film

item.title: Raveena Tandone
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Raveena Tandon

Bollywood Female Actor

Raveena Tandon is an Indian film actress, producer, and television personality who has primarily worked in Hindi cinema. She was born on October 26, 1974, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India.

 

Raveena Tandon made her acting debut with the film "Patthar Ke Phool" in 1991, for which she received the Filmfare Award for Lux New Face of the Year. She gained popularity and critical acclaim for her performances in films like "Andaz Apna Apna" (1994), "Mohra" (1994), and "Laadla" (1994). Raveena's portrayal of strong, independent, and feisty characters resonated with the audience.

 

In the 1990s, Raveena Tandon established herself as one of the leading actresses in Bollywood. She appeared in a wide range of films, including romantic dramas, comedies, and action thrillers. Some of her notable movies from that era include "Dilwale" (1994), "Ziddi" (1997), and "Ghulam-E-Mustafa" (1997).

 

Raveena Tandon is also known for her performances in socially relevant films. She received critical acclaim and won the National Film Award for Best Actress for her role in the hard-hitting film "Daman: A Victim of Marital Violence" (2001).

item.title: Richa Chadda
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Richa Chadha

Bollywood Female Actor

Richa Chadha is an Indian actress who predominantly works in Hindi cinema. She was born on December 18, 1986, in Amritsar, Punjab, India.

 

Richa Chadha began her acting career in 2008 with a small role in the critically acclaimed film "Oye Lucky! Lucky Oye!" directed by Dibakar Banerjee. However, she gained widespread recognition and critical acclaim for her portrayal of Nagma Khatoon in the film "Gangs of Wasseypur" (2012), directed by Anurag Kashyap. Her performance in the film garnered her several awards and nominations.

 

Following her breakthrough, Richa Chadha appeared in a variety of films, showcasing her versatility as an actress. Some of her notable movies include "Fukrey" (2013) and its sequel "Fukrey Returns" (2017), "Masaan" (2015), "Sarbjit" (2016), and "Section 375" (2019). She has worked with renowned directors and actors, delivering powerful performances that have earned her critical acclaim.

item.title: Riya Sen
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Riya Sen

Bollywood Female Actor

Riya Sen is an Indian film actress and model. She was born on January 24, 1981, in Kolkata, West Bengal, India. Riya comes from a family with a strong connection to the film industry; her mother is actress Moon Moon Sen, and her grandmother was legendary actress Suchitra Sen.

 

Riya Sen made her acting debut as a child artist in the Bengali film "Vishkanya" in 1991. She then appeared in various commercials and music videos before transitioning to full-fledged acting in Hindi and Bengali films.

 

In Bollywood, Riya Sen gained prominence for her roles in movies like "Style" (2001), "Jhankaar Beats" (2003), and "Apna Sapna Money Money" (2006). She was known for her glamorous on-screen presence and worked alongside popular actors during her career.

 

Apart from Hindi films, Riya has also acted in several Bengali movies, including "Rokto Korobi" (2000), "Noukadubi" (2011), and "Dark Chocolate" (2016). She received critical acclaim for her performances in Bengali cinema.

item.title: Rajshri Deshpande
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Rajshri Deshpande

Bollywood Female Actor

Rajshri Deshpande is an Indian actress known for her work in both Hindi and international cinema. She was born on October 14, 1988, in Aurangabad, Maharashtra, India.

Rajshri Deshpande gained recognition for her role in the critically acclaimed Indian drama film "Angry Indian Goddesses" in 2015. Her performance as Laxmi, a housewife dealing with societal pressures, received widespread acclaim and established her as a talented actress.

In addition to her work in Indian cinema, Rajshri Deshpande has also made a mark on the international stage. She portrayed the character of Shalini in the Netflix miniseries "Sacred Games" (2018), based on the novel by Vikram Chandra. Her performance in the series garnered international recognition and praise.

Rajshri Deshpande is known for taking up roles that challenge societal norms and shed light on important social issues. She has been associated with films and projects that tackle topics such as gender equality, sexuality, and women's empowerment.

Apart from her acting skills, Ritika is also a social media sensation, with a substantial following across various platforms. Her vibrant and relatable content has resonated with the younger generation, making her a popular influencer.

 

Beyond her professional achievements, Ritika is known for her down-to-earth nature and positive attitude. She is passionate about using her platform to spread awareness about social issues and actively participates in charitable initiatives.

item.title: Riddhi Dogra
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Riddhi Dogra

Bollywood Female Actor

Riddhi Dogra is a talented and versatile Indian actress who has left an indelible mark on the entertainment industry. Born on September 22, 1984, in New Delhi, Riddhi's journey in the world of acting began with her debut in the popular TV show "Jhoome Jiya Re" in 2007. Since then, she has captivated audiences with her impeccable acting skills and charismatic screen presence.

 

Riddhi Dogra has portrayed a wide range of characters, showcasing her versatility as an actress. From intense and dramatic roles to light-hearted and comedic ones, she has effortlessly brought each character to life, leaving a lasting impact on viewers. Her performances in shows like "Maryada: Lekin Kab Tak?" and "Woh Apna Sa" have garnered critical acclaim and earned her a loyal fan base.

 

Beyond her acting prowess, Riddhi is also known for her striking beauty and elegant fashion sense. Her style statements have made her a fashion icon in the industry, inspiring countless fans to emulate her unique and trendy looks.

Rasika Dugal

Bollywood Female Actor

Rasika Dugal is an Indian actress known for her work in both film and television. She was born on January 17, 1985, in Jamshedpur, Jharkhand, India.

 

Rasika Dugal gained recognition for her performances in various critically acclaimed films and web series. Some of her notable works include the films "Qissa" (2013), "Manto" (2018), and "Hamid" (2019). In these films, she showcased her acting prowess and received positive reviews for her nuanced performances.

 

In addition to films, Rasika Dugal has also made a mark in the digital entertainment space. She appeared in several web series, including "Mirzapur," where she played the character of Beena Tripathi, and "Delhi Crime," where she portrayed the role of Neeti Singh. Her performances in these series were widely appreciated, and she garnered a significant fan following.

 

Rasika Dugal's acting skills and ability to portray diverse characters have made her a respected figure in the Indian entertainment industry. She continues to be a part of interesting projects, both in films and digital platforms, showcasing her talent and versatility as an actress.

item.title: Ruhi Singh
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Ruhi Dilip Singh

Bollywood Female Actor

Ruhi Dilip Singh is an accomplished Indian actress and model known for her appearances in Hindi films and television. Her journey to fame began when she was crowned 1st Runner up at Femina Miss India East 2011. Later, she won the title of Miss Universal Peace and Humanity in 2014.

 

Her acting career took off with the drama film "Calendar Girls" in 2015, directed by Madhur Bhandarkar, who was impressed by her work in a Canadian documentary. She gained further recognition for her roles in the Emmy-nominated documentary "The World Before Her" and popular web series like "Chakravyuh" and "Runaway Lugai."

 

In 2020, she was spotlighted among The Times' "50 Desirable Women of 2020," and her popularity continued to rise. She received critical acclaim for her performances in the series "Chakravyuh" and "Runaway Lugai," and both shows achieved significant success.

 

Ruhi Singh's talent and online presence with over 12 million followers on social media platforms have made her one of the most influential artists among the youth. Her upcoming Netflix original show, "Social Currency," is highly anticipated and slated for release in early 2022.

item.title: Swara Bhaskar
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Swara Bhaskar

Bollywood Female Actor

Swara Bhaskar is an Indian actress and activist known for her work in Hindi cinema. She was born on April 9, 1988, in Delhi, India. Swara initially gained recognition for her performances in supporting roles and has since established herself as a versatile actress.

 

Swara made her acting debut in 2009 with the film "Madholal Keep Walking." She gained critical acclaim and attention for her role in the coming-of-age film "Tanu Weds Manu" (2011) and its sequel "Tanu Weds Manu Returns" (2015). Her portrayal of the character Payal in the movies was widely appreciated, and she received several nominations and awards for her performances.

 

Swara Bhaskar has showcased her versatility by taking on diverse roles in films that tackle social issues and explore unconventional narratives. She has appeared in movies like "Raanjhanaa" (2013), "Nil Battey Sannata" (2016), "Anaarkali of Aarah" (2017), and "Veere Di Wedding" (2018). Her performances have been lauded for their depth and authenticity.

 

Apart from her film career, Swara is actively involved in social and political activism. She has been vocal about various social issues, including gender equality, women's rights, and freedom of expression. Swara has participated in protests and has used her platform to raise awareness and advocate for change.

Bollywood Female Actor

Navni Parihar is a talented Indian actress known for her notable work in the Hindi film and television industry. With her natural acting prowess and versatility, she has captivated audiences with her performances.

 

Navni Parihar has showcased her talent across various mediums, including films, television serials, and web series. She has appeared in several popular movies, portraying diverse characters with conviction and depth. Her ability to bring authenticity and emotional depth to her roles has garnered her critical acclaim and a dedicated fan base.

 

In addition to her film work, Navni Parihar has also made a significant impact on television. She has been part of successful television serials and has portrayed memorable characters that resonate with the audience. Her ability to adapt to different genres and portray both positive and negative roles with equal finesse has established her as a versatile actress in the industry.

item.title: Niharika Lyra Dutt
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Niharika Lyra Dutt

Bollywood Female Actor

Niharika Lyra Dutt is an Indian actress known for her work in films and web series. She was born on March 10, 1990, in Delhi, India. Niharika has garnered attention and praise for her performances in projects like "The Bizarre Murder of Mr Tusker," "Paatal Lok," and "Die Trying."

 

With her talent and versatility, Niharika has made a mark in the entertainment industry. Her acting skills have been showcased in different genres, allowing her to display her range as an actress. "The Bizarre Murder of Mr Tusker" is one of the projects that has brought her recognition. The film tells a mysterious and intriguing story, and Niharika's performance has captivated audiences.

 

In 2020, Niharika gained further acclaim for her role in the highly acclaimed web series "Paatal Lok." The series, produced by Amazon Prime Video, delves into the dark underbelly of Indian society and received critical acclaim for its gripping storytelling and performances. Niharika's portrayal in the series added depth to the narrative and showcased her acting prowess.

 

Prior to "Paatal Lok," Niharika also appeared in the web series "Die Trying" in 2018. The series revolves around the struggles and adventures of aspiring musicians and has been well-received by viewers.
