item.title: Swaroop Sampat
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Swaroop Sampat

Bollywood Female Actor

Swaroop Sampat is an Indian actress and former beauty queen. She was born on November 3, 1958, in Mumbai, India. Swaroop gained fame for her work in both Bollywood films and Indian television shows.

 

Swaroop Sampat won the Miss India title in 1979 and later represented India at the Miss Universe pageant. She made her acting debut in Bollywood with the film "Naram Garam" in 1981, where she played the lead role opposite Amol Palekar. She went on to appear in films like "Krodhi" (1981), "Yeh Desh" (1984), and "Saath Saath" (1982).

 

While Swaroop had a notable career in films, she achieved significant popularity through her work on Indian television. She became a household name with her portrayal of the character "Renu" in the hit television sitcom "Yeh Jo Hai Zindagi" (1984). Her comic timing and natural acting skills made her a favorite among viewers.

 

Swaroop Sampat took a break from acting after her marriage to renowned actor Paresh Rawal. However, she made a comeback to the screen with notable appearances in films like "Ki & Ka" (2016) and "The Tashkent Files" (2019). She has also acted in Gujarati films and continues to be associated with the entertainment industry.

item.title: Sushmita Sen
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Sushmita Sen

Bollywood Female Actor

Sushmita Sen is an Indian actress, model, and beauty queen who was crowned Miss Universe in 1994. She was born on November 19, 1975, in Hyderabad, India. Sushmita is known for her significant contributions to the Indian film industry and her empowering presence as a public figure.

 

Sushmita made history by becoming the first Indian woman to win the Miss Universe title at the age of 18. Her victory brought pride to the nation and established her as a symbol of grace and beauty. Following her win, she pursued a career in acting.

 

In Bollywood, Sushmita Sen made her acting debut with the film "Dastak" in 1996. She went on to appear in a variety of films, showcasing her versatility as an actress. Some of her notable movies include "Biwi No.1" (1999), "Main Hoon Na" (2004), and "Aarya" (2020), which marked her successful debut in the digital streaming space.

 

Sushmita's performances have been praised for their elegance and charisma. She has portrayed strong, independent women on screen and has been recognized for her acting skills. Sushmita's magnetic presence and captivating performances have earned her a dedicated fan following.

 

In addition to her acting career, Sushmita Sen is known for her philanthropy and advocacy work. She has been involved in various charitable initiatives, especially those related to child welfare and education. Sushmita is also known for her positive outlook on life and her empowering messages to women.

item.content:encoded:
Surveen Chawla

Bollywood Female Actor

Surveen Chawla is an Indian actress known for her work in Hindi and Punjabi films, as well as in Indian television shows. She was born on August 1, 1984, in Chandigarh, India.

 

Surveen Chawla began her acting career in the television industry and gained popularity with her roles in shows like "Kahiin to Hoga" and "Kasautii Zindagii Kay." She transitioned to the big screen with her debut in the Punjabi film industry in 2011 with the movie "Dharti." Her performance in the film was well-received, and she went on to act in several Punjabi films, including "Taur Mittran Di" (2012), "Saadi Love Story" (2013), and "Disco Singh" (2014).

 

In Bollywood, Surveen Chawla made her mark with her role in the critically acclaimed film "Hate Story 2" (2014), where she portrayed a bold and strong character. She also appeared in movies like "Ugly" (2014), "Parched" (2015), and "Welcome Back" (2015).

 

Surveen Chawla's performances have garnered praise for their intensity and versatility. She has portrayed a range of characters, from romantic leads to complex and layered roles. Her acting skills, combined with her striking screen presence, have made her a notable actress in the industry.

item.content:encoded:
Supriya Shukla

Bollywood Female Actor

Supriya Shukla is an Indian actress known for her work in Hindi television shows and films. She was born on January 14, 1967, in India. Supriya has established herself as a talented actress with her memorable performances.

 

Supriya Shukla made her acting debut on television and gained recognition for her portrayal of the character Laboni Banerjee in the popular TV show "Tere Liye." She went on to appear in numerous television series, showcasing her versatility as an actress. Some of her notable TV shows include "Sasural Genda Phool," "Yeh Un Dinon Ki Baat Hai," and "Kasautii Zindagii Kay."

 

In addition to her television work, Supriya Shukla has also acted in films. She has appeared in supporting roles in Hindi movies like "Tere Naam" (2003), "Bhool Bhulaiyaa" (2007), and "Wake Up Sid" (2009). Her performances have been appreciated for their authenticity and natural acting style.

 

Supriya Shukla's portrayals often bring a touch of relatability and emotional depth to her characters. She is known for her ability to bring out the nuances of the roles she plays, making them memorable and impactful.

item.title: Supriya Pathak
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Supriya Pathak

Bollywood Female Actor

Supriya Pathak is an Indian film and television actress known for her versatile performances in Hindi cinema. She was born on January 7, 1961, in Mumbai, India. Supriya Pathak comes from a renowned family of actors, with her mother Dina Pathak and sister Ratna Pathak Shah also being prominent figures in the industry.

 

Supriya Pathak made her acting debut with the critically acclaimed film "Kalyug" in 1981. However, she gained widespread recognition and acclaim for her portrayal of the character Hansa Parekh in the popular television sitcom "Khichdi" and its spin-off show "Instant Khichdi." Her comedic timing and impeccable delivery of dialogues made her a household name and endeared her to audiences.

 

In addition to her successful television career, Supriya Pathak has also showcased her talent in Hindi films. She has appeared in movies like "Bazaar" (1982), "Masoom" (1983), "Ram-Leela" (2013), and "Goliyon Ki Raasleela Ram-Leela" (2013), among others. Her performances have been praised for their depth and authenticity, earning her critical acclaim and several awards.

 

Supriya Pathak's ability to effortlessly portray both comedic and dramatic roles has made her a respected actress in the industry. She has the innate ability to bring life to her characters and has often left a lasting impact on the audience.

item.content:encoded:
Surbhi Jyoti

Television Female Actor

Surbhi Jyoti is an Indian actress who primarily works in the Hindi television industry. She was born on May 29, 1988, in Jalandhar, Punjab, India. Surbhi gained immense popularity for her role as Zoya Farooqui in the television series "Qubool Hai," which aired from 2012 to 2016. Her portrayal of the character earned her critical acclaim and a massive fan following.

 

After the success of "Qubool Hai," Surbhi went on to appear in various other television shows, including "Koi Laut Ke Aaya Hai," "Naagin 3," and "Naagin 4." She is known for her versatile acting skills and has won several awards for her performances.

 

Apart from television, Surbhi Jyoti has also made appearances in web series and films. She made her digital debut with the web series "Tanhaiyan" in 2017. Surbhi has also acted in Punjabi films like "Raula Pai Gaya" and "Munde Patiala De."

Surbhi Chandna

Television Female Actor

Surbhi Chandna is an Indian television actress known for her work in the Hindi television industry. She was born on September 11, 1989, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. However, she eventually developed an interest in acting and decided to pursue it professionally.

Her performances in these shows earned her critical acclaim and a large fan following. Surbhi is known for her versatile acting skills, charming screen presence, and ability to connect with the audience.

 

Apart from her television work, Surbhi has also made appearances in various reality shows and hosted award ceremonies. She has won several awards for her performances, including the Indian Television Academy Awards and the Gold Awards.

item.title: Sunny Leone
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Sunny Leone

Bollywood Female Actor

Sunny Leone, born on May 13, 1981, as Karenjit Kaur Vohra, is a Canadian-born Indian-American actress, model, and former adult film star. She gained prominence in India after participating in the reality TV show "Bigg Boss" in 2011. Sunny Leone made her Bollywood debut in 2012 with the film "Jism 2" and has since appeared in several Hindi films.

 

Known for her attractive looks and bold on-screen persona, Sunny Leone has carved a niche for herself in the Indian film industry. She has starred in movies like "Ragini MMS 2," "Ek Paheli Leela," and "Tera Intezaar," among others. Apart from films, she has also made special appearances in item songs and has been a part of web series.

 

Sunny Leone is admired for her professionalism, business acumen, and philanthropic endeavors. She has launched her own line of perfumes, a makeup brand, and a lingerie brand. Additionally, she actively supports various charitable causes and has been involved in campaigns promoting animal rights and HIV/AIDS awareness.

 

Sunny Leone has a massive fan following and remains a popular figure in the entertainment industry. She continues to work on diverse projects, maintaining her status as one of the most recognizable and influential personalities in the Indian film fraternity.

item.title: Suchitra Pillai
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Suchitra Pillai

Bollywood Female Actor

Suchitra Pillai is an Indian actress, model, and singer who predominantly works in Indian films and television. She was born on August 27, 1970, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. Suchitra Pillai started her career as a model and gained recognition for her appearances in numerous print and television advertisements. She made her acting debut in the Bollywood film "Dil Chahta Hai" in 2001, where she played a supporting role. Her performance in the film was well-received, and she went on to work in various Hindi films, including "Page 3," "Laaga Chunari Mein Daag," and "Fashion." Apart from films, Suchitra Pillai has also been active in the Indian television industry. She has appeared in popular TV shows such as "Beintehaa," "24," and "Beyhadh." Her performances in these shows showcased her versatility as an actress. In addition to acting, Suchitra is a talented singer and has lent her voice to several songs in films and independent music albums. She has performed live at various music events and has collaborated with renowned musicians. Suchitra Pillai is known for her elegant and sophisticated screen presence. She has received critical acclaim for her acting skills and ability to portray diverse characters convincingly. She continues to be a respected figure in the Indian entertainment industry.

item.title: Suchitra Krishnamurthy
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Suchitra Krishnamoorthi

Bollywood Female Actor

Suchitra Krishnamoorthi is an Indian actress, singer, and writer who has worked in Hindi films and music. She was born on November 27, 1975, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India.

 

Suchitra began her career in the entertainment industry as a model and gained recognition for her appearances in various print and television advertisements. She made her acting debut in the critically acclaimed film "Kabhi Haan Kabhi Naa" in 1994, where she played the female lead opposite Shah Rukh Khan. Her performance in the film was well-received, and she went on to work in movies like "Dil Pe Mat Le Yaar!!," "Fiza," and "Main Madhuri Dixit Banna Chahti Hoon."

 

Apart from acting, Suchitra Krishnamoorthi has pursued a career in music. She released her debut pop album "Dole Dole" in 2000, which garnered popularity and established her as a singer. She has since released several albums and has performed in various music concerts and shows.

 

Suchitra has also showcased her writing skills through her blog and authored a book titled "Drama Queen," which offers insights into her personal experiences and journey in the entertainment industry.

 

In recent years, Suchitra Krishnamoorthi has been actively involved in theater and has performed in plays like "Dinner with Friends" and "My Name is Gauhar Jaan."

item.title: Sonnalli Seygall

item.content:encoded:
Sonnalli Seygall

Bollywood Female Actor

Sonnalli Seygall is an Indian actress and model who primarily works in Hindi films. She was born on May 1, 1989, in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, India.

 

Sonnalli began her career in the entertainment industry as a model and gained attention for her beauty and charisma. She made her acting debut in Bollywood with the film "Pyaar Ka Punchnama" in 2011, directed by Luv Ranjan. Her portrayal of Rhea in the film was well-received, and it earned her recognition and popularity among the audience.

 

Following her debut, Sonnalli Seygall went on to work in films like "Pyaar Ka Punchnama 2," where she reprised her role as Rhea, and "Wedding Pullav." She has also appeared in supporting roles in movies such as "Sonu Ke Titu Ki Sweety" and "Jai Mummy Di."

 

Sonnalli is known for her fresh and vibrant on-screen presence, and she has often portrayed modern and relatable characters. She has showcased her talent for comedy and has garnered appreciation for her comedic timing.

 

Apart from her film career, Sonnalli Seygall has also been associated with various brands as a model and has appeared in commercials and endorsements.

item.title: Tara Sutaria
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Tara Sutaria

Bollywood Female Actor

Tara Sutaria is an Indian actress, singer, and dancer who primarily works in Bollywood. She was born on November 19, 1995, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India.

 

Tara Sutaria made her acting debut with the film "Student of the Year 2" in 2019, produced by Dharma Productions. Her performance in the film garnered attention and marked her entry into the film industry. She starred alongside Tiger Shroff and Ananya Panday in the movie.

 

Prior to her acting career, Tara Sutaria was trained in classical ballet, modern dance, and Latin American dances. She has also been a part of various musical theater productions, including Disney's "Beauty and the Beast" and "Grease."

 

In addition to acting, Tara Sutaria is a skilled singer. She has lent her voice to several Bollywood songs and has showcased her singing talent on various platforms. Her debut as a playback singer was with the film "Taare Zameen Par" in 2007.

 

After her debut in "Student of the Year 2," Tara Sutaria starred in the romantic action film "Marjaavaan" (2019), alongside Sidharth Malhotra. She has also been a part of the ensemble cast in the film "Tadap" (2021).

item.title: Tisca Chopra
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Tisca Chopra

Bollywood Female Actor

Tisca Chopra is an Indian actress, author, and film producer known for her work in Hindi cinema and the Indian television industry. She was born on November 1, 1973, in Kasauli, Himachal Pradesh, India.

 

Tisca Chopra made her acting debut in the television series "Kahaani Ghar Ghar Kii" in 2003, where she portrayed the character of "Tanya." She gained popularity and recognition for her role in the show. Tisca has also appeared in other television series like "Astitva...Ek Prem Kahani" and "24," which was the Indian adaptation of the American TV series.

 

In Bollywood, Tisca Chopra has acted in various films and has showcased her versatility as an actress. She has appeared in movies such as "Taare Zameen Par," where she played the mother of the lead character, and "Rahasya," a suspense thriller in which she portrayed the lead role. Tisca has also been a part of films like "Qissa," "The Hungry," and "Good Newwz," among others.

 

Apart from her acting career, Tisca Chopra is an author and has written the book "Acting Smart: Your Ticket to Showbiz," which provides insights and guidance for aspiring actors. She is also involved in theater productions and has performed in various stage plays.

item.title: Tara Sharma
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Tara Sharma

Bollywood Female Actor

Tara Sharma is an Indian actress and television host. She was born on January 11, 1977, in Mumbai, India. Tara started her acting career in Bollywood in the late 1990s and early 2000s, appearing in films like "Om Jai Jagadish" (2002) and "Masti" (2004). However, she gained more recognition for her roles in television shows.

 

Tara Sharma became well-known as the host of the talk show "The Tara Sharma Show," which aired on television from 2008 to 2010. The show focused on parenting and family-related topics and featured discussions with celebrity guests. It was widely appreciated for its informative and engaging content.

 

Aside from her acting and hosting career, Tara Sharma is also actively involved in various social causes. She is an advocate for children's rights and education and has been associated with organizations like Save the Children India. She uses her platform to raise awareness about important issues and often participates in charity events and campaigns.

item.title: Tina Desai
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Tina Desai

Bollywood Female Actor

Tina Desai is an Indian actress and model. She was born on February 24, 1987, in Bangalore, India. Tina started her career as a model and gained recognition in the fashion industry before transitioning to acting.

 

Desai made her acting debut in 2011 with the critically acclaimed Indian film "Yeh Faasley." However, she gained international prominence for her role as Kala Dandekar in the Netflix original series "Sense8." The science fiction drama, created by the Wachowskis, ran from 2015 to 2018 and garnered a dedicated fan base worldwide.

 

Following her success in "Sense8," Tina Desai appeared in several international projects. She starred alongside Dev Patel in the 2015 drama film "The Second Best Exotic Marigold Hotel" and its 2018 sequel, "The Best Exotic Marigold Hotel." She also appeared in the Netflix anthology series "Black Mirror" in the episode titled "Hated in the Nation" in 2016.

 

In addition to her acting career, Tina Desai continues to work as a model and has appeared in advertising campaigns and fashion magazines. She has been praised for her versatile performances and has been recognized for her talent both in India and internationally.

item.title: Taapsee Pannu
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Taapsee Pannu

Bollywood Female Actor

Taapsee Pannu is an Indian actress known for her work in Hindi, Telugu, and Tamil cinema. She was born on August 1, 1987, in New Delhi, India. Taapsee began her acting career in the South Indian film industry before making her mark in Bollywood.

 

Taapsee made her acting debut with the Telugu film "Jhummandi Naadam" in 2010. She then appeared in several successful Telugu films, including "Mr. Perfect" (2011) and "Shadow" (2013). Her performance in these films earned her critical acclaim and established her as a promising talent.

 

In 2013, Taapsee Pannu made her Bollywood debut with the film "Chashme Baddoor." She subsequently appeared in movies like "Baby" (2015), "Pink" (2016), and "Naam Shabana" (2017), where she garnered significant praise for her acting skills. Her portrayal of strong, independent characters and her ability to handle diverse roles have been widely appreciated by both critics and audiences.

 

Over the years, Taapsee has been a part of several successful films, including "Badla" (2019), "Thappad" (2020), and "Haseen Dillruba" (2021). She has shown her versatility by taking on roles in various genres, ranging from intense dramas to comedies.

item.title: Tanvi Azmi
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Tanvi Azmi

Bollywood Female Actor

Tanvi Azmi is an Indian film and television actress. She was born on November 9, 1960, in Mumbai, India. Tanvi comes from a renowned family of actors, as she is the daughter of renowned Marathi actress Usha Kiran and sister of actress Shabana Azmi.

 

Tanvi Azmi has acted in a wide range of films in various languages, including Hindi, Marathi, and English. She made her acting debut in the Marathi film "Rajnigandha" in 1974 and gained critical acclaim for her performance. However, she took a break from acting after her marriage and made a comeback in the late 1990s.

 

In the later years of her career, Tanvi Azmi appeared in several notable Bollywood films and garnered praise for her acting skills. Some of her notable movies include "Dil Chahta Hai" (2001), "Veer-Zaara" (2004), "Bajirao Mastani" (2015), and "Tribhanga" (2021). She has portrayed diverse characters and displayed her versatility as an actress.

 

Tanvi Azmi has also worked extensively in Indian television. She has appeared in popular TV shows such as "Jeevanrekha," "Kora Kagaz," and "Vidya." Her performances on the small screen have been well-received by the audience.

item.title: Sonam Kapoor
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Sonam Kapoor Ahuja

Bollywood Female Actor

Sonam Kapoor Ahuja is an Indian actress and fashion icon who predominantly works in Hindi cinema. She was born on June 9, 1985, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India.

 

Sonam Kapoor made her acting debut in the film industry with the romantic drama "Saawariya" in 2007, directed by Sanjay Leela Bhansali. Although the film did not perform well at the box office, Sonam's performance received positive reviews, and she was recognized for her talent and screen presence.

 

She gained significant acclaim and commercial success with films like "Raanjhanaa," "Neerja," and "Pad Man." Her portrayal of Neerja Bhanot in the biographical drama "Neerja" earned her widespread critical acclaim and several awards, including a National Film Award for Best Actress.

 

Sonam Kapoor is known for her fashion-forward style and is considered one of the most stylish celebrities in the industry. She has graced the covers of numerous fashion magazines and is a prominent figure in the fashion world.

item.title: Sonam Bajwa
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Sonam Bajwa

Bollywood Female Actor

Sonam Bajwa is an Indian actress and model who primarily works in Punjabi and Tamil cinema. She was born on August 16, 1989, in Nanakmatta, Uttarakhand, India.

 

Sonam Bajwa began her career as a model and participated in the Femina Miss India contest in 2012. She then made her acting debut in the Punjabi film industry with the movie "Best of Luck" in 2013. Her performance in the film was well-received, and she quickly gained popularity in the Punjabi film industry.

 

She went on to work in several successful Punjabi films, including "Punjab 1984," "Carry on Jatta 2," and "Nikka Zaildar 2." Sonam has showcased her acting skills and versatility by portraying a range of characters in different genres, from romantic comedies to drama.

 

In addition to Punjabi cinema, Sonam Bajwa has also appeared in Tamil films. She made her Tamil debut with the movie "Kappal" in 2014 and has since worked in other Tamil films like "Maragadha Naanayam" and "Kaatteri."

 

Sonam is known for her charming screen presence, expressive eyes, and impeccable fashion sense. She has won several awards for her performances, including the PTC Punjabi Film Award for Best Actress.

item.title: Sonal Chauhan
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Sonal Chauhan

Bollywood Female Actor

Sonal Chauhan is an Indian actress, model, and singer. She was born on May 16, 1987, in Bulandshahr, Uttar Pradesh, India. Sonal began her career in the entertainment industry as a fashion model and made her acting debut in the 2008 Bollywood film "Jannat."

 

In "Jannat," Sonal played the female lead opposite Emraan Hashmi, and her performance was well-received by the audience and critics alike. She gained popularity for her beauty and acting skills. After her successful debut, Sonal appeared in several other Hindi films, including "Bbuddah... Hoga Terra Baap," "3G," and "Jack and Dil."

 

Apart from Bollywood, Sonal Chauhan has also worked in Telugu and Kannada cinema. She made her Telugu film debut with the movie "Rainbow" in 2008 and went on to act in films like "Legend" and "Sher." In the Kannada film industry, Sonal appeared in the film "Cheluveye Ninne Nodalu" in 2010.

 

In addition to acting, Sonal Chauhan has pursued a career in modeling. She has walked the ramp for numerous fashion shows and has appeared in several commercials and print advertisements. Sonal has also released a few singles as a singer.

item.title: Simone Singh
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Simone Singh

Bollywood Female Actor

Simone Singh is an Indian actress and model who was born on November 10, 1974, in Jamshedpur.

 

She started her acting career with the English language series "A Mouthful of Sky" and later appeared in the television series "Sea Hawks" in 1995. However, it was her role as Heena in the popular television series "Heena" that brought her widespread recognition and made her a household name. The show was highly rated and gained immense popularity during its run.

 

Simone Singh has received critical acclaim for her performances in various projects. She portrayed the character of Sakshi Goenka, a cunning and powerful woman, in the television series "Ek Hasina Thi." Her portrayal of the role was appreciated by both audiences and critics.

 

In addition to her television work, Simone Singh has also made notable appearances in films. She was praised for her role in the movie "Being Cyrus," where she starred alongside Boman Irani, Dimple Kapadia, and Saif Ali Khan. She played the iconic character of Camilla in the blockbuster film "Kal Ho Naa Ho" and delivered a memorable performance as Rukshar in "Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham."

item.title: Sonali Bendre
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Sonali Bendre

Bollywood Female Actor

Sonali Bendre is an Indian film actress and model. She was born on January 1, 1975, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India.

 

Sonali began her career in the entertainment industry as a model and made her acting debut in the Tamil film "Aag" in 1994. She gained popularity with her Bollywood debut in the movie "Aag" (1995), where she played a leading role. Sonali went on to star in several successful Hindi films, including "Sarfarosh," "Hum Saath-Saath Hain," "Diljale," "Major Saab," and "Kal Ho Naa Ho," among others. Her performances were appreciated, and she established herself as a talented actress in the industry.

 

Apart from Hindi cinema, Sonali Bendre has also worked in Telugu, Kannada, and Marathi films. She has acted alongside some of the biggest stars in the Indian film industry and has earned a reputation for her versatility and grace on screen.

 

In 2018, Sonali Bendre was diagnosed with high-grade metastatic cancer and underwent treatment. She showed immense strength and resilience throughout her battle with the disease and became an inspiration for many. She documented her journey on social media and shared her experiences to create awareness about cancer and the importance of early detection and self-care.

item.title: Soha Ali Khan
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Soha Ali Khan

Bollywood Female Actor

Soha Ali Khan is an Indian actress who primarily works in Hindi films. She was born on October 4, 1978, in New Delhi, India. Soha is the daughter of famous Indian cricketer Mansoor Ali Khan Pataudi and veteran Bollywood actress Sharmila Tagore. She is also the sister of Bollywood actor Saif Ali Khan.

 

Soha made her acting debut in the Bollywood film industry with the movie "Dil Maange More" in 2004. She gained recognition and critical acclaim for her performances in films like "Rang De Basanti," "Khoya Khoya Chand," "Mumbai Meri Jaan," and "Tum Mile." Her roles showcased her versatility as an actress and earned her praise from both critics and audiences.

 

Apart from Hindi films, Soha has also appeared in Bengali and English language movies. She has explored diverse genres and characters throughout her career. In addition to acting, Soha is an accomplished author and has written books like "The Perils of Being Moderately Famous" and "The ABCs of Parenting."

item.title: Shriya Pilgaonkar
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Shriya Pilgaonkar

Bollywood Female Actor

Shriya Pilgaonkar is an Indian actress, director, and producer known for her work in the Hindi and Marathi film industries. She was born on April 25, 1989, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. Shriya is the daughter of renowned actors Sachin Pilgaonkar and Supriya Pilgaonkar.

 

Shriya made her acting debut in the Marathi film "Ekulti Ek" in 2013, directed by her father Sachin Pilgaonkar. She gained recognition for her role in the film and went on to star in several Marathi movies, including "Un Plus Une" and "Adhyan." Shriya also made her mark in the Hindi film industry with her debut in the critically acclaimed movie "Fan" in 2016, starring alongside Shah Rukh Khan.

 

Apart from acting, Shriya Pilgaonkar has directed and produced short films. She has also worked in the digital space and appeared in web series such as "Mirzapur" and "The Gone Game," showcasing her versatility as an artist.

item.title: Shriya Saran
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Shriya Saran

Bollywood Female Actor

Shriya Saran, born on September 11, 1982, is an Indian actress and model who primarily works in the Telugu, Tamil, and Hindi film industries. She hails from Dehradun, Uttarakhand, India.

 

Shriya Saran made her acting debut in 2001 with the Telugu film "Ishtam" and gained recognition for her role in the film "Santhosham" (2002). She then appeared in several Telugu films, including "Tagore" (2003), "Chatrapathi" (2005), and "Manam" (2014). She has also acted in Tamil films like "Mazhai" (2005), "Sivaji" (2007), and "Kanthaswamy" (2009).

 

In addition to Telugu and Tamil films, Shriya Saran has also worked in Hindi cinema. She made her Bollywood debut with the film "Tujhe Meri Kasam" (2003) and went on to star in movies such as "Awarapan" (2007), "Mission Istanbul" (2008), and "Drishyam" (2015).

 

Over the course of her career, Shriya Saran has received several awards and accolades for her performances. She has established herself as one of the leading actresses in the South Indian film industry and has gained popularity for her beauty, talent, and versatility.

item.title: Shruti Haasan
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Shruti Haasan

Bollywood Female Actor

Shruti Haasan, born on January 28, 1986, is an Indian actress, singer, and musician who primarily works in the South Indian film industries, including Tamil, Telugu, and Hindi cinema. She is the daughter of renowned actors Kamal Haasan and Sarika Thakur.

 

Shruti Haasan made her acting debut in 2009 with the Bollywood film "Luck" and simultaneously entered the Telugu film industry with "Anaganaga O Dheerudu" in 2011. She gained widespread recognition and critical acclaim for her performances in movies like "Gabbar Singh" (2012), "Race Gurram" (2014), and "Srimanthudu" (2015).

 

In addition to Telugu films, Shruti Haasan has acted in Tamil movies such as "7aum Arivu" (2011), "Vedalam" (2015), and "Singam 3" (2017). She has also made appearances in Hindi films like "Dil Toh Baccha Hai Ji" (2011), "Ramaiya Vastavaiya" (2013), and "Welcome Back" (2015).

 

Apart from her acting career, Shruti Haasan is a talented singer and has lent her voice to several songs in her films. She has also released her own independent music albums and has performed live concerts.

item.title: Shweta Tripathi
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Soha Ali Khan

Bollywood Female Actor

Shweta Tripathi is an Indian actress known for her work in Hindi cinema and web series. She was born on July 6, 1985, in New Delhi, India.

 

Shweta Tripathi made her acting debut with the critically acclaimed film "Masaan" in 2015, for which she received widespread praise for her performance as a young girl dealing with social stigmas. The film garnered several awards and accolades, including the Cannes Film Festival's FIPRESCI Prize.

 

Following her debut, Shweta Tripathi appeared in various films, including "Haraamkhor" (2017), where she played the role of a school student involved in an unconventional relationship, and "Gone Kesh" (2019), where she portrayed a girl battling alopecia.

 

Apart from her film career, Shweta Tripathi has also worked in several web series, gaining popularity for her performances. She starred in the acclaimed Amazon Prime Video series "Mirzapur" (2018-present), where she played the character Golu Gupta, and in the Netflix series "Cargo" (2020).

item.title: Shweta Basu Prasad
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Shweta Basu Prasad

Bollywood Female Actor

Shweta Basu Prasad is an Indian actress who primarily works in Hindi, Telugu, and Bengali films. She was born on January 11, 1991, in Jamshedpur, Jharkhand, India.

 

Shweta Basu Prasad began her acting career as a child artist and gained prominence with her role in the critically acclaimed film "Makdee" (2002), where she portrayed the dual roles of Chunni and Munni. Her performance in the movie earned her the National Film Award for Best Child Artist.

 

As a child artist, Shweta Basu Prasad appeared in several films and television shows, including "Iqbal" (2005) and the popular TV series "Kahaani Ghar Ghar Kii" (2005-2007).

 

She transitioned to adult roles and continued to act in films. She appeared in movies like "Ride" (2009), "The Tashkent Files" (2019), and "Shukranu" (2020). She has also worked in Telugu and Bengali cinema, featuring in films like "Kotha Bangaru Lokam" (2008) and "Ek Nadir Galpo: Tale of a River" (2008).

item.title: Tanushree Dutta
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Soha Ali Khan

Bollywood Female Actor

Tanushree Dutta is an Indian model and actress. She was born on March 19, 1984, in Jamshedpur, Jharkhand, India. Tanushree began her career in the entertainment industry as a model and went on to win the Femina Miss India Universe title in 2004.

 

In 2005, Tanushree made her Bollywood debut with the film "Aashiq Banaya Aapne." She gained recognition and popularity with her performances in movies like "Chocolate" (2005) and "Bhagam Bhag" (2006). Her portrayal of diverse characters and her on-screen presence earned her a considerable fan following.

 

However, Tanushree Dutta is also known for her role in bringing awareness to the issue of sexual harassment in the Indian film industry. In 2018, she accused fellow actor Nana Patekar of misconduct on the set of a film they were shooting in 2008. Her allegations sparked the #MeToo movement in India and led to a significant discussion about harassment and workplace safety in the entertainment industry.

item.title: Tanishaa Mukerji
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Tanishaa Mukerji

Bollywood Female Actor

Tanishaa Mukerji is an Indian film actress who predominantly works in Bollywood. She was born on March 3, 1978, in Mumbai, India. Tanishaa comes from a prominent film family, as she is the daughter of actress Tanuja and the younger sister of Bollywood actress Kajol.

 

Tanishaa made her acting debut in 2003 with the film "Sssshhh..." but gained recognition for her role in the critically acclaimed film "Neal 'n' Nikki" (2005). She went on to appear in movies like "Sarkar" (2005), "Tango Charlie" (2005), and "One Two Three" (2008). Although she acted in several films, her career in Bollywood didn't achieve notable success.

 

Apart from Bollywood, Tanishaa has also participated in reality TV shows. In 2013, she appeared on the reality show "Bigg Boss Season 7" and became one of the popular contestants. Her stint on the show brought her back into the limelight and showcased her personality to a wider audience.

 

Tanishaa Mukerji has also ventured into regional cinema, particularly in the Marathi film industry. She acted in Marathi films like "Pitruroon" (2013) and "Adhantari" (2019). Her performances in Marathi films were well-received, and she gained appreciation for her acting skills in the regional cinema.

item.title: Tanaaz Irani
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Tanaaz Irani

Bollywood Female Actor

Tanaaz Irani is an Indian actress and television personality. She was born on April 8, 1971, in Mumbai, India. Tanaaz has primarily worked in the Indian television industry but has also appeared in a few films.

 

Tanaaz Irani began her acting career in the late 1990s with television shows like "Zaban Sambhal Ke" and "Fame Gurukul." She gained recognition and popularity for her comedic roles in sitcoms and comedy shows. Some of her notable television appearances include "Zabaan Sambhal Ke" (1993), "Bigg Boss 3" (2009), and "Badi Door Se Aaye Hai" (2014-2016).

 

Apart from her television work, Tanaaz Irani has also acted in a few Bollywood films. She made her film debut in 1995 with the movie "Sajan Ka Ghar" and went on to appear in films like "Main Prem Ki Diwani Hoon" (2003) and "Kya Love Story Hai" (2007). While her focus has mainly been on television, her film appearances have added to her acting repertoire.

 

Tanaaz has also participated in various reality shows. She showcased her dancing skills in the dance reality show "Nach Baliye 2" and even emerged as the runner-up. She has also been a part of comedy shows like "Comedy Circus" and "Comedy Circus Ka Naya Daur," where she displayed her comedic timing and improvisation skills.

item.title: Tillotama Shome
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Tillotama Shome

Bollywood Female Actor

Tillotama Shome is an Indian actress known for her work in both mainstream and independent cinema. She was born on July 25, 1976, in Kolkata, West Bengal, India. Shome began her career in the entertainment industry as a theater artist and later transitioned into films.

 

Tillotama Shome gained recognition for her role in the critically acclaimed film "Monsoon Wedding" (2001), directed by Mira Nair. Her performance as Alice, a maid in an upper-middle-class Indian family, received positive reviews and brought her into the spotlight. Since then, she has been a part of numerous notable films and projects.

 

Some of Shome's notable films include "Shadows of Time" (2004), "Qissa: The Tale of a Lonely Ghost" (2013), "Children of War" (2014), and "Hindi Medium" (2017). She has also worked in international films like "Sold" (2014) and "Nayantara's Necklace" (2015).

 

Tillotama Shome is known for her versatility and ability to portray complex characters with depth and nuance. She has received several awards and nominations for her performances, including the Best Actress award at the 10th New York Indian Film Festival for her role in "Sir" (2018), directed by Rohena Gera.

item.title: Urmila Matondkar
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Urmila Matondkar

Bollywood Female Actor

Urmila Matondkar is an Indian actress who has worked predominantly in Hindi cinema, also known as Bollywood. She was born on February 4, 1974, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India.

 

Urmila Matondkar made her acting debut as a child artist in the film "Kalyug" (1981) and later appeared in several other films as a child artist. She gained significant recognition and acclaim for her performance in the movie "Masoom" (1983), where she played the role of a child protagonist.

 

As an adult actress, Urmila Matondkar rose to prominence with her versatile performances in a range of films. She is well-known for her roles in movies like "Rangeela" (1995), directed by Ram Gopal Varma, where she portrayed a lively and aspiring actress. Her portrayal in "Satya" (1998) as a vulnerable and innocent girl caught in the underworld received critical acclaim.

 

Urmila Matondkar has acted in numerous successful Bollywood films, including "Judaai," "Kaun," "Bhoot," "Pinjar," and "Ek Hasina Thi," among others. She has showcased her acting prowess in various genres, from romantic dramas to thrillers and intense character-driven roles.

item.content:encoded:
Vidya Malvade

Bollywood Female Actor

Vidya Malvade is an Indian actress who primarily works in Bollywood films and television shows. She was born on March 2, 1973, in Maharashtra, India. Vidya gained recognition for her performances in both mainstream and parallel cinema.

 

Vidya Malvade made her acting debut with the Bollywood film "Inteha" in 2003. However, it was her role as Captain Vidya Singh in the sports drama film "Chak De! India" (2007) that brought her widespread acclaim and popularity. Her portrayal of a hockey player in the movie was highly appreciated, and the film itself became a blockbuster.

 

Following the success of "Chak De! India," Vidya appeared in several Hindi films, including "Kidnap" (2008), "Striker" (2010), and "1920: Evil Returns" (2012). She has also worked in regional cinema, specifically Marathi films.

 

In addition to her film career, Vidya has made appearances in television shows. She participated in the reality show "Fear Factor: Khatron Ke Khiladi" in 2011 and was also seen in the drama series "Ishq Mein Marjawan" in 2017.

item.title: Varsha Usgaonkar
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Varsha Usgaonkar

Bollywood Female Actor

Varsha Usgaonkar is an Indian actress who primarily works in the Marathi and Hindi film industries. She was born on February 28, 1968, in Goa, India. Varsha has acted in numerous films and television shows, earning acclaim for her performances.

 

Varsha Usgaonkar made her acting debut with the Marathi film "Gojiri" in 1982. She gained popularity with her performances in Marathi films like "Saglikade Bombabomb" (1985) and "Ek Hota Vidushak" (1992), for which she received critical acclaim.

 

In the Hindi film industry, Varsha made her debut with the film "Beta" in 1992, starring alongside Anil Kapoor and Madhuri Dixit. Her role as Saraswati in the film earned her a Filmfare nomination for Best Supporting Actress. She went on to act in several Hindi films, including "Gardish" (1993), "Krishna" (1996), and "Gair" (1999).

 

Varsha Usgaonkar has also worked in television. She appeared in the popular TV series "Kabhi Souten Kabhi Saheli" (2001) and "Astitva...Ek Prem Kahani" (2002-2006), where she played the lead role of Dr. Simran Mathur.

Apart from acting, Varsha is also a trained classical singer. She has showcased her singing talent in some of her films and has released a few music albums.

Vaidehi Parashurami

Bollywood Female Actor

Vaidehi Parashurami is an Indian actress who primarily works in the Marathi film industry. She was born on February 1, 1992, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. Vaidehi made her acting debut in Marathi cinema and has since appeared in several films, gaining recognition for her performances.

 

Vaidehi Parashurami made her debut with the Marathi film "Varyavarchi Varaat" in 2010. She gained popularity with her role in the film "Kshanbhar Vishranti" (2010), where she played the female lead opposite Bharat Jadhav. Her performance in the film was well-received, and it established her as a promising actress in the Marathi industry.

 

Since then, Vaidehi has appeared in various Marathi films, including "Pune Via Bihar" (2014), "Anvatt" (2014), and "Vrundavan" (2016). She has portrayed diverse characters and showcased her acting skills in different genres of films.

 

Apart from her film career, Vaidehi Parashurami has also been involved in theater. She has performed in Marathi plays and has garnered praise for her stage performances.

item.title: Virti Vaghani
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Virti Vaghani

Bollywood Female Actor

Virti Vaghani is an Indian actress and model known for her notable work in both television and film. She gained recognition for her role as the child Radha in the television show "Jai Shri Krishna" (2008) and made her Bollywood debut in the film "Patiala House" (2011). Additionally, she appeared in the comedy-drama film "Hope Aur Hum" (2018) and the web series "Aarya" (2020).

 

Born and raised in Mumbai, Maharashtra, Virti started her career as a child artist by featuring in various advertisements for renowned brands such as Whirlpool, Kwality Walls, Clinic Plus Shampoo, Dettol Soap, Knorr Soup, Mobilla, and Colgate. Her early success in commercials paved the way for her entry into the entertainment industry.

 

In 2008, Virti made her television debut with the show "Jai Shri Krishna," where she portrayed the character of child Radha. The show, which aired on Colors TV and was also shared with Nick Channel, garnered popularity and was later dubbed and telecast in Tamil and Bengali TV channels.

 

Virti ventured into Bollywood with the film "Patiala House" in 2011, directed by Nikkhil Advani and starring Akshay Kumar and Anushka Sharma. She played a supporting role in the film, marking her debut in Hindi cinema.

 

In 2018, Virti appeared in the comedy-drama film "Hope Aur Hum," which featured renowned actors Naseeruddin Shah and Sonali Kulkarni. Her performance in the film was well-received by audiences and critics alike.

 

She further showcased her talent by portraying the character of Arundhati, Aarya's teenage daughter, in the Disney+Hotstar web series "Aarya" (2020). The series starred Sushmita Sen, Chandrachur Singh, and Sikandar Kher, and Virti's portrayal added depth to the complex family dynamics depicted in the show.

item.content:encoded:
Vedika Pinto

Bollywood Female Actor

Vedika Pinto, born on 14th October 1995 in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India, is a talented actress known for her work in the Indian film industry. With her promising performances, she has garnered attention and recognition.

 

She made her mark in the entertainment world with her roles in notable films. In 2022, Vedika appeared in the film "Operation Romeo," showcasing her acting prowess and leaving a strong impression on the audience. Her ability to bring depth and authenticity to her characters was evident in this project.

 

Following her successful debut, Vedika Pinto continued to rise in the industry, and in 2023, she was seen in the film "Gumraah." Her performance in this film further established her as a talented actress to watch out for.

 

With a promising career ahead, Vedika Pinto has become an exciting name in Indian cinema. Her dedication to her craft and ability to portray diverse roles have earned her appreciation from both filmmakers and viewers.

As she continues to explore new opportunities and challenges in the world of acting, Vedika Pinto's talent and versatility are sure to captivate audiences and solidify her position as a respected figure in the Indian film industry.

item.title: Waluscha De Sousa
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Waluscha De Sousa

Bollywood Female Actor

Waluscha De Sousa is an Indian model and actress. She was born on November 28, 1984, in Goa, India. Waluscha gained recognition for her work in the modeling industry and later ventured into acting.

 

Waluscha started her career as a model and worked with various renowned brands and designers. She was associated with prominent fashion events and walked the ramp for fashion shows. Her striking looks and confident presence helped her establish a successful modeling career.

 

In 2016, Waluscha made her Bollywood debut with the film "Fan," directed by Maneesh Sharma and starring Shah Rukh Khan. She portrayed the role of Aryan Khanna's (played by Shah Rukh Khan) wife in the movie. Despite having a relatively small role, her performance was appreciated.

 

Following her debut, Waluscha has appeared in other Hindi films, including "Time to Dance" (2021), where she shared the screen with Sooraj Pancholi. She has also made special appearances in songs and music videos.

item.title: Wamiqa Gabbi
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Wamiqa Gabbi

Bollywood Female Actor

Wamiqa Gabbi is an Indian actress who primarily works in Punjabi, Hindi, and Telugu cinema. She was born on September 29, 1993, in Chandigarh, India. Wamiqa began her acting career as a child artist and has since established herself as a prominent actress in the industry.

 

Wamiqa Gabbi made her acting debut as a child artist in the Punjabi film "Jawani Zindabad" (2010). She gained recognition for her performance in the film and went on to act in other Punjabi movies as a child artist, including "Tu Mera 22 Main Tera 22" (2013) and "Ishq Brandy" (2014).

 

As an adult actress, Wamiqa made her Hindi film debut with "Sixteen" in 2013. She then appeared in the Hindi film "Love Aaj Kal" (2020) directed by Imtiaz Ali, where she had a supporting role.

Apart from Punjabi and Hindi cinema, Wamiqa has also acted in Telugu films. She made her Telugu debut with the film "Bhale Manchi Roju" (2015) and has since appeared in other Telugu movies like "Mahanubhavudu" (2017) and "7" (2019).

item.title: Sneha Ullal
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Sneha Ullal

Bollywood Female Actor

Sneha Ullal is an Indian actress who primarily works in the Hindi and Telugu film industries. She was born on December 18, 1987, in Muscat, Oman. Sneha gained recognition for her striking resemblance to actress Aishwarya Rai Bachchan, which led to her being cast opposite Salman Khan in the Bollywood film "Lucky: No Time for Love" in 2005.

 

"Lucky: No Time for Love" marked Sneha's debut in the film industry, and although the movie received mixed reviews, her performance was appreciated. She gained popularity for her innocent looks and charming screen presence. Sneha went on to appear in several Telugu films, including "Ullasamga Utsahamga," "Nenu Meeku Telusa...?", and "Ala Modalaindi."

 

Despite making a promising start, Sneha's acting career didn't achieve significant success, and she took a break from films for a while. She later made a comeback with independent and regional films, including Malayalam and Kannada films.

 

Apart from acting, Sneha Ullal has been involved in charitable activities. She supports causes related to education and child welfare.

item.title: Zoa Morani
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Soha Ali Khan

Bollywood Female Actor

Zoa Morani is an Indian actress and producer. She was born on March 29, 1988, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. Zoa comes from a film background, as her father Karim Morani is a prominent film producer in Bollywood.

 

Zoa Morani made her acting debut in 2011 with the Hindi film "Always Kabhi Kabhi." She played the lead role of Nandini Oberoi in the movie, which was produced by her father. However, the film did not perform well at the box office.

 

After her debut, Zoa took a break from acting and focused on other ventures. She co-founded a company called "Better Life Enterprise," which aimed to create environmentally friendly products. Additionally, she has been involved in philanthropic activities, supporting causes such as cancer awareness and education for underprivileged children.

 

In 2020, Zoa Morani made headlines when she tested positive for COVID-19 during the initial wave of the pandemic in India. However, she recovered successfully after receiving medical treatment.

item.title: Zoya Afroz
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Zoya Afroz

Television Female Actor

Zoya Afroz is an Indian actress and model. She was born on January 10, 1994, in Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India. Zoya began her career as a child artist and gained popularity for her work in films and television.

 

Zoya made her acting debut as a child artist in the Bollywood film "Hum Saath-Saath Hain" in 1999. She appeared in several other Hindi films as a child artist, including "Kuch Naa Kaho" (2003) and "Mann" (1999).

 

As an adult, Zoya Afroz participated in beauty pageants and won the title of Pond's Femina Miss India International in 2013. This opened doors for her in the modeling industry, and she appeared in various commercials and fashion shows.

 

In terms of her acting career, Zoya has predominantly worked in the South Indian film industry. She has appeared in Telugu films like "Sye" (2004) and "Anaganaga O Dheerudu" (2011). She also acted in the Malayalam film "Puthiya Mukham" (2009) and the Tamil film "Vaagai Sooda Vaa" (2011).

item.title: Zarine Khan
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Zarina Wahab

Bollywood Female Actor

Zarina Wahab is an Indian actress who primarily works in the Hindi film industry. She was born on July 17, 1959, in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, India. Zarina has acted in numerous films and has had a long and successful career in Indian cinema.

 

Zarina Wahab made her acting debut in the 1974 film "Ishq Ishq Ishq" directed by Dev Anand. She gained recognition for her performances in films like "Chitchor" (1976), "Gopal Krishna" (1979), and "Dil Diwana" (1979). Her portrayal of the character Kasturi in the film "Gharonda" (1977) earned her critical acclaim and a nomination for the Filmfare Award for Best Supporting Actress.

 

Throughout her career, Zarina has worked with renowned actors and directors in the Hindi film industry. Some of her notable films include "Anpadh" (1978), "Agneepath" (1990), and "My Name Is Khan" (2010). She has also acted in regional cinema, including Malayalam and Telugu films.

 

Apart from her film work, Zarina Wahab has also appeared in television shows, including the popular series "Madhubala - Ek Ishq Ek Junoon" (2012-2014). She continues to be active in the industry and is known for her versatility as an actress.

Zoya's dedication to her craft and her willingness to take on challenging roles have set her apart as an actress to watch out for.

item.title: Aanchal Munjal
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Aanchal Munjal

Television Female Actor

Aanchal Munjal is an Indian actress who has worked in both Bollywood films and television shows. She is best known for her roles in the television shows Parvarrish – Kuchh Khattee Kuchh Meethi (2011) and Bade Acche Lagte Hain (2013).

 

Munjal started her acting career as a child actor in the television show Shanno Ki Shaadi (2005). She went on to appear in several other television shows, including Dhoom Machao Dhoom (2008), Ghost Bana Dost (2010), and Ek Boond Ishq (2013).

In 2011, Munjal made her Bollywood debut with the film We Are Family. She played the role of Aleya, the daughter of Kajol's character. The film was a commercial success and Munjal's performance was praised by critics.

 

The same year, Munjal appeared in the television show Parvarrish – Kuchh Khattee Kuchh Meethi. She played the role of Raavi Ahuja, the youngest daughter of the Ahuja family. The show was a huge success and Munjal's performance was one of the highlights of the show.

 

In 2013, Munjal appeared in the television show Bade Acche Lagte Hain. She played the role of Pihu Ram Kapoor, the young daughter of Ram Kapoor and Sakshi Tanwar's characters. The show was a huge success and Munjal's performance was praised by critics.

Chhavi Mittal

Bollywood Female Actor

Chhavi Mittal is a prominent figure in the Indian entertainment industry, known for her multifaceted talents and inspiring journey. Born on September 4, 1984, Chhavi has made a remarkable impact as an actress, entrepreneur, blogger, and social media influencer.

 

With her captivating on-screen presence, Chhavi has showcased her acting prowess in various television shows and films, winning the hearts of audiences across the nation. Her versatility and ability to portray diverse characters have earned her immense recognition and a dedicated fan base.

 

Beyond her acting career, Chhavi has ventured into entrepreneurship, co-founding a successful digital media company called Shitty Ideas Trending. She has also made her mark as a blogger, sharing her insights and experiences on motherhood, wellness, and personal growth. Chhavi's authentic and relatable content has resonated with millions of followers, making her a popular influencer on social media platforms.

 

Known for her warmth, intelligence, and grace, Chhavi Mittal has become an inspiration for many aspiring artists and entrepreneurs. Her commitment to personal growth, combined with her creative talents, continues to propel her towards new heights of success. With her unwavering dedication and passion, Chhavi continues to leave an indelible mark in the entertainment industry and beyond.

item.title: Debina Bonnerjee
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Debina Bonnerjee

Television Female Actor

Debina Bonnerjee is an Indian actress who appears predominantly in Tamil and Hindi films and television. She is well known for playing the role Sita and Lakshmi in the 2008 television soap opera Ramayan. She acted with Famous Kannada Actor Shiva Rajkumar in Nanjundi. Her first television role was in the Tamil TV serial Mayavi (2005). She also appeared as Mayuri in Chidiya Ghar and in several reality shows. In 2019, she appeared in Colors TV's show Vish: A Poisonous Story.

Personal life. On 15 February 2011, Bonnerjee married actor Gurmeet Choudhary. On 4 October 2021, they married again. On 3 April 2022, they had their first child, Lianna Choudhary On 11 November 2022, they had their second child, another girl, Divisha Choudhary.

Debina Bonnerjee was born on 18 April 1983 in Kolkata, West Bengal, India. She completed her schooling from St. Xavier's School, Kolkata. She is a graduate in Mass Communication from the University of Calcutta.

Debina Bonnerjee started her career as a model and appeared in several commercials. She made her television debut in 2005 with the Tamil TV serial Mayavi. She played the role of Mayavi, a young woman who is cursed by a witch. She was a part of the show for one year.

In 2006, Debina Bonnerjee joined the cast of the Hindi TV serial Chidiya Ghar. She played the role of Mayuri, a young woman who is trying to find her place in the world. She was a part of the show for three years and her performance was praised by critics and audiences alike.

In 2008, Debina Bonnerjee bagged the lead role of Sita in the mythological drama Ramayan. She played the role of Sita, the wife of Lord Rama. She was a part of the show for one year and her performance was praised by critics and audiences alike.

Debina Bonnerjee has also appeared in several reality shows, including Nach Baliye 4, Jhalak Dikhhla Jaa 6, and Fear Factor: Khatron Ke Khiladi 5. She is a talented actress who is sure to go a long way in her career. She is a versatile actress who can play a variety of roles. She is also a beautiful and charming woman who is sure to win the hearts of many.

item.title: Disha Parmar
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Disha Parmar

Television Female Actor

Disha Parmar is an Indian television actress. She is known for her roles in the television shows Pyaar Ka Dard Hai Meetha Meetha Pyaara Pyaara, Woh Apna Sa, and Bade Achhe Lagte Hain 2.

Disha Parmar was born on 11 November 1994 in New Delhi, India. She completed her schooling from Sadhu Vaswani International School, Delhi. During her higher secondary education, she participated in dance competitions, plays and fashion shows. Parmar appeared in several print and commercial ads in Delhi. She was pursuing a degree in Business Marketing but left her under graduate studies midway as she was selected for Pyaar Ka Dard Hai Meetha Meetha Pyaara Pyaara.

 

Disha Parmar made her acting debut in 2012 with the show Pyaar Ka Dard Hai Meetha Meetha Pyaara Pyaara. She played the role of Pankhuri Gupta, a young woman who is trying to find her place in the world. She was a part of the show for two years and her performance was praised by critics and audiences alike.

 

In 2014, Disha Parmar joined the cast of the show Woh Apna Sa and played the role of Priya Kapoor, a young woman who is trying to find her true love. She was a part of the show for one year and her performance was praised by critics and audiences alike.

In 2021, Disha Parmar bagged the lead role of Priya Sood in the Ekta Kapoor show Bade Achhe Lagte Hain 2. She plays the role of a young woman who is trying to find her place in the world. The show has been well-received by the audience and Disha Parmar's performance has been praised by critics.

item.title: Divya Agarwal
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Divya Agarwal

Television Female Actor

Divya Agarwal is an Indian actress, model, and social media personality. She is known for her work in the television shows MTV Splitsvilla 10, Ace of Space 1, and Bigg Boss OTT. She has also starred in the web series Ragini MMS Returns 2 and The Girl on the Train.

 

Divya Agarwal was born on December 4, 1992, in Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. She completed her schooling from Kendriya Vidyalaya, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai. She is a graduate in Mass Communication from the University of Mumbai.

 

Divya Agarwal started her career as a model and appeared in several commercials. She made her television debut in 2017 with the reality show MTV Splitsvilla 10. She finished as the runner-up with Priyank Sharma. In 2018, she participated in the reality show Ace of Space 1 and emerged as the winner. In 2020, she participated in the reality show Bigg Boss OTT and became the first-ever winner of the show.

 

Divya Agarwal has also starred in the web series Ragini MMS Returns 2 and The Girl on the Train. She is a talented actress and has won several awards for her work, including the MTV Style Icon Award, the Gold Awards for Best Actress, and the Indian Telly Award for Best Actress (Popular).

 

Divya Agarwal is a popular social media personality and has a large following on Instagram and Twitter. She is known for her fashion sense and her candid posts about her life. She is also a strong advocate for mental health awareness and has spoken about her own struggles with depression.

item.title: Divyanka Tripathi Dahiya
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Divyanka Tripathi

Television Female Actor

Divyanka Tripathi is a highly acclaimed and immensely popular television actress who has captivated audiences with her exceptional talent and mesmerizing performances. With her immense versatility, charm, and natural acting prowess, Divyanka has become a household name in the Indian television industry.

 

Divyanka rose to fame with her breakthrough role as Vidya in the hit serial "Banoo Main Teri Dulhann," which earned her widespread recognition and numerous accolades. Her portrayal of Vidya, a young woman facing various challenges in her life, showcased her ability to bring depth and authenticity to her characters.

 

Known for her striking beauty and graceful presence, Divyanka has an incredible ability to connect with the emotions of her audience. Whether it's a dramatic scene or a lighthearted moment, she effortlessly delivers performances that leave a lasting impact.

 

Divyanka's talent and popularity have earned her a massive fan following, and she continues to win hearts with her subsequent roles in popular shows like "Yeh Hai Mohabbatein" and "Coldd Lassi Aur Chicken Masala." Her ability to portray a wide range of characters with equal finesse has solidified her position as one of the most versatile actresses in the industry.

 

Aside from her acting skills, Divyanka is admired for her humility, warmth, and professionalism. She is known for her dedication to her craft, working tirelessly to deliver her best in every project she undertakes. Her positive attitude and down-to-earth nature have made her a beloved figure both on and off-screen.

Donal Bisht

Television Female Actor

Donal Bisht is an Indian actress who is known for her work in Hindi television. She is best known for her role as Sharanya Bisht in the romance thriller television show Ek Deewana Tha (2017-2018) and Ishika Patel in Roop- Mard Ka Naya Swaroop (2018-2019).

 

Donal Bisht was born on 27 August 1994 in Alwar, Rajasthan, India. She completed her schooling from Delhi Public School, Alwar. She is a graduate in Mass Communication from the Amity University, Noida.

 

Donal Bisht started her career as a model and appeared in several commercials. She made her television debut in 2017 with the show Ek Deewana Tha. She played the role of Sharanya Bisht, a young woman who is trying to find her place in the world. She was a part of the show for one year.

 

In 2018, Donal Bisht joined the cast of Roop - Mard Ka Naya Swaroop. She played the role of Ishika Patel, a young woman who is trying to break the stereotypes of society. She was a part of the show for two years and her performance was praised by critics and audiences alike.

 

Donal Bisht is a talented actress who is sure to go a long way in her career. She is a versatile actress who can play a variety of roles. She is also a beautiful and charming woman who is sure to win the hearts of many.

Drashti Dhami

Television Female Actor

Drashti Dhami is an Indian television actress. She is best known for her roles as Geet in the television series Geet – Hui Sabse Parayi and Madhubala in the television series Madhubala – Ek Ishq Ek Junoon.

 

Drashti Dhami was born on 10 December 1985 in Mumbai, India. She completed her schooling from St. Anne's High School. She started her career with various advertisements. In 2008, she made her television debut with the show Geet – Hui Sabse Parayi. She played the role of Geet, a simple and innocent girl who falls in love with a wealthy man. The show was a huge success and Drashti's performance was praised by critics and audiences alike. She won several awards for her role in the show, including the Indian Telly Award for Best Actress (Popular) and the Gold Awards for Best Actress.

 

In 2012, Drashti Dhami bagged the lead role of Madhubala in the Star Plus show Madhubala – Ek Ishq Ek Junoon. She played the role of Madhubala, a beautiful and talented actress who falls in love with a film director. The show was a huge success and Drashti's performance was praised by critics and audiences alike. She won several awards for her role in the show, including the Indian Telly Award for Best Actress (Popular) and the Gold Awards for Best Actress.

item.title: Divya Seth
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Divya Seth

Television Female Actor

Divya Seth is an accomplished Indian film and television actress who initially gained recognition for her role as Majhli in the TV serial "Hum Log." She is the daughter of renowned actress Sushma Seth and Dhruv Seth. Divya Seth's acting journey began with theater, where she worked with renowned theater personality Barry John in Delhi. She later transitioned to television and films, making appearances in notable projects such as "Jab We Met."

 

In recent years, Divya Seth has been actively involved in the web series realm. One of her notable works includes the web series titled "The Married Woman," directed by Sahir Raza. The series revolves around the life of Astha, played by Ridhi Dogra, and explores her journey of self-discovery and her relationship with another woman, played by Monica Dogra. Divya Seth's performance in the series has garnered praise and showcased her versatility as an actress.

 

Divya Seth's talent and dedication to her craft have allowed her to carve a niche for herself in the Indian entertainment industry. Her portrayal of diverse characters, both on television and in films, has contributed to her popularity among viewers. With her strong acting skills and impressive body of work, Divya Seth continues to captivate audiences with her performances.

Drishti Thakur

Television Female Actor

Drishti Thakur is an emerging Indian television actress and model who recently made her debut in the television industry through the Colors TV show "Namak Issk Ka." In the series, she shares the screen with fellow actors Aditya Ojha and Shruti Sharma, marking the beginning of her acting career.

 

Before stepping into the world of acting, Drishti began her professional journey as a model and has been actively involved in the glamour industry since 2018. Her experience in the modeling world may have contributed to her poise and confidence in her television debut.

 

As a newcomer in the television arena, Drishti Thakur's talents and potential are eagerly awaited by audiences and fans. With her dedication and determination, she has set foot on a promising path in the entertainment industry, and her journey in television is one to watch for future developments and success.

item.title: Deepali Pansare
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Deepali Pansare

Television Female Actor

Deepali Pansare is a talented Indian actress known for her work in both Hindi television and films. She made her acting debut in 2008 and has since garnered widespread recognition for her notable roles in various TV shows and films.

 

In the television realm, Deepali is best known for portraying Suhaagi in "Neer Bhare Tere Naina Devi," Payal Singh Raizada in "Iss Pyaar Ko Kya Naam Doon?," Devyani Kelkar in "Devyani," Sanjana Deshmukh in "Aai Kuthe Kay Karte," and Kamini Joshi in "Chikoo Ki Mummy Durr Kei." She has portrayed several supporting and episodic roles in other shows, showcasing her versatility as an actress.

 

Deepali Pansare also ventured into the film industry, making her debut with the Marathi film "Hello! Gandhe Sir" in 2010 and her Hindi film debut with "Ek Thi Daayan" in 2013. She has been part of various films, including "Sunoyona: The Beautiful Eyes," "Chalk n Duster," and "Fraud Saiyaan."

item.title: Eisha Singh
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Eisha Singh

Television Female Actor

Eisha Singh is an Indian actress who predominantly works in Hindi television. She began her acting career in 2015 with Colors TV's soap Ishq Ka Rang Safed where she portrayed a widow Dhaani Awasthi. Singh is best known for portraying Zara Siddiqui in Zee TV's popular romantic Ishq Subhan Allah. She was last seen portraying Suhani Ranveer Oberoi in Colors TV's dramatic Sirf Tum (2021-22). 

Eisha Singh was born on 24 December 1998 in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, India. She completed her schooling from Kendriya Vidyalaya, Sultanpur, Madhya Pradesh. She is a graduate in Mass Communication from the Bhartiya Vidya Bhavan's Adarsh Vidya Mandir College, Bhopal.

 

Eisha Singh started her career as a child artist in 2012 with the television show Devon Ke Dev Mahadev. She played the role of young Parvati in the show. In 2015, she joined the cast of Ishq Ka Rang Safed and played the role of Dhaani Awasthi. She was a part of the show for two years and her performance was praised by critics and audiences alike.

 

In 2017, Eisha Singh bagged the lead role of Zara Siddiqui in the Zee TV show Ishq Subhan Allah. She played the role of a Muslim girl who falls in love with a Hindu boy. She was a part of the show for three years and her performance was praised by critics and audiences alike.

 

In 2021, Eisha Singh joined the cast of Colors TV's romantic drama Sirf Tum. She is playing the role of Suhani, a young woman who is trying to find her place in the world. The show has been well-received by the audience and Eisha Singh's performance has been praised by critics.

Eisha Singh started her career as a child artist in 2012 with the television show Devon Ke Dev Mahadev. She played the role of young Parvati in the show. \u00a0<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

In 2021, Eisha Singh joined the cast of Colors TV's romantic drama Sirf Tum. She is playing the role of Suhani, a young woman who is trying to find her place in the world. item.title: Erica Fernandes
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Erica Fernandes

Television Female Actor

Erica Fernandes is an Indian actress and model who works in Indian television and films. She is best known for her roles in the television shows Kuch Rang Pyar Ke Aise Bhi and Kasautii Zindagii Kay.

Erica Jennifer Fernandes was born on May 7, 1993, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. She completed her schooling from St. Anne's High School. She is a graduate in Mass Communication from the University of Mumbai.

 

Erica Fernandes started her career as a model and appeared in several commercials. She made her television debut in 2013 with the show Kuch Rang Pyar Ke Aise Bhi. She played the role of Dr. Sonakshi Bose, a young doctor who is trying to find love and balance her personal and professional life. The show was a huge success and Erica's performance was praised by critics and audiences alike. She won several awards for her role in the show, including the Indian Telly Award for Best Actress (Popular) and the Gold Awards for Best Actress.

 

In 2018, Erica Fernandes bagged the lead role of Prerna Sharma in the reboot of the popular show Kasautii Zindagii Kay. She played the role of a young woman who is trying to find her place in the world. The show has been a huge success and Erica's performance has been praised by critics and audiences alike.

item.title: Falaq Naaz
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Falaq Naaz

Television Female Actor

Falaq Naaz is an Indian television actress. She is the sister of actors Shafaq Naaz and Sheezan Khan. She is best known for her roles in TV shows telecast on Colors TV channel, most notably the long running soap opera Sasural Simar Ka in which she played the character of Jhanvi Bhardwaj.

 

Naaz was born on 2 December 1993 in Meerut, Uttar Pradesh, India. She is a trained dancer under the famous Bollywood choreographer, Saroj Khan at Indian Film and Television Institute, Meerut.

 

Naaz made her acting debut in 2010 with a cameo in the longest-running comedy series Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. She then appeared in a number of TV shows, including Adaalat, Devon Ke Dev... Mahadev, Savdhaan India: Crime Alert, and Vish Ya Amrit: Sitara.

 

In 2011, Naaz was cast in the long running soap opera Sasural Simar Ka. She played the character of Jhanvi Bhardwaj, a young woman who is forced to marry into a wealthy family. Naaz's performance in the show was praised by critics and audiences alike. She remained with the show for four years and became one of its most popular characters.

 

Naaz has also appeared in a number of films, including Chote Nawab (2020) and Haathi Ghoda Pal Ki Jai Kanhaiya Lal Ki (2021).

Naaz is a talented actress and dancer. She is also a popular social media influencer with over 1 million followers on Instagram. She is known for her positive attitude and her love for her family and friends.

item.title: Fenil Umrigar
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Fenil Umrigar

Television Female Actor

Fenil Umrigar is an Indian actress who works in Hindi television. She was born on 14 January 1993 in Surat, Gujarat, India. She made her acting debut in 2010 with the television series Maryada: Lekin Kab Tak?. She has since appeared in several other television series, including Best Friends Forever?, Bade Acche Lagte Hain, Kaala Teeka, and Rajaa Betaa.

 

Umrigar is best known for her portrayal of Sanjana Roy in Best Friends Forever?. She played the role of a young woman who is struggling to find her place in the world. The series was a critical and commercial success, and Umrigar's performance was praised by critics.

 

Umrigar has also appeared in several films, including Yam Hain Hum, 1920 London, and Love Sonia. She is a versatile actress who is capable of playing a wide range of roles. She is a rising star in the Indian entertainment industry, and her career is sure to continue to grow in the years to come.

Falguni Rajani

Television Female Actor

Falguni Rajani, born on 5 February 1980 in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India, is an Indian actress. As of 2022, she is 42 years old. She attended New English School in Vasai West, Maharashtra.

 

Rajani faced a difficult situation when her father passed away while she was in the 11th standard. Determined to support her family, she took up a job alongside her studies. Her resilience and dedication became evident at a young age as she juggled her responsibilities and pursued her education.

 

Falguni Rajani ventured into the entertainment industry as an actress. She has appeared in various television shows and has made a mark with her performances. While specific details about her acting career are not mentioned, her commitment to her craft and her ability to balance work and personal responsibilities are noteworthy.

 

Despite the challenges she faced early in life, Rajani persevered and followed her passion for acting. Her journey showcases her determination and strength in overcoming adversity. As an actress, she has contributed to the Indian television industry, captivating audiences with her talent and performances.

item.title: Gauri Pradhan Tejwani
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Gauri Pradhan Tejwani

Television Female Actor

Gauri Pradhan Tejwani is an Indian television actress. She is best known for her roles as Gauri Pratham Mittal in Kutumb, Nandini Karan Virani in Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi, and Deepika Ghosh in Special Squad.

Gauri was born on September 16, 1977, in Jammu, India. She began her career as a model and appeared in several commercials. In 1999, she made her acting debut with the television series Noorjahan. She then went on to star in several other television series, including Kutumb (2000), Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi (2000-2004), and Special Squad (2003).

 

Gauri has won several awards for her acting, including the STAR Parivaar Award for Favourite Bahu, the STAR Parivaar Award for Favourite Jodi, the STAR Parivaar Award for Favourite Hottest Jodi, the Indian Telly Award for Best Actress in a Supporting Role, and the STAR Parivaar Award for Favourite Yogya Bahu.

 

In 2004, Gauri married actor Hiten Tejwani. The couple has two sons, Nevaan and Katya.

 

Gauri is a versatile actress who has played a variety of roles on television. She is known for her beauty, her acting skills, and her down-to-earth personality. She is a popular actress and is loved by her fans all over India.

item.title: Giaa Manek
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Giaa Manek

Television Female Actor

Giaa Manek is an Indian television actress. She is best known for her role as Gopi Modi in the popular soap opera Saath Nibhaana Saathiya. She has also appeared in the television shows Jeannie Aur Juju and Tera Mera Saath Rahe.

 

Manek was born on February 18, 1986, in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. She graduated in Advertising and Marketing from the University of Mumbai. After graduating, she worked as a marketing professional for a few years before pursuing a career in acting.

 

Manek made her acting debut in the 2010 Hindi comedy film Na Ghar Ke Na Ghaat Ke. She then landed the role of Gopi Modi in Saath Nibhaana Saathiya in 2010. The show was a huge success and Manek's performance was widely praised. She won several awards for her role, including the Indian Telly Award for Best Actress in a Lead Role.

 

In 2012, Manek participated in the dance reality show Jhalak Dikhhla Jaa 5. She was the first runner-up of the show. After Jhalak Dikhhla Jaa, she starred in the television show Jeannie Aur Juju. The show was a moderate success.

 

In 2019, Manek made a comeback to television with the show Tera Mera Saath Rahe. The show is a reboot of Saath Nibhaana Saathiya. Manek is playing the role of Gopika Modi in the show.
