item.title: Gulki Joshi
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Gulki Joshi

Television Female Actor

Gulki Joshi is an Indian television actress who is known for her role as Haseena Malik in the Sony SAB show Maddam Sir. She was born on May 17, 1990, in Indore, Madhya Pradesh. She completed her schooling from St. Joseph's Convent School, Indore, and then went on to study Philosophy at the Devi Ahilya Vishwavidyalaya in Indore.

 

Gulki Joshi started her acting career with the television show Ek Mutthi Aasmaan in 2013. She then went on to play supporting roles in shows like Yeh Hai Mohabbatein, Qubool Hai, and Ishq Subhan Allah. In 2020, she got her big break with the role of Haseena Malik in Maddam Sir. The show is a comedy-drama about a female police officer who heads a women's police station. Gulki Joshi's performance in the show has been praised by critics and audiences alike. She has won several awards for her role, including the Zee Rishtey Award for Favourite Naya Sadasya (Female) and the Indian Telly Award for Best Actress in a Comedy Series.

 

Gulki Joshi is a versatile actress who can play a variety of roles. She is also a strong advocate for women's empowerment. She is a role model for young girls and inspires them to follow their dreams.

item.title: Gayatri Bhardwaj
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Gayatri Bhardwaj

Television Female Actor

Gayatri Bhardwaj is an Indian model and actress who gained recognition after being crowned fbb Colors Femina Miss India United Continents 2018. Born on June 17, 1995, in Delhi, India, Gayatri comes from a well-to-do Hindu family. Her father, Sanjay Bhardwaj, is a renowned businessman, and her mother, Urvashi Bhardwaj, owns an organic food processing company called Urvika. Gayatri has a younger brother named Raghav Bhardwaj.

 

She completed her schooling at Modern School Barakhamba Road in New Delhi and later pursued her graduation from Bharati Vidyapeeth Dental College in Pune. While initially aspiring to become a dentist, Gayatri developed an inclination towards modeling during her college years. She participated in the Campus Princess 2018 competition, where she reached the finals. This experience led her to choose a career in the modeling industry.

 

Gayatri's breakthrough came when she participated in and won the title of Miss India Delhi 2018. This victory opened doors for her to compete in Femina Miss India United Continents 2018. During the same year, she also participated in Miss India 2018, where she won awards like Miss Glamorous Look, Miss Spectacular Eyes, and Miss Popular. While she didn't win the overall beauty pageant, her success in these subcategories further established her presence in the industry.

item.content:encoded:
Geetanjali Kulkarni

Television Female Actor

Geetanjali Kulkarni is a highly acclaimed Indian actress known for her work in both Marathi and Hindi cinema. With her remarkable performances, she has garnered recognition and has been honored with several prestigious awards, including two Filmfare Awards Marathi and two Filmfare OTT Awards.

 

Geetanjali has showcased her talent and versatility across various platforms, delivering captivating performances in both regional and mainstream cinema. Her ability to bring depth and authenticity to her characters has made her a sought-after actress in the industry.

 

In Marathi cinema, Geetanjali has made a significant impact, impressing both critics and audiences with her compelling portrayals. She has worked alongside renowned filmmakers and actors, contributing to the growth and success of Marathi cinema.

 

Not only has Geetanjali excelled in regional cinema, but she has also made her mark in Hindi cinema. Her performances in Hindi films have been lauded for their nuanced approach and emotional depth, further solidifying her reputation as a versatile actress.

 

Geetanjali's talent extends beyond the big screen, as she has also made a strong presence in the digital realm. Her exceptional performances in web series and digital content have earned her recognition at the Filmfare OTT Awards, highlighting her adaptability and skill in the evolving landscape of entertainment.

item.title: Gracy Goswami
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Gracy Goswami

Television Female Actor

Gracy Goswami is an Indian actress known for her work in Hindi television and films. She was born on May 31, 2003, in Vadodara, Gujarat. At the age of 11, she made her acting debut in the television series "Bandhan" on Sony Entertainment Television, playing the role of Pinky Patil. However, she was later replaced in January 2015.

 

Goswami gained recognition for her portrayal of young Nandini Shekhar in the popular and long-running series "Balika Vadhu" on Colors TV. She left the show in April 2016 to participate in the dance reality show "Jhalak Dikhhla Jaa 8" on the same channel.

 

In 2017, she made her film debut in the periodic film "Begum Jaan," directed by Srijit Mukherji. She played the role of Laadli in the movie. That same year, she also appeared in an episode of the crime drama series "Crime Patrol" as Shilpi Rane.

 

Goswami went on to portray Princess Garima in Star Bharat's series "Mayavi Maling." In 2020, she appeared in Anubhav Sinha's social drama film "Thappad," where she played the character of Sania.

item.title: Ishita Vyas
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Ishita Vyas

Television Female Actor

Ishita Vyas, born as Manju Vyas, is an Indian television and film actress known for her work in the entertainment industry. She gained recognition by participating in the reality television show Kingfisher Calendar Hunt 2013, where she secured a place in the top seven contestants.

 

Starting her career as a model, Ishita later transitioned into acting. Her first notable project was the talk show Lift Kara De, produced by Yash Raj Films. Following the show's broadcast, she was offered the role of Jhalkaribai, a significant figure in the Indian Rebellion of 1857, for the television serial Jhansi Ki Rani. Her portrayal of Jhalkaribai garnered critical acclaim and brought her widespread recognition in both the Bollywood and television industries.

 

In addition to her television work, Ishita also appeared in a film for Kamdhenu Steel, directed by John Matthew Matthan. Her talent caught the attention of financer and producer Apoorvaditya (Aaditya) Kulshreshtha, who signed her for his upcoming big-budget suspense thriller film titled 11.40. The shooting for the film was set to commence in August 2020.

item.content:encoded:
Janvi Chheda

Television Female Actor

Janvi Chheda is an Indian actress who has made a notable mark in the entertainment industry. Born on February 29th, 1984, in Mumbai, India, Janvi Chheda is best known for her versatile performances in both television and film.

 

Janvi started her acting career with popular Indian soap operas like "Kumkum - Ek Pyara Sa Bandhan" and "Baa Bahoo Aur Baby," where she portrayed diverse roles and garnered praise for her acting skills. Her ability to bring depth and authenticity to her characters quickly gained her a loyal fan base.

 

Apart from television, Janvi has also made her presence felt in the film industry. She has appeared in Hindi films like "Ghutan" and "Koi Aap Sa," showcasing her talent on the big screen.

 

Janvi Chheda's beauty, talent, and dedication to her craft have earned her recognition and accolades in the Indian entertainment industry. With her versatility and charismatic presence, she continues to captivate audiences and remains an inspiration to aspiring actors.

item.content:encoded:
Jasmin Bhasin

Television Female Actor

Jasmin Bhasin is a popular Indian actress known for her versatile talent and striking beauty. Born on June 28, 1990, in Kota, Rajasthan, Jasmin has made a remarkable impact on the Indian entertainment industry. She gained widespread recognition through her appearances in various television shows, where she showcased her acting prowess and charismatic presence.

 

Jasmin's journey in the entertainment industry began with modeling, and she quickly made a seamless transition to acting. She became a household name with her portrayal of Twinkle Taneja in the TV drama series "Tashan-e-Ishq," which earned her critical acclaim and a massive fan following. Her ability to effortlessly portray complex characters and deliver powerful performances has made her a sought-after actress in the industry.

 

Aside from her television success, Jasmin has also participated in the reality show "Bigg Boss" and captivated viewers with her authentic personality and strong presence. Her unwavering determination and infectious energy have endeared her to fans across the nation.

Jennifer Mistry Bansiwal

Television Female Actor

Jennifer Mistry Bansiwal is an Indian actress known for her notable work in the entertainment industry. Jennifer gained widespread recognition for her portrayal of Roshan Kaur Sodhi in the popular Indian sitcom "Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah," which has been running successfully for over a decade. Her comic timing and impeccable acting skills have made her a household name.

 

Jennifer's journey in the industry began with theater, where she honed her acting skills and developed a strong foundation. She later ventured into television and films, showcasing her talent in various genres. Her infectious energy, natural charm, and ability to bring characters to life have won her the love and admiration of audiences.

 

Off-screen, Jennifer is known for her humility and down-to-earth nature, which has endeared her to fans and colleagues alike. She continues to impress with her acting prowess and remains a prominent figure in the Indian television industry. Jennifer Mistry Bansiwal's contribution to the entertainment world is undeniable, and her talent continues to shine bright on the screen.

Jigyasa's natural flair for acting and dedication towards her craft have been evident in her subsequent roles. item.content:encoded:
Juhi Parmar

Television Female Actor

Juhi Parmar is an accomplished Indian television actress, presenter, and entrepreneur. Born on December 14, 1980, in Ujjain, Madhya Pradesh, she rose to prominence through her remarkable performances on the small screen. Juhi is best known for her portrayal of Kumkum in the popular TV series "Kumkum - Ek Pyara Sa Bandhan," which earned her immense recognition and a loyal fan base.

 

With her exceptional acting skills and magnetic screen presence, Juhi has successfully essayed a wide range of roles in various television shows. Her versatility and ability to bring depth to her characters have made her a household name in India. She has also hosted several reality shows and events, showcasing her confident and charismatic personality.

 

Apart from her acting career, Juhi Parmar is an accomplished entrepreneur. She launched her own production company called "Juhi Entertainment Pvt. Ltd." and has produced various television shows. She is also involved in philanthropic activities and has supported several charitable organizations.

item.title: Jayati Bhatia
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Jayati Bhatia

Television Female Actor

Jayati Bhatia, born on July 28, 1970, is an Indian actress known for her work in the television industry. She gained significant recognition for her portrayal of Nirmala "Mataji" Bharadwaj in the long-running TV show "Sasural Simar Ka," which aired on Colors TV from 2011 to 2018. Currently, she is playing the role of Geetanjali Devi Oswal in the second season of "Sasural Simar Ka."

 

Jayati Bhatia made her debut in the Hindi television industry in 1995 with the show "Challenge," where she played the character Khushnuma. She further showcased her talent in the sitcom "Tu Tu Main Main" on Star Plus, portraying the role of Kumud. Her association with producer Ekta Kapoor began with the show "Kanyadaan" and she also had a small role in Kapoor's production "Itihaas."

 

Continuing into the new century and decade, Jayati Bhatia appeared as the wife of Arun Govil's character in the show "Kaise Kahoon" on Zee TV. She worked with Ekta Kapoor on two more projects: the comedy-drama "Kitne Kool Hai Hum" and the Sony TV show "Kutumb," where she portrayed the character Kavita Mittal, the aunt of the male lead.

 

One of Jayati Bhatia's notable roles was that of Geetu Basu in the popular daily soap "Kasautii Zindagii Kay" from 2003 to 2006. Additionally, she played the role of Bindiya, the friend of the titular lead in "Jassi Jaissi Koi Nahin" in 2003, and appeared as Titli in "Sinndoor Tere Naam Ka" on Zee TV in 2005. She also portrayed the character Mishti in Zee TV's "Mamta" from 2006 to 2007.

item.title: Jiya Shankar
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Jiya Shankar

Television Female Actor

Jiya Shankar, an accomplished Indian actress, has left her mark in both television and film industries with diverse and impactful roles.

Hailing from Mumbai, Maharashtra, Jiya Shankar was born to Surekha Gavli. She embarked on her acting journey in 2013, making her debut in the Telugu film "Entha Andanga Unnave," alongside Ajay Manthena. She continued to explore different cinematic territories, featuring in the Tamil film "Kanavu Variyam" opposite Arun Chidambaram in 2017.

 

Jiya's television career commenced in 2015 with her portrayal of Alisha Rai in Bindass's "Love by Chance." Her breakthrough on television came in 2016 when she took on the role of Shreya Dixit Rathore in &TV's "Queens Hain Hum." Subsequently, she gained recognition by portraying Dr. Iravati "Ira" Pandey in the comedy drama series "Meri Hanikarak Biwi" on &TV.

 

Her versatility extended to Sab TV's "Kaatelal & Sons," where she portrayed Susheela "Susheela" Ruhail Solanki opposite Paras Arora. Further expanding her horizons, she starred as Nisha Katkar in the Marathi movie "Ved," alongside Ritesh Deshmukh and Genelia Deshmukh. The film's success underscored her acting prowess and marked her entry into the Marathi film industry.

item.content:encoded:
Kamya Panjabi

Television Female Actor

Kamya Panjabi is a renowned Indian television actress who has left an indelible mark in the entertainment industry. Born on August 13, 1979, she gained immense popularity through her remarkable performances in various television shows. With her exceptional acting skills and charismatic personality, Kamya has won the hearts of millions of viewers.

 

Known for her versatility, Kamya has portrayed a wide range of characters, from the strong and independent to the vulnerable and emotional. Her ability to bring depth and conviction to her roles has earned her critical acclaim and numerous accolades. She has also showcased her talent as a reality show contestant, appearing in shows like "Bigg Boss" and "Nach Baliye."

 

Apart from her acting prowess, Kamya is admired for her bold and fearless attitude. She is known for speaking her mind and advocating for important social issues. Kamya's determination and resilience have inspired many, making her a role model for aspiring actors.

 

With her captivating performances and unwavering dedication, Kamya Panjabi continues to be a prominent figure in the world of Indian television, leaving an indelible impact on the industry and the hearts of her fans.

item.title: Karishma Tanna
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Karishma Tanna

Television Female Actor

Karishma Tanna is an Indian actress and model known for her contributions to the entertainment industry. With her striking looks, charismatic presence, and versatile acting skills, she has carved a niche for herself in both television and film domains. Born on December 21, 1983, in Mumbai, Karishma made her acting debut in 2001 with the popular TV show "Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi."

 

Over the years, she has appeared in numerous successful TV serials, reality shows, and Bollywood films, earning accolades and a massive fan following. Her notable works include "Naagarjuna – Ek Yoddha," "Qayamat Ki Raat," and "Bigg Boss 8." Karishma's ability to effortlessly portray diverse characters has won her critical acclaim.

 

Beyond her acting prowess, Karishma is known for her graceful personality and impeccable style. She has also been a part of several reality shows like "Jhalak Dikhhla Jaa" and "Fear Factor: Khatron Ke Khiladi," where she showcased her adventurous side. With her talent, beauty, and determination, Karishma Tanna continues to be a prominent figure in the Indian entertainment industry, captivating audiences with her charm and talent.

item.title: Keerti Nagpure
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Keerti Nagpure

Television Female Actor

Keerti Nagpure is an Indian television actress who has captured the hearts of viewers with her captivating performances. Born on January 23, 1987, Keerti hails from Pune, Maharashtra. She made her acting debut with the popular TV show "Parichay - Nayee Zindagi Kay Sapno Ka" in 2011, where she portrayed the character of Siddhi Chopra. Her portrayal of the innocent and vulnerable Siddhi earned her accolades and a dedicated fan following.

 

Keerti Nagpure's talent and dedication to her craft have allowed her to explore a diverse range of roles. She has appeared in several television series, including "Desh Ki Beti Nandini" and "Sasural Simar Ka." With her impeccable acting skills and natural screen presence, Keerti has showcased her versatility as an actress.

 

Apart from television, Keerti Nagpure has also ventured into the film industry. She made her silver screen debut with the Marathi film "Sanshay Kallol" in 2013, further establishing her acting prowess.

 

With her talent, beauty, and commitment to her craft, Keerti Nagpure continues to shine in the entertainment industry, leaving a lasting impression on audiences and cementing her place as one of the prominent talents in Indian television and cinema.

item.content:encoded:
Kratika Sengar

Television Female Actor

Kratika Sengar is a renowned Indian television actress who has captivated audiences with her exceptional talent and captivating screen presence. Born on July 3, 1986, in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, she has established herself as one of the most popular faces in the Indian entertainment industry.

 

Kratika gained widespread recognition for her portrayal of the strong-willed character Aarti in the popular television series "Punar Vivah." Her nuanced performance and ability to bring depth to her roles have garnered critical acclaim and a loyal fan following. With her graceful demeanor and expressive eyes, she effortlessly connects with viewers, leaving a lasting impact on their hearts.

 

Throughout her career, Kratika has showcased her versatility by taking on a diverse range of roles, from playing a warrior princess in the historical drama "Jhansi Ki Rani" to a fearless police officer in "Kasam Tere Pyaar Ki." Her ability to portray complex emotions and handle challenging characters with finesse has cemented her status as a sought-after actress in the industry.

Krissann Barretto

Television Female Actor

Krissann Barretto is a talented Indian television actress and social media influencer, known for her notable work in the entertainment industry. Born on October 3, 1991, she hails from Mumbai, Maharashtra. With her captivating charm and acting prowess, Krissann has garnered a significant fan following.

 

Krissann rose to fame with her role as Ria Oberoi in the popular youth-oriented show "Kaisi Yeh Yaariaan." Her portrayal of a spirited and independent character won the hearts of audiences. She has also showcased her acting skills in other TV series like "Yeh Hai Aashiqui" and "Sasural Simar Ka."

 

Apart from her acting career, Krissann is highly active on social media platforms. With her vibrant personality and engaging content, she has amassed a substantial following on Instagram. She often shares glimpses of her personal and professional life, connecting with fans on a deeper level.

item.title: Kaveri Priyam
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Kaveri Priyam

Television Female Actor

Kaveri Priyam, a prominent Indian actress, is recognized for her significant contributions to Hindi television. Born on October 22, in Bokaro, Jharkhand, she embarked on her career journey with determination and passion.

 

Kaveri Priyam's academic foundation was established at St. Xavier School in Bokaro, and she further honed her skills by graduating from the Vellore Institute of Technology. Following her studies, she made her way to Mumbai, where she initiated her career as a model, engaging in print shoots and advertisements. Alongside her younger brother Ritesh Anand, she ventured into the culinary world, co-owning the Mumbai-based restaurant Konkan Chilly.

 

Her acting journey commenced with a role in the TV show "Naagin 2" as Madhu Makkhi, which marked her debut. Subsequently, she appeared in "Pardes Mein Hai Mera Dil" and "Savdhaan India." Priyam expanded her horizons by entering the film arena with her debut in "Tishnagi" in 2018.

 

A pivotal moment in her career came when she joined Rajan Shahi's "Yeh Rishtey Hain Pyaar Ke" as Kuhu Maheshwari Rajvansh in 2019, opposite Ritvik Arora and Avinash Mishra. This role propelled her to the limelight, establishing her as a breakthrough talent. Simultaneously, she was part of Shahi's another production, the romantic drama series "Yeh Rishta Kya Kehlata Hai."

 

In 2021, Kaveri Priyam took on the role of Dr. Monami Mahajan in Sony SAB's "Ziddi Dil Maane Na," opposite Shaleen Malhotra. The show concluded in June 2022. Presently, she portrays Amrita Kaur Brar in Sony SAB's "Dil Diyaan Gallaan," alongside Paras Arora.

Leena Jumani

Television Female Actor

Leena Jumani is a talented Indian actress known for her work in the television and film industry. Born on July 16, 1990, in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, she made her acting debut with the TV show "Koi Aane Ko Hai" in 2009. However, it was her portrayal of Khemi in the popular soap opera "Bandini" that garnered her widespread recognition and acclaim.

 

Leena's mesmerizing beauty, coupled with her exceptional acting skills, quickly made her a favorite among viewers. Her ability to bring depth and authenticity to her characters has earned her a dedicated fan base. Over the years, she has showcased her versatility by taking on various roles in both television and films.

 

Leena Jumani's notable performances include her roles in TV shows like "Tujh Sang Preet Lagai Sajna" and "Kumkum Bhagya." She has also appeared in movies such as "Himmatwala" and "Mad About Dance." With her charming presence on-screen and commitment to her craft, Leena continues to leave a lasting impression in the entertainment industry. Her talent and dedication make her a promising talent to watch out for in the years to come.

Television Female Actor

Lavina Tandon is an Indian television actress who is known for her roles in Hindi TV serials. She was born on May 14, 1991, in Ludhiana, Punjab, India. Lavina Tandon has also appeared in other TV shows such as "Itna Karo Na Mujhe Pyaar," "Sasural Simar Ka," and "Kumkum Bhagya." item.title: Madhurima Tuli
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Madhurima Tuli

Television Female Actor

Madhurima Tuli is a talented Indian actress known for her captivating performances in both television and film industries. Born on August 19, 1986, in Odisha, India, Madhurima began her career in the entertainment world with modeling assignments before transitioning to acting. She made her television debut with the popular show "Kumkum Bhagya" and gained recognition for her portrayal of the character Tanushree. Her dynamic acting skills and on-screen presence impressed the audience, leading to numerous opportunities in the industry.

 

Madhurima's versatility as an actress is evident in her diverse roles, ranging from intense dramas to lighthearted comedies. She has also made a mark in the world of cinema, appearing in notable films like "Baby," "Naam Shabana," and "Hamari Adhuri Kahani." Her ability to bring depth and nuance to her characters has earned her critical acclaim and a loyal fan base.

 

Apart from her acting prowess, Madhurima is also recognized for her graceful appearance and fashion sense. Her dedication to her craft and commitment to delivering impactful performances have made her a respected figure in the entertainment industry. With her talent and passion, Madhurima Tuli continues to enthrall audiences and carve a successful path in the world of acting.

item.content:encoded:
Madirakshi Mundle

Television Female Actor

Madirakshi Mundle is an Indian actress known for her work in the television industry. Born on July 1, 1995, in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, Madirakshi began her acting career in 2015 with the popular mythological series "Siya Ke Ram." In the show, she portrayed the character of Sita, the wife of Lord Rama. Her portrayal of Sita earned her critical acclaim and made her a household name.

 

Madirakshi's beauty, grace, and exceptional acting skills captivated the audience, making her one of the most promising actresses in the industry. Her ability to bring depth and emotion to her characters is commendable, and she has shown versatility in playing different roles.

 

Since her debut, Madirakshi has appeared in several television shows and has garnered a dedicated fan following. Her dedication and hard work have earned her numerous accolades and nominations. With her talent and passion for acting, Madirakshi continues to impress and entertain audiences with her performances. She remains an influential figure in the television industry, inspiring aspiring actors with her talent and success.

item.title: Helly Shah
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Helly Shah

Television Female Actor

Helly Shah is an Indian actress and model who primarily works in Hindi television. She made her acting debut in 2010 with Zindagi Ka Har Rang... Gulaal portraying Talli. She is best known for her portrayal of Swara Sanskaar Maheshwari in Swaragini and Devanshi Pawan Bakshi in Devanshi.

 

Shah was born on 7 January 1996 in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. She completed her schooling from St. Xavier's High School, Ahmedabad. She then pursued a Bachelor of Arts degree in Mass Communication from Gujarat University.

Shah began her acting career when she was in 8th grade. Her career began with Star Plus's show Gulaal. In 2011 she appeared in Diya Aur Baati Hum playing Shruti. She then played Alaxmi in Life OK's Alaxmi - Hamari Super Bahu. Later, she played Ami in Khelti Hai Zindagi Aankh Micholi. She then appeared in Sony Pal's Khushiyon Kii Gullak Aashi.

 

In 2015, Shah bagged the lead role of Swara Sanskaar Maheshwari in Star Plus's show Swaragini. The show was a huge success and made Shah a household name. She won several awards for her performance in the show, including the Indian Telly Award for Best Actress.

 

In 2017, Shah starred in the lead role of Devanshi Pawan Bakshi in Colors TV's show Devanshi. The show was also a huge success and made Shah even more popular. She won several awards for her performance in the show, including the Gold Award for Best Actress.

item.title: Hiba Nawab

item.content:encoded:
Hiba Nawab

Television Female Actor

Hiba Nawab is an Indian television actress. She was born on November 14, 1996, in Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh, India. She made her acting debut as a child artist in the 2003 horror film Ssshhhh... Phir Koi Hai. Her first role as an adult was in the 2013 romantic comedy film Crazy Stupid Ishq, where she played the role of Anushka 'Pampi' Atwal.

 

Nawab had her breakthrough with the portrayal of Amaya Mathur in the 2015 television series Tere Sheher Mein. She played the role of a young woman who is torn between her love for two men. The series was a critical and commercial success, and Nawab's performance was praised by critics.

 

Nawab is also known for her role of Elaichi Bansal Khurana in the 2018-2020 television series Jijaji Chhat Per Hain. She played the role of a young woman who is married to an older man. The series was a popular comedy, and Nawab's performance was praised by fans.

 

Nawab is a talented actress who has starred in a variety of films and television series. She is known for her versatility and her ability to portray a wide range of characters. She is a rising star in the Indian television industry, and she is sure to continue to entertain audiences for many years to come.

 

In addition to her acting career, Nawab is also a social media influencer. She has over 3 million followers on Instagram, and she uses her platform to promote body positivity and self-love. She is an inspiration to young women everywhere, and she is a role model for those who want to pursue a career in the entertainment industry.

item.title: Himanshi Khurana
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Himanshi Khurana

Television Female Actor

Himanshi Khurana is an Indian model, actress, and singer who works in Punjabi films. She was born on November 27, 1991, in Kiratpur Sahib, Punjab. She made her acting debut in the 2013 Punjabi film "Munda Hi Da Munda". She has since appeared in several other Punjabi films, including "Sadda Haq" (2016), "Jatt & Juliet" (2017), and "Fukrey Returns" (2017). In 2019, she participated in the reality show "Bigg Boss 13". She was one of the most popular contestants on the show and finished in the top 5.

 

Himanshi Khurana is also a successful singer. She has released several hit singles, including "I Like It", "Surma Bole", and "Mohabbatan". She has also collaborated with several other Punjabi singers, including Diljit Dosanjh, Yo Yo Honey Singh, and Gippy Grewal.

 

Himanshi Khurana is a popular and successful figure in the Punjabi entertainment industry. She is known for her beauty, talent, and personality. She is also a strong advocate for animal rights and has worked with several organizations to raise awareness about the issue.

item.title: Hina Khan
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Hina Khan

Television Female Actor

Hina Khan is an Indian actress who appears in Hindi television and films. She is known for playing Akshara in Star Plus's Yeh Rishta Kya Kehlata Hai and Komolika in Kasautii Zindagii Kay 2.

 

Khan was born on 2 October 1987 in Srinagar, Jammu and Kashmir, India into a Kashmiri Muslim family. She completed her Master of Business Administration (MBA) in 2009 from the CCA School of Management in Gurgaon.

 

Khan made her television debut in 2009 with the show Yeh Rishta Kya Kehlata Hai. She played the role of Akshara Singhania, a simple and innocent girl, for nine years. Her performance in the show was highly praised and she won several awards, including the Indian Telly Award for Best Actress.

 

In 2018, Khan made a comeback to television with the show Kasautii Zindagii Kay 2. She played the role of Komolika Basu, an evil and manipulative woman. Her performance in the show was once again highly praised and she won several awards, including the Indian Telly Award for Best Actress in a Negative Role.

 

Khan has also appeared in a few films. She made her Bollywood debut in 2017 with the film Lines. She has also appeared in the films Hacked (2019) and Qarib Qarib Singlle (2017).

 

Khan is a popular and successful actress. She is known for her talent, hard work, and dedication. She is also a fashion icon and is often seen at fashion events and award shows.

 

Khan is an inspiration to many young women. She is a role model for women who want to achieve success in their careers.

item.title: Heli daruwala
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Heli Daruwala

Television Female Actor

Heli Daruwala is an Indian television actress who has made her mark in the industry through her appearances in various Hindi TV serials. She has showcased her talent and versatility in a range of roles, gaining recognition and appreciation from the audience.

 

Heli first came into the limelight with her role in the TV serial "Nisha Aur Uske Cousins" in 2014. Her performance in the show earned her praise and established her as a promising actress. She further cemented her position in the industry with her role in "Naagin 3" in 2018, where she portrayed a significant character in the popular supernatural drama series.

 

In the same year, Heli appeared in the historical drama "Dastaan-E-Mohabbat: Salim Anarkali," showcasing her acting skills and ability to bring depth to her characters. She continued to impress the audience with her performances in shows like "Yeh Rishtey Hain Pyaar Ke" (2019) and "Shaadi Mubarak" (2020).

 

Throughout her career, Heli Daruwala has displayed her versatility by portraying different characters across various genres. Her dedication and talent have made her a sought-after actress in the television industry. With her appearances in popular TV shows, she has garnered a significant fan following and continues to charm viewers with her on-screen presence.

Mouli Ganguly

Television Female Actor

Mouli Ganguly is an accomplished Indian actress known for her remarkable contributions to the television and film industry. Born on December 15, 1982, in Kolkata, West Bengal, Ganguly has captivated audiences with her exceptional acting prowess and mesmerizing screen presence.

 

With a career spanning over two decades, Ganguly has portrayed a diverse range of characters, effortlessly transitioning between intense dramas and light-hearted comedies. She gained immense popularity for her role as Dr. Riddhima Gupta in the critically acclaimed medical drama series "Dill Mill Gayye." Her portrayal of the complex and compassionate character earned her widespread acclaim and a dedicated fan following.

 

Ganguly's talent and dedication have earned her several accolades, including prestigious awards for her outstanding performances. Beyond television, she has also showcased her versatility in the world of cinema, appearing in notable films such as "Jodi Love Dile Na Prane" and "Teen Patti."

item.title: Munmun Dutta
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Munmun Dutta

Television Female Actor

Munmun Dutta is a popular Indian actress known for her role as Babita Iyer in the long-running sitcom "Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah." Born on September 28, 1987, in Durgapur, West Bengal, Munmun made her acting debut in the television industry with the show "Hum Sab Baraati" in 2004. However, it was her portrayal of Babita Iyer, a charming and fashionable neighbor, that brought her widespread recognition and adoration.

 

With her impeccable comic timing, Munmun has won the hearts of millions of viewers and has become an integral part of the show's success. Her character's signature dialogue "Hey maa, mataji" has become a catchphrase among fans.

 

Besides her acting skills, Munmun is also admired for her graceful beauty and elegant fashion sense. She has garnered a huge following on social media platforms, where she often shares glimpses of her personal and professional life.

 

Munmun Dutta's talent, charm, and versatility have earned her a special place in the hearts of fans and the entertainment industry. Her dedication and commitment to her craft continue to make her a beloved figure in Indian television.

item.title: Mahima Makwana

item.content:encoded:
Mahima Makwana

Television Female Actor

Mahima Makwana is a talented Indian actress who has made a significant mark in the entertainment industry. Born on August 5, 1999, in Mumbai, India, she began her acting career at a young age and quickly gained recognition for her remarkable performances.

 

Mahima rose to prominence with her portrayal of Rachna in the popular television series "Sapne Suhane Ladakpan Ke." Her ability to bring depth and emotion to her characters won the hearts of audiences across the country. Since then, she has appeared in several successful TV shows, including "Adhuri Kahaani Hamari" and "Rishton Ka Chakravyuh," further cementing her position as a versatile actress.

 

With her impeccable acting skills, Mahima has effortlessly portrayed a wide range of characters, from the innocent girl-next-door to strong and independent women. Her ability to connect with the audience and convey complex emotions has earned her critical acclaim.

 

Besides her acting prowess, Mahima is also known for her striking beauty and impeccable fashion sense. She has a significant following on social media, where she shares glimpses of her personal and professional life.

Manasi Salvi

Television Female Actor

Manasi Salvi is a talented and versatile Indian actress who has left an indelible mark on the television industry. Born on January 19, 1980, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, Manasi has captivated audiences with her impeccable acting skills and charismatic screen presence.

 

She made her acting debut in 2002 with the popular television show "Aashirwad" and since then, there has been no looking back for her. Manasi has portrayed a wide range of characters, each with its unique nuances, which has earned her critical acclaim and a loyal fan base. Whether it's the strong-willed and independent woman or the vulnerable and emotional character, she effortlessly breathes life into every role she takes on.

 

Manasi's talent extends beyond television as she has also appeared in several Marathi films, further showcasing her versatility as an actress. With her impeccable dialogue delivery and expressive eyes, she has created a lasting impact on the hearts of the audience.

 

Off-screen, Manasi is known for her humility and grace. She continues to inspire and motivate aspiring actors through her dedication and passion for her craft. Her journey in the entertainment industry is a testament to her talent and determination, making her one of the most beloved and respected actresses in the Indian television industry today.

item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Mansi Srivastava

Television Female Actor

Mansi Srivastava is a talented Indian television actor known for her captivating performances and striking beauty. With her remarkable acting skills and charming personality, Mansi has carved a niche for herself in the entertainment industry.

 

Born and raised in Uttar Pradesh, Mansi embarked on her acting journey with the popular show "Suvreen Guggal - Topper of The Year," where she portrayed the role of a supportive friend with utmost finesse. Her impeccable acting prowess earned her recognition and a dedicated fan following.

 

Over the years, Mansi has showcased her versatility by portraying diverse characters in various television dramas. Whether it's a strong-willed woman fighting against societal norms or a vulnerable yet determined individual, Mansi effortlessly breathes life into her roles, leaving the audience mesmerized.

 

Her flawless portrayal of characters, combined with her natural charm and captivating screen presence, has made her a favorite among viewers. Mansi's dedication and commitment to her craft have garnered accolades and admiration from both critics and fans alike.

item.content:encoded:
Meera Deosthale

Television Female Actor

Meera Deosthale is a talented Indian television actor known for her remarkable performances in the entertainment industry. Born on November 16, 1995, Meera has carved a niche for herself with her incredible acting skills and captivating on-screen presence.

 

She gained widespread recognition for her portrayal of Chakor Suraj Rajvanshi in the popular television drama series "Udaan." Her portrayal of a strong-willed and resilient character won the hearts of audiences and garnered critical acclaim. Meera's nuanced performance showcased her versatility and ability to bring depth to her roles.

 

With her exceptional talent and dedication, Meera has managed to establish herself as one of the most promising actors in the industry. Her commitment to her craft and the ability to effortlessly portray a range of emotions has earned her a dedicated fan following.

Apart from her acting prowess, Meera is also admired for her natural beauty and graceful demeanor. Her charming personality and down-to-earth nature have made her a favorite among her co-stars and fans alike.

item.title: Megha Chakraborty
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Megha Chakraborty

Television Female Actor

Megha Chakraborty is an Indian film and television actress known for her work in various TV serials. She is currently playing the role of Imlie in the TV show "Imlie."

 

Megha started her career in the entertainment industry with the Bengali serial "Joto Hashi Tato Ranna." Her breakthrough in Hindi television came with the show "Badii Devrani." She gained further recognition for her roles in TV shows like "Khwaabon Ki Zamin Par," "Peshwa Bajirao," and "Krishna Chali London," which made her a household name.

 

In addition to her television work, Megha Chakraborty also played the lead role of Gulaal in the film "Desert Tears." The film sheds light on the persecution of women in rural India and was shot in Rajasthan.

 

In November 2020, Megha started portraying the lead role of Garima Ruhail Rajawat in the TV show "Kaatelal & Sons." After the show ended, she and Sahil Phull, her co-star, started their own production company called Mismanaged Company. Their first production is the web show "Dil-e-couch," where Megha plays the role of Nima. The series premiered on the YouTube channel "Mismanaged Company."

Monalisa

Television Female Actor

Monalisa, also known as Antara Biswas, is a prominent Bhojpuri actress who has captivated audiences with her talent and beauty. Born on October 21, 1982, in Kolkata, India, Monalisa ventured into the Bhojpuri film industry and made a remarkable mark.

 

With her mesmerizing on-screen presence and versatile acting skills, Monalisa has become one of the most sought-after actresses in the Bhojpuri cinema. She has starred in numerous successful Bhojpuri films, earning accolades and a dedicated fan following. Her ability to portray various characters with depth and conviction has garnered critical acclaim.

 

Monalisa's charm extends beyond the silver screen as she has also made appearances in popular reality shows like "Bigg Boss" and "Nach Baliye." Her captivating personality and graceful dance moves have won hearts across the nation.

 

Aside from her acting prowess, Monalisa is known for her striking looks and impeccable style. Her radiant smile and expressive eyes add to her magnetic appeal, making her a beloved figure among fans.

item.title: Madalsa Sharma
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Madalsa Sharma

Television Female Actor

Madalsa Sharma is an Indian actress who primarily works in the Hindi and Telugu film industries. She was born on September 26, 1991, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. Madalsa made her acting debut with the Telugu film "Fitting Master" in 2009.

 

She gained recognition in the Hindi film industry with her role in the film "Samrat & Co." in 2014. Madalsa has also appeared in other Hindi films such as "Angry Young Man" (2014) and "Amla" (2019).

 

In addition to films, Madalsa Sharma has also ventured into the television industry. She gained significant popularity for her portrayal of Kavya Desai in the Hindi TV serial "Anupamaa" (2020-present), which airs on Star Plus. Her character in the show has been well-received by the audience.

 

Madalsa Sharma comes from a family with a background in the film industry. Her father, Subhash Sharma, is a film producer, while her mother, Sheela Sharma, is a veteran actress.

item.title: Mallika Singh
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Mallika Singh

Television Female Actor

Mallika Singh is an Indian actress known for her work in the television industry. She was born on September 15, 2000, in Jammu, Jammu and Kashmir, India. Mallika gained popularity for her portrayal of the character Radha in the television series "RadhaKrishn," which aired on Star Bharat.

 

"RadhaKrishn" is a mythological drama that depicts the love story of Lord Krishna and Radha. Mallika Singh's portrayal of Radha received acclaim for her performance and on-screen chemistry with the actor who played Krishna.

 

Mallika made her acting debut with "RadhaKrishn" and captured the attention of the audience with her talent and charm. Her portrayal of Radha showcased her acting skills and gained her a significant fan following.

item.title: Moon Banerjee
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Moonmoon Banerjee

Television Female Actor

Moonmoon Banerjee, also known as Mahua, is a talented Indian television actress who has garnered popularity and appreciation for her various roles on the small screen. One of her significant roles was as Sampada Basu in Ekta Kapoor's soap "Kasautii Zindagii Kay" on Star Plus, which brought her widespread recognition.

 

Moonmoon's acting prowess was further showcased in her roles as Panna in "Sasural Genda Phool," Asha Bose in "Kuch Rang Pyar Ke Aise Bhi" on Sony Entertainment Television, and Damayanti in "Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani" on Zee TV.

 

In more recent times, Moonmoon Banerjee starred as Gayatri Singh in Star Bharat's "Muskaan," solidifying her position as a prominent figure in the television industry. She also portrayed the character of Uma Rawat in "Muskuraane Ki Vajah Tum Ho."

item.title: Nalini Negi
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Nalini Negi

Television Female Actor

Nalini Negi is an accomplished Indian actress who has made a significant impact in the world of entertainment. With her remarkable talent and captivating on-screen presence, she has earned a special place in the hearts of audiences. Born on September 14, 1990, in Delhi, Nalini initially ventured into the industry through modeling and quickly gained attention for her striking looks and natural acting skills.

 

Nalini rose to fame with her portrayal of the character Tanveer in the popular Indian television series "Naamkarann." Her stellar performance and ability to connect with viewers garnered critical acclaim and established her as a promising actress. She later appeared in various other television shows, including "Laut Aao Trisha" and "Meri Durga," where she showcased her versatility and versatility as an actor.

 

In addition to her television work, Nalini has also ventured into the world of film, starring in the Bollywood movie "Luv U Soniyo" in 2013. Her charming personality and ability to effortlessly portray diverse roles have earned her a loyal fan base.

Neha Lakshmi Iyer

Television Female Actor

Neha Lakshmi Iyer is a talented Indian television actress who has made a remarkable mark in the entertainment industry. With her captivating performances and stunning screen presence, she has won the hearts of audiences across the country. Neha's journey in the world of television began with her debut in the popular soap opera "Ishqbaaz," where she portrayed the character of Saumya. Her nuanced portrayal of Saumya, a brave and independent woman, earned her widespread recognition and appreciation.

 

Neha's versatility as an actress is evident in her ability to effortlessly switch between various genres. From intense dramas to light-hearted comedies, she has showcased her acting prowess in shows like "Yeh Hai Mohabbatein" and "Mayavi Maling." Her ability to bring depth and emotional authenticity to her characters has garnered her critical acclaim.

 

Apart from her acting skills, Neha is also admired for her natural beauty and elegant fashion sense. Her graceful presence on and off-screen has made her a style icon for many. With her dedication and passion for her craft, Neha Lakshmi Iyer continues to captivate audiences and carve a niche for herself in the television industry

item.title: Neha Marda
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Neha Marda

Television Female Actor

Neha Marda is a talented Indian television actress who has left an indelible mark on the small screen with her captivating performances. Born on September 23, 1985, in Kolkata, Neha embarked on her acting journey at a young age and has since become a household name.

 

Known for her versatility and ability to portray a wide range of characters, Neha has graced the screens with her exceptional talent in various popular TV shows. One of her most notable roles was as Gehna in the long-running soap opera "Balika Vadhu," where she portrayed the struggles and triumphs of a child bride with conviction and sensitivity.

 

Neha's impeccable acting skills and natural charm have earned her immense popularity and critical acclaim. She has also won several awards for her outstanding performances, including the Indian Telly Award for Best Actress in a Negative Role.

 

Off-screen, Neha is known for her warm and friendly personality, and she has garnered a large fan following who admire her not only for her acting prowess but also for her dedication and hard work.

item.title: Neha Mehta
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Neha Mehta

Television Female Actor

Neha Mehta is a prominent Indian television actress known for her remarkable performances in the entertainment industry. With her captivating screen presence and exceptional acting skills, she has won the hearts of millions of viewers. Born on June 9, 1978, in Bhavnagar, Gujarat, Neha embarked on her acting journey with the popular television show "Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah," where she portrayed the character of Anjali Mehta, the wife of the main protagonist. Her portrayal of Anjali Mehta was widely appreciated, and she became a household name across India.

 

Neha Mehta's dedication and versatility as an actress have earned her numerous accolades and a loyal fan base. Her ability to effortlessly switch between emotional and comedic scenes has made her a sought-after artist in the television industry. Apart from her notable role in "Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah," Neha has also appeared in other television shows and films, showcasing her versatility as an actor.

 

Beyond her acting prowess, Neha is admired for her graceful persona and philanthropic endeavors. She actively participates in charitable causes and has contributed to the betterment of society.

item.title: Nikita Dutta
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Nikita Dutta

Television Female Actor

Nikita Dutta is a talented Indian television actress who has captivated audiences with her remarkable performances. With her charming persona and exceptional acting skills, she has carved a niche for herself in the entertainment industry.

 

Born on November 13, 1990, in Delhi, India, Nikita initially aspired to be an air hostess but destiny had other plans for her. She made her acting debut in 2014 with the popular TV show "Dream Girl - Ek Ladki Deewani Si," where she portrayed the lead role of Lakshmi Mathur. Her portrayal of a small-town girl dreaming big won hearts and earned her accolades.

 

Nikita's career graph soared with subsequent roles in shows like "Ek Duje Ke Vaaste," "Haasil," and "Laal Ishq." Her impeccable acting prowess and on-screen chemistry with co-stars earned her a loyal fan base.

 

Apart from television, Nikita also ventured into the world of films with the Bollywood movie "Gold" in 2018, where she shared the screen with Akshay Kumar. Her performance was well-received, showcasing her versatility as an actress.

 

With her grace, elegance, and acting prowess, Nikita Dutta continues to shine in the television industry, leaving a lasting impact on viewers. Her journey serves as an inspiration for aspiring actors, proving that talent and dedication can take you far in the world of entertainment.

item.title: Nimrit Kaur Ahluwalia
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Nimrit Kaur Ahluwalia

Television Female Actor

Nimrit Kaur Ahluwalia is a talented Indian television actress who has captivated audiences with her remarkable performances. Born on December 11, 1994, Nimrit hails from a small town in Punjab, India. She rose to fame with her portrayal of Meher Kaur Dhillon in the popular TV show "Choti Sarrdaarni."

Nimrit's acting prowess and dedication to her craft have earned her immense praise and recognition within the entertainment industry. Her ability to bring depth and authenticity to her characters has won the hearts of viewers across the country. Nimrit's natural charm and screen presence have made her a favorite among fans, who eagerly await her every on-screen appearance.

 

Beyond her acting talent, Nimrit is known for her graceful beauty and elegant style. She carries herself with confidence and grace, making her a fashion inspiration for many young women. Nimrit's strong work ethic and commitment to her craft have helped her carve a niche for herself in the competitive world of television.

 

With her incredible talent and dedication, Nimrit Kaur Ahluwalia is undoubtedly a rising star in the Indian television industry. Her future looks bright, and fans eagerly anticipate witnessing her continue to shine on both the small and big screens.

item.title: Niti Taylor
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Niti Taylor

Television Female Actor

Niti Taylor is a talented Indian television actress who has made a significant mark in the entertainment industry. With her charming persona and exceptional acting skills, she has won the hearts of millions of viewers across the nation. Born on November 8, 1994, in Gurgaon, Haryana, Niti embarked on her acting journey at a young age and rose to prominence with her remarkable performances.

 

Niti gained immense popularity for her portrayal of Nandini Murthy in the youth-oriented show "Kaisi Yeh Yaariaan." Her portrayal of the strong, independent yet vulnerable character resonated with the audience and earned her a massive fan following. She has also appeared in other successful TV shows like "Ghulaam," "Ishqbaaaz," and "Laal Ishq," showcasing her versatility as an actress.

 

Apart from her acting prowess, Niti is known for her stunning looks and fashion sense. She exudes confidence and grace both on and off-screen, making her a style icon for many young women. Niti's vibrant personality and positive outlook on life have made her an inspiration for her fans.

 

With her talent, dedication, and endearing presence, Niti Taylor continues to captivate audiences and leaves a lasting impression in the world of Indian television. Her promising career trajectory promises many more remarkable performances and memorable characters in the years to come.

Niyati Fatnani

Television Female Actor

Niyati Fatnani is a talented and versatile television actress who has made a notable impact in the Indian entertainment industry. With her mesmerizing beauty and impeccable acting skills, she has captivated the hearts of audiences across the nation. Niyati rose to fame with her portrayal of Pia in the popular TV show "Nazar," where she showcased her ability to effortlessly embody diverse characters.

 

Born and raised in Gujarat, India, Niyati always had a passion for performing arts. Her dedication and hard work paid off when she entered the television industry and began leaving her mark. Her infectious energy and natural charisma make her a delight to watch on screen.

 

Apart from her acting prowess, Niyati has also showcased her dancing skills on various reality shows. Her graceful moves and precision on the dance floor have garnered her immense praise from both the audience and industry peers.

 

Niyati's down-to-earth nature and humility have won her a large fan base, who admire her not only for her talent but also for her positive attitude and approachability. With her undeniable talent and determination, Niyati Fatnani is undoubtedly a rising star in the Indian television industry, and her future endeavors are eagerly awaited by her fans.

item.title: Pallavi Subhash Shirke
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Pallavi Subhash Shirke

Television Female Actor

Pallavi Subhash Shirke, born on June 9, 1984, is an accomplished Indian actress renowned for her diverse roles across Marathi plays, films, TV shows, and various language films. Her journey from being a model to a versatile actress has earned her recognition and acclaim.

 

Starting her career in the entertainment industry, Pallavi made her mark in Marathi plays, films, and TV shows. Her talents were noticed when she appeared in the Marathi play "Tu Tu Mee Mee." She ventured into television with roles in Marathi serials like "Char Divas Sasuche" and "Adhuri Ek Kahani." Pallavi's role in the Marathi TV show "Ek Hota Raja" alongside Shreyas Talpade further established her acting prowess. Later, she transitioned to Hindi television, gaining prominence through shows like "Tumhari Disha" and "Karam Apnaa Apnaa."

 

Pallavi's career expanded across various languages, with significant roles in Telugu, Kannada, Marathi, and Sinhala films. Her portrayal of Dharma in the TV series "Chakravartin Ashoka Samrat" and Yasodhara in the film "Bimba Devi Alias Yashodhara" garnered her widespread recognition. She showcased her versatility by essaying roles ranging from mythological characters to modern-day protagonists.

 

Her film journey began in the Marathi movie "Polisachi Bayko," and she earned acclaim for her performance in "Kunku Zale Vairi." Pallavi's filmography includes notable works like "Happy Journey," "Naruda Donoruda," and her Sinhala debut in "Bimba Devi Alias Yashodhara." Her performance in the latter led to her receiving accolades and awards for her contribution to the film.

 

In addition to her acting career, Pallavi has been a successful model, appearing in various TV advertisements for brands like Cadbury's, Lion Date Jam, and Everest Gharam Masala. Her captivating presence in ad campaigns earned her the moniker of the 'Cadbury girl.'

Pallavi Subhash Shirke, born on June 9, 1984, is an accomplished Indian actress renowned for her diverse roles across Marathi plays, films, TV shows, and various language films. Her journey from being a model to a versatile actress has earned her recognition and acclaim.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Starting her career in the entertainment industry, Pallavi made her mark in Marathi plays, films, and TV shows. Her talents were noticed when she appeared in the Marathi play \"Tu Tu Mee Mee.\" She ventured into television with roles in Marathi serials like \"Char Divas Sasuche\" and \"Adhuri Ek Kahani.\" Pallavi's role in the Marathi TV show \"Ek Hota Raja\" alongside Shreyas Talpade further established her acting prowess. Later, she transitioned to Hindi television, gaining prominence through shows like \"Tumhari Disha\" and \"Karam Apnaa Apnaa.\"<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Pallavi's career expanded across various languages, with significant roles in Telugu, Kannada, Marathi, and Sinhala films. Her portrayal of Dharma in the TV series \"Chakravartin Ashoka Samrat\" and Yasodhara in the film \"Bimba Devi Alias Yashodhara\" garnered her widespread recognition. She showcased her versatility by essaying roles ranging from mythological characters to modern-day protagonists.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Her film journey began in the Marathi movie \"Polisachi Bayko,\" and she earned acclaim for her performance in \"Kunku Zale Vairi.\" Pallavi's filmography includes notable works like \"Happy Journey,\" \"Naruda Donoruda,\" and her Sinhala debut in \"Bimba Devi Alias Yashodhara.\" Her performance in the latter led to her receiving accolades and awards for her contribution to the film.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

In addition to her acting career, Pallavi has been a successful model, appearing in various TV advertisements for brands like Cadbury's, Lion Date Jam, and Everest Gharam Masala. item.title: Pankhuri Awasthy
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Pankhuri Awasthy

Television Female Actor

Pankhuri Awasthy is a talented Indian television actress known for her remarkable performances and captivating screen presence. Born on March 31, 1991, she hails from Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh. Pankhuri started her acting journey with the popular show "Razia Sultan" in 2015, where she portrayed the titular character of Razia Sultan, the first female ruler of the Delhi Sultanate.

 

Her portrayal of Razia Sultan garnered critical acclaim, and she was praised for her impeccable acting skills and ability to bring depth and emotion to her characters. Pankhuri's flawless performances continued with her role as Vedika Mathur in the hit show "Yeh Rishta Kya Kehlata Hai." Her portrayal of Vedika, a strong and independent woman facing life's challenges, struck a chord with the audience.

 

Pankhuri's dedication and versatility as an actress have made her a prominent figure in the Indian television industry. With her expressive eyes and natural acting prowess, she effortlessly captivates viewers. Her talent and charisma have earned her a significant fan following, who eagerly anticipate her every on-screen appearance.

item.title: Paridhi Sharma
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Paridhi Sharma

Television Female Actor

Paridhi Sharma is a talented and versatile Indian television actress known for her remarkable performances in the entertainment industry. Born on May 15, Paridhi made her acting debut with the popular soap opera "Ruk Jana Nahin" in 2011, where she portrayed the character of Mehek. However, it was her portrayal of Jodha Bai in the historical drama "Jodha Akbar" that brought her widespread recognition and acclaim.

 

With her flawless acting skills and captivating screen presence, Paridhi won the hearts of audiences across the nation. She effortlessly portrayed the nuances of Jodha Bai's character, capturing the essence of a strong and independent woman from the Mughal era. Her chemistry with co-star Rajat Tokas was widely appreciated, making their on-screen pairing one of the most beloved in Indian television history.

 

Paridhi Sharma's success in "Jodha Akbar" led to numerous awards and nominations, including the Zee Gold Awards for Best Actress in a Lead Role. Her popularity and talent have continued to shine as she has taken on diverse roles in other television shows. With her captivating performances, Paridhi has established herself as a highly sought-after actress in the Indian television industry, leaving a lasting impression on audiences with her impeccable acting prowess and undeniable charm.

item.content:encoded:
Parineeta Borthakur

Television Female Actor

Parineeta Borthakur is a talented Indian television actress who has made a remarkable impact in the entertainment industry. With her captivating performances and versatile acting skills, she has garnered a large fan base and established herself as a prominent figure in the world of Indian television.

 

Born on February 21, Parineeta hails from Assam, India. She began her acting journey with the popular Assamese film industry and later transitioned to television. Parineeta has worked in various TV shows and has portrayed diverse characters with finesse. Her notable performances include roles in shows like "Swabhimaan," "Ek Tha Raja Ek Thi Rani," and "Gupta Brothers."

 

Parineeta's ability to effortlessly portray a range of emotions and connect with her audience has earned her critical acclaim. Her natural talent, combined with her dedication and hard work, has made her a sought-after actress in the industry.

 

Apart from acting, Parineeta is also recognized for her elegant style and charming personality. She has become an inspiration for many aspiring actors and continues to enthrall her fans with her remarkable performances on screen.

Nikita Dutta

Television Female Actor

Priyal Gor is a talented Indian actress who has carved a niche for herself in the entertainment industry. Born on November 2, 1994, in Mumbai, India, Priyal started her acting career at a young age and quickly gained recognition for her exceptional talent and mesmerizing beauty.

 

Priyal rose to fame with her portrayal of the lovable character Mona in the popular Indian television series "Ram Milaayi Jodi." Her charming presence and natural acting skills won the hearts of viewers across the nation. She continued to captivate audiences with her versatile performances in shows like "Dekha Ek Khwaab" and "Ichhapyaari Naagin."

 

Beyond television, Priyal has also ventured into films, showcasing her acting prowess on the big screen. Her notable performances in movies like "Just U & Me" and "Saheba Subramanyam" have earned her critical acclaim and further solidified her position in the industry.

 

Priyal Gor's dedication and commitment to her craft have made her a favorite among fans and colleagues alike. Her ability to effortlessly portray a range of emotions and bring depth to her characters is a testament to her talent and versatility. With her captivating screen presence and undeniable talent, Priyal continues to shine as one of the brightest stars in the Indian entertainment industry.

item.title: Pooja Gaur
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Pooja Gaur

Television Female Actor

Pooja Gaur is a talented Indian actress known for her captivating performances in the television industry. Born on June 1, 1991, in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, Pooja made her acting debut in 2008 with the popular TV show "Kitani Mohabbat Hai," where she portrayed the character of Purvi. Her portrayal of the innocent and vulnerable Purvi garnered widespread praise from both critics and audiences alike.

 

Pooja's acting skills and versatility soon led her to bag other notable roles in television shows such as "Mann Kee Awaaz Pratigya," where she played the fierce and bold Pratigya, further establishing her position as a promising actress. Her powerful performances, coupled with her expressive eyes and natural charm, endeared her to fans across the country.

 

In addition to her acting prowess, Pooja is also known for her graceful dance moves, making her a complete entertainer. Her dedication to her craft and ability to immerse herself in diverse characters have made her a sought-after actress in the industry.

 

Beyond her professional achievements, Pooja is admired for her down-to-earth nature and philanthropic endeavors. She actively supports various social causes and uses her platform to raise awareness about important issues.

item.title: Pranali Rathod
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Pranali Rathod

Television Female Actor

Pranali Rathod is a talented Indian television actress who has captivated audiences with her impressive acting skills and charming on-screen presence. With her remarkable performances, she has carved a niche for herself in the entertainment industry.

 

Born on November 15, 1999, in Bhavnagar, Gujarat, Pranali Rathod started her career in the world of acting at a young age. She made her television debut with the popular show "Bramhakumari Badi," where she portrayed the role of Ambika. Her portrayal of the character received critical acclaim and established her as a promising actress.

 

Pranali Rathod's natural acting abilities and dedication have earned her numerous opportunities in the television industry. She has since appeared in several successful shows, including "Pavitra Bhagya" and "Jai Kanhaiya Lal Ki." Her versatility as an actress is evident in the diverse roles she has portrayed, winning the hearts of viewers across the country.

 

Besides her acting prowess, Pranali Rathod possesses a radiant and charismatic personality that adds to her appeal. Her talent, combined with her beauty, has made her a favorite among fans and a sought-after name in the industry.

item.content:encoded:
Preetika Rao

Television Female Actor

Preetika Rao is an acclaimed Indian television actress who has carved a niche for herself in the entertainment industry. Born on May 29, 1988, in Mangalore, India, Preetika is known for her mesmerizing beauty, impressive acting skills, and captivating screen presence.

 

She made her acting debut with the popular television series "Beintehaa" in 2013, where she portrayed the lead role of Aaliya Haider. Preetika's portrayal of Aaliya garnered critical acclaim and won her a loyal fan following. Her ability to bring depth and vulnerability to her characters made her a sought-after actress in the television industry.

 

Preetika Rao's talent and dedication have earned her numerous accolades and awards. Her graceful performances and versatility have captivated audiences across the country. With her striking looks and natural charm, she has become a style icon for many young women.

 

Beyond her acting career, Preetika is also a talented writer and has penned several articles for popular publications. She is known for her intelligence, eloquence, and commitment to social causes.

item.title: Pavitra Punia
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Pavitra Punia

Television Female Actor

Pavitra Punia is an Indian television actress and model. She was born on April 22, 1988, in Hisar, Haryana, India. Pavitra initially started her career as a model and participated in various beauty pageants. She gained recognition in the entertainment industry through her appearances in popular Indian television shows.

 

Pavitra Punia has acted in several TV serials, including "Love u Zindagi," "Hongey Judaa Na Hum," "Yeh Hai Mohabbatein," and "Naagin 3." However, she rose to fame for her portrayal of the character Timnasa in the fantasy drama series "Baalveer Returns." Her performance in the show received positive reviews and earned her a significant fan following.

 

In addition to television, Pavitra Punia has also participated in reality shows. She was a contestant on the reality TV show "Splitsvilla 3" and later appeared on the reality show "Bigg Boss 14" in 2020. Her participation in "Bigg Boss" further increased her popularity and showcased her strong and independent personality.

item.title: Panchi Bora
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Panchi Bora

Television Female Actor

Panchi Bora is an Indian television actress known for her work in Hindi and Assamese serials. She was born on December 27, 1985, in Assam, India. Panchi started her acting career in the early 2000s and has appeared in various television shows, gaining popularity for her performances.

 

She gained recognition for her role as Prachi in the popular Hindi soap opera "Kayamath," which aired from 2007 to 2009. Her portrayal of the character earned her praise from the audience and established her as a talented actress in the industry. Panchi went on to appear in several other Hindi television series, including "Gangaa" and "Meri Awaaz Hi Pehchaan Hai."

 

Panchi Bora has also acted in Assamese films and TV shows, showcasing her versatility and command over different languages. She has displayed her acting skills in both dramatic and emotional roles

item.title: Puja Banerjee
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Puja Banerjee

Television Female Actor

Puja Banerjee, also known as Pooja Bose, is an Indian actress who has primarily worked in the Bengali and Hindi television and film industries. She was born on February 6, 1987, in Kolkata, West Bengal, India.

 

Puja Banerjee gained popularity for her portrayal of Vrinda in the popular fantasy television series "Tujh Sang Preet Lagai Sajna" (2008-2010). She has also appeared in other Hindi TV shows such as "Devon Ke Dev...Mahadev" (2011-2014), where she played the role of Parvati, and "Qubool Hai" (2013-2015), where she portrayed the character of Raima.

 

In addition to television, Puja Banerjee has also acted in Bengali films. She made her film debut with the Bengali movie "Macho Mustanaa" in 2012. She has appeared in other Bengali films like "Teen Patti" (2016) and "Ohongkar" (2017).

 

Puja Banerjee has showcased her talent as an actress in various roles and has garnered a dedicated fan base. She is known for her beauty and acting skills, which have contributed to her popularity in the entertainment industry.

item.title: Priyanka chahar choudhary
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Priyanka Choudhary

Television Female Actor

Priyanka Choudhary is an Indian television actress and model who rose to fame through her role as Tejo Sandhu in the Hindi TV serial 'Udaariyaan' in 2021. Known for her acting prowess and on-screen presence, Priyanka has garnered immense popularity among viewers.

 

Born into a family with a military background, Priyanka's father, Mahavir Singh Chahar, holds the esteemed position of an honorary captain in the Indian Army. She is one of seven siblings, with her brother Vikas Choudhary serving as the managing director at SRM Hospital and Laboratories in Jaipur. Additionally, she has a sister named Preeti Choudhary and a brother named Yogesh Choudhary.

 

Apart from her television career, Priyanka has also made appearances as a model in various Punjabi music videos. Notable among these are Babbu Maan's 'Online' (2016), Ishan Kouran's 'Mai Bewafa' (2018), and Robin Sidhu's 'Hanju' (2020). She has showcased her versatility by venturing into the Hindi film industry as well, featuring in movies such as 'Pending Love' (2018), 'Lateef to Laden' (2018), and 'Kandy Twist' (2019).

 

Priyanka Choudhary's talent, charm, and dedication have made her a prominent figure in the entertainment industry. With her captivating performances and striking presence, she continues to win hearts and make a name for herself in the television and film world

item.title: Poulomi Das
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Poulomi Das

Television Female Actor

Poulomi Das is a prominent Indian model and television actress known for her versatile roles on various shows. She began her modeling career a few years ago and gained recognition as a finalist on the second season of India's Next Top Model in early 2016.

 

Her acting journey started with the role of Baby in the Star Plus soap opera "Suhani Si Ek Ladki," where she showcased her talent and garnered attention. Following this success, she appeared as Ananya Puri, a female parallel lead character, in the Balaji Telefilms production "Dil Hi Toh Hai" in July 2018. Her popularity further rose when she featured on the cover of Maxim magazine in June 2018.

 

In 2020, Poulomi landed the lead role of Purnima in the Star Bharat soap opera "Kartik Purnima," a role that further showcased her acting prowess. She continued to impress viewers with her performance in the web series "Paraushpur," where she portrayed the character Kala on Alt Balaji in December 2020.

item.title: Pariva Pranati
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Pariva Pranati

Television Female Actor

Pariva Pranati is a popular Indian actress known for her work in Hindi soap operas. Born as Pariva Sinha in Patna, she hails from a Bihari Hindu family, and her father, Prabhat Sinha, is a retired Air Force Officer. She completed her education at Air Force Golden Jubilee Institute and Lady Shree Ram College in Delhi before moving to Mumbai, where she currently resides.

 

In her acting career, Pariva has been featured in various television series, gaining recognition for her roles. Some of her notable appearances include "Vaada Raha," "With Love, Delhi," and the role of Amrita in "Hamari Sister Didi." She has also taken on the character of Vandana Wagle in "Wagle Ki Duniya – Nayi Peedhi Naye Kissey," airing on Sony SAB.

 

In her personal life, Pariva Pranati tied the knot with actor and wildlife photographer Puneet Sachdev in a private ceremony held in Gwalior on Valentine's Day, 14th February 2014. The couple welcomed a baby boy into their lives on 9th May 2017.

 

Throughout her acting journey, Pariva has garnered a substantial fan following and appreciation for her performances in the television industry. With her talent and dedication, she continues to make a mark in the world of entertainment.

item.title: Pooja Sharma
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Nikita Dutta

Television Female Actor

Nikita Dutta is a talented Indian television actress who has captivated audiences with her remarkable performances. With her charming persona and exceptional acting skills, she has carved a niche for herself in the entertainment industry.

 

Born on November 13, 1990, in Delhi, India, Nikita initially aspired to be an air hostess but destiny had other plans for her. She made her acting debut in 2014 with the popular TV show "Dream Girl - Ek Ladki Deewani Si," where she portrayed the lead role of Lakshmi Mathur. Her portrayal of a small-town girl dreaming big won hearts and earned her accolades.

 

Nikita's career graph soared with subsequent roles in shows like "Ek Duje Ke Vaaste," "Haasil," and "Laal Ishq." Her impeccable acting prowess and on-screen chemistry with co-stars earned her a loyal fan base.

 

Apart from television, Nikita also ventured into the world of films with the Bollywood movie "Gold" in 2018, where she shared the screen with Akshay Kumar. Her performance was well-received, showcasing her versatility as an actress.

 

With her grace, elegance, and acting prowess, Nikita Dutta continues to shine in the television industry, leaving a lasting impact on viewers. Her journey serves as an inspiration for aspiring actors, proving that talent and dedication can take you far in the world of entertainment.

Rati Pandey

Television Female Actor

Rati Pandey is a talented Indian actress who has made a significant impact in the entertainment industry. Born on September 11, 1982, in Assam, India, Rati's journey into acting began with her passion for performing arts. She gained recognition for her remarkable portrayal of Nupur Bhushan in the popular television series "Miley Jab Hum Tum," which catapulted her to fame.

 

Rati's versatility as an actress is evident in her ability to effortlessly portray a wide range of characters. Whether it's a bubbly and vivacious young girl or a strong and independent woman, she captivates the audience with her natural acting skills. Her expressive eyes and graceful demeanor add depth and authenticity to her performances.

 

Over the years, Rati has garnered a loyal fan base who admire her talent and admire her for the dedication she puts into each role. Her impeccable acting skills and charming personality have earned her accolades and numerous awards.

 

Beyond her acting prowess, Rati is also known for her philanthropic endeavors. She actively participates in social causes and uses her platform to create awareness about various issues.

With her passion, versatility, and commitment to her craft, Rati Pandey continues to be a shining star in the Indian entertainment industry, leaving an indelible mark on the hearts of her fans.
