item.title: Reem Sameer Shaikh
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Reem Sameer Shaikh

Television Female Actor

Reem Sameer Shaikh is indeed an Indian actress known for her work in Indian television and Hindi cinema. She has appeared in several popular shows and movies throughout her career.

 

Born on September 8th in Mumbai, Maharashtra, Reem Sameer Shaikh began her acting career as a child actor at the age of 6 with the show "Neer Bhare Tere Naina Devi." She gained recognition for her roles in shows like "Me Aajji Aur Sahib" and "Yeh Rishta Kya Kehlata Hai" in 2012.

 

One of her notable roles was as Rimjhim Bhatnagar in the show "Na Bole Tum Na Maine Kuch Kaha." She also portrayed Khushboo in "Khelti Hai Zindagi Aankh Micholi" and Mishri in "Diya Aur Baati Hum." However, she gained significant popularity for her portrayal of young Kaurwaki, the wife of Emperor Ashoka, in the show "Chakravartin Ashoka Samrat," where she acted alongside Siddharth Nigam.

 

In 2018, Reem Sameer Shaikh made a guest appearance as Sanaya Seth on the popular Colors TV show "Tu Aashiqui." The same year, she landed the lead role of Kalyani Malhar Rane in Zee TV's show "Tujhse Hai Raabta," for which she received the Gold Debut in Lead Role award in 2019.

In 2020, Reem Sameer Shaikh played the role of Malala Yousafzai in the biopic "Gul Makai." This showcased her versatility as an actress.

 

In 2022, she was seen as Paakhi Srivastava Raichand in Colors TV's "Fanaa: Ishq Mein Marjawan," acting alongside Zain Imam and Akshit Sukhija.

 

Since February 2023, Reem Sameer Shaikh has been a part of Colors TV's series "Tere Ishq Mein Ghayal," where she plays the character of Eisha Sharma.

Resham Tipnis

Television Female Actor

Resham Tipnis is an Indian television actress who has been active in the industry for several years. She started her career with a small role as Anjali Sinha in the Shah Rukh Khan-starrer film "Baazigar" in 1993.

 

Resham Tipnis gained further recognition when she participated as a contestant in the first season of "Bigg Boss Marathi." Her appearance on the reality show helped increase her popularity among the audience.

 

Currently, Resham Tipnis can be seen in the television series "Punyashlok Ahilyabai," which airs on Sony Entertainment Television. She portrays the character of Queen Dwarkabai Sahib in the show. The series takes an 8-year leap, and Resham Tipnis's character is shown after this time jump. The show premiered in July 2022.

 

Resham Tipnis continues to be an active and well-known figure in the Indian television industry, and her contributions to various shows and films have made her a familiar face among viewer

Television Female Actor

Rhea Sharma is an Indian actress known for her work in Hindi television. She was born on August 7, 1995, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, into a Hindu family. Rhea completed her graduation from St. Xavier's College, Mumbai. Initially aspiring to be a journalist, she later chose acting as her career path.

 

Rhea Sharma made her acting debut in 2014 with the television series "Itna Karo Na Mujhe Pyaar," where she portrayed the character of Nishi Khanna Shah opposite Mehul Vyas. She gained recognition for her role as Priyanka "Priya" Prabhakar Datar in the show "Badi Doooor Se Aaye Hai" in 2014.

 

In 2015, Rhea Sharma played the role of Chandini Kapoor opposite Darsheel Safary in an episode of "Yeh Hai Aashiqui Sun Yaar Try Maar." She continued to explore different roles and portrayed Shubhi Deshpande in "Yeh Hai Aashiqui" opposite Kinshuk Vaidya. The same year, she appeared as Gauri Shukla in "Kahani Hamari... Dil Dosti Deewanepan Ki," but the show concluded after a month.

 

Rhea Sharma made her film debut in 2016 with Neeraj Pandey's "M.S. Dhoni: The Untold Story." In the film, she played the character of Ritu, who was a friend of Dhoni's wife. The movie starred Sushant Singh Rajput and Kiara Advani in lead roles.

 

However, Rhea Sharma gained wider recognition and popularity for her roles in the television series "Tu Sooraj Main Saanjh, Piyaji" and "Yeh Rishtey Hain Pyaar Ke." In "Tu Sooraj Main Saanjh, Piyaji," she portrayed the character of Dr. Kanak Rathi Toshniwal, while in "Yeh Rishtey Hain Pyaar Ke," she played the role of Mishti Agrawal Rajvansh.

 

Throughout her career, Rhea Sharma has received nominations and awards, including the Gold Awards.

item.title: Roopal Tyagi
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Roopal Tyagi

Television Female Actor

Roopal Tyagi is an Indian choreographer and television actor. She was born on October 6, 1989, in Bangalore, India. Roopal received her education at Sophia High School in Bangalore. She trained at Shiamak Davar's dance institute in Bangalore and later had the opportunity to assist Bollywood choreographer Pony Verma in the song "Mere Dholna" from the movie "Bhool Bhulaiyaa." After shuttling between Bangalore and Mumbai for two years, she eventually settled in Mumbai to pursue her career.

 

Roopal Tyagi began her career as a choreographer in 2007. She made her acting debut with the role of Mansha in the TV show "Hamari Betiyoon Ka Vivaah." She also appeared in the Zee TV show "Kasamh Se" produced by Ekta Kapoor and Balaji Telefilms. However, she gained significant popularity for her portrayal of Gunjan in the Indian soap opera "Sapne Suhane Ladakpan Ke."

 

In 2015, Roopal Tyagi participated in the eighth season of the dance reality show "Jhalak Dikhhla Jaa" as a wildcard entrant. She also participated in the reality show "Bigg Boss 9," where she was paired up with Digangana Suryavanshi. Roopal was eliminated from the show in the second week of voting.

 

Roopal Tyagi has received recognition for her performances and has won awards for her role as Gunjan in "Sapne Suhane Ladakpan Ke." She won two Zee Rishtey Awards in 2012, one for Favorite Behen (sister) and another for Favorite Nayi Jodi (new couple). She was also nominated for the Fresh New Face category at the Indian Telly Awards in 2013.

 

In 2020, Roopal Tyagi wrote an open letter on her Instagram, where she criticized the portrayal of the main female character and the regressive nature of certain aspects of the series. She expressed her views on the need for more progressive and inclusive storytelling in television shows.

item.title: Roop Durgapal
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Roop Durgapal

Television Female Actor

Roop Durgapal is an Indian television actress known for her role as Sanchi in the popular serial "Balika Vadhu." She was born in Almora, Uttarakhand, India, and holds a Bachelor of Technology degree in Instrumentation and Control Engineering from Graphic Era Deemed To Be University.

 

Roop Durgapal started her acting career after working at Infosys. Apart from "Balika Vadhu," she has appeared in various other television shows. Some of her notable roles include Dari Dari Pari in "Baal Veer," Kavya Maheshwari in "Swaragini," and Natasha Gujral in "Kuch Rang Pyar Ke Aise Bhi."

 

She has also made guest appearances in shows like "Akbar Birbal" and has been part of television advertisements. In 2018, she played the lead role of Sharmishtha, a lawyer, in Zing TV's episodic show "Pyaar Pehli Baar."

 

Roop Durgapal joined Zee TV's series "Tujhse Hai Raabta" in July 2019, playing the character of Ketki, a Maharashtrian girl. She also appeared in shows like "CIF" as the forensic doctor Sakshi Shrivastava and "Laal Ishq" as Sonia and Aleesha.

 

In 2013, Roop Durgapal was nominated as "Most Tez Taraar Personality" in the Colors Golden Petal Awards

item.title: Roshni Walia
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Roshni Walia

Television Female Actor

Roshni Walia is an Indian actress known for her work in television shows. She was born on September 20, 2001, in Allahabad, Uttar Pradesh, India. She started her career by appearing in television commercials. Her mother's name is Sweety Walia, and she has an older sister named Noor Walia. Roshni Walia currently resides in Mumbai.

 

Her debut television show was "Main Lakshmi Tere Aangan Ki," where she portrayed the character of Jiyana. She then appeared in another Life OK drama series called "Ringa Ringa Roses," where she played the daughter of Samir Soni's character.

 

In 2014, Roshni Walia gained recognition for her role as young Maharani Ajabde Punwar, the first wife of Maharana Pratap, in the historical drama series "Bharat Ka Veer Putra – Maharana Pratap." Her performance earned her a nomination for Best Child Actor - Female at the 13th Indian Telly Awards in 2014.

 

She also appeared in the third season of the youth crime drama series "Gumrah: End of Innocence" in December 2014. Her character in the show was named Aarohi.

 

Additionally, Roshni Walia played the role of Tara Mane in the Sony TV series "Tara From Satara."

item.title: Rubina Dilaik
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Rubina Dilaik

Television Female Actor

Rubina Dilaik is an Indian actress known for her work in Hindi television shows and films. She was born on August 26, 1989, in Shimla, Himachal Pradesh, India. Rubina made her acting debut with the popular show "Chotti Bahu," where she portrayed the character of Radhika Shastri. This role brought her recognition and marked the beginning of her acting career.

 

One of Rubina Dilaik's notable roles was Soumya Singh in the show "Shakti - Astitva Ke Ehsaas Ki." Her portrayal of this character received critical acclaim, and she won the ITA Award for Best Actress Drama for her performance. In 2020, she participated in and emerged as the winner of the reality show "Bigg Boss 14."

 

Rubina Dilaik has also participated in other reality shows such as "Fear Factor: Khatron Ke Khiladi 12," where she finished in fourth place, and "Jhalak Dikhhla Jaa 10," where she was the first runner-up. These appearances showcased her versatility and talent beyond acting.

 

In 2022, Rubina made her debut in Hindi films with the movie "Ardh," directed by Palash Muchhal. She played a role in the film and expanded her presence in the entertainment industry.

 

Prior to her acting career, Rubina Dilaik was a beauty pageant contestant and won several local beauty pageants. She was crowned Miss Shimla in 2006 and also won the Miss North India Pageant in 2008.

 

Rubina Dilaik pursued her education at Shimla Public School and St. Bede's College in Shimla. She holds a degree in English Literature with minors in Political Science.

item.title: Rucha Hasabnis
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Rucha Hasabnis

Television Female Actor

Rucha Hasabnis Jagdale is an Indian actress known for her role as Rashi Shah Modi in the popular soap opera "Saath Nibhana Saathiya" on Star Plus from 2010 to 2014. She was born on February 8, 1988, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India, into a Marathi family.

 

Rucha started her acting career in 2009 with the Marathi drama series "Chaar Choughi," where she played the role of Devika. However, her breakthrough came with the role of Rashi Modi in "Saath Nibhana Saathiya," which gained her immense popularity. She portrayed the character from 2010 to 2014.

 

After her stint in the show, Rucha took a break from acting to focus on her personal life. She got married to businessman Rahul Jagdale on January 26, 2015. They have two children together. Their daughter, Ruhi, was born on December 10, 2019, and their son, Ronit, was born on November 7, 2022.

 

In 2020, during the COVID-19 lockdown, Rucha regained popularity when musician and YouTuber Yashraj Mukhate created a rap video using her famous dialogues as 'Rashiben' from "Saath Nibhana Saathiya." The video went viral, resulting in the show's re-run and Rucha gaining renewed attention.

 

In 2021, Rucha expressed her readiness to make a comeback on television in an interview with Times of India & Glitz Vision USA, stating that she is waiting for an amazing script.

item.title: Rupali Bhosale
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Rupali Bhosale

Television Female Actor

Rupali Bhosale is an Indian television actress known for her work in Marathi shows and Bollywood films. She gained recognition for portraying the characters of Sanjana in Star Pravah's show "Aai Kuthe Kay Karte" and Varsha Ghotala in Sony SAB's "Badi Doooor Se Aaye Hai." She was also a contestant in the reality show "Bigg Boss Marathi 2" in 2019.

 

Rupali began her career in the Marathi television industry with shows like "Man Udhan Varyache," "Don Kinaare Doghi Apan," and "Kanyadaan." She later ventured into Bollywood and made her debut with the film "Risk" in 2007.

 

In her personal life, Rupali Bhosale was previously married to Milind Shinde, but they divorced in 2012. Currently, she is in a relationship with Aniket Magare.

 

Rupali's talent and performances have garnered her a dedicated fan following in the Marathi television industry. Her notable roles and appearances in popular shows have contributed to her success and popularity as an actress.

item.title: Rupali Ganguly
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Rupali Ganguly

Television Female Actor

Rupali Ganguly is an Indian actress, born on April 5, 1977, in Kolkata, West Bengal. She comes from a family with a background in the film industry, as her father, Anil Ganguly, was a director and screenwriter, and her brother Vijay Ganguly is an actor-producer.

 

Rupali started her acting career at a young age, making her debut in her father's film "Saaheb" in 1985. She later ventured into television, gaining recognition for her role as Dr. Simran Chopra in the medical drama series "Sanjivani" on Star Plus in 2002. However, she achieved significant fame with her portrayal of Monisha Sarabhai in the popular sitcom "Sarabhai vs Sarabhai" (2004), where she received critical acclaim for her performance.

 

Over the years, Rupali has appeared in several successful television series, including "Baa Bahoo Aur Baby" (2005) and "Parvarrish – Kuchh Khattee Kuchh Meethi" (2011). After taking a break from acting, she made a comeback in 2020 with the soap opera "Anupamaa," in which she portrays the titular character. The show has garnered immense popularity and has been well-received by the audience.

 

In addition to her television career, Rupali has also participated in reality shows like "Bigg Boss 1" in 2006 and "Fear Factor: Khatron Ke Khiladi 2" in 2009. She even lent her voice for an animation film called "Dashavatar" in 2008. In 2022, she made her digital debut with the prequel web series of "Anupamaa" called "Anupama: Namaste America," which premiered on Disney+ Hotstar.

item.title: Revathi Pillai
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Revathi Pillai

Television Female Actor

Revathi Pillai is an Indian actress known for her work in the Hindi film and web series industry. She was born on June 5, 2002, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. Revathi made her acting debut in 2019 and has gained popularity for her performances in various projects.

 

Revathi Pillai gained recognition for her portrayal of Vidhya in the web series "Yeh Meri Family" (2018). The show, created by TVF (The Viral Fever), follows the story of a middle-class family set in the 1990s. Her performance as the teenage sister in the series was well-received, and she received praise for her natural and relatable acting.

 

In 2020, Revathi appeared in the Amazon Prime Video web series "Lalbazaar," a crime thriller set in Kolkata. She played the role of Mira, a young woman who gets involved in a murder investigation. Her performance in the series was appreciated for its intensity and emotional depth.

 

Revathi Pillai has also worked in Hindi films. She made her big-screen debut with the movie "Laila Majnu" (2018), directed by Sajid Ali. The film is a modern retelling of the classic love story of Laila and Majnu.

item.title: Ridhima Pandit
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Ridhima Pandit

Television Female Actor

Ridhima Pandit is an Indian actress and model known for her work in the television industry. She gained popularity for her portrayal of the character Rajni in the TV show "Bahu Hamari Rajni Kant" (2016-2017), where she played an android robot. Ridhima's performance in the series earned her critical acclaim and a substantial fan following.

 

Before entering the world of acting, Ridhima Pandit worked as a model and appeared in various commercials and print advertisements. She also participated in the reality show "Fear Factor: Khatron Ke Khiladi" in 2019, where she showcased her daring and adventurous side.

 

Ridhima has made guest appearances in other television shows and has also hosted a few episodes of the singing reality show "The Voice India." She continues to be active in the entertainment industry, exploring different opportunities and engaging with her fans through social media platforms.

item.title: Ruma Sharma
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Ruma Sharma

Television Female Actor

Ruma Sharma is a model and actress known for her work in the Hindi television and film industry. She began her acting journey at a young age, starting with performances at the Shree Ram Centre Auditorium in Delhi and appearing in episodic series on channels like Star Gold. She has also been featured in shows telecasted on BBC World and DD1.

 

In 2009, Ruma Sharma made her debut in the film industry as a child artist in the movie "Dimag Ki Dahi." After completing her schooling, she relocated to Mumbai to pursue her acting career more intensely.

 

Ruma Sharma has appeared in several popular television serials such as "Fear Files: Darr Ki Sacchi Tasvirein," "Savdhaan India," "Shapath," and "Code Red." Additionally, she has acted in short films including "The Tale of the Boy & Two Nights" and others.

item.title: Sana Amin Sheikh
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Sana Amin Sheikh

Television Female Actor

Sana Amin Sheikh is an Indian actress and radio jockey who primarily works in Hindi television shows and films. She made her acting debut with the Disney Channel India series "Kya Mast Hai Life" in which she played the character Ritu Shah. Since then, she has appeared in over 30 television serials and has become one of the most popular television stars in the industry.

 

Sana has portrayed lead roles in various shows, including "Jeet Jayenge Hum," "Gustakh Dil," "Million Dollar Girl," "Bhootu Season 1," "Krishnadasi," and "Perfect Pati," among others. She has also played supporting and antagonist roles in shows like "Kuch Rang Pyar Ke Aise Bhi 3," "Tere Shehar Mein," and "Mann Kee Awaaz Pratigya."

 

In addition to her television career, Sana made her Bollywood debut with the film "Singham" where she portrayed the character Anjali Bhosle. She has also appeared in supporting roles in films like "Table No. 21," "Island City," and "Bamfaad."

 

Sana Amin Sheikh was born and raised in Mumbai, Maharashtra. Her great-grandfather, Ashraf Khan, was an actor and singer in Gujarati theatre. She was married to television director Aijaz Sheikh from 2016 to 2022.

 

Before pursuing acting, Sana worked as a radio jockey at Radio Mirchi 98.3 FM since August 2004. She hosted shows like 'Khoobsurat, Sana ke saath' and 'TRP – Television Radio Par' on Mirchi Love and Ishq FM.

 

Sana began her acting career as a child artist and gained fame for her roles in shows like "Hasratein" and "Junoon" in the 1990s. She later made a comeback in 2009 with "Kya Mast Hai Life" and went on to portray lead roles in various television serials. She has been part of popular shows like "Mann Kee Awaaz Pratigya," "Gustakh Dil," and "Krishnadasi." She also played the lead character Avanti Bansal in Channel V's "Million Dollar Girl."

item.title: Sana Makbul
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Sana Makbul Khan

Television Female Actor

Sana Makbul Khan, formerly known as Sana Khan, is an Indian model and actress. She gained recognition for her role as Dr. Aliya Sanyal in the Colors TV supernatural drama series "Vish." She made her film debut in 2014 with the Telugu film "Dikkulu Choodaku Ramayya." Sana also participated in the reality TV show "Fear Factor: Khatron Ke Khiladi 11," where she reached the semi-finals.

 

Born on June 13, 1993, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, Sana started her career in modeling before venturing into acting. She appeared in advertisements and TV shows, including the reality show "MTV Scooty Teen Diva" in 2009. She was also part of the teen musical series "Ishaan: Sapno Ko Awaaz De" and the TV serials "Kitani Mohabbat Hai" and "Iss Pyaar Ko Kya Naam Doon?" She played the role of Lavanya Kashyap in the latter.

 

In 2012, Sana participated in Femina Miss India and won the title of Femina Miss Beautiful Smile. She made her screen name change to Sana Makbul in 2014 when she made her debut in the Telugu film "Dikkulu Choodaku Ramayya." She played the role of Samhitha, an aerobics trainer, in the film. Sana has also worked on the Tamil film "Rangoon," a crime thriller directed by Rajkumar Periasamy.

item.title: Sana Sayyad
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Sana Sayyad

Television Female Actor

Sana Sayyad, born on October 29, 1994, is an Indian actress known for her work in Hindi television. She gained recognition by participating in the reality TV show "Splitsvilla 8." Sana has portrayed notable characters such as Drishti Sharma in "Divya Drishti" and Sejal Kotadia in "Spy Bahu." Currently, she is playing the role of Dr. Palki Khurana in Zee TV's show "Kundali Bhagya."

 

Sana was born into a Muslim family, and her father, Yaquib Sayyad, works in the Merchant Navy. In February 2021, she revealed her relationship with entrepreneur Imaad Shamsi, and they got married in an intimate Nikaah ceremony on June 25, 2021.

 

Her acting career began in 2015 when she participated in "MTV Splitsvilla 8," where she finished as the runner-up alongside Utkarsh Gupta. The same year, she made her acting debut with the series "Boyz Will Be Boyz," portraying the character Ashita. She also appeared as Avanti in "Yeh Hai Aashiqui Sun Yaar Try Maar."

 

In 2016, Sana portrayed Aditi Vashisht in "Jaana Na Dil Se Door" and Megha in "MTV Girls on Top." She also made an appearance as Manisha in an episode of "Crime Patrol" in 2017. In 2018, she played Amrit Kakkar Chopra in "Papa By Chance."

 

Sana's breakthrough role came in 2019 when she portrayed Drishti Sharma Shergill in the series "Divya Drishti." This role proved to be a significant turning point in her career. She went on to play Sonam Goel Jaiswal in "Lockdown Ki Love Story" from 2020 to 2021.

 

In 2022, Sana received praise for her portrayal of Sejal Kotadia Nanda/Mahira Mirza, a RAW agent, in the series "Spy Bahu" opposite Sehban Azim.

item.title: Sangita Ghosh
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Sangita Ghosh

Television Female Actor

Sangita Ghosh, born on August 18, 1976, is an Indian film and television actress and model. She gained recognition for her role as Pammi in the television serial "Des Mein Niklla Hoga Chand." Sangita has also hosted and anchored several award shows and television series. She co-hosted the show "Nach Baliye" with Shabbir Ahluwalia and showcased her dancing skills with multiple performances. She is also known for her role as Pishachini in "Divya Drishti."

 

Sangita began her acting career at the age of ten in a serial called "Hum Hindustani." She has been a successful model and has worked with brands like Donear Suitings and Nirma. After completing her college studies in 1996, she appeared in serials such as "Mehndi Tere Naam Ki," "Sansaar," "Kurukshetra," "Adhikar," "Ajeeb Dastan," and "Daraar." Her breakthrough role came with "Des Mein Niklla Hoga Chand," where she portrayed the character of Pammi. She also played the role of Priyanka Kharbanda / Priyanka Rahul Lamba in the popular TV show "Viraasat" in 2006.

 

Sangita has showcased her dancing skills in reality shows like "Zara Nachke Dikha 2" as the captain of the girls' team in 2010. After a gap of six years, she made her comeback in the TV show "Kehta Hai Dil Jee Le Zara" in 2013, where she played the role of Sanchi opposite Ruslaan Mumtaz. The show received praise for its unique concept, and Sangita's chemistry with Ruslaan was highly appreciated. She later appeared in the second season of the daily soap "Parvarrish" and portrayed the antagonist Sudha in Star Plus's thriller series "Rishton Ka Chakravyuh."

She also played the role of Priyanka Kharbanda \/ Priyanka Rahul Lamba in the popular TV show \"Viraasat\" in 2006.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Sangita has showcased her dancing skills in reality shows like \"Zara Nachke Dikha 2\" as the captain of the girls' team in 2010. After a gap of six years, she made her comeback in the TV show \"Kehta Hai Dil Jee Le Zara\" in 2013, where she played the role of Sanchi opposite Ruslaan Mumtaz. The show received praise for its unique concept, and Sangita's chemistry with Ruslaan was highly appreciated. item.title: Sanjeeda Sheikh
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Sanjeeda Sheikh

Television Female Actor

Sanjeeda Sheikh, born on December 20, 1984, is an Indian actress known for her work in the Hindi television industry. She is widely recognized and considered one of the most famous actresses in Indian television.

Sanjeeda was born in Kuwait to a religious Muslim family with roots in Ahmedabad, Gujarat.

In March 2012, she married her longtime boyfriend, Aamir Ali. The couple revealed in August 2020 that they had a one-year-old daughter named Ayra Ali through surrogacy. However, they separated in 2020 after eight years of marriage, and their divorce was granted in 2021, with Sanjeeda getting the custody of their daughter. Reportedly, she is currently dating her co-star from the movie "Taish," Harshvardhan Rane.

In May 2017, Sanjeeda's sister-in-law filed a domestic violence case against her, her brother, and their mother, alleging physical abuse and mistreatment. The case resulted in legal proceedings, with Sanjeeda being granted interim relief by the court.

Sanjeeda has portrayed various roles in television soap operas. She made her acting debut as Nimmo in the TV series "Kyaa Hoga Nimmo Kaa" in 2005. She gained recognition for her portrayal of a vamp in the Star Plus series "Kayamath" in 2007. The same year, she participated in the dance competition show "Nach Baliye 3" with her husband, Aamir Ali, and they won the competition.

In 2008, she appeared in the serial "Kya Dill Main Hai" opposite Aamir Ali, which aired on the 9X channel.

Her breakthrough role came in 2014 when she played the character of Durga Thakur in the series "Ek Hasina Thi." Her performance in the show received critical acclaim, and it became one of the most successful shows on Star Plus at the time.

In 2016, Sanjeeda portrayed the character of Dhani in "Ishq Ka Rang Safed," where she played an onscreen mother for the first time, with a 5-year-old child.

She also appeared in the supernatural web series "Gehraiyaan" in 2017, opposite Vatsal Sheth, and played the role of Kamini Mathur, a superstar, in the TV series "Love Ka Hai Intezaar" in the same year.

item.title: Sara Khan
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Sara Khan

Television Female Actor

Sara Khan is an Indian model and actress. She was born on August 6, 1989, in Bhopal, India. She won the Miss Bhopal title in 2007. Sara Khan is best known for her role as Sadhna in the Star Plus show "Sapna Babul Ka...Bidaai." She appeared in the show from 2007 to 2010.

 

After leaving "Sapna Babul Ka...Bidaai," Sara Khan joined the Zee TV show "Preet Se Bandhi Ye Dori Ram Milaayi Jodi" from 2010 to 2012, where she played the character Mona. She has also appeared in other television shows such as "Junoon - Aisi Nafrat Toh Kaisa Ishq," "Sasural Simar Ka," "V The Serial," "Pyaar Tune Kya Kiya," "Encounter," "Tujhse Hi Rabta," "Bhagyalaxmi," "Saubhagyalakshmi," "Dil Boley Oberoi," and "Jaana Na Dil Se Door."

 

Apart from television shows, Sara Khan has made appearances in reality television. In 2010, she participated as a contestant in "Bigg Boss 4," the Indian version of the reality TV show "Big Brother." She also appeared on shows like "Kya Aap Paanchvi Pass Se Tez Hain?," "Amul Star Voice of India 2," "10 Ka Dum," "Welcome - Baazi Mehmaan-Nawaazi Ki," and "Nach Baliye 6." Additionally, she has hosted the show "BIG Fame Star" and appeared in comedy shows like "Comedy Classes" and "Comedy Nights Bachao."

item.content:encoded:
Sargun Kaur

Television Female Actor

Sargun Kaur Luthra is an Indian television and film actress. She was born on November 24, 1998, in New Delhi, India. Sargun initially pursued a degree in psychology but decided to drop out in the first year to pursue a career in acting. In 2017, she moved from Delhi to Mumbai and currently resides with her father. She has a twin brother named Harman Luthra.

Sargun made her television debut in 2017 with Star Bharat's thriller series "Kaal Bhairav Rahasya," where she portrayed the character of Gauri. She has also appeared in TV commercials, modeling assignments, photoshoots, and advertisements.

From 2018 to 2019, Sargun played the role of Niyati Khanna in Colors TV's horror drama series "Tantra." In 2019, she portrayed the character of Aayat Ganai in the drama "Kasganj." Since December 2019, Sargun has been starring as Dr. Preesha Srinivasan Khurana in Star Plus's "Yeh Hai Chahatein" opposite Abrar Qazi.

In 2020, Sargun made her film debut by playing the character Priya, Naga Shaurya's sister, in the movie "Aswathama." She has been actively working in the television industry, gaining popularity for her roles in various TV shows and currently continuing her journey in "Yeh Hai Chahatein

item.title: Sargun Mehta
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Sargun Mehta Dubey

Television Female Actor

Sargun Mehta Dubey is an Indian actress, model, and television host. She was born on September 6, 1988, in Chandigarh, India. Sargun started her acting career in theatre productions during her college years. In 2009, she made her screen debut with the TV show "12/24 Karol Bagh" on Zee TV. She gained critical acclaim for her supporting role in the series and received praise for her work in the 2013 series "Balika Vadhu." Sargun has also hosted the dance reality show "Boogie Woogie Kids Championship."

 

In 2015, Sargun made her feature film debut in the Punjabi romantic comedy "Angrej." Her portrayal of Dhann Kaur in the film earned her the PTC Punjabi Film Award for Best Actress. She has since appeared in other successful Punjabi films such as "Love Punjab" (2016) and "Lahoriye" (2017). Her performance in "Love Punjab" as a troubled housewife earned her the Filmfare Award Punjabi for Best Actress.

 

Sargun Mehta Dubey is married to her co-star from "12/24 Karol Bagh," Ravi Dubey. They got married in December 2013, and Sargun changed her name to Sargun Mehta Dubey after marriage.

 

Throughout her career, Sargun has been recognized for her acting talent and has received several awards for her performances in both television and Punjabi cinema. She continues to be a prominent figure in the entertainment industry, appearing in various TV shows and films

Sargun started her acting career in theatre productions during her college years. In 2009, she made her screen debut with the TV show \"12\/24 Karol Bagh\" on Zee TV. She gained critical acclaim for her supporting role in the series and received praise for her work in the 2013 series \"Balika Vadhu.\" Sargun has also hosted the dance reality show \"Boogie Woogie Kids Championship.\"<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

In 2015, Sargun made her feature film debut in the Punjabi romantic comedy \"Angrej.\" Her portrayal of Dhann Kaur in the film earned her the PTC Punjabi Film Award for Best Actress. She has since appeared in other successful Punjabi films such as \"Love Punjab\" (2016) and \"Lahoriye\" (2017). Her performance in \"Love Punjab\" as a troubled housewife earned her the Filmfare Award Punjabi for Best Actress.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Sargun Mehta Dubey is married to her co-star from \"12\/24 Karol Bagh,\" Ravi Dubey. They got married in December 2013, and Sargun changed her name to Sargun Mehta Dubey after marriage.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Throughout her career, Sargun has been recognized for her acting talent and has received several awards for her performances in both television and Punjabi cinema. item.title: Saumya Tandon
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Saumya Tandon

Television Female Actor

Saumya Tandon is an Indian actress and television presenter, known for her role as Anita Mishra in the Hindi sitcom television series "Bhabiji Ghar Par Hain!". She has also hosted several TV shows, including "Dance India Dance," "Bournvita Quiz Contest," and "Entertainment Ki Raat."

 

Saumya Tandon was born on 3 November 1984 in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh. She completed her schooling from St. Mary's Convent School in Ujjain. Her father, B.G. Tandon, is a writer and former professor.

 

She began her career in the entertainment industry as a model and was the first runner-up in the "Femina Cover Girl" contest in 2006. She also appeared in the Afghan serial "Khushi" in 2008, where she played the lead role of an Afghan woman doctor. Saumya Tandon co-hosted the show "Zor Ka Jhatka: Total Wipeout" with Shah Rukh Khan in 2011 and has hosted "Dance India Dance" for three seasons. She also co-hosted "Bournvita Quiz Contest" with Derek O'Brien and hosted "LG Mallika-e-Kitchen."

 

However, Saumya Tandon gained significant popularity for her portrayal of Anita in the comedy serial "Bhabiji Ghar Par Hain!" starting from 2015. She earned the nickname "gori mem" from the show. In 2018, she hosted the second season of "Entertainment Ki Raat" on Colors TV.

 

In August 2020, Saumya Tandon announced her departure from "Bhabiji Ghar Par Hain!" after playing the role of Anita for several years.

item.title: Sriti Jha
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Sriti Jha

Television Female Actor

Sriti Jha is an Indian television actress known for her work in Hindi soap operas. She was born on February 26, 1986, in Begusarai, Bihar, India.

Sriti Jha gained popularity for her portrayal of Pragya in the long-running television series "Kumkum Bhagya." Her performance in the show garnered immense appreciation from the audience and established her as one of the leading actresses in the Indian television industry. Sriti's chemistry with her co-star Shabbir Ahluwalia, who played the character of Abhi, was widely loved by fans.

Prior to "Kumkum Bhagya," Sriti Jha had appeared in various other TV shows, including "Jyoti" and "Balika Vadhu," where she showcased her acting prowess. She is known for her ability to portray complex and emotionally challenging characters with great depth and authenticity.

Sriti has received several accolades for her performances, including multiple Indian Television Academy Awards and Zee Rishtey Awards. Her natural talent and versatility as an actress have earned her a dedicated fan base.

Apart from her television work, Sriti Jha has also ventured into the world of web series. She appeared in the critically acclaimed series "Dhoom Machaao Dhoom" and "Gangaa."

item.title: Shama Sikander
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Shama Sikander

Television Female Actor

Shama Sikander Ali Gesawat is an Indian actress known for her roles in TV series such as "Yeh Meri Life Hai" and mini-series like "Maaya: Slave of Her Desires." She has also appeared in Bollywood films, with her debut in the 1999 film "Mann" starring Aamir Khan. Shama's last theatrical release was the Bollywood thriller "Bypass Road" in 2019.

 

Shama Sikander was born in Makrana, Rajasthan, India, and later moved to Mumbai with her family. Her early years in Mumbai were challenging, with financial difficulties and struggles to provide food for the family. She attended multiple schools in different parts of Greater Mumbai.

 

She started her career with small roles in films like "Prem Aggan" (1998) and "Mann" (1999). Her breakthrough on television came with the role of Pooja Mehta in the drama series "Ye Meri Life Hai" (2003-2005). This role earned her nominations and awards, including the Critics' Choice Best Actress at the 12th Annual Lion's Gold Awards.

 

Shama Sikander has also worked as a host for shows like "Popkorn Newz" (2007) and "Jet Set Go" (2008). She has appeared in films like "Dhoom Dhadaka" (2008) and played the lead antagonist in the children's program "Baal Veer" (2012-2014).

item.title: Shamin Mannan
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Shamin Mannan

Television Female Actor

Shamin Mannan is an Indian actress known for her role as Bhoomi in the television show "Sanskaar - Dharohar Apno Ki" on Colors TV. She gained appreciation and recognition for her portrayal of a NRI girl in the first season of the show.

 

Shamin was born in Dibrugarh, Assam. She has a younger sister named Tamanna Mannan, who is also a TV actress known for her role as Naina in the show "Nazar" on Star Plus.

 

Before her acting career, Shamin appeared in several TV commercials for brands such as Dabur Gulabari Rose Water, Bagh Bakri tea, Dish TV, Sony Ericsson, Polycrol antacid, and McDonald's.

 

However, Shamin's breakthrough role came with her portrayal of Bhoomi in "Sanskaar - Dharohar Apno Ki." Her performance in the show was highly appreciated by the audience.

 

Please note that the information provided is based on the available knowledge up until September 2021, and there may have been developments or new projects involving Shamin Mannan since then.

item.title: Sheena Bajaj
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Sheena Bajaj

Television Female Actor

Sheena Bajaj is an Indian actress known for her roles in various television shows. She gained popularity for her portrayal of Dolly Singh in the Disney Channel sitcom "Best of Luck Nikki" and Meher Khan in the Star Plus drama "Mariam Khan - Reporting Live."

 

Sheena started her acting career as a child artist and appeared in films such as "Footpath," "Rakht," "Kyun! Ho Gaya Na...," and "Bhoot Unkle" in 2003. However, she gained recognition in the television industry for her role as Dolly Singh in "Best of Luck Nikki." Her performance in the show was well-received by the audience.

 

She has also appeared in shows like "Jassi Jaissi Koi Nahi," "Thapki Pyar Ki," and "Khatmal E Ishq." In addition, Sheena portrayed the character of Meher Khan in the drama series "Mariam Khan - Reporting Live" on Star Plus.

In her personal life, Sheena Bajaj got married to actor Rohit Purohit in 2019. They had been dating for six years after meeting on the set of the television show "Arjun."

item.title: Shehnaaz Gill
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Shehnaaz Gill

Television Female Actor

Shehnaaz Gill, also known as Shehnaaz Kaur Gill, is an Indian actress, model, and singer who primarily works in Punjabi and Hindi television and films. She gained recognition through her participation in the reality show Bigg Boss 13, where she finished in the third place.

 

Shehnaaz started her career in 2015 with the music video "Shiv Di Kitaab" and went on to appear in other music videos such as "Majhe Di Jatti" and "Pindaan Diyan Kudiyaan" in 2016. She made her acting debut in the Punjabi film "Sat Shri Akaal England" in 2017 and later appeared in films like "Kala Shah Kala" and "Daaka" in 2019.

 

In September 2019, Shehnaaz entered the reality show Bigg Boss 13 as a celebrity contestant. During her time in the show, she released her first single called "Veham" and subsequently released several other singles like "Sidewalk," "Range," and "Ronda Ali Peti." Shehnaaz finished as the second runner-up of the season in February 2020. She also appeared in another reality show called "Mujhse Shaadi Karoge" but it was terminated due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

 

After her stint in Bigg Boss, Shehnaaz appeared in various music videos including "Bhula Dunga," "Keh Gayi Sorry," "Kurta Pajama," "Waada Hai," "Shona Shona," and "Fly."

item.title: Sonarika Bhadoria
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Sonarika Bhadoria

Television Female Actor

Sonarika Bhadoria is an Indian actress who primarily works in the Telugu and Hindi film industries. She was born on December 3, 1992, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India.

 

Sonarika made her acting debut with the popular television series "Tum Dena Saath Mera" in 2011. However, she gained significant recognition and popularity for her portrayal of Goddess Parvati/Adi Shakti in the mythological TV show "Devon Ke Dev... Mahadev." Her portrayal of the divine character garnered her widespread acclaim and a massive fan following.

 

After her successful stint on television, Sonarika Bhadoria ventured into films. She made her Telugu film debut with "Jadoogadu" in 2015. She went on to appear in Telugu movies such as "Speedunnodu," "Eedo Rakam Aado Rakam," and "Sarada." In Hindi cinema, she starred in the film "Saat Uchakkey."

 

Sonarika is known for her beauty, elegance, and versatility as an actress. She has showcased her talent in both television and films, portraying diverse characters with conviction.

 

In addition to acting, Sonarika Bhadoria is an active social media user and often engages with her fans through various platforms. She keeps her followers updated about her projects and personal life.

item.title: Shikha Singh Shah
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Shikha Singh Shah

Television Female Actor

Shikha Singh Shah, born on 7 February 1986, is an Indian actress known for her notable work in the Indian television industry.

 

She made her acting debut in the show "Left Right Left" as Cadet Aakriti Bhat. She was then seen in Zee TV's "Meri Doli Tere Angana" and "Ghar Ki Lakshmi Betiyaan." In 2010, she joined the cast of Colors TV's social drama "Na Aana Is Des Laado" as Amba Sangwan, but she exited the show in 2011.

 

Singh collaborated with Colors TV for the third time for the show "Phulwa." In 2013, she appeared in Life OK's "26/12" as Shahana Malik and also in "Adaalat." She played the character of Meghna Singhania in Colors TV's "Sasural Simar Ka" and portrayed the role of the brave girl warrior Shikhandi in the epic TV series "Mahabharat." Both roles were from 2013 to 2014.

 

From 2014 to 2020, Singh portrayed the character of Alia Mehra in the popular show "Kumkum Bhagya." She also played the same character in its spin-off series "Kundali Bhagya." Additionally, she appeared in "Chandra Nandini" on Star Plus and in the episodic series "Laal Ishq" on &TV as Vibha.

 

In 2022, she portrayed Riddhi Sharma in Colors TV's "Naagin 6."

Apart from acting, Shikha Singh Shah has made appearances as herself in shows like Sony Entertainment Television's "Jubilee Comedy Circus" in 2008. She also anchored the series "Gold Safe" on the same channel from 2009 to 2010. She was seen on "Comedy Nights Bachao" in 2015 and 2016.

\u00a0<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

In 2022, she portrayed Riddhi Sharma in Colors TV's \"Naagin 6.\"<\/p>

item.title: Tina Dutta
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Tina Dutta

Television Female Actor

Tina Dutta, also known as Tinu Dutta, is an Indian actress who primarily works in the Hindi television industry. She was born on November 27, 1986, in Kolkata, West Bengal, India.

 

Tina Dutta gained widespread recognition for her role as Ichcha Veer Singh Bundela in the popular television show "Uttaran." The show aired from 2008 to 2015 and became immensely popular among the audience. Her portrayal of Ichcha, a character from a disadvantaged background, earned her praise for her acting skills.

 

Before her breakthrough in "Uttaran," Tina Dutta appeared in several Bengali films and television shows. She made her acting debut in the Bengali film industry with the movie "Chokher Bali" in 2003. She has also acted in Bengali films like "Parineeta," "Chirodini Tumi Je Amar," and "Nirbhoya," among others.

 

Apart from "Uttaran," Tina Dutta has participated in reality shows such as "Fear Factor: Khatron Ke Khiladi" and "Jhalak Dikhhla Jaa." She has also made guest appearances in other television shows and has been a part of web series.

 

Tina Dutta continues to work in the television industry, exploring different roles and projects. She is known for her versatility as an actress and her ability to connect with the audience through her performances.

item.title: Tanvi Dogra
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Tanvi Dogra

Television Female Actor

Tanvi Dogra is an Indian television actress who rose to fame for her portrayal of Falguni Purohit in the popular series "Jiji Maa." She is currently captivating audiences with her role as Neetii Juneja in Colors TV's show "Parineetii."

 

Tanvi began her acting journey in 2016 when she appeared as Babita Sharma in Zee TV's "Meri Saasu Maa." However, it was her role as Falguni Purohit Rawat in Star Bharat's "Jiji Maa" from 2017 to 2019 that brought her widespread recognition and established her as a talented actress in the industry.

 

In 2019, she took on the character of Kavya Singhania Mittal in the revenge thriller "Ek Bhram Sarvagun Sampanna" on Star Plus, although she left the series midway. Tanvi showcased her versatility by playing dual roles as Swati Mishra Singh and Babli in &TV's "Santoshi Maa" from 2020 to 2021.

 

Since 2022, Tanvi Dogra has been enthralling viewers with her portrayal of Neetii Juneja in Colors TV's "Parineetii," where she shares the screen with Anchal Sahu and Ankur Verma.

item.title: Tanya Sharma
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Tanya Sharma

Television Female Actor

Tanya Sharma is an Indian television actress who gained recognition for her roles in popular shows like "Saath Nibhaana Saathiya" and "Sasural Simar Ka 2." Tanya started her television career with the series "Afsar Bitiya" in 2011, where she portrayed the character of Chanchal Raj. She then appeared in the mythological drama "Devon Ke Dev...Mahadev" as Devasena and made an episodic appearance in "Fear Files." Although these roles didn't bring her widespread acclaim, they marked the beginning of her acting journey. Her breakthrough role came in 2015 when she was cast as Meera Modi, one of the parallel lead characters, in the long-running StarPlus soap opera "Saath Nibhaana Saathiya." Tanya's portrayal of Meera earned her immense fame and popularity, establishing her as a notable actress in the industry. In 2018, she starred in the Zee TV show "Woh Apna Sa" as Binni Jindal. Tanya also appeared in three different standalone episodes of the popular anthology drama "Laal Ishq" on &TV, portraying different characters in each episode. In February 2019, Tanya secured her second significant role when she was selected to play Saanvi "Anjor" Rajvanshi in Colors TV's social drama "Udaan." With her talent and versatility, Tanya Sharma has made a name for herself in the television industry.

item.title: Tina Ann Philip
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Tina Phillip

Television Female Actor

Tina Phillip is an Indian television actress known for her work in various television shows. She began her career with the lead role of Aastha in the Star Plus channel show "Ek Aastha Aisi Bhi." Since then, she has appeared in several other popular shows, including "Mere Sai," "Mann Ki Awaaz Pratigya 2," "Ek Bhram Sarvagun Sampanna," and "Aye Mere Humsafar."

 

Tina Phillip was born in New Delhi and later moved to London at the age of 6 due to her father's job. She comes from a close-knit family and has a younger brother named Rohan Philip. While Tina currently resides in Mumbai for her acting career, her family continues to live in London.

 

Even though Tina had a passion for acting and dancing from a young age, she prioritized completing her education due to family pressure. After finishing her studies, she pursued her acting aspirations and entered the television industry. With her talent and dedication, Tina has gained recognition for her performances in various roles on television.

item.title: Tridha Choudhury
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Tridha Choudhury

Television Female Actor

Tridha Choudhury is a talented Indian actress known for her work in Hindi, Bengali, and Telugu films and series. She rose to prominence after winning the title of Clean & Clear Times of India Freshface in 2011, which marked the beginning of her career in the entertainment industry. In 2013, she made her debut in the film industry with the Bengali movie "Mishawr Rawhoshyo" directed by Srijit Mukherji.

 

Tridha Choudhury made her television debut in 2016 with the Star Plus series "Dahleez," which premiered on 14 March. Her portrayal of the character in the show garnered positive reviews and showcased her acting prowess. She has since worked on various projects, including the Amazon Prime Video web series "Bandish Bandits" and the MX Player original web series "Aashram." These roles further established her versatility as an actress.

 

Born and raised in Kolkata, West Bengal, Tridha Choudhury completed her schooling at M. P. Birla Foundation Higher Secondary School and later attended Scottish Church College in Kolkata. Her educational background has contributed to her overall growth as an artist.

 

Tridha Choudhury's talent and beauty have gained recognition, and she was ranked No. 13 on The Times of India's "Most Desirable Women List" in 2020. Her dedication to her craft and the ability to portray diverse characters have made her a sought-after actress in the industry.

item.title: Tannaz Irani
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Tannaz Irani

Television Female Actor

Tannaz Irani is a prominent Indian actress and television personality known for her remarkable talent and versatility in the entertainment industry. With a career spanning over two decades, Tannaz has established herself as a respected figure in both films and television.

 

Born on March 8, 1974, Tannaz initially made her mark on the small screen with her memorable performances in popular TV shows like "Kyunki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi" and "Kkusum." Her ability to effortlessly portray a wide range of characters earned her critical acclaim and a loyal fan base.

 

Tannaz's talent and charm soon caught the attention of filmmakers, leading to her foray into Bollywood. She showcased her acting prowess in movies such as "Koi Aap Sa" and "36 China Town," leaving a lasting impression with her memorable roles.

 

Apart from her acting skills, Tannaz is known for her vivacious personality and impeccable comic timing. She has also participated in reality shows like "Bigg Boss" and "Nach Baliye," further showcasing her versatility as a performer.

item.title: Tanya Maniktala
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Tanya Maniktala

Television Female Actor

Tanya Maniktala, born on July 7, 1997, in Delhi, India, is a talented Indian actress known for her remarkable performances in Hindi web shows. She gained prominence for her roles as Ishita in "Flames" (2018) and Lata Mehra in "A Suitable Boy" (2020).

 

Having graduated from Shivaji College, University of Delhi, Tanya initially pursued a career as a copywriter before venturing into the world of acting. Her acting journey began in 2018 with the series "School Days," and it was her subsequent role in Timeliner's "Flames" opposite Ritvik Sahore that brought her widespread recognition. Tanya's portrayal received high praise, establishing her as a rising star in the industry.

 

In 2020, Tanya's career took a major leap forward when she portrayed the character of Lata Mehra in BBC One's "A Suitable Boy," sharing the screen with Ishaan Khattar. Her performance garnered critical acclaim, further solidifying her position as a talented and versatile actress.

 

Continuing her success, Tanya appeared in Netflix's "Feels Like Ishq" (2021) alongside Skand Thakur and in Sony LIV's "Chutzpah" (2021) alongside Varun Sharma. She also starred in Netflix's "How To Fall In Love" (2021) opposite Ayush Mehra.

 

Tanya is set to make her Hindi film debut with "Mumbaikar," where she will be seen alongside Vijay Sethupathi and Vikrant Massey. Additionally, she has exciting projects lined up, including Pratim D Gupta's "Tooth Pari" opposite Shantanu Maheshwari, as well as the web series "P.I. Meena" and the highly anticipated third season of "Flames."

item.title: Upasana Singh
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Upasna Singh

Television Female Actor

Upasna Singh is an Indian actress and comedian who primarily works in the Punjabi and Hindi film industries. She was born on June 29, 1975, in Kapurthala, Punjab, India.

 

Upasna Singh has appeared in numerous films and television shows throughout her career. She is best known for her role as "Bua" in the popular comedy show "Comedy Nights with Kapil." Her portrayal of the character Bua, known for her witty one-liners and comic timing, earned her a lot of popularity and recognition.

 

Apart from "Comedy Nights with Kapil," Upasna Singh has appeared in various other television shows, including "Son Pari," "Parrivaar," and "Mrs. & Mr. Sharma Allahabadwale," among others. She has also acted in Punjabi films like "Jatt & Juliet," "Carry On Jatta," and "Naughty Jatts."

 

Upasna Singh's talent for comedy and her ability to entertain audiences have made her a well-known face in the Indian entertainment industry. She continues to work in both television and films, showcasing her comedic skills and acting prowess.

item.title: Ulka Gupta
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Ulka Gupta

Television Female Actor

Ulka Gupta is an Indian actress who primarily works in the Hindi television and film industry. She was born on April 12, 1997, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India.

Ulka Gupta gained popularity at a young age for her portrayal of young Goddess Parvati in the television series "Devon Ke Dev...Mahadev" (2011-2014). Her performance in the show received critical acclaim, and she became a household name.

Prior to her television debut, Ulka Gupta made her acting debut in the Marathi film "Ya...Mrityu Bhet Tayel" in 2002. She has also appeared in other Marathi films like "Odyssey," "Khamosh Adalat Jaari Hai," and "The Silence."

In addition to her television and film work, Ulka Gupta has been associated with various social and environmental causes. She has actively participated in campaigns related to education and women's empowerment.

Ulka Gupta's talent and dedication to her craft have earned her recognition and admiration among the audience. While she is best known for her portrayal of young Goddess Parvati, she has also acted in other television shows like "Jhansi Ki Rani" and "Khelti Hai Zindagi Aankh Micholi."

item.title: Vaishnavi Mahant
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Vaishnavi Mahant

Television Female Actor

Vaishnavi Mahant is an Indian television and film actress known for her work in the Hindi entertainment industry. She was born on September 9, 1974, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India.

 

Vaishnavi Mahant made her acting debut with the television show "Shaktimaan" in 1997, where she played the role of Geeta Vishwas. The show gained immense popularity and became a cult classic among Indian audiences. Her portrayal of Geeta Vishwas, a news reporter, earned her recognition and appreciation.

 

Following her debut, Vaishnavi Mahant appeared in several television shows, including "Achanak 37 Saal Baad," "Doli Saja Ke," and "Kesariya Balam Aavo Hamare Des," among others. She has showcased her versatility as an actress and has played a variety of roles in both positive and negative shades.

 

Apart from television, Vaishnavi Mahant has also acted in Bollywood films. She made her film debut with the movie "Roop Ki Rani Choron Ka Raja" in 1993. She has appeared in films like "Trimurti," "Yeh Teraa Ghar Yeh Meraa Ghar," and "Bhoot Unkle," among others.

item.title: Vaishnavi Dhanraj
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Vaishnavi Dhanraj

Television Female Actor

Vaishnavi Dhanraj is an Indian television and film actress known for her versatile performances. She made her acting debut in 2008 with a cameo in the popular TV show "Kasautii Zindagii Kay" and later gained recognition for her role as Inspector Tasha in Sony Entertainment Television's "C.I.D." Her portrayal of the gun-toting detective earned her popularity and she performed all her stunts herself, refusing to use stunt doubles.

 

Vaishnavi's breakthrough role came in the show "Na Aana Is Des Laado" where she played the character of Jhanvi, a feminist fighting for women's empowerment in rural India. She showcased her acting skills and commitment to the role, and the show focused on the issue of female foeticide.

 

After a brief break following her marriage, Vaishnavi returned to television with "Parvarrish – Kuchh Khattee Kuchh Meethi" and played the character of Meera Mathur, a calm and composed businesswoman. She then took on the role of Riya Jaiswal/Devika, a self-obsessed struggling Bollywood actress, in Colors TV's "Madhubala – Ek Ishq Ek Junoon."

 

Vaishnavi also ventured into the mythological genre with Star Plus's epic series "Mahabharat." She played the dual role of Hidimbaa, an ugly demoness, and a stunning enchantress. Her performance received critical acclaim, and she successfully portrayed the contrasting characters.

 

In addition to her television roles, Vaishnavi has appeared in various episodic shows including "Kitchen Champion 4," "India's Got Talent," "Crime Patrol," "Hum Ne Li Hai- Shapath," and "Fear Files." She has also worked in films, including the adult Hindi film "PK Lele A Salesman" where she played the role of Mary Marlo, a rich girl.

 

Vaishnavi Dhanraj was last seen in Colors TV's "Bepannaah," where she portrayed the character of Mahi Arora. Throughout her career, she has showcased her versatility and talent, taking on diverse roles in both television and film.

Vaishnavi Dhanraj is an Indian television and film actress known for her versatile performances. She made her acting debut in 2008 with a cameo in the popular TV show \"Kasautii Zindagii Kay\" and later gained recognition for her role as Inspector Tasha in Sony Entertainment Television's \"C.I.D.\" Her portrayal of the gun-toting detective earned her popularity and she performed all her stunts herself, refusing to use stunt doubles.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Vaishnavi's breakthrough role came in the show \"Na Aana Is Des Laado\" where she played the character of Jhanvi, a feminist fighting for women's empowerment in rural India. She showcased her acting skills and commitment to the role, and the show focused on the issue of female foeticide.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

After a brief break following her marriage, Vaishnavi returned to television with \"Parvarrish \u2013 Kuchh Khattee Kuchh Meethi\" and played the character of Meera Mathur, a calm and composed businesswoman. She then took on the role of Riya Jaiswal\/Devika, a self-obsessed struggling Bollywood actress, in Colors TV's \"Madhubala \u2013 Ek Ishq Ek Junoon.\"<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Vaishnavi also ventured into the mythological genre with Star Plus's epic series \"Mahabharat.\" She played the dual role of Hidimbaa, an ugly demoness, and a stunning enchantress. Her performance received critical acclaim, and she successfully portrayed the contrasting characters.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

In addition to her television roles, Vaishnavi has appeared in various episodic shows including \"Kitchen Champion 4,\" \"India's Got Talent,\" \"Crime Patrol,\" \"Hum Ne Li Hai- Shapath,\" and \"Fear Files.\" She has also worked in films, including the adult Hindi film \"PK Lele A Salesman\" where she played the role of Mary Marlo, a rich girl.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Vaishnavi Dhanraj was last seen in Colors TV's \"Bepannaah,\" where she portrayed the character of Mahi Arora. Throughout her career, she has showcased her versatility and talent, taking on diverse roles in both television and film.<\/p>","typography_typography":"custom","typography_font_weight":"bold"},"elements":[],"widgetType":"text-editor"}],"isInner":false}],"isInner":false},{"id":"f1e608b","elType":"section","settings":{"background_background":"classic","background_color":"#EAF0EE8F","hover_parallax":[{"layer_position_vr":{"unit":"%","size":30},"layer_position_hr":{"unit":"%","size":40},"_id":"ac4fb18"},{"layer_position_vr":{"unit":"%","size":60},"layer_position_hr":{"unit":"%","size":20},"_id":"a1b2b38"}]},"elements":[{"id":"b9dba07","elType":"column","settings":{"_column_size":100,"_inline_size":null},"elements":[{"id":"8a466b8","elType":"widget","settings":{"title":"Enquiry Form","header_size":"h3","align":"center","typography_typography":"custom","typography_font_size":{"unit":"px","size":40,"sizes":[]},"typography_font_weight":"bold","_margin":{"unit":"px","top":"40","right":"0","bottom":"20","left":"0","isLinked":false},"__globals__":{"title_color":"globals\/colors?id=6d3d44f9"}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"heading"},{"id":"e520a3a","elType":"widget","settings":{"shortcode":"[forminator_form id=\"5483\"]","_margin":{"unit":"px","top":"0","right":"0","bottom":"40","left":"0","isLinked":false}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"shortcode"}],"isInner":false}],"isInner":false}]

item.title: Vandana Pathak
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Vandana Pathak

Television Female Actor

Vandana Vaidya Pathak is an Indian actress known for her work in Hindi films, stage, and television. She has gained popularity for her roles in comedic plays and sitcoms, particularly for her portrayal of Jayshree Parekh in the Khichdi franchise and the antagonistic character Gaura in the soap opera Saath Nibhaana Saathiya. Vandana has played several Gujarati roles in Indian serials, showcasing her versatility as an actress.

Born and raised in Ahmedabad, Vandana is the daughter of Gujarati actor Arvind Vaidya. She made her television debut in 1995 with the popular sitcom Hum Paanch, where she portrayed the character of Meenakshi Mathur and gained overnight stardom. Her terrific performance in the show contributed to its success and marked the beginning of her successful career in the television industry.

After the success of Hum Paanch, Vandana Pathak became a recognized face and was chosen to play the pivotal role of Jayshree Parekh in the sitcom Khichdi. The show further elevated her fame and established her as a prominent actress in Indian television. She reprised the same character in the sequel Instant Khichdi, which was equally successful. Vandana has also acted in Gujarati plays and has showcased her talent in comedy plays and sitcoms.

Throughout her career, Vandana Pathak has taken on diverse roles, including the twisted character of Sheela Devi in Main Kab Saas Banoongi and an alien in the television series Badi Door Se Aaye Hai. In 2015, she joined the cast of the long-running show Saath Nibhaana Saathiya, portraying the character of Gaura. Her negative portrayal of Gaura was well-received, and she brought toughness and intensity to the role.

In 2017, Vandana Pathak played the villainous character of Padmini/Vaidehi in Colors TV's medical drama show Savitri Devi College & Hospital, which was created by Rashmi Sharma, with whom Vandana had previously worked in Saath Nibhaana Saathiya.

item.title: Veebha Anand
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Veebha Anand

Television Female Actor

Veebha Anand is an Indian actress known for her roles in various television shows. She gained recognition for her portrayal of Sugna Shyam Singh in the popular series Balika Vadhu. She has also appeared in shows like Shree, Sanskaar Laxmi, Mahabharat, Kaisi Yeh Yaariaan, and Begusarai.

 

Veebha Anand was born on September 8, 1995, in Dehradun, Uttarakhand. She comes from a non-filmy background and has a younger sister named Sakshi Anand, who is a writer, and a brother named Ajeet Anand. In accordance with numerology, she changed her name from Vibha Anand to Veebha Anand. While the pronunciation of her name remained the same, the change was made by replacing the 'i' with 'ee'.

 

She completed her schooling at Doon Presidency School in Uttarakhand. Veebha Anand started her acting career with the television show Balika Vadhu, where she played the role of Sugna Shyam Singh. The character garnered her popularity and established her as a talented actress in the industry. She has since appeared in various shows across different genres, showcasing her versatility as an actress.

item.title: Vindhya Tiwari
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Vindhya Tiwari

Television Female Actor

Vindhya Tiwari is an Indian television actress known for her work in Indian soap operas. She gained recognition for her breakthrough role in the drama series Agle Janam Mohe Bitiya Hi Kijo on Zee TV. She is also well-known for her role as Vidya in the series Maryada: Lekin Kab Tak? on Star Plus, for which she received a nomination for Best Television Actress at the Indian Television Academy Awards (ITA). Additionally, she portrayed the main female antagonist, Chandramani, in Sasural Simar Ka on Colors TV and played the lead role of Sonachandi in Badi Door Se Aaye Hain on SAB TV.

 

Vindhya Tiwari was born on November 22, 1992, in Ramnagar, Varanasi district, Uttar Pradesh. She had a passion for acting from a young age and aspired to become an actress. She pursued her dreams and entered the television industry, where she made a mark with her notable performances in various popular shows.

 

Throughout her career, Vindhya Tiwari has showcased her talent and versatility as an actress, portraying diverse characters across different television series. Her dedication to her craft and notable performances have garnered her recognition and appreciation from the audience

item.title: Vinny Arora
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Vinny Arora

Television Female Actor

Vinny Arora Dhoopar, formerly known as Vinny Arora, is an Indian television actress. She began her acting career with the show Kasturi and went on to appear in other series such as Kuchh Is Tara and Aathvaan Vachan. She gained prominence through her roles in shows like Maat Pitaah Ke Charnon Mein Swarg, Shubh Vivah, and Itna Karo Na Mujhe Pyaar. Her most recent television appearance was as Juhi Sethi in Colors TV's Laado – Veerpur Ki Mardani.

 

In her personal life, Arora is married to actor Dheeraj Dhoopar. They tied the knot on 16 November 2016 in Delhi. The couple first met on the sets of Maat Pitaah Ke Charnon Mein Swarg in 2009. In April 2022, they announced that they were expecting their first child, and on 10 August 2022, they welcomed their baby boy.

 

Arora started her acting career at a young age and has worked in various television shows across different channels, including Star Plus, Sony TV, Colors TV, and Life OK. She has also made appearances in other formats, such as an episode of Yeh Hai Aashiqui on Bindass titled "The Other Mummy" and a TV commercial for Sonata Watches Wedding Collection in 2015. Additionally, she played the role of Asha, a teacher, in the acclaimed film Dhanak in 2016. Besides her television work, Arora was last seen as Surbhi in the web series Pati Patni Aur Woh.

item.title: Vahbbiz Dorabjee
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Vahbiz Dorabjee

Television Female Actor

Vahbiz Dorabjee is an Indian television actress and model. She made her television debut with the serial Pyaar Kii Ye Ek Kahaani, where she portrayed the character of Panchi Dobriyal from 2010 to 2011. She also appeared in the series Saraswatichandra in 2013, playing the role of Alak. Dorabjee received an award for her best supporting role in Pyaar Kii Ye Ek Kahaani in 2011.

 

She was also a part of the television series Bahu Hamari Rajni Kant, where she portrayed the character of Maggie Kant.

 

In her personal life, Dorabjee was born into a Parsi family in Pune, Maharashtra. Her father, Jehangir Dorabjee, and mother, Firoza Dorabjee, are known entrepreneurs in Pune.

item.title: Vrushika Mehta
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Vrushika Mehta

Television Female Actor

Vrushika Mehta is an Indian actress and professional dancer known for her work in Hindi television. She was born in Ahmedabad and raised in Mumbai. She completed her graduation from Tolani College of Commerce in Mumbai and is a professional dancer.

 

Mehta made her acting debut in 2012 with the show Aasman Se Aage, where she portrayed the character of Vrushika. However, she gained significant recognition and popularity for her role as Sharon Rai Prakash in the television series Dil Dosti Dance from 2013 to 2015, opposite Shantanu Maheshwari.

 

After that, she appeared in various episodic roles in shows like Yeh Hai Aashiqui, Pyaar Tune Kya Kiya, and Fear Files. In 2015, she played the character of Amrita Prasad in Twist Wala Love and Kaira in Satrangi Sasural.

 

In 2016, Mehta portrayed the character of Ishana in the popular show Ishqbaaaz. She also hosted the web series Desi Explorers Jordan on YouTube.

Her digital debut came in the form of the character Tamanna in Viu's Truth or Tamanna. From 2018 to 2020, she gained further success by playing the role of Asmita "Puchki" Kumari in Zee TV's Yeh Teri Galiyan opposite Avinash Mishra.

Vassundhara Pandita

Television Female Actor

Vassundhara Pandita is a well-known social media star, singer, and actress who rose to fame through her entertaining TikTok videos. Born on May 20, 2000, in Jammu & Kashmir, India, she hails from a Hindu family and has four members, including her parents and a brother.

 

Vassundhara gained popularity for her creative and engaging content on TikTok, where she showcased her talent for lip-syncing, dancing, and comedic skits. Her videos garnered a massive following, and she became a prominent figure on the platform.

 

In addition to her success on TikTok, Vassundhara is also a talented singer. She has captivated audiences with her melodious voice and has shared her singing performances on various social media platforms. Her musical talent has garnered praise and admiration from her fans.

 

As an actress, Vassundhara has displayed her skills in short films and other video projects. Her on-screen presence and acting abilities have further contributed to her popularity and fan base.

With her vibrant personality and entertaining content, Vassundhara Pandita has established herself as a prominent social media personality. Her talent, combined with her dedication and hard work, has enabled her to gain a significant following and become a well-loved figure on various social media platforms

item.title: Vidhi Pandya
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Vidhi Pandya

Television Female Actor

Vidhi Pandya, an accomplished Indian actress in the Hindi television industry, has left her mark with versatile roles that have resonated with audiences.

 

Beginning her acting journey in 2014, Vidhi Pandya made her debut as Kiran Maheshwari in "Tum Aise Hi Rehna." Her career trajectory gained momentum as she portrayed Nidhi in the acclaimed show "Balika Vadhu" from 2015 to 2016. In 2015, she showcased her skills in various episodes of "Crime Patrol" as Rohini Singh / Sophia.

 

However, it was her portrayal of Imli Singh Rajvanshi in the popular series "Udaan" from 2016 to 2019 that proved to be a pivotal turning point in her career. The role opposite Paras Arora and Vikas Bhalla garnered her significant recognition and acclaim.

 

Vidhi Pandya's career continued to flourish with appearances in different projects. In 2019, she graced the screen with an episode on "Kitchen Champion" and played Rani in an episode of "Laal Ishq" alongside Saheem Khan and Mehnaz Shroff.

 

Her talent shone in 2021 when she portrayed Major Dr. Suman Tiwari Malhotra in "Ek Duje Ke Vaaste 2" opposite Mohit Kumar. In October 2021, she ventured into reality TV by participating in "Bigg Boss 15," marking another dimension of her career.

 

In 2022, Vidhi Pandya showcased her acting finesse once again as Saumya Verma in "Mose Chhal Kiye Jaaye," opposite Vijayendra Kumeria.

\u00a0<\/p>

However, it was her portrayal of Imli Singh Rajvanshi in the popular series \"Udaan\" from 2016 to 2019 that proved to be a pivotal turning point in her career. The role opposite Paras Arora and Vikas Bhalla garnered her significant recognition and acclaim.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Her talent shone in 2021 when she portrayed Major Dr. Suman Tiwari Malhotra in \"Ek Duje Ke Vaaste 2\" opposite Mohit Kumar. In October 2021, she ventured into reality TV by participating in \"Bigg Boss 15,\" marking another dimension of her career.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

item.title: Yukti Kapoor
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Yukti Kapoor

Television Female Actor

Yukti Kapoor is an Indian television actress who is known for her roles in various shows. She gained recognition for her portrayal of Urmila in Siya Ke Ram and Ragini Singh in Agniphera. She is currently playing the role of S.I. Karishma Singh in the show Maddam Sir.

 

Kapoor made her acting debut in 2010 with the show Nanhi Si Kali Meri Laadli, where she played the character of Guddi. She subsequently appeared in other shows like Jhilmil Sitaaron Ka Aangan Hoga as Tanu Chauhan, Pyaar Ka Dard Hai Meetha Meetha Pyaara Pyaara as Bittoo, and Yeh Hai Mohabbatein as Mayura Dunavati.

 

In 2013, Kapoor made her film debut with the Bhojpuri film Ka Ukhaad Leba, where she played the character of Mona Bai. The same year, she made her Hindi film debut with Uvaa.

In 2015, Kapoor landed her first major role in Star Plus's Siya Ke Ram, where she portrayed the character of Urmila opposite Karan Suchak. Her performance in the show garnered her recognition and praise.

 

In 2016, she played the role of Sudha Shekhwat in the popular show Balika Vadhu. She portrayed one of the protagonists, Ragini Singh, in the show Agniphera alongside Ankit Gera and Simran Kaur in 2017.

 

After Agniphera took a leap in 2018, Kapoor continued her journey in the show as Agni Singh Thakur, the on-screen daughter of her earlier character. She appeared alongside actors Samridh Bawa and Simran Kaur.

 

In addition to her television career, Kapoor also appeared in an episode of Laal Ishq as Swetha, sharing the screen with Vikram Sakhalkar. She played the characters of Lakshmi, Alakshmi, and Matrikas in the show Namah alongside Savi Thakur.

In 2020, she made an appearance in her first music video titled "Fakiri." Since 2020, Kapoor has been playing the role of S.I. Karishma Singh, a Lucknow-based female cop, in Sony SAB's Maddam Sir. Her portrayal of Karishma Singh has been appreciated by the audience. In 2022, she showcased her versatility by also portraying the character of Kaushalya Singh, the twin sister of her on-screen character Karishma Singh, in Maddam Sir, marking her third dual role in the show.

item.title: Yashaswini Dayama
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Yashaswini Dayama

Television Female Actor

Yashaswini Dayama is an Indian actress known for her work in both films and web series. She was born on October 25, 1994, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India.

 

Yashaswini Dayama gained recognition for her performances in various digital platforms. She made her acting debut with the web series "Adulting" in 2018, where she portrayed the character of Ray. Her portrayal of a young independent woman navigating adulthood resonated with the audience and received positive reviews.

 

She has since appeared in other popular web series such as "Delhi Crime," where she played the role of Chandni, and "Made in Heaven," where she portrayed the character of Mitali. Her performances showcased her talent and versatility as an actress.

In addition to web series, Yashaswini Dayama has also acted in films. She was seen in the Bollywood movie "Dear Zindagi" in 2016, where she had a supporting role.

item.title: Akhil Akkineni
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Akhil Akkineni

Regional Male Actor

Akhil Akkineni is an Indian film actor who primarily works in the Telugu film industry. He was born on April 8, 1994, in San Jose, California, USA. Akhil made his acting debut as a child artist in the film "Sisindri" in 1995, which was a Telugu adaptation of the Hollywood film "Baby's Day Out." He then took a break from acting to focus on his education.

 

In 2014, Akhil made his debut as a lead actor with the film "Akhil," which was directed by V. V. Vinayak. Despite receiving mixed reviews, the film performed well at the box office. He subsequently appeared in the film "Hello" in 2017, which received positive reviews for his performance.

 

Apart from acting, Akhil is also trained in martial arts and has showcased his skills in his films. He is known for his charming looks and energetic performances. Akhil comes from a prominent film family in South India, being the son of actors Nagarjuna Akkineni and Amala Akkineni.

 

Akhil Akkineni has a strong fan following and continues to work on establishing himself as a leading actor in the Telugu film industry.

item.title: Adivi Sesh
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Adivi Sesh

Regional Male Actor

Adivi Sesh is a prominent actor in the Telugu film industry, also known as Tollywood. Born on December 17, 1985, in Hyderabad, India, he has made a significant impact with his versatile performances. Sesh began his acting career in 2002 with the film "Karma: Do You Believe?" and later appeared in supporting roles in movies like "Panjaa" and "Baahubali: The Beginning."

 

In 2016, Adivi Sesh gained recognition for his breakthrough role as the lead actor and writer in the critically acclaimed film "Kshanam." The film received widespread praise for its unique storyline and Sesh's compelling performance, earning him several awards and nominations. He further showcased his talent as a writer and actor in the successful spy thriller "Goodachari" in 2018, which garnered positive reviews and commercial success.

 

Apart from acting, Adivi Sesh has also written scripts for movies like "Kiss" and "Ami Thumi." He is known for his dedication to his craft, often involving himself in various aspects of filmmaking. Sesh's dedication and hard work have earned him a loyal fan base and established him as a promising actor in the Telugu film industry.

item.title: Allari Naresh
