item.content:encoded:
Allari Naresh

Regional Male Actor

Allari Naresh is an accomplished Indian actor known for his versatility and comedic timing in the Telugu film industry. Born on June 30, 1982, as Edara Naresh, he earned the moniker "Allari" (meaning mischievous) due to his energetic and lively performances. With his unique blend of humor and acting prowess, Naresh has carved a niche for himself in Tollywood.

 

Starting his career with the film "Allari" in 2002, Naresh quickly gained recognition for his impeccable comic timing and natural flair for comedy. He has since acted in a multitude of successful films, earning him the title of "comedy king" in Telugu cinema. Despite being primarily known for his comic roles, Naresh has also showcased his versatility by portraying diverse characters in films like "Gamyam" and "Sudigadu."

 

Naresh's ability to connect with audiences through his relatable characters and effortless humor has made him a favorite among moviegoers. He has received several accolades for his performances, including the Nandi Award for Best Supporting Actor.

 

Beyond his acting career, Naresh is also involved in social causes and has actively participated in charitable initiatives. With his infectious charm and comedic brilliance, Allari Naresh continues to enthrall audiences and remains one of the most beloved actors in the Telugu film

item.title: Aadi Saikumar
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Aadi Saikumar

Regional Male Actor

Aadi Saikumar, born on December 23, 1991, is a prominent Indian actor known for his work in the Telugu film industry. He hails from the illustrious film background, being the son of renowned actor Sai Kumar. Aadi made his acting debut in 2011 with the film "Prema Kavali," which garnered him immense recognition and a Filmfare Award for Best Male Debut.

 

He continued to impress the audience with his versatile performances in movies like "Lovely," "Sukumarudu," and "Rough," establishing himself as a talented actor in Tollywood. Aadi has showcased his acting prowess in a variety of genres, including romantic dramas, action films, and family entertainers.

 

Besides his acting skills, Aadi is also known for his dedication to fitness and physical training, which is evident in his well-toned physique. He actively engages with his fans on social media platforms, providing glimpses into his personal and professional life.

 

Aadi Saikumar is highly regarded for his affable personality, humble nature, and commitment to his craft. With his undeniable talent and growing popularity, he continues to captivate the audience and carve a niche for himself in the Telugu film industry.

item.title: Allu Sirish
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Allu Sirish

Regional Male Actor

Allu Sirish is a prominent Indian actor known for his work in the Telugu film industry. Born on May 30, 1987, he is the youngest son of film producer Allu Aravind and the brother of popular actors Allu Arjun and Allu Venkatesh. With a background deeply rooted in the film industry, Allu Sirish made his acting debut in 2013 with the film "Gouravam," which garnered him critical acclaim.

 

Despite coming from a renowned film family, Allu Sirish has carved a niche for himself with his unique choices of films and versatile performances. He has been part of movies like "Kotha Janta," "Srirastu Subhamastu," and "ABCD: American Born Confused Desi," showcasing his acting prowess and establishing his own identity in the industry.

 

Apart from acting, Allu Sirish is also known for his philanthropic endeavors and social work. He actively participates in various charitable initiatives and believes in giving back to society.

 

With his charming screen presence, dedication to his craft, and versatility as an actor, Allu Sirish continues to win hearts and entertain audiences with his performances. He is a rising star in the Telugu film industry, and fans eagerly anticipate his future projects, expecting him to deliver more memorable performances on the big screen.

item.title: Adinath Kothare
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Adinath Kothare

Regional Male Actor

Adinath Kothare is a talented Indian actor and filmmaker known for his work in the Marathi film industry. Born on 13th May 1984, in Maharashtra, India, Adinath has made a remarkable impact on the regional cinema with his exceptional acting skills and creative vision. He is the son of renowned Marathi actor and filmmaker, Mahesh Kothare, which has undoubtedly influenced his career choice.

 

Adinath made his acting debut in 2004 with the film "Maza Chakula" and since then has appeared in numerous critically acclaimed movies. He has portrayed a wide range of characters, showcasing his versatility and ability to immerse himself in each role. Some of his notable films include "Zapatlela 2," "Pune 52," and "Ishq Wala Love."

 

Apart from acting, Adinath has also ventured into directing. In 2018, he made his directorial debut with the film "Paani," which received positive reviews for its unique storyline and execution. Adinath's passion for storytelling and his commitment to quality filmmaking have earned him a dedicated fan base and critical acclaim.

item.title: Ajith Kumar
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Ajith Kumar

Regional Male Actor

Ajith Kumar, often referred to as Thala by his ardent fans, is a prominent figure in the Indian film industry. Born on May 1, 1971, Ajith has left an indelible mark in the world of cinema with his exceptional talent and charismatic presence. He began his acting career in the early 1990s and has since starred in numerous Tamil films, earning him a dedicated fan following.

 

Ajith is known for his versatility as an actor, effortlessly transitioning between action-packed roles and intense emotional performances. His commitment to his craft is evident in the dedication he brings to every project. With his rugged charm and impeccable style, he has become a role model for many aspiring actors.

 

Apart from his acting prowess, Ajith is also admired for his humility and philanthropic endeavors. Despite his immense fame, he remains grounded and uses his influence to make a positive impact on society. He has supported various charitable causes and has actively contributed to initiatives aimed at helping the underprivileged.

item.title: Amey Wagh
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Amey Wagh

Regional Male Actor

Amey Wagh is a prominent figure in the Indian entertainment industry known for his versatility as an actor, director, and writer. Born on November 13, 1987, in Pune, Maharashtra, Amey's passion for acting emerged at a young age. He began his acting journey on the Marathi stage and quickly gained recognition for his exceptional talent. Amey's breakthrough came with his role as "Kaivalya" in the Marathi TV show "Dil Dosti Duniyadari," which became immensely popular and catapulted him to stardom. His portrayal of the lovable and mischievous character won the hearts of audiences across Maharashtra. Since then, he has consistently delivered remarkable performances in various films and TV shows. Amey's ability to effortlessly switch between comedy and drama has made him one of the most sought-after actors in the Marathi film industry. His natural charm, impeccable comic timing, and nuanced acting skills have garnered critical acclaim and a dedicated fan base. In addition to his acting prowess, Amey has also ventured into directing and writing. He directed the Marathi play "Goshta Tashi Gamtichi" and co-wrote the screenplay for the film "Ghanta" along with his fellow actors.

item.title: Aadarsh Balakrishna
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Aadarsh Balakrishna

Regional Male Actor

Aadarsh Balakrishna is an Indian actor and model who primarily works in the Telugu film industry. He was born on February 10, 1984, in Bangalore, Karnataka, India. Aadarsh initially gained fame as a model before transitioning to acting.

 

Aadarsh made his acting debut in 2004 with the Telugu film "Happy." However, he rose to prominence with his role as Ravi in the blockbuster film "Happy Days" (2007), directed by Sekhar Kammula. The film was a commercial success and earned him widespread recognition. He later appeared in several Telugu films, including "Vinayakudu" (2008), "Prayanam" (2009).

 

Apart from his film career, Aadarsh Balakrishna has also appeared in a few Telugu television shows. He participated in the reality show "Bigg Boss Telugu 1" in 2017, which further increased his popularity.

item.content:encoded:
Aadesh Bandekar

Regional Male Actor

Aadesh Bandekar, a prominent figure in the Indian entertainment industry, is a multi-talented individual who has made significant contributions to television and radio. Born on November 1, 1966, in Mumbai, India, Bandekar's journey in the media world began with his radio career. He worked as a radio jockey, winning hearts with his charming voice and engaging style of hosting.

 

However, Bandekar's talent didn't stop at radio. He ventured into television and gained immense popularity as a television presenter, hosting various shows across different genres. With his affable personality and natural ease in front of the camera, he captivated audiences and became a household name.

 

Besides his hosting skills, Aadesh Bandekar has also displayed his acting prowess, starring in Marathi films and television serials. His versatility as an entertainer has garnered him a loyal fan base and critical acclaim. He has been recognized with numerous awards for his outstanding contributions to the entertainment industry.

 

In addition to his on-screen presence, Bandekar is also known for his philanthropic endeavors. He actively participates in social causes, advocating for education and healthcare.

item.title: Aadhi Pinisetty
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Aadhi Pinisetty

Regional Male Actor

Aadhi Pinisetty is an Indian actor who primarily works in Tamil and Telugu films. He was born into a Telugu-speaking family, and his father is the renowned film director Ravi Raja Pinisetty. Aadhi made his acting debut in 2006 with the Telugu film "Oka V Chitram," directed by Teja.

 

His breakthrough role came in the Tamil film "Eeram" in 2009, which was produced by director S. Shankar. Aadhi gained recognition for his performance in the supernatural thriller. Following that, he appeared in films like "Mirugam" (2007), "Ayyanar" (2010), "Aadu Puli" (2010), "Aravaan" (2012), "Gundello Godari" (2013), "Vallinam" (2014), "Kochadaiyaan" (2014), and "Yagavarayinum Naa Kaakka" (2015).

 

One of his notable films is the action film "Sarrainodu" (2016), which received critical acclaim, and Aadhi's performance was highly praised for elevating the film. In 2017, he starred in the successful thriller "Maragadha Naanayam" and the Telugu romantic drama "Ninnu Kori."

 

Aadhi Pinisetty continued to appear in notable films like "Agnyaathavaasi" (2018), "Rangasthalam" (2018), "Neevevaro" (2018), and the bilingual film "U Turn" (2018).

item.title: Aarav Chowdhary
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Aarav Chowdhary

Regional Male Actor

Aarav Chowdhary, a talented Indian actor and model, has left his mark in both the television and film industries with his diverse roles and notable performances.

 

Born on November 23, 1981, Aarav Chowdhary hails from Jaipur. He has garnered recognition for his acting prowess as well as his modeling endeavors.

Chowdhary's career trajectory includes appearances in various Bollywood movies, such as "Dhoom" and "Housefull 3." However, he gained significant fame for his portrayal of Bhishma Pitamah in the 2013 edition of the iconic TV show "Mahabharat." His performance as Bhishma garnered widespread acclaim and solidified his position in the industry.

 

In addition to his work in films and television, Aarav Chowdhary has also acted in the television series "Iss Pyaar Ko Kya Naam Doon? Ek Baar Phir." His ability to seamlessly transition between different mediums and bring depth to his characters reflects his dedication to his craft.

 

Aarav Chowdhary's versatility as an actor, along with his charismatic presence, has earned him respect and admiration in the entertainment world. His contributions to both film and television continue to captivate audiences and showcase his talent.

item.title: Adil Ibrahim
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Adil Ibrahim

Regional Male Actor

Adil Ibrahim is an Indian actor, radio jockey, television host, and model. He was born on February 6, and he hails from Tirur, Malappuram, Kerala, India. However, he was born in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Adil completed his education at New Indian Model School and Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani – Dubai Campus. After obtaining an engineering degree, he worked for around two years before deciding to pursue a career in acting.

 

Adil Ibrahim began his TV anchoring career in 2009 on the Malayalam channel Asianet. He hosted shows like "You, Me and Dubai," which was based on the Dubai Shopping Festival, and "Magic Carpet," an Arabian travelogue. He has also been associated with other Malayalam channels such as Amrita TV and Media One, where he anchored various shows.

 

In addition to his TV career, Adil Ibrahim worked as an RJ and producer at RadioMe (100.3 FM Dubai) for nearly two years. He hosted the breakfast show called "Morning Madness" during the programs Ramadan Nights and Cocktail.

 

Adil gained recognition as the host of the popular dance reality show "D3-D4 Dance Season 3" on Mazhavil Manorama. He also hosts the show "Still Standing" on the same channel.

As an actor, Adil Ibrahim has appeared in several Malayalam films. Some of his notable characters include Sudev in "Nirnnayakam," Abey in "Achayans," Dr. Rahul in "Nine," Riju in "Lucifer," Arun Rajeev in "Mohan Kumar Fans," and Abin in "Cheraathukal."

item.title: Akash Thosar
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Akash Thosar

Regional Male Actor

Akash Thosar is a talented Indian actor known for his notable work in the Marathi film industry. Born on February 24, 1993, in Karamala, Maharashtra, Thosar captured the hearts of audiences with his debut performance in the critically acclaimed film "Sairat" in 2016. His portrayal of the character Parshya, a young boy from a lower caste, showcased his acting prowess and garnered widespread praise.

 

Thosar's natural acting skills and captivating screen presence have made him a sought-after actor in Marathi cinema. He has since worked on several successful films, including "Friends," "FU: Friendship Unlimited," and "Faster Fene." With each project, Thosar has demonstrated his versatility and ability to bring depth and authenticity to his characters.

 

Apart from acting, Thosar is also a talented sportsman, having represented Maharashtra in various state-level cricket tournaments. This athletic background adds an extra dimension to his performances, allowing him to imbue his characters with a unique physicality.

 

Akash Thosar's dedication to his craft and his ability to connect with audiences have made him a rising star in the Marathi film industry. With his undeniable talent and potential, he continues to win hearts and leave a lasting impression on the silver screen

item.title: Ankush Chaudhari
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Ankush Chaudhari

Regional Male Actor

Ankush Chaudhari is a talented and versatile actor hailing from the Indian film industry. He has left an indelible mark on Marathi cinema with his exceptional performances and charming persona. Born on February 31, 1977, in Pune, Maharashtra, Ankush embarked on his acting journey at a young age. With his natural flair for acting, Ankush made his debut in Marathi cinema in the late 1990s and quickly gained recognition for his noteworthy performances. His ability to seamlessly transition between various genres, from comedy to drama, has endeared him to audiences across Maharashtra. Ankush's portrayal of diverse characters has showcased his range and versatility as an actor. He has consistently delivered memorable performances in films like "Duniyadari," "Double Seat," and "Guru," among others. His ability to connect with audiences on an emotional level has earned him a loyal fan base. Beyond his acting prowess, Ankush is also known for his charismatic presence off-screen. His humility, dedication, and professionalism have earned him respect within the industry. He continues to push boundaries and explore new horizons, leaving an indomitable impression on the Marathi film industry.

item.title: Arjun Das
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Arjun Das

Regional Male Actor

Arjun Das is an Indian actor primarily known for his work in Tamil films, as well as a few Telugu films. He gained significant recognition for his role as Anbu in the film "Kaithi" (2019), where his deep bass voice made a lasting impression.

 

Arjun started his acting career with the suspense thriller "Perumaan" in 2012. After appearing in a few other movies and short films, he landed the role of the antagonist, a cocaine addict gang leader, in Lokesh Kanagaraj's "Kaithi." His portrayal received widespread acclaim, and the film propelled him to the forefront of the Tamil film industry. He then collaborated with Lokesh again for the film "Master," where he played the secondary antagonist named Das.

 

Prior to entering the film industry, Arjun worked as a banker in Dubai. However, he decided to pursue opportunities in cinema and moved to Chennai. He has mentioned in interviews that he was overweight at the time but managed to lose around 36 kilograms (79 lb) before entering the Tamil cinema industry.

 

In addition to his acting career, Arjun Das worked as a radio jockey for Radio One 94.3FM, hosting the Drive show. He has often attributed his initial fan base to his distinctive voice, which gained popularity during his time as a radio jockey.

 

Arjun's breakthrough came with "Kaithi," and he received high praise for his performance and voice. This led to his casting in "Master," where he delivered a memorable performance as Das, with his intense gaze and commanding voice standing out among the diverse cast.

 

Arjun Das's recent release is the supernatural thriller "Andhaghaaram," in which he plays the lead role of Vinod, an alcoholic and smoke addict coach plagued by guilt over his friend's mental condition.

item.title: Brahmanandam
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Brahmanandam

Regional Male Actor

Brahmanandam Kanneganti, popularly known as Brahmanandam, is an acclaimed Indian actor and comedian who primarily works in the Telugu film industry. Born on February 1, 1956, in Chaganti Vari Palem, Andhra Pradesh, he has appeared in over 1,000 films and holds a Guinness World Record for the most screen credits for a living actor. Brahmanandam's versatile comedic timing and unique style have earned him the title of "Comedy King" in Telugu cinema. He is renowned for his impeccable dialogue delivery, physical comedy, and remarkable ability to improvise on screen. His performances in films like "Aha Naa Pellanta," "Dookudu," and "Ready" have received widespread acclaim and have contributed to his immense popularity among audiences. Throughout his career, Brahmanandam has won numerous awards for his outstanding contributions to comedy in Indian cinema, including the prestigious Padma Shri, India's fourth-highest civilian award, in 2009. He has also received several Nandi Awards, Filmfare Awards South, and CineMAA Awards.

item.title: Bharat Jadhav
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Bharat Jadhav

Regional Male Actor

Bharat Jadhav is a renowned actor and producer in the Marathi film, theatre, and television industry. Known for his comic roles, he has established himself as one of the most successful actors in Marathi cinema.

 

Originally hailing from Kolhapur, Bharat's family relocated to Mumbai when he was young. He spent his childhood in the courtyard (Chal) of Rajaram Studios in Lalbaug Parel, which played a significant role in shaping his passion for acting.

 

Bharat gained prominence through his performances in Marathi stage plays. His collaboration with Ankush Chaudhari and Sanjay Narvekar in the play "All The Best" completed a remarkable 3000 shows. He also showcased his acting prowess in the hit play "Sahi re Sahi." In the film "Jatra," his performance in the song "Kombadi Palali" was highly appreciated by audiences.

 

In 2013, Bharat Jadhav launched his production company, Bharat Jadhav Entertainment Pvt Ltd. The launch event was graced by notable personalities like Raj Thackeray, Nikhil Wagle, Sachin Pilgaonkar, Mahesh Manjrekar, Siddarth Jadhav, Makarand Anaspure, and others.

 

Throughout his career, Bharat has acted in more than 85 movies and eight television serials. He has also been involved in over 8500 drama shows, showcasing his versatility as an actor. Bharat shares a close friendship with producer and director Kedar Shinde.

 

In the realm of stage plays, Bharat has appeared in numerous productions such as "All the Best," "Sahi Re Sahi," "Shrimanta Damodar Panta," "Amchya Sarkhe Amhich," "Dhant Dhan," and "Tu Tu Me Me."

 

His notable film credits include "Jatra," "Pachadalela," "Masta Chalalay Amacha," "Shreemant Damodar Panta," "Sat Na Gat," "One Room Kitchen," "Jabardast," "Kho-Kho," "Khabardar," "Shikshanachya Aaicha Gho," "Sade Made Teen," "No Entry - Pudhe Dhoka Aahe," "Agabai Arrecha 2," "Davpech," and many more. Bharat has also made guest appearances in films like "Me Shivaji Raje Boltoy," "Agabai Arrecha," and "Vaastav."

 

On the television front, Bharat has been part of popular serials like "Hasa Chakatfu" and "Saheb Biwi Ani Me." Additionally, he hosted the comedy show "Aali Lahar Kela Kahar" on Colors Marathi in 2016, showcasing his hosting skills.

In 2013, Bharat Jadhav launched his production company, Bharat Jadhav Entertainment Pvt Ltd. The launch event was graced by notable personalities like Raj Thackeray, Nikhil Wagle, Sachin Pilgaonkar, Mahesh Manjrekar, Siddarth Jadhav, Makarand Anaspure, and others.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Throughout his career, Bharat has acted in more than 85 movies and eight television serials. He has also been involved in over 8500 drama shows, showcasing his versatility as an actor. Bharat shares a close friendship with producer and director Kedar Shinde.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

In the realm of stage plays, Bharat has appeared in numerous productions such as \"All the Best,\" \"Sahi Re Sahi,\" \"Shrimanta Damodar Panta,\" \"Amchya Sarkhe Amhich,\" \"Dhant Dhan,\" and \"Tu Tu Me Me.\"<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

His notable film credits include \"Jatra,\" \"Pachadalela,\" \"Masta Chalalay Amacha,\" \"Shreemant Damodar Panta,\" \"Sat Na Gat,\" \"One Room Kitchen,\" \"Jabardast,\" \"Kho-Kho,\" \"Khabardar,\" \"Shikshanachya Aaicha Gho,\" \"Sade Made Teen,\" \"No Entry - Pudhe Dhoka Aahe,\" \"Agabai Arrecha 2,\" \"Davpech,\" and many more. Bharat has also made guest appearances in films like \"Me Shivaji Raje Boltoy,\" \"Agabai Arrecha,\" and \"Vaastav.\"<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

On the television front, Bharat has been part of popular serials like \"Hasa Chakatfu\" and \"Saheb Biwi Ani Me.\" Additionally, he hosted the comedy show \"Aali Lahar Kela Kahar\" on Colors Marathi in 2016, showcasing his hosting skills.<\/p>","typography_typography":"custom","typography_font_weight":"bold"},"elements":[],"widgetType":"text-editor"}],"isInner":false}],"isInner":false},{"id":"83b0b9f","elType":"section","settings":{"background_background":"classic","background_color":"#EAF0EE8F","hover_parallax":[{"layer_position_vr":{"unit":"%","size":30},"layer_position_hr":{"unit":"%","size":40},"_id":"ac4fb18"},{"layer_position_vr":{"unit":"%","size":60},"layer_position_hr":{"unit":"%","size":20},"_id":"a1b2b38"}]},"elements":[{"id":"954d1b9","elType":"column","settings":{"_column_size":100,"_inline_size":null},"elements":[{"id":"adad0f7","elType":"widget","settings":{"title":"Enquiry Form","header_size":"h3","align":"center","typography_typography":"custom","typography_font_size":{"unit":"px","size":40,"sizes":[]},"typography_font_weight":"bold","_margin":{"unit":"px","top":"40","right":"0","bottom":"20","left":"0","isLinked":false},"__globals__":{"title_color":"globals\/colors?id=6d3d44f9"}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"heading"},{"id":"3e1fbe0","elType":"widget","settings":{"shortcode":"[forminator_form id=\"5483\"]","_margin":{"unit":"px","top":"0","right":"0","bottom":"40","left":"0","isLinked":false}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"shortcode"}],"isInner":false}],"isInner":false}]

item.title: Bharat Ganeshpure
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Bharat Ganeshpure

Regional Male Actor

Bharat Ganeshpure is an Indian actor and comedian known for his comical performances in Marathi television shows. Born on August 15, 1969, he has gained popularity for his work in shows like "Fu Bai Fu" and "Chala Hawa Yeu Dya" (CHYD).

 

Bharat's breakthrough came with his performance in "Chala Hawa Yeu Dya," which catapulted him to fame. His portrayal of characters with the Vidarbha Marathi Accent, also known as Varhadi, became his specialty and endeared him to the audience. His impeccable comedic timing and unique style have made him a beloved figure on the show.

 

Apart from his television work, Bharat has also played supporting roles in various Marathi films. One notable film is "Chi Va Chi Sau Ka," in which he delivered a memorable performance. He has also made his mark in the Marathi comedy film "Jalsa," where he played a pivotal role, showcasing his versatility as an actor.

 

Bharat Ganeshpure's ability to bring humor to his characters and connect with the audience has made him a prominent figure in the Marathi entertainment industry. His comical performances and the Varhadi accent have become his trademarks, earning him a loyal fan base. With his talent and dedication, Bharat continues to entertain audiences with his humorous portrayals on both the small and big screens.

item.title: Chiranjeevi
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Chiranjeevi

Regional Male Actor

Chiranjeevi, born as Konidela Siva Sankara Vara Prasad, is a renowned Indian actor, politician, and film producer. He was born on August 22, 1955, in Mogalthur, West Godavari district, Andhra Pradesh, India. Chiranjeevi made his acting debut in 1978 with the film "Punadhirallu" and quickly rose to fame with his exceptional performances and captivating screen presence. He has acted in over 150 Telugu films, earning him the title "Megastar" in the film industry.

 

Chiranjeevi has received numerous accolades throughout his career, including ten Filmfare Awards South and four Nandi Awards. His notable films include "Khaidi," "Rudraveena," "Gang Leader," and "Indra." Chiranjeevi is celebrated for his versatility as an actor, seamlessly transitioning between action, comedy, and dramatic roles.

 

In addition to his successful acting career, Chiranjeevi ventured into politics and founded the Praja Rajyam Party in 2008. Later, he merged his party with the Indian National Congress and was elected as a member of the Rajya Sabha, the upper house of the Parliament of India. Chiranjeevi actively participated in political campaigns and played a crucial role in Andhra Pradesh's politics.

 

Chiranjeevi's contributions to the Indian film industry and his philanthropic endeavors have made him an iconic figure, admired by millions of fans worldwide. He continues to inspire and entertain audiences with his charisma and passion for acting.

item.title: Chiyaan Vikram (Kennedy John Victor)
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Chiyaan Vikram (Kennedy John Victor)

Regional Male Actor

Vikram is a prominent actor in the Telugu film industry, popularly known as Tollywood. With his exceptional acting skills and versatility, he has established himself as one of the most respected actors in the industry. Born on April 14th, 1966, Vikram, whose real name is Kennedy John Victor, has carved a niche for himself through his incredible performances.

 

Vikram made his acting debut in the early 1990s and initially faced several challenges. However, his perseverance and dedication to his craft paid off when he delivered a breakthrough performance in the movie "Sethu," which earned him critical acclaim and a Filmfare Award. Since then, he has delivered several memorable performances in films such as "I," "Anniyan," and "Kandasamy."

 

Known for his ability to seamlessly transform himself into diverse characters, Vikram has showcased his range by portraying a wide array of roles, from romantic leads to intense and complex characters. He has displayed his prowess in action sequences, emotional scenes, and has even taken on challenging physical transformations for certain roles.

 

Vikram's dedication to his craft and his willingness to push boundaries have earned him a loyal fan following and numerous accolades. He continues to captivate audiences with his exceptional performances, cementing his position as one of the finest actors in Tollywood. With his talent and passion, Vikram's contribution to the industry remains significant, and his legacy continues to inspire aspiring actors.

item.title: Duniya Vijay
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
DUNIYA VIJAY

Regional Male Actor

B. R. Vijay Kumar, known by his screen name Duniya Vijay or Duniya Viji, is a prominent Indian actor and film director renowned for his contributions to Kannada cinema. He embarked on his acting journey with minor roles before gaining recognition with his breakthrough role in the movie "Duniya" (2007). His noteworthy performances in films like "Chanda" (2007), "Junglee" (2009), "Johny Mera Naam Preethi Mera Kaam" (2011), and "Jayammana Maga" (2013) have further solidified his status in the industry.

 

Vijay initiated his cinematic journey with a role in Yograj Bhat's "Ranga SSLC," sharing the screen with Sudeep. He subsequently appeared in films like "Jogi," "Shree," and "Ee Rajeev Gandhi Alla," while also making appearances in television projects.

 

However, his career-changing moment came with the film "Duniya," directed by his friend Soori. In the movie, Vijay portrayed a naive village boy who becomes ensnared by underworld criminals. His exceptional performance garnered critical acclaim, leading to State and Filmfare awards for his portrayal.

 

Over the years, Vijay continued to showcase his acting prowess in a range of films, displaying versatility and depth in his roles. His commitment to his craft led to performances that were celebrated by audiences and critics alike.

 

In addition to acting, Vijay ventured into film direction. Notable among his directorial endeavors is his debut film "Salaga," released in 2021, which showcases his multi-faceted talents.

B. R. Vijay Kumar, known by his screen name Duniya Vijay or Duniya Viji, is a prominent Indian actor and film director renowned for his contributions to Kannada cinema. He embarked on his acting journey with minor roles before gaining recognition with his breakthrough role in the movie \"Duniya\" (2007). His noteworthy performances in films like \"Chanda\" (2007), \"Junglee\" (2009), \"Johny Mera Naam Preethi Mera Kaam\" (2011), and \"Jayammana Maga\" (2013) have further solidified his status in the industry.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Vijay initiated his cinematic journey with a role in Yograj Bhat's \"Ranga SSLC,\" sharing the screen with Sudeep. He subsequently appeared in films like \"Jogi,\" \"Shree,\" and \"Ee Rajeev Gandhi Alla,\" while also making appearances in television projects.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

However, his career-changing moment came with the film \"Duniya,\" directed by his friend Soori. In the movie, Vijay portrayed a naive village boy who becomes ensnared by underworld criminals. His exceptional performance garnered critical acclaim, leading to State and Filmfare awards for his portrayal.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Over the years, Vijay continued to showcase his acting prowess in a range of films, displaying versatility and depth in his roles. His commitment to his craft led to performances that were celebrated by audiences and critics alike.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

item.title: Dulquer Salmaan
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Dulquer Salmaan

Regional Male Actor

Dulquer Salmaan, born on July 28, 1986, is an Indian actor, playback singer, and film producer primarily working in the Malayalam film industry. He is the son of renowned actor Mammootty. Salmaan made his acting debut in 2012 with the film "Second Show," which garnered critical acclaim and marked the beginning of a successful career. Known for his versatile acting skills, he has since appeared in numerous commercially successful films.

 

Dulquer Salmaan has won several awards for his outstanding performances, including a Kerala State Film Award for Best Actor. He has showcased his talent in various genres, ranging from romantic comedies like "Bangalore Days" to intense dramas like "Charlie." Salmaan has also worked in other languages such as Tamil, Telugu, and Hindi, expanding his reach to a wider audience.

 

Aside from acting, Salmaan has lent his voice as a playback singer in a few of his films. He also ventured into film production with his company, Wayfarer Films, aiming to support fresh and innovative storytelling.

item.title: Dhanush
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Dhanush

Regional Male Actor

Dhanush, born as Venkatesh Prabhu Kasthuri Raja, is a renowned Indian actor, producer, and playback singer who has left an indelible mark on the world of cinema. Hailing from a family with a strong film background, Dhanush made his acting debut in the Tamil film industry with "Thulluvadho Ilamai" in 2002, instantly winning hearts with his natural talent and charm.

 

Dhanush's meteoric rise to stardom came with his exceptional performance in the critically acclaimed film "Aadukalam" in 2011, for which he received the prestigious National Film Award for Best Actor. His ability to portray diverse characters with utmost conviction has earned him widespread acclaim and numerous accolades.

 

Beyond acting, Dhanush has also showcased his versatility as a playback singer, delivering several chart-topping hits that resonate with audiences of all ages. His soulful voice and innate musicality have garnered him a dedicated fan following.

 

As a producer, Dhanush has helmed successful ventures under his banner, Wunderbar Films, supporting innovative storytelling and nurturing fresh talent.

 

Dhanush's infectious energy, unmatched talent, and dedication to his craft have established him as one of the most bankable stars in the Indian film industry. With each project, he continues to push boundaries, captivate audiences, and cement his position as a true icon of Indian cinema.

item.title: Darshan Thoogudeep
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Darshan Thoogudeep

Regional Male Actor

Darshan Thoogudeep, born on February 16, 1977, is a renowned actor in the Kannada film industry. Known for his charismatic presence and powerful performances, Darshan has carved a niche for himself in the hearts of millions of fans.

 

Hailing from a family with a strong background in the film industry, Darshan inherited the passion for acting from his father, Thoogudeepa Srinivas. He made his acting debut in 2001 with the film "Majestic," which became a massive hit and established him as a promising actor.

 

Over the years, Darshan has portrayed a wide range of characters, showcasing his versatility and acting prowess. He has been a part of numerous successful films such as "Kariya," "Sangolli Rayanna," and "Kurukshetra," which have not only achieved commercial success but also garnered critical acclaim.

 

Darshan's screen presence and ability to connect with the audience have earned him a massive fan following. His powerful dialogue delivery and action sequences have become iconic and are eagerly anticipated by his fans in every film.

Apart from his acting career, Darshan is also actively involved in philanthropic activities and has supported various charitable causes. His contributions to society have earned him immense respect and admiration.

item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Fish Venkat

Regional Male Actor

Fish Venkat is an Indian actor known for his work in the Telugu film industry. He was born in Hyderabad, Telangana, India. Venkat is primarily recognized for his comedic and negative roles in films.

One distinctive aspect of Venkat's acting is his use of the Telangana dialect, which bears resemblance to the language spoken by fishermen. This unique quality has earned him the moniker "Fish" Venkat. He has garnered popularity and acclaim for his ability to bring humor to his characters through his dialogue delivery and comedic timing.

Venkat has appeared in numerous Telugu films, where he has showcased his versatility as an actor by portraying both comedic and negative roles with equal ease. He has the ability to entertain audiences with his comedic performances, while also leaving a lasting impact in roles that require negative shades.

Although details about his early life and career beginnings are limited, Fish Venkat has made a notable presence in the Telugu film industry. With his distinct style and memorable performances, he continues to be a recognizable face in the industry and contributes to the diverse range of characters seen in Telugu cinema.

item.title: Gopichand
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Gopichand

Regional Male Actor

Gopichand, a renowned Tollywood actor, has carved a niche for himself in the Telugu film industry. Born on June 12, 1979, in Hyderabad, India, Gopichand's birth name is Tottempudi Gopichand. He hails from a film background, as his father, T. Krishna, was a prominent filmmaker. Gopichand made his acting debut with the Telugu film "Tholi Valapu" in 2001.

 

However, it was his role in the critically acclaimed movie "Lakshyam" (2007) that catapulted him to stardom. Known for his powerful screen presence and versatile performances, Gopichand has acted in numerous successful films, including "Yagnam" (2004), "Loukyam" (2014), and "Oxygen" (2017). His portrayal of action-packed and intense characters has garnered him a dedicated fan base.

 

Gopichand has also received accolades for his acting prowess, earning a Nandi Award for Best Actor for his role in "Yagnam." With his striking looks, impressive physique, and commendable acting skills, Gopichand continues to entertain audiences and remains a sought-after actor in the Telugu film industry.

item.title: Golden Star Ganesh
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Golden Star Ganesh

Regional Male Actor

Golden Star Ganesh, born as Ganesh Gowda, is a prominent actor in the Kannada film industry. With his charismatic presence and versatile acting skills, Ganesh has carved a niche for himself in the hearts of audiences. Known as the "Golden Star," he has consistently delivered entertaining and commercially successful movies throughout his career.

 

Ganesh's journey in the film industry began with small roles, but his dedication and talent propelled him to greater heights. He gained recognition for his exceptional comic timing and ability to bring life to diverse characters. His energetic performances and effortless charm make him a favorite among fans of all ages.

 

Apart from acting, Ganesh has also showcased his talent as a playback singer and dancer, adding another dimension to his multifaceted personality. His songs have become chartbusters, and his dance moves are often imitated by his admirers.

 

Beyond his on-screen success, Ganesh is known for his down-to-earth nature and philanthropic endeavors. He actively participates in charitable initiatives and uses his influence to support social causes.

item.content:encoded:
Gaurav Ghatnekar

Regional Male Actor

Gaurav Ghatnekar is an Indian actor known for his contributions to the Marathi film and television industry. After completing his graduation, Gaurav pursued his passion for acting by enrolling at the Whistling Woods International Film Institute, a renowned film school in Mumbai, India. During his time at the institute, he honed his acting skills and gained a deeper understanding of the craft.

Following his training, Gaurav had the opportunity to join the drama group of Naseeruddin Shah, a veteran actor in Indian cinema. Working alongside a seasoned performer like Naseeruddin Shah provided Gaurav with invaluable experience and exposure to the intricacies of the acting profession. This association further enriched his knowledge and skills as an actor.

In the Marathi film industry, Gaurav has showcased his talent through various projects. While specific details about his filmography may not be available, his work in Marathi films has garnered recognition and praise from audiences and critics alike. He has contributed to the growth and development of the Marathi cinema landscape with his performances and dedication to his craft.

In addition to his work in films, Gaurav has also made a mark in the Marathi television industry. His appearances on television shows have showcased his versatility as an actor and have helped him establish a strong presence in the medium.

item.title: Jagapathi Babu
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Jagapathi Babu

Regional Male Actor

Jagapathi Babu, born on February 12, 1962, is a prominent Indian film actor known for his versatile performances predominantly in the Telugu film industry. With a career spanning over three decades, Babu has established himself as one of the most talented and respected actors in the industry.

 

Jagapathi Babu made his acting debut in 1989 with the film "Simha Swapnam" and quickly gained recognition for his natural acting skills and charismatic screen presence. He has since appeared in numerous successful films, portraying a wide range of characters across various genres.

What sets Babu apart is his ability to seamlessly transition from hero roles to character roles, constantly challenging himself and delivering outstanding performances. His roles in films like "Peddarikam," "Anthapuram," and "Rangasthalam" have garnered critical acclaim and showcased his versatility as an actor.

 

Apart from his acting prowess, Babu is also known for his baritone voice, which has made him a sought-after voice artist for dubbing in Telugu cinema. He has lent his voice to several popular characters in both animated and live-action films.

\u00a0<\/p>

item.title: Jayam Ravi
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Jayam Ravi

Regional Male Actor

Jayam Ravi, born as Mohammed Ravi on September 10, 1980, is an Indian actor known for his work in Tamil cinema. He is the son of veteran film editor A. Mohan. Ravi started his career as a child artist in the film "Oru Thottil Sabadham" (1989), produced by his father. He has received several awards, including a Filmfare Award and three SIIMA Awards.

 

After the success of the film "Jayam," which prompted the title to become a prefix to his stage name, Ravi continued to collaborate with his brother, director Mohan Raja, for other films such as "M. Kumaran S/O Mahalakshmi" (2004), "Unakkum Enakkum" (2006), "Santhosh Subramaniam" (2008), and "Thani Oruvan" (2015).

 

Ravi was born in Tirumangalam, Madurai, and his father is a Tamil Rowther Muslim. His brother Mohan Raja is a film director, and his sister Roja is a dentist. Ravi completed his schooling at Jawahar Vidyalaya in Chennai and studied Visual Communication at Loyola College. He trained in acting at the Kishore Namit Kapur Institute in Mumbai and worked as an assistant director to Suresh Krishna for the film "Aalavandhan" (2001).

 

Ravi made his acting debut in the film "Jayam" (2003), a remake of the Telugu film of the same name. His performance received praise, and he gained popularity in the industry. He went on to star in films like "M. Kumaran Son Of Mahalakshmi" (2004), "Daas" (2005), "Unakkum Enakkum" (2006), and "Thani Oruvan" (2015). Many of these films were directed by his brother Mohan Raja.

 

Throughout his career, Ravi has acted in various genres, including action, comedy, romance, and thrillers. Some of his notable films include "Peranmai" (2009), "Engeyum Kaadhal" (2011), "Thani Oruvan" (2015), "Bogan" (2017), "Tik Tik Tik" (2018), and "Comali" (2019). He has also ventured into experimental genres with films like "Miruthan" (2016), the first Tamil zombie film, and "Vanamagan" (2017), an action-adventure film.

item.title: Jayasurya
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Jayasurya

Regional Male Actor

Jayasurya, born on August 31, 1978, is a multi-talented Indian actor who primarily works in Malayalam cinema. Apart from acting, he has also ventured into film distribution, sponsorship, modeling, film production, playback singing, and impressionism. With a career spanning over two decades, Jayasurya has appeared in more than 100 films and has received numerous awards and accolades for his performances.

 

He started his career as a mimicry artist and later hosted television shows on Malayalam channels. Jayasurya made his acting debut with a small role in the film "Pathram" in 1999. However, his breakthrough came in 2002 when he portrayed a mute character in the film "Oomappenninu Uriyadappayyan."

 

During the 2000s, Jayasurya gained popularity for his comedic roles in films like "Swapnakkoodu" (2003), "Pulival Kalyanam" (2003), "Chathikkatha Chanthu" (2004), "Chocolate" (2007), and "Gulumaal" (2009). He also showcased his versatility by playing villainous roles in movies like "Classmates" (2006), "Arabikkatha" (2007), and "Kangaroo" (2007).

 

In the 2010s, Jayasurya received critical acclaim for his performances in films such as "Cocktail" (2010), "Janapriyan" (2011), "Beautiful" (2011), "Trivandrum Lodge" (2012), "Apothecary" (2014), "Iyobinte Pusthakam" (2014), "Lukka Chuppi" (2015), "Su.. Su... Sudhi Vathmeekam" (2015), and "Captain" (2018). He also gained popularity for his comedic roles in movies like "Punyalan Agarbattis" (2013), "Amar Akbar Anthony" (2015), "Aadu" (2015), and its sequel "Aadu 2" (2017). Jayasurya made his debut as a film producer with "Punyalan Agarbattis."

 

His notable achievements include winning the Best Supporting Actor Award at the 62nd Filmfare Awards South for his performance in "Apothecary." In 2016, he received the Special Jury Award at the 46th Kerala State Film Awards and the Special Mention at the 63rd National Film Awards for his roles in "Su.. Su... Sudhi Vathmeekam" and "Lukka Chuppi." Jayasurya won the Kerala State Film Award for Best Actor for his performances in "Captain" and "Njan Marykutty" in 2018, and for "Vellam" in 2020.

item.title: Jimit Trivedi
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Jimit Trivedi

Regional Male Actor

Jimit Trivedi is an Indian actor known for his versatile performances in Gujarati and Hindi cinema. He has showcased his acting prowess in both comedic and dramatic roles, earning him critical acclaim and a dedicated fan following.

 

Born on January 1, 1976, in Gujarat, Jimit Trivedi started his acting career in Gujarati theater. He honed his skills and gained recognition for his outstanding performances on stage. His ability to effortlessly portray diverse characters with depth and conviction set him apart from his peers.

 

Jimit made his foray into Hindi cinema with the critically acclaimed film "Bhool Bhulaiyaa" in 2007. He delivered a memorable performance as Ganesh, earning praise for his comic timing and natural flair. He went on to appear in notable Bollywood films like "Dhamaal" and "Ajab Prem Ki Ghazab Kahani," leaving a lasting impression with his unique style of acting.

 

However, it is in Gujarati cinema where Jimit Trivedi has truly made a mark. He has been part of several successful Gujarati films, including "Gujjubhai the Great" and "Shu Thayu?," where he showcased his ability to effortlessly transition between comedy and emotional scenes. His performances have been lauded for their authenticity and the relatable charm he brings to his characters.

 

Jimit Trivedi's versatility extends beyond the big screen. He has also made notable appearances on television, entertaining audiences with his comedic timing and impeccable acting skills.

item.title: Jitendra Joshi
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Jitendra Joshi

Regional Male Actor

Jitendra Joshi is an acclaimed Indian actor and reality show host, primarily known for his work in Marathi cinema. He gained significant recognition for his portrayal of Sant Tukaram Maharaj in the Marathi film Tukaram released in 2012. Another notable role of his was as constable Katekar in the popular Netflix television series Sacred Games.

 

Joshi's career has been diverse, showcasing his talents in various facets of the entertainment industry. In addition to acting, he has also ventured into writing. He penned the widely popular song "Kombdi Palali," which was later remixed as "Chikni Chameli." He garnered early recognition for his role as Krishna in the Zee Marathi daily soap Ghadlay Bighadlay.

 

As a host, Joshi helmed Marathi Paaul Padte Pudhe, a talent reality show on Zee Marathi in 2011. His versatility as an actor is evident in the range of characters he has portrayed. He played the titular role of Sant Tukaram in the film Tukaram and showcased his comic skills in Guldasta. Notably, he also essayed the role of the villainous character Sai in the film Duniyadari.

 

Joshi's talent and ability to captivate audiences continued to shine in the critically acclaimed dramedy Ventilator (2016), produced by Priyanka Chopra. His performance in the film garnered widespread praise. In 2018, he further solidified his acting prowess by starring in the Netflix Original Series Sacred Games alongside Saif Ali Khan, portraying the role of constable Katekar.

 

Joshi's exceptional acting skills were recognized at the 52nd International Film Festival of India in 2021, where he won the Best Actor Award for his role as Nishikant Deshmukh in Nikhil Mahajan's Marathi film Godavari.

Moreover, Joshi's talent and versatility were showcased once again in Netflix's series Thar, where he delivered an impressive performance as a cunning villager.

item.title: Jr. NTR
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Jr. NTR

Regional Male Actor

Jr. NTR, also known as Nandamuri Taraka Rama Rao Jr., is a prominent Indian film actor and television personality. Born on May 20, 1983, in Hyderabad, Telangana, he hails from the prestigious Nandamuri family, renowned for its contributions to the Telugu film industry. Jr. NTR made his acting debut in 2001 with the film "Ninnu Choodalani." He gained immense popularity and acclaim for his versatile performances and charismatic screen presence.

 

Throughout his career, Jr. NTR has starred in numerous blockbuster films, showcasing his acting prowess and dance skills. Some of his notable movies include "Simhadri," "Yamadonga," "Janatha Garage," and "Aravinda Sametha Veera Raghava." His portrayal of challenging and diverse roles has earned him several awards and accolades.

 

Apart from acting, Jr. NTR is also a skilled dancer and has mesmerized audiences with his energetic and graceful moves. He has been a part of several successful stage shows and performances.

 

Jr. NTR is actively involved in philanthropic activities and has supported various social causes. He is known for his humble and down-to-earth personality, which has garnered him a massive fan following. His fans fondly refer to him as "Young Tiger" and admire his dedication to his craft.

item.title: Kabir Duhan Singh
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Kabir Duhan Singh

Regional Male Actor

Kabir Duhan Singh is an Indian actor known for his work in Telugu, Kannada, and Tamil films. He was born on 8 September 1986 in Gohana, Haryana. Kabir started his career as a model and participated in various fashion shows and international assignments. He moved to Mumbai in 2011 to pursue acting.

 

Initially, Kabir was set to make his acting debut in a Hindi film starring Shiney Ahuja, but the project was shelved. He then turned to stage acting and eventually landed a role in the Telugu film "Jil" (2015). The makers of the film were looking for a North Indian antagonist, and Kabir's performance garnered positive reviews. He continued to receive acclaim for his roles in films like "Kick 2" (2015) and the Tamil film "Vedalam" (2015), where he played the villain opposite Ajith Kumar.

 

Kabir became one of the busiest antagonists in Southern cinema, working on multiple Telugu films simultaneously, including "Dictator" and "Sardaar Gabbar Singh." He is known for carefully analyzing his characters and choosing roles that showcase his acting skills.

 

The provided information summarizes Kabir Duhan Singh's personal and professional life, highlighting his journey from a model to an actor and his successful career in Telugu, Kannada, and Tamil films.

item.title: Karthik Sivakumar
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Karthik Sivakumar

Regional Male Actor

Karthik Sivakumar, known by his stage name Karthi, is an Indian actor who primarily works in Tamil cinema. He was born on May 25, 1977, in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. Karthi is the younger brother of popular actor Suriya and the son of actor Sivakumar.

 

Before venturing into acting, Karthi initially worked as an assistant director under renowned filmmaker Mani Ratnam. He made his acting debut with the film "Paruthiveeran" in 2007, which garnered him critical acclaim and several awards, including the Filmfare Award for Best Actor.

 

Some of Karthi's notable films include "Aayirathil Oruvan" (2010), "Paiyaa" (2010), "Naan Mahaan Alla" (2010), "Siruthai" (2011), "Biriyani" (2013), "Madras" (2014), "Thozha" (2016), "Theeran Adhigaaram Ondru" (2017), "Kadaikutty Singam" (2018), "Kaithi" (2019), "Sulthan" (2021), "Viruman" (2022), "Ponniyin Selvan: I" (2022), "Sardar" (2022), and "Ponniyin Selvan: II" (2023). These films have established him as a commercially successful leading actor in the Tamil film industry.

 

In addition to his film career, Karthi is actively involved in social welfare activities. He has encouraged his fans to participate in social causes through the "Makkal Nala Mandram," a social welfare club that he inaugurated. He has also served as the treasurer of the Nadigar Sangam, an association of actors in the Tamil film industry.

Karthi completed his education at Padma Seshadri Bala Bhavan and St. Bede's Anglo Indian Higher Secondary School in Chennai. He holds a bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering from Crescent Engineering College, Chennai, and a Master of Science in industrial engineering from Binghamton University in New York. While pursuing his master's degree, he also took elective courses on filmmaking.

Karthi's acting career has seen both successes and setbacks. He had a successful phase with films like "Paruthiveeran," "Aayirathil Oruvan," and "Paiyaa," but he also faced a career slump with films like "Saguni" and "All in All Azhagu Raja." However, he made a comeback with films like "Madras," "Theeran Adhigaaram Ondru," "Kaithi," and "Sulthan," which were critically acclaimed and commercially successful.

item.title: Ketan Karande
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Ketan Karande

Regional Male Actor

Ketan Karande, born on April 7, 1978, is an accomplished Indian actor known for his impactful roles on both television and in films. He rose to prominence by portraying significant characters in renowned productions.

Notably, he gained recognition for his portrayal of Bhima in Sony TV's TV series "Suryaputra Karn," where his performance captivated audiences. He further showcased his versatility by taking on the role of Ghatotkacha in the 2013 TV series "Mahabharat," adding depth to the epic tale.

Ketan's talent extended beyond the small screen as he made his mark in the film industry. He shared screen space with iconic actors such as Amitabh Bachchan and Aamir Khan in the film "Thugs Of Hindostan," where he played a noteworthy role that contributed to the movie's impact. Additionally, he showcased his acting prowess alongside Ajay Devgn in the film "Action Jackson," leaving a lasting impression with his important character.

Ketan Karande's ability to seamlessly transition between television and film roles, coupled with his dedication to his craft, has solidified his position as a respected and versatile actor. His contribution to both realms of the entertainment industry continues to earn him recognition and appreciation from audiences and peers alike

item.title: Kiccha Sudeep
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Kiccha Sudeep

Regional Male Actor

Kiccha Sudeep, born as Sudeep Sanjeev, is an Indian actor, filmmaker, and television presenter who has made a significant impact on the Kannada film industry. Known for his charismatic personality and versatile acting skills, Sudeep has garnered a massive fan following across South India.

 

With a career spanning over two decades, Sudeep has acted in numerous blockbuster films, portraying a wide range of characters with ease. His notable performances in movies like "Huchcha," "My Autograph," and "Eega" have earned him critical acclaim and established him as a force to be reckoned with in the industry.

 

Apart from acting, Sudeep has also directed and produced several successful films, showcasing his prowess behind the camera. His directorial venture, "My Autograph," was well-received by both audiences and critics alike.

 

Sudeep's talent extends beyond the silver screen. He has also hosted popular reality shows like "Bigg Boss Kannada," where his wit and charm have captivated viewers. His ability to connect with people and entertain them has made him a beloved figure in the television industry as well.

 

Beyond his professional achievements, Sudeep is known for his philanthropic endeavors. He actively participates in charitable activities and has contributed to various social causes.

item.title: Lalit Prabhakar
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Lalit Prabhakar

Regional Male Actor

Lalit Prabhakar is an exceptional actor who has made a significant impact in the Indian entertainment industry. With his remarkable talent, charming personality, and dedication to his craft, he has won the hearts of audiences across the nation. Lalit's journey in the acting realm began in Marathi theater, where he honed his skills and showcased his versatility on stage. 

 

His breakthrough came with his portrayal of Aditya in the critically acclaimed Marathi television series "Julun Yeti Reshimgathi." Lalit's nuanced performance as a young, ambitious professional struck a chord with viewers and catapulted him to fame. Since then, he has continued to impress audiences with his stellar performances in both television and films.

 

Lalit's ability to effortlessly embody diverse characters and breathe life into them is truly commendable. Whether it's portraying complex emotional journeys or delivering impactful dialogues, he exhibits immense depth and authenticity in his acting. His natural charisma and relatable persona have endeared him to a wide range of viewers, making him a sought-after talent in the industry.

 

With his talent, versatility, and unwavering commitment to his craft, Lalit Prabhakar is undoubtedly an actor to watch out for, and his future endeavors are eagerly anticipated by fans and critics alike.

Regional Male Actor

Mahesh Babu, born on August 9, 1975, is a renowned Indian actor, producer, and philanthropist. He predominantly works in the Telugu film industry and has established himself as one of the leading actors in South Indian cinema. Mahesh Babu is the son of veteran actor Krishna Ghattamaneni and began his acting career as a child artist in the film "Needa" at the age of four. He made his debut as a lead actor in the film "Raja Kumarudu" in 1999, which earned him the Nandi Award for Best Male Debut.

 

Over the years, Mahesh Babu has delivered numerous critically acclaimed and commercially successful films, including "Pokiri," "Dookudu," "Businessman," and "Bharat Ane Nenu." He is known for his versatile acting skills, charming personality, and ability to portray a wide range of characters with ease. His performances have garnered him several prestigious awards, including seven Nandi Awards and four Filmfare Awards.

 

Apart from his acting career, Mahesh Babu is actively involved in humanitarian work. He is associated with various social causes and has been appointed as the brand ambassador for several government welfare campaigns in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana. He is also the founder of the non-profit organization Heal-a-Child, which provides medical support to underprivileged children.

item.content:encoded:
Mammootty

Regional Male Actor

Mammootty, whose real name is Muhammad Kutty Panaparambil Ismail, is a renowned Indian actor known for his remarkable contributions to the Malayalam film industry. Born on September 7, 1951, in Kerala, Mammootty has established himself as a versatile actor with a career spanning over four decades.

 

With an impressive filmography of over 400 movies, Mammootty has portrayed a wide range of characters, showcasing his exceptional acting skills and versatility. His performances have earned him numerous accolades, including three National Film Awards and several state awards.

 

Mammootty's magnetic screen presence and ability to immerse himself into the skin of his characters have made him a favorite among audiences. He effortlessly transitions between intense dramas, romantic roles, and action-packed thrillers, leaving a lasting impact on viewers. His nuanced performances and impeccable dialogue delivery have become his signature traits.

 

Beyond his acting prowess, Mammootty is also a philanthropist and a social activist. He has actively supported various charitable initiatives and has been involved in campaigns promoting education, healthcare, and environmental conservation.

item.title: Manchu Vishnu
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Manchu Vishnu

Regional Male Actor

Manchu Vishnu is a prominent actor in the Telugu film industry, commonly known as Tollywood. Born on November 23, 1981, in Chennai, India, Vishnu is the eldest son of renowned actor Mohan Babu. He belongs to the prestigious Manchu family, known for their contributions to the Indian cinema.

 

With his charming looks and impressive acting skills, Manchu Vishnu has carved a niche for himself in Tollywood. He made his acting debut with the film "Vishnu" in 2003, which garnered him critical acclaim. Since then, he has appeared in numerous successful movies such as "Dhee," "Denikaina Ready," and "Eedo Rakam Aado Rakam," showcasing his versatility as an actor.

 

Apart from acting, Vishnu is also actively involved in film production. He established his own production banner, 24 Frames Factory, through which he has produced several successful films. This demonstrates his entrepreneurial spirit and passion for the film industry.

 

Vishnu is known for his philanthropic endeavors as well. He actively participates in charitable activities and is associated with various social causes. He believes in giving back to society and making a positive impact on people's lives.

item.title: Meka Srikanth
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Meka Srikanth

Regional Male Actor

Meka Srikanth, widely known as Srikanth, is an acclaimed Indian film actor who has made a significant mark in the Telugu film industry. Born on March 23, 1968, in Gangavathi, Karnataka, Srikanth ventured into acting with the movie "People's Encounter" in 1990. Since then, he has delivered remarkable performances in numerous films, establishing himself as a versatile actor.

 

Srikanth's on-screen presence, intense expressions, and impeccable dialogue delivery have garnered him a loyal fan base. He has portrayed a wide range of characters, effortlessly transitioning from romantic roles to action-packed performances. His notable films include "Pelli Sandadi," "Maa Nannaki Pelli," "Operation Duryodhana," and "Shankar Dada M.B.B.S."

 

Throughout his career, Srikanth has received several accolades, including the prestigious Nandi Award for Best Actor for his outstanding performance in the film "Mahatma." His dedication to his craft and commitment to portraying diverse roles have earned him critical acclaim and commercial success.

 

Beyond acting, Srikanth has also ventured into producing films under his banner, namely "Jagapathi Cinema" and "Sri Raja Rajeshwari Art Creations." He continues to be a prominent figure in the Telugu film industry, captivating audiences with his talent and versatility.

Mohan Babu

Regional Male Actor

Mohan Babu is a prominent figure in the Indian film industry, specifically known for his contributions to Telugu cinema. Born on March 19, 1952, in Modhugulapalem, Andhra Pradesh, he has established himself as a versatile actor, producer, and politician. With a career spanning over four decades, Mohan Babu has left an indelible mark on the industry.

 

He made his acting debut in 1975 with the film "Swargam Narakam" and has since appeared in over 500 films, portraying diverse characters across genres. His powerful screen presence and impeccable dialogue delivery have earned him a loyal fan base. Mohan Babu is renowned for his ability to effortlessly switch between comedic and dramatic roles, showcasing his versatility as an actor.

 

Apart from his acting career, Mohan Babu has also ventured into film production, founding the production company named "Sree Lakshmi Prasanna Pictures." He has produced several successful films under this banner, including critically acclaimed projects.

 

Furthermore, Mohan Babu entered politics and served as a Member of Parliament from the Rajya Sabha, representing Andhra Pradesh. His philanthropic endeavors include the establishment of the educational institution "Sree Vidyanikethan Educational Trust" and various charitable activities.

item.title: Naga Chaitanya
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Naga Chaitanya

Regional Male Actor

Naga Chaitanya is a prominent actor in the Telugu film industry, also known as Tollywood. He was born on November 23, 1986, in Hyderabad, India, into a family deeply rooted in the film industry. Naga Chaitanya is the son of famous actors Akkineni Nagarjuna and Lakshmi Ramanaidu Daggubati. He made his acting debut in 2009 with the film "Josh," which received positive reviews.

 

However, it was his role in the 2010 film "Ye Maaya Chesave" that brought him widespread recognition and critical acclaim. Naga Chaitanya has since acted in a variety of genres, including romantic dramas, action films, and family entertainers. Some of his notable films include "Manam," "Premam," "Majili," and "Love Story." He has received several awards and nominations for his performances.

 

Naga Chaitanya is known for his charming on-screen presence and versatile acting skills. Apart from acting, he is also actively involved in various charitable activities. With his talent and dedication, Naga Chaitanya has established himself as one of the leading actors in the Telugu film industry.

item.title: Nagarjuna
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Nagarjuna

Regional Male Actor

Nagarjuna is a prominent figure in the Telugu film industry, commonly known as Tollywood. Born on August 29, 1959, in Chennai, India, Nagarjuna Akkineni is the son of legendary actor Akkineni Nageswara Rao. He made his acting debut in 1986 with the film "Vikram." Since then, he has acted in over 100 films and has garnered a massive fan following.

 

Nagarjuna is known for his versatility and has portrayed a wide range of characters, from romantic leads to action-packed roles. Some of his notable films include "Geethanjali," "Shiva," "Criminal," "Manmadhudu," and "Annammayya." He has received numerous awards for his outstanding performances, including multiple Nandi Awards and Filmfare Awards.

 

Apart from his acting career, Nagarjuna is also a successful film producer and entrepreneur. He established his production company, Annapurna Studios, and has produced several successful films. Additionally, he is actively involved in philanthropic work, supporting various causes through his charitable foundation.

item.title: Nagashaurya
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Naga Shaurya

Regional Male Actor

Naga Shaurya is a talented and versatile actor in the Telugu film industry. Born on January 22, 1989, in Eluru, Andhra Pradesh, India, Nagashaurya entered the film industry with his debut film "Chandamama Kathalu" in 2014. Since then, he has gained recognition for his impressive acting skills and charming screen presence.

 

With his boy-next-door looks and natural acting abilities, Nagashaurya has won the hearts of the audience. He has portrayed a wide range of characters, from romantic leads to intense roles, showcasing his versatility as an actor. His performances in films like "Oohalu Gusagusalade," "Kalyana Vaibhogame," and "Aswathama" have been highly appreciated by both critics and viewers.

 

Apart from acting, Nagashaurya has also ventured into film production with his own banner, IRA Creations. He has shown his dedication to delivering quality content to the audience through his production ventures.

 

Nagashaurya's talent and hard work have earned him a dedicated fan base and several accolades in the Telugu film industry. With each project, he continues to prove his mettle as an actor, leaving audiences eagerly awaiting his future ventures.

item.title: Nandamuri Balakrishna
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Nandamuri Balakrishna

Regional Male Actor

Nandamuri Balakrishna is an acclaimed Indian actor, politician, and film producer known for his work primarily in the Telugu cinema industry. Born on June 10, 1960, in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, he is the son of the legendary actor and politician Nandamuri Taraka Rama Rao. Balakrishna made his acting debut at the age of 14 in the film "Tatamma Kala" (1974). Since then, he has appeared in over 100 films, earning him a dedicated fan following.

 

Balakrishna is recognized for his powerful performances and versatile roles in movies such as "Mangamma Gari Manavadu" (1984), "Aditya 369" (1991), and "Legend" (2014). He has received numerous awards and accolades for his contribution to the industry, including Nandi Awards and Filmfare Awards South.

 

Apart from his successful film career, Balakrishna has also ventured into politics. He is a prominent member of the Telugu Desam Party (TDP) and was elected as a Member of Legislative Assembly (MLA) from the Hindupur constituency in Andhra Pradesh.

 

As a film producer, Balakrishna has established his own production company called "Brahmashri Art Productions." He continues to be a significant figure in the Telugu film industry and enjoys a loyal fan base for his charismatic screen presence and dedication to his craft.

item.title: Nandamuri Kalyan Ram
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Nandamuri Kalyan Ram

Regional Male Actor

Nandamuri Kalyan Ram is an Indian actor and film producer who primarily works in the Telugu film industry. Born on July 5, 1978, in Hyderabad, India, he hails from the prestigious Nandamuri family, which has a significant presence in the Telugu film industry. Kalyan Ram is the son of actor and politician Nandamuri Harikrishna and the grandson of the legendary actor and politician Nandamuri Taraka Rama Rao.

 

Kalyan Ram made his acting debut in 2003 with the film "Toli Choopulone." However, he gained recognition and critical acclaim for his role in the film "Athanokkade" (2005), which established him as a promising actor in the industry. He has since appeared in numerous successful films, showcasing his versatility as an actor.

 

Apart from acting, Kalyan Ram is also a proficient film producer. He founded the production company named N.T.R. Arts, which has produced several successful films under his supervision. He has always shown a keen interest in exploring diverse genres and experimenting with different roles, earning him a dedicated fan following.

 

Kalyan Ram's dedication to his craft and his ability to balance acting and production responsibilities have made him one of the prominent figures in the Telugu film industry. With his talent and lineage, he continues to leave a lasting impact on the world of cinema

item.title: Nani
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Nani

Regional Male Actor

Nani, a popular Tollywood actor, is known for his versatility and natural acting skills. Born on February 24, 1984, as Naveen Babu Ghanta, he hails from Andhra Pradesh, India. Nani made his acting debut in 2008 with the film "Ashta Chamma," which earned him critical acclaim. He gained widespread recognition for his portrayal of the lead character in the 2011 film "Ala Modalaindi," which became a commercial success. Nani has since starred in numerous hit films, showcasing his ability to effortlessly switch between different genres, including romantic dramas, comedies, and thrillers.

 

His notable films include "Eega" (2012), directed by S.S. Rajamouli, which won critical acclaim and several awards. Nani's performance as a reincarnated housefly in the film was widely appreciated. He has also collaborated with renowned directors such as Krishna Vamsi, Hanu Raghavapudi, and Trinadha Rao Nakkina, among others. Nani has received several accolades for his work, including the Filmfare Awards South and Nandi Awards.

 

Besides his acting career, Nani has ventured into film production with his production company, Wall Poster Cinema. He is known for his philanthropic activities and has actively supported various social causes. Nani's charm, talent, and dedication to his craft have established him as one of the leading actors in the Telugu film industry.

item.title: Naveen Polishetty
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Naveen Polishetty

Regional Male Actor

Naveen Polishetty is an exceptionally talented Indian actor, comedian, and writer who has made a significant impact on the entertainment industry. With his infectious energy, impeccable comic timing, and versatility, Naveen has carved a niche for himself in the hearts of audiences.

 

Born and raised in Hyderabad, Naveen initially pursued a career in engineering but soon realized his true passion lay in acting. He burst onto the scene with his breakout performance in the critically acclaimed web series "AIB: Honest Engineering Campus Placements." Since then, there has been no looking back for him.

 

Naveen's ability to effortlessly transition between comedy and drama has garnered widespread praise. He has showcased his acting prowess in films like "Agent Sai Srinivasa Athreya" and "Jathi Ratnalu," where his performances were hailed as refreshing and brilliant.

 

Beyond acting, Naveen has a unique knack for storytelling. He co-wrote and acted in the 2020 hit film "Chhichhore," which touched hearts with its poignant message about the importance of embracing failure. His writing skills coupled with his knack for delivering memorable performances make him a force to be reckoned with in the industry.

 

With his charismatic screen presence and incredible talent, Naveen Polishetty continues to captivate audiences and leave a lasting impression. His dedication, passion, and ability to bring characters to life make him one of the most promising actors of his generation.

item.title: Nikhil Gowda
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Nikhil Gowda

Regional Male Actor

Nikhil Kumaraswamy is an Indian actor and politician renowned for his contributions to Kannada cinema. He marked his acting debut with the bilingual film "Jaguar" (2016), which was released in both Kannada and Telugu.

 

Nikhil Kumaraswamy comes from a notable political lineage. He is the son of former Karnataka Chief Minister H. D. Kumaraswamy and the grandson of former Indian Prime Minister H. D. Deve Gowda.

 

In his personal life, Nikhil got engaged to Revathi, the grand-niece of Congress leader and realtor M. Krishnappa, on February 10, 2020, at the Taj West End Bangalore. Their wedding took place on April 17, 2020, near Janapada Loka in Ramanagara, and the couple is now blessed with a son.

 

Nikhil ventured into politics by contesting in the 2019 Indian general election from the Mandya Lok Sabha constituency as a candidate of the Janata Dal (Secular) party. Despite the historical stronghold of the Congress-JDS alliance in Mandya, he faced defeat by a margin of 128,876 votes against Sumalatha, the wife of late Kannada veteran Ambareesh.

 

Continuing his political journey, Nikhil participated in the 2023 Karnataka Legislative Assembly election from Ramanagara, a constituency previously represented by his father, mother Anitha, and grandfather H. D. Devegowda. However, he conceded defeat to Iqbal Hussain from the Congress party by a margin of 11,000 votes.
