Nikhil Kumaraswamy is an Indian actor and politician renowned for his contributions to Kannada cinema. He marked his acting debut with the bilingual film \"Jaguar\" (2016), which was released in both Kannada and Telugu.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Nikhil Kumaraswamy comes from a notable political lineage. He is the son of former Karnataka Chief Minister H. D. Kumaraswamy and the grandson of former Indian Prime Minister H. D. Deve Gowda.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

In his personal life, Nikhil got engaged to Revathi, the grand-niece of Congress leader and realtor M. Krishnappa, on February 10, 2020, at the Taj West End Bangalore. Their wedding took place on April 17, 2020, near Janapada Loka in Ramanagara, and the couple is now blessed with a son.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Nikhil ventured into politics by contesting in the 2019 Indian general election from the Mandya Lok Sabha constituency as a candidate of the Janata Dal (Secular) party. Despite the historical stronghold of the Congress-JDS alliance in Mandya, he faced defeat by a margin of 128,876 votes against Sumalatha, the wife of late Kannada veteran Ambareesh.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Continuing his political journey, Nikhil participated in the 2023 Karnataka Legislative Assembly election from Ramanagara, a constituency previously represented by his father, mother Anitha, and grandfather H. D. Devegowda. However, he conceded defeat to Iqbal Hussain from the Congress party by a margin of 11,000 votes.<\/p>","typography_typography":"custom","typography_font_weight":"bold"},"elements":[],"widgetType":"text-editor"}],"isInner":false}],"isInner":false},{"id":"be13db5","elType":"section","settings":{"background_background":"classic","background_color":"#EAF0EE8F","hover_parallax":[{"layer_position_vr":{"unit":"%","size":30},"layer_position_hr":{"unit":"%","size":40},"_id":"ac4fb18"},{"layer_position_vr":{"unit":"%","size":60},"layer_position_hr":{"unit":"%","size":20},"_id":"a1b2b38"}]},"elements":[{"id":"f52888d","elType":"column","settings":{"_column_size":100,"_inline_size":null},"elements":[{"id":"78b3ee6","elType":"widget","settings":{"title":"Enquiry Form","header_size":"h3","align":"center","typography_typography":"custom","typography_font_size":{"unit":"px","size":40,"sizes":[]},"typography_font_weight":"bold","_margin":{"unit":"px","top":"40","right":"0","bottom":"20","left":"0","isLinked":false},"__globals__":{"title_color":"globals\/colors?id=6d3d44f9"}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"heading"},{"id":"a2a4d65","elType":"widget","settings":{"shortcode":"[forminator_form id=\"5483\"]","_margin":{"unit":"px","top":"0","right":"0","bottom":"40","left":"0","isLinked":false}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"shortcode"}],"isInner":false}],"isInner":false}]

item.title: Nikhil Siddharth
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Nikhil Siddharth

Regional Male Actor

Nikhil Siddharth, a talented Indian actor, has carved a niche for himself in the Telugu film industry. Born on June 1, 1985, in Hyderabad, Nikhil ventured into acting with a passion for storytelling and an innate flair for performing. He gained recognition for his versatile roles and impressive screen presence.

 

Nikhil made his acting debut in 2003 with the movie "Sambaram" and went on to portray diverse characters in films like "Happy Days," "Yuvatha," and "Swamy Ra Ra," which garnered critical acclaim and box office success. Known for his youthful charm and ability to connect with the audience, Nikhil has constantly evolved as an actor and taken on challenging roles, experimenting with various genres.

 

His notable performances in movies like "Karthikeya," "Ekkadiki Pothavu Chinnavada," and "Arjun Suravaram" have further established his reputation as a skilled actor. Nikhil's dedication and hard work reflect in his portrayals, bringing depth and authenticity to his characters.

 

Beyond acting, Nikhil is also known for his philanthropic efforts. He actively supports social causes and has been involved in initiatives to uplift underprivileged sections of society.

 

With his talent, charisma, and philanthropic endeavors, Nikhil Siddharth continues to captivate audiences and make a positive impact in the world of cinema. His journey is a testament to his passion and commitment to his craft.

item.title: Nilesh Sable
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Nilesh Sable

Regional Male Actor

Nilesh Sable is a well-known Marathi television show host and film actor hailing from Maharashtra, India. He is widely recognized as the host of the popular Marathi TV show "Chala Hawa Yeu Dya."

 

In terms of his education, Nilesh completed his secondary school education at Mahatma Gandhi Vidyalaya in Dahiwadi, followed by his junior college education at Mahatma Gandhi Vidyalaya Junior College in Dahiwadi as well. He holds a Masters of Science degree in Ayurvedic medicine, showcasing his academic pursuits in the field.

 

Nilesh Sable's personal life revolves around his marriage to his childhood friend, Gauri Sable, in the year 2013. As of now, the couple does not have any children.

 

Nilesh's journey in the entertainment industry began after he emerged as the winner of the Zee Marathi reality series, "Maharashtracha Superstar," in 2010. This success paved the way for him to appear in other popular series such as "Home Minister" and "Fu Bai Fu." He made his debut in Marathi cinema with the film "Navra Majha Bhavra."

 

However, it is his role as the host of the comedy show "Chala Hawa Yeu Dya" on Zee Marathi that has truly solidified his position in the industry. The show has garnered immense popularity, and Nilesh's hosting skills have been widely appreciated by the audience.

item.title: Nithiin

item.content:encoded:
Nithiin

Regional Male Actor

Nithiin is an Indian actor who primarily works in the Telugu film industry. He was born on March 30, 1983, in Nizamabad, Telangana, India. Nithiin's full name is Nithiin Kumar Reddy. He made his acting debut in 2002 with the film "Jayam," which became a huge success and established him as a promising actor. Nithiin has acted in several commercially successful films throughout his career, including "Sye," "Dil," "A Aa," and "Bheeshma." He is known for his energetic and youthful performances.

 

Apart from acting, Nithiin is also involved in film production. He started his own production company called "Sresht Movies" and produced the film "Akhil" in 2015. Nithiin has received several awards and nominations for his performances, including the Filmfare Awards and the Nandi Awards.

 

Nithiin is highly popular among his fans and has a strong presence on social media. He has a large following on platforms like Instagram and Twitter. In addition to his acting career, Nithiin is also actively involved in philanthropic activities and has supported various charitable causes. He continues to entertain his audience with his versatile acting skills and remains a prominent figure in the Telugu film industry.

item.title: Parambrata Chatterjee
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Parambrata Chattopadhyay

Regional Male Actor

Parambrata Chattopadhyay is an Indian actor and director, born on June 27, 1980. He started his career in the Bengali television and film industry. One of his notable roles was portraying the fictional character Topshe from the Feluda detective series, directed by Sandip Ray.

 

Parambrata made his Hindi film debut in the critically acclaimed movie "Kahaani" in 2012, alongside Vidya Balan and Nawazuddin Siddiqui. Throughout his career, he has worked in a variety of Bengali films, including "Bhalo Theko" (2003), "Baishe Srabon" (2011), "Kadambari" (2017), "Anukul" (2017), "Pari" (2018), "Ramprasad Ki Tehrvi" (2019), "Dwitiyo Purush" (2020), and "Bulbbul" (2020).

 

In addition to acting, Parambrata Chattopadhyay has also directed films. His directorial debut was the feature film "Jiyo Kaka" (2011), starring Rituparna Sengupta and Rudranil Ghosh. He followed it up with his second directorial venture, "Hawa Bodol" (2013).

 

In May 2011, Parambrata, along with his colleague Rudranil Ghosh, ventured into film production. They launched their own production house called Workshop Productions Pvt. Ltd, in association with Dipak Raha of Durgandh Group.

item.title: Pawan Kalyan
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Pawan Kalyan

Regional Male Actor

Pawan Kalyan, born Konidela Kalyan Babu on September 2, 1971, is an Indian actor, politician, and film producer. He is predominantly known for his work in the Telugu film industry. Pawan Kalyan is the younger brother of popular actor Chiranjeevi and belongs to the illustrious Konidela family.

 

He made his acting debut in 1996 with the film "Akkada Ammayi Ikkada Abbayi." However, he gained immense popularity and a strong fan following with his film "Tholi Prema" in 1998, which became a blockbuster hit and won him a National Film Award.

 

Apart from his successful acting career, Pawan Kalyan has also been actively involved in politics. He founded the Jana Sena Party in March 2014 with the aim of addressing various issues in society. He has campaigned extensively in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana and contested in the 2019 Andhra Pradesh Legislative Assembly elections.

 

Pawan Kalyan is known for his charismatic screen presence and versatile acting skills. He has appeared in numerous successful films, including "Gabbar Singh," "Attarintiki Daredi," and "Katamarayudu." His movies often have a mass appeal and showcase his unique style and action sequences.

item.content:encoded:
Naga Shaurya

Regional Male Actor

Naga Shaurya is a talented and versatile actor in the Telugu film industry. Born on January 22, 1989, in Eluru, Andhra Pradesh, India, Nagashaurya entered the film industry with his debut film "Chandamama Kathalu" in 2014. Since then, he has gained recognition for his impressive acting skills and charming screen presence.

 

With his boy-next-door looks and natural acting abilities, Nagashaurya has won the hearts of the audience. He has portrayed a wide range of characters, from romantic leads to intense roles, showcasing his versatility as an actor. His performances in films like "Oohalu Gusagusalade," "Kalyana Vaibhogame," and "Aswathama" have been highly appreciated by both critics and viewers.

 

Apart from acting, Nagashaurya has also ventured into film production with his own banner, IRA Creations. He has shown his dedication to delivering quality content to the audience through his production ventures.

 

Nagashaurya's talent and hard work have earned him a dedicated fan base and several accolades in the Telugu film industry. With each project, he continues to prove his mettle as an actor, leaving audiences eagerly awaiting his future ventures.

item.title: Prabhas
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Prabhas

Regional Male Actor

Prabhas is an Indian actor known for his work primarily in Telugu cinema. He was born on October 23, 1979, in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. His full name is Venkata Satyanarayana Prabhas Raju Uppalapati. Prabhas comes from a film background, as his father U. Suryanarayana Raju was a famous producer.

 

He gained widespread fame and recognition for his portrayal of the lead character Baahubali in the epic film franchise "Baahubali: The Beginning" (2015) and "Baahubali: The Conclusion" (2017). The films were directed by S.S. Rajamouli and became the highest-grossing Indian films of all time.

Prabhas has acted in several other successful Telugu films such as "Mirchi" (2013) and "Darling" (2010), which further cemented his position as a leading actor in the industry. He is known for his dedication to his roles and often undergoes physical transformations for his characters.

 

In addition to Telugu cinema, Prabhas has also appeared in a few Hindi films, including "Saaho" (2019), which was a commercial success. He has a massive fan following, not only in India but also internationally.

item.title: Prakash Belawadi
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Prakash Belawadi

Regional Male Actor

Prakash Belawadi is a multi-faceted Indian personality known for his extensive involvement in various fields including theatre, film direction, television, journalism, teaching, and activism. Born in Bangalore, he comes from a family deeply rooted in the world of theatre. His father, Belawadi Nanjundaiah Narayan, and mother, Bhargavi Narayan, were both prominent figures in Kannada theatre and cinema.

Belawadi's educational journey led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering from University Visvesvaraya College of Engineering in 1983. However, his true passion lay in the arts, and he carved out a significant career in theatre, film, and media.

 

He made his mark in the film industry with his debut film "Stumble," which he wrote and directed. The film achieved great recognition, winning the National Award for Best Film in the English language in 2003. His contributions to culture and the arts were acknowledged when he was conferred the 'Pratibha Bhushan' by the Government of Karnataka in 2003 and the Karnataka Nataka Academy Award in 2011-12 for his significant role in English and Kannada theatre.

 

Beyond his accomplishments on the national stage, Belawadi has actively engaged with the international arts community. He has participated in numerous seminars, conferences, and festivals in India and abroad. His global engagements include the Beyond Bollywood conference at the Gothenburg International Film Festival, the Performing Arts Market conference in Seoul, and the Theatertreffen theatre festival in Berlin, among others.

 

Belawadi's dedication extends beyond his creative work. He has also been a motivational speaker at events and TEDx conferences, inspiring others with his insights. He is a mentor for the Bengaluru International Short Film Festival and has contributed significantly to theatre and cultural exchange as a faculty member for film courses in countries like Sweden and Turkey.

Riyanka Chanda

Television Male Actor

Riyanka Chanda is a talented and versatile actress who has made a significant impact in the world of entertainment. With her captivating performances and charming presence, she has gained a considerable fan base and established herself as a rising star in the industry. Known for her ability to portray diverse characters with depth and authenticity, Riyanka has showcased her acting prowess in a wide range of roles. Whether it's a vulnerable and emotional character or a strong and independent woman, she brings a unique flair to every performance, captivating audiences with her nuanced portrayals. Riyanka's dedication to her craft is evident in her meticulous approach to each role. She immerses herself in the characters she portrays, meticulously studying their nuances and mannerisms, and delivering powerful performances that leave a lasting impact. In addition to her acting talent, Riyanka possesses a magnetic on-screen presence that draws viewers in and keeps them engaged throughout her performances. Her ability to connect with the audience on an emotional level has made her a favorite among fans and critics alike. With her exceptional talent, passion, and determination, Riyanka Chanda is undoubtedly an actress to watch out for. As she continues to push boundaries and explore new horizons, her star is destined to shine even brighter in the years to come.

item.title: Prakash Raj
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Prakash Raj

Regional Male Actor

Prakash Raj is an Indian actor, film director, and producer, known for his work in the South Indian film industry as well as Bollywood. He was born on March 26, 1965, in Bangalore, Karnataka, India. Raj has acted in over 200 films in various languages, including Telugu, Tamil, Malayalam, Kannada, and Hindi. He has won several prestigious awards for his performances, including five National Film Awards and six Filmfare Awards South.

 

In addition to his acting career, Prakash Raj has also ventured into film direction and production. He has directed and produced critically acclaimed films such as "Naanu Nanna Kanasu" (2010) and "Oggarane" (2014). Raj is known for his versatile acting skills and has portrayed a wide range of characters, including both positive and negative roles.

 

Prakash Raj is recognized for his strong social and political activism. He has been vocal about various social issues and has actively participated in campaigns for education, health, and the environment. He is also a prominent supporter of the anti-corruption movement in India.

 

Outside of the film industry, Prakash Raj has been involved in theater and has performed in numerous plays. He has also appeared in a few international films, gaining recognition on a global scale. Prakash Raj's contributions to Indian cinema and his commitment to social causes have made him one of the most respected and influential figures in the industry.

item.title: Prudhvi Raj
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Prudhvi Raj

Balireddy Prudhviraj, popularly known as 30 Years Industry, is an Indian actor and politician who predominantly works in Telugu films. Born on August 6, 1964, in Tadepalligudem, Andhra Pradesh, he has appeared in over 100 films, mostly in comic roles. Prudhviraj made his acting debut in the film Aa Okkati Adakku in 1992, where he was introduced by noted actor M. Prabhakar Reddy and director E. V. V. Satyanarayana. He gained recognition for his role in the film Khadgam (2002), where his dialogue "30 Years Industry ikkada" became popular and earned him the moniker 30 Years Industry. Apart from his acting career, Prudhviraj has also ventured into politics. In February 2019, he was appointed as the state secretary of the YSR Congress Party in Andhra Pradesh. He later joined the Jana Sena Party in 2022. Prudhviraj faced controversy in January 2020 when an audiotape recording featuring him and a female employee of the SVBC TV channel, where he served as chairman, went viral on YouTube. The incident led to protests by SVBC employees, who demanded his resignation. Consequently, Prudhviraj resigned from his post as the chairman of the Sri Venkateswara Bhakti Channel. Throughout his career, Prudhviraj has entertained audiences with his comedic performances and has made a significant impact in the Telugu film industry.

Balireddy Prudhviraj, popularly known as 30 Years Industry, is an Indian actor and politician who predominantly works in Telugu films. Born on August 6, 1964, in Tadepalligudem, Andhra Pradesh, he has appeared in over 100 films, mostly in comic roles.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Prudhviraj made his acting debut in the film Aa Okkati Adakku in 1992, where he was introduced by noted actor M. Prabhakar Reddy and director E. V. V. Satyanarayana. He gained recognition for his role in the film Khadgam (2002), where his dialogue \"30 Years Industry ikkada\" became popular and earned him the moniker 30 Years Industry.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Apart from his acting career, Prudhviraj has also ventured into politics. In February 2019, he was appointed as the state secretary of the YSR Congress Party in Andhra Pradesh. He later joined the Jana Sena Party in 2022.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Prudhviraj faced controversy in January 2020 when an audiotape recording featuring him and a female employee of the SVBC TV channel, where he served as chairman, went viral on YouTube. The incident led to protests by SVBC employees, who demanded his resignation. Consequently, Prudhviraj resigned from his post as the chairman of the Sri Venkateswara Bhakti Channel.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

item.title: Rakshit Shetty
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Rakshit Shetty

Regional Male Actor

Rakshit Shetty is a renowned Indian actor, filmmaker, and screenwriter who has made a significant impact on the Kannada film industry. Born on June 6, 1983, in Udupi, Karnataka, Rakshit's journey in the entertainment world has been nothing short of remarkable. With his exceptional talent and dedication, he has carved a niche for himself in the industry.

 

Rakshit first gained recognition with his breakthrough role as "Richie" in the critically acclaimed film "Ulidavaru Kandante" in 2014. The film not only established him as a talented actor but also showcased his screenwriting skills. He went on to write and star in the blockbuster hit "Kirik Party" in 2016, which became a cult favorite among the youth.

 

Known for his versatile performances, Rakshit has the ability to effortlessly portray diverse characters on screen. His magnetic screen presence and natural acting style have won him a huge fan following. He has also ventured into film production with his production house, Paramvah Studios, which aims to promote innovative and quality cinema.

 

Beyond his professional accomplishments, Rakshit is admired for his humility and down-to-earth nature. He has become an inspiration for aspiring actors and filmmakers, proving that with talent, hard work, and determination, one can achieve great heights in the film industry. Rakshit Shetty continues to captivate audiences with his talent, and his contributions to Kannada cinema have undoubtedly left an indelible mark.

item.title: Ram Pothineni
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Ram Pothineni

Regional Male Actor

Ram Pothineni is an Indian actor known for his work predominantly in Telugu cinema. Born on May 15, 1988, in Hyderabad, India, Ram made his acting debut in 2006 with the film "Devadasu." He comes from a family with a film background, as his father Murali Mohan Pothineni is a producer.

 

Ram gained recognition for his roles in successful films like "Ready" (2008), "Kandireega" (2011), and "Nenu Sailaja" (2016). He has established himself as a versatile actor, showcasing his ability to excel in both action and romantic genres. Ram's performances have earned him numerous accolades, including two Filmfare Awards.

 

Apart from acting, Ram is also known for his dedication to fitness and has often undergone physical transformations for his roles. He is admired for his dancing skills and has showcased them in several films, earning him the title of "Energetic Star."

 

Ram has a significant fan following, especially among the younger audience, who appreciate his charismatic screen presence and entertaining performances. With his talent and charm, Ram Pothineni continues to make a mark in the Telugu film industry and remains a prominent figure in South Indian cinema.

item.title: Ramesh Aravind
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Ramesh Aravind

Regional Male Actor

Ramesh Aravind is a versatile Indian actor, director, screenwriter, and television presenter primarily known for his contributions to Kannada films and television. With a career spanning over 36 years, he has participated in more than 140 films, including ventures in Tamil, Telugu, and Hindi cinema. Aravind has received multiple awards, including Filmfare Awards for Best Actor, Karnataka State Awards for Best Actor and Best Story, and recognition from Udaya TV and Suvarna TV.

 

Notably, he hosts the popular television show "Weekend with Ramesh," which has seen five successful seasons on Zee Kannada. Aravind has also hosted the Kannada version of "Who Wants to Be a Millionaire" and served as the awareness ambassador for COVID-19 appointed by the Bruhat Bengaluru Mahanagara Palike (BBMP).

 

Throughout his film career, Aravind has achieved significant milestones. Several of his movies, such as "Anuraga Sangama," "Nammoora Mandara Hoove," "America America," and "Thutta Mutta," completed a 100-day run in theaters. His performances in various movies have garnered critical acclaim, leading to his recognition as a talented actor.

 

In 2022, Ramesh Aravind received an honorary doctorate from Rani Channamma University for his substantial contributions to the field of cinema. He was also honored with the Dr. Shivarama Karanth Award for his exceptional services as an actor, director, and resource person.

 

Aravind's career extends beyond acting to writing and directing. He scripted the film "Hoomale" in 1998, which earned him accolades and marked the beginning of his directing career. He directed films like "Rama Shama Bhama," "Sathyavan Savithri," and "Uttama Villain," working with well-known personalities like Kamal Haasan.

 

Beyond his cinematic endeavors, Aravind is a motivational speaker and has authored successful books. He has shared his insights through various platforms, contributing to his reputation as a multi-talented and influential figure.

Ramesh Aravind is a versatile Indian actor, director, screenwriter, and television presenter primarily known for his contributions to Kannada films and television. With a career spanning over 36 years, he has participated in more than 140 films, including ventures in Tamil, Telugu, and Hindi cinema. Aravind has received multiple awards, including Filmfare Awards for Best Actor, Karnataka State Awards for Best Actor and Best Story, and recognition from Udaya TV and Suvarna TV.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Notably, he hosts the popular television show \"Weekend with Ramesh,\" which has seen five successful seasons on Zee Kannada. Aravind has also hosted the Kannada version of \"Who Wants to Be a Millionaire\" and served as the awareness ambassador for COVID-19 appointed by the Bruhat Bengaluru Mahanagara Palike (BBMP).<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Throughout his film career, Aravind has achieved significant milestones. Several of his movies, such as \"Anuraga Sangama,\" \"Nammoora Mandara Hoove,\" \"America America,\" and \"Thutta Mutta,\" completed a 100-day run in theaters. His performances in various movies have garnered critical acclaim, leading to his recognition as a talented actor.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

In 2022, Ramesh Aravind received an honorary doctorate from Rani Channamma University for his substantial contributions to the field of cinema. He was also honored with the Dr. Shivarama Karanth Award for his exceptional services as an actor, director, and resource person.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Aravind's career extends beyond acting to writing and directing. He scripted the film \"Hoomale\" in 1998, which earned him accolades and marked the beginning of his directing career. He directed films like \"Rama Shama Bhama,\" \"Sathyavan Savithri,\" and \"Uttama Villain,\" working with well-known personalities like Kamal Haasan.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Beyond his cinematic endeavors, Aravind is a motivational speaker and has authored successful books. He has shared his insights through various platforms, contributing to his reputation as a multi-talented and influential figure.<\/p>","typography_typography":"custom","typography_font_weight":"bold"},"elements":[],"widgetType":"text-editor"}],"isInner":false}],"isInner":false},{"id":"1a14c61","elType":"section","settings":{"background_background":"classic","background_color":"#EAF0EE8F","hover_parallax":[{"layer_position_vr":{"unit":"%","size":30},"layer_position_hr":{"unit":"%","size":40},"_id":"ac4fb18"},{"layer_position_vr":{"unit":"%","size":60},"layer_position_hr":{"unit":"%","size":20},"_id":"a1b2b38"}]},"elements":[{"id":"f1a7afd","elType":"column","settings":{"_column_size":100,"_inline_size":null},"elements":[{"id":"c809644","elType":"widget","settings":{"title":"Enquiry Form","header_size":"h3","align":"center","typography_typography":"custom","typography_font_size":{"unit":"px","size":40,"sizes":[]},"typography_font_weight":"bold","_margin":{"unit":"px","top":"40","right":"0","bottom":"20","left":"0","isLinked":false},"__globals__":{"title_color":"globals\/colors?id=6d3d44f9"}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"heading"},{"id":"872d1f7","elType":"widget","settings":{"shortcode":"[forminator_form id=\"5483\"]","_margin":{"unit":"px","top":"0","right":"0","bottom":"40","left":"0","isLinked":false}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"shortcode"}],"isInner":false}],"isInner":false}]

item.title: Rana Daggubati
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Rana Daggubati

Regional Male Actor

Rana Daggubati, born on December 14, 1984, is an Indian actor, producer, and entrepreneur. He hails from a prominent film family in the Telugu film industry. Rana made his acting debut in 2010 with the Telugu film "Leader," which earned him critical acclaim and a Nandi Award for Best Male Debut. He gained widespread recognition and popularity for his portrayal of the antagonist Bhallaladeva in the epic film series "Baahubali," directed by S.S. Rajamouli.

 

Aside from his acting career, Rana has also ventured into film production and has founded his production company called "Suresh Productions." He has been involved in producing various successful Telugu films. Rana has expanded his horizons beyond the Telugu film industry and has acted in several Hindi, Tamil, and Malayalam films, further establishing his presence in the Indian film industry.

 

Apart from films, Rana has shown his entrepreneurial skills by co-founding a technology startup called "Anthill Studio" and a talent management agency named "Kwan South." He is also actively involved in philanthropic endeavors and supports several charitable causes.

 

With his talent, versatility, and entrepreneurial spirit, Rana Daggubati has become one of the most influential and respected personalities in the Indian entertainment industry. His contributions to cinema and his diverse range of ventures have garnered him a significant fan following.

item.title: Ravi Teja
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Ravi Teja

Regional Male Actor

Ravi Teja, born as Ravi Shankar Raju Bhupatiraju on January 26, 1968, is a prominent Indian actor known for his work predominantly in Telugu cinema. Hailing from Jaggampeta, Andhra Pradesh, he has established himself as one of the leading actors in the industry. Ravi Teja made his acting debut with the film "Karthavyam" in 1990, but it was his breakthrough performance in the movie "Idiot" in 2002 that catapulted him to fame. He is often referred to as the "Mass Maharaja" for his entertaining and energetic performances.

 

Throughout his career, Ravi Teja has delivered several commercially successful films, including "Vikramarkudu," "Dubai Seenu," "Kick," and "Mirapakay," among others. His distinctive style and dialogue delivery have endeared him to the masses. Ravi Teja has received several awards and accolades for his performances, including the Nandi Special Jury Award for his role in the film "Neninthe" in 2008.

 

Apart from his acting skills, Ravi Teja is also known for his dedication to fitness. He maintains a well-built physique and often incorporates action sequences in his movies. With his charismatic screen presence and versatile acting abilities, Ravi Teja continues to entertain audiences and remains a prominent figure in the Telugu film industry.

item.title: Sagar Karande
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Sagar Karande

Regional Male Actor

Sagar Karande is an Indian actor and stand-up comedian known for his work in the Marathi entertainment industry. Born on January 1, 1980, in Nasik, Maharashtra, he developed an interest in acting from a young age. After completing his schooling at Balmohan Vidyamandir in Maharashtra, Sagar pursued a bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering. However, his passion for acting led him to attend an acting school and join a theatre group.

 

Sagar Karande began his career as a theatre artist and later transitioned into stand-up comedy. In 2010, he gained recognition for his humorous performances in the Marathi comedy show "Fu Bai Fu." He went on to participate in various comedy shows, including "Comedy Express" and "Dhinka Chika." In 2022, he showcased his comedic skills as a participant on the comedy show "India's Laughter Champion."

 

In addition to his work in theatre and comedy, Sagar Karande has appeared in several Marathi films and television shows. He made his film debut in 2012 with the Marathi movie "Kutumb" and has since been part of films like "Chal Dhar Pakad," "Fakt Ladh Mhana," and "Ek Taara." On television, he gained popularity for his role as Lavini Queen in the Marathi show "Chala Hawa Yeu Dya." He has also appeared in serials such as "Virkhit," "Basta," "Doctor Don," and "Bhai - Vyakti Ki Valli 2."

item.title: Sai Kumar
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Sai Kumar

Regional Male Actor

Pudipeddi Sai Kumar, born on July 27, 1960, is an accomplished Indian actor, dubbing artist, and television presenter renowned for his contributions to Telugu and Kannada cinema. His remarkable talent has earned him recognition, including three state Filmfare Awards South, two Nandi Awards, and two SIMA Awards in both Telugu and Kannada industries.

 

Sai Kumar hails from a family with a strong connection to the entertainment world. Born to P. J. Sarma and Krishna Jyothi, he was raised in an environment influenced by the film industry. His father, P. J. Sarma, was a prominent dubbing artist, and Sai Kumar followed in his footsteps, providing voiceovers for well-known actors like Suman and Rajasekhar.

 

Starting his career as a child actor, Sai Kumar appeared in films like "Devudu Chesina Pelli" (1975) and "Sneham" (1977). As he grew, he ventured into adult roles, starring in movies such as "Challenge" (1984), "Kalikalam" (1991), and "Major Chandrakanth" (1993).

 

Sai Kumar made a mark in both Telugu and Kannada industries. His Kannada films like "Police Story" (1996), "Agni IPS" (1997), "Central Jail" (1997), and "Police Story 2" (2007) became major box office hits, elevating his popularity in Karnataka. His performance in the Kannada film "RangiTaranga" received critical acclaim and earned him awards like IIFA Utsavam and SIIMA Award.

item.title: Sai Srinivas Bellamkonda
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Sai Srinivas Bellamkonda

Regional Male Actor

Sai Srinivas Bellamkonda, often referred to as Bellamkonda Sai Srinivas, is a talented Indian actor who has made a significant impact in the Telugu film industry. Born on January 3, 1993, in Guntur, Andhra Pradesh, Sai Srinivas comes from a renowned film family. His father, Bellamkonda Suresh, is a prominent film producer. Sai Srinivas made his acting debut in 2014 with the film "Alludu Seenu," directed by V. V. Vinayak. Despite being a newcomer, he showcased his acting skills and received critical acclaim for his performance. His intense screen presence and commendable action sequences soon made him a sought-after actor in Tollywood. Over the years, Sai Srinivas has appeared in several commercially successful films, including "Speedunnodu," "Jaya Janaki Nayaka," and "Kavacham." He has proven his versatility by portraying a range of characters, from romantic leads to action-oriented roles. Apart from his acting prowess, Sai Srinivas is known for his dedication and commitment to his craft. He has worked hard to improve his acting skills and physical fitness, often undergoing rigorous training for his action-packed roles.

Known for his charming screen presence and energetic performances, Sai Dharam Tej has established himself as a versatile actor over the years. He has showcased his acting prowess in various genres, including action, romance, and comedy. Some of his notable films include "Supreme," "Subramanyam for Sale," and "Prati Roju Pandage," among others.

 

Apart from his acting skills, Sai Dharam Tej is also known for his dedication and hard work. He has portrayed diverse characters and has successfully entertained the audience with his impeccable comic timing and intense action sequences. With his charismatic persona and talent, Sai Dharam Tej has garnered a significant fan following, especially among the younger generation.

item.title: Santosh Juvekar
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Santosh Juvekar

Regional Male Actor

Santosh Juvekar is an Indian actor known for his work in Marathi films, as well as in Hindi films, television, and stage productions.

 

Juvekar began his acting career in 2004 with the Marathi play "Aani Makarand Rajadhyaksha," directed by Dilip Kolhatkar. The play featured veteran actor Vikram Gokhale, and Juvekar portrayed the character of Naren Deshmukh. He gained popularity on television with the show "Ya Gojirvanya Gharaat."

 

In 2006, Juvekar made his film debut in Rajiv Patil's "Blind Game." The film starred renowned actors Anant Jog and Upendra Limaye, with actress Mukta Barve in a supporting role. Juvekar went on to play lead roles in Marathi films like "Zenda," "Morya," "Matter," and more. He also appeared in the film "31December: The Mirror," where he portrayed the role of an army officer. His performance in the film "Gadbad Gondhal" earned him a nomination for Best Actor at the Ambarnath Marathi Film Festival in 2017.

 

In addition to films and television, Juvekar has also worked in a web series called "Struggler Saala," which is available on YouTube.

Santosh Juvekar is an Indian actor known for his work in Marathi films, as well as in Hindi films, television, and stage productions.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Juvekar began his acting career in 2004 with the Marathi play \"Aani Makarand Rajadhyaksha,\" directed by Dilip Kolhatkar. The play featured veteran actor Vikram Gokhale, and Juvekar portrayed the character of Naren Deshmukh. He gained popularity on television with the show \"Ya Gojirvanya Gharaat.\"<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

In 2006, Juvekar made his film debut in Rajiv Patil's \"Blind Game.\" The film starred renowned actors Anant Jog and Upendra Limaye, with actress Mukta Barve in a supporting role. Juvekar went on to play lead roles in Marathi films like \"Zenda,\" \"Morya,\" \"Matter,\" and more. He also appeared in the film \"31December: The Mirror,\" where he portrayed the role of an army officer. His performance in the film \"Gadbad Gondhal\" earned him a nomination for Best Actor at the Ambarnath Marathi Film Festival in 2017.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

In addition to films and television, Juvekar has also worked in a web series called \"Struggler Saala,\" which is available on YouTube.<\/p>","typography_typography":"custom","typography_font_weight":"bold"},"elements":[],"widgetType":"text-editor"}],"isInner":false}],"isInner":false},{"id":"fe5e958","elType":"section","settings":{"background_background":"classic","background_color":"#EAF0EE8F","hover_parallax":[{"layer_position_vr":{"unit":"%","size":30},"layer_position_hr":{"unit":"%","size":40},"_id":"ac4fb18"},{"layer_position_vr":{"unit":"%","size":60},"layer_position_hr":{"unit":"%","size":20},"_id":"a1b2b38"}]},"elements":[{"id":"9e561ae","elType":"column","settings":{"_column_size":100,"_inline_size":null},"elements":[{"id":"c050474","elType":"widget","settings":{"title":"Enquiry Form","header_size":"h3","align":"center","typography_typography":"custom","typography_font_size":{"unit":"px","size":40,"sizes":[]},"typography_font_weight":"bold","_margin":{"unit":"px","top":"40","right":"0","bottom":"20","left":"0","isLinked":false},"__globals__":{"title_color":"globals\/colors?id=6d3d44f9"}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"heading"},{"id":"43b5ae3","elType":"widget","settings":{"shortcode":"[forminator_form id=\"5483\"]","_margin":{"unit":"px","top":"0","right":"0","bottom":"40","left":"0","isLinked":false}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"shortcode"}],"isInner":false}],"isInner":false}]

item.title: Sayaji Shinde
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Sayaji Shinde

Regional Male Actor

Sayaji Shinde is an Indian actor known for his work in Telugu, Marathi, Tamil, Kannada, Malayalam, English, Gujarati, Hindi, and Bhojpuri films, as well as Marathi plays. Born on January 13, 1959, in Sakharwadi, Satara District, Maharashtra, he began his acting career in 1978 with Marathi one-act plays. He gained recognition for his performance in the 1987 Marathi play "Zulva" and went on to establish himself as a talented actor.

 

Sayaji made his debut in Marathi cinema with the film "Aboli" in 1995. He received acclaim for his roles in Marathi plays such as "Sakharam Binder," "Zulva," "One Room Kitchen," and "Amchya ya gharat." His portrayal of the Agricultural Minister in the movie "Goshta Chhoti Dongara Evadhi" was highly appreciated. His talent caught the attention of Hindi actor Manoj Bajpai, who recommended Sayaji to filmmaker Ram Gopal Varma.

 

Sayaji's Bollywood debut came with the film "Shool," in which he played the role of Bachhu Yadav. However, it was his performance in the Tamil film "Barathi" that garnered him immense recognition. Despite not speaking Tamil, Sayaji portrayed the renowned poet and writer Subramanya Bharathi and received the Tamil Nadu State Award for his portrayal. He continued to work in Tamil films, including "Azhagi" and "Dhool."

item.title: Sharwanand
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Sharwanand

Regional Male Actor

Sharwanand, born as Sarwanad, is a talented and versatile Indian actor who predominantly works in the Telugu film industry. Known for his charming personality and impressive acting skills, Sharwanand has established himself as one of the most promising actors in the South Indian film industry.

 

Born on March 6, 1984, in Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh, Sharwanand made his acting debut with the Telugu film "5va Tareeku" in 2003. However, it was his role in the critically acclaimed film "Amma Cheppindi" that brought him recognition and appreciation from both critics and audiences.

 

Sharwanand has since then delivered several memorable performances in films like "Gamyam," "Prasthanam," "Run Raja Run," and "Mahanubhavudu," among others. He has portrayed a wide range of characters, showcasing his versatility as an actor.

 

Apart from his acting prowess, Sharwanand is also known for his dedication and commitment to his craft. He consistently strives to choose unique and challenging roles, pushing the boundaries of his capabilities.

 

With his boy-next-door charm, impressive acting range, and dedication to his craft, Sharwanand continues to enthrall audiences and carve a niche for himself in the Telugu film industry. His talent and versatility make him an actor to watch out for in the coming years.

Regional Male Actor

Shivrajkumar, also known as the "Hat-trick Hero," is an eminent Indian film actor renowned for his work in the Kannada film industry. Born on July 12, 1962, he hails from a family deeply rooted in cinema, with his father being the legendary actor Rajkumar. Shivrajkumar has carved a niche for himself through his exceptional talent and versatile performances.

 

With a career spanning over three decades, Shivrajkumar has mesmerized audiences with his intense portrayals, impeccable dialogue delivery, and powerful screen presence. He has acted in a wide range of genres, including action, drama, and romance, effortlessly immersing himself in diverse characters. His ability to bring authenticity and depth to his roles has garnered him immense respect and a dedicated fan following.

 

Apart from his acting prowess, Shivrajkumar is also known for his philanthropic endeavors. He actively participates in social causes and charitable activities, reflecting his commitment to making a positive impact on society.

 

Shivrajkumar's contributions to the Kannada film industry have earned him numerous accolades and awards, including several Karnataka State Film Awards. His humility, professionalism, and dedication to his craft make him an icon in the industry. Shivrajkumar's enduring charm and his ability to captivate audiences continue to make him a beloved figure in the world of Indian cinema.

With his boy-next-door looks and natural acting abilities, Nagashaurya has won the hearts of the audience. Apart from acting, Nagashaurya has also ventured into film production with his own banner, IRA Creations. He has shown his dedication to delivering quality content to the audience through his production ventures.

item.title: Siddharth
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Siddharth

Regional Male Actor

Siddharth Suryanarayan, known professionally as Siddharth, is an Indian actor, screenwriter, producer, and playback singer. Born on 17 April 1979 in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, he primarily works in Tamil, Telugu, and Hindi films. Siddharth began his career as an assistant director to Mani Ratnam and made his acting debut in the Tamil film Boys (2003) directed by S. Shankar.

 

After the success of Boys, Siddharth gained recognition with his role in Mani Ratnam's Aayutha Ezhuthu (2004). He then ventured into Telugu cinema with Nuvvostanante Nenoddantana (2005), which earned him critical acclaim and marked a turning point in his career. Siddharth went on to deliver notable performances in films like Rang De Basanti (2006) and Bommarillu (2006), establishing himself as a leading actor in Telugu and Hindi cinema.

 

In the late 2000s, Siddharth focused on selective projects, showcasing his versatility as an actor. He portrayed a carrom player in the film Striker (2010) and a blind warrior in Anaganaga O Dheerudu (2011). Siddharth made his comeback to Tamil cinema with Kadhalil Sodhappuvadhu Yeppadi (2012), which he also produced. He garnered critical acclaim for his performances in Jigarthanda (2014) and Kaaviya Thalaivan (2014).

 

Siddharth's career continued to flourish with appearances in films like Aranmanai 2 (2016) and Kammara Sambhavam (2018) in Malayalam. He has also been involved in various commercials and has showcased his talents as a screenwriter, producer, and playback singer.

 

Outside of his film career, Siddharth has been actively involved in social issues and has expressed his opinions on various topics. He has gained a dedicated fan base for his versatile acting skills and his ability to portray diverse characters on screen.

 

Early in his education, Siddharth displayed a passion for films and actively participated in extra-curricular activities. After completing his studies, he worked as an assistant director before pursuing acting. His dedication and talent have earned him accolades and nominations for various awards throughout his career.

item.title: Siddharth Chandekar
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Siddharth Chandekar

Regional Male Actor

Siddharth Chandekar is a talented and versatile Indian actor who has made a significant mark in the Marathi film industry. Born on June 14, 1991, in Pune, Maharashtra, Siddharth started his acting journey at a young age and quickly gained recognition for his exceptional skills and charming personality.

 

With his striking looks and natural acting abilities, Siddharth has effortlessly portrayed a wide range of characters in both films and television. He has showcased his talent in various genres, including romantic dramas, comedies, and intense thrillers, captivating audiences with his impeccable performances.

 

Siddharth's breakthrough came with his lead role in the critically acclaimed Marathi film "Bakula Namdeo Ghotale" in 2007, which earned him praise and several awards. Since then, he has been a part of numerous successful films like "Classmates," "Gulabjaam," and "Vazandar," further establishing himself as one of the industry's finest actors.

 

Apart from films, Siddharth has also appeared in popular Marathi television shows, enhancing his popularity and connecting with a wider audience. His dedication to his craft and his ability to portray characters with depth and authenticity have garnered him a strong fan base

item.content:encoded:
Sidhu Jonnalagadda

Regional Male Actor

Sidhu Jonnalagadda is a talented and versatile actor hailing from the Telugu film industry. With his charming personality and natural acting skills, Sidhu has managed to carve a niche for himself in the hearts of the audience. Born and raised in Hyderabad, India, Sidhu made his acting debut with the critically acclaimed film "Guntur Talkies" in 2016, which showcased his ability to portray diverse characters with ease.

 

Since then, Sidhu has been a part of several successful films, impressing both critics and viewers alike. His performances in movies like "Maa Vintha Gaadha Vinuma" and "Krishna and His Leela" have been widely appreciated for their emotional depth and authenticity. Sidhu's ability to effortlessly switch between intense drama and lighthearted comedy has made him a sought-after actor in the industry.

 

Apart from acting, Sidhu is also known for his strong screen presence and charming demeanor. He has a knack for connecting with the audience and bringing his characters to life. With his passion for cinema and dedication to his craft, Sidhu Jonnalagadda continues to win hearts and prove himself as a promising talent in the Telugu film industry.

item.title: Sudheer Babu
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Sudheer Babu

Regional Male Actor

Sudheer Babu is a talented Indian actor and former professional badminton player who has made a significant impact on the Telugu film industry. Born on May 11, 1979, in Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh, Sudheer Babu has carved a niche for himself with his impressive performances and dedication to his craft.

 

Before entering the world of acting, Sudheer Babu pursued a career in badminton. He was a skilled player and represented Andhra Pradesh at the national level. However, his passion for the entertainment industry led him to make a career shift. Sudheer made his acting debut with the Telugu film "Ye Maaya Chesave" in 2010, and since then, there has been no turning back for him.

 

Known for his charming looks and versatility, Sudheer Babu has delivered several memorable performances in films like "Prema Katha Chitram," "Shamanthakamani," and "Sammohanam." He has portrayed a wide range of characters, showcasing his acting prowess and captivating audiences with his on-screen presence.

 

Apart from his acting skills, Sudheer Babu is also admired for his dedication to fitness and maintaining a well-toned physique. He has inspired many with his fitness journey and often shares workout tips and routines on his social media platforms.

item.title: Sumanth
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Sumanth

Regional Male Actor

Sumanth Kumar Yarlagadda, popularly known as Sumanth, is an Indian actor known for his work in Telugu cinema. Born on February 9, 1975, in Hyderabad, India, he comes from a prominent film family as the eldest grandson of the legendary Telugu actor Akkineni Nageswara Rao. Sumanth is also a partner in Annapurna Studios.

 

Sumanth has acted in several notable films throughout his career. Some of his noteworthy movies include "Prema Katha" (1999), "Yuvakudu" (2000), "Satyam" (2003), "Gowri" (2004), "Godavari" (2006), "Madhumasam" (2008), "Golconda High School" (2011), "Malli Raava" (2017), and "Sita Ramam" (2022).

 

Raised in India by his maternal grandparents, Sumanth was adopted by them at the request of his grandfather, Akkineni Nageswara Rao, who wanted to experience the joys of fatherhood. His father, Surendra Yarlagadda, is a former film producer, and his sister, Supriya Yarlagadda, is the executive director of Annapurna Studios. Actor Nagarjuna Akkineni is his maternal uncle, and he has cousins Naga Chaitanya, Akhil Akkineni, and Sushanth, who are also actors.

 

Sumanth completed his schooling at the Hyderabad Public School and then pursued engineering studies in Michigan before transferring to Columbia College Chicago, where he graduated with a B.A. in Film Studies in 1997.

Sumanth made his acting debut as a lead actor in the romantic film "Prema Katha" directed by Ram Gopal Varma in 1999. Although the film did not achieve commercial success, it received critical acclaim and won several awards. His breakthrough role came in the 2003 film "Satyam," where he portrayed a ghost-writer aspiring to become a lyricist. The movie was both a commercial success and earned Sumanth critical praise for his performance.

item.content:encoded:
Sundeep Kishan

Regional Male Actor

Sundeep Kishan is a popular actor in the Telugu film industry, commonly known as Tollywood. Born on May 7, 1987, in Chennai, India, Sundeep began his acting career with the critically acclaimed film "Prasthanam" in 2010. Since then, he has emerged as a versatile and talented actor, impressing audiences with his performances.

 

Sundeep Kishan has a unique screen presence and the ability to portray a wide range of characters. He has worked in various genres, including romantic dramas, action thrillers, and comedy films. Some of his notable movies include "Venkatadri Express," "Tiger," "Nagaram," and "Maanagaram."

 

Apart from his acting skills, Sundeep is also known for his dedication and hard work. He has consistently chosen diverse roles and has been recognized for his commitment to his craft. His performances have earned him a strong fan base and critical acclaim.

 

Sundeep Kishan's journey in the Telugu film industry continues to evolve, and he remains a prominent figure in Tollywood. With his passion for acting and ability to connect with the audience, he is sure to leave a lasting impression on the industry for years to come.

item.title: Supreeth Reddy
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Supreeth Reddy

Regional Male Actor

Supreeth Reddy is an Indian actor known for his work primarily in Telugu-language films. He has gained recognition for his roles in movies such as Chatrapati and Maryada Ramanna, where he has portrayed both villainous and supporting characters. He has also made appearances in Bollywood films, including Rowdy Rathore, a remake of the Telugu film Vikramarkudu, and Aamir Khan's Ghajini`

 

Reddy's interest in films dates back to his childhood, and he was particularly drawn to acting. While growing up, he was also involved in playing volleyball. Although he initially missed the auditions for the film Jayam, he was encouraged by director Teja to maintain a portfolio. He made his acting debut in Pawan Kalyan's directorial debut, Johnny. Notably, he received training in Rugby for his role in the sports film Sye, directed by S. S. Rajamouli.

 

In the film Chatrapati, Reddy was initially selected to play a friend of the protagonist, Prabhas, but his role was later changed to that of Kaatraj, a villain. This performance garnered him significant acclaim and popularity. Since then, he has been frequently cast in negative roles in various films.

item.title: Suriya Sivakumar
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Suriya Sivakumar

Regional Male Actor

Suriya Sivakumar, popularly known as Suriya, is a talented and versatile Indian actor who has left an indelible mark on the Tamil film industry. Born on July 23, 1975, in Chennai, India, Suriya is the son of veteran Tamil actor Sivakumar. With his charismatic personality, exceptional acting skills, and dedication to his craft, Suriya has become one of the most celebrated actors in the South Indian film fraternity.

 

Suriya made his acting debut in 1997 with the film "Nerukku Ner" and went on to deliver a string of successful performances in movies like "Kaakha Kaakha," "Ghajini," and "Singam," among others. He has portrayed a wide range of characters, from intense action roles to emotionally charged dramas, showcasing his versatility as an actor.

 

Beyond acting, Suriya is also known for his philanthropic efforts. He established the Agaram Foundation, which focuses on promoting quality education among underprivileged children. The foundation has been instrumental in transforming the lives of numerous students by providing scholarships and educational support.

 

Suriya's talent, dedication, and commitment to his craft have earned him numerous accolades, including several Filmfare Awards and Tamil Nadu State Film Awards. With his incredible screen presence and ability to connect with audiences, Suriya continues to captivate and entertain viewers with his exceptional performances, cementing his legacy as a powerhouse performer in the Indian film industry.

item.title: Swapnil Joshi
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Swapnil Joshi

Swapnil Joshi is a versatile and accomplished Indian actor who has made a significant mark in the entertainment industry. Born on October 18, 1977, in Mumbai, Swapnil Joshi began his acting career at a young age and quickly gained recognition for his talent and charm. He has portrayed a wide range of characters in various mediums, including television, films, and theater.

 

Swapnil Joshi is best known for his notable roles in popular Marathi television shows like "Eka Lagnachi Dusri Goshta" and "Tuza Maza Breakup." His impeccable comic timing and natural flair for acting have earned him immense praise from audiences and critics alike. Swapnil has also been a part of successful Marathi films, including "Mumbai-Pune-Mumbai" and its sequel.

 

Apart from acting, Swapnil Joshi is also a talented host and has anchored several reality shows, including "Comedy Circus" and "Comedy Circus Mahasangram." His charismatic presence and ability to engage with the audience have made him a favorite among viewers.

item.title: Tovino Thomas
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Tovino Thomas

Regional Male Actor

Tovino Thomas is an Indian actor and film producer who primarily works in Malayalam cinema. He was born on January 21, 1989, in Irinjalakuda, Thrissur, Kerala. Tovino made his acting debut in 2012 with the film "Prabhuvinte Makkal." However, before venturing into acting, he worked as a software engineer at Cognizant Technologies.

 

Tovino gained recognition for his roles in films like "ABCD: American-Born Confused Desi" (2013), "7th Day" (2014), and "Ennu Ninte Moideen" (2015). His performance in "Ennu Ninte Moideen" earned him critical acclaim and the Filmfare Award for Best Supporting Actor. He continued to deliver notable performances in films such as "Guppy" (2016), "Oru Mexican Aparatha" (2017), "Godha" (2017), and "Mayanadi" (2017). His portrayal in "Mayanadi" garnered him the Filmfare Critics Award for Best Actor.

 

In 2018, Tovino made his Tamil film debut with "Maari 2" alongside Dhanush. He also appeared in several successful Malayalam films that year, including "Theevandi," "Ente Ummante Peru," and "Oru Kuprasidha Payyan." In 2019, he featured in films like "Lucifer," "Uyare," and "Virus." "Uyare" became the first Malayalam film to be released in South Korea.

 

In 2020, Tovino starred in the crime thriller "Forensic," which was a commercial success. In 2021, he ventured into film production with his own production house, Tovino Thomas Productions. His production house's first film was "Kala," in which he played the role of the antagonist. Tovino also portrayed the titular character in the Netflix superhero film "Minnal Murali" (2021), which received positive reviews.

 

Throughout his career, Tovino has received several awards and accolades for his performances, including the Kerala Film Critics Association Award and Filmfare Critics Award for Best Actor for "Mayanadi." He is also recognized for his looks and style, being ranked among the most desirable men from Kerala by Kochi Times.

item.title: Thakur Anoop
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Thakur Anoop Singh

Regional Male Actor

Thakur Anoop Singh is an Indian actor and bodybuilder, known for his work primarily in Telugu films. He was born on 23 March 1989. His ancestral roots can be traced back to Udaipur, Rajasthan.

 

Thakur Anoop Singh gained recognition for his portrayal of Dhritarashtra in the popular 2013 TV series "Mahabharat," which brought him widespread acclaim. His performance in the show showcased his acting skills and helped establish his presence in the entertainment industry.

 

Apart from acting, Thakur Anoop Singh has made significant achievements in the field of bodybuilding. In 2015, he participated in a bodybuilding contest held in Bangkok, Thailand, where he won a gold medal. This victory further solidified his reputation as a dedicated and talented bodybuilder.

 

Thakur Anoop Singh's passion for bodybuilding goes hand in hand with his acting career. He has been able to maintain a well-built physique, which has often played a crucial role in his roles on screen. His dedication to fitness and bodybuilding has earned him a substantial following and admiration from fans.

Umesh Kamat

Regional Male Actor

Umesh Kamat is a talented Indian actor who has made a significant mark in the Marathi film industry. Born on December 12, 1980, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, Umesh began his career in the entertainment industry as a model before transitioning into acting.

 

Known for his charming persona and versatile acting skills, Umesh Kamat has delivered noteworthy performances in both movies and television shows. He has portrayed a wide range of characters, showcasing his ability to bring depth and authenticity to his roles. His charismatic presence on screen has won the hearts of audiences across Maharashtra.

 

Umesh Kamat's notable works include films like "Time Please," "A Paying Ghost," and "Guru Pournima," among others. His performances have earned him critical acclaim and numerous awards, further solidifying his position as one of the leading actors in Marathi cinema.

 

Beyond his acting career, Umesh Kamat is actively involved in social causes and has been associated with various charitable organizations. He is admired not only for his talent but also for his humility and dedication to his craft.

With his captivating performances and commitment to his art, Umesh Kamat continues to captivate audiences and contribute to the growth of Marathi cinema. His talent and passion make him a cherished figure in the industry, and his future endeavors are eagerly awaited by fans and critics alike.

item.title: Upendra Rao
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Upendra Rao

Regional Male Actor

Upendra is a renowned figure in the Indian film industry, known for his multifaceted talents as an actor, director, and screenwriter. Born on September 18, 1968, in Kundapura, Karnataka, Upendra's real name is Upendra Rao. He began his career as a writer and made a significant impact with his thought-provoking scripts that challenged societal norms and conventions.

 

Upendra's directorial debut came in 1999 with the critically acclaimed film "Upendra," which showcased his unique storytelling style and unconventional narrative techniques. He gained recognition for his ability to blend commercial elements with deep philosophical themes, making his films stand out in the industry.

 

As an actor, Upendra has portrayed diverse characters with great versatility and intensity. His performances are known for their rawness and the ability to connect with audiences on an emotional level. Some of his notable films include "A," "Super," and "Uppi 2."

 

Apart from his successful film career, Upendra is also known for his political activism. He formed his own political party, the "Karnataka Pragnyavanta Janata Paksha," and contested in the 2018 Karnataka Legislative Assembly elections.

item.title: V Ravichandran
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
V Ravichandran

Regional Male Actor

V Ravichandran, popularly known as "Crazy Star" Ravichandran, is a renowned Indian film actor, director, producer, music composer, and screenwriter. Born on May 30, 1961, in Hassan, Karnataka, Ravichandran has made significant contributions to the Kannada film industry, earning him a dedicated fan base.

 

Ravichandran's charismatic personality, versatile acting skills, and creative genius have established him as one of the most influential figures in Sandalwood (Kannada film industry). He is known for his experimental and innovative approach towards filmmaking, often pushing the boundaries of conventional storytelling.

 

With a career spanning over three decades, Ravichandran has acted in numerous blockbuster films, delivering memorable performances in both commercial and critically acclaimed movies. Some of his notable films include "Premaloka," "Anjada Gandu," and "Malla."

 

Apart from acting, Ravichandran has directed and produced several successful films, showcasing his multifaceted talent. He has also composed music for several of his movies, displaying his creativity in yet another artistic domain.

 

Ravichandran's contributions to the Kannada film industry have been recognized and honored with numerous awards, including several Karnataka State Film Awards and Filmfare Awards.

item.title: Vaibhav Tatwawadi
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Vaibhav Tatwawadi

Regional Male Actor

Vaibhav Tatwawadi is a talented Indian actor who has made a notable mark in the entertainment industry. Born on September 25, 1988, in Nagpur, Maharashtra, he possesses a captivating screen presence and versatile acting skills. Tatwawadi gained recognition through his work in Marathi cinema and has since expanded his horizons to Hindi and regional films.

 

With his striking looks and impeccable acting prowess, Vaibhav Tatwawadi has successfully portrayed a diverse range of characters across various genres. He has delivered memorable performances in movies like "Bajirao Mastani" (2015), where he played the role of Chimaji Appa, and "Hunterrr" (2015), in which he portrayed the character of Dilip Deshmukh.

 

Tatwawadi's ability to effortlessly blend into his characters and bring depth to his portrayals has garnered critical acclaim and a strong fan following. His dedication and commitment to his craft are evident in every role he takes on, showcasing his versatility as an actor.

 

Beyond his on-screen achievements, Tatwawadi is also known for his philanthropic efforts. He actively supports causes related to education and child welfare, using his platform to make a positive impact in society.

item.title: Varun Tej
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Varun Tej

Regional Male Actor

Varun Tej is a talented and promising actor in the Indian film industry. Born on January 19, 1990, in Hyderabad, Telangana, Varun belongs to the esteemed Konidela family, renowned for its contributions to the Telugu cinema. He is the nephew of popular Telugu actor Chiranjeevi and the younger brother of actor Ram Charan.

Varun made his acting debut in 2014 with the film "Mukunda," where he showcased his acting prowess and impressed both critics and audiences. Since then, he has been a part of several successful films, including "Kanche," "Fidaa," and "Tholi Prema." Varun's performances have been appreciated for their depth and versatility, and he has garnered a loyal fan base.

 

Apart from his acting skills, Varun Tej is known for his tall and charming persona, which adds to his on-screen presence. He has a unique ability to portray a wide range of emotions and effortlessly transition between different genres. With each film, Varun continues to evolve as an actor, exploring new characters and challenging roles.

 

Varun Tej's dedication to his craft, coupled with his natural talent, has established him as one of the most promising actors of his generation. His versatility, charm, and commitment to quality cinema make him a force to be reckoned with in the Telugu film industry. As he continues to take on diverse roles, fans eagerly anticipate his upcoming projects and the captivating performances he will bring to the silver screen.

item.title: Venkatesh Daggubati
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Venkatesh Daggubati

Regional Male Actor

Venkatesh Daggubati, born on December 13, 1960, is an acclaimed Indian film actor known for his work in Telugu cinema. He hails from a prominent film family, with his father being a well-known filmmaker. Venkatesh made his acting debut in 1986 with the film "Kaliyuga Pandavulu" and since then has appeared in numerous successful movies.

 

With a career spanning over three decades, Venkatesh has showcased his versatility by portraying a wide range of characters, including romantic leads, action heroes, and comedic roles. He has received several awards and accolades throughout his career, including several Nandi Awards for Best Actor.

 

Known for his charismatic screen presence and natural acting skills, Venkatesh has established a loyal fan base. He has collaborated with renowned directors and actors in the industry, contributing to many commercially successful films. His notable movies include "Bobbili Raja," "Prema," "Chanti," "Gharshana," "Raja," and "Drushyam," among others.

item.title: Vijay Raghavendra
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Vijay Raghavendra

Regional Male Actor

Vijay Raghavendra, a prominent Indian actor in Kannada cinema, gained recognition as "Chinnari Mutha." Born to a family of film personalities, including uncle Dr. Rajkumar, he began his career as a child artist, impressing audiences with performances in movies like "Chinnari Mutha" and "Kotreshi Kanasu," which won him the National Film Award for Best Child Artist. His lead role in "Ninagagi" (2002) marked his entry into adult roles and was a hit.

 

Despite initial setbacks, his portrayal in films like "Kallarali Hoovagi" and "Sevanthi Sevanthi" caught attention. He ventured into directing with "Kismath" (2018). Vijay secured acclaim for his portrayal of Puttaraj Gawai in "Shivayogi Sri Puttayyajja," earning the Karnataka State Film Award for Best Actor.

 

In 2013, Vijay triumphed in the debut season of the reality show "Bigg Boss" in its Kannada version. His journey encompassed around eight films as a child artist, formal acting training, and diverse roles in movies like "Kotra Highschoolige Seriddu," "Ninagagi," and "Shivayogi Sri Puttayyajja.

item.title: Vijay Sethupathi
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Vijay Sethupathi

Regional Male Actor

Vijay Sethupathi is a highly acclaimed and versatile actor who has made a significant impact on the Indian film industry. Born on January 16, 1978, in Rajapalayam, Tamil Nadu, Sethupathi began his career in the industry as a supporting actor and gradually rose to prominence with his exceptional acting skills.

 

Known for his naturalistic performances and ability to effortlessly slip into diverse roles, Sethupathi has portrayed a wide range of characters, from intense and brooding to comedic and light-hearted. His commitment to his craft and dedication to each character he plays have earned him immense praise and a loyal fan base.

 

Sethupathi's breakthrough came with the critically acclaimed film "Pizza" in 2012, and since then, he has delivered several remarkable performances in movies like "Soodhu Kavvum," "Vikram Vedha," and "96." His collaboration with acclaimed directors and actors has further solidified his position as one of the finest actors in the industry.

 

Apart from his acting prowess, Sethupathi has also ventured into producing films under his banner, which showcases his passion for storytelling and his desire to support new talent.

item.content:encoded:
Vishwak Sen

Regional Male Actor

Vishwak Sen, an emerging talent in the Indian film industry, has captivated audiences with his remarkable acting skills and distinctive screen presence. Born on October 29, 1995, in Hyderabad, Vishwak Sen began his journey in the world of entertainment as a theater artist. He gained recognition for his exceptional performances in various plays before making his debut in the Telugu film industry.

 

In 2019, Vishwak Sen caught the attention of both critics and viewers with his breakthrough role in the film "Falaknuma Das," which he also directed. His portrayal of the conflicted protagonist showcased his versatility and garnered him widespread acclaim. Known for his intense performances, Vishwak Sen has since delivered exceptional performances in films like "HIT: The First Case" and "Paagal."

 

With his youthful charm and ability to effortlessly immerse himself in his characters, Vishwak Sen continues to push boundaries and experiment with diverse roles. He has quickly become a sought-after actor, and his natural talent has earned him a dedicated fan base. Apart from acting, Vishwak Sen has also shown his passion for storytelling through his directorial ventures.

 

As an actor and director, Vishwak Sen represents the new wave of talent in the Telugu film industry, and his remarkable potential promises an exciting future filled with even more memorable performances.

item.title: A R Rahman
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
A.R. Rahman

Playback Male Singer

A.R. Rahman is an Indian music composer, record producer, singer, songwriter, musician, multi-instrumentalist and philanthropist, popular for his works in Indian cinema; predominantly in Tamil. He is known for his fusion of Indian classical music with electronic music and world music influences. He has won two Academy Awards, two Grammy Awards, a BAFTA Award, a Golden Globe Award, fifteen Filmfare Awards and seventeen Filmfare Awards South. In 2010, the Indian government conferred him with the Padma Bhushan, the nation's third-highest civilian award.

 

Rahman was born in Chennai, India, in 1967. He began his musical training at a young age, learning to play the piano and violin. He later studied Western classical music at the Trinity College of Music in London. After graduating, Rahman returned to India and began composing music for films.

 

Rahman's first major success came with the Tamil film Roja (1992). The film's soundtrack was a huge hit, and it launched Rahman's career as a leading music composer in India. He has since composed music for over 100 films, including some of the biggest blockbusters in Indian cinema.

item.title: Aaman Trikha
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Aaman Trikha

Playback Male Singer

Aaman Trikha is an Indian playback singer who has sung songs in Hindi, English, and other languages. He was born in Mumbai, India, and started playing keyboards without any formal training. In 2005, while in the first year of pursuing his Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.) in Electronics & Telecommunication from Thakur College of Engineering and Technology, he discovered that he could sing. He then started participating in various singing competitions and won several awards.

 

In 2009, Trikha made his playback singing debut with the song "Dilruba" for the film "99". He then went on to sing for many popular Bollywood films, including "Gumraah", "Khiladi 786", "Policegiri", "Prem Ratan Dhan Payo", and "Son of Sardaar". He has also sung for several television shows and commercials.

 

Trikha has won several awards for his singing, including the Mirchi Music Award for Best Male Playback Singer for the song "Hookah Bar" from the film "Gumraah". He is also a recipient of the Zee Cine Award for Best Male Playback Singer for the song "Jaaneman Aah" from the film "Prem Ratan Dhan Payo".

 

Trikha is known for his soulful voice and his ability to connect with the listener. He is also known for his humble personality and simple lifestyle. He is one of the most popular singers in India today, and his songs have been enjoyed by millions of people around the world.

item.title: Aamir Ali
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Aamir Ali Sultan

Playback Male Singer

Aamir Ali Sultan is a talented playback singer, songwriter, composer, and performer. He gained recognition for his work as a playback singer in the movie "Master," which features the renowned actor Thalapathy Vijay. In Hindi, the film is known as "Vijay The Master." Aamir Ali Sultan was born in Bhagalpur, Bihar.

 

He has also lent his vocals to the Hindi title song of the highly successful Kannada movie "Damayanthi," starring Radhika Kumaraswamy. Aamir Ali Sultan's recent album "Shor" has received significant acclaim and popularity. He is a verified artist on popular music platforms like Spotify and JioSaavn.

 

Aamir Ali Sultan has showcased his versatile talent by contributing as one of the singers in the album "Jayatu Jayatu Bharatam." Additionally, he holds the prestigious distinction of being a TEDxSpeaker and has served as a judge for several prominent youth festivals in Asia.

 

Apart from his playback singing, Aamir Ali Sultan has established himself as a skilled songwriter, composer, and performer. Some of his notable works include "Nanhi Pari," "Ashq," "One Nation One Voice," "Hot Fountain," and the aforementioned "Shor" and "Master."

item.title: Abhijeet Sawant
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Abhijeet Sawant

Playback Male Singer

Abhijeet Sawant is an Indian playback singer, television personality, and actor. He is best known for winning the first season of Indian Idol in 2004. He has since sung for many popular Bollywood films, including Kal Ho Naa Ho, Fanaa, Om Shanti Om, and Agneepath. He has also released several solo albums.

 

Sawant was born in Mumbai, India, on October 7, 1981. He started singing at a very young age and participated in several singing competitions. In 2004, he auditioned for the first season of Indian Idol and was selected as one of the top 12 contestants. He went on to win the show and became a household name.

 

After winning Indian Idol, Sawant signed a recording contract with Sony Music India and released his debut album, Abhijeet Sawant, in 2005. The album was a commercial success and featured the hit songs Kal Ho Naa Ho and Tujhe Dekha To. He has since released several more albums, including Abhi Mujh Mein Kahi (2006), Soch (2007), and Abhijeet Sawant Live (2008).

 

Sawant has also sung for many popular Bollywood films. Some of his most popular songs include Kal Ho Naa Ho (Kal Ho Naa Ho), Fanaa (Fanaa), Om Shanti Om (Om Shanti Om). He has also sung for several television shows and commercials.

item.title: Abhijit Ghoshal
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Abhijit Ghoshal

Playback Male Singer

Abhijit Ghoshal is an Indian playback singer known for his work in the Bollywood film industry. He was born on October 27, 1976, in Kolkata, West Bengal, India. Abhijit Ghoshal has lent his melodious voice to numerous popular songs in Hindi cinema.

 

Abhijit Ghoshal started his singing career by participating in various music reality shows and competitions. He gained recognition and appreciation for his soulful and versatile singing style. His talent caught the attention of music directors and composers in the industry, leading to opportunities for playback singing.

 

Some of Abhijit Ghoshal's notable songs include "Main Agar Kahoon" from the movie "Om Shanti Om," "Mohabbatein Lutaunga" from "Aap Kaa Surroor," "Saathiya" from "Singham," "Mujhe Neend Na Aaye" from "Dil," and many more. He has collaborated with renowned music directors and singers in the industry, showcasing his vocal prowess and emotional depth in his renditions.
