item.title: Aditya Narayan
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Aditya Narayan

Playback Male Singer

Aditya Narayan is an Indian playback singer, television host, and actor. He is the son of veteran playback singer Udit Narayan. He has hosted several popular Indian television shows, including Indian Idol and Sa Re Ga Ma Pa. He has also starred in a few Bollywood films, including Shaapit and Dil Bechara.

 

Aditya Narayan was born on 6 August 1987 in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. He started his career as a child artist, appearing in several television commercials and films. In 1996, he sang his first song, "Chhota Baccha Jaan Ke", for the film Masoom. The song was a huge success and launched Narayan's career as a playback singer.

 

Since then, Narayan has sung for many popular Bollywood films, including "Akele Hum Akele Tum", "Hum Dil De Chuke Sanam", "Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham", and "Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge". He has also released several solo albums, including "Aditya Narayan" (2000), "Aditya Narayan 2" (2002), and "Aditya Narayan 3" (2004).

 

In addition to his singing career, Narayan has also hosted several popular Indian television shows, including Indian Idol (2004-2005, 2010-2011, 2018-2019), Sa Re Ga Ma Pa (2007-2008, 2011-2012, 2016-2017), and Jhalak Dikhhla Jaa (2010). He has also starred in a few Bollywood films, including Shaapit (2010) and Dil Bechara (2020).

item.title: Aftab & Hashim Sabri
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Aftab Sabri and Hashim Sabri

Playback Male Singer

Aftab Sabri and Hashim Sabri are renowned qawwali singers hailing from India. They are brothers and come from a rich musical lineage. Qawwali is a devotional form of music that originated in the Sufi tradition.

 

Aftab and Hashim Sabri have inherited the art of qawwali from their father, Ustad Meraj Ahmed Nizami Sabri, who was a celebrated qawwali singer himself. The brothers have continued the family legacy and have gained recognition for their powerful and soulful performances.

 

Their renditions are characterized by their dynamic vocals, rhythmic patterns, and emotional depth. Aftab and Hashim Sabri have performed at numerous prestigious events, concerts, and festivals, both in India and internationally, mesmerizing audiences with their captivating performances.

item.content:encoded:
Altaaf Sayyed

Playback Male Singer

Altaaf Sayyed is a talented singer known for his soulful voice and heartfelt renditions of songs. Hailing from India, Altaaf has made a name for himself in the music industry with his unique vocal range and ability to connect with listeners on an emotional level.

 

With a passion for music that dates back to his childhood, Altaaf embarked on his musical journey and quickly gained recognition for his exceptional talent. His melodious voice, combined with his versatility in various genres like Bollywood, Sufi, and romantic ballads, has garnered him a dedicated fan base.

 

Altaaf's songs are characterized by their meaningful lyrics and the depth of emotions he conveys through his vocals. His ability to infuse each note with passion and sincerity has earned him critical acclaim and adoration from fans worldwide.

 

Beyond his musical prowess, Altaaf is also known for his philanthropic endeavors. He actively uses his platform to support charitable causes and raise awareness about social issues, showcasing his compassionate nature and commitment to making a positive impact on society.

item.title: Amaal Mallik
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Amaal Mallik

Playback Male Singer

Amaal Mallik is a prominent Indian music composer and playback singer known for his contributions to the Bollywood film industry. He was born on June 16, 1990, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, into a musical family. His grandfather, Sardar Malik, and his father, Daboo Malik, are both renowned music directors.

Amaal Mallik made his mark in the industry with his debut song "Naina" from the movie "Khoobsurat" in 2014. However, it was his composition for the film "Roy" that gained him widespread recognition. The song "Sooraj Dooba Hain" became a chartbuster and established him as a talented music composer.

Since then, Amaal Mallik has composed and sung for numerous successful Bollywood films, delivering hit tracks like "Main Hoon Hero Tera," "Kar Gayi Chull," and "Bol Do Na Zara." His compositions often have a contemporary and melodious touch, blending various genres and incorporating catchy hooks.

Apart from his film projects, Amaal Mallik has also collaborated with independent artists and released singles like "Ghar Se Nikalte Hi" and "Tu Mera Nahi." His ability to create melodies that resonate with the audience, combined with his soulful voice, has garnered him a loyal fan base.

item.title: Ami Mishra
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Ami Mishra

Playback Male Singer

Ami Mishra is an Indian singer and music composer known for his soulful and melodious compositions in the Bollywood film industry. Born on July 12, 1987, in Jaunpur, Uttar Pradesh, Mishra showed an early inclination towards music and started learning classical music at a young age. He later pursued a degree in engineering but realized his true passion lay in music.

 

Mishra gained widespread recognition with his debut song "Hasi" from the movie "Hamari Adhuri Kahani" in 2015. The song received critical acclaim and earned him a nomination for the Filmfare Award for Best Male Playback Singer. His soothing voice and heartfelt renditions struck a chord with the audience, making him a sought-after artist in the industry.

 

Since then, Ami Mishra has lent his voice to several popular Bollywood tracks, including "Main Rahoon Ya Na Rahoon," "Lost Without You," and "Meri Maa" among others. His unique blend of emotions, backed by soul-stirring compositions, has made him a favorite among music lovers.

item.title: Anirudh Ravichander
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Anirudh Ravichander

Playback Male Singer

Anirudh Ravichander, the young and dynamic music composer, has carved a niche for himself in the Indian music industry. Born on October 16, 1990, in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, Anirudh is known for his unique style of composing music that effortlessly blends different genres and appeals to a wide audience.

 

Anirudh rose to fame with his debut song "Why This Kolaveri Di" from the Tamil film "3" in 2012. The song became an overnight sensation and garnered millions of views on various digital platforms. Since then, there has been no looking back for him. He has consistently delivered chart-topping hits and has worked with some of the biggest names in the industry.

 

What sets Anirudh apart from other composers is his ability to experiment with different musical styles. Whether it is a peppy dance number, a soulful melody, or a romantic ballad, he brings a unique touch to each composition. His music is known for its catchy tunes, foot-tapping beats, and relatable lyrics, making it a hit among the youth.

 

Apart from Tamil films, Anirudh has also composed music for Telugu and Hindi films, further expanding his reach and popularity. Some of his notable works include "Maari," "Kaththi," "Jersey," and "Master." He has also won several awards for his exceptional work, including Filmfare Awards and Vijay Awards.

 

In addition to his film compositions, Anirudh has also ventured into independent music. He has released several singles, which have received positive reviews and millions of views on YouTube. His collaboration with renowned artists such as Arjun Kanungo and Jonita Gandhi has further showcased his versatility and ability to transcend language barriers.

item.title: Ankit Tiwari
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Altaaf Sayyed

Playback Male Singer

Ankit Tiwari is an acclaimed Indian playback singer and music composer known for his soulful and melodious compositions in the Bollywood music industry. He was born on March 6, 1986, in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh. Ankit gained prominence with his debut song "Sunn Raha Hai" from the film "Aashiqui 2" in 2013. The song became a massive hit and earned him widespread recognition and critical acclaim.

 

Ankit Tiwari's voice is characterized by its depth and emotional appeal, which adds a unique flavor to his compositions. He has delivered several chart-topping songs, including "Galliyan," "Tu Hai Ki Nahi," and "Dil Cheez Tujhe Dedi." His compositions often have a blend of romantic and soul-stirring elements that resonate with listeners.

 

Apart from singing, Ankit Tiwari has also showcased his skills as a music composer, creating captivating melodies for various films. He has been nominated for and won several awards for his exceptional contributions, including the Filmfare Award for Best Music Director.

 

With his passionate voice and heartfelt compositions, Ankit Tiwari continues to captivate audiences with his music. He remains a sought-after artist in the Indian music industry, known for his ability to evoke emotions through his soulful renditions.

item.title: Anuj Gurwara
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Anuj Gurwara

Playback Male Singer

Anuj Gurwara is an Indian playback singer who made his debut in the Telugu film industry, also known as Tollywood, in 2009. Despite not knowing how to speak Telugu initially, he ventured into playback singing and gained recognition with his first Telugu song, "Panchadara Bomma," from the film Magadheera. The movie, directed by S. S. Rajamouli, became one of the highest-grossing Telugu films of all time.

 

Anuj's rendition of "Panchadara Bomma" quickly became a massive hit and established him as a fresh new voice in the music industry. The song received widespread acclaim and was hailed as the best song in Rajamouli's career. It also won several awards and was declared the Top Telugu Song of the year 2009 by various media channels.

 

Notably, "Panchadara Bomma" achieved significant commercial success, generating over Rs 30 million in revenue from mobile phone ringtone downloads alone. This accomplishment set a record in Telugu cinema and showcased the immense popularity of the song.

item.title: Anupam Roy
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Anupam Roy

Playback Male Singer

Anupam Roy is a multi-talented Indian singer-songwriter, music director, composer, guitarist, and playback singer hailing from Kolkata, West Bengal. Born on 29 March 1982, he made his debut in the music industry with the songs "Amake Amar Moto Thakte Dao" and "Benche Thakar Gaan," which were featured on the soundtrack of the Bengali film Autograph in 2010.

 

Anupam Roy has since become a prominent figure in the Bengali music scene, contributing as a composer, lyricist, and singer for numerous Bengali films. His compositions are known for their soulful melodies and meaningful lyrics. In 2015, he made his Bollywood debut as a music composer with the critically acclaimed film Piku. His work in Piku earned him a nomination for the Filmfare Award for Best Music Director and he won the Filmfare Award for Best Background Score.

 

With his talent and versatility, Anupam Roy has received several accolades throughout his career. He is a recipient of four Filmfare Awards and was honored with the 64th National Film Award for Best Lyrics for the song "Tumi Jaake Bhalobasho."

 

Anupam Roy's contributions to the music industry, both in Bengali and Hindi cinema, have garnered him widespread recognition and appreciation. He continues to captivate audiences with his soul-stirring compositions and remains a celebrated musician in India.

item.title: Arijit Singh
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Arijit Singh

Playback Male Singer

Arijit Singh is an Indian singer and music composer. He was born on 25 April 1987 in Jiaganj, Murshidabad, West Bengal. He began his music training at a very young age at home. His maternal aunt trained in Indian classical music, and his maternal grandmother used to sing. His maternal uncle played the tabla, and his mother also sang and played the tabla. He studied at Raja Bijay Singh High School and later at the Sripat Singh College, a University of Kalyani affiliate.

 

Singh began his career when he participated in the contemporary reality show, Fame Gurukul in 2005, but did not receive widespread recognition until the release of "Tum Hi Ho" and "Chahun Main Ya Naa" in 2013. He has since gone on to record songs for many popular Bollywood films, including "Aashiqui 2", "Barfi!", "Yeh Jawaani Hai Deewani", "Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge", and "Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham". He has won numerous awards for his singing, including a National Film Award and seven Filmfare Awards.

 

Singh is known for his soulful voice and his ability to connect with the listener. He is also known for his humble personality and simple lifestyle. He is one of the most popular singers in India today, and his songs have been enjoyed by millions of people around the world.

item.title: Armaan Malik
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Armaan Malik

Playback Male Singer

Armaan Malik is a young and talented playback singer who has made a mark in the Bollywood music industry with his melodious voice. Known for his romantic tracks and soulful renditions, Armaan Malik has a wide vocal range and a captivating stage presence. Some of his popular songs include "Main Rahoon Ya Na Rahoon," "Bol Do Na Zara," and "Sab Tera." Armaan's ability to express emotions through his singing and his ability to connect with the audience make him a favorite among music lovers.

 

Armaan Malik is an Indian singer and songwriter. He was born on 22 July 1995 in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. He began his career as a child artist, appearing in several television commercials and films. In 2011, he made his singing debut with the song "Sau Dard Hain" for the film Murder 2. The song was a huge success and launched Malik's career as a playback singer.

 

Since then, Malik has sung for many popular Bollywood films, including "Azhar", "Jab Harry Met Sejal", "Padmaavat", and "Bharat". He has won numerous awards for his singing, including a Filmfare Award for Best Male Playback Singer for the song "Tujhe Dekha To" from the film "Azhar".

item.title: Ash King
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Arijit Singh

Playback Male Singer

Ash King is a talented singer known for his contributions to both Bollywood and the UK music scene. His first breakthrough in Bollywood came with A. R. Rahman's film Delhi-6, where he recorded at Rahman's personal studio. Impressed by King's voice, Rahman invited him to Chennai to record in his private studio, leading to a successful collaboration.

 

Since then, Ash King has sung notable tracks such as "Te Amo" from the film Dum Maaro Dum and "I Love You" from the film Bodyguard. He was also featured on the remix of Lady Gaga's "Bad Romance" and collaborated with artists like Ramzi and Hard Kaur on various projects.

 

In the UK, Ash King has gained recognition as a prominent singer. He co-wrote and sang the song "Love Is Blind" with Ramzi and featured on "Look For Me" with Hard Kaur. He has performed at major events in the UK, including the Glastonbury Festival and the BBC London Mela.

 

In 2012, Ash King was appointed for the Bengali song "Kothin" for the film Bojhena Shey Bojhena. He also participated in MTV India's 'MTV Unplugged' series and headlined a concert at the Southbank Centre in London alongside Harshdeep Kaur.

 

Ash King's versatile vocals and successful collaborations have cemented his position as a respected singer in both Bollywood and the UK music industry. He continues to captivate audiences with his soulful renditions and remains a sought-after artist in the music world.

item.title: Anurag Kulkarni
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Anurag Kulkarni

Playback Male Singer

Anurag Kulkarni, born in Kamareddy, Telangana, is an Indian playback singer known for his work in the Telugu music industry. Despite being born into a Marathi family, he has made a name for himself in the Telugu music scene.

 

Anurag received his musical training in Hindustani classical music from the renowned vocalist and guru, Kakunoori Jangaiah, who belonged to the kirana gharana style of singing.

 

In 2015, Anurag participated in and won the eighth season of the Telugu reality singing competition, Idea Super Singer. This victory served as a platform for his career in the industry.

 

Anurag has been actively recording songs in the Telugu language and has achieved remarkable success. In an interview, he mentioned having recorded more than 800 songs in Telugu by August 2021. His melodious and versatile voice has earned him popularity among music lovers, and he has lent his vocals to numerous film songs.

 

Anurag Kulkarni's dedication to music and his extensive repertoire of recorded songs have established him as a talented and sought-after playback singer in the Telugu music industry.

item.title: Alphons Joseph
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Alphons Joseph

Playback Male Singer

Alphons Joseph is an Indian music director and playback singer who works in the Malayalam film industry. He debuted with the 2003 movie Vellithira. Alphons is also known for singing "Aaromale" from the film Vinnaithaandi Varuvaayaa, which was composed by A. R. Rahman.

 

He is the lead guitarist, vocalist, and one of the founders of Rexband, a gospel music band with a few albums to their credit. This band experimented a lot in gospel music by blending Western music with Hindustani and Carnatic. They have listeners all over the world and the only Asian Band, which got a chance to participate in World Youth Day.

 

From 2000 onwards, he started working as a composer and a sound engineer in Asia-net Radio 657AM, a radio station in Dubai. He worked there even after the release of his first film soundtrack and composed many jingles and title songs as part of his work.

 

Some of his notable works as a music director include Varane Avashyamund, Panthrand, Oru Kadath Naadan Katha, Lonappante Mammodisa, Akkaldamayile Pennu, and Kathai Thiraikathai Vasanam Iyakkam. He has also composed music for a few short films and music videos.

 

Alphons Joseph is a talented musician who has made a significant contribution to the Malayalam film industry. His music is known for its freshness, originality, and soulfulness. He is one of the most sought-after music directors in Malayalam cinema today.

item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
B Praak

Playback Male Singer

B Praak is a talented singer and composer who has gained popularity with his soulful and emotional renditions. He has a unique voice that strikes a chord with listeners, and his songs often evoke deep emotions. Some of his popular tracks include "Teri Mitti," "Filhall," and "Mann Bharrya." B Praak's heartfelt singing and his ability to bring out the emotional essence of a song have made him a sought-after artist in the industry.

item.title: Badshah
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Badshah

Playback Male Singer

Aditya Prateek Singh Sisodia, popularly known by his stage name Badshah, is a renowned Indian rapper, singer, film producer, and businessman. Born on 19 November 1985, he has gained fame for his Hindi, Haryanvi, and Punjabi music.

 

Badshah began his career in 2006 as part of the hip-hop group Mafia Mundeer, alongside Yo Yo Honey Singh. He gained recognition and popularity with his independent Haryanvi song "Kar Gayi Chull," which was later included in the Bollywood film Kapoor & Sons in 2016. His music has been featured in several Bollywood soundtracks, including films like Humpty Sharma Ki Dulhania and Khoobsurat.

 

One of his notable achievements was his debut single "DJ Waley Babu," featuring Aastha Gill, which reached number one on the Indian iTunes charts within 24 hours of its release. The song also garnered millions of views on YouTube in a short span of time. Badshah's collaboration with Navv Inder on "Wakhra Swag" won awards at the Punjabi Music Awards.

 

Badshah has been featured on Forbes India's Celebrity 100 list in 2017, 2018, and 2019, recognizing him as one of the highest-paid celebrities in India and the only rapper in the list. He has achieved tremendous success with his commercial works, consistently topping charts including YouTube Music Video Charts, BBC Asian Network Charts, and various Indian radio and streaming charts.

item.title: Benny Dayal
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Benny Dayal

Playback Male Singer

Benny Dayal, born on 13 May 1984, is a versatile Indian playback singer known for his contributions to various Indian film industries. He has showcased his talent in languages such as Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, Kannada, Bengali, Gujarati, Marathi, and more. With a career spanning across different regions, Benny has sung over 3500 songs in multiple languages.

 

Benny's journey began as a member of the band S5, which was launched by the SS Music TV channel. His talent caught the attention of renowned composer A.R. Rahman when he made his acting debut in the Malayalam movie "By the People," where all the songs were sung by S5 members. Impressed by his vocals, Rahman offered Benny an audition, which marked the beginning of his successful career as a playback singer.

 

Benny Dayal's energetic and soulful voice has captivated audiences in films across various languages. He has collaborated with numerous composers and delivered hit songs in the Indian music industry. His versatility and ability to adapt to different musical styles have made him a sought-after singer.

 

With his remarkable vocal range and passion for music, Benny Dayal continues to make his mark in the industry, earning accolades for his contributions to film soundtracks. He remains a beloved figure among music enthusiasts, and his impressive discography reflects his versatility and talent as a playback singer.

item.title: Bhaven Dhanak
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Bhaven Dhanak

Playback Male Singer

Bhaven Dhanak is a professional singer hailing from Mumbai, the capital of Maharashtra, India. Born and raised in Dubai, he developed a strong passion for music from a young age. Initially, Bhaven started playing musical instruments like the keyboard and guitar before transitioning into singing.

 

His journey in the music industry began with his participation in Zee TV's Sa Re Ga Ma Pa Dubai. Encouraged by his success, Bhaven moved to Mumbai to further pursue his dreams. There, he had the privilege of learning music under the guidance of the renowned Padma Bhushan Ustad Ghulam Mustafa Khan, who helped refine his singing skills.

 

Bhaven's talent caught the attention of many, and he secured a place in the top 16 contestants of Indian Idol 3. His impressive performances on the show showcased his vocal prowess and garnered him recognition.

 

Following his stint on Indian Idol, Bhaven started working as a demo singer for esteemed music directors such as Sandesh Shandaliya, Pritam, Lalit Pandit, Amit Trivedi, and Sachin Jigar. His first recording for a feature film came with Rakesh Roshan's "Krazzy 4." He has also lent his voice to films like Rishi Kapoor's "Chintu Ji," Ram Gopal Verma's "Agyaat," and several advertisements.

item.title: Bhavin Shastri
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Bhavin Shastri

Playback Male Singer

Bhavin Shastri is a renowned Sufi singer whose mesmerizing voice has captivated audiences around the world. Born into a family of musicians, he inherited a deep love for Sufi music from an early age. With his soulful renditions and mastery over various musical instruments, Bhavin has carved a niche for himself in the world of Sufi music.

 

What sets Bhavin apart is his ability to effortlessly blend traditional Sufi melodies with contemporary elements, creating a unique and enchanting musical experience. His rich, velvety voice carries the essence of mysticism and spirituality, evoking a sense of transcendence in his listeners.

 

Bhavin's performances are not just musical spectacles; they are transformative journeys that transport the audience to a higher plane of consciousness. His soul-stirring melodies and heartfelt lyrics touch the deepest chords of the human spirit, invoking a sense of peace, love, and unity.

item.title: Bishakh jyoti
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Bishakh jyoti

Playback Male Singer

Bishakh Jyoti is an Indian Music Director, Indian Singer, Film Score Composer, and Live Performer.Bishakh Jyoti is a talented music composer and singer. Bishakh Jyoti has belted out many songs which have become hits and are adored by the audience. Bishakh Jyoti has been in the industry for decades and has been producing outstanding performances since the start of his career.
Bishakh Jyoti was born in the state of Maharashtra in India. Bishakh Jyoti did his schooling and then went on to earn his bachelor's degree in Psychology from Jai Hind college
Bishakh Jyoti made his debut in 2014 as a film composer in the film Babloo Happy Hai. Bishakh Jyoti was the runner-up in the Indian singing show Sa Re Ga Ma Pa . Bishakh Jyoti worked actively on the song Uhe Batiya  in the movie Babloo Happy Hai. Bishakh Jyoti in 2015 worked on another song called Chala Murari in the film Kaun Kitne Panni Me. He recently composed, produced and gave voice to "Pagal Parindey" a song from "The Kerala Story".

item.title: Biswajit Mahapatra
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Biswajit Mahapatra

Playback Male Singer

Biswajit Mahapatra gained recognition as a participant in Indian Idol Season 10 and has primarily worked as a playback singer in the Odia film industry, also known as Ollywood.

 

After his participation in the reality show "Voice of Odisha," Biswajit received offers from the Odia film industry and started contributing to Odia films from 2012 onwards. Additionally, he has released several solo albums.

 

In 2016, Biswajit Mahapatra further showcased his talent by participating in the Indian Idol reality show. His participation in both "Voice of Odisha" and "Indian Idol" helped him gain wider recognition and expand his reach as a singer.

item.title: Blaaze
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Blaaze

Playback Male Singer

Blaaze, born on Vijaya Dashami day in 1975 in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India, is a rapper and playback singer known for his work in the Indian film industry. Born into a Brahmin family, he grew up in Kitwe, Zambia, where his family traveled due to his father's architectural work. At a young age, Blaaze developed a passion for performing, starting with breakdancing on his father's designed sets when he was just nine years old.

 

His musical journey began with rap, and at the age of 16, he performed for President Chiluba of Zambia during an election campaign. Shortly after, he produced and performed in Zambia's first-ever music video, "Advice 4 Livin'," in collaboration with the Zambian national broadcasting corporation.

 

In 2002, Blaaze made his entry into the Indian film industry when acclaimed composer A.R. Rahman chose him to sing the "Baba Rap" for Rajinikanth's film "Baba." This collaboration marked the beginning of Blaaze's successful career in the Tamil cinema. He continued to work frequently with Rahman, lending his voice to songs in films like "Kangalal Kaidhu Sei," "Boys," "Enakku 20 Unakku 18," "New," "Aayutha Ezhuthu," and "Anbe Aaruyire."

item.title: Bohemia
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Bohemia

Playback Male Singer

In the early 2000s, Bohemia made a significant move to join his cousin in Oakland, California. His cousin was working at a recording studio in West Oakland, where Bohemia was introduced to a talented hip-hop producer named Sha One (Seth Agress). Recognizing their shared passion for music, they decided to form their own record label, which they named "The Outfit Entertainment."

 

During their collaboration, Sha One heard Bohemia reciting Punjabi lyrics and was impressed. He asked Bohemia to rap those lyrics over one of his beats, and they began working on creating music together. Over the following months, Bohemia wrote a collection of lyrics, which would serve as the foundation for his debut album titled "Vich Pardesan De" (In The Foreign Land). The album reflected an autobiographical account of Bohemia's life as a Desi youngster adapting to the streets of America. Both Bohemia and Sha One produced the album.

 

Although their first single, "Sha Te Ra," was released as a music video, it did not make it onto the final tracklist of "Vich Pardesan De." The album marked Bohemia's introduction to the music industry and showcased his unique style and storytelling abilities. It laid the groundwork for his subsequent success and established him as a pioneer of Punjabi rap and Desi hip-hop.

During their collaboration, Sha One heard Bohemia reciting Punjabi lyrics and was impressed. He asked Bohemia to rap those lyrics over one of his beats, and they began working on creating music together. Over the following months, Bohemia wrote a collection of lyrics, which would serve as the foundation for his debut album titled \"Vich Pardesan De\" (In The Foreign Land). The album reflected an autobiographical account of Bohemia's life as a Desi youngster adapting to the streets of America. Both Bohemia and Sha One produced the album.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Although their first single, \"Sha Te Ra,\" was released as a music video, it did not make it onto the final tracklist of \"Vich Pardesan De.\" The album marked Bohemia's introduction to the music industry and showcased his unique style and storytelling abilities. It laid the groundwork for his subsequent success and established him as a pioneer of Punjabi rap and Desi hip-hop.<\/p>","typography_typography":"custom","typography_font_weight":"bold"},"elements":[],"widgetType":"text-editor"}],"isInner":false}],"isInner":false},{"id":"3e77580","elType":"section","settings":{"background_background":"classic","background_color":"#EAF0EE8F","hover_parallax":[{"layer_position_vr":{"unit":"%","size":30},"layer_position_hr":{"unit":"%","size":40},"_id":"ac4fb18"},{"layer_position_vr":{"unit":"%","size":60},"layer_position_hr":{"unit":"%","size":20},"_id":"a1b2b38"}]},"elements":[{"id":"ef6131a","elType":"column","settings":{"_column_size":100,"_inline_size":null},"elements":[{"id":"edaef87","elType":"widget","settings":{"title":"Enquiry Form","header_size":"h3","align":"center","typography_typography":"custom","typography_font_size":{"unit":"px","size":40,"sizes":[]},"typography_font_weight":"bold","_margin":{"unit":"px","top":"40","right":"0","bottom":"20","left":"0","isLinked":false},"__globals__":{"title_color":"globals\/colors?id=6d3d44f9"}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"heading"},{"id":"c4db438","elType":"widget","settings":{"shortcode":"[forminator_form id=\"5483\"]","_margin":{"unit":"px","top":"0","right":"0","bottom":"40","left":"0","isLinked":false}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"shortcode"}],"isInner":false}],"isInner":false}]

item.title: Brajesh Sandeliya
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Brijesh Kumar

Playback Male Singer

Brijesh Kumar Tripathi, professionally known as Brijesh Shandilya, is an Indian playback singer hailing from Uttar Pradesh. He received his early musical training in classical vocals from Prayag Sangeet Samiti and completed his studies in 2005. In 2006, he moved to Mumbai to pursue a career in music.

Brijesh Shandilya's musical journey began with a focus on Indian classical music, and he also developed skills in playing instruments like tabla, guitar, and harmonium. His versatility extends to various genres, including new-age Indian classical music and Bollywood music.

One of his notable Bollywood songs is the title track from the movie "Golmaal Again" (2017), which gained popularity. Another hit song in his repertoire is "Banno" from the film "Tanu Weds Manu: Returns" (2015). In 2016, he lent his voice to the title song "Sarrainodu" for the film of the same name. In 2008, he sang "Hooriyaan" for the movie "Oye Lucky! Lucky Oye!". In 2013, he contributed to the song "Fauji" in the film "War Chhod Na Yaar". In 2015, he delivered the track "Mera Nachan Nu" for the movie "Airlift".

Brijesh Shandilya has showcased his talent and versatility through his work in Bollywood, providing soulful and energetic vocals to a range of songs. His contributions to the industry have earned him recognition and appreciation from audiences and music lovers.

item.title: Babul Supriyo
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Babul Supriyo

Playback Male Singer

Babul Supriyo, born on 15 December 1970, is a multi-talented Indian personality known for his contributions as a playback singer, live performer, television host, actor, and politician. He has made a notable career in Hindi cinema as a playback singer since the mid-1990s and has sung for numerous films in Hindi, Bengali, and Odia languages. He has also lent his voice to songs in several other languages.

 

In addition to his musical career, Babul Supriyo ventured into politics and served as a Member of Parliament from Asansol in the 16th and 17th Lok Sabha. He held various ministerial positions in the Union Council of Ministers, including Minister of State for Environment, Forest and Climate Change, and Minister of State for Ministry of Urban Development and Ministry of Heavy Industries and Public Enterprises.

 

Babul Supriyo resigned as a Member of Parliament in October 2021 and subsequently joined the All India Trinamool Congress Party after leaving the Bhartiya Janata Party. He was later elected as a Member of the West Bengal Legislative Assembly from the Ballygunge Assembly seat in April 2022.

item.title: Chandan Shetty
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Chandan Shetty

Playback Male Singer

Chandan Shetty, born on September 17, 1989, is an Indian composer, lyricist, and pop singer known for his work in Kannada films. He gained popularity as a solo artist with his Kannada singles, including "Halagode," "3 Peg," "Chocolate Girl," "Tequila," "Fire," and "Party Freak." These songs showcased his unique style and energetic performances, making him a favorite among the Kannada music audience.

 

Shetty began his journey in the music industry in 2012 as a lyricist and assistant music director for the movie "Alemaari," working alongside renowned music director Arjun Janya. He then went on to contribute to the music of various films such as "Varadanayaka," "Power," "Chakravyuha," and "Bhajarangi," showcasing his versatility and talent in composing and writing music.

 

In addition to his musical career, Chandan Shetty also gained attention through his participation in the reality show "Bigg Boss Kannada Season 5," where he emerged as the winner. During the show, he got engaged to his fellow contestant Niveditha Gowda, and the couple later tied the knot on February 25, 2020.

item.title: chetan fefar
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Chetan Fefar

Playback Male Singer

Chetan Fefar is a talented Indian singer known for his versatile vocal range and captivating performances. Born in Morbi, Gujarat, Chetan has been actively pursuing his passion for music for over a decade. Currently based in Mumbai, he has established himself as a professional singer and live performer.

 

Chetan has received training from esteemed gurus including Ustad Aslam Khan, an Indian classical singer, Abhijit Ghosal, and Dr. Ritu Johri. His musical journey began at the age of 14 when he participated in competitions and events in schools and his hometown. While pursuing his engineering degree, he started performing as a live performer with his band, 'The Off Beat Band,' and gained popularity through numerous shows in Gujarat.

 

Known for his soulful renditions of Bollywood numbers, both new and retro, Chetan has showcased his exceptional voice texture and stage presence. He has also performed in various Gujarati shows and has been recognized as a prominent Garba singer, performing during Navratris in Mumbai and Gujarat.

 

Chetan's talent has taken him beyond national borders as he has traveled internationally for concerts in Hong Kong and the UAE (Dubai). He has had the opportunity to share the stage with renowned Bollywood singers such as Parthiv Gohil and Isheta Sarkar. Chetan has also been featured in the web show 'Times of Music' with the musical duo Sachin-Jigar.

 

In addition to his live performances, Chetan has contributed to the film and animation industries as a singer. He has lent his voice to films like 'Angrezi Me Kahete Hai,' 'All Are Welcome' (Gujarati), and 'DevaRattam' (Hindi), as well as cartoons such as 'Oye Golu' (Disney) and 'Horrid Henry.'

Throughout his musical journey, Chetan has achieved remarkable milestones, winning state-level competitions and being recognized as a top 100 contestant in Indian Idol 2010. He has garnered accolades, including being honored by Kavita Seth, famous for the song 'Iktara,' in a singing competition on Radio Madhuban.

item.title: Chetan Rana
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Chetan Ranaf

Playback Male Singer

Chetan Rana is an acclaimed singer in the Hindi music industry, known for his passion and talent in singing. His journey in music began during his childhood, where he developed a natural inclination towards singing and music. Whenever he heard a song on the radio, Chetan would find himself humming along, showcasing his innate musical abilities.

 

During his school days, Chetan's talent was discovered by his teacher when he was caught humming a tune. However, instead of punishment, he was encouraged to sing during free periods and school events, becoming a source of entertainment for his classmates.

 

One memorable incident during his childhood was when Chetan sang the song "Meri Lottery" from the movie "Holi Ayee Re," originally sung by the legendary singer Kishore Kumar. This led to him being affectionately called "Meri Lottery" in school, highlighting the impact of his singing abilities.

 

In 1984, while working at Canara Bank, Chetan continued to showcase his musical talent during anniversaries and company functions, mesmerizing everyone with his melodious voice. Encouraged by the support and appreciation from his friends and family, he decided to pursue singing as a career.

item.title: Chetan Sashital
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Chetan Sashital

Playback Male Singer

Chetan Sashital is an accomplished Indian playback singer, composer, and voice actor who has made a mark in the entertainment industry. He has contributed his talent to both the Hindi and Marathi film industries, lending his voice to numerous songs and characters.

 

Chetan Sashital's singing career began in the 1990s, and he has worked with renowned music composers and directors. He has sung in various genres, including romantic, devotional, and peppy tracks, showcasing his versatility as a vocalist.

 

Apart from playback singing, Chetan Sashital has also ventured into composing music for Marathi films. His compositions have garnered appreciation for their soulful melodies and unique arrangements.

 

In addition to his work in music, Chetan Sashital has also lent his voice to animated characters in popular children's shows and movies. His voice acting skills have added depth and character to various animated projects, making him a sought-after voice artist in the industry.

item.title: Chetan Sosca
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Chetan Sosca

Playback Male Singer

Krishna, a prominent playback singer in the Kannada film industry, made his debut in 2001 with the movie "Kothigalu Saar Kothigalu." Since then, he has sung over 1000 songs in Kannada films, collaborating with renowned music composers such as Hamsalekha, Mano Murthy, Hari Krishna, V Manohar, R P Patnaik, and Guru Kiran.

His breakthrough song came in 2007 with the pathos song "Janumada Gelathi" from the film "Cheluvina Chittara," which garnered him recognition and opened doors for more opportunities. Subsequently, he recorded songs for notable films like "Moggina Manasu," "Taj Mahal," and "Chaitrada Chandrama" in 2008.

In 2009, Krishna's song "Yaare Nee Devatheya" from the film "Ambaari" won several prestigious awards, including Filmfare South Indian Awards, Karnataka State Film Awards, Suvarna Film Awards, Mirchi Music Award South, and South Scope Cine Awards.

He continued his successful musical journey with hits like the title track of "Pancharangi" and its sloka version, as well as songs in films like "Krishnan Love Story" and "Adduri." In 2011, his song "Yaarig Helona" from "Lifeu Ishtene" also received critical acclaim and won several awards, including Filmfare South Indian Awards, Suvarna Film Awards, Mirchi Music Award South Indian Award, and Santhosham South Indian Award.

item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Chirag Kotwal

Playback Male Singer

Chirag Kotwal is a talented singer known for his soulful and captivating performances. With his melodious voice and versatile range, he has managed to captivate the hearts of music enthusiasts across the globe. Chirag's journey in the music industry began at a young age, and his passion for music has only grown stronger over the years.

 

Born with a natural talent for singing, Chirag has honed his skills through rigorous training and dedication. His ability to effortlessly transition between different genres, including Bollywood, Sufi, and classical music, sets him apart as a versatile artist. Chirag's voice is characterized by its warmth, depth, and emotional resonance, which allows him to connect with his audience on a profound level.

 

Chirag Kotwal's talent has been recognized and applauded by both critics and fans alike. His performances are marked by a unique blend of technical prowess and heartfelt expression, leaving a lasting impact on all who listen. As he continues to evolve as an artist, Chirag Kotwal undoubtedly has a promising future ahead in the music industry, and his contributions to the world of music will undoubtedly be cherished for years to come.

item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Chin2 Bhosle

Playback Male Singer

Chin2 Bhosle, also known as Anand Bhosle, is an Indian singer, composer, and songwriter. He is the grandson of the legendary playback singer Asha Bhosle and the great-nephew of the iconic playback singer Lata Mangeshkar.

 

Chin2 Bhosle began his musical journey at a young age and was trained in classical and contemporary music. He gained recognition with his unique vocal style and versatility in singing various genres, including pop, rock, and fusion.

 

His debut album, "Jhoom," released in 2003, showcased his talent as a singer and composer. The album featured a blend of Hindi and English songs, and the title track became a hit among music enthusiasts.

 

Chin2 Bhosle has collaborated with renowned artists and musicians, both in India and internationally. He has performed at various live concerts and music festivals, captivating audiences with his energetic stage presence and soulful singing.

 

In addition to his solo career, Chin2 Bhosle has also composed and sung songs for Bollywood films. His notable works include songs in movies like "Ishq Vishk" and "Socha Na Tha."

item.title: Daboo Malik

item.content:encoded:
Daboo Malik

Playback Male Singer

Daboo Malik is a renowned Indian music composer, singer, and songwriter. Born as Israr Sardaar Malik, he is the son of veteran music director Sardar Malik and the brother of popular Bollywood music directors Anu Malik and Abu Malik.

 

Daboo Malik began his musical journey by assisting his elder brother Anu Malik in composing music for various films. He gained recognition for his skills as a composer and went on to work independently in the industry.

 

As a music composer, Daboo Malik has composed songs for several Bollywood films, including "Main Hoon Na," "Pyaar Mein Twist," and "Masti." His compositions often feature a blend of catchy melodies, foot-tapping beats, and memorable arrangements.

 

Apart from composing, Daboo Malik is also a talented singer. He has lent his voice to a few of his compositions and has showcased his vocal abilities in various live performances and concerts.

Daboo Malik's contributions to the music industry have earned him critical acclaim and popularity among both fans and fellow musicians. His musical versatility and ability to create songs that resonate with audiences have made him a sought-after composer in Bollywood.

item.title: Daler Mehndi
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Daler Mehndi

Playback Male Singer

Daler Mehndi is a highly acclaimed Indian singer, songwriter, and performer known for his energetic and distinctive style. Born on August 18, 1967, in Patna, Bihar, he hails from a musical family and was influenced by his father, who was a classical musician.

 

Daler Mehndi rose to prominence in the 1990s with his hit song "Bolo Ta Ra Ra," which became a sensation and brought him widespread recognition. Known for his powerful and captivating voice, he specializes in various genres including Bhangra, Punjabi pop, and folk music.

 

With his dynamic stage presence and charismatic performances, Daler Mehndi has won the hearts of audiences around the world. He is known for his high-energy live shows and his ability to engage and entertain the crowd.

 

Over the years, Daler Mehndi has released numerous successful albums, featuring popular tracks like "Tunak Tunak Tun," "Ho Jayegi Balle Balle," and "Rang De Basanti." His music blends traditional Punjabi folk elements with contemporary beats, creating a unique and infectious sound.

 

In addition to his solo career, Daler Mehndi has also lent his voice to Bollywood films, contributing to the soundtracks of movies such as "Rang De Basanti," "Dhoom," and "Dil To Pagal Hai." His powerful vocals and energetic performances have made his songs a favorite choice for dance numbers in Indian cinema.

Darshan Raval

Playback Male Singer

Darshan Raval, an Indian singer, kickstarted his career in 2014 by participating in the reality show "India's Raw Star," where he emerged as the first runner-up. His success in the Bollywood industry was aided by the support of Himesh Reshammiya, who played a crucial role in his initial breakthrough.

 

Since then, Darshan Raval has gained popularity and released several hit songs in various languages, including Hindi, Gujarati, and Telugu. Some of his notable tracks include "Ek Ladki Ko Dekha Toh Aisa Laga," "Chogada," and "Kheech Meri Photo." These songs have garnered significant attention and have contributed to his growing success as a singer.

item.title: Debojit Saha
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Debojit Saha

Playback Male Singer

Debojit Saha is an Indian playback singer known for his soulful and versatile voice. He gained popularity as the winner of the reality singing competition show, "Sa Re Ga Ma Pa Challenge 2005." Born on December 21, 1981, in Silchar, Assam, Debojit hails from a musically inclined family and developed a passion for singing at a young age.

 

Debojit Saha's journey to fame began with his participation in "Sa Re Ga Ma Pa Challenge 2005," where he showcased his impressive vocal range and captivating performances. His powerful and emotive renditions of various genres, including Indian classical, Bollywood, and folk songs, earned him accolades from both the judges and the audience.

 

After winning the show, Debojit Saha made his mark in the music industry as a playback singer. He has lent his melodious voice to numerous Bollywood songs, creating a distinct presence with his heartfelt renditions. Some of his notable songs include "Kaisa Lagta Hai" from the film "Baaghi," "Mujhmein Tu" from "Special 26," and "Rabba" from "Musafir."

item.title: Dev Negi
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Dev Negi

Playback Male Singer

Dev Negi is an Indian playback singer known for his work in the Bollywood music industry. He was born on June 25, 1989, in Dwarahat, Uttarakhand, India. Dev Negi gained popularity with his hit song "Ishq Wala Love" from the movie "Student of the Year" (2012).

 

Dev Negi's journey in the music industry began with reality shows. He participated in singing competitions like "Indian Idol 2" and "Jo Jeeta Wohi Superstar." However, his breakthrough came with his debut song in Bollywood.

 

Since then, Dev Negi has lent his voice to several successful Bollywood tracks. Some of his popular songs include "Badri Ki Dulhania" from the movie "Badrinath Ki Dulhania," "Chalti Hai Kya 9 Se 12" from "Judwaa 2," "Aala Re Aala" from "Simmba," and "Psycho Saiyaan" from "Saaho."

 

Known for his versatile voice, Dev Negi has the ability to sing across various genres, from peppy dance numbers to soulful romantic melodies. His voice carries a unique charm that resonates with the audience.

 

Dev Negi continues to contribute to the music industry with his talent and dedication. His melodious vocals and energetic performances have made him a sought-after playback singer in Bollywood.

item.title: Devang Patel
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Devang Patel

Playback Male Singer

Devang Patel is an Indian singer, actor, and songwriter known for his humorous and satirical songs. Born on December 4, 1958, in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, Devang Patel has made a name for himself in the entertainment industry with his unique style and catchy tunes.

 

Devang Patel gained popularity in the 1990s with his humorous and quirky songs that often touched upon social issues and everyday life. His songs were characterized by witty lyrics, playful melodies, and a comedic touch. Some of his well-known tracks include "Meri Marzi," "Patel Rap," "Aye Raju," and "Ole Ole."

 

Apart from singing, Devang Patel has also acted in Gujarati and Hindi films. He made his acting debut with the film "Hum Sab Chor Hain" (1995) and went on to appear in movies like "Ghoonghat" and "C Kkompany." He is known for his comedic timing and lively performances on-screen.

item.title: Dhruv Sangari
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Dhruv Sangari

Playback Male Singer

Dhruv Sangari, widely known as Bilal Chishty, is a renowned Sufi singer whose ethereal voice and deep understanding of Sufism have captivated audiences around the world. Born in India, Sangari grew up in a family deeply rooted in Sufi traditions, which inspired his spiritual journey and musical path.

 

Sangari's mesmerizing vocal abilities allow him to effortlessly blend classical and contemporary styles, infusing his renditions with profound emotion and devotion. His performances are not merely musical expressions but transformative experiences, connecting listeners to the essence of Sufi teachings and the divine.

 

With his profound knowledge of Sufi poetry and mystical traditions, Dhruv Sangari has become a torchbearer of this ancient tradition, bridging the gap between generations and cultures. Through his music, he spreads a message of love, peace, and unity, encouraging individuals to embrace their spiritual selves and seek inner enlightenment.

 

Dhruv Sangari's musical prowess and soul-stirring performances have earned him accolades and a dedicated global fanbase. His enchanting melodies and heartfelt interpretations continue to touch the hearts and souls of those who seek solace and transcendence through music.

item.title: Digvijay Singh
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Digvijay Singh

Playback Male Singer

Ddevigvijay Singh Pariyar is a talented singer based in Mumbai, known for his versatility in various genres of music including Bollywood, Sufi, semi-classical, classical, and folk. Born on February 24, 1993, in Nainital, Digvijay developed a passion for music at a young age, learning from his mother. He honed his skills and participated in college-level singing competitions, winning accolades such as the Antar Ragini Idol at IIT Kanpur for three consecutive years.

 

After completing his graduation from Kirori Mal College, Delhi University, Digvijay showcased his talent on the platform of Benedryl Big Golden Voice by Big FM. Impressing the judges, including Shankar Mahadevan, he was selected as a playback singer for an upcoming movie, marking his entry into the Bollywood music industry. This opportunity opened doors for him to work with renowned music composers Salim-Sulaiman in two more movies.

 

Some of Digvijay's notable Bollywood songs include "Katti Batti" (music by Shankar Ehsaan Loy), "UN Indian" (music by Salim-Sulaiman), and "Wedding Pulao" (music by Salim-Sulaiman). His soulful and rustic vocal texture has garnered appreciation from both critics and audiences.

 

Digvijay has been honored with various awards for his talent and contributions to the music industry, including the Baalgayak Samman, Geet Gunjar Awaaz Hindustan Ki, and the Benedryl Big Golden Voice.

Ddevigvijay Singh Pariyar is a talented singer based in Mumbai, known for his versatility in various genres of music including Bollywood, Sufi, semi-classical, classical, and folk. Born on February 24, 1993, in Nainital, Digvijay developed a passion for music at a young age, learning from his mother. He honed his skills and participated in college-level singing competitions, winning accolades such as the Antar Ragini Idol at IIT Kanpur for three consecutive years.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

After completing his graduation from Kirori Mal College, Delhi University, Digvijay showcased his talent on the platform of Benedryl Big Golden Voice by Big FM. Impressing the judges, including Shankar Mahadevan, he was selected as a playback singer for an upcoming movie, marking his entry into the Bollywood music industry. This opportunity opened doors for him to work with renowned music composers Salim-Sulaiman in two more movies.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Some of Digvijay's notable Bollywood songs include \"Katti Batti\" (music by Shankar Ehsaan Loy), \"UN Indian\" (music by Salim-Sulaiman), and \"Wedding Pulao\" (music by Salim-Sulaiman). His soulful and rustic vocal texture has garnered appreciation from both critics and audiences.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

item.title: Dileish Doshi
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Dileish Doshi

Playback Male Singer

Dileish Doshi is an accomplished musician and vocalist based in Mumbai, Maharashtra. He is known for his unique style of singing Bollywood songs and has the ability to captivate audiences with his performances. With a passion for music, Dileish has been rocking stages across India for several years.

 

Dileish is recognized for his authentic voice and the incredible energy he brings to his live performances. He has honed his skills and developed a strong presence in the music scene. Whether it's through his powerful vocals or his ability to engage the crowd, Dileish knows how to create an unforgettable experience for his listeners.

 

With his dedication to music and his ability to make people dance and enjoy themselves, Dileish Doshi continues to leave a mark in the industry and entertain audiences with his unique talent.

item.title: Divya Kumar
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Divya Kumar

Playback Male Singer

Divya Kumar is an Indian playback singer known for his contributions to Hindi, Gujarati, Telugu, and other language films. Born into a musical family, he carries forward a rich legacy of music. His grandfather, Pandit Shivram, was a renowned composer for regional films in India, including works for V. Shantaram's movies. His father, Bhagwan Shivram, is also a musician who has collaborated with prominent composers like RD Burman, Jatin–Lalit, and Himesh Reshamiya.

 

Divya Kumar made his Bollywood debut with the song "Tutiya Dil" in collaboration with Gujraj Singh. Since then, he has sung numerous popular songs that have resonated with audiences. Some notable tracks include "Shubhaarambh" from the film Kai Po Che, "Chanchal Man Ati Random" from Shuddh Desi Romance, and "Daingad Daingad" from Humpty Sharma Ki Dulhania.

 

He showcased his vocal prowess in the Farhan Akhtar starrer Bhaag Milkha Bhaag with the energetic song "Maston Ka Jhund" composed by Shankar–Ehsaan–Loy. Divya Kumar's versatile singing abilities were further showcased in films like Finding Fanny and Ghanchakkar. He also had the honor of being featured in MTV India's prestigious 'MTV Unplugged' where he dedicated an entire episode to his popular hits. Additionally, he has appeared on other renowned musical shows such as "MTV Unplugged."

 

Divya Kumar's talent extends beyond Bollywood as well. He lent his voice to the theme music composed by Sachin–Jigar for the serial Satrangi Sasural. In 2017, he recorded the title song for the internationally acclaimed Rajasthani film Taawdo The Sunlight, which won multiple awards.

item.title: Diwakar
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Diwakar

Playback Male Singer

Dhivagaran Santhosh, popularly known as Diwakar, is an Indian playback singer and live performer. He gained recognition by winning the fourth season of the Tamil language musical reality TV show, "Airtel Super Singer 4," which aired on Vijay TV from February 4, 2013, to February 1, 2014.

 

Diwakar's musical journey began with his participation in various reality TV musical competitions on Tamil channels. He competed in shows like Zee Tamil's "Sa Re Ga Ma Pa 2009 Challenge," Jaya TV's "Hariyudan Naan," and Sun TV's "Sangeetha Mahayuddham" season 2. In 2012, he finished as the runner-up in Raj TV's "Voice of Tamil Nadu."

 

On February 1, 2014, Diwakar emerged as the winner of the fourth season of "Airtel Super Singer" by receiving the highest number of viewer votes. During the show's grand finale, his rendition of the song "Neeye Unakku Endrum" from the film "Bale Pandiya" garnered a standing ovation from the audience and a heartfelt gesture from renowned playback singer S. Janaki, who kissed his forehead in appreciation.

item.title: Dr. Zeus
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Dr. Zeus

Playback Male Singer

Dr. Zeus, also known as Baljit Singh Paddam, is a British-Indian music producer, singer, and songwriter. He was born in the United Kingdom and grew up in Birmingham, England. Dr. Zeus is known for his contributions to the Punjabi music industry and is considered one of the pioneers of the British Bhangra sound.

 

Dr. Zeus rose to prominence in the early 2000s with his debut album "The Highlife" which featured hit tracks like "Kangna" and "Ah Ni Kuriye." His music blends traditional Punjabi folk elements with contemporary sounds, creating a unique fusion that appeals to a wide audience.

 

Over the years, Dr. Zeus has collaborated with numerous artists and has produced chart-topping songs in both the Punjabi and Bollywood music scenes. Some of his popular tracks include "Woofer," "Kangna Tera Ni," "Rough," and "Lovely." He has also worked with Bollywood actors and contributed to the soundtracks of films like "Cocktail," "Happy New Year," and "Fugly."

 

Dr. Zeus is known for his infectious beats, catchy melodies, and ability to create music that gets people on their feet. With his talent and contribution to the music industry, he has gained a loyal fan base both in India and abroad.

\u00a0<\/p>

Dr. Zeus rose to prominence in the early 2000s with his debut album \"The Highlife\" which featured hit tracks like \"Kangna\" and \"Ah Ni Kuriye.\" His music blends traditional Punjabi folk elements with contemporary sounds, creating a unique fusion that appeals to a wide audience.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

item.title: Damodar Raao
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Damodar Raao

Playback Male Singer

In the year 2000, Raao made his singing debut in the Hindi film "Shaitan Tantrik," which featured music composed by Nikhil Vinay and lyrics by Vinay Bihari.

 

In 2007, Raao relocated to Mumbai along with his family to pursue his career in the music industry.

 

In 2008, he ventured into music composition for the low-budget Hindi film "Once More," also known as "Gorakh Dhandha."

Raao has made significant contributions to the Bhojpuri film industry, composing music for more than 75 films in the language. Some of his notable works include "Dil Ho Gail Qurban," "Teri Meri Ashiqui," "Sargana Kushi Nagar Rangdari Tax," "Gunday" (Bhojpuri version), "Bagi Ishq," "Inspector Chandani," "Jungal Raj," "Dil Aur Deewar," "The Power of Dahshat," "Sajan Ki Bahon Me" (Bhojpuri), "Majnu Motorwala," and "Baap Re Baap."

 

The musical film "Teri Meri Ashqui," for which Raao provided the music, received praise from critics for its musical composition and overall appeal.

item.title: Gaurav Dutta
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Gaurav Dutta

Playback Male Singer

Gaurav Dutta is a young and talented singer hailing from the province of Jammu and Kashmir. He has received formal training in traditional music and has emerged as a prominent artist in the modern music era. Gaurav leads a group of young and talented musicians who are making a significant impact in the music industry.

 

With his passion for singing, Gaurav has become an influential figure in his hometown of Jammu, inspiring and motivating other talented musicians. He has garnered recognition for his exceptional talent and has been honored with several awards, including the Jammu and Kashmir Idol in 2012. Gaurav has also been a three-time winner of the Golden Guitar Festival and has achieved success in the Pandit Uma Dutt Sangeet Mahotsav, among other notable accolades.

 

Through his performances and achievements, Gaurav Dutta continues to showcase his remarkable singing abilities and contribute to the rich musical culture of Jammu and Kashmir

item.title: Gippy Grewal
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Gippy Grewal

Playback Male Singer

Gippy Grewal, born as Rupinder Singh Grewal, is a renowned Punjabi singer, actor, and film producer from India. He was born on January 2, 1983, in Koom Kalan, Ludhiana, Punjab. Gippy Grewal started his singing career in 2002 with the album "Chakkh Lai" and gained popularity with his hit song "Phulkari." Since then, he has released numerous successful albums and has become one of the most prominent figures in the Punjabi music industry.

 

Gippy Grewal is known for his versatile singing style, which encompasses various genres such as Bhangra, Pop, and Folk. Some of his popular songs include "Angreji Beat," "Carry On Jatta," "Kudam Kabila," and "Hukam Da Yakka." He has collaborated with many renowned Punjabi music artists and has consistently delivered chart-topping tracks.

 

Apart from his singing career, Gippy Grewal has also established himself as a successful actor in Punjabi cinema. He made his acting debut in the film "Mel Karade Rabba" in 2010 and has since appeared in numerous Punjabi films, earning critical acclaim and commercial success. Some of his notable films include "Carry On Jatta," "Manje Bistre," and "Ardaas."

item.content:encoded:
Goldie Sohel

Playback Male Singer

Goldie Sohel is a talented singer, songwriter, and composer in the Indian music industry. Hailing from Kolkata, West Bengal, Goldie has made a mark with his soulful voice and captivating melodies. He has gained popularity for his versatile singing style, which encompasses various genres such as Pop, Rock, R&B, and Bollywood music.

 

Goldie Sohel started his musical journey at a young age and honed his skills as a vocalist. He made his breakthrough in the music industry with his debut single "Baatein Karo" in 2017, which received widespread acclaim and established him as a promising artist. Since then, Goldie has released several successful singles, including "Rabba Ve" and "Yeh Kya Hua."

 

Apart from his solo work, Goldie Sohel has also collaborated with renowned music composers and singers in the industry. He has lent his soulful voice to various Bollywood soundtracks, including songs in films like "Kabir Singh," "Bharat," and "Tumhari Sulu." His collaborations with top-notch composers and singers have earned him recognition and appreciation from music enthusiasts.

item.title: Gurdas Maan
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Gurdas Maan

Playback Male Singer

Gurdas Maan is a renowned Indian playback singer, songwriter, and actor known for his contributions to Punjabi and Hindi music and films. He rose to national prominence in 1980 with the release of his song "Dil Da Mamla Hai." Since then, he has recorded more than 34 albums and written over 305 songs. In 2015, he collaborated with Diljit Dosanjh on the song "Ki Banu Dunia Da" for MTV Coke Studio India, which was featured in Season 4, Episode 5. Gurdas Maan was born in Giddarbaha, Punjab to parents Gurdev Singh and Tej Kaur. He completed his schooling in Giddarbaha and obtained his graduation degree from DAV College, Malout. He pursued his Bachelor of Physical Education (B.P.Ed) from Government College of Physical Education in Patiala in 1973. He later pursued his Master's in Physical Education and met his wife during his time in college. From a young age, Gurdas Maan showed a keen interest in music and mimicry, laying the foundation for his successful career in the entertainment industry.

item.content:encoded:
Gurshabad Singh

Playback Male Singer

Gurshabad Singh Kular, born on August 24, 1989, is an Indian film actor and playback singer primarily known for his work in Punjabi cinema and the music industry. After completing his junior high school education from a local school, he pursued his undergraduate studies at Khalsa College, Amritsar. He furthered his education at Guru Nanak Dev University, Amritsar, where he completed his Master of Arts program in Music.

 

In September 2015, Gurshabad made his singing debut with the song "Vaar Bhagat Singh," a collaboration with Ammy Virk dedicated to Shaheed Bhagat Singh. That same year, he made his film debut in the successful movie "Angrej," in which Amrinder Gill played the lead role.

 

After releasing singles such as "Milne Di Rutt" (2016), "Geetkariyan" (2016), and "Tarakiyaan" (2017), Gurshabad began his career as a playback singer with the song "Rajya" in the film "Sarvann" (2017). The track was penned by Harman Jeet and the film was produced by Priyanka Chopra, Madhu Chopra, and Deepshikha Deshmukh.

After completing his junior high school education from a local school, he pursued his undergraduate studies at Khalsa College, Amritsar. He furthered his education at Guru Nanak Dev University, Amritsar, where he completed his Master of Arts program in Music.<\/p>

In September 2015, Gurshabad made his singing debut with the song \"Vaar Bhagat Singh,\" a collaboration with Ammy Virk dedicated to Shaheed Bhagat Singh. That same year, he made his film debut in the successful movie \"Angrej,\" in which Amrinder Gill played the lead role.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

item.title: Hans Raj Hans
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Hans Raj Hans

Playback Male Singer

Hans Raj Hans is a renowned Punjabi singer and politician hailing from Punjab, India. Born on April 9, 1962, in a village called Shafipur in Punjab, he belongs to a family with a rich musical background. Hans Raj Hans began his singing career in the late 1980s and quickly gained popularity with his soulful and powerful voice.

 

Known for his versatility, Hans Raj Hans has sung in various genres, including Punjabi folk, Sufi, and Bollywood music. He is particularly known for his mastery of Sufi music, which he infuses with his unique style and mesmerizing vocal range. His renditions of popular Sufi poems and compositions have touched the hearts of millions of listeners.

 

Hans Raj Hans has released numerous albums throughout his career, earning critical acclaim and commercial success. Some of his most popular songs include "Dil Chhori Sada Ho Gaya," "Sili Sili Hawa," "Chorni," and "Nit Khair Manga." He has collaborated with various music composers and artists, showcasing his versatility and ability to adapt to different musical styles.

In addition to his successful music career, Hans Raj Hans has also ventured into politics. He joined the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and served as a member of parliament representing the North West Delhi constituency from 2019 to 2021.

item.title: Happy Raikoti
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Happy Raikoti

Playback Male Singer

Happy Raikoti, whose real name is Harpreet Singh Dhillon, is an Indian singer, lyricist, and actor known for his contributions to Punjabi music. He was born on December 7, 1992, in Raikot, Ludhiana, Punjab, India. Happy Raikoti gained popularity with his soulful and meaningful lyrics that resonated with the audience.

 

He made his singing debut in 2014 with the song "Jaan," which received positive reviews and helped establish his career in the Punjabi music industry. In 2015, he released his album titled "7 Knaalan," which further showcased his talent as a singer and lyricist. The album was well-received by the audience and established Happy Raikoti as a promising artist.

 

Aside from his singing career, Happy Raikoti has also ventured into acting. He made his acting debut in the Punjabi film "Teshan," released in 2016. Though he has primarily focused on his music and songwriting, his acting skills have been appreciated by his fans.

 

Happy Raikoti is highly regarded as one of the leading lyricists in Punjabi music. His songs are known for their meaningful and relatable lyrics, often touching upon themes of love, relationships, and social issues. He has penned lyrics for numerous hit songs performed by renowned Punjabi artists.

 

With his talent as a singer, lyricist, and actor, Happy Raikoti has gained a dedicated fan base and continues to contribute to the vibrant Punjabi music and film industry. His work reflects his passion for music and storytelling, making him a prominent figure in the Punjabi entertainment scene.

item.title: Harish Moyal
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Harish Moyal

Playback Male Singer

Harish Moyal is a talented Indian playback singer and performer known for his soulful voice and versatility in various genres of music. He was born on August 2, 1988, in Mumbai, Maharashtra.

 

Harish Moyal made his debut in the music industry with the song "Humse Pyaar Kar Le Tu" from the Bollywood film "Teri Meri Kahaani" in 2012. Since then, he has lent his melodious voice to numerous hit songs in Hindi cinema.

 

Apart from playback singing, Harish Moyal has also showcased his talent on various reality shows. He participated in the singing reality show "Jo Jeeta Wohi Superstar" and emerged as the first runner-up in 2008. His performances on the show received widespread acclaim, establishing him as a promising singer in the industry.

item.title: Harrdy Sandhu
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Harrdy Sandhu

Playback Male Singer

Harrdy Sandhu, whose real name is Hardevinder Singh Sandhu, is a popular Indian singer, actor, and former cricketer. He was born on September 6, 1986, in Patiala, Punjab.

Before his foray into the music industry, Harrdy Sandhu had a successful career in cricket. He represented Punjab in domestic cricket and played as a fast bowler. However, his passion for music led him to pursue a career in singing.

 

Harrdy Sandhu gained widespread recognition with his debut song "Tequila Shot" in 2012, which became an instant hit. He rose to fame with his breakthrough track "Soch" in 2013, which was later recreated in the Bollywood film "Airlift." The song garnered millions of views and established Harrdy Sandhu as a talented singer.

 

Since then, Harrdy Sandhu has released numerous chart-topping Punjabi songs, including "Naah," "Backbone," "Kya Baat Ay," and "Joker." His songs are known for their catchy beats, Punjabi flavor, and his energetic and soulful voice. He has collaborated with renowned music composers and artists in the industry, further enhancing his popularity.

 

Apart from his singing career, Harrdy Sandhu has also ventured into acting. He made his acting debut with the Punjabi film "Yaaran Da Katchup" in 2014 and has appeared in other movies like "Mera Mahi NRI" and "Soorma."

item.content:encoded:
Harshit Chauhan

Playback Male Singer

Harshit Chauhan is an exceptional singer who has captivated audiences with his melodious voice and remarkable talent. With his innate musicality and soulful renditions, he has carved a niche for himself in the world of music.

Born with a passion for singing, Harshit embarked on his musical journey at a young age. His dedication and perseverance soon paid off as he began winning hearts with his powerful performances. His versatility is evident as he effortlessly navigates through various genres, including Bollywood, Sufi, and classical music.

 

Harshit's vocal range is truly awe-inspiring, allowing him to effortlessly hit high notes and convey deep emotions through his voice. His ability to connect with his listeners on a profound level sets him apart as an artist. Whether he is performing on stage or recording in the studio, his passion for music shines through, leaving an indelible impact.

 

Beyond his vocal prowess, Harshit is also known for his humility and down-to-earth demeanor. Despite his rising fame, he remains grounded and continues to work hard to refine his skills and expand his musical horizons.

 

Harshit Chauhan is a name synonymous with musical excellence, and he is undoubtedly a force to be reckoned with in the world of singing. As he continues to enchant audiences with his enchanting voice, there is no doubt that his star will continue to rise in the years to come.

item.content:encoded:
Hemang Dave

Playback Male Singer

Hemang Dave is a versatile Indian singer, actor, and television personality known for his contributions to the Gujarati entertainment industry. He has showcased his talent in various genres, including playback singing, folk music, and acting.

 

Hemang Dave was born and raised in Gujarat, India. He developed a passion for music from a young age and started his career as a singer, performing at local events and cultural gatherings. His soulful voice and ability to connect with the audience quickly gained recognition, leading him to venture into professional singing. As a playback singer, Hemang Dave has lent his vocals to numerous Gujarati film songs. He has collaborated with various composers and his melodious renditions have added depth and emotion to the film soundtracks. In addition to his singing career, Hemang Dave has also showcased his acting skills in Gujarati films and television shows. He has portrayed diverse roles, ranging from romantic leads to character-driven performances

item.title: Hriday Gattani
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Hriday Gattani

Playback Male Singer

Hriday Deepak Gattani, born on January 20, 1991, is an Indian playback singer, music director, songwriter, and performer hailing from Mumbai, India. He had the privilege of being mentored by the legendary music maestro A.R. Rahman, which played a significant role in shaping his musical career.

 

Hriday made his Bollywood debut as a singer under the music direction of A.R. Rahman in the 2014 film "Lekar Hum Deewana Dil." He lent his voice to the songs "Maaloom" and "Tu Shining" for the movie, showcasing his talent and versatility as a singer. He had the opportunity to pursue playback singing while studying Western Classical music at KM College of Music and Technology.

 

In addition to his work in films, Hriday has had the privilege of touring with A.R. Rahman for live concerts and performances, which further enhanced his musical prowess. He also recorded for A.R. Rahman's project called "One Vision," where he contributed to a song composed from the prose written by the former President of India, Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam.

 

Hriday has collaborated with various renowned artists in the music industry. He teamed up with singer Neeti Mohan for the upbeat indie pop track "I Just Met Somebody," where Neeti sang the Hindi verses while Hriday performed the English ones. He has also collaborated with Shruti Pathak on a fusion cover of "Nothing on You" and with Suchismita Das on "Let It Be."

item.title: Hemant Brijwasi
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Hemant Brijwasi

Playback Male Singer

Hemant Brijwasi is a talented Indian singer who gained fame through his participation in reality singing competitions. He was born on November 25, 1998, in Mathura, Uttar Pradesh.

 

Hemant's musical journey began at a young age when he started singing devotional songs in his local temple. His exceptional talent was recognized when he participated in the reality show "Sa Re Ga Ma Pa L'il Champs" in 2009 and emerged as the winner of the competition. This victory marked the beginning of his musical career.

 

After his win on "Sa Re Ga Ma Pa L'il Champs," Hemant continued to showcase his singing prowess in various other singing competitions. He participated in shows like "India's Got Talent" and "Rising Star." His melodious voice, versatility, and ability to captivate the audience with his performances earned him accolades and a dedicated fan base.

 

Hemant Brijwasi's singing style encompasses a wide range of genres, including Bollywood songs, devotional music, and Sufi music. His soulful renditions and emotive singing have touched the hearts of many listeners. He has also had the opportunity to collaborate with renowned music composers and singers in the industry.

item.title: Hardil Pandya
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Hardil Pandya

Playback Male Singer

Hardil Pandya is an emerging singer-songwriter who has been gaining recognition in the Indie Music scene for his melodious love songs. With a focus on heartfelt lyrics and soulful melodies, he has captured the attention of listeners with his emotional and captivating performances.

 

One of his notable tracks, "Pehchaan Na Paaoge," showcases his ability to create a heartfelt composition that resonates with listeners. The song explores themes of identity and self-discovery, accompanied by Pandya's soothing vocals and a beautifully arranged musical backdrop.

 

Another popular song by Hardil Pandya is "Meri Kahaani," which delves into the depths of personal experiences and emotions. Through poignant storytelling and a soul-stirring melody, Pandya creates a connection with his audience, evoking a range of emotions with his heartfelt rendition.

 

"Yeh Ho Nahi Sakta" is yet another mesmerizing track by Hardil Pandya, showcasing his versatility as a singer. This song, known for its romantic essence, combines soft melodies with expressive vocals, creating a captivating musical experience for the listeners.

 

With his talent for crafting soulful compositions and his ability to convey deep emotions through his music, Hardil Pandya is steadily making a name for himself in the Indie Music scene. His melodious love songs and heartfelt performances have touched the hearts of many, and he continues to leave a lasting impression with his unique musical style.
