item.title: Ishq Bector
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Ishq Bector

Playback Male Singer

IshQ Bector, born as Amitabh Bhattacharya, is an Indian-Canadian singer, music producer, and songwriter. He is known for his unique blend of Punjabi, hip-hop, and pop music. IshQ Bector was born in Winnipeg, Canada, and later moved to India to pursue his career in the music industry.

 

IshQ Bector gained recognition with his debut album "Dakku Daddy," which was released in 2008. The album featured the popular track "Dakku Daddy" that became a hit and established IshQ Bector as a distinctive artist in the Indian music scene. His music is known for its catchy beats, energetic performances, and lyrics that often blend Hindi, Punjabi, and English languages.

 

Apart from his solo work, IshQ Bector has collaborated with various artists and music producers. He has worked with renowned Bollywood composers and singers, lending his vocals and songwriting skills to films like "Dil Bole Hadippa," "Pyaar Impossible," and "Tees Maar Khan." He has also composed and produced music for television shows and commercials.

 

IshQ Bector's music is characterized by its upbeat and party-centric vibe, making it popular among the youth. He has performed at numerous concerts, music festivals, and events both in India and abroad, captivating the audience with his energetic stage presence and groovy tracks.

item.title: Jasbir Jassi
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Jasbir Jassi

Playback Male Singer

Jasbir Jassi, born on February 7, 1970, is an Indian singer, songwriter, and actor known for his Punjabi folk and pop music. Hailing from Punjab, India, Jassi rose to fame with his hit track "Dil Le Gayi Kudi Gujarat Di" from the Bollywood film "Dil Le Gayi Kudi Gujarat Di" (1998). The song became an instant sensation and established Jassi as a prominent Punjabi music artist.

 

Jasbir Jassi's music is a blend of traditional Punjabi folk music with contemporary elements, creating a unique and captivating sound. He is known for his powerful and energetic voice, which has made him a popular choice for live performances and concerts. Jassi's songs often carry a vibrant and celebratory spirit, reflecting the rich cultural heritage of Punjab.

 

Over the years, Jasbir Jassi has released several successful albums, including "Kudi Kudi" (1999), "Dil Le Gayee" (2001), and "Jasbir Jassi Live" (2005). He has collaborated with various music composers and producers, incorporating different musical styles into his repertoire.

 

In addition to his music career, Jasbir Jassi has also ventured into acting. He made his acting debut with the Punjabi film "Khushiyaan" (2011), where he played the lead role. He has since appeared in a few other Punjabi films, showcasing his versatility as an entertainer.

 

Jassi's contributions to the music industry have been recognized with several awards and accolades. He has received the ETC Channel Punjabi Best Non-Resident Punjabi Music Director Award and the Best Pop Male Vocalist Award at the ETC Channel Punjabi Music Awards.

item.title: Jass Manak
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Jass Manak

Playback Male Singer

Jaspreet Singh Manak, better known as Jass Manak, is an Indian singer-songwriter who has gained popularity for his hit songs. Born on 12 February 1999, he has made a name for himself in the Punjabi music industry with his distinct style and catchy tunes.

 

Jass Manak began his singing career in 2017 with the release of his debut song "U-Turn." Although it didn't garner much attention, he caught the public's eye with his track "Prada" in 2018, which became a massive hit and catapulted him to fame. The song's popularity made it one of the most-streamed songs in India and established Jass Manak as a rising star.

 

In 2019, Jass Manak released his album "Age 19," which featured popular tracks like "Rabb Wangu" and "Bandook" for the Punjabi movie Sikander 2. His single "Lehanga" gained significant success, ranking high on both the Global and Indian YouTube music weekly charts.

 

Jass Manak is known for his songwriting abilities, and he often writes his own songs. Some of his notable compositions include "Prada," "Lehanga," "Boss," and "Viah." He has also penned songs for other artists such as Karan Randhawa, Nishawn Bhullar, Jassi Gill, and Gippy Grewal.

 

As an artist, Jass Manak is associated with the music label Geet MP3, which has been instrumental in promoting his music. He has continued to release new singles and albums, keeping his fans eagerly awaiting his latest creations. His single "Lehanga" crossed one billion views on YouTube in 2021, further solidifying his popularity.

item.title: Jassie Gift
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Jassie Gift

Playback Male Singer

Jassie Gift is an Indian film music composer and playback singer known for his work in Malayalam, Kannada, Tamil, and Telugu cinema. He was born in Vithura and his parents are Gift Israel and Rajamma. From a young age, Jassie had a keen interest in music, particularly influenced by western music. He admired renowned composer Ilayaraja and was a fan of Freddie Mercury. Jassie received lessons in western piano and started singing and playing the keyboard in local bands. He is also a singer and keyboard player for the band Moby Dick.

 

Jassie Gift made his entry into the film music industry under the guidance of director Jayaraj. Before entering films, he composed songs for a couple of albums in Malayalam, including the popular album "Soona Soona." He also composed singles and became known for his innovative use of reggae fusion music infused with Indian ragas in the Malayalam music scene. Jassie's first film composition was for the movie "Saphalam." However, he gained widespread recognition after his songs in the movie "4 The People" became hits in Kerala, especially the song "Lajjavathiye."The success of the film contributed to Jassie's rising popularity, and the song was later remade in Tamil and Telugu, receiving acclaim in all languages.

 

Jassie Gift's musical talent and unique compositions have earned him accolades in the industry. He won the Best Music Director award at The Bangalore Times Film Awards in 2011, further solidifying his position as a notable music director. With his distinct style and successful compositions, Jassie Gift continues to be a prominent figure in the Indian film music industry.

item.title: Jassie Gill
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Jassie Gill

Playback Male Singer

Jasdeep Singh Gill, known by his stage name Jassi Gill, is an Indian singer, live performer, and actor associated with Punjabi and Hindi music and films. He was born on November 26, 1988, in Jandali village near Khanna in Ludhiana district of Punjab. Gill studied at Gobindgarh Public College, where he focused on music and physical education. He participated in local youth festivals and consistently secured the second position in singing competitions.

 

Gill made his debut in the Punjabi music industry in 2011 with the album "Batchmate," which featured the popular song "Churiyan." He gained further recognition with the release of the single "Vigrey Sharabi" in 2012. In 2013, he released his second album, "Batchmate 2," which included the hit song "Lancer" with lyrics by Narinder Batth. Another popular song, "Classmate," featured in the film "Daddy Cool Munde Fool."

 

In addition to his music career, Jassi Gill ventured into acting. He made his acting debut in the Punjabi film "Mr & Mrs 420" and appeared in "Dil Vil Pyar Vyar" and "Mundeyan Ton Bachke Rahin." He starred alongside Gauahar Khan in the Punjabi film "Oh Yaara Ainvayi Ainvayi Lut Gaya" and worked with Neeru Bajwa in "Channo Kamli Yaar Di." Jassi Gill made his Hindi cinema debut in the film "Happy Phirr Bhag Jayegi" (2018), sharing the screen with Sonakshi Sinha, Diana Penty, and Jimmy Sheirgill. He has also acted in films like "Panga" (2020) alongside Kangana Ranaut and "Kya Meri Sonam Gupta Bewafa Hai?" (2021) alongside Surbhi Jyoti.

 

Jassi Gill has been recognized for his charm and popularity in the media. He ranked in The Times Most Desirable Men list at No. 42 in 2018, No. 44 in 2019, and No. 42 in 2020. In the Chandigarh Times Most Desirable Men list, he secured the No. 1 position in 2018 and 2020, and No. 2 in 2019.

item.title: Jatin Pandit
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Jatin Pandit

Playback Male Singer

Jatin Pandit and Lalit Pandit are an Indian musical duo consisting of brothers Jatin and Lalit Pandit. They have had a successful career in the Indian film industry, composing music for numerous popular films. Some of the notable films for which they have composed music include Yaara Dildara, Khiladi, Jo Jeeta Wohi Sikandar, Kabhi Haan Kabhi Naa, Raju Ban Gaya Gentleman, Khamoshi: The Musical, Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge, Fareb, Yes Boss, Jab Pyaar Kisise Hota Hai, Kuch Kuch Hota Hai, Sarfarosh, Ghulam, Pyaar Kiya To Darna Kya, Pyaar To Hona Hi Tha, Khoobsurat, Mohabbatein, Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham..., Chalte Chalte, Hum Tum, and Fanaa.

Jatin and Lalit were born into a musical family and received their musical education from their father, Pandit Pratap Narayan. They were also taught guitar and piano by Pyarelal Ramprasad Sharma of the Laxmikant-Pyarelal duo. The duo started their career in the early 1990s and gained recognition for their work on films like Khiladi and Jo Jeeta Wohi Sikandar. They became known for their melodic and catchy compositions, often drawing inspiration from the style of renowned composer R.D. Burman.

Some of their most successful soundtracks include Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge, Kuch Kuch Hota Hai, Mohabbatein, and Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham... Their music often featured popular playback singers and they were among the first composers to write songs specifically for Bollywood film stars to perform. Despite being nominated multiple times, Jatin-Lalit never won a Filmfare Award, but their music remains highly regarded in the industry.

Apart from their musical career, Jatin and Lalit have also made appearances in films and television shows. They appeared in the movie Jo Jeeta Wohi Sikandar during the song "Humse Hai Saara Jahaan," with Jatin singing the song and Lalit playing the bass guitar. They have also served as judges on musical shows like Sa Re Ga Ma Pa and Star Voice of India.

In 2006, Jatin and Lalit announced their separation as a duo due to personal reasons. However, in February 2020, they reunited and organized a successful concert in Mumbai, showcasing their collective talent. Since their separation, both brothers have continued their musical careers independently, with Lalit composing for films like Dabangg and Jatin working on various projects, including film scores and albums.

Overall, Jatin and Lalit Pandit have left a significant impact on the Indian music industry with their melodious compositions and memorable film soundtracks

Their music often featured popular playback singers and they were among the first composers to write songs specifically for Bollywood film stars to perform. Despite being nominated multiple times, Jatin-Lalit never won a Filmfare Award, but their music remains highly regarded in the industry.<\/p>

Apart from their musical career, Jatin and Lalit have also made appearances in films and television shows. They appeared in the movie Jo Jeeta Wohi Sikandar during the song \"Humse Hai Saara Jahaan,\" with Jatin singing the song and Lalit playing the bass guitar. They have also served as judges on musical shows like Sa Re Ga Ma Pa and Star Voice of India.<\/p>

In 2006, Jatin and Lalit announced their separation as a duo due to personal reasons. However, in February 2020, they reunited and organized a successful concert in Mumbai, showcasing their collective talent. Since their separation, both brothers have continued their musical careers independently, with Lalit composing for films like Dabangg and Jatin working on various projects, including film scores and albums.<\/p>

Overall, Jatin and Lalit Pandit have left a significant impact on the Indian music industry with their melodious compositions and memorable film soundtracks<\/p>","typography_typography":"custom","typography_font_weight":"bold"},"elements":[],"widgetType":"text-editor"}],"isInner":false}],"isInner":false},{"id":"14f1e50","elType":"section","settings":{"background_background":"classic","background_color":"#EAF0EE8F","hover_parallax":[{"layer_position_vr":{"unit":"%","size":30},"layer_position_hr":{"unit":"%","size":40},"_id":"ac4fb18"},{"layer_position_vr":{"unit":"%","size":60},"layer_position_hr":{"unit":"%","size":20},"_id":"a1b2b38"}]},"elements":[{"id":"55373ae","elType":"column","settings":{"_column_size":100,"_inline_size":null},"elements":[{"id":"58b2203","elType":"widget","settings":{"title":"Enquiry Form","header_size":"h3","align":"center","typography_typography":"custom","typography_font_size":{"unit":"px","size":40,"sizes":[]},"typography_font_weight":"bold","_margin":{"unit":"px","top":"40","right":"0","bottom":"20","left":"0","isLinked":false},"__globals__":{"title_color":"globals\/colors?id=6d3d44f9"}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"heading"},{"id":"11913c3","elType":"widget","settings":{"shortcode":"[forminator_form id=\"5483\"]","_margin":{"unit":"px","top":"0","right":"0","bottom":"40","left":"0","isLinked":false}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"shortcode"}],"isInner":false}],"isInner":false}]

item.title: Javed Ali
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Javed Ali

Playback Male Singer

Javed Ali is an acclaimed Indian playback singer known for his contributions to the Hindi film industry. While predominantly singing in Hindi, he has also lent his soulful voice to various other Indian languages such as Bengali, Kannada, Malayalam, Gujarati, Marathi, Odia, Tamil, Telugu, and Urdu. He was born as Javed Hussain in Panchkuian Road, Delhi.

 

Javed Ali's musical journey began at a young age under the guidance of his father, Ustad Hamid Hussain, who was a renowned qawwali singer. His talent caught the attention of the legendary ghazal singer Ghulam Ali, who recognized his potential and mentored him. Ghulam Ali not only provided guidance to Javed but also gave him opportunities to sing in his live concerts. In honor of his guru, Javed Hussain changed his name to Javed Ali.

 

In 2007, Javed Ali gained significant recognition for his song "Ek Din Teri Raahon Mein" from the film "Naqaab." Since then, he has delivered several memorable tracks that have captivated listeners. Some of his notable songs include "Jashn-e-Bahaaran" from "Jodhaa Akbar," "Arziyan" from "Delhi-6," "Kun Faya Kun" from "Rockstar," "Guzarish" from "Ghajini," "Aa Jao Meri Tamanna" from "Ajab Prem Ki Ghazab Kahani," "Gale Lag Ja" from "De Dana Dan," "Tu Hi Haqeeqat" from "Tum Mile," "Tum Tak" from "Raanjhanaa," the title track of "Jab Tak Hai Jaan," "Deewana Kar Raha Hai" from "Raaz 3," "Ishaqzaade" title track from "Ishaqzaade," "Galat Baat Hai" from "Main Tera Hero," the title track of "Daawat-e-Ishq," "Maula" from "Wazir," "Nagada Nagada" from "Jab We Met," "Tu Jo Mila" from "Bajrangi Bhaijaan," "Saanson Ke" from "Raees," "Kuch Nahi" from "Tubelight," and "Naina Lade" from "Dabangg 3."

Jay Mehta

Playback Male Singer

Jay Mehta is a talented playback singer known for his contributions to the music industry. While specific information about his background and career is limited, his musical abilities and performances have earned him recognition among audiences.

 

As a playback singer, Jay Mehta lends his soulful and melodious voice to songs featured in various films and albums. His vocal range and versatility allow him to adapt to different genres and styles of music, adding depth and emotion to the compositions he works on.

 

Though details about his notable projects or specific songs are not readily available, it can be inferred that Jay Mehta's talent and dedication have led him to collaborate with renowned composers and filmmakers in the industry. His ability to interpret and bring life to the lyrics and melodies of a song contributes to the overall impact and success of the music he is associated with.

 

While his presence in the public domain may not be as prominent as some other playback singers, Jay Mehta's contributions to the industry should not be overlooked. With his passion for music and his ability to connect with listeners through his voice, he continues to make his mark in the world of playback singing.

 

As Jay Mehta's career progresses, it is likely that his talent and artistic contributions will be further recognized and appreciated by a wider audience, cementing his position as a respected playback singer in the industry.

item.title: Jazzy B
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Jazzy B

Playback Male Singer

Jazzy B, born Jaswinder Singh Bains on April 1, 1975, is an Indo-Canadian Punjabi singer and songwriter. He was born in Jalandhar, Punjab, India, and later moved to Surrey, British Columbia, Canada, with his family when he was five years old.

 

Jazzy B released his first album, "Gugiyan Da Jora," in 1993, with the rhythm played by Sukhshinder Shinda. Shinda advised Jazzy B to move to England if he wanted to have a prominent career in Punjabi music. Over the years, Jazzy B has released 12 studio albums and two religious albums. He has collaborated with various artists on many tracks.

 

Apart from his music career, Jazzy B has also ventured into the film industry. He made his film debut in 2000 with the movie "Shaheed Udham Singh." He has appeared in several Punjabi films, including "Teesri Aankh: The Hidden Camera" (2006), "Best of Luck" (2013), "Romeo Ranjha" (2014), "Double Di Trouble" (2014), and "Snowman: The Dark Side of Canada" (2022), among others. He has also made special appearances in films like "Jatt & Juliet 2" (2013) and "Jawaani Jaaneman" (2020).

 

Throughout his career, Jazzy B has worked with various Bollywood and international artists. He has collaborated with singers like Apache Indian, Snoop Dogg, and Hard Kaur, among others. His song "Sat Rangey" was featured in the Hollywood movie "Deadpool" in 2016. Jazzy B has also been recognized for his contributions to the entertainment industry and became the first South Asian entertainer to have his name added to the BC Entertainment Hall of Fame Star Walk in Vancouver.

 

In addition to his music and film career, Jazzy B has appeared as a judge on the Punjabi singing reality show "Sa Re Ga Ma Pa" on Zee Punjabi, alongside Sonu Kakkar and Jaidev Kumar, mentored by Gurdas Mann. He continues to be an influential figure in the Punjabi music industry with his distinctive style and energetic performances.

item.title: Jeet Gannguli
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Jeet Gannguli

Playback Male Singer

Jeet Gannguli, born as Chandrajeet Ganguly on May 24, 1977, is an Indian score composer and playback singer known for his work in Bengali and Hindi movies. He hails from a Bengali Brahmin family and was introduced to the world of music at a very young age. He studied at Baranagore Ramakrishna Mission Ashrama High School and later graduated from the University of Calcutta.

 

Jeet Gannguli received his training in Indian classical music from his father, Kali Ganguly, and his father's sister, Shibani Roychowdhury. Additionally, he also studied western classical music, jazz, and rock under jazz guitarist Carlton Kitto.

His breakthrough in the film industry came when director Sanjay Gadhvi signed him, along with Pritam, to compose the music for the film "Tere Liye." Subsequently, they collaborated on the music for Yash Raj Films' "Mere Yaar Ki Shaadi Hai" in 2002.

 

Following his successful ventures in Hindi cinema, Jeet Gannguli began scoring music for both Hindi and Bengali films, as well as TV serials and jingles. He has composed numerous songs for popular Hindi movies such as "Aashiqui 2," "Khamoshiyan," "Hamari Adhuri Kahani," "Rustom," "Raaz Reboot," and many more, many of which have become chartbusters.

 

Jeet Gannguli's melodious compositions and soulful tunes have garnered him a significant fan following and acclaim in the music industry. His ability to create memorable songs has contributed to the success of several films and has established him as a prominent figure in both Bengali and Hindi music.

Jeet Gannguli, born as Chandrajeet Ganguly on May 24, 1977, is an Indian score composer and playback singer known for his work in Bengali and Hindi movies. He hails from a Bengali Brahmin family and was introduced to the world of music at a very young age. He studied at Baranagore Ramakrishna Mission Ashrama High School and later graduated from the University of Calcutta.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Jeet Gannguli received his training in Indian classical music from his father, Kali Ganguly, and his father's sister, Shibani Roychowdhury. Additionally, he also studied western classical music, jazz, and rock under jazz guitarist Carlton Kitto.<\/p>

His breakthrough in the film industry came when director Sanjay Gadhvi signed him, along with Pritam, to compose the music for the film \"Tere Liye.\" Subsequently, they collaborated on the music for Yash Raj Films' \"Mere Yaar Ki Shaadi Hai\" in 2002.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Following his successful ventures in Hindi cinema, Jeet Gannguli began scoring music for both Hindi and Bengali films, as well as TV serials and jingles. He has composed numerous songs for popular Hindi movies such as \"Aashiqui 2,\" \"Khamoshiyan,\" \"Hamari Adhuri Kahani,\" \"Rustom,\" \"Raaz Reboot,\" and many more, many of which have become chartbusters.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Jeet Gannguli's melodious compositions and soulful tunes have garnered him a significant fan following and acclaim in the music industry. His ability to create memorable songs has contributed to the success of several films and has established him as a prominent figure in both Bengali and Hindi music.<\/p>","typography_typography":"custom","typography_font_weight":"bold"},"elements":[],"widgetType":"text-editor"}],"isInner":false}],"isInner":false},{"id":"fbfb825","elType":"section","settings":{"background_background":"classic","background_color":"#EAF0EE8F","hover_parallax":[{"layer_position_vr":{"unit":"%","size":30},"layer_position_hr":{"unit":"%","size":40},"_id":"ac4fb18"},{"layer_position_vr":{"unit":"%","size":60},"layer_position_hr":{"unit":"%","size":20},"_id":"a1b2b38"}]},"elements":[{"id":"81807e9","elType":"column","settings":{"_column_size":100,"_inline_size":null},"elements":[{"id":"c823996","elType":"widget","settings":{"title":"Enquiry Form","header_size":"h3","align":"center","typography_typography":"custom","typography_font_size":{"unit":"px","size":40,"sizes":[]},"typography_font_weight":"bold","_margin":{"unit":"px","top":"40","right":"0","bottom":"20","left":"0","isLinked":false},"__globals__":{"title_color":"globals\/colors?id=6d3d44f9"}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"heading"},{"id":"11084cb","elType":"widget","settings":{"shortcode":"[forminator_form id=\"5483\"]","_margin":{"unit":"px","top":"0","right":"0","bottom":"40","left":"0","isLinked":false}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"shortcode"}],"isInner":false}],"isInner":false}]

item.title: Jigardan Gadhavi
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Jigardan Gadhavi

Playback Male Singer

Jigardan Gadhavi, popularly known as Jigardan, is an acclaimed Indian singer, composer, and actor primarily associated with the Gujarati music and film industry. He has captivated audiences with his soulful voice, versatility, and charming personality.

 

Jigardan Gadhavi was born on March 19, 1992, in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. He developed a keen interest in music from a young age and started his journey by participating in various singing competitions. His talent and passion for music caught the attention of music directors, leading to his entry into the professional music industry.

 

Jigardan gained widespread recognition with his breakthrough song "Satrangi Re" from the Gujarati film "Wrong Side Raju" in 2016. The song became an instant hit and established him as a prominent singer in the Gujarati music scene. Since then, he has delivered numerous popular tracks, including "Dariyo," "Sonbai Ni Chundadi," and "Mari Bharoso."

 

In addition to his success in music, Jigardan Gadhavi has also ventured into acting. He made his acting debut in the Gujarati film "Hu Tara Ishq Ma" in 2017, where he played the lead role. He received positive reviews for his performance and showcased his versatility as an artist.

Jigardan's singing style encompasses a wide range of genres, including traditional Gujarati folk, contemporary Gujarati music, Bollywood songs, and fusion music. His melodious voice, emotional depth, and ability to connect with listeners have made him immensely popular among music lovers.

item.title: Joi Barua
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Joi Barua

Playback Male Singer

Joi Barua is a talented Indian singer and music composer hailing from Digboi, Assam. He has made significant contributions to the music industry by lending his soulful voice and composing music for various Hindi, Assamese, and Telugu films. He is also known as the lead vocalist of the band Joi.

 

Barua's musical style is a fusion of rock, soul, jazz, folk, and world music, showcasing his versatility and diverse influences. He initially started his career by singing jingles for popular advertising campaigns, including brands like Fiat Linea, Vodafone, Reliance, LG, Hero Honda, Nescafe, Club Mahindra, and Yatra.com.

 

Before venturing into playback singing, Barua worked as a background singer for several Bollywood films in the early 2000s. He gained recognition for his notable playback singing in Hindi films such as "Dev.D," "Udaan," "Luv Ka The End," "Mujhse Fraaandship Karoge," and "Zindagi Na Milegi Dobara." In 2010, he recorded two songs for the Telugu film "Kalavar King."

 

One of the notable achievements of Joi Barua and his band was the release of an anthem for the 114 bravehearts of the Indian Army who lost their lives during the Indo-China War in 1962. They created history by releasing the anthem atop the Rezang La War Memorial on May 4, 2022. This initiative was collated by his close associate, Sattyakee D'com Bhuyan, who is a theater director, writer, and journalist.

 

Joi Barua's contributions to the music industry reflect his passion for creating meaningful and diverse musical experiences. He continues to explore new genres and collaborate with various artists, enriching the Indian music landscape.

item.title: Junaid Sultani
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Junaid Sultani

Playback Male Singer

Junaid Sultani is a talented singer who has captivated audiences with his soulful voice and remarkable musical abilities. Hailing from a small town, Junaid's passion for music started at an early age. His melodic voice and ability to convey emotions through his songs have earned him widespread recognition and a dedicated fan following.

 

With a versatile vocal range, Junaid effortlessly transitions between various genres, including classical, Sufi, and contemporary music. His renditions of traditional folk songs and ghazals have a timeless appeal, while his modern compositions resonate with the younger generation. Junaid's powerful yet soothing voice has the ability to touch hearts and evoke deep emotions.

 

Junaid's dedication to his craft is evident in his live performances, where he effortlessly connects with the audience, leaving them spellbound. His musical prowess has garnered him numerous accolades and opportunities to collaborate with renowned musicians and composers.

 

As an emerging artist, Junaid Sultani's talent and potential know no bounds, and his journey in the music industry promises to be one filled with success, innovation, and musical brilliance.

item.title: Kailash Kher
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Kailash Kher

Playback Male Singer

Kailash Kher, born on 7 July 1973, is a prominent Indian music composer and singer known for his unique style influenced by Indian folk music and Sufi music. His music is deeply rooted in traditional Indian sounds, and he draws inspiration from renowned classical musicians such as Pandit Kumar Gandharva, Pandit Hridaynath Mangeshkar, Pandit Bhimsen Joshi, and Qawwali maestro Nusrat Fateh Ali Khan.

In recognition of his contributions to music, Kailash Kher was honored with the Padma Shri award by the Indian government in 2017. He has also received two Filmfare Awards for Best Male Playback Singer, one for the Hindi film Fanaa (2006) and another for the Telugu film Mirchi (2013). His powerful voice and distinct musical style have made him a beloved playback singer in the Indian music industry.

Kailash Kher has composed music scores for numerous films, including Chandni Chowk To China, Dasvidaniya, Sacred Evil, Sangini, and Desi Kattey. He has also penned lyrics for a few films, such as Chandni Chowk To China, Dasvidaniya, Kaal, and Traffic Signal.

Having sung in more than 20 Indian languages, Kailash Kher has showcased his versatility by lending his voice to songs in languages like Malayalam, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Oriya, Bengali, Sindhi, Bhojpuri, Gujarati, Marathi, Punjabi, Konkani, and Rajasthani. Kanhiya Mittal

Playback Male Singer

Kanhiya Mittal was born on September 21, 1990 in Chandigarh, capital of the northern Indian states of Punjab and Haryana. Kanhiya Mittal pursued his studies along with his passion for singing and preaching. It has been almost 18 years since Kanhiya is pursuing his passion. His journey began at the young and tender age of 12. Many famous personalities appear as guest at his various religious events. Honourable Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi, Uttarakhand CM Pushkar Singh Dhami and Uttar Pradesh CM Yogi Adityanath have appreciated the singing talent of Kanhiya Mittal.

item.title: Karan Singh Arora
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Karan Singh Arora

Playback Male Singer

Karan Singh Arora is an Indian singer, music director, songwriter, and music performer. He hails from Ranchi, Jharkhand, and is currently based in Mumbai, India. Karan attended Army Public School in Ramgarh Cantt. and later studied at Delhi Public School in Ranchi. He initially pursued a BBA degree from Wadia College in Pune but left his studies to focus on his music career. Karan also studied sound engineering and electronic music production at the SAE Institute in London.

 

Karan Singh Arora made his singing debut at the age of nineteen with the song "Shiv Shankar," which was released in March 2015 and received positive feedback. One of his notable songs, "RelationShit," was released on Valentine's Day in February 2017 and gained popularity on YouTube, particularly among different Viners.

 

In April 2018, Karan collaborated with Pakistani singer Salman Mithani for a single titled "Tu Jo Kahe," which was picked up by Zee Music Company. The song garnered 1.2 million views on YouTube within two days of its release.

 

In July 2018, Karan released a new Punjabi song called "Magnet," featuring Nataša Stanković, with music composed by Jass Singh.

item.title: Keerthi Sagathia
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Keerthi Sagathia

Playback Male Singer

Keerthi Sagathia is a musician and singer who gained recognition for his talent and musical background. He is the son of the renowned Gujarati folk singer Karsan Sagathiya, which provided him with a strong musical foundation from an early age. Keerthi's passion for music led him to participate in various singing competitions and reality shows.

 

In 2005, Keerthi participated as a contestant in the Sony TV reality show "Fame Gurukul." This platform provided him with an opportunity to showcase his singing skills and gain exposure to a wider audience. His performances on the show received appreciation and helped him establish a presence in the music industry.

 

Keerthi's talent as a singer brought him further recognition when he was invited as a celebrity guest singer on the popular reality show "X Factor." He appeared in Episode 29, which was first aired on 20 August 2011. This appearance showcased his versatility as a singer and allowed him to captivate the audience with his vocal abilities.

 

Throughout his career, Keerthi Sagathia has showcased his talent in various musical genres and styles. He has lent his voice to numerous songs in both Bollywood and regional cinema. With his rich musical heritage and his own unique style, Keerthi continues to contribute to the Indian music industry and is appreciated for his melodious voice and captivating performances.

item.title: Khesari Lal Yadav
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Khesari Lal Yadav

Playback Male Singer

Khesari Lal Yadav, born as Shatrughan Kumar Yadav on 15 March 1986, is a multi-talented Indian actor, singer, dancer, and model known primarily for his work in Bhojpuri cinema. He is also referred to by the initials KLY. With a career spanning over a decade, Khesari has appeared in more than 70 films, including one Bollywood film, and has performed as a vocalist in over 5000 songs. He has worked not only in Bhojpuri but also in Hindi, Awadhi, and Haryanvi languages.

 

Born in Chhapra, Bihar, Khesari Yadav began his singing career in the late 2000s and gained recognition with his acting debut in the film Saajan Chale Sasural in 2011. He made his Bollywood debut as a singer in 2014 with the song "AK-47" from the film Koyelaanchal. He has received several awards for his contributions to Bhojpuri cinema, including the Best Popular Actor award at the 2016 Bhojpuri Film Awards. He also won the Best Actor (Male) and Best Playback Singer (Male) awards at the Sabrang Film Awards in 2018 for his role in the film Mehandi Laga Ke Rakhna. In 2019, he won four more awards for his performance in the film Sangharsh.

 

In 2019, Khesari Yadav participated in the reality show Bigg Boss 13, which further increased his popularity. He made his mark in the Bollywood music scene with his third Bollywood song, "Ladki Patana," released by Sony Music India in 2020. He followed it up with "Tere Mere Darmiyaan" in 2021. He collaborated with Badshah to recreate the song "Pani Pani" in the Bhojpuri language. In 2022, he ventured into screenwriting and made his debut as a screenwriter with the film Aashiqui. Two of his songs were featured in YouTube's list of Top Indian songs of 2022, showcasing his growing influence and popularity.

item.title: Krishna Beura
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Krishna Beuraa

Playback Male Singer

Krishna Beuraa is an Indian playback singer known for his versatile singing in commercial Hindi and regional Indian cinema. He has contributed his vocals to numerous hit songs in various languages. One of his notable songs is "Maula Mere" from the film Chak De India. Other popular tracks include "Main Jahan Rahoon" from Namaste London, "Rabba" from Musafir, and "Soniyo from the Heart" from Raaz-2.

 

Krishna Beuraa is known for his ability to sing in 22 languages, including his mother tongue Odia. His journey as a singer in Bollywood began when he approached Sanjay Dutt, who not only appreciated his singing style but also provided him with opportunities to sing in films like Rudraksh, Rakht, Musafir, and Deewaar.

 

In addition to playback singing, Krishna Beuraa released his first solo pop album titled Ishq Gali Na Jaiyo in 2008, which consisted of eight songs. He has also collaborated with the popular Indian rock band Bandish for their self-titled album in 2010. Throughout his career, Krishna Beuraa has delivered hit songs like "Inteqam" from Shaadi Mein Zaroor Aana (2017), "Chaska" from Badmaash Company (2010), and "Soniyo" (From the Heart) from Raaz - The Mystery Continues (2009), showcasing his versatility and talent as a singer.

item.title: Krishna Iyer
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Krishna Iyer

Playback Male Singer

Krishna Iyer is a Tamil playback singer from Chennai, India. He has sung in Tamil, Hindi, and Telugu films. His first entry into the Tamil music industry was through the movie Kanthaswamy, starring Chiyaan Vikram. He has sung several popular songs, including "En Uchi Mandaila" from Vettaikaran, "Google Google" from Thuppakki, and "Yaelae Yaelae Dosthu Da" from Endrendrum Punnagai. He has worked with some of the top music directors in India, including Vijay Antony, Harris Jayaraj, G.V. Prakash Kumar, and Devi Sri Prasad.

 

Krishna Iyer is a talented singer with a wide range of vocal abilities. He is known for his powerful voice and his ability to sing in a variety of genres. He is a popular choice for playback singing in Tamil films and has sung several hit songs.

item.title: Kumar Sanu
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Kumar Sanu

Playback Male Singer

Kumar Sanu, whose real name is Kedarnath Bhattacharya, is a renowned Indian playback singer known for his melodious voice in Bollywood. He was born on October 20, 1957. Kumar Sanu is often referred to as the "King of Melody" in Bollywood and is famous for singing numerous super-hit Hindi songs. He was one of the most successful playback singers during the 1990s era of Bollywood.

 

In addition to Hindi, Kumar Sanu has sung in various other languages including Bengali, Marathi, Nepali, Assamese, Bhojpuri, Gujarati, Manipuri, Telugu, Malayalam, Kannada, Tamil, Punjabi, Odia, Chhattisgarhi, Urdu, Pali, English, and his native language Bengali, both in West Bengal and Bangladesh.

 

Kumar Sanu holds the record for winning five consecutive Filmfare Awards for Best Male Playback Singer from 1991 to 1995. He has also been recognized by the Guinness Book of World Records since 1993 for recording the maximum number of songs in a single day.

 

Sanu began his playback career as Sanu Bhattacharya in 1984. He made his debut in the Bangladeshi film "Teen Kanya" in 1986, directed by Shibli Sadiq. In 1989, Kumar Sanu was introduced to Kalyanji by Jagjit Singh at Vimal Bunglow in Mumbai. Following their suggestion, he changed his name from "Sanu Bhattacharya" to "Kumar Sanu" as a tribute to his idol, the legendary singer Kishore Kumar. Sanu then moved to Mumbai, where he received an opportunity to sing in the film "Jaadugar" by Kalyanji-Anandji.

Kumar Sanu, whose real name is Kedarnath Bhattacharya, is a renowned Indian playback singer known for his melodious voice in Bollywood. He was born on October 20, 1957. Kumar Sanu is often referred to as the \"King of Melody\" in Bollywood and is famous for singing numerous super-hit Hindi songs. He was one of the most successful playback singers during the 1990s era of Bollywood.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

In addition to Hindi, Kumar Sanu has sung in various other languages including Bengali, Marathi, Nepali, Assamese, Bhojpuri, Gujarati, Manipuri, Telugu, Malayalam, Kannada, Tamil, Punjabi, Odia, Chhattisgarhi, Urdu, Pali, English, and his native language Bengali, both in West Bengal and Bangladesh.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Kumar Sanu holds the record for winning five consecutive Filmfare Awards for Best Male Playback Singer from 1991 to 1995. He has also been recognized by the Guinness Book of World Records since 1993 for recording the maximum number of songs in a single day.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Sanu began his playback career as Sanu Bhattacharya in 1984. He made his debut in the Bangladeshi film \"Teen Kanya\" in 1986, directed by Shibli Sadiq. In 1989, Kumar Sanu was introduced to Kalyanji by Jagjit Singh at Vimal Bunglow in Mumbai. Following their suggestion, he changed his name from \"Sanu Bhattacharya\" to \"Kumar Sanu\" as a tribute to his idol, the legendary singer Kishore Kumar. Sanu then moved to Mumbai, where he received an opportunity to sing in the film \"Jaadugar\" by Kalyanji-Anandji.<\/p>","typography_typography":"custom","typography_font_weight":"bold"},"elements":[],"widgetType":"text-editor"}],"isInner":false}],"isInner":false},{"id":"24cb8de","elType":"section","settings":{"background_background":"classic","background_color":"#EAF0EE8F","hover_parallax":[{"layer_position_vr":{"unit":"%","size":30},"layer_position_hr":{"unit":"%","size":40},"_id":"ac4fb18"},{"layer_position_vr":{"unit":"%","size":60},"layer_position_hr":{"unit":"%","size":20},"_id":"a1b2b38"}]},"elements":[{"id":"968efb0","elType":"column","settings":{"_column_size":100,"_inline_size":null},"elements":[{"id":"b6ddb60","elType":"widget","settings":{"title":"Enquiry Form","header_size":"h3","align":"center","typography_typography":"custom","typography_font_size":{"unit":"px","size":40,"sizes":[]},"typography_font_weight":"bold","_margin":{"unit":"px","top":"40","right":"0","bottom":"20","left":"0","isLinked":false},"__globals__":{"title_color":"globals\/colors?id=6d3d44f9"}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"heading"},{"id":"f84e05b","elType":"widget","settings":{"shortcode":"[forminator_form id=\"5483\"]","_margin":{"unit":"px","top":"0","right":"0","bottom":"40","left":"0","isLinked":false}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"shortcode"}],"isInner":false}],"isInner":false}]

item.title: Kshitij Tarey
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Kshitij Tarey

Playback Male Singer

Kshitij Tarey is an Indian playback singer known for his soulful and melodious voice. He was born on January 21, 1987, in Kolkata, West Bengal, India.

 

Kshitij Tarey gained popularity with his breakthrough song "Pee Loon" from the Bollywood film "Once Upon a Time in Mumbaai" (2010). The song became a huge hit and showcased his versatility as a singer. He received critical acclaim for his rendition and established himself as a talented playback singer in the industry.

 

Since then, Kshitij Tarey has lent his voice to various Bollywood songs. Some of his notable tracks include "Tera Ban Jaunga" from the film "Kabir Singh" (2019), "Kaisi Hai Ye Udaasi" from "Karthik Calling Karthik" (2010), and "Ro Len De" from "1920 London" (2016). His soul-stirring vocals and emotional renditions have resonated with audiences.

 

Kshitij Tarey continues to actively contribute to the music industry and collaborate with renowned composers and singers. His soothing voice and ability to convey emotions through his singing have made him a respected name in the Bollywood playback singing scene.

item.title: Kunal Ganjawala
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Kunal Ganjawala

Playback Male Singer

That's correct! Kunal Ganjawala is an Indian playback singer known for his work in Hindi and Kannada films. He was born on April 14, 1972. Kunal initially started his career by singing jingles for advertisements. However, he gained widespread recognition in Hindi cinema with the song "Bheege Honth Tere" from the film Murder in 2004. This song became a huge hit and earned him the Zee Cine Award for Best Playback Singer in 2005.

 

In Kannada cinema, Kunal rose to prominence with the song "Neene Neene" from the film Aakash, which was released in 2005. His melodious voice and impactful renditions made him popular among the audience and established him as a sought-after playback singer. Apart from Hindi and Kannada, Kunal has also lent his voice to songs in Marathi, Bengali, and several other languages spoken in India.

item.title: Kunal Pandit
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Kunal Pandit

Playback Male Singer

Kunal Pandit is a talented singer who has captured the hearts of many with his soulful voice and charismatic stage presence. Born with a passion for music, Kunal's journey in the music industry has been nothing short of remarkable. Hailing from a musically inclined family, he developed a deep understanding of music from a young age.

Kunal rose to fame through his appearances on the popular reality show Indian Idol, where his melodious voice and versatile singing style earned him a devoted fan following. His ability to effortlessly traverse various genres, from romantic ballads to energetic dance numbers, showcases his versatility as an artist.

With his enchanting vocals and impeccable range, Kunal has delivered several hit songs, leaving listeners spellbound. His renditions have a unique blend of emotion and technical finesse, creating an unforgettable musical experience. Whether performing on stage or recording in the studio, Kunal's dedication to his craft shines through in every note he sings.

As an artist, Kunal Pandit continues to evolve and push boundaries, captivating audiences with his exceptional talent and passion for music. With a bright future ahead, he is poised to make a lasting impact on the music industry and inspire aspiring singers around the world.

item.title: L. V. Revanth
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Lolla Venkata Revanth

Playback Male Singer

Lolla Venkata Revanth Kumar Sharma, known as L. V. Revanth, is an Indian playback singer primarily known for his work in the Telugu film industry. He was born on February 10, 1990. Revanth gained recognition after winning various singing competitions and reality shows.

 

One of his notable achievements was winning the ninth season of the popular reality show Indian Idol in 2017, which aired on Sony Entertainment Television. This victory earned him a cash prize of Rs. 25 lakhs and a Mahindra KUV100. His talent was also acknowledged with nominations for the IIFA Utsavam and Star Maa Music Awards for Best Male Playback Singer for his rendition of the song "Manohari" from the film Baahubali: The Beginning.

 

Revanth has contributed his vocals to approximately 200 songs in Telugu and Kannada films. Some of his notable songs include "Telisiney Na Nuvvey" and "Oopiri Aaguthunnadey" from the 2017 film Arjun Reddy. In addition to Telugu, he made his debut in the Hindi music industry by singing the title track for the reality show Sabse Bada Kalakar, which aired on Sony Entertainment Television.

Throughout his career, Revanth has considered renowned music composer M. M. Keeravani as his mentor. He has participated in various singing shows like Saptha Swaralu, Super Singer 5, Super Singer 7, and served as a mentor on Super Singer 8. In 2022, he emerged as the winner of the sixth season of the Telugu reality show Bigg Boss.

item.title: Mohan Babu
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Mohan Babu

Playback Male Singer

Mohan Babu is a prominent figure in the Indian film industry, specifically known for his contributions to Telugu cinema. Born on March 19, 1952, in Modhugulapalem, Andhra Pradesh, he has established himself as a versatile actor, producer, and politician. With a career spanning over four decades, Mohan Babu has left an indelible mark on the industry.

 

He made his acting debut in 1975 with the film "Swargam Narakam" and has since appeared in over 500 films, portraying diverse characters across genres. His powerful screen presence and impeccable dialogue delivery have earned him a loyal fan base. Mohan Babu is renowned for his ability to effortlessly switch between comedic and dramatic roles, showcasing his versatility as an actor.

 

Apart from his acting career, Mohan Babu has also ventured into film production, founding the production company named "Sree Lakshmi Prasanna Pictures." He has produced several successful films under this banner, including critically acclaimed projects.

 

Furthermore, Mohan Babu entered politics and served as a Member of Parliament from the Rajya Sabha, representing Andhra Pradesh. His philanthropic endeavors include the establishment of the educational institution "Sree Vidyanikethan Educational Trust" and various charitable activities.

 

Mohan Babu's contribution to the entertainment industry and his multifaceted personality have earned him immense respect and admiration from his peers and fans alike. He continues to inspire and entertain audiences with his captivating performances.

item.title: Mohanlal
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Mohanlal

Playback Male Singer

Mohanlal, born on May 21, 1960, is a legendary Indian actor known for his exceptional contributions to the Malayalam film industry. With a career spanning over four decades, he has left an indelible mark on the hearts of millions of fans worldwide. Mohanlal's versatility and captivating performances have earned him numerous accolades and a revered status in the film fraternity.

 

Known for his impeccable acting skills, Mohanlal has portrayed a wide range of characters with utmost brilliance and finesse. From intense dramas to comedy, action-packed thrillers to soul-stirring emotional roles, he has effortlessly breathed life into each character he has played. His ability to effortlessly switch between diverse roles showcases his immense talent and dedication to his craft.

 

Beyond acting, Mohanlal has also ventured into film production, playback singing, and screenwriting, showcasing his multifaceted abilities. Despite his colossal success, he remains grounded and humble, endearing himself to both colleagues and fans alike.

 

Mohanlal's contributions to Indian cinema have been recognized with several prestigious awards, including five National Film Awards and multiple state awards. He continues to mesmerize audiences with his charismatic presence, impeccable dialogue delivery, and innate ability to connect with viewers on an emotional level.

 

Mohanlal's influence and legacy extend beyond the silver screen. He is a philanthropist, actively involved in various charitable initiatives, and has been appointed as a goodwill ambassador for several social causes.

 

In summary, Mohanlal is an icon of Indian cinema, a true powerhouse of talent, and a living legend whose impact on the industry will be celebrated for generations to come.

item.title: Madan Gopal Singh
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Madan Gopal Singh

Playback Male Singer

Madan Gopal Singh is a renowned Sufi singer who has captivated audiences with his soulful voice and profound understanding of Sufi poetry. Born in India, he has dedicated his life to preserving and propagating the rich musical traditions of Sufism. With his exceptional vocal range and emotive renditions, Madan Gopal Singh effortlessly weaves together spirituality, music, and poetry, creating a mesmerizing experience for his listeners.

 

His deep-rooted knowledge of Sufi philosophy and his ability to express its essence through his music have earned him accolades and recognition both nationally and internationally. Madan Gopal Singh's performances are characterized by a sense of transcendence, as he delves into the mystical realms of Sufi poetry, exploring themes of love, devotion, and spiritual awakening.

 

Throughout his career, Madan Gopal Singh has collaborated with various musicians and artists, enriching his music with diverse influences. His commitment to preserving the traditional forms of Sufi music while incorporating contemporary elements has made him a revered figure in the world of Sufi music. Madan Gopal Singh's music serves as a bridge between the past and the present, touching the hearts and souls of people from all walks of life.

item.title: Mame Khan
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Mame Khan

Playback Male Singer

Mame Khan is a renowned Sufi singer hailing from Rajasthan, India, whose captivating voice and soulful renditions have enchanted audiences worldwide. Born into a family of Manganiyar musicians, Mame Khan inherited a rich musical heritage and began his musical journey at an early age. With his exceptional vocal range and unique style, he has breathed new life into traditional Sufi music.

 

Mame Khan's performances are marked by his heartfelt expressions, melodic improvisations, and the ability to evoke deep emotions in his listeners. His mastery of various vocal techniques, including intricate ornamentations and powerful modulations, adds a mesmerizing dimension to his renditions. Whether performing soul-stirring Qawwalis, mystical Sufi compositions, or folk songs, he effortlessly connects with his audience, transcending cultural boundaries.

 

Beyond his captivating performances, Mame Khan has collaborated with prominent musicians and composers from around the world, further enriching his musical repertoire. His collaborations with international artists have showcased the universal appeal of Sufi music and promoted cultural exchange.

item.title: Master Saleem
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Master Saleem

Playback Male Singer

Master Saleem, born as Saleem Shahzada, is a renowned Indian playback singer and musician hailing from Punjab. With his soulful voice and exceptional vocal range, Saleem has carved a niche for himself in the music industry. His versatility spans across various genres, including Sufi, devotional, and romantic melodies.

 

Saleem's musical journey began at a young age when he started accompanying his father, Ustad Puran Shah Koti, on stage. He gained recognition through his exceptional performances in reality shows, captivating the hearts of audiences with his melodious renditions. His breakthrough came with the song "Dhol Jagiro Da" in the Bollywood film "Oh My God."

 

Known for his emotional and heartfelt performances, Master Saleem has received numerous accolades for his contributions to the music industry. His soul-stirring vocals have touched the hearts of millions, making him a favorite among music enthusiasts worldwide.

 

Beyond his playback singing career, Saleem has also released several successful albums, showcasing his prowess as a versatile artist. His ability to infuse passion and emotion into every note he sings has earned him a loyal fan base and established him as a true master of his craft.

item.title: Meet Jain
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Meet Jain

Playback Male Singer

Meet Jain is an Indian playback singer, composer, and lyricist known for his work in the Hindi and Gujarati film industry. Born and raised in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, Meet Jain comes from a family of professors. He is a well-trained vocalist, pianist, and guitarist who has been performing on stage since the age of 12.

 

In 2013, Meet Jain gained recognition when he won the "Idea Rocks India, Ahmedabad" competition, where he shared the stage with singer Mika Singh. He has also sung for prominent business banner advertisements in Gujarati, including TATA and ADANI.

 

Meet Jain has appeared as a contestant on various reality shows. He participated in the 5th edition of Sony TV's "Entertainment Ke Liye Kuch Bhi Karega," judged by Farah Khan and Anu Malik. In 2015, he was selected as a contestant on the first season of "The Voice India," mentored by singer Shaan. Although he was eliminated during the battle rounds, his popularity on the show led to him hosting "The Voice India" alongside Karan Tacker.

 

Meet Jain has also shared a special bond with actor and host Arjun Bijlani, leading to him playing the role of Arjun's friend on a special episode of "Dance Deewane 2." He performed on the show and shared the stage with Madhuri Dixit, Tushar Kalia, and Shashank Khaitan.

 

With a career spanning over several years, Meet Jain has performed in more than 1100 shows worldwide. He has also contributed his vocals to various Gujarati songs, with one of his most popular tracks being "Radha Khovai," where he featured alongside Shraddha Dangar.

 

Meet Jain's versatility as a singer, composer, and lyricist has allowed him to make a mark in both the Hindi and Gujarati music industries. His performances and compositions continue to charm audiences, making him a respected figure in the industry.

item.title: Mehul Surti
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Mehul Surti

Playback Male Singer

Mehul Surti is indeed an Indian music composer and singer known for his work in Gujarati cinema and theatre. He has made significant contributions to the Gujarati film industry by composing music for several successful films and plays.

 

As a music director, Mehul Surti started his career at a young age, composing songs for the 1999 Gujarati film "Narmada Tara Vahi Jata Pani," directed by Kirit Panwalla. Since then, he has composed music for various Gujarati films, including notable works such as "Kevi Rite Jaish" (2012), "Vitamin She" (2017), "Montu Ni Bittu" (2019), "Short Circuit" (2019), and the National Film Award-winning film "Hellaro" (2019). His compositions have garnered appreciation and recognition within the Gujarati film industry.

 

Mehul Surti has also ventured into composing background scores for plays, adding depth and emotional resonance to theatrical performances. Some of the plays he has worked on include "Priya Pappa Have To," "Aakhar Ni Aatmakatha," "Khelando," "Koi Pan Ek Phoolnu Naam Bolo To," "Samudramanthan," and "Dhaad."

 

In addition to his film and theatre work, Mehul Surti has also composed music for over 200 poems by various Gujarati poets. His compositions showcase his versatility and ability to capture the essence of the written word through music.

\u00a0<\/p>

As a music director, Mehul Surti started his career at a young age, composing songs for the 1999 Gujarati film \"Narmada Tara Vahi Jata Pani,\" directed by Kirit Panwalla. Since then, he has composed music for various Gujarati films, including notable works such as \"Kevi Rite Jaish\" (2012), \"Vitamin She\" (2017), \"Montu Ni Bittu\" (2019), \"Short Circuit\" (2019), and the National Film Award-winning film \"Hellaro\" (2019). His compositions have garnered appreciation and recognition within the Gujarati film industry.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Mehul Surti has also ventured into composing background scores for plays, adding depth and emotional resonance to theatrical performances. Some of the plays he has worked on include \"Priya Pappa Have To,\" \"Aakhar Ni Aatmakatha,\" \"Khelando,\" \"Koi Pan Ek Phoolnu Naam Bolo To,\" \"Samudramanthan,\" and \"Dhaad.\"<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

In addition to his film and theatre work, Mehul Surti has also composed music for over 200 poems by various Gujarati poets. item.title: Milind Gaba
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Millind Gaba

Playback Male Singer

Millind Gaba is an Indian singer, songwriter, music producer, and actor known for his contributions to Punjabi and Bollywood music. He has gained popularity with songs such as "Nazar Lag Jayegi," "She Don't Know," and "Yaar Mod Do."

 

As a singer, Millind Gaba has released several hit singles, including "Nazar Lag Jayegi," "She Don't Know," "Main Teri Ho Gayi," "Zindagi Di Paudi," "Peele Peele," "Beautiful," "Nachunga Aise," "Kya Karu," and "Dilli Shehar." He has collaborated with Punjabi singer Guru Randhawa on the song "Yaar Mod Do."

 

One of his notable music videos is for the song "She Don't Know," which was released by T-Series on YouTube. The video has garnered over 500 million views as of January 2021, showcasing the widespread popularity of Millind Gaba's music.

 

In addition to his musical endeavors, Millind Gaba has ventured into acting, making his debut in the Punjabi film "Stupid 7."

In his personal life, Millind Gaba married fashion blogger Pria Beniwal on 16 April 2022, marking a significant milestone in his journey.

item.title: Mithoon Sharma
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Mithoon Sharma

Playback Male Singer

Mithoon Sharma, popularly known as Mithoon, is a renowned Indian singer, music composer, and lyricist who has left an indelible mark on the Bollywood music industry. With his soulful voice and exceptional musical talent, Mithoon has captivated the hearts of millions of music lovers.

 

Born into a family deeply rooted in music, Mithoon inherited a passion for melodies from his father, Naresh Sharma, a well-known musician himself. Since his debut as a composer with the film "Bas Ek Pal" in 2006, Mithoon has consistently delivered chart-topping hits that resonate with emotions.

 

What sets Mithoon apart is his ability to create music that touches the core of human emotions. His compositions are characterized by haunting melodies, heartfelt lyrics, and a seamless fusion of traditional and contemporary sounds. Mithoon has an innate knack for crafting music that strikes a chord with listeners, making him a sought-after artist in the industry.

 

His notable works include the soul-stirring tracks "Tum Hi Ho" from "Aashiqui 2," "Phir Bhi Tumko Chaahunga" from "Half Girlfriend," and "Sanam Re" from the eponymous film. Mithoon's contributions have garnered critical acclaim and numerous awards, including Filmfare and IIFA, solidifying his position as one of the most talented and respected artists in Indian music.

item.title: Mohammed Irfan
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Mohammad Irfan

Playback Male Singer

Mohammad Irfan is an Indian playback singer who gained recognition in the Bollywood music industry. He came to the attention of veteran singer S. P. Balasubrahmanyam during a concert in Hyderabad, who recommended him to renowned composer A.R. Rahman. This led to Irfan providing background vocals for the song "Behene De" in the 2010 film Raavan, alongside Karthik. The track became a chart-topper and received positive reviews.

 

In the same year, Irfan recorded two songs for Mithoon's Lamhaa, titled "Salaam Zindagi" and "Rehmat Zara," with the latter earning him the Best Male Singer Debut award. He also collaborated with various music directors such as Sajid–Wajid, Himesh Reshammiya, Meet Bros Anjjan, and Jeet Ganguly.

 

One of Irfan's notable songs is "Phir Mohabbat," performed alongside Arijit Singh and Saim Bhat for the 2011 film Murder 2. The song achieved commercial success and received significant radio airplay. However, it was his song "Dil Sambhal Ja Zara" from Murder 2 that truly established him as a singer.

 

In 2014, Irfan's notable songs included "Baarish" from Yaariyan, "Muskurane" from Citylights, "Banjaara" from Ek Villain, "Dard Dilo Ke" from The Xpose, and "Tu Hi Tu" from Kick. The song "Banjaara" composed by Mithoon Sharma was particularly successful.

 

Irfan's soulful voice and impactful renditions have made him a respected figure in the Bollywood music industry, and he continues to contribute his talent to various films and music albums.

item.title: Mohd Faiz
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Mohammad Faiz

Playback Male Singer

Mohammad Faiz is a talented Indian child artist and singer who rose to fame by winning the prestigious singing reality show, Superstar Singer Season 2. The show, aired on Sony TV, showcased Faiz's exceptional vocal skills and stage presence, ultimately leading him to claim the winner's title on 4 September 2022. The renowned Indian musicians Himesh Reshammiya, Alka Yagnik, and Javed Ali served as the judges of the show, providing guidance and mentorship to Faiz throughout his journey.

 

Faiz comes from a musical background, with his maternal grandfather, Ustad Shakur Khan, being a renowned Indian classical singer. This familial connection to music inspired Faiz to pursue his passion from a young age. At the tender age of eight, he began his musical training under the guidance of his maternal grandfather, receiving invaluable lessons and honing his skills.

 

Prior to his success on Superstar Singer, Faiz showcased his talent on the reality show Love Me India Kid in 2018, where he emerged as one of the finalists. Judged by popular Indian singers Guru Randhawa, Neha Bhasin, and Himesh Reshammiya, the show provided Faiz with a platform to display his musical abilities and gain recognition.

 

Continuing his journey in the world of reality singing competitions, Faiz participated in Sa Re Ga Ma Pa Lil Champs in 2019, which aired on Zee TV. His exceptional performances earned him the title of the first runner-up in the competition, further solidifying his position as a rising star in the music industry.

 

With his remarkable talent, dedication, and the support of his family and mentors, Mohammad Faiz has established himself as a promising young artist with a bright future ahead. His achievements on various reality shows have catapulted him into the spotlight, and he continues to captivate audiences with his soulful voice and passion for music.

item.title: Mohd. Danish
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Mohd. Danish

Playback Male Singer

Mohd. Danish is an Indian singer hailing from Muzaffarnagar, Uttar Pradesh. Coming from a family deeply rooted in music, Danish carries the legacy of the renowned Kirana Gharana. He began his musical journey at a young age, receiving extensive training from his grandfather, Ustad Abdul Karim Khan, for over a decade.

 

Danish not only possesses a melodious voice but also pays great attention to his appearance. He takes pride in maintaining a well-groomed and presentable image, which has garnered him a substantial following on various social media platforms. Fans appreciate not only his singing talent but also his striking looks.

 

During his childhood, Danish actively participated in numerous singing competitions, where he showcased his remarkable skills and won several awards. He even secured the prestigious title of the divisional music competition, further establishing his talent and potential.

 

In 2016, Danish embarked on his singing career by participating in the television singing reality show "Voice of Punjab Season 6." His exceptional performances led him to become one of the top finalists of the show, earning recognition for his talent. The following year, he further showcased his abilities on another reality show called "The Voice of India," where he became a favorite contestant of the esteemed judge Neeti Mohan.

 

With his rich musical background, captivating voice, and charming persona, Mohd. Danish has become a rising star in the Indian music industry. His dedication to his craft and his ability to connect with audiences have helped him build a promising career in the realm of music.

Mohit Modanwal

Playback Male Singer

Mohit Modanwal is a multi-talented artist who excels as a singer, performer, and charmer. With his captivating stage presence and dynamic performances, he goes beyond mere entertainment and creates an immersive experience for his audience.

 

Known for his versatility, Mohit possesses a unique ability to adapt to various musical genres and styles. Whether it's soulful ballads, energetic pop numbers, or foot-tapping Bollywood hits, he showcases his vocal prowess and delivers engaging performances that leave a lasting impact.

 

Mohit's shows are more than just musical performances; they are an amalgamation of his talent, charisma, and connection with the audience. His ability to engage and interact with the crowd creates a vibrant atmosphere, making every show a memorable experience for attendees.

Beyond his singing skills, Mohit Modanwal's stage presence and charming personality add an extra dimension to his performances. His passion for music and dedication to his craft shine through in every note he sings, leaving a lasting impression on his listeners.

As an artist, Mohit continues to evolve and explore new avenues in the music industry. With his talent, versatility, and ability to captivate audiences, he has the potential to make a significant impact and establish himself as a prominent figure in the music scene. Whether on stage or in the studio, Mohit Modanwal's artistry and charm make him a captivating performer worth experiencing.

item.title: Noel Sean
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Noel Sean

Playback Male Singer

Noel Sean, born on November 28, 1982, is an Indian rapper and actor known for his work in the Telugu cinema and Telugu music industry. He is recognized as the first rapper in the Telugu music industry and has established himself as a versatile actor, music producer, television host, radio jockey, lyricist, and composer.

 

Noel Sean's journey in the entertainment industry began when he met renowned archery coach Pallela Ravishankar, who encouraged and guided him into the film industry. He made his on-screen debut in the Telugu film "Sambhavami Yuge Yuge" and got the opportunity to work with director Krishna and music director M. M. Keeravani. His breakthrough as a rapper came with the Telugu movie "Vikramarkudu," directed by S. S. Rajamouli, which earned him immense recognition and the title of the "First Telugu Rapper."

 

In 2007, Noel Sean appeared in the film "Mantra" alongside Charmy Kaur, featuring the popular song "Maha Maha." He also ventured into radio jockeying for 93.5 Red FM, where he gained a significant fan following. Over the years, he has played notable roles in various prominent projects, establishing himself as a versatile actor in Telugu cinema.

item.content:encoded:
Nitin Kumar

Playback Male Singer

Nitin Kumar is a remarkable singer whose enchanting voice captivates listeners worldwide. With his undeniable talent and passion for music, he has carved a niche for himself in the music industry. Nitin's mesmerizing performances and soulful renditions have earned him immense acclaim and a dedicated fan following.

 

Born with a melodious voice, Nitin Kumar started his musical journey at a young age. His versatility allows him to effortlessly transition between various genres, including Bollywood, classical, and Sufi. His flawless vocal control and ability to evoke emotions through his singing make each of his performances a breathtaking experience.

 

Nitin Kumar rose to prominence with his participation in a popular singing reality show, where he showcased his exceptional vocal prowess. His dynamic stage presence and charisma captivated the judges and the audience alike, leading him to emerge as a frontrunner in the competition.

 

Since then, Nitin has collaborated with renowned music composers and singers, delivering chart-topping hits. His melodious voice has lent itself to numerous successful Bollywood songs, making him a sought-after playback singer in the industry.

 

Beyond his musical achievements, Nitin Kumar remains grounded and humble, attributing his success to his dedication, hard work, and love for music. With his innate talent and relentless pursuit of excellence, Nitin continues to enthrall music lovers worldwide, leaving an indelible mark on the music industry.

item.title: Navdeep Wadali
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Navdeep Wadali

Playback Male Singer

Navdeep Wadali is a talented singer who rose to fame through his participation in the reality singing competition "Indian Idol." Born into a renowned musical family in Punjab, India, Navdeep inherited his musical prowess from his father, Puran Chand Wadali, who belonged to the famous Wadali Brothers duo.

 

With his soulful voice and captivating performances, Navdeep captivated the audience and judges alike on Indian Idol. His ability to effortlessly traverse various genres, including Sufi, folk, and Bollywood, showcased his versatility as a singer. Navdeep's renditions were marked by his emotive expressions, impeccable control over pitch and melody, and a deep understanding of the essence of each song.

 

His performances on Indian Idol not only earned him praise and adoration from the judges but also garnered a huge fan following across the nation. Navdeep Wadali's journey on the show served as a platform for him to showcase his musical talent and solidify his place in the Indian music industry. Today, he continues to enthrall audiences with his melodious voice and contribute to the rich musical legacy of his family.

item.title: Nitin Dubey
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Nitin Dubey

Playback Male Singer

Nitin Dubey, born on July 3, 1981, is a versatile Indian artist known for his talents as a singer, composer, actor, and lyricist. Hailing from Raigarh, Chhattisgarh, Nitin Dubey gained prominence through his melodious singing and compositions on his YouTube channel, "Nitin Dubey Official," which has garnered more than 7 lakh subscribers.

 

Throughout his career spanning over two decades in the Chhattisgarh film industry, Dubey has showcased his skills as a singer, music director, and actor. He has lent his voice to various movies and acted in his own album songs. Nitin Dubey embarked on his singing career in 2001 with the album "Tain Deewani Main Deewana," featuring popular tracks like "Manmohini He Gaon Ke Goriya," "Ud Ja Re Maina," and "Jawan De Jawan De Mola." He went on to release several albums, including "Hay Tore Bindiya," "Tain Mor Prem Deewani," and "Padosin Turi." In 2005, his album "Hay Mor Chandni" catapulted him to fame and earned him recognition across Chhattisgarh.

 

Apart from his work in film music, Nitin Dubey has also garnered fame as a bhajan singer. He has released Chhattisgarhi bhajan albums such as "Chandraseni Amar Katha 1" and "Chandraseni Amar Katha 2" in 2006 and 2007, respectively. He has also released Hindi bhajan albums like "Chalo Shirdi Dham" and "Sancha Hai Maa Ka Darbar" in 2009 and 2010. In 2013, he collaborated with renowned Bollywood singers Suresh Wadkar and Sadhna Sargam on the album "Sai Ka Sajda," released under the label Ultra Music, Mumbai. This album propelled Nitin Dubey's reputation as a Sai bhajan singer, leading to live performances and bhajan programs across different states in India.

item.title: Nihal Tauro
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Nihal Tauro

Playback Male Singer

Nihal Tauro gained recognition as a contestant on Indian Idol 2020 Season 12, representing Moodbidri, Mangalore, India. His participation in various music shows, including "Sa Re Ga Ma Pa Kannada" and "Daijiworld Studio Voice," showcases his talent and versatility as a singer, songwriter, and composer.

Nihal Tauro's film debut in the song "Naa Huduko Naale" from the movie "Premier Padmini," composed by Arjun Janya, further established his presence in the industry. It's commendable that he has performed in various stage shows in countries like Qatar and Kuwait, captivating audiences with his performances.

 

Having appeared on popular TV reality shows on Sony TV and other channels, Nihal Tauro has not only won titles but also earned the appreciation of judges and viewers. His contributions to film soundtracks, such as "Premier Padmini" and "Love Moktel," have further solidified his presence in the film industry.

 

Overall, Nihal Tauro's talent as a singer, songwriter, composer, and playback singer, along with his ability to perform in multiple languages, has helped him make a name for himself in the music industry. His journey on Indian Idol and subsequent achievements demonstrate his dedication and passion for music.

item.title: Nakash Aziz
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Nakash Aziz

Playback Male Singer

Nakash Aziz is an Indian playback singer and music composer who predominantly works in the Hindi film industry. He was born on 24 February 1985 in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. Nakash began his career as a playback singer in 2008 with the film Jodhaa Akbar, where he sang the song "Jashn-e-Bahaara." Since then, he has lent his voice to numerous hit songs in Bollywood.

 

Some of Nakash Aziz's popular songs include "Sari Ke Fall Sa" from R... Rajkumar, "Gandi Baat" from the same film, "Jabra Fan" from Fan, "Selfie Le Le Re" from Bajrangi Bhaijaan, and "The Breakup Song" from Ae Dil Hai Mushkil. His versatile voice and energetic performances have made him a sought-after singer in the industry.

 

Apart from singing, Nakash has also composed music for films like Galti Sirf Tumhari and Muavza: Zameen Ka Paisa. He has received several nominations and awards for his contributions to the music industry, including the Filmfare Award for Best Male Playback Singer.

 

Nakash Aziz continues to captivate audiences with his soulful voice and vibrant musical talent, establishing himself as a prominent figure in the Indian music scene.

item.title: Naresh Iyer
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Naresh Iyer

Playback Male Singer

Naresh Iyer, born on 3 January 1981 in Mumbai, is an Indian playback singer known for his versatile singing in multiple languages. He is fluent in Tamil, Malayalam, Kannada, Hindi, and Marathi. With his exceptional talent, Naresh has rendered around 2000 film songs in various Indian languages and has delivered numerous chart-topping hits.

 

One of Naresh Iyer's notable achievements was his rendition of the song "Roobaroo" from the film Rang De Basanti, composed by A.R. Rahman. The song topped music charts for several weeks in 2006 and earned him the National Film Award for Best Male Playback Singer. He was also honored with the Filmfare award in the R.D. Burman Musical Talent category.

 

Naresh Iyer was discovered by A.R. Rahman during his participation in the reality talent show Channel V's Super Singer. Although he did not win the show, Rahman recognized his talent and approached him. Naresh made his debut with the song "Mayilirage" from the film Anbe Aaruyire. He has since collaborated with various composers in Tamil, Telugu, Hindi, and Malayalam languages.

 

In addition to his playback singing, Naresh Iyer is the lead vocalist of a fusion band based in Mumbai called Dhvani. His remarkable contributions to the music industry have earned him accolades and recognition, including the prestigious R.D. Burman Award for the best male upcoming singer. Furthermore, he received the National Award for Best Playback Singer (Male) for his soulful rendition of "Roobaroo" from the movie Rang De Basanti.

item.title: Panna Gill
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Panna Gill

Playback Male Singer

Panna Gill is a multi-talented singer known for his melodious voice, good looks, and charming personality. He developed a passion for singing at a young age and started his musical journey at the age of 13. Panna Gill is a disciple of Ustad Gulam Mustafa Khan, a highly respected and renowned Indian classical vocalist, from whom he learned the intricacies of music and honed his skills.

 

Panna Gill's career took a significant turn when he participated in Indian Idol 2, a popular singing reality show in India. His talent and impressive performances on the show gained him recognition and opened doors to new opportunities in the music industry.

 

In 2007, Panna Gill released his first album titled "PANNA" under the label Frankfin Music. The album showcased his versatility and vocal prowess, establishing him as a promising singer. Since then, he has continued to progress in his musical journey, consistently delivering captivating performances.

 

Panna draws inspiration from his father, Lakhbir Singh Lakha, who is a renowned singer himself. This family influence has played a significant role in shaping Panna's musical style and approach.

 

His energy and passion for music have only grown with each performance, and he has become known for his charismatic stage presence. Panna Gill's dedication and uncompromising charm have contributed to his success, and he remains grateful for the opportunities that have come his way.

 

With his talent, hard work, and a touch of stardom, Panna Gill's journey resembles a Bollywood story. Hailing from a small town, he pursued his dreams with determination and stayed true to his musical roots. Panna's heartfelt performances reflect his genuine emotions and the values he holds dear. He continues to shine in the music industry, leaving a lasting impression on his audiences and proving that dreams do come true with dedication and passion.
