item.title: Prashant Tamang
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Prashant tamang

Playback Male Singer

Prashant Tamang is an Indian singer and actor who gained fame by winning the reality TV show "Indian Idol" Season 3 in 2007. He was born on January 4, 1983, in Darjeeling, West Bengal, India.

 

Prashant Tamang's victory on "Indian Idol" propelled him into the music industry, and he released his debut album titled "Dhanyavad" in 2007. The album received a positive response from audiences and helped establish his career as a playback singer.

 

Following his success on the show, Prashant Tamang ventured into acting and made his film debut with the Nepali movie "Gorkha Paltan" in 2010. He has since acted in several Nepali and Hindi films, including "Kahaani Gudiya Ki: True Story of a Woman" (2008), "Parda" (2019), and "Angry Young Man" (2014).

 

Prashant Tamang continues to perform in concerts and events, captivating audiences with his soulful voice. He has released several singles and albums, showcasing his versatility as a singer.

item.title: Parmish Verma
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Parmish verma

Playback Male Singer

Parmish Verma is an Indian singer, rapper, director, and actor known for his contributions to the Punjabi Music and Punjabi Film Industry. He initially began his career as a video director before transitioning to singing and eventually making his acting debut in the film Rocky Mental.

 

Parmish started his journey as a director with the film "Zimmewari Bhukh Te Doori," which was based on his own life experiences as a young boy growing up in Australia. The film depicted the hardships he faced during that time and the advice he received from Gurikk Maan.

 

In 2017, Parmish made his acting debut with the film Rocky Mental, where he played the lead role. He went on to act in movies like Dil Diyan Gallan (2019), which he also wrote and directed. He has since released more movies, including "Singham" and most recently, "Jinde Meriye."

 

Born in Patiala, Parmish comes from a Punjabi Hindu Khatri family. His father, Satish Verma, is a theatre artist and writer, while his mother, Paramjit Verma, is a professor.

 

Parmish faced a life-threatening incident when he was shot by Punjab gangster Dilpreet Baba while returning home from a party. However, he recovered from the incident.

On 20 October 2021, Parmish Verma married his longtime girlfriend, Canadian politician Guneet Grewal. They welcomed their daughter named Sadaa on 30 September 2022.

Parmish Verma is an Indian singer, rapper, director, and actor known for his contributions to the Punjabi Music and Punjabi Film Industry. He initially began his career as a video director before transitioning to singing and eventually making his acting debut in the film Rocky Mental.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Parmish started his journey as a director with the film \"Zimmewari Bhukh Te Doori,\" which was based on his own life experiences as a young boy growing up in Australia. The film depicted the hardships he faced during that time and the advice he received from Gurikk Maan.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

In 2017, Parmish made his acting debut with the film Rocky Mental, where he played the lead role. He went on to act in movies like Dil Diyan Gallan (2019), which he also wrote and directed. He has since released more movies, including \"Singham\" and most recently, \"Jinde Meriye.\"<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Born in Patiala, Parmish comes from a Punjabi Hindu Khatri family. His father, Satish Verma, is a theatre artist and writer, while his mother, Paramjit Verma, is a professor.<\/p>

\u00a0<\/p>

Parmish faced a life-threatening incident when he was shot by Punjab gangster Dilpreet Baba while returning home from a party. However, he recovered from the incident.<\/p>

On 20 October 2021, Parmish Verma married his longtime girlfriend, Canadian politician Guneet Grewal. They welcomed their daughter named Sadaa on 30 September 2022.<\/p>","typography_typography":"custom","typography_font_weight":"bold"},"elements":[],"widgetType":"text-editor"}],"isInner":false}],"isInner":false},{"id":"a6a5e50","elType":"section","settings":{"background_background":"classic","background_color":"#EAF0EE8F","hover_parallax":[{"layer_position_vr":{"unit":"%","size":30},"layer_position_hr":{"unit":"%","size":40},"_id":"ac4fb18"},{"layer_position_vr":{"unit":"%","size":60},"layer_position_hr":{"unit":"%","size":20},"_id":"a1b2b38"}]},"elements":[{"id":"746b900","elType":"column","settings":{"_column_size":100,"_inline_size":null},"elements":[{"id":"27fe29e","elType":"widget","settings":{"title":"Enquiry Form","header_size":"h3","align":"center","typography_typography":"custom","typography_font_size":{"unit":"px","size":40,"sizes":[]},"typography_font_weight":"bold","_margin":{"unit":"px","top":"40","right":"0","bottom":"20","left":"0","isLinked":false},"__globals__":{"title_color":"globals\/colors?id=6d3d44f9"}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"heading"},{"id":"78a5c65","elType":"widget","settings":{"shortcode":"[forminator_form id=\"5483\"]","_margin":{"unit":"px","top":"0","right":"0","bottom":"40","left":"0","isLinked":false}},"elements":[],"widgetType":"shortcode"}],"isInner":false}],"isInner":false}]

item.title: Pawandeep Rajan
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Pawandeep Rajan

Playback Male Singer

Pawandeep Rajan is an Indian singer who gained prominence after winning the singing reality show, Indian Idol Season 12, in 2021. Born on July 27, 1996, in Champawat, Uttarakhand, Pawandeep showcased exceptional talent and a soulful voice throughout the competition.

 

Pawandeep's journey on Indian Idol captivated the audience with his melodious renditions and versatility in various music genres, including Indian classical, Bollywood, and folk. His performances often left both the judges and viewers spellbound, earning him praise for his impeccable singing skills and emotional expressions.

 

During his stint on the show, Pawandeep mesmerized the audience with his renditions of popular songs and received accolades from renowned music personalities. His ability to connect with the emotions of the songs and deliver powerful performances made him a favorite among music enthusiasts.

 

Since his victory on Indian Idol, Pawandeep Rajan has been recognized as a promising talent in the Indian music industry. He has gained a significant following and continues to enthrall his fans through live performances, recordings, and collaborations with renowned musicians and composers.

item.title: Parthiv Gohil
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Parthiv Gohil

Playback Male Singer

Parthiv Gohil is an acclaimed Indian playback and ghazal singer known for his soulful renditions and versatile vocal abilities. He has made a significant impact in the music industry, particularly in the Gujarati film and music scene.

Parthiv Gohil was born on August 22, 1976, in Bhavnagar, Gujarat. He displayed a keen interest in music from a young age and received formal training in classical music. His talent and passion for singing earned him recognition and opportunities to showcase his skills.

Parthiv Gohil gained widespread acclaim with his performance in the Gujarati film "Devdas" (2002), where he lent his melodious voice to the lead character, Devdas, portrayed by actor Shah Rukh Khan. The song "Mor Bani Thangat Kare" became a massive hit and established Parthiv as a prominent playback singer.

Known for his versatility, Parthiv Gohil has sung in various languages, including Gujarati, Hindi, and Marathi. He has worked on numerous film soundtracks and has collaborated with renowned music composers. Some of his notable songs include "Man Mor Bani Thanghat Kare" (Gujarati), "Dil Mera Muft Ka" (Hindi), and "Kanjadai" (Marathi).

Apart from film songs, Parthiv Gohil is also known for his soul-stirring ghazals. He has performed in numerous ghazal concerts and has released albums showcasing his proficiency in this genre. His renditions of ghazals, characterized by his emotive expressions and seamless vocal control, have garnered him critical acclaim.

Parthiv Gohil's contribution to Gujarati music and his ability to effortlessly switch between various genres have made him a respected figure in the industry. He continues to enthrall audiences with his live performances, capturing hearts with his powerful voice and captivating stage presence.

item.title: Parleen Gill
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Parleen Gill

Playback Male Singer

Parleen Gill, a talented Bollywood singer, hails from Chandigarh and comes from an army background. With a passion for music, he began his musical journey at the tender age of four, showcasing his innate talent and dedication to his craft. Known for his disciplined approach to singing, Parleen has mesmerized audiences with his soulful voice.

 

One of his notable appearances was as a contestant on the famous musical reality show, "Indian Idol," during its third season. The show was judged by renowned stars such as Udit Narayan, Anu Malik, Alisha Chinai, and Javed Akhtar. Parleen showcased his singing prowess and left a lasting impact on the audience.

 

Parleen Gill was also associated with Sony BMG from 2007 to 2009. During this period, the label collaborated with four Indian Idol contestants, including Parleen, and released a successful album. His association with Sony BMG further cemented his position as a promising musical artist.

 

Parleen Gill has lent his melodious voice to various songs, including "Yaaroon Ki Yaari" (2019), "Hai To Jaa," "Jaati Hai To Jaa," "Jaan Thi Tum," "Blue Angel," and "Patiala on the Rocks." He has also showcased his versatility by creating his own cover versions of popular songs such as "Bekhayali" from the movie "Kabir Singh" and "Bada Pachtaoge."

 

Apart from his studio recordings, Parleen Gill has also performed in numerous live concerts and shows. His live performance at Star Cruise in Singapore was particularly well-received, further enhancing his reputation as a captivating performer.

To connect with his fans and showcase his talent, Parleen Gill maintains an active presence on YouTube. His channel regularly updates with his covers, allowing his audience to enjoy his soulful renditions.

 

With his enchanting voice and dedication to his craft, Parleen Gill continues to enthrall audiences with his musical performances. His commitment to his artistry and his ability to connect with listeners have established him as a promising Bollywood singer, and his captivating journey in the music industry is set to soar to new heights.

item.title: Prateek Kuhad
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Prateek Kuhad

Playback Male Singer

Prateek Kuhad is an immensely talented Indian singer-songwriter and musician who creates captivating independent music in both Hindi and English. Born in Jaipur, Rajasthan, he grew up with a passion for music and learned to play the guitar at the age of 16. During his late teens, he began writing songs, setting the foundation for his future musical journey.

 

After completing his high school at Maharaja Sawai Man Singh Vidyalaya in Jaipur, Kuhad pursued higher studies in Maths and Economics at New York University. However, his love for music eventually led him back to India, where he decided to pursue a full-time career in the music industry.

 

Kuhad's musical style draws inspiration from various artists, including Elliott Smith, Bob Dylan, Woody Guthrie, Laura Marling, and Fleet Foxes. These influences, along with his natural talent for guitar and songwriting, have shaped his unique and soul-stirring sound.

 

Comfortable in both English and Hindi, Kuhad effortlessly weaves heartfelt lyrics in his songs, often touching on themes of love, relationships, and personal experiences. His music predominantly falls within the Americana and folk genres, featuring acoustic sounds and unconventional song structures that add to the haunting beauty of his compositions.

 

Over the years, Prateek Kuhad has garnered significant acclaim for his musical artistry. His track "cold/mess" became particularly famous and gained widespread recognition. In 2020, he achieved a remarkable milestone by becoming the first Indian artist to sign with the renowned American record label Elektra Records.

 

With his angelic vocals and poetic songwriting, Prateek Kuhad has earned a devoted fan base and continues to touch hearts with his music. His emotionally charged and thought-provoking songs resonate deeply with listeners, making him a true standout in the world of independent music

item.title: Parth Oza
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Parth Oza

Playback Male Singer

Parth Oza is a talented Indian playback singer and musician known for his versatile vocals and contributions to the Gujarati music industry. He has captivated audiences with his soulful renditions and his ability to connect with listeners.

 

Parth Oza hails from Gujarat, India, and he developed a passion for music at a young age. He began his musical journey by participating in various singing competitions and performing at local events. His talent and dedication to music soon gained recognition, leading him to venture into professional singing.

 

Parth Oza has made significant contributions to the Gujarati music industry as a playback singer. He has recorded numerous songs for Gujarati films, infusing each track with his unique vocal style and expressive nuances. His versatility is evident as he effortlessly transitions between various musical genres, including romantic melodies, folk-inspired compositions, and contemporary hits.

 

In addition to his playback singing career, Parth Oza is also known for his live performances. He has showcased his talent on various stages, captivating audiences with his dynamic stage presence and powerful vocals. His ability to engage and connect with the audience has made him a sought-after performer.

 

Parth Oza has released several successful albums and singles throughout his career, earning him a dedicated fan base. Some of his popular songs include "Rang Bhini Radha," "Mari Preet," and "Pardesi Jaana Nahi."

item.content:encoded:
Riddhiman Biswas

Playback Male Singer

Riddhiman Biswas is a versatile and talented singer who has captivated audiences with his enchanting voice and soulful performances. Born with an innate passion for music, Riddhiman's journey in the music industry has been nothing short of remarkable. His ability to effortlessly switch between genres, from classical to contemporary, has earned him a special place in the hearts of his fans. Riddhiman's vocal range and control are truly impressive, allowing him to explore various musical styles with finesse. His mellifluous tone and emotive delivery have the power to stir deep emotions within the listeners. Whether he is singing a melancholic ballad or an energetic pop anthem, Riddhiman's voice carries an undeniable charisma that draws the audience in. Beyond his exceptional singing abilities, Riddhiman is also a skilled songwriter, often penning lyrics that resonate with his listeners on a personal level. His songs delve into themes of love, heartbreak, and self-discovery, displaying a profound understanding of the human experience. With a promising future ahead, Riddhiman Biswas continues to captivate music enthusiasts worldwide, leaving a lasting impression with his remarkable talent and heartfelt performances.

The show, which was judged by renowned musicians Himesh Reshammiya, Alka Yagnik, and Javed Ali, provided a platform for young aspiring singers to showcase their skills and compete against each other.

Hailing from Kolkata, West Bengal, Rohan Das displayed exceptional singing abilities and a passion for music throughout his journey on Superstar Singer. His performances on the show captivated both the judges and the audience, earning him a significant fan following. Rohan's ability to connect with the songs emotionally and deliver powerful performances showcased his maturity as a young artist.

Superstar Singer is known for nurturing young talents and giving them exposure in the music industry. The guidance and feedback from esteemed judges like Himesh Reshammiya, Alka Yagnik, and Javed Ali would have helped Rohan in further enhancing his vocal skills and understanding of music.

While specific details about Rohan Das's journey on Superstar Singer and his current pursuits are not provided, his participation in the show undoubtedly provided him with valuable experience and exposure. It is likely that Rohan's talent and dedication to music have opened doors for him to explore further opportunities in the industry.

As an Indian child singer, Rohan Das has showcased immense potential and is poised to make a mark in the music industry. item.title: Rcr (Rapper)
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Rohit Kumar

Playback Male Singer

Rohit Kumar, popularly known as RCR, is a rapper and singer from Amritsar, India. Born into a middle-class Hindu family, Rohit developed an interest in singing during his school days. He showcased his talent at various school events and received encouragement from his teachers.

 

After completing his schooling at DAV Senior Secondary School in Amritsar, Rohit enrolled in Hindu College to pursue his graduation. It was during this time that a teacher recognized his potential as a rapper and advised him to pursue it as a career. Inspired by this guidance, Rohit made becoming a rapper his life's goal.

 

Due to financial constraints, Rohit left college after completing five semesters and moved to Mumbai to pursue his music career. He had a passion for writing and composing songs and has written over 500 raps to date. item.content:encoded:
Raj Raninga

Playback Male Singer

Raj Raninga, better known by his stage name RR Live, is a sensational singer who has captivated audiences around the world with his mesmerizing voice and dynamic performances. Hailing from a small town, Raj's journey to stardom has been nothing short of remarkable.

 

From a young age, Raj displayed an innate passion for music, and it was evident that he possessed a rare talent. With a versatile vocal range and a unique ability to infuse emotion into his songs, RR Live quickly became a household name in the music industry.

 

What sets RR Live apart is not just his incredible voice but also his ability to connect with his listeners on a deep and personal level. His performances are filled with raw energy, leaving the audience spellbound and craving for more. Whether he's belting out heart-wrenching ballads or delivering high-energy anthems, Raj's stage presence is electrifying.

 

His music transcends genres, seamlessly blending elements of pop, rock, and soul to create a sound that is uniquely his own. RR Live's heartfelt lyrics and soul-stirring melodies have touched the hearts of millions, making him a beloved figure in the music industry.

As his star continues to rise, RR Live remains grounded and grateful for the unwavering support of his fans. With his passion, talent, and magnetic stage presence, there's no doubt that Raj Raninga, aka RR Live, will continue to enthrall audiences and leave an indelible mark on the music industry for years to come.

item.title: Raghav Sachar
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Raghav Sachar

Playback Male Singer

Raghav Sachar is an Indian singer, composer, and multi-instrumentalist. He was born on July 24, 1981, in India. Raghav is known for his versatility as a musician, playing various instruments such as the flute, saxophone, clarinet, and guitar.

 

He made his debut as a playback singer in Bollywood with the song "Kuchh Khaas" from the movie "Fashion" in 2008. The song became popular and earned him recognition in the industry. Since then, Raghav has contributed to the music industry with his melodious voice and musical skills.

 

Apart from singing, Raghav Sachar has composed music for several films and television shows in Bollywood. Some of his notable compositions include "Soniye" from the movie "Will You Marry Me?" and "Dil Ye Dil" from the film "Pyaar Impossible!"

 

Raghav Sachar is also known for his live performances, where he showcases his talents as a multi-instrumentalist. He has performed at various concerts and events both in India and internationally.

 

Overall, Raghav Sachar is a talented singer and musician who has made a mark in the Indian music industry with his versatile skills and melodious voice.

item.title: Rabbi Shergill
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Rabbi Shergill

Playback Male Singer

Rabbi Shergill is a renowned Sufi singer who has captivated audiences with his soulful melodies and profound lyrics. Born in Punjab, India, he is widely recognized for his distinctive voice and unique fusion of Sufi, Punjabi folk, and rock music. With his debut album "Rabbi" released in 2005, he shot to fame with the chart-topping song "Bulla Ki Jaana," which became an anthem of self-identity and spiritual questioning.

Shergill's music is deeply rooted in Sufi philosophy, blending elements of mysticism, love, and spirituality. His compositions reflect a rare blend of traditional and contemporary influences, drawing inspiration from the rich cultural heritage of Punjab. Known for his poetic prowess, he weaves thought-provoking verses in Punjabi and Urdu, touching the hearts of listeners across generations.

Beyond his musical talents, Rabbi Shergill's social activism is also noteworthy. He has been actively involved in advocating for peace, social justice, and environmental issues through his songs and public appearances. His passionate performances and genuine connection with the audience have earned him a dedicated fan base both in India and internationally.

Rabbi Shergill's contributions to Sufi music have made him a beloved figure in the world of Indian music, leaving a lasting impact on the genre and inspiring aspiring musicians to explore the depths of their artistic expression.

item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Rishi Singh

Playback Male Singer

Rishi Singh, a talented singer, has captivated audiences worldwide with his mesmerizing voice and exceptional musicality. Born with an innate passion for music, Rishi embarked on his musical journey at a young age and quickly rose to prominence in the industry. His versatility as a singer allows him to effortlessly transition between various genres, including pop, R&B, and soul, showcasing his incredible vocal range and emotive delivery.

 

Rishi's unique style and ability to infuse emotions into his performances have garnered him a dedicated fan base that admires his artistry. His soulful renditions of both classic and contemporary songs have earned him critical acclaim and numerous accolades. Whether he is delivering a heartfelt ballad or a catchy upbeat track, Rishi's dynamic stage presence and charismatic personality leave a lasting impression on his listeners.

 

Beyond his musical talents, Rishi Singh is also recognized for his philanthropic efforts, using his platform to support charitable causes and make a positive impact on society. With his unwavering dedication to his craft and his commitment to giving back, Rishi Singh continues to inspire and entertain audiences worldwide with his extraordinary talent and passion for music.

item.title: Sunny M. R.
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Sunny M.R.

Playback Male Singer

Sunny M.R. is an Indian music composer, music producer, sound engineer, and playback singer. He gained recognition for his work in the Telugu films "Swamy Ra Ra" (2013) and "Uyyala Jampala" (2013). His music in these films received positive reviews, with Musicperk.com rating the album highly and praising its experimental yet simple approach.

 

Sunny M.R. won the Global Indian Music Award and the Mirchi Music Award for the Hindi film "Yeh Jawaani Hai Deewani" (2013). He was recognized as the "Best Music Arranger cum Programmer" and "Song Programmer cum Arranger of the Year" in 2014.

 

Early Life: Sunny M.R. studied at St. Anne's High School in Patna. He began his career in the music industry by working as a sound engineer, assisting his accomplished brother, Shadab Rayeen. At the age of 15, Sunny became an independent sound engineer. He gained experience in mixing, arranging, and composing various tunes during his time at Keerthana Digital Studios in Hyderabad, Telangana, where he worked for six years.

 

Career: During his time at Keerthana Digital Studios, Sunny collaborated on 350 albums, mastering ragas from Carnatic music. Initially, he had a dislike for Carnatic tunes but later realized that jazz is a harmonized version of Carnatic music. He started to appreciate and work on albums with Carnatic ragas. Sunny then moved to Mumbai to meet Sandeep Chowta, a music director, and joined as a sound engineer.

 

Inspired by late Anil Kumar, a music director, and Krishna Chaitanya, a Telugu songs lyricist, Sunny decided to pursue a career as a music director. He got his breakthrough when director Sudheer Varma selected him for the Telugu film "Swamy Ra Ra." Sunny M.R. is also a part of the innovative Open Music Community called Blogswara, where his entry as a music director was appreciated by the team.

 

Sunny M.R. has showcased his talent as a music composer, producer, sound engineer, and playback singer in the Indian music industry, gaining recognition for his unique approach and contributions to various films.

item.title: Sunny Hindustani
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Sunny Hindustani

Playback Male Singer

Sunny Hindustani, a talented Indian singer, captured the hearts of millions with his soulful voice and inspiring journey. Born in Punjab, India, Sunny's musical journey began at a young age, where he faced numerous challenges and financial constraints. However, his determination and raw talent propelled him to audition for the reality show Indian Idol in 2019.

 

Sunny's remarkable performances on the show left audiences awe-inspired, as he effortlessly sang melodies across various genres, including Bollywood classics and Sufi music. His distinct voice, rich with emotions and depth, resonated with listeners, earning him widespread acclaim. Sunny's ability to connect with the audience through his heartfelt renditions made him a fan favorite and helped him secure the title of Indian Idol Season 11.

 

Beyond his success on the show, Sunny's career continues to flourish as he releases his own music and collaborates with renowned artists. His humility, passion, and dedication to his craft serve as an inspiration to aspiring musicians across the nation. Sunny Hindustani is a shining example of how talent and determination can overcome any obstacle, making him a beloved figure in the Indian music industry.

item.title: Stebin Ben
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Stebin Ben

Playback Male Singer

Stebin Ben is a talented Indian singer who has made a significant impact on the music industry with his soulful voice and versatile singing style. Born on November 9, 1993, in Kerala, India, Stebin Ben's journey in music began at a young age. His passion for singing led him to participate in various singing competitions, where he showcased his exceptional talent. Stebin Ben gained widespread recognition and popularity with his soul-stirring renditions of popular Bollywood songs. His melodious voice, coupled with his emotive expressions, captivates the hearts of his listeners, creating a deep connection with his music. Known for his ability to convey emotions through his songs, Stebin Ben has become a favorite among music lovers who appreciate his heartfelt performances. Over the years, Stebin Ben has released several hit tracks, including "Baarish," "Mera Mehboob," and "Rula Ke Gaya Ishq." His soothing voice has garnered millions of views and streams on various digital platforms, earning him a loyal fan base. With his remarkable talent and dedication to his craft, Stebin Ben continues to enchant audiences with his soulful melodies, establishing himself as a prominent singer in the Indian music industry.

item.title: Shriram Iyer
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Shriram Iyer

Playback Male Singer

Shriram Iyer is a talented Indian singer known for his soulful voice and versatile musical style. With his ability to effortlessly transition between genres like Indian classical, Bollywood, and Western music, Shriram has captivated audiences around the world.

 

Born and raised in Mumbai, Shriram began his musical journey at a young age. He trained rigorously in Hindustani classical music and honed his skills under renowned vocal gurus. His dedication and passion for music led him to participate in various singing competitions, where he showcased his exceptional talent.

 

Shriram gained widespread recognition after participating in the reality TV show "Sa Re Ga Ma Pa." His performances on the show mesmerized both the judges and viewers, and he emerged as a frontrunner, captivating the hearts of millions with his soothing renditions.

 

With his melodious voice and impeccable control over sur and taal, Shriram has collaborated with leading composers and artists in the Indian music industry. His songs, whether romantic ballads or peppy tracks, leave a lasting impression on listeners.

Shriram Iyer continues to enthrall music enthusiasts with his captivating performances and remarkable vocal range. His ability to connect with his audience through his music makes him a true gem in the world of Indian singing.

Shekhar Suman

Playback Male Singer

Shekhar Suman is a renowned Indian singer who has made a significant mark in the music industry with his melodious voice and soulful performances. Born on June 7, 1962, in Patna, Bihar, Shekhar Suman began his musical journey at a young age and honed his singing skills through rigorous training.

 

With his versatile vocal range and captivating stage presence, Shekhar Suman has mesmerized audiences across the country. His ability to effortlessly switch between different genres, including romantic ballads, ghazals, and peppy tracks, showcases his versatility as an artist.

 

Shekhar Suman has collaborated with several eminent composers and lyricists, creating timeless melodies that resonate with listeners of all generations. His renditions are known for their emotional depth, bringing life to the lyrics and connecting with the hearts of his audience.

 

Apart from his musical prowess, Shekhar Suman has also made notable contributions to the entertainment industry as an actor, television host, and comedian. His charismatic personality and natural flair for entertainment have earned him a special place in the hearts of his fans.

 

Today, Shekhar Suman continues to captivate audiences with his soul-stirring performances and remains an inspiration for aspiring singers. His melodious voice, coupled with his passion for music, has solidified his position as a true icon in the realm of Indian music.

item.title: Shivam Pathak
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Shivam Pathak

Playback Male Singer

Shivam Pathak is an Indian playback singer known for his work in the Bollywood film industry. He was born on October 7, 1991, in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India. Shivam Pathak gained recognition for his soulful and powerful vocals.

 

One of Shivam Pathak's notable songs is "Kamli" from the film "Dhoom 3" (2013), where he lent his voice for the character played by actress Katrina Kaif. The song became a hit and showcased Shivam Pathak's singing prowess.

 

He has also collaborated with renowned composers and singers in the industry. Shivam has worked with composer A.R. Rahman on the song "Matargashti" from the film "Tamasha" (2015). Additionally, he has sung songs for other Bollywood movies, including "Manmarziyan" (2018) and "Panipat" (2019).

item.content:encoded:
Shaarib and Toshi

Playback Male Singer

Shaarib and Toshi are an immensely talented music duo from India who have made a significant impact on the Bollywood music scene. Born as brothers, Shaarib and Toshi Sabri have carved a niche for themselves with their soulful voices and remarkable musical compositions. They entered the industry as playback singers and quickly gained recognition for their powerful and melodious vocals.

 

Shaarib and Toshi's journey in the music industry has been nothing short of inspiring. Their compositions are known for their versatility and ability to connect with the listeners on an emotional level. They have created memorable songs that have become chartbusters and have left a lasting impression on the hearts of millions.

 

Their collaborations with top-notch lyricists and composers have resulted in numerous hit songs for Bollywood films. From romantic ballads to foot-tapping dance numbers, Shaarib and Toshi have showcased their prowess in a wide range of musical genres. Their dedication and passion for music have earned them a loyal fan base that eagerly awaits their every release.

 

With their innate talent and unwavering determination, Shaarib and Toshi continue to captivate audiences with their enchanting melodies and soul-stirring performances. Their contributions to the Indian music industry have solidified their place as one of the most respected and celebrated duos in the country.

item.content:encoded:
Salman Ali

Playback Male Singer

Salman Ali is an Indian singer who gained fame through his participation in the reality TV show "Indian Idol" in 2018. He was born on September 2, 1998, in Mewat, Haryana, India.

 

Salman Ali's soulful voice and remarkable singing abilities captivated both the judges and the audience throughout his journey on "Indian Idol." His ability to sing a wide range of genres, including Bollywood songs, ghazals, and Sufi music, showcased his versatility as a singer.

 

During the show, Salman Ali received high praise from the judges for his powerful and emotive renditions of popular songs. He went on to win the title of "Indian Idol" in the 10th season, earning him widespread recognition and a dedicated fan base.

 

Following his victory on "Indian Idol," Salman Ali has been actively pursuing a career in the music industry. He has performed at various concerts and events, both in India and internationally, showcasing his talent and entertaining audiences with his melodious voice.

item.title: Satinder Sartaaj
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Satinder Sartaaj

Playback Male Singer

Satinder Sartaaj is a renowned Sufi singer who has mesmerized audiences worldwide with his soul-stirring voice and profound lyrics. Born in Punjab, India, Sartaaj possesses a unique ability to blend traditional Sufi poetry with contemporary music, creating an enchanting musical experience. His melodious voice carries deep emotions, evoking a sense of spirituality and inner peace in listeners.

 

Sartaaj's music is a testament to his deep understanding of Sufi philosophy and mysticism. He often draws inspiration from the works of Sufi saints and poets, infusing their timeless wisdom into his compositions. His songs touch upon themes of love, devotion, and the pursuit of spiritual enlightenment.

 

Beyond his musical talent, Sartaaj is also recognized for his humble and down-to-earth nature. He connects with his audience on a personal level, creating an intimate atmosphere during his performances. His concerts are known for their captivating energy and a profound sense of unity among attendees.

 

Satinder Sartaaj's contributions to Sufi music have garnered him numerous accolades and a dedicated fan following worldwide. His music transcends boundaries, inviting people from all walks of life to embrace the spiritual journey through his soulful melodies.

Sayan Bargi

Playback Male Singer

Sayan Bargi is an exceptional singer who has captivated audiences with his mesmerizing voice and incredible talent. With a unique blend of soulful melodies and powerful performances, he has established himself as a rising star in the music industry. Born with a gift for music, Sayan began singing at a young age and honed his skills through years of dedication and hard work.

 

Sayan's versatility as a singer allows him to effortlessly traverse various genres, from romantic ballads to high-energy pop tracks. His ability to convey emotions through his voice is truly remarkable, leaving listeners spellbound with each performance. Sayan's stage presence is equally captivating, as he exudes confidence and charisma, engaging the audience in an unforgettable experience.

 

Beyond his musical abilities, Sayan is also known for his philanthropic endeavors, using his platform to raise awareness and support various social causes. His humility and down-to-earth nature have endeared him to fans around the world, making him not only an exceptional artist but also a role model.

Shankar Mahadevan

Playback Male Singer

Shankar Mahadevan is a versatile playback singer and composer who has contributed immensely to the Bollywood music industry. Known for his incredible vocal range and soul-stirring renditions, Shankar Mahadevan has delivered several chart-topping songs. His ability to effortlessly switch between different genres, from soulful melodies to high-energy tracks, has made him a prominent figure in the industry. Some of his popular tracks include "Breathless," "Mitwa," and "Dil Chahta Hai." Shankar Mahadevan's melodious voice and his expertise in blending Indian classical and contemporary music have made him a respected name in the music fraternity.

item.title: Snighdajit
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Snigdhajit

Playback Male Singer

Snigdhajit Bhowmik is a talented Indian playback vocalist known for his versatile performances in various musical genres such as Fusion, Rock, Jazz, Qawali, and Folk. Born on January 5, 1991, in Raiganj, West Bengal, he hails from a financially disadvantaged family. He completed his schooling at Banshihari High School and graduated from Raiganj University College.

Snigdhajit began his musical journey as a contestant on the television singing reality show "The Voice India" in 2015. The following year, he participated in the Bengali music reality television show "Phire Ashar Gaan" in 2016. His talent and passion for music earned him recognition and opportunities to showcase his skills on these platforms.

In 2018, Snigdhajit achieved great success when he became the first runner-up on Zee Bangla's prestigious singing competition "Sa Re Ga Ma Pa." This further propelled his career and brought him wider recognition in the music industry.

Apart from his reality show appearances, Snigdhajit also produces personal music albums on YouTube, showcasing his artistic abilities and captivating the audience with his soulful renditions.

In his personal life, Snigdhajit Bhowmik is married to his long-time girlfriend Aditi. Their love story had its share of challenges, as they had to face opposition from their families. Snigdhajit eloped with Aditi, and they were temporarily estranged from their families due to their secret marriage. However, with time, things improved, and they managed to overcome the difficulties they faced.

Snigdhajit Bhowmik's talent, dedication, and perseverance have played a significant role in his success as a playback vocalist. His melodious voice and ability to excel in different musical genres continue to captivate audiences and establish him as a prominent figure in the Indian music industry.

item.title: Tejas Gambhir
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Tejas Gambhir

Playback Male Singer

Tejas Gambhir is a professional singer hailing from Pune, India. He is known for his versatility in singing across various genres. Having performed in over 300 shows, Tejas has gained extensive experience in live performances.

Tejas Gambhir has had the opportunity to perform alongside renowned artists such as Vishal-Shekhar, Amit Trivedi, Papon, KK, and more, serving as a supporting act for their concerts. His talent and skills have taken him to different parts of the country, where he has participated in college events, private events, corporate events, and club gigs.

Additionally, Tejas Gambhir is the co-founder of a progressive classical fusion band called Amritaansh, where he serves as the singer, composer, and songwriter. This band combines elements of classical and fusion music to create a unique and innovative sound.

item.title: Thomson Andrews
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Thomson Andrews

Playback Male Singer

Thomson Andrews is an Indian playback singer, songwriter, and vocal arranger. He gained recognition for his versatile voice and has worked in the Indian music industry across various languages, including Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, and English.

 

Thomson Andrews has collaborated with several renowned composers and singers, lending his voice to numerous Bollywood songs. Some of his popular tracks include "Jee Karda" from the film "Badlapur," "Nachange Saari Raat" from "Junooniyat," and "Premika" from "Dilwale." He has also worked on background vocals and arrangements for songs in movies like "Ae Dil Hai Mushkil" and "Befikre."

 

Apart from his work in Bollywood, Thomson has participated in music reality shows such as "The Stage" and "ARRived," where he showcased his talent and received accolades for his performances. He is known for his dynamic stage presence and his ability to effortlessly blend different musical genres.

item.title: Tony Kakkar
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Tony Kakkar

Playback Male Singer

Tony Kakkar is an Indian singer, composer, and songwriter. He was born on April 9, 1984, in Rishikesh, Uttarakhand, India. Tony Kakkar is known for his contributions to the Indian music industry, particularly in the genre of pop and Bollywood music.

 

Tony Kakkar started his musical journey by composing songs for movies and television shows. He gained recognition with the song "Sawan Aaya Hai" from the Bollywood film "Creature 3D" in 2014. However, he rose to prominence as a singer with his independent singles and music videos.

 

Some of Tony Kakkar's popular songs include "Mile Ho Tum" from the movie "Fever," "Coca Cola Tu," "Dheeme Dheeme," "Naagin Jaisi Kamar Hila," and "Kuch Kuch." He has also collaborated with other artists and released duets like "Car Mein Music Baja" with Neha Kakkar and "Goa Beach" with Neha Kakkar and Aditya Narayan.

 

Tony Kakkar is known for his catchy tunes, peppy beats, and his ability to create foot-tapping music. His songs often have a mix of Hindi and Punjabi lyrics, and his music videos feature vibrant visuals and energetic performances.

item.title: Vineet Garg
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Vineet Garg

Playback Male Singer

Vineet Garg is a talented singer who has made a name for himself in the music industry with his soulful voice and versatile singing style. With his passion for music and dedication to his craft, Vineet has garnered a significant following and recognition for his talent.

 

Known for his ability to convey emotions through his singing, Vineet has captivated audiences with his heartfelt renditions. Whether it's romantic ballads, soulful melodies, or energetic tracks, he brings a unique charm and depth to every performance. His ability to connect with listeners on an emotional level has made him a favorite among music enthusiasts.

 

Vineet Garg's musical journey started at a young age when he discovered his love for singing. He honed his skills and received formal training to refine his vocal abilities. His dedication and hard work paid off as he began participating in various singing competitions and talent shows, showcasing his talent to a wider audience.

 

In recent years, Vineet has gained popularity through his appearances on reality singing shows. His mesmerizing performances on platforms like Indian Idol and Sa Re Ga Ma Pa have impressed judges and viewers alike. Vineet's versatility as a singer allows him to tackle different genres and styles with ease, displaying his adaptability and range as a vocalist.

 

Beyond reality shows, Vineet has also collaborated with renowned music composers and has lent his voice to numerous film songs and albums. His collaborations have allowed him to showcase his talent to a wider audience and have earned him appreciation from both critics and listeners. Vineet's ability to bring life to a song with his expressive vocals and impeccable control is what sets him apart as an artist.

item.title: Vineet Singh
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Vineet Singh

Playback Male Singer

Vineet Singh is an Indian playback singer known for his work in the Bollywood film industry. He was born on October 9, 1990, in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, India. Vineet gained popularity through his participation in the singing reality show "Indian Idol" in 2005.

 

After his stint on "Indian Idol," Vineet Singh ventured into playback singing for Bollywood films. He made his debut as a playback singer with the song "Parda" from the film "Once Upon a Time in Mumbaai" in 2010. The song received positive reviews and established Vineet as a talented singer.

 

Some of Vineet Singh's notable songs include "Be Intehaan" from the film "Race 2" (2013), "Keh Ke Lunga" from the movie "Gangs of Wasseypur" (2012), and "Jab Se Tere Naina" from the film "Saawariya" (2007). He has collaborated with various music directors and composers in the industry.

 

Vineet Singh's singing style is known for its soulful and powerful rendition. While he may not be as widely recognized as some of the leading playback singers in Bollywood, he has contributed his vocals to several film soundtracks and has garnered appreciation for his talent.

item.title: Yatin Sangoi
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Yatin Sangoi

Playback Male Singer

Yatin Sangoi, born and raised in Mumbai, is a software engineer by profession but also a versatile singer and composer. He began his musical journey in 1988 and was trained in the renowned Kirana Gharana. Yatin possesses a deep knowledge and expertise in Hindi film music, spanning from the era of K.L. Saigal to Rafi, Kishore Kumar to KK, and beyond. He has the ability to perform almost any song with perfection.

 

With a strong foundation in Indian classical music, Yatin Sangoi has skillfully integrated Sufi music into his unique style. His compositions and singing have captivated audiences, showcasing his flamboyant artistry. He has led his music group with expertise, enhancing their performances and enthralling listeners.

 

Yatin's adventurous spirit led him to compete in the popular reality show Sa Re Ga Ma, where he reached the finals and showcased his exceptional talent. He has also made appearances on the popular TV show Bollywood Ka Boss, further expanding his presence in the entertainment industry.

 

Yatin Sangoi's success extends beyond live performances. He has successfully collaborated with various corporates, TV channels, and radio stations for events and shows. He has also conducted a talent hunt called Surat Idol, providing a platform for aspiring singers.

 

His talent has taken him to various countries, including the USA, UK, and Middle Eastern countries, where he has performed and garnered appreciation for his musical prowess.

item.title: Yashraaj Kapil
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Yashraj Kapil

Playback Male Singer

Yashraj Kapil is a talented musician and upcoming playback singer in the Bollywood film industry. Born in Faridabad in 1991, he displayed a natural aptitude for music from an early age. As an only child, Yashraj received unwavering support from his family, leading them to relocate to New Delhi to foster his music career.

In 2009, at the age of 18, Yashraj participated in the reality show "Sitaaron ko choona hai" and emerged as the winner. This early success provided a promising start to his career. However, he faced a temporary setback before resurfacing in 2010 with his participation in a popular prime time music reality show, where his performances garnered high praise from celebrity judges.

 

Yashraj's musical journey continued with his participation in Sahara One's "Sur Kshetra" in 2012. Alongside being a vocalist, he also excels as a keyboardist and guitarist, showcasing his versatility as a musician. He draws inspiration from his favorite singer, Sonu Nigam, whose style has influenced his own artistic development.

 

As a playback singer, Yashraj has had the opportunity to work with renowned singer and composer Himesh Reshammiya on movies like "Khiladi" and "Policegiri." Collaborating with established names in the industry has allowed him to showcase his talent and further expand his musical repertoire.

Although Yashraj has experienced ups and downs in his career, his fresh and versatile talent holds promise for a bright future. In June 2013, he tied the knot and now resides in Mumbai with his wife, embarking on his journey to establish himself as a prominent playback singer in the Bollywood film industry.

item.title: Yasser Desai
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Yasser Desai

Playback Male Singer

Yasser Desai is an Indian playback singer known for his work in the Bollywood music industry. He was born on May 15, 1989, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. Yasser gained recognition and popularity through his soulful and melodious singing style.

 

Yasser Desai made his singing debut in 2015 with the song "Mera Ishq" from the movie "Saansein: The Last Breath." However, he gained widespread acclaim with the song "Pallo Latke" from the film "Shaadi Mein Zaroor Aana" in 2017. The song became a chartbuster and established Yasser as a promising playback singer.

 

Since then, Yasser Desai has lent his voice to numerous Bollywood films, delivering several hit songs. Some of his popular tracks include "Naino Ne Baandhi" from "Gold," "Rangtaari" from "Loveyatri," "Tum Chale Gaye" from "Marudhar Express," "Mera Dil Bhi Kitna Pagal Hai" from "Saajan," and "Sanam Re" from the movie of the same name.

 

Yasser's singing style is characterized by his smooth and emotive vocals, which add depth and expression to the songs he sings. He has collaborated with various music composers and lyricists, creating a diverse range of musical compositions across different genres.

item.title: Anweshaa
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Anweshaa Dattagupta

Playback Female Singer

Anweshaa Dattagupta is a versatile Indian playback singer known for her melodious voice and exceptional vocal skills. Born on December 15, 1993, in Kolkata, India, she showed a keen interest in music from a very young age. Anweshaa rose to fame when she participated in the reality TV singing competition, "Amul STAR Voice of India" in 2007, where she emerged as the runner-up, captivating audiences with her powerful performances.

 

Anwesshaa is a second generation musician and by the grace of her mother, she got a culture at home which was inclusive of literature and music. Formal training started at the age of four from her Guru Shri Jayant Sarkar, who is a senior disciple of Pandit Ajoy Chakraborty. Lately she has been closely associated with Pandit ji as well which allowed her to learn from him. Indirectly, the singers and composers whose work she has grown up on are a huge source of inspiration.

 

Anwesha achieved 1st Division with Distinction in Hindustani Vocal and Rabindra Sangeet under Bangiya Sangeet Parishad Examination (2002–03 and 2003–04). She also became one of the few recipients of the Jugal Srimal Talent Scholarship in Rabindra Sangeet, given by Tagore Foundation.

 

Anwesha was the Winner of "Young Talent Contest – 2004" in Indian Popular Vocal category (Junior) organized by the Calcutta School of Music. She has also won the All Bengal (Inter School) Music Competition 2006 organized by Smile World, an NGO. She was also the runner up at Amul Star Voice of India Chhote Ustaad.  Here is a recent interview

item.title: Anuradha Bhat
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Anuradha Bhat

Playback Female Singer

Anuradha Bhat is an Indian playback singer who predominantly works in Kannada language films. She has sung over 100 songs for feature films and also sung in various private musical albums. She has also worked in several non-film albums, remix songs, TV serials, children's songs & rhymes. Anuradha Bhat was born in Mangaluru, Karnataka, India. Anuradha Bhat received her primary education from carmel school and later from premier institutes like canara college and MSNM Besant PG Institute of Management Studies (both affiliated to Mangalore University) Anuradha Bhat has performed at various events Hampi Utsav, Mysore dasara, Yuva Dasara, Mysore Winter Festival,  Vishwa Kannada Sammelana  and Bengaluru Ganesh Utsava (BGU)

item.title: Asees Kaur
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Asees Kaur

Playback Female Singer

Asees Kaur is an acclaimed Indian playback singer known for her captivating voice and versatile singing skills. Born on 26th September 1988 in Panipat, Haryana, India, she developed a deep passion for music from a young age. Asees began her musical journey by participating in various singing competitions and local events. Asees is known for the song "Ve Maahi" that was trending on all platforms. She performed "bolna " at the GIMA 2016 Fanpark. Her singles "Gal Karke" with Desi Music Factory, "Kisi Aur Naal" with VYRL Originals and "Mujhe Jeene De" with Panoctave India were instant hits and topped the charts. She is currently managed by Tarsame Mittal Talent Management for her live shows. In September 2021, Kaur along with Renuka Panwar featured at the time square in New York City for their song "52 Gaj Ka Daman" With her melodious voice and emotional depth, Asees Kaur continues to captivate listeners and establish herself as one of the prominent playback singers in the Indian music industry. Her ability to bring life to every song she sings and her dedication to her craft make her a beloved figure among music enthusiasts.

item.title: Anushka Manchanda
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Anushka Manchanda

Playback Female Singer

Anushka Manchanda is an Indian singer, model, and actress known for her versatile talent and unique style. She was born on February 11, 1984, in Delhi, India. Anushka gained widespread recognition as a member of the Indian pop girl group, Viva, which was formed through the reality TV show, "Coke [V] Popstars," in 2002. Her distinct voice and confident stage presence made her a standout performer in the group. After the disbandment of Viva, Anushka pursued a solo career in music. She made her playback singing debut in Bollywood with the hit song "Ek Do Teen" from the film "Golmaal" in 2006. Her energetic and peppy rendition of the song garnered immense popularity and established her as a playback singer. Anushka's singing prowess extends beyond Bollywood, as she has also ventured into independent and alternative music. She has collaborated with various musicians and bands, experimenting with different genres and styles. Some of her notable independent songs include "Dum Maaro Dum" from the film "Dum Maaro Dum" and "Manma Emotion Jaage" from "Dilwale." In addition to her singing career, Anushka Manchanda has also explored other creative fields. She has acted in movies like "Mumbai Matinee" and "Angry Indian Goddesses." She has also been a prominent figure in the modeling industry, walking the ramp for various fashion shows and appearing in numerous advertisements.

item.title: Anusha Mani
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Anusha Mani

Playback Female Singer

Anusha Mani is an Indian playback singer known for her work in the Bollywood film industry. Born on March 29, 1985, she comes from a musically-inclined family and received training in Carnatic music from Smt. Meera Nathan. Anusha began her singing career by performing in Gujarati plays and later collaborated with Amit Trivedi on a music album, although it was never released. In 2007, Anusha Mani got her big break when Shankar Mahadevan of the music trio Shankar-Ehsaan-Loy offered her the opportunity to sing the track "Dhoka" from the film "Johnny Gaddaar." This marked the beginning of her association with the trio, and she has worked on about six albums with them to date. item.title: Antara Mitra
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Antara Mitra

Playback Female Singer

Antara Mitra is an Indian playback singer who gained prominence through her participation in the reality singing competition show, Indian Idol, in 2006. Born on July 10, 1987, in Kolkata, West Bengal, Antara showed a passion for singing from a young age. Her powerful and versatile voice captivated the audience and judges alike during her stint on Indian Idol. While she did not win the competition, Antara's talent caught the attention of the music industry. She subsequently embarked on a successful career as a playback singer in Bollywood, lending her voice to numerous hit songs. Her playback singing debut came in 2010 with the song "Bheegi Si Bhaagi Si" from the film "Raajneeti." Over the years, Antara Mitra has collaborated with renowned composers and delivered chart-topping tracks. Some of her notable songs include "Gerua" from "Dilwale," "Janam Janam" from "Dilwale," "Saree Ke Fall Sa" from "R... Rajkumar," and "Kamli" from "Dhoom 3," among many others. Her melodious voice, versatility, and ability to bring emotion into her renditions have made her a sought-after playback singer in the Indian film industry. Antara continues to mesmerize audiences with her soulful voice and continues to contribute to the Indian music scene. Her dedication and talent have earned her a loyal fan base, and she remains an influential figure in the world of playback singing

item.title: Anitha Shaiq
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Anitha Shaiq

Playback Female Singer

Anitha Shaiq is an Indian playback singer and music composer, living in Mumbai, India. She performs Indian classical, sufi, Ghazal, folk and pop music, having sung in Malayalam, Kannada, Telugu, Oriya, Punjabi, and Tamil languages. In her 12 years in the film industry, she has recorded more than 100 songs for films. Shaiq was born in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, to Sirajuniza Begum, a secondary school music teacher, and Sheikh Ebrahim. She graduated from the Government College for Women, majoring in music. She has studied Hindustani, Sufi, Carnatic, and Western music. Shaiq began her career as a playback singer in 2007 with the song "Mazha Mazha" from the film Killaadi. She has since sung for over 100 films in Malayalam, Kannada, Telugu, Oriya, Punjabi, and Tamil languages. Some of her most popular songs include "Chandamama" from the film Rock N Roll, "House Full" from the film House Full, and "Dhak Dhak" from the film Alexander The Great. Shaiq has won several awards for her work as a playback singer, including the Filmfare Award for Best Female Playback Singer – Malayalam (2010) and the Vijay Award for Best Female Playback Singer (2010). She was also nominated for the National Film Award for Best Female Playback Singer for her performance in the film Minnaminnikkoottam (2008). Shaiq is a versatile singer with a powerful voice. She is known for her ability to sing in a variety of genres, from classical to folk to pop. She is a rising star in the Indian film industry and is sure to achieve even greater success in the years to come.

item.content:encoded:
Anindita Paul

Playback Female Singer

Anindita Paul is an Indian playback singer who sings predominantly in Assamese, Bengali and Hindi languages. She was born in Guwahati, Assam, in 1979. She started learning music at a young age and her talent was soon recognized. Paul is a versatile singer and she can sing in a variety of genres. She is known for her melodious voice and her ability to convey the emotions of the songs she sings. She is a popular singer in Assam and she is sure to achieve even greater success in the years to come. Paul made her playback singing debut in the Assamese film "Prem Aru Prem" in 2002. She has since sung for many other Assamese films, including "Hiranyarekha" (2005) Anindita Paul is a talented singer who is sure to continue to entertain her fans for many years to come.

item.title: Amrutha Suresh
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Amrutha Suresh

Playback Female Singer

Amrutha Suresh is an Indian singer, composer, songwriter, and radio jockey. She was born on August 2, 1990, in Kochi, Kerala. She is the daughter of musician P. R. Suresh and Laila. She has a younger sister, Abhirami Suresh, who is also a singer.

 

Amrutha started singing at a very young age. She used to perform at stage shows during her childhood. In 2007, she participated in the second season of the reality television singing competition Idea Star Singer on Asianet. She was one of the popular contestants on the show and eventually finished as the second runner-up.

 

Amrutha's stint at Idea Star Singer helped her to launch her career as a playback singer in Malayalam films. Her debut film as a playback singer was Pulliman (2009). She has since sung for over 100 Malayalam films and has won several awards for her singing.

 

In addition to her work as a playback singer, Amrutha has also composed music for a few films. She has also released a few music albums. Amrutha is also a radio jockey and has hosted several shows on various radio stations.

Amrutha Suresh is a talented singer and musician. She has made a significant contribution to the Malayalam film industry and has won the hearts of millions of fans with her beautiful voice.

Amrutha Suresh is a versatile singer who can sing in a variety of genres. She is also a gifted composer and songwriter. She is a rising star in the Malayalam film industry and has a bright future ahead of her.

item.title: Amrita Kak
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Amrita Kak

Playback Female Singer

Amrita Kak is a Bollywood singer known for her contributions to the music of various Bollywood films. She comes from a notable background, being the daughter of Indian politician Beena Kak. Amrita Kak's connection to actor Salman Khan has also played a significant role in her career, with Salman Khan introducing her to the film industry and considering her his rakhi sister.

 

Amrita Kak has sung several popular songs for Salman Khan's films, including "Just Chill" from Maine Pyar Kyun Kiya?, "Character Dheela" from Ready, and "Desi Beat" from Bodyguard, among others. Her soulful and versatile voice has made her a sought-after singer in the Bollywood music industry.

 

Aside from her singing career, Amrita Kak has also ventured into the fashion industry by starting her own fashion brand called "Amrita the Label." This showcases her entrepreneurial spirit and diverse interests beyond music.

 

Amrita Kak's musical talents extend beyond Bollywood, as she is also trained in Indian classical music. This training adds depth and versatility to her singing style, allowing her to deliver powerful performances across various genres.

In her personal life, Amrita Kak is married to businessman Riju Jhunjhunwala since May 29, 2010. Her family includes her mother, Bina Kak, who is an Indian politician, and her brother, Ankur Kak. Her close bond with Salman Khan has been a significant influence on her career, with Salman Khan serving as her mentor and guiding her in the film industry.

Amrita Kak's journey as a singer and entrepreneur showcases her talent, versatility, and connection to the Bollywood industry. Her collaborations with Salman Khan and her own fashion brand demonstrate her passion for music and creativity. As she continues to make her mark in the industry, Amrita Kak's contributions to Bollywood music are sure to leave a lasting impression.

item.title: Ambili Menon
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Ambili Menon

Playback Female Singer

Ambili Menon is a talented singer who gained recognition as the winner of the show "Sunsilk Gang of Girls." Since her early success, she has embarked on a global journey, captivating audiences with her powerful performances. With more than 1500 shows under her belt, Ambili has proven her ability to captivate and enthrall audiences worldwide.

 

One of Ambili's notable attributes is her versatility as a singer. She possesses the talent to perform in 11 different languages, showcasing her ability to connect with diverse audiences and cultures. This versatility allows her to deliver heartfelt performances that resonate with listeners from various backgrounds.

 

Ambili's unique style of engaging and interacting with her audience sets her apart from others in the industry. Her charismatic stage presence and ability to connect with her listeners create an immersive experience that leaves a lasting impact. This personalized approach gives her an edge and contributes to her growing popularity as a performer.

 

A highlight of Ambili's career includes her recent collaboration with legendary composer Jatin Pandit on the stage of Jammin 2, which aired on Sony Entertainment Television. This opportunity showcased her talent alongside esteemed artists and further solidified her position in the industry.

 

Additionally, Ambili has been involved in numerous radio and television award shows, further establishing her presence in the music scene. Her participation in these events highlights her recognition and appreciation within the industry.

Ambili Menon's journey as a singer has been marked by early success and continuous growth. With her powerhouse performances, versatile skills, engaging style, and notable collaborations, Ambili has made a name for herself in the music industry. Her talent and dedication promise a bright future filled with memorable performances and continued success.

item.title: Alka Ajith
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Alka Ajith

Playback Female Singer

Alka Ajith is an Indian playback singer, best known for winning season 2 of Airtel Super Singer Junior, a Tamil language music competition reality TV show broadcast on Vijay TV. She was awarded the Jaycey Foundation Best Female Singer Award in 2017.

 

Alka was born in Thalassery, Kerala, India, in 1996. Her father, M.P. Ajith Kumar, is a professional musician and organist, who runs Alka's orchestra, "Sangeeth Sagar". Alka first learnt music from her father. She studied in University of Madras in Chennai.

 

Alka started her singing career at a very young age. She has performed in various concerts and competitions, and has won several awards. item.title: Alisha Chinai
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Alisha Chinai

Playback Female Singer

Alisha Chinai, born on March 18, 1965, is an Indian pop singer known for her contributions to the Indi-pop genre and her playback singing in Hindi cinema. She rose to fame in the 1990s and was widely recognized as the 'Queen of Indipop.' Alisha made her singing debut with the album "Jadoo" in 1985, and her career took off from there.

Initially, Alisha's albums like "Babydoll," "Aah... Alisha!," "Madonna," "Kamasutra," and "Made in India" garnered significant attention. She collaborated with veteran music director Bappi Lahiri in the 1980s and delivered numerous disco hits in films such as "Adventures of Tarzan," "Dance Dance," "Commando," "Guru," "Love Love Love," and more. Alisha's playback singing career in Bollywood took off under the guidance of Bappi Lahiri, and she lent her voice to several leading actresses of that era.

During the 1990s, Alisha expanded her repertoire by collaborating with various music directors, including Anu Malik, Anand–Milind, Rajesh Roshan, and Nadeem-Shravan. She delivered several Bollywood hit songs like "Dhak Dhak Dhak," "Jalta Hai Badan," "Tere Ishq Mein Nachenge," "Chaa Raha Hain Pyaar Ka Nasha," "Roundhe," "Sona Sona Roop Hai," "Mouje Mein," "De Diya," "Ruk Ruk Ruk," and the controversial "Sexy Sexy Sexy Mujhe Log Bole."

In 1994, Alisha recorded the album "Bombay Girl" with Lesle Lewis, which featured the hit song "De De." Simultaneously, she released numerous pop albums and gained immense popularity with her 1995 album titled "Made in India," composed by Biddu. The album featured iconic songs like "Aaja Mere Dil Mein," "Ek Baar Do Baar," "Sun O Meri Dhadkan," "Tu Kahan," "Ooh La La," "Tu Jo Mila," "Dhokha Diya Hai Re Tune Mere Dil," and "Lover Girl." "Made in India" became one of the highest-selling pop albums of its time and propelled Alisha to stardom. After its success, she decided to focus solely on private pop albums and moved away from playback singing.

However, Alisha's subsequent releases didn't achieve the same level of success. During this period, she faced controversy when she accused Anu Malik, with whom she had recorded numerous hit songs, of molesting her. As a result, they didn't work together for several years but eventually reunited in 2003 for the film "Ishq Vishk."

Alisha made a comeback to film music with the song "Oh My Darling" in the Yash Raj film "Mujhse Dosti Karoge!" From 2000 to 2009, she collaborated with composers like Himesh Reshammiya, Shankar–Ehsaan–Loy, and Pritam. She also served as a judge on shows like Indian Idol 3 and Zee TV's Star Ya Rockstar alongside Anu Malik.

item.title: Akriti Kakar
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Akriti Kakar

Playback Female Singer

Akriti Kakar is an Indian playback singer and composer. She was born on 7 August 1986 in Delhi. She started her singing career at a very young age and has sung for many popular Bollywood films. Some of her most popular songs include "Saturday Saturday" from the film Humpty Sharma Ki Dulhania, "Iski Uski" from 2 States, "Dil Vich Lageya Ve" from Johnny Gaddaar, and "Chhamm Se" from Dus.

 

She has also won several awards for her singing, including the Best Female Playback Singer Award at the Filmfare Awards and the Screen Awards.

Akriti is also a talented composer and has composed music for several films and television shows. She is a versatile singer and composer who can sing in a variety of genres, including Bollywood, EDM, Sufi, and Ghazals.

She is a true constant both on the stage and in the studio, and her singing career is sure to continue to grow in the years to come.

item.title: Akanksha Bhandari
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Akanksha Bhandari

Playback Female Singer

Akanksha Bhandari is a versatile playback singer known for her expertise in soulful melodies and folk music. With her captivating voice and emotive performances, she has carved a niche for herself in the Indian music industry.

 

Known for her ability to convey emotions through her singing, Akanksha Bhandari excels in delivering soul-stirring melodies. Her renditions of romantic ballads and heartfelt tracks have garnered appreciation from both critics and audiences. She has the ability to infuse depth and passion into her vocals, bringing life to the compositions she sings.

 

Apart from soulful melodies, Akanksha Bhandari is also skilled in performing folk music. With her versatile range and versatility, she effortlessly embraces the diverse regional flavors of folk songs, showcasing her deep-rooted connection to Indian cultural music traditions. Her renditions of folk songs reflect her passion for preserving and promoting the rich musical heritage of the country.

 

Throughout her career, Akanksha Bhandari has collaborated with renowned composers and music directors, lending her voice to various Bollywood and regional film projects. Her ability to adapt to different musical styles and genres has made her a sought-after playback singer in the industry.

 

With her talent, versatility, and dedication to her craft, Akanksha Bhandari continues to captivate listeners with her soulful melodies and enchanting performances. Her contributions to the world of music have established her as a respected and admired playback singer, and her passion for soulful melodies and folk music ensures that her artistic journey remains diverse and compelling

item.title: Aishwarya Majmudar
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Aishwarya Majmudar

Playback Female Singer

Aishwarya Majmudar, born on October 5, 1993, is an Indian singer who gained recognition by winning the musical reality show STAR Voice of India - Chhote Ustad in 2007-08 at the age of 15. Throughout the competition, she received high praise from the judges and emerged as the winner alongside Anwesha Datta Gupta. Aishwarya later participated in the show Music Ka Maha Muqabala as part of Himesh Reshamiya's team, "Himesh's Warriors." She has sung in Gujarati and Hindi films and has been involved in various musical projects.

Aishwarya comes from a musical background, as both her parents are singers. She started her vocal training in Hindustani classical music at a young age and participated in Sa Re Ga Ma Pa at the age of seven. Before her success in the Chhote Ustaad competition, she had already made a name for herself in the Gujarati music industry. Aishwarya gave her first solo concert in Nagpur at the age of 11 and has performed numerous solo concerts in India and abroad.

Under the music direction of Gaurang Vyas, Aishwarya recorded her first solo album titled "Aishwarya," which featured Gujarati devotional songs. She has released several other albums including "Saat Suro na Sarname," "Paalav," "Swarabhishek," "Videshini," "Niralo Mukaam," "Aishwarya's Nursery Rhymes," "Sapna Sathe Aishwarya," and "Allak Mallak." She has also ventured into playback singing, recording songs for Gujarati, Hindi, and Kannada movies. Aishwarya has recorded songs for Hindi movies like "Hari Puttar: A Comedy of Terrors" and has lent her voice to the Hindi dubbing of the popular animated film series "Frozen."

In addition to her singing career, Aishwarya has worked as an anchor for various television shows, including Nach Baliye 4, Mummy ke Super Stars, Hum Young Hindustani, Little Star Awards 2008, and Harmony Silver Awards 2008. She also runs a successful YouTube channel with a substantial subscriber base and millions of views.

item.title: Aditi Singh Sharma
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Aditi Singh Sharma

Playback Female Singer

Aditi Singh Sharma is an Indian playback singer known for her contributions to Bollywood films. She made her debut as a playback singer in the movie Dev.D, directed by Anurag Kashyap. Aditi has lent her voice to several popular films, including No One Killed Jessica, Dhoom 3, 2 States, Agent Vinod, and Heroine, among others. Born in New Delhi, India, Aditi completed her education in Moscow, Russia, and later moved to Mumbai to pursue her career as a singer. She exhibited a keen interest in music from a young age. Aditi began her playback singing journey with the song "Yahi Meri Zindagi" from the film Dev.D, which garnered attention and marked the beginning of her successful career in the industry. Apart from her film work, Aditi Singh Sharma has performed in numerous live concerts. She has also showcased her talent on popular music shows such as MTV's Coke Studio and MTV Unplugged. Her performance with Pritam and Arijit Singh at the IIFA Awards received high praise from critics and audiences alike. Currently, Aditi is managed by Mourjo Chatterjee of On Stage Talents, who handles her professional engagements. In addition to her musical pursuits, Aditi is known among her family and friends for her cooking skills. She has garnered a reputation for being a talented cook alongside her successful singing career.

item.title: Aastha Gill
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Aastha Gill

Playback Female Singer

Aastha Gill is a popular Indian singer and songwriter who made her debut in the music industry with the lively track "Dhup Chik" from the movie Fugly. Her energetic vocals and peppy style garnered attention and established her as a promising artist. Following her successful debut, she released the dance number "Abhi Toh Party Shuru Hui Hai" for the film Khoobsurat, which further added to her growing fame.

Aastha Gill has become widely recognized for her hit singles, including "DJ Wale Babu," "Buzz," and "Naagin." These songs showcased her versatility as a vocalist and her ability to deliver catchy tunes that resonated with the audience. With her distinct voice and engaging performances, she has gained a dedicated fan base and has been a sought-after artist in the Indian music scene.

In addition to her musical endeavors, Aastha Gill ventured into the realm of reality television by participating in the stunt-based show Fear Factor: Khatron Ke Khiladi 11. This popular show features celebrities facing various challenging tasks and daring stunts, pushing their physical and mental limits. Aastha Gill's participation in the show demonstrated her adventurous spirit and willingness to take on new challenges.

item.title: Aditi Paul
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Aditi Paul

Playback Female Singer

Aditi Paul is an Indian playback singer known for her versatile vocals and contributions to the music industry. She gained recognition as the playback voice behind the song "Ang Laga De Re" from the Hindi film Goliyon Ki Raasleela Ram-Leela and "Veeron ke Veer Aa" from the blockbuster Baahubali 2: The Conclusion. Her melodic rendition of these songs showcased her talent and helped her establish a name in the industry.

 

Aditi Paul has also lent her voice to various other notable tracks, such as "En Kadhaal" from the Tamil film Vaaraayo Vennilaave, "En Mannava" (Tamil Version), and "Vo Manmadhaa" (Telugu Version) from the multilingual film Lingaa starring Rajinikanth. She has collaborated with renowned music director A. R. Rahman on these projects.

 

In addition to her playback singing career, Aditi Paul has showcased her skills on the reality show Indian Idol, where she participated in the debut season and was among the top 10 contestants. Her live performances with her band, both in India and abroad, have garnered acclaim and allowed her to connect with audiences on a personal level.

 

Aditi Paul's passion for music began at an early age, and she received initial training from her parents, who recognized her talent. She further honed her skills under the guidance of Pt. Ajoy Chakraborty, a renowned classical singer. Currently, she continues her training with Bhavdeep Jaipurwale in Mumbai, further enhancing her musical abilities.

Bela Sulakhe

Playback Female Singer

Bela Sulakhe is an Indian playback singer known for her contributions to Bollywood films. She was born and raised in Barshi, near Solapur. Bela displayed her talent for singing from a young age and gave her first solo performance at the age of nine.

Bela comes from a family with a musical background, and her father, Shrikant Sulakhe, was a well-known personality in Maharashtra. Bela Sulakhe has carried forward the musical legacy of her family and established herself as a playback singer in the Indian film industry.

As a playback singer, Bela has lent her melodious voice to numerous Bollywood films. Her songs have captivated audiences and contributed to the success of several movie soundtracks. With her versatility and soulful renditions, she has left a mark in the realm of Indian film music.

Bela Sulakhe's talent and passion for singing have earned her recognition and respect in the industry. She continues to enchant listeners with her beautiful vocals and remains a prominent figure in the world of Bollywood playback singing.
